places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a teppanyaki grill built on beef, pork and seafood; even the vegetable dishes use butter, cream and cheese sauces.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day cancellations charged (Tabelog). No cards at lunch; cards, e-money and PayPay otherwise, and a September 2026 diner paid by PayPay at lunch (Tabelog). 18 seats, counter and tables; private hire for 11 or more; smoking allowed in the evening, not at lunch; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Call ahead before bringing children (Tabelog). Sister restaurant: Yoshoku-ya Izanagi in Ebisu-cho (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Teppanyaki and drinks, from the counter griddle or the tables (18 seats) · daily blackboard menu · teppan hamburg steak (the house signature), misuji and Kuroge wagyu steaks, tonteki with Awaji onion steak, napa cabbage steak, Awaji onion in browned-butter cream sauce, napa cabbage with Gouda sauce, Kumamoto red eggplant with ginger sauce, smoked daikon with cream cheese, mint vegetable pickles, Akashi octopus sashimi, seared duck prosciutto, scallop bruschetta, potato salad topped with a fried egg, tenderloin cutlet, sukiyaki · lunch about ¥900–1,000 with salad: hamburg steak, tonteki, tonkatsu, beef-tendon curry, weekly special (fried salmon, yuzu-pepper fried chicken); large rice free · party courses with 90-minute all-you-can-drink: hamburg ¥5,680 (food only ¥3,880), creative teppanyaki ¥6,180 (¥4,380), sukiyaki of crossbred beef and Awaji onions ¥6,680 (¥4,880) · sake and wine
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Minamisenba, a hidden griddle counter for hamburg lunches and wine evenings] Tucked into the back of a building in a quiet Minamisenba alley, past the queue for the ramen shop out front, this calm counter-and-tables grill cooks in front of you. Lunch is busy with people working nearby: a fluffy, juicy teppan hamburg steak with roasted Awaji onions, or tonteki, curry or the weekly special, around ¥1,000 with a big salad and free large rice. In the evening the blackboard turns to the vegetables one regular raves about — a napa cabbage steak that amazed a first-timer, Awaji onions in browned-butter cream — alongside misuji steak, the house hamburg and sukiyaki, with a good sake and wine list. Party courses with all-you-can-drink suit groups; the whole room can be booked for 11 or more.

chef_bio.background: Teppanyaki izakaya in Minamisenba; the shop describes its dishes as cooked by skilled chefs and runs a sister restaurant, Yoshoku-ya Izanagi, in Ebisu-cho (Tabelog, shop-provided). A diner was back after about three years (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: A daily blackboard menu paired with sake; cooking at a counter you can watch (Tabelog, shop-provided). Ingredients from the Kansai region (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan hamburg steak; napa cabbage steak; Awaji onion dishes.

anecdotes.text: "The standout for me was the Napa cabbage steak… The sweetness and aroma were perfectly highlighted, making it a truly unique dish that only this restaurant could offer." — October 2025, fifth or sixth visit.
"The Hamburg Steak lunch was juicy and delicious… For just JPY 1,000, it even comes with a salad." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鉄板焼きとお酒 sAtori家、大阪市中央区南船場3-6-25 IBC心斎橋east 1F、心斎橋駅から北へ徒歩3分、月〜土11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:30〜23:30 (L.O. 23:00)、日曜・祝日休み、予約可、当日キャンセルは料金あり、ランチはカード不可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、18席、11名から貸切可、夜は喫煙可・昼は禁煙、Wi-Fiあり、子連れは電話で確認。店の紹介: 心斎橋の路地裏の隠れ家の鉄板焼き、カウンターで目の前で焼く、日替わりの黒板メニューと日本酒、ワインも豊富、アラカルトからコースまで、姉妹店の Yoshoku-ya Izanagi (Ebisu-cho)、ハンバーグのコース5680円 (料理のみ3880円)、創作鉄板焼きコース6180円 (4380円)、交雑牛と淡路島の玉ねぎのすき焼きコース6680円 (4880円)、飲み放題90分。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年10月): ビルの奥、手前のラーメン店の行列、鉄板ハンバーグ、淡路島の玉ねぎのステーキ、トンテキ、とんかつ、牛すじカレー、週替わり (鮭フライ、柚子胡椒の鶏の揚げ物)、昼は900〜1000円でサラダつき、ご飯大盛り無料、夜は白菜のステーキ、淡路島の玉ねぎの焦がしバタークリームソース、白菜のゴーダチーズソース、熊本の赤なすの生姜ソース、燻製大根とクリームチーズ、ミントのピクルス、ミスジのステーキ、黒毛和牛のステーキ、明石のタコの刺身、鴨の生ハムのあぶり、ホタテのブルスケッタ、目玉焼きをのせたポテトサラダ、ヒレカツ、すき焼き、関西の食材、ソースが少し辛かった、ご飯が柔らかかったという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: No cards at lunch; book for the evening (Tabelog).

places.name: 南船場Nat's食堂 (Minamisenba Nat's Shokudo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the lunch plates are built on fried shrimp, cutlets, croquettes and demi-glace or curry sauce, so ask about the hamburg steak and the grated-ponzu option.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, cutlets, fried shrimp and chicken make up the menu.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:30; Sat 17:30–22:30 (food last order 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Table reservations only for full meals; at dinner a ¥1,000 charge applies when you only eat (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats: 7 at an L-shaped counter, two tables of 4; smoking allowed at dinner, no smoking at lunch; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Lunch rice refills cost ¥100 from April 2025 (April 2025 review). Opened 22 April 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Minami-Senba 3-1-7, ground floor at the back of the building (several shops share it) — 6 min north of Shinsaibashi Stn exits 1 and 2
places.cuisine: Yoshoku lunch and an evening bistro with wine and sake (15 seats) · daily lunch plate ¥1,000–1,100 (2026): hamburg steak with two of fried shrimp, cream croquette, beef cutlet, bite-sized pork cutlet, white-fish fry or chicken-wing kara-age, with soup, salad and rice · Nat's hamburg steak ¥1,000 in a hot skillet, cooked to order, with demi-glace, beef-tendon curry sauce or grated-daikon ponzu · hamburg steak and Angus beef cutlet ¥1,280 · omurice · tonteki set · soup of the day (corn chowder, pumpkin, potato) · evenings: fish delivered daily, market vegetables, rice milled to order, wine and sake (shop text)
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Minami-Senba, the hamburg-steak lunch hidden at the back of a building] A small Western-style diner tucked deep inside a ground-floor arcade of shops north of Shinsaibashi, announced by a board that asks whether you have ever eaten a truly delicious hamburg steak. It fills up at lunch for the daily plate: a meaty hamburg paired with fried shrimp and a cream croquette, a beef cutlet or juicy chicken-wing kara-age, with the soup of the day (corn chowder, pumpkin) and salad, for about ¥1,000–1,100. The house hamburg is seared crisp in a hot skillet and comes with demi-glace, grated-daikon ponzu, or a beef-tendon curry sauce simmered for a week that, per a September 2026 diner, won a 2013 award for European-style curry. One diner found the hamburg didn't match the board's boast; the daily plate is what most order. Heavy metal plays. At night it becomes a bistro pouring wine and sake. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Yoshoku restaurant and bistro that opened on 22 April 2013; a corporate-member Tabelog listing (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh seafood delivered daily, unusual vegetables bought straight from the wholesale market and rice milled each time, with carefully made sauces; wines and sake chosen to match (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Hamburg steak with fried shrimp and croquettes; beef-tendon curry sauce.

anecdotes.text: "Today's special was a golden trio of Hamburg Steak, Ebi Fry, and a Bite-sized Cutlet, a classic selection from a Western-style restaurant." — March 2025, daily lunch special (the same diner's ninth visit was in August 2026).
"This curry sauce is a European-style curry that has been simmered for a week and won the Ultimate Curry Award 2013 for European-style curry." — September 2026, Nat's Hamburger Steak ¥1,000.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 南船場Nat's食堂、大阪市中央区南船場3-1-7 日宝東心斎橋ビル 1F、心斎橋駅1・2番出口から北へ徒歩6分ほど、月〜金11:30〜14:00・17:30〜22:30、土17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 料理21:30、ドリンク22:00)、日曜・祝日休み、席の予約は食事のコースのみ、ディナータイムの食事のみの場合はチャージ料1,000円、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、15席 (カウンター7、テーブル4×2)、昼は禁煙・夜は喫煙可、貸切20名まで、オープン日2013年4月22日、法人会員の店。店の紹介: 毎日届く鮮魚、市場から直接仕入れる野菜、その都度精米するお米、こだわりのソース、料理に合うワインと日本酒。口コミ(2025年3月〜2026年10月): ビルの奥の目立たない洋食店、「本当においしいハンバーグを食べたことがありますか!」の看板、日替わりランチ1000〜1100円 (ハンバーグとエビフライ、クリームコロッケ、牛カツ、一口カツ、白身魚フライ、手羽唐揚げ)、Nat'sハンバーグ1000円は鉄板で、注文を受けてから焼く、デミグラス・牛すじカレーソース・特製おろしポン酢から選ぶ、カレーソースは1週間煮込んだ欧風カレーで2013年のアワード受賞、ハンバーグとアンガス牛カツ1280円、オムライス、トンテキ定食、日替わりスープ (コーンチャウダー、かぼちゃ、じゃがいも)、2025年4月からご飯の大盛り・おかわりは100円、BGMはヘヴィメタル、看板ほどではなかったという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; lunch is first come (2026).

places.name: 橋本屋 (Hashimoto Ya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; one chicken curry built on chicken broth, kombu, onions and freshly ground spices, with spiced rice, but no source says whether any flour or soy sauce goes in.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the only dish is a chicken curry on a whole-chicken broth, with an egg, and the rice is cooked with chicken fat.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Thu 11:45–13:30; closed Friday–Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Reopened 8 September 2026 after a break (Tabelog). Numbered tickets are handed out from about 10:05 at the shop: each person in line (up to 4 per representative) chooses a time slot, orders and pays cash on the spot, then returns 5 minutes before the slot (Tabelog; October 2026 reviews). October 2026 diners lined up from 9:15–9:55 and were given slots from 10:50 to 12:20; servings run out (one April 2026 diner had ticket 35 of about the last 40). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026 reviews). 16 seats: 6 at the counter, 10 at tables; non-smoking; school-age children welcome (Tabelog). The room is a dimly lit bar at night (October 2026 reviews). Tabelog Award Bronze 2025 and 2026; Tabelog Curry WEST Top 100 2026; rated 4.02.
places.neighborhood: Minami-Senba 2-2-21, near Shinsaibashi-suji — 4 min from Nagahoribashi Stn
places.cuisine: One dish: clay-pot chicken curry ("Rich Chicken Curry") ¥1,400 (October 2026) (16 seats) · spice levels 0–3, and even 1 is hot · in the pot: tender chicken, a soft-boiled egg and marinated tomatoes in a thin, soup-like curry; about 20 whole spices ground in an electric mill for each order; broth from Daisendori and two kinds of whole chicken with Rausu kombu and onions (October 2026 review) · spiced rice cooked with chicken fat, about 10 spices and onions, served apart; large rice +¥100 · add-ons: extra chicken, onion pickles (achaar) · an eating guide: smell, sip the clear top, eat with rice, then tip the rice into the pot and break the egg for a porridge finish, with spice and Sichuan-pepper grinders on the table
places.notes: [Curry · Minami-Senba, one clay-pot chicken curry and a morning ticket line] One of Osaka's most sought-after curries, a Tabelog Award Bronze winner in 2025 and 2026, served at lunch Monday to Thursday in a dim room that is a bar at night. There is one dish: chicken curry brought bubbling in a clay pot, with tender chicken, a soft-boiled egg and marinated tomatoes in a thin, soup-like curry that tastes of whole spices ground to order rather than curry powder. A card explains how to eat it: smell it, sip the clear top like soup, eat it with the spiced rice, then tip the rice and onion pickles into the pot and break the egg for a creamy porridge. To eat, queue from about 9:30, take a numbered ticket when they are handed out around 10:05, order and pay cash, and come back at your time slot; the day's servings go by mid-morning. Diners describe a gentle owner and pleasant staff; one found the flavour a little monotonous, and another thought one visit enough.

chef_bio.background: Curry shop with Tabelog Award Bronze in 2025 and 2026 and Tabelog Curry WEST Top 100 in 2026 (Tabelog); reopened on 8 September 2026 (Tabelog). The owner hands out the numbered tickets (April 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Spices ground fresh for each serving (about 20 whole spices, per an October 2026 review); a guide card for eating the curry in stages.
chef_bio.specialty: Clay-pot "Rich Chicken Curry" with spiced rice.

anecdotes.text: "The interior feels like a 'BAR.' It's dimly lit and calm, with the sound of an electric mill grinding about 20 types of whole spices after each order, filling the air with a fresh and intense aroma of spices." — October 2026, Clay Pot Chicken Curry (mild) ¥1,400.

"There are various suggestions on how to eat, but the owner was very gentle and the staff were all very pleasant… even after waiting in line for so long in the morning, I didn't feel annoyed at all." — October 2026, Rich Chicken Curry, level 1, small rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 橋本屋、大阪市中央区南船場2-2-21、長堀橋駅から徒歩4分、月〜木11:45〜13:30、金〜日・祝日休み、2026年9月8日営業再開、整理券の配布は10:05ごろ、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10)、禁煙、小学生から可、The Tabelog Award 2025・2026 Bronze、食べログ カレー WEST 百名店 2026、評価4.02。口コミ(2025年11月〜2026年10月): 9:15〜9:55ごろから並び、10:05ごろから整理券、代表者1人で4人まで、その場で時間と注文を決めて現金で前払い、時間の5分前に戻る、10:50〜12:20の枠、35番前後で売り切れ、メニューは芳醇チキンカレー1400円だけ、辛さ0〜3、ライス大盛り+100円、チキン増し、玉ねぎのアチャール、土鍋でぐつぐつ、柔らかい鶏肉、半熟卵、トマトのマリネ、さらっとしたスープのようなカレー、注文ごとに電動ミルで約20種のホールスパイスを挽く、Daisendori と2種類の丸鶏、Rausu の昆布、玉ねぎのだし、鶏油と約10種のスパイスと玉ねぎで炊いたごはん、食べ方の指南書 (香り、上澄み、ごはんと、最後にごはんを土鍋に入れて卵を崩しておじや風)、卓上のスパイスミルと花椒、夜はバーになる薄暗い店内、やさしい店主と感じのよいスタッフ、一度で十分、単調という声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue before 10:00 for a numbered ticket; order and pay cash in line (2026).

places.name: 居酒屋 十兵衛 (Izakaya Jubei)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the 12 sauces for the grilled thigh include sweet miso, wasabi soy and curry, and the menu has tonkatsu, chicken katsu, kushikatsu and yakisoba; salt-grilled yakitori is the place to start asking.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken izakaya; the lunch sets are chicken or pork with miso soup.

Lunch has a line most weekdays, with waits of 10–20 minutes around noon (2025–2026 reviews); lunch bento to take away (April 2026 review; shop site). Reservations accepted; parties of 12 or more by arrangement; private hire up to 20; all-you-can-drink (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a long L-shaped counter and two tables of four at the back (September 2026 review); smoking allowed except at lunch (Tabelog). Opened 21 January 2016 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Chicken izakaya with a cheap, busy lunch (20 seats) · lunch: grilled chicken thigh set ¥850 (October 2026) with crisp skin on cabbage, single, double or triple, with two of 12 sauces (stamina garlic, salt, spicy, spicy curry, wasabi soy, sweet miso, green onion, ginger, a shichimi set with yuzu pepper) · mixed set (thigh and a cutlet), tonkatsu set, chicken katsu, pork thigh · free raw egg, refills of rice and miso soup · chicken-katsu bento ¥600 with miso soup to take away (April 2026) · night: yakitori (heart, harami with tare, negima on a long iron skewer, yagen cartilage, seseri), whole grilled thigh, sliced onion, "addictive" cabbage, kimchi, fried eggplant, horumon with ponzu, plain salt yakisoba with egg yolk · sake and shochu; the shop site names yakitori (from 大山産がいな鶏 chicken), kushikatsu and oden as the three mainstays
places.notes: [Izakaya · Minami-Senba, the chicken-thigh lunch with twelve sauces] A narrow, retro counter izakaya near Shinsaibashi that draws a line at lunch for a very cheap, hearty set: a whole grilled chicken thigh, skin crackling, laid on cabbage, with two sauces picked from a list of twelve (the garlicky stamina sauce is the favourite), a free raw egg, and refills of rice and miso soup, ¥850. Diners go double or mix it with a cutlet, and finish a second bowl of rice as tamago kake gohan. At night the owner runs the room alone: yakitori from heart to seseri, the same grilled thigh, horumon with ponzu, quick plates of cabbage and kimchi, and a plain salt yakisoba, with local sake. At a busy lunch, one diner had to ask twice for the free egg.

roles: Owner (runs the room alone at dinner, per a September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Izakaya that opened on 21 January 2016; a corporate-member Tabelog listing (Tabelog). The shop site describes a cheap izakaya for office workers, banquets and solo drinkers.
chef_bio.philosophy: Yakitori, kushikatsu and oden as three mainstays, none done by halves (shop site).
chef_bio.specialty: Grilled chicken thigh with a choice of 12 sauces; yakitori.

anecdotes.text: "You can also select two sauces from a choice of 12, and I went with the spicy sauce and wasabi soy sauce. Apparently, there's even a triple option." — September 2025, double grilled chicken thigh set.
"The interior features a long L-shaped counter with two tables for four at the back, all managed by the owner alone." — September 2026, dinner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋 十兵衛、大阪市中央区南船場3-8-1、堺筋本町駅から徒歩5分・心斎橋駅から徒歩7分、月〜金11:00〜14:30・18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、土11:00〜14:30、日曜・祝日休み、予約可、12名以上は相談、貸切20名まで、飲み放題、カード可 (VISA、Master、JCB、AMEX、Diners)、電子マネー・QR不可、20席、昼のみ禁煙、オープン日2016年1月21日、法人会員の店。店のサイト: 本町・心斎橋・南船場の安いうまい居酒屋、焼き鳥 (大山産がいな鶏)・串かつ・おでんの三本柱、宴会、飲み放題、全メニューテイクアウト可、ランチタイムに店頭でお弁当。口コミ(2025年7月〜2026年10月): 平日の昼はいつも行列、もも焼き定食850円、皮はパリッと、キャベツの上に、ダブル・トリプルも、12種類のソースから2つ (スタミナ、塩だれ、辛口、辛口カレー、わさび醤油、甘味噌、ねぎ、生姜、七味と柚子胡椒)、ミックス定食、豚カツ定食、チキンカツ、豚もも、生卵1個無料、ご飯と味噌汁はおかわり自由、卵かけご飯に、テイクアウトのチキンカツ弁当600円 (味噌汁付き)、夜は店主ひとり、長いL字のカウンターと奥に4人のテーブル2つ、焼き鳥 (ハツ、はらみ、ねぎま、やげん軟骨、せせり)、鶏もも一枚焼き、オニオンスライス、やみつきキャベツ、キムチ、なす揚げ、ホルモンポン酢、シンプルな塩焼きそば、地酒、昼は忙しく卵を2回頼んだという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Lunch line at noon; pick two sauces from the list (2026).

places.cuisine: Katsu-don counter from a former sumo wrestler (14 seats) · thick pork loin cutlet marinated and cooked slowly at low temperature, then fried, laid over a soft, runny egg on rice rather than simmered in it, so the crust stays crisp; the shop says 5 cm thick · sizes by the weight of cutlet: regular 200 g ¥1,500, jo 300 g ¥2,000, and a larger special (2025–2026) · pork miso soup included · ponzu, mustard, yuzu pepper, rock salt and katsu sauce to change the taste · takeaway; Hoegaarden beer
places.notes: [Katsu-don · Shinmachi near Yotsubashi, very thick cutlets from a former sumo wrestler] A bright little katsu-don shop opened in September 2025 as a sister shop of Sennichimae's long-queue thick-cut tonkatsu, once called Chiyomatsu and now Osaka Tonkatsu; the shop is run by a former sumo wrestler, and a life-size panel of the wrestler stands inside. The pork is marinated and cooked low and slow before frying, so the thick cutlet is tender and seasoned all the way through, and it sits on a soft egg over the rice instead of being simmered in it, which keeps the crust crisp. Sizes go by weight (200 g regular ¥1,500, 300 g jo ¥2,000), with pork miso soup and a tray of ponzu, mustard and yuzu pepper. Opinions split: many love it, others found the pre-seasoned pork ham-like or too salty, and the miso soup thin. Order on your phone by QR code; English menu.

roles: Former sumo wrestler (runs the shop, per Tabelog and 2025–2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Katsu-don shop that opened on 20 September 2025 (Tabelog); a sister shop of the Sennichimae thick-cut tonkatsu shop once called Chiyomatsu and renamed Osaka Tonkatsu, which also has a stall in the Abeno Hoop dining court (January and March 2026 reviews). A life-size panel of the wrestler stands in the shop (January 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Thick meat slow-cooked for a tender, juicy, generous bowl; satisfying portions (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Very thick low-temperature katsu-don with egg underneath.

anecdotes.text: "Since this Katsu-don is not topped with a beaten egg, the katsu remains crispy and fresh. You can enjoy the tonkatsu with the accompanying yuzu pepper, mustard, and special sauce to change up the flavors." — April 2026, regular katsu-don ¥1,500.
"The main branch is in Namba, and the name has now changed to 'Osaka Tonkatsu.' I decided to try this new location, which seems to be a sister restaurant." — January 2026, katsu-don regular ¥1,500.

places.name: イタリアンバル食堂チャコ (Italian Bar Shokudo Chako)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The shop says it can leave allergen ingredients out on request but cannot guarantee complete removal or prevent cross-contamination; the menu leans on fresh wheat pasta, bruschetta, fried calamari and fries fried in lard.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Wagyu, pork, prosciutto, liver mousse, mussels, sea urchin and cheese run through the menu; even the cover charge is a cheese appetizer.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Fri 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 straight through (à la carte or courses, day drinking welcome, no lunch menu); last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30; closed Tuesday and some long weekends (Tabelog). Weekday lunch for reserved groups only (Tabelog). Regular reservations up to 4 people, 5–8 by phone; one drink minimum at dinner; seats may be limited to about 2 h 20 min when busy; cover charge ¥450 (a cheese appetizer), waived with a course (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 18 seats: 10 at the counter, 8 at tables, plus standing room; non-smoking, smoking area outside; children welcome (one low seat, the rest high chairs); the shop asks guests not to wear strong perfume (Tabelog). Opened 26 August 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nambanaka 3-9-7 — 6 min from Nankai Namba Stn, south of Namba Parks
places.cuisine: Casual Italian bar and diner (18 seats) · specialties: foie gras terrine and prosciutto bruschetta ¥880, sea urchin and potato cream (shredded potato like pasta) ¥1,600, white corn mousse with salmon roe and crab ¥1,380 · A4 Kuroge Wagyu roast steak, slow-cooked and finished over charcoal (200 g ¥3,200), Wagyu and pork hamburg, charcoal-grilled Oita pork, beef stew · Aomori mussels steamed in white wine ¥1,200, then risotto from the broth (+¥700); acqua pazza with risotto or pasta from the broth · fresh pasta from Awaji Noodles: Wagyu Bolognese tagliatelle ¥1,480, cacio e pepe · burrata with fruit, ajillo, fried calamari, lard-fried fries · seasonal blackboard specials · prices from the Tabelog menu updated 16 October 2026 · about 10 wines chosen by a sommelier, mostly natural, from ¥550; Peroni on draft; Japanese craft beer · courses with 2- or 3-hour free-flow drinks ¥5,500 / ¥6,600
places.notes: [Italian bar · Nambanaka, a natural-wine diner south of Namba Parks] A small, warm-wood Italian bar a few minutes south of Namba Parks that opened in 2024; one regular is already on a seventh visit. The order to make is the Aomori mussels steamed in white wine, then a risotto made from the broth; diners rave about the acqua pazza done the same way. Around it: foie gras and prosciutto bruschetta, sea urchin over shredded potato in cream, Wagyu roast steak slow-cooked and finished over charcoal (order it early, it takes time), and fresh pasta finished as Bolognese with chunks of braised Wagyu. Handwritten blackboard specials change with the season, and a few dishes, such as a Rossini, are kept for return visits. Wines are mostly natural, from ¥550 a glass. Weekends run from noon straight through to 23:00 for day drinking. It gets lively, so book.

chef_bio.background: Italian bar and diner that opened on 26 August 2024 (Tabelog); a sommelier picks about 10 wines, mostly natural (Tabelog, shop-provided). Staff described as attentive and kind (September 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Italian-inspired dishes from seasonal ingredients to go with wine, in a relaxed setting; guests are asked to skip strong perfume so the food and wine can be smelled (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Mussels steamed in white wine with risotto from the broth; charcoal-finished Wagyu roast; foie gras and prosciutto bruschetta.

anecdotes.text: "First up was the mussels steamed in white wine. The plump mussels were accompanied by a flavorful broth, and I loved that I could turn the leftover broth into risotto." — September 2026, seventh visit, Today's Recommendations from the blackboard.
"For the finale, we had Bolognese, but instead of ground meat, it was chunks of tender, shredded meat. I was completely moved by this dish." — September 2026, 3-hour free-flow course ¥6,600.

places.name: 鉄板彩菜やまぐち (Teppan Saisai Yamaguchi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the Wagyu is served with salt, ponzu or soy sauce (March 2026), so ask for salt, and check the garlic rice, potage and appetizers.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Wagyu teppanyaki counter; appetizers include prosciutto, and the meal comes with red miso soup.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:30); closed Monday, open when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; birthday plates and anniversary courses on request (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY; no e-money; no cover charge (Tabelog). 9 seats around a U-shaped counter; non-smoking, ashtray outside; children welcome; private use up to 20 (Tabelog). Instagram @saisai_yamaguchi (linked in an October 2023 review). Opened 17 January 2019 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Teppanyaki of Black Wagyu and seasonal vegetables at a 9-seat U-shaped counter · the shop names Yamagata beef · lunch (Tabelog lunch menu, April 2025): Teppan Black Wagyu lunch ¥3,180 (salad, potage, grilled vegetables, 100 g top sirloin, rice, red miso soup, pickles, frozen dessert, coffee or tea), special Black Wagyu steak lunch ¥4,280, strip loin ¥5,780, fillet ¥6,080; garlic rice +¥700 · steak rice bowl ¥1,280, 10 a day (October 2025) · dinner courses ¥7,080 / ¥9,200 / ¥12,000 / premium ¥17,000: assorted appetizers, potage, salad, grilled vegetables, Wagyu, garlic rice · live lobster and abalone by reservation (2022 menu) · sake, shochu, wine; non-alcoholic red-wine juice
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Minami-Senba, a nine-seat Wagyu counter near Nagahoribashi] A quiet, stylish counter of nine seats wrapped around the teppan, so every seat watches the grilling, with art pieces around the room. The owner-chef grills Black Wagyu (the shop names Yamagata beef) and seasonal vegetables in front of you; diners praise the vegetables as much as the meat, a rich potage served hot or cold, a small assortment of appetizers, and garlic rice to finish, with salt, ponzu or soy sauce for the beef. Lunch is the deal: a Black Wagyu set from ¥3,180, or a limited steak rice bowl. Dinner courses run ¥7,080 to ¥17,000. The service is homey: staff have arranged birthday plates and cakes, lent a shawl to a pregnant guest, and the chef likes to chat after the meal.

roles: Owner-chef (grills at the counter, per 2023–2025 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Teppanyaki counter that opened on 17 January 2019 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a warm, humble owner who grills in front of guests and tells entertaining stories after the meal (October 2023, April 2025 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Carefully chosen beef and vegetables grilled in front of guests; particular about where the vegetables come from (Tabelog, shop-provided; October 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Black Wagyu steak; grilled seasonal vegetables; garlic rice.

anecdotes.text: "The star of the meal, the Black Wagyu Top Sirloin, had just the right amount of marbling… allowing me to enjoy it with salt, ponzu, or soy sauce." — March 2026, Black Wagyu Saisai Course ¥7,080.
"Since I was pregnant, a female staff member kindly lent me a shawl when I sat down… The chef grilled the vegetables and meat right in front of us." — July 2025, course.

places.name: Restaurant つじ川 (Restaurant Tsujikawa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the course builds on dashi and miso, and includes homemade focaccia, a fermented-butter pie and several desserts, so ask when booking.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the courses run on fish, shellfish, foie gras and beef, with dashi-based sauces.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 18:00–22:00; Sat and Sun 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservation only, online or by phone; same-day seats sometimes available by phone; departure times within two hours of the booking are not accepted (Tabelog). Cash only since 6 July 2026, when the shop's card processor went bankrupt; no split bills; 5% service charge at dinner (Tabelog). 12 seats: 8 at an L-shaped counter, one table of 4; non-smoking; no children (Tabelog). Tabelog Innovative/Creative Top 100, 2025. Opened 21 April 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Minami-Senba 3-2-28, Taiyo Bldg — 5 min from Shinsaibashi, Honmachi or Nagahoribashi Stn
places.cuisine: French techniques with Japanese ingredients such as dashi and miso, eaten with chopsticks (12 seats) · omakase course of 12–13 dishes ¥14,770, with focaccia baked in house and a choice of five homemade desserts (Tabelog; September 2026 review) · menu changes about eight times a year · examples: root celery mousse with Ezo abalone, sea urchin and three-flavor vinegar; sea bream tartare with turnip and pear; sautéed scallops with shiitake, balsamic and seaweed; foie gras mousse with persimmon and fermented-butter pie; isaki with burdock purée and sea bream dashi espuma; domestic beef fillet with roast sweet potato and porcini; grilled matsutake risotto (September 2026); grilled eel with truffle sauce over rice (May 2026) · desserts such as chocolate terrine, matcha madeleine, brown sugar pudding, white sesame blancmange, honey and pepper ice cream · weekend lunch course (cash only) · wine-focused list, sweet wines with the foie gras
places.notes: [French-Japanese · Minami-Senba, a couple-run counter for French food you eat with chopsticks] A small counter between Shinsaibashi and Honmachi, open since 2014 and in Tabelog's Innovative 100 for 2025, where French techniques of taking a dish apart and rebuilding it meet Japanese dashi, miso and seasonal fish. The single omakase runs 12 or 13 dishes for ¥14,770 — think a root celery mousse with Ezo abalone and sea urchin, foie gras mousse with persimmon, isaki with burdock and a sea bream dashi foam, a beef fillet main that regulars call the best part, and a grilled matsutake risotto to finish — then five desserts, and you may choose all of them. The homemade focaccia comes with refills; diners warn to pace yourself. A couple runs the room warmly. Weekend lunch is a good-value way in. Pay cash: the card processor went under in July 2026.

roles: Chef (cooks in front of the counter)
chef_bio.background: Opened on 21 April 2014 (Tabelog); Tabelog Innovative/Creative Top 100 in 2025. Run by a couple, per two reviews by the same diner (July 2024, September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: French deconstruction and reconstruction applied to Japanese ingredients such as dashi and miso; a seasonal menu changed about eight times a year, easy to eat with chopsticks (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase French-Japanese course; homemade focaccia; five desserts.

anecdotes.text: "The focaccia is tasty, but be careful not to overindulge, as it may prevent you from enjoying the five desserts at the end… The couple running the place provides warm and pleasant service." — September 2026, omakase course, ¥14,770 with service charge.
"Usually, I'm not surprised by the main dish at any course meal, even if it's delicious, but this was shockingly good." — May 2026, roasted domestic beef fillet with pumpkin and balsamic.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Restaurant つじ川、大阪市中央区南船場3丁目2-28 タイヨービル、心斎橋・本町・長堀橋駅から徒歩5分、火〜金18:00〜22:00、土日12:00〜14:00・18:00〜22:00、月曜休み、完全予約制、予約から2時間以内の退店は不可、2026年7月6日にカード会社が倒産したため現金のみ、割り勘不可、ディナーはサービス料5%、12席 (カウンター8、テーブル4)、禁煙、子供不可、食べログ 創作料理・イノベーティブ 百名店 2025、オープン日2014年4月21日。店の紹介: フレンチの解体と再構築の技法に、だしや味噌などの和の食材、年に8回ほど変わる季節のメニュー、自家製の焼きたてフォカッチャ、5種のデザート、おまかせコース14770円。口コミ(2024年7月〜2026年9月): ご夫婦の温かいサービス、L字のカウンター、ウニとEzo のアワビ、鯛のタルタル、帆立のソテー、フォアグラのムースと柿、イサキとごぼう、国産牛フィレ、焼き松茸のリゾット、鰻のトリュフソースご飯、5種のデザート、フォカッチャのお代わり、ランチは現金のみ。

places.name: 鮨とよたか (Sushi Toyotaka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the omakase includes soy-marinated tuna, anago with glaze, miso soup and dishes with soy sauce, so ask when booking (the shop adjusts for dislikes told in advance, per a May 2026 review).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase of fish and shellfish, with a bonito-dashi anago shabu-shabu.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Sun 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–23:00; Tue 18:00–23:00 (Tabelog). The Senba Uraroji site lists 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00). Reservation only (Tabelog); a May 2026 diner booked by phone and paid a deposit through a text-message link. Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Allow about 2.5 hours for the dinner course (July 2026 review). Inside Senba Uraroji, a renovated machiya with several restaurants; the entrance down the alley is easy to miss (Senba Uraroji site; 2026 reviews). Opened 13 December 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Minami-Senba 4-10-22, Senba Uraroji 1F (end of the alley) — 6 min from Shinsaibashi or Yotsubashi Stn
places.cuisine: Edomae sushi counter (8 seats) mixing Tokyo and Kansai technique: aged, vinegar- or kombu-cured and simmered fish on red-vinegar rice · omakase with free-flow drinks ¥20,000, about 20–22 dishes (July–August 2026; TableCheck), sake among 15–20 kinds; lunch omakase nigiri with free-flow drinks ¥10,000 (TableCheck) · a May 2026 diner paid ¥16,000 for the only course · typical summer course (July–August 2026): toro-taku of aged tuna with miso-pickled takuan, abalone in chilled seawater, aged Akashi sea bream, corn chawanmushi, mackerel sushi, octopus and sweetfish, Densuke anago shabu-shabu with grated daikon and ponzu, then nigiri (swordtip squid, aged flounder, scallop, horse mackerel, marinated tuna, o-toro, hokkigai, shima ebi, sea urchin gunkan piled high, anago with salt and yuzu), miso soup from the shabu-shabu broth, watermelon
places.notes: [Sushi · Minami-Senba, an alley-end Edomae counter where the drinks are included] At the far end of the Senba Uraroji alley, in a renovated machiya, an eight-seat wooden counter serves what diners call Osaka-style Edomae sushi: fish aged for days, cured with vinegar or kombu, or simmered, on mild red-vinegar rice. The dinner omakase (¥20,000 in summer 2026) includes free-flow drinks, sake among them, so drinkers find it a rare bargain. It runs to about 20 dishes: it opens with a toro-taku hand roll of aged tuna and miso-pickled daikon, peaks with a shabu-shabu of a 700 g Densuke anago, and ends with a sea urchin gunkan stuffed and heaped with urchin, miso soup from the anago broth, and watermelon. Portions are generous; ask for smaller nigiri if needed. The chef is friendly and chats across the counter. Reservation only; budget 2.5 hours.

chef_bio.background: Trained at Edomae sushi restaurants in Tokyo and at sushi shops in Kyoto (August 2026 review); another August 2026 review adds Nagoya and says the chef wanted to be a sushi chef since childhood. Time Out Osaka (July 2022) introduced the shop as Edomae sushi made by a woman sushi chef who had won a Michelin Bib Gourmand; the 2026 reviews read do not say whether the same chef is at the counter. Opened 13 December 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Bring out each fish with Edomae methods — aging, curing with vinegar or kombu, simmering — so each piece is a dish in itself (Tabelog and Senba Uraroji site, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Aged-fish omakase; Densuke anago shabu-shabu; sea urchin gunkan.

anecdotes.text: "Densuke refers to those over 300g, and this one was 700g… The grated daikon is so good you could drink it!" — July 2026, omakase course with free drinks ¥20,000.
"I was able to enjoy scallops, which I usually dislike, for the first time in my life!" — May 2026, ¥16,000 course.

It's often full, so book; lunch stopped in April 2026.

chef_bio.background: Italian restaurant that opened on 23 September 2016 (Tabelog); a repeat diner heard it was the tenth anniversary in 2026 (August 2026 review). Fish, organic vegetables and meat come straight from Tango, the owner's home region; the owner chooses the wines (Tabelog, shop-provided). One chef runs the kitchen (July 2026 review). A repeat diner mentions playing with the owner's daughter (August 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal Italian built on the day's ingredients from Tango, so the dishes differ visit to visit (Tabelog, shop-provided).

"When dessert arrived, I honestly expected just a small gelato, but I was astonished by the beautifully crafted dessert that was served." — September 2026, ¥6,500 course.

places.cuisine: Okinawa soba specialist (10 counter seats) · clear golden broth of katsuobushi, kombu, niboshi and dried clams with two Okinawan salts and a splash of awamori · flat, medium-thick noodles developed with a noodle factory · Tengan soba ¥1,200 (grilled three-layer pork belly and salt-simmered cartilage soki) · salt cartilage soki soba ¥950 · back-fat topping ¥100 · summer chilled Churaumi soba ¥980 · aosa seaweed soba · small jushi (Okinawan mixed rice) ¥200, with mozuku vinegar · Po-Tama onigiri (Spam and omelet) half ¥200, ¥150 at lunch · fresh shredded ginger, kamaboko, tied kombu · koregusu and yuzu kosho on the counter
places.notes: [Okinawa soba · Minamisenba, a lunch counter with a line of office workers] A ten-seat counter in Minamisenba's office blocks that opened in 2024 as the area's first Okinawa soba specialist, and now often has a line at weekday lunch. The shop takes the broth seriously: katsuobushi and kombu with niboshi, dried clams, two kinds of Okinawan salt and a splash of awamori, poured clear and golden over flat, medium-thick noodles worked out with a noodle factory. Fresh shredded ginger stands in for the usual pickled kind. The big bowl is the Tengan soba (¥1,200), with crisp-grilled three-layer pork and tender salt-simmered cartilage soki; the salt soki soba (¥950) is the everyday order, and one diner on a 71st visit still adds the ¥100 back fat. In summer there's a chilled Churaumi soba. Add a small jushi or a Po-Tama onigiri, and season with koregusu or yuzu kosho from the counter. Lunch only, no cards (PayPay is fine), and it closes when the soup runs out. A second shop runs in Honmachi.

chef_bio.background: Okinawa soba shop that opened on 17 April 2024 as the first Okinawa soba specialist in Minamisenba (Tabelog, shop-provided); the Honmachi branch marked its first anniversary in December 2025 (review). A diner chatted with the owner in July 2024 (review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Serious about broth and noodles: noodles researched with the noodle factory down to blend and size; broth of katsuobushi and kombu with two kinds of Okinawan salt, dried clams and a splash of awamori (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Tengan soba; salt cartilage soki soba.

anecdotes.text: "The broth is light yet rich in umami, and the addition of back fat enhances its deliciousness. The noodles are special flat, medium-thick noodles with a smooth texture…" — October 2026, 71st visit, Tengan Soba ¥1,200 with back fat ¥100.
"The bonito broth was rich and flavorful... and instead of pickled ginger, [the shop] used fresh shredded ginger, which was a nice touch!" — September 2026.

places.notes: [Mexican · Shinmachi, a carne-asada izakaya on Tabelog's 2026 ethnic Top 100] A glass-fronted cantina with a big sign and cacti outside, north of Yotsubashi, playing Latin music, that made Tabelog's Asian/Ethnic WEST Top 100 in 2026. The star is the carne asada: lean steak cooked rare, eaten on its own first, then wrapped in a tortilla with chili con carne, jalapeño pickles, mashed potato and fresh salsa. Around it, Mexican-izakaya plates with a Japanese streak: spiced beans with sansho, spicy takuan, shibire chicken in a sansho sauce, chili-cheese quesadilla, pulled-chicken nachos. The October 2026 course (¥7,000 with all-you-can-drink) pairs red-meat and lamb steaks and ends with a curry. One diner found the menu short for a long stay and suggests it as one stop on a crawl. Drinkers only, no children, PayPay rather than cards.

anecdotes.text: "The slightly rare, juicy red meat steak is grilled to perfection. First, I savored the meat on its own, then wrapped it in a tortilla with chili con carne, jalapeño pickles, mashed potatoes, and fresh salsa." — October 2026, Carne Asada.

"I booked the assorted platter course featuring red meat steak and lamb sirloin cap, along with an all-you-can-drink option for JPY 7000… the curry that came out at the end was rich and delicious." — October 2026.

places.cuisine: Seasonal Japanese à la carte at a counter and tables (16 seats) · long menu that changes with the day's stock; examples from the shop site: Akashi wild sea bream sashimi, Chiba bonito sashimi or tataki, hamo with plum, aori squid, hairy crab with sanbaizu, Kamo eggplant simmered with myoga, lotus-root manju, celery nuta, grilled extra-thick asparagus, simmered rockfish, gindara saikyo-yaki, anago kabayaki, young ayu tempura, Tajima chicken salt-grilled or fried, bite-size wagyu fillet katsu, natto zosui, anago rice · from 2026 reviews: matsutake dobin-mushi, bamboo shoots simmered in dashi, kizushi, raw oysters, sashimi, shishamo, mentaiko with karasumi, white sesame and celery salad, grilled duck with island garlic, seasonal tempura · sake, shochu, wine
places.notes: [Japanese · Shinmachi by Nishi-Ohashi, a regulars' counter for seasonal small dishes since 2013] A bright, clean Japanese restaurant a few minutes from Nishi-Ohashi Station, open since 2013, which sets out to serve seasonal food in a homely room without fuss. The menu is long and moves with the market: sashimi that one diner calls the highlight, kizushi that won another over at first bite, bamboo shoots simmered in dashi in spring, eggplant in summer, matsutake dobin-mushi in autumn, and plenty of small plates for sake, such as mentaiko with a little karasumi, or a white sesame and celery salad. Finish with the natto zosui, which a first-timer went home wanting to cook. Regulars, many older and local, keep it full, so book; one diner who waited was phoned the moment a table came free. Tabelog puts dinner at about ¥8,000–15,000 a head, plus 10% service.

chef_bio.background: Japanese restaurant that opened on 12 March 2013 (shop site). Diners mention both a chef and an owner (January 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Delicious dishes made with the ingredients of each season, enjoyed casually in a homely atmosphere" (shop site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal sashimi and small dishes; natto zosui.

anecdotes.text: "I made a reservation for 7 PM, and [the shop] called me as soon as a table was available, so I rushed over. The owner apologized for the wait, but honestly, I was grateful for the call!" — May 2026, third visit.
"I was also intrigued by the natto zosui (natto rice porridge) and decided to order it, and it was fantastic! I plan to try making it at home." — January 2026, first visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 店のサイト: 和食の店 青地、四季折々の旬の食材を使った美味しいお料理をアットホームな雰囲気の中で気軽に、2013年3月12日開店、2022年5月から火・水曜定休、カウンター9席と4人掛けテーブル2卓、西大橋交差点よりなにわ筋を北へ二つ目の辻を東へ入った北側、西大橋駅2番出口より徒歩約3分。お料理の例: 明石の天然真鯛造り、千葉県産かつおの造り・叩き、はもの焼霜造り・落とし梅肉、あおりいかの造り、毛ガニ三杯酢、賀茂茄子みょうが煮、れんこんまんじゅう、セロリのぬたあえ、極太アスパラの塩焼、メバルの煮付け、銀だらの西京焼、穴子のかば焼、稚鮎の天ぷら・唐揚、但馬どりの塩焼・唐揚、一口和牛ヒレカツ、納豆ぞうすい、穴子めし、その日の仕入れ状況により価格の変動あり。食べログ: 大阪市西区新町1-30-6 第一合田ビル 1F、月17:00〜22:30、木〜日17:00〜23:00、火・水曜休み、年末年始休み、予約可、カード (VISA、Master) 可、電子マネー・QR不可、サービス料10%、16席 (カウンター8、テーブル8)、禁煙、子供可、持ち込み可、オープン日2013年3月12日。口コミ(2026年1月〜10月): いつも常連でいっぱい、年配の常連も、松茸の dobin-mushi、夏の茄子、shishamo、鶏、筍のだし煮、kizushi、生牡蠣、刺身、karasumi を少し合わせた mentaiko、白ごまとセロリのサラダ、島にんにくを添えた鴨の焼き物、雑炊、納豆ぞうすい、手ごろな季節の天ぷら、日本酒が豊富、席が空いたら電話をくれた、シェフもオーナーも感じがいい、一人8000円〜15000円ほど (食べログ)。

places.name: 和風カフェ はらいそ (Wafu Cafe Haraiso)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the daily main is often a fried tofu cutlet or croquette, sides have included macaroni salad, and sauces (sesame, miso, ponzu, ketchup) change with the day.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A February 2025 diner found no animal products in that day's set (tofu minced cutlet, tofu, bean sprouts, miso soup, brown-rice onigiri), but the menu changes daily, the miso soup's stock is not stated, and an earlier set included macaroni salad.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 12:00–19:00; closed Saturday, Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). An August 2026 diner reports last order at 15:30 for the set meal. Cash only (Tabelog; August 2026 review). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). 15 seats, counter and tables; smoking allowed except 11:00–15:00 (Tabelog). Up a steep staircase to the 2nd floor, above a Chinese restaurant (February 2025, October 2025 and January 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Bakuromachi 3-3-14, 2F, one block east of Shinsaibashi-suji — 8 min from Honmachi or Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese-style café with one daily set (15 seats) · Inaka set meal: a daily tofu-based main (tofu minced cutlet, tofu hamburg, tofu croquettes, lotus root stuffed with tofu), four small sides served on a bamboo leaf, chilled tofu, miso soup, pickles and brown-rice onigiri · choose 1 onigiri ¥800 or 2 ¥850 (January 2025; 2 still ¥850 in May 2026) · coffee or tea after the meal +¥50
places.notes: [Café · Bakuromachi, a quiet Showa-retro room and one healthy daily set] Up a steep, worn staircase above a flashy Chinese restaurant, a dim, hushed room of antique furniture and soft music where the wall clock is audible and most diners eat alone. There is one lunch: the Inaka (country-style) set, built around a daily tofu dish — a minced cutlet with sesame sauce and grated daikon in January 2026, a fluffy tofu hamburg with daikon and ponzu in June 2026 — with four little sides on a bamboo leaf, chilled tofu, miso soup and plain brown-rice onigiri without nori. Pick one or two onigiri (¥800 or ¥850); a coffee after is ¥50. It fills up just after noon on weekdays. A September 2023 diner saw one person running the whole shop. Cash only.

roles: Owner (ran the shop alone on a September 2023 visit)
chef_bio.background: Japanese-style café serving a daily brown-rice onigiri set since at least 2018 (April 2018 review). A September 2023 diner thought the owner was running the place single-handedly.
chef_bio.specialty: Daily tofu-based Inaka set with brown-rice onigiri.

anecdotes.text: "The meal features a daily main dish along with four side dishes, cold tofu, miso soup, and a rural set meal with brown rice onigiri… Coffee or tea after the meal is available for just JPY 50." — January 2026, Inaka set with tofu minced cutlet.
"The interior is quiet… You can even hear the ticking of the wall clock due to the tranquility." — January 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和風カフェ はらいそ、大阪市中央区博労町3-3-14 2階、本町駅・心斎橋駅から徒歩8分、月〜金12:00〜19:00、土日祝休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、15席、喫煙可 (11時〜15時は禁煙)。口コミ(2018年4月〜2026年8月): 2階への急な階段、1階は中華料理店、昭和レトロで薄暗く静か、アンティークの家具、黒電話、ひとりの女性客が多い、メニューは日替わりの田舎定食のみ、玄米おにぎりを1個か2個 (800円・850円、2025年1月)、主菜は豆腐のメンチカツ、豆腐ハンバーグ、豆腐と野菜のコロッケなど、笹の葉にのせた小鉢4品、冷奴、味噌汁、海苔のないおにぎり、食後のドリンク50円、2025年2月の客は動物性のものなしと、2023年9月の客は店主がひとりで切り盛りしていると、2026年8月の客によるとラストオーダー15時半、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: One set only, just order lunch and say 1 or 2 onigiri; cash only (2026).

places.name: 焼鳥 刻 TOKI (Yakitori Toki TOKI)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the course includes soy-marinated quail egg, tare-glazed skewers, a monaka wafer, country bread, and a choice of somen or curry to finish, so ask when booking.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken omakase course with duck, egg custard and a cheesecake.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun and holidays 18:00–22:30; closed Thursday (Tabelog). The official site says closing days are irregular. Two fixed seatings, 18:00 and 20:30, everyone starting together; phone if late, since late arrivals join the course mid-way; no children under 12 (Tabelog). Omakase course only, ¥14,300 tax included (Tabelog), plus a 10% service charge from 1 July 2026 (Tabelog); October 2026 reviews paid ¥15,730. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 14 seats by Tabelog; the official site gives a counter of 8 and a private room for 4; non-smoking. Opened 1 October 2025 (Tabelog; official site). Tabelog notes it is unrelated to the other Toki yakitori shops in Higobashi and Namba.
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-20-3, SUKISHA Bldg 1F — 3 min from Yotsubashi Stn; 7 min from Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: Omakase yakitori counter grilling Yamagata and Hinai jidori over Kishu binchotan, with Japanese and French technique (14 seats) · course of about 15 dishes, ¥15,730 with service (October 2026) · examples (October 2026): pâté de campagne in a monaka shell, grilled-maitake consommé, chicken breast with shiso genovese, furisode (shoulder), gizzard, skin-on thigh and neck, wings smoked after grilling, liver with chive sauce, quail egg in soy sauce, fruit tomato with fig oil, Sobue ginkgo, chawanmushi with lily bulb and a porcini-truffle mushroom sauce, Kawachi duck with red wine sauce, tsukune with truffle cheese · finish: karasumi on Miwa somen or spiced curry · pumpkin cheesecake over red bean paste · sake, shochu, wine and champagne pairing, Japanese whisky
places.notes: [Yakitori · Shinmachi, an omakase counter that looks like a sushi bar] Nothing outside says yakitori: inside is a quiet room with a coffered ceiling, natural-stone walls and a counter cut from a 200-year-old hinoki, more like a sushi or kaiseki bar. The owner-chef, born in Osaka and shaped by youth spent in Yamagata, trained at a well-known Kitashinchi yakitori restaurant before opening here in October 2025, and grills mainly Yamagata and Hinai jidori over Kishu binchotan, folding in Japanese and French technique. Two seatings a night run one course of about 15 dishes: a pâté de campagne in a monaka shell, a grilled-maitake consommé, skin-on thigh and neck, crunchy gizzard, wings smoked after grilling, truffle-cheese tsukune, a chawanmushi under porcini-and-truffle sauce, then karasumi somen or spiced curry and a pumpkin cheesecake on red bean paste. One diner describes a young grill master who greets and explains each dish, then grills with total focus at the centre of the counter. Pairings run to wine and champagne as well as sake.

chef_bio.origin: Born in Osaka; spent youth in Yamagata (official site).
chef_bio.background: Trained at a well-known yakitori restaurant in Kitashinchi (official site, Japanese page; the English page says Michelin-starred restaurants) before opening Yakitori Toki on 1 October 2025. Reviewers call the grill master young (October 2026). One October 2026 review says a chef from The Ritz-Carlton supervised the curry and the mushroom sauce.
chef_bio.philosophy: Cooking as thanks to people and to the land: ingredients from places tied to the chef's life, vegetables picked by the chef at the market, Japanese and French techniques used to take yakitori beyond its usual form (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase yakitori of Yamagata and Hinai jidori over Kishu binchotan.

anecdotes.text: "The Yamagata chicken is usually raised for about 120 days, but they sometimes extend it to 150-160 days, showing their commitment to the chicken's growing environment." — October 2026, omakase course ¥15,730.
"The chicken wings are bone-in and smoked after grilling, which reduces the fat while enhancing the aroma." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 焼鳥 刻 -TOKI-、大阪市西区新町1丁目20-3 SUKISHA BLD 1階、四ツ橋駅から徒歩3分、心斎橋駅から徒歩7分、2部制18:00〜と20:30〜、カウンター8名と個室4名、不定休、2025年10月1日グランドオープン、北新地の有名店で研鑽を重ねた店主、大阪で生まれ山形で青春を過ごした、山形地鶏や比内地鶏が中心、紀州備長炭、日本料理やフランス料理の技法、野菜は大将自らが市場で目利き、樹齢200年の檜カウンターと自然石の壁、格天井。食べログ: 月火水金土日祝18:00〜22:30、木曜休み、おまかせコース14300円 (税込)、2026年7月1日からサービス料10%、カード可、14席、禁煙、12歳未満不可、遅れたらコースの途中から、肥後橋・なんばの同名店とは無関係。口コミ (2026年10月): ¥15,730のおまかせ約15品、モナカのパテ・ド・カンパーニュ、焼いた舞茸のコンソメ、大葉のジェノベーゼの胸肉、ふりそで、砂ずり、皮付きのももとせせり、焼いてから燻した手羽、トリュフチーズのつくね、茶碗蒸し、締めはからすみそうめんかスパイスカレー、かぼちゃのチーズケーキ、ワインとシャンパーニュのペアリング、若い焼き手、1周年の蘭。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a seating (18:00 or 20:30) and arrive on time; English page on the official site (2026).

Order at a self-service touch panel (September 2026 reviews). Reservations through Tabelog (August 2026 review). places.notes: [Café · Bakuromachi, soft serve dressed as your favourite dog] A white, wood-trimmed café opened in late 2025 where dogs come in with their owners and the soft serve wears a sugar-candy face of a dog breed: twelve breeds and two cats to choose from on the touch-panel, in a cup or a cone. Diners rate the ice cream itself rich and milky, around ¥690–750 (August 2026), and there are scones, matcha and hojicha drinks, and a menu for the dogs. One August 2026 diner found the faces vary in neatness and the room a little food-court-like; on a Sunday it was packed. Open from 8 am; Tuesday hours conflict between listings.

chef_bio.background: Dog-friendly café that opened on 27 November 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: A break for people walking their dogs, with soft serve designed after dog breeds and meals for dogs (Tabelog, shop-provided).

anecdotes.text: "You can choose from 12 different dog designs for the soft serve, all of which are incredibly cute. There are also 2 cat options available." — September 2026, Maltese vanilla.
"Dog Soft Serve Ice Cream - JPY 750 / Scone - JPY 450" — August 2026.

places.name: 旬菜ダイニング らかんか (Shunsai Dining Rakan Ka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the daily mains include herb-and-breadcrumb-crusted fish, saikyo-miso fish and stews, and every set comes with miso soup, so ask which main is wheat-free that day.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: each set is built around a fish or meat main, with miso soup.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:30–23:00; closed Saturday, Sunday, public holidays and over the New Year (Tabelog). Lunch is a daily set: choose the fish or the meat main (2024–2026 reviews); one April 2026 regular simply orders the omakase set and it arrives. Set meals in the evening too (September 2026 review). Takeaway available (2026 review). Busy just before noon with office workers (April 2026 review). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). 12 seats with counter seating; no private rooms; whole-shop booking possible (Tabelog). In a narrow alley; small from outside but roomier inside (April 2024 review). The website listed on Tabelog (racanca.com) no longer resolves (checked 2026-10-30).
places.neighborhood: Minami-Senba 2-7-1, in a narrow alley — 337 m from Nagahoribashi Stn, between Sakaisuji-Honmachi and Nagahoribashi
places.cuisine: Healthy set meals with brown rice, lunch and dinner on weekdays (12 seats) · lunch: a daily fish or meat main with two small side dishes, miso soup, brown rice and a piece of fruit, about ¥1,000 (2026; ¥900 in 2024, and ¥900 for the omakase set per one April 2026 review) · mains seen in 2026: herb-crusted salmon or white fish, butter-grilled salmon, saikyo-miso grilled Spanish mackerel, mackerel grilled with basil, chicken and vegetable tomato stew, beef stew, mapo tofu · earlier: fish steamed in foil over vegetables, mackerel stuffed with cheese and shiso · dinner: sets with 4 side dishes ¥1,650 or 8 side dishes ¥2,200 (July 2024) · a daily health tea (mugwort, persimmon leaf, roasted barley)
places.notes: [Set meals · Minami-Senba, brown-rice health lunches in an office alley] A small counter dining room in a narrow alley of the Minami-Senba office district that has served the same kind of meal for years: a daily choice of fish or meat, two little side dishes, miso soup, fruit and brown rice that the shop advertises as the best in Osaka (per an April 2026 diner) — chewy, fluffy, and to another diner not like brown rice at all. Seasoning is gentle throughout (saikyo-miso Spanish mackerel, basil-grilled mackerel, herb-crusted salmon, a mild mapo tofu), and the health tea changes daily. Lunch is about ¥1,000 and fills up before noon; turnover is quick and takeaway is offered. In the evening the same kitchen serves vegetable-heavy set meals with four or eight side dishes. A January 2026 diner returning after five or six years found the master and partner still there, and a July 2024 diner notes the owner specializes in astrology.

chef_bio.background: Run by the master and a partner; a diner returning in January 2026 after five or six years found both still at the shop (January 2026 review). The owner specializes in astrology (July 2024 review). Offered takeout through Uber during the pandemic (June 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Healthy, gently seasoned set meals that let the ingredients come through, always with brown rice (2025–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Daily fish or meat set with brown rice.

anecdotes.text: "Now, onto the main topic: this brown rice. It's advertised as the best in Osaka, and I can see why—it's incredibly delicious!" — April 2026, Daily Set A (herb-crusted salmon) ¥1,000.
"I don't ask about the details; it comes out in order automatically… All of this for JPY 900." — April 2026, omakase set meal.

Bread half price after 16:00 to cut food waste (Tabelog, shop-provided). Cards, transport IC, WAON, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai (Tabelog). 12 table seats (Tabelog); non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; birthday plates. Opened 7 January 2026 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Bread-buffet café (12 seats) · order a main, then add the bread buffet (about ¥700–770, October 2026) or the premium course with desserts · mains: salad, clam chowder, cream pasta, omurice · about 10–15 breads: croissants and salt bread fresh from the oven every 30 minutes, focaccia, apple, mango, fig and curry danishes, matcha croissant, mentaiko cheese, corn mayo, bacon sandwich, sweet potato bread, muscat and strawberry fruit sandwiches · premium: French toast, mini fruit sandwiches, ice cream, cheesecake and tiramisu from the showcase · cookies, brownies, pound cake, banana cake · coffee, tea, lemon water · a toaster at the buffet
places.notes: [Bread-buffet café · Kitahorie, opened January 2026] A small café with a very cute interior on the ground floor of a Kitahorie apartment building (Halloween-themed in October 2026) where lunch means picking a main — salad, clam chowder, cream pasta or omurice — and adding all-you-can-eat bread. About a dozen breads sit at the buffet, mostly sweet, and croissants and salt bread come out hot every 30 minutes, often brought to the table; diners single those two out. The premium plan adds mini desserts, French toast and fruit sandwiches. Seating is timed (80 minutes per Tabelog) and tight, a few tables went to the terrace on a busy holiday, and after noon some breads run out or dry. Reviews are mostly happy; one diner found ¥2,000 for a salad plus the bread add-on poor value. Bread is half price after 4 pm.

chef_bio.background: Bread-buffet café that opened on 7 January 2026 in the Ajiru Kitahorie apartment building (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Bread sold at half price after 16:00 to reduce food waste (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Freshly baked croissants and salt bread; bread buffet.

anecdotes.text: "The bread selection included about 15 varieties such as croissants, salt bread, focaccia, apple danish, mango danish, fig danish, matcha croissant… The croissants and salt bread were served fresh twice during my visit." — October 2026, holiday lunch, clam chowder.
"Personally, the freshly baked salt bread and the muscat fruit sandwich were the most delicious!" — October 2026.

places.cuisine: Creative nigiri at a 6-seat counter · lunch: Gourmet Nigiri, 10 pieces ¥5,000, or the omakase course ¥12,500 (April 2026) · dinner courses ¥12,000 and ¥16,000 (February 2024) · signature nigiri: foie gras (lightly seared), mozzarella, water eggplant or grilled eggplant with sea urchin, sweet shrimp with liver sauce · classics: Senshu squid with red-vinegar rice, kombu-cured anago, lean and fatty tuna, horse mackerel, grilled anago, kanpyo roll · tamago with foie gras, squid and shrimp · seko-gani crab and sea-urchin chawanmushi in season · red miso soup · sake, shochu and wine
places.notes: [Sushi · Minami-Senba, a six-seat counter known for foie gras and mozzarella nigiri] A calm, wood-toned counter of six seats in a quiet Minami-Senba alley that calls its sushi 'gourmet nigiri': Edomae classics such as lean tuna, kombu-cured anago and a kanpyo roll sit beside foie gras seared on the surface, mozzarella, and water eggplant with sea urchin. The tamago is filled with foie gras, squid and shrimp. Lunch is 10 pieces for ¥5,000 or a ¥12,500 omakase, served quickly by one person; dinner is a course. The pieces are small, and one April 2026 diner found the sweet soy glaze too strong; a long-time fan returns for the foie gras and mozzarella nigiri. A July 2022 diner who had eaten at Sushi Yoshi in Tsuruhashi some 20 years earlier found much the same menu here. Book by phone, from a Japanese mobile number if possible.

chef_bio.background: Opened at this address on 2 April 2014 (Tabelog). A July 2022 diner had eaten at Sushi Yoshi in Tsuruhashi about 20 years earlier and found the menu here mostly the same, foie gras sushi included. One person runs the counter at lunch (June 2025 review); diners describe a friendly chef with entertaining stories (2020 and 2022 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Creative toppings alongside Edomae-style classics (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Foie gras nigiri; mozzarella nigiri; eggplant with sea urchin.

anecdotes.text: "The egg was quite elaborate, filled with foie gras, squid, and shrimp, which is a bit different from the traditional Edo-style shrimp and white fish paste." — April 2026, Gourmet Nigiri (10 pieces) ¥5,000.

"I used to go to Sushi Yoshi in Tsuruhashi 20 years ago… The menu was mostly the same as the one in Tsuruhashi, and I was so happy to enjoy my favorite foie gras sushi after a long time." — July 2022.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿し吉、大阪市中央区南船場2-9-3、クリスタ長堀の北4・北5出口から北へ徒歩3分ほど (長堀橋駅・心斎橋駅)、本町駅・堺筋本町駅から徒歩6分、月〜土12:00〜13:30 (L.O. 13:00)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 20:30)、日祝・祝前日・祝後日休み、月曜祝日も休み、予約可 (当日5分前でも電話で)、日本の携帯電話以外の番号からの予約は確認できないことがある、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、6席 (カウンター)、禁煙、隣にコインパーキング、英語・中国語 (繁体・簡体)・韓国語のメニュー、英語・中国語・韓国語のスタッフ、オープン日2014年4月2日、Instagram (minamisenba_sushiyoshi)。口コミ(2018年〜2026年9月): 創作寿司、昼は握り10貫5000円 (英語の口コミでは Gourmet Nigiri)かおまかせ12500円 (2026年4月)、夜のコースは12000円と16000円 (2024年2月)、フォアグラの握り、モッツァレラの握り、水茄子や焼き茄子にウニ、甘エビの肝ソース、Senshu のイカと赤酢のシャリ、昆布締めの穴子、赤身、トロ、アジ、焼き穴子、かんぴょう巻き、フォアグラ・イカ・エビ入りの玉子、セコガニ、ウニの茶碗蒸し、赤だし、昼は一人で営業 (2025年6月)、話の楽しい気さくな大将、甘い醤油だれが強すぎるという声、握りは小ぶり、20年前に Tsuruhashi の寿し吉に通った人によると品書きはほぼ同じ (2022年7月)。

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Mostly seafood and meat, but the meze include hummus, a roasted-eggplant dip, a red pepper and walnut paste (which contains breadcrumbs) and ratatouille; no vegan statement, so ask.
places.hours_raw: Official site (October 2026): lunch 11:30–14:30 (Sat, Sun and holidays from 12:00); dinner 17:30–22:00 (Fri, Sat and days before holidays to 24:00); irregular closing days, posted monthly — November 2026: 3, 10, 15, 18, 23 and 30 November. Lunch changed in October 2026 from reservation-only to walk-ins welcome (official site); the lunch course still needs a booking. One-drink minimum at dinner (Tabelog). English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Opened 29 July 2024 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Mediterranean and Middle Eastern bistro with a Santorini-themed room (14 seats) · Mediterranean appetizer platter, ¥2,860 for two (official site): Niçoise salad, hummus, brandade croquette, vichyssoise, prawn and sea bream carpaccio, smoked edamame with pecorino, orange-marinated beets, tapenade, ratatouille · lamb brochette with spicy couscous ¥580 (official site) · seafood bouillabaisse ¥1,980, upgradeable to lobster, with risotto from the broth ¥780 to finish · Moroccan briouat spring rolls · red-wine-braised Kumamoto akagyu beef cheek · fresh pasta from an Awaji noodle maker: sea urchin cream, egg yolk and fresh truffle, squid ink · Basque cheesecake with gelato ¥880 (July 2026) · lunch: pita sandwiches (chicken, lamb or a seasonal filling) with lentil soup, fries, harissa and tzatziki from ¥1,000 (2026), lunch course ¥3,080 (reserve) · courses ¥5,000–7,700 · unusual wines by the glass from ¥680
places.notes: [Mediterranean bistro · Shinmachi near Yotsubashi, Middle Eastern meze from a one-person kitchen] A small Santorini-themed bistro on the south side of a Shinmachi apartment block, run by one owner-chef whom reviewers credit with cooking in Dubai and London. Start with the appetizer platter — hummus, orange-marinated beets, tapenade, a carpaccio, sometimes a smoky roasted-eggplant dip or an Aleppo-style red pepper and walnut paste — then the seafood bouillabaisse, saving the broth for the risotto that reviewers insist on. Lamb brochettes over spicy couscous are the official No. 1; the red-wine-braised beef cheek is said to take three days. Since spring 2026 lunch is a pita sandwich set with lentil soup, harissa and tzatziki from about ¥1,000. The wine list leans unusual. Diners call the owner cheerful and willing to talk food at the counter; the room was featured in an・an and Meets, per an October 2025 review. One cook means relaxed pacing, and the counter passage is narrow.

roles: Owner-chef (runs the bistro alone, per a November 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened on 29 July 2024 (Tabelog). The owner, described on the official site as having wide experience, cooks the food and picks the wines (official site; Tabelog). Reviewers say the chef cooked for the wealthy in places like Dubai and London (October 2025 review) and worked in Dubai and London (July 2026 review), and a July 2024 diner had followed the chef from a previous restaurant. Featured in an・an and in Meets' "Delicious Book 2026" (October 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Making Mediterranean cuisine more familiar": Mediterranean cooking that spreads out from the south of France, with fresh seafood, game and vegetables, and unusual wines (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Mediterranean appetizer platter; seafood bouillabaisse and risotto; lamb brochette.

anecdotes.text: "It's incredible that I can enjoy dishes from a chef who has cooked for the wealthy in places like Dubai and London at such reasonable prices in Nishihonmachi!" — October 2025, second visit.
"Despite being run by a single person, the timing of the food delivery was just right, and everything was served hot and fresh." — November 2025, course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (bistro-umami.com): 「地中海料理をもっと身近に」、南フランスから広がる地中海料理と厳選ワイン、サントリーニ島をイメージした店、新鮮な魚介やジビエ、野菜、多彩な経験を持つ店主が料理を用意、気さくな店主、四ツ橋駅から徒歩4分、営業11:30〜14:30 (土日祝12:00〜)・17:30〜22:00 (金土祝前日〜24:00)、不定休 (11月は3・10・15・18・23・30日)、ランチは2026年10月から予約なしでも可、ランチコースは要予約、地中海オードブル2名盛2860円、仔羊のブロシェットとスパイシークスクス580円 (人気No.1)、魚介山盛りブイヤベース1980円、UMaランチコース3080円、コース5000円〜7700円、パスタは淡路の製麺所の生パスタ、ワインはグラス680円から。食べログ: 大阪市西区新町1-22-22 新町ダイヤパレス 104 (建物の南側)、西大橋駅・四ツ橋駅から徒歩4分、14席 (カウンター8、テーブル6)、禁煙、ワンドリンク制、カード・iD・QUICPay可、英語のスタッフ、オープン日2024年7月29日。口コミ(2024年7月〜2026年10月): 店主ひとりで営業、Dubai や London で経験を積んだシェフ、前の店からのファン、an・an と Meets に掲載、地中海前菜の盛り合わせ (フムス、ビーツのオレンジマリネ、焼き茄子のペースト、アレッポ発祥の赤パプリカとくるみのペースト)、ブイヤベースと〆のリゾット、牛ほほ肉の赤ワイン煮込みは3日かける、ブリワット、2026年春からピタサンドのランチ (チキン、ラム、季節の具、レンズ豆のスープ、ポテト、ハリッサ、ザジキ)、珍しいワイン、明るい店主、カウンターの後ろの通路はせまい。

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: dumplings, shumai, spring rolls, noodle soups and crêpe-wrapped char siu are wheat, and the sauces (black bean, soy-garlic, chili) are not described; nothing is marked gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an à la carte Chinese menu built on pork, chicken, shrimp, squid and fish; no vegan dishes are described.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:30; Mon and Sat 17:30–22:30 (last order 21:50); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Lunch cannot be reserved and is paid in cash or PayPay only; dinner reservations taken, two people usually seated at the counter or a table for two (Tabelog). One drink per person at dinner (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), PayPay, Rakuten Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). 17 seats: 7 at the counter, 10 at tables (Tabelog details); the shop text says 6 counter seats, one table for 2 and two tables for 4. places.cuisine: Cantonese-leaning Chinese, lightly seasoned, à la carte (17 seats) · market fish and seasonal vegetables · assorted appetizer platter (five kinds, e.g. spicy fried shrimp, yodare chicken, fresh-fish carpaccio, Shaoxing-marinated tomatoes) · mapo tofu with fermented black beans · tom yum fried rice · Cantonese fresh-fish carpaccio · stir-fried squid with black beans · sweet and sour pork · shrimp chili, shrimp mayo · yurinchi · shrimp dumplings, chicken and water chestnut shumai, oyster shumai · char siu wrapped in a crêpe · spring rolls · noodle soup with green onion and char siu · almond tofu · natural wine, Shaoxing wine, turmeric lemon sour · weekday lunch sets about ¥1,200 (April 2026)
places.notes: [Chinese · Hakuromachi, a white, stylish room up the back stairs behind the W Osaka] Easy to miss: climb the stairs at the back of an older, well-renovated building and the second floor opens into a bright, modern room with a counter and tables. A January 2025 reviewer called it the second shop of Tokuchaina, and a September 2026 diner who usually goes to Tokuchaina came here for the first time. The cooking is Cantonese-leaning and gently seasoned, with market fish and seasonal vegetables: start with the assorted appetizer platter, then the mapo tofu sharpened with fermented black beans, a fresh-fish carpaccio, stir-fried squid with black beans, shrimp chili or the tom yum fried rice, and finish with a green-onion and char siu noodle soup. Natural wines and Shaoxing run alongside. Weekday lunch is a few sets (mapo tofu, yurinchi, shrimp chili and a weekly special); an April 2026 diner had the special soy-sauce noodles with four small sides for ¥1,200. Dishes come out at a leisurely pace, so order most of it at once.

chef_bio.background: Chinese restaurant opened 6 April 2024 (Tabelog). A January 2025 review calls it the second shop of Tokuchaina; a September 2026 reviewer usually eats at Tokuchaina.
chef_bio.philosophy: Cantonese-inspired dishes with light seasoning, made from fresh domestic fish and seasonal vegetables bought at the market, paired with natural wine and Shaoxing wine (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Mapo tofu; assorted appetizers; Cantonese-style fresh-fish carpaccio.

anecdotes.text: "I was pleasantly surprised by the lavishness of the side dishes for lunch! Century egg tofu, pickled mustard greens, menma, and pickles … I think it's a great deal to have such a luxurious lunch for just JPY 1200." — April 2026, weekly special Chinese noodles.
"The Char Siu Wrapped in Crepe was inspired by Peking Duck. The rich sauce was delicious, and the chewy crepe combined with chunky char siu made for a hearty dish." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中国菜 Yin Yang、大阪市中央区博労町4-3-14 8Rビル 2F、心斎橋駅から徒歩4分、火〜金11:30〜14:00・17:30〜22:30、月・土17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 21:50)、日曜休み、ランチは予約不可で現金とPayPayのみ、お一人様ワンドリンク制、カード・PayPay・楽天ペイ可、17席 (カウンター7、テーブル10)、禁煙、英語メニューあり、オープン日2024年4月6日。店の紹介: 広東の要素を取り入れたやさしい味の中国料理、市場で仕入れる国産の鮮魚と季節の野菜、自然派ワインと紹興酒、人気は前菜盛り合わせ、麻婆豆腐、トムヤム炒飯、広東風の鮮魚のカルパッチョ。口コミ(2025年1月〜2026年10月): Tokuchaina の2号店、W Osaka の裏のビルの奥の階段を上った2階、白を基調にしたおしゃれな店内、前菜5種盛り、豆豉の効いた麻婆豆腐、イカと豆豉炒め、黒酢酢豚、海老チリ、エビマヨ、油淋鶏、海老餃子、鶏とクワイの焼売、牡蠣焼売、チャーシューのクレープ包み、春巻き、ネギとチャーシューのスープ麺、杏仁豆腐、ランチは週替わりの中華そばと小鉢4品で1200円、料理はゆっくり出てくる。

places.cuisine: Wagyu yakiniku at a full-flat counter, the Osaka sister of Niku to Ieba Matsuda in Nara (16 seats) · Yamato beef from Nara · signature Chateaubriand tongue sliced and grilled in front of you · Chateaubriand, salt tongue, outside skirt, sirloin, lean cuts · wagyu truffle yukke with egg-yolk soy sauce · beef sashimi · kimchi · hamburg steak · croquette · katsu sandwich · garlic fried rice with Chateaubriand · creative dishes (pasta, beef stew, tacos, a monthly seasonal menu) · omakase courses ¥6,000 and ¥11,000 (two or more); wagyu sansho hot pot course ¥8,500 (private room, 3–6 people) · over 100 wines chosen by the sommelier · cold-brewed Yamato tea
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Hakuromachi, the Osaka counter of a Nara wagyu shop] The Osaka sister of Niku to Ieba Matsuda in Nara, behind a hidden-feeling entrance: a tea-room-like room with a tokonoma-style backdrop, bamboo and a pine-tree neon sign, and a long full-flat counter where the cooking happens in front of you. Yamato beef from Nara is the point. The signature is the thick-cut Chateaubriand tongue, sliced and grilled at the counter; diners also order the Chateaubriand, outside skirt, the truffle yukke and the beef sashimi, and finish with garlic fried rice studded with Chateaubriand. The kitchen also cooks pasta, beef stew, tacos and a katsu sandwich, and a sommelier pours from over 100 wines. Omakase courses run ¥6,000 or ¥11,000. Several October 2026 diners found the service slow on busy nights; one table had a two-hour limit.

chef_bio.background: Osaka sister shop of Niku to Ieba Matsuda in Nara (Tabelog, shop-provided); opened 30 August 2022 (Tabelog). Tabelog links the website trio-inc.jp, a TRIO Inc. page that was under maintenance on 30 October 2026. A September 2026 reviewer calls the Nara shop the original.
chef_bio.philosophy: Yamato beef grilled cut by cut with matching seasonings, alongside genre-crossing dishes from experienced chefs and sommelier-chosen wines (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Chateaubriand tongue; wagyu truffle yukke; Chateaubriand.

anecdotes.text: "Watching the tongue being expertly sliced right in front of me and then grilled to perfection with just the right heat was an incredible experience." — September 2026, signature Chateaubriand tongue.
"I had garlic fried rice topped with small pieces of Chateaubriand, and it was fantastic!" — October 2026.

places.notes: [Chinese · Minamisenba, a small Chinese bar-diner run by a warm couple] Chinese restaurant, bar and diner in one, as one diner puts it: fourteen seats at two-person tables near Nagahoribashi, opened in January 2025. A March 2026 regular credits a husband-and-wife team with the warm, attentive service; another diner was greeted by the friendly woman serving with thanks for an earlier group visit, and says Google suggests 'Azuki Oneesan' when you search the shop. Repeat diners come back for the sweet Shanghai yakisoba, piping-hot xiaolongbao with black vinegar, crisp gyoza, black-vinegar sweet and sour pork and a surprisingly good potato salad with apple; the yurinchi reportedly draws a lunch queue. Lunch is three fixed sets plus a daily special (seafood champon ¥1,200 in February 2026, a mapo curry in April). Courses with all-you-can-drink suit groups, and the whole room can be booked for 20.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 January 2025 (Tabelog). Described by a March 2026 regular as run by a husband-and-wife team; a November 2025 diner was seen off at the door by the manager.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Chinese at reasonable prices, with dishes that suit drinks (official site and Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Spicy mapo tofu; yurinchi; Shanghai yakisoba; xiaolongbao.

places.cuisine: Everyday Hakata-style tempura, fried in front of you a few pieces at a time (16 seats) · 100% rice oil · tempura set meals with rice (free refills, white or barley) and miso soup: Tamago (soft-boiled egg tempura) ¥1,350, Tenjin ¥1,200, vegetable ¥1,000, angel shrimp ¥1,700, Osusume ¥1,550, large anago ¥1,700, large shrimp ¥1,500, Kiwami ¥2,450, tororo ¥1,200, monthly special ¥1,400 · evening sets and a seasonal assortment · drink sets from ¥1,000 (draft beer and three tempura) · mentaiko tencha · course ¥3,200 (two or more) · Seto Inland Sea moshio salt, house tentsuyu · free daikon pickles on the table · à la carte from ¥140
places.notes: [Tempura · Hakuromachi, Hakata-style everyday tempura between Honmachi and Shinsaibashi] The name joins Tenjin, the Fukuoka district known for its crowd of casual tempura shops, with 'the god of tempura' (official site). Tempura is fried in 100% rice oil and brought to you a few pieces at a time, so it arrives piping hot: lunch is a set with rice that is cooked continuously in small cookers and refilled free (white or barley), miso soup and homemade daikon pickles on the table. The favourite is the Tamago set, whose soft-boiled egg tempura goes over the rice; others go for 'angel shrimp' (from New Caledonia, one regular heard), kisu, sardines, cheese-stuffed chikuwa or a dorayaki tempura with butter. In the evening, ¥1,000 buys a beer with shrimp, eggplant and chicken tempura. The shop is the only restaurant of Patria Co., whose site names the manager as Takimoto Youhei, from Hokkaido; an August 2026 regular noticed new staff and a new potato salad.

chef_bio.background: Named as manager of the shop on the site of Patria Co., which runs it as its only restaurant from the same address; the site describes a manager who is earnest and passionate rather than high-energy, answers customers' requests in the tempura, and trains the frying staff in a spirit of "no waste, precise". The site is undated, and an August 2026 regular noticed the staff had changed recently. Patria's representative director, 冨安 美絵子 (Tomiyasu Mieko), is from Fukuoka, studied at Saga University aiming to teach art, went into martial arts as a student and after graduating, and founded the company after retiring (operator's site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Freshly fried tempura served straight from the fryer in front of the diner, to make tempura casual and familiar (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Tamago tempura set (soft-boiled egg tempura); angel shrimp.

anecdotes.text: "I ordered the popular Tamago Tempura (JPY 1350). The shrimp was plump and juicy, and the eggplant was crispy. I enjoyed the Tamago Tempura on top of my rice, and it was delicious when mixed with the tempura scraps." — September 2026.
"You can get three pieces of freshly fried tempura (chicken tempura, eggplant tempura, and shrimp tempura) along with a bottle of beer for just JPY 1000!" — August 2026, a regular of a few years.
