places.name: 新町 和けい (Shinmachi Wakei)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The shop asks to be told about food allergies when booking and offers to adjust dishes, but makes no gluten-free claim; tempura comes with nearly every set and course, and the shabu-shabu uses a house dipping sauce.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the cooking is built on a dashi of Rishiri kelp and honkarebushi bonito (Tabelog, shop-provided), and the sets and courses centre on fish, shrimp, pork and beef.
places.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 18:00–24:00; lunch closes if there are no reservations, dinner by reservation only and same-day bookings may not be possible because of market closures; closing days not fixed (late May listed); the shop will try to take bookings outside these hours (Tabelog). Lunch courses 12:00–14:30 (Tabelog course page). Service charge 5%, private-room charge 5% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats: a counter (about five to seven seats per 2023–2024 reviews) and one sunken-kotatsu private room for 4–8, which may refuse children when booked for business; whole-shop booking up to 20; smoking only in the private room at night (Tabelog). Opened 20 November 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 2-3-13, Lions Mansion Yotsubashi 105 — 3 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn (Exit 1), 8 min from Yotsubashi Stn (Exit 2)
places.cuisine: Seasonal Japanese cooking on a Rishiri-kelp and honkarebushi dashi (15 seats, counter and a private room) · lunch: Wakei set of about 12 small side dishes with seasonal rice, soup and a sweet ¥1,600, with sashimi and tempura ¥2,500; three-tiered bento ¥3,500 (two a day, book); add-ons: tempura, sashimi, pork shabu-shabu in a paper pot · lunch kaiseki from ¥4,300 (Sumire ¥4,500, Aoi ¥6,000, Miyabi ¥8,500); tempura kaiseki ¥6,500 and ¥8,000 · omakase from ¥10,000–15,000; matsutake courses in autumn; Yamasan wagyu shabu-shabu ¥18,000; pork shabu-shabu course ¥8,500; torafugu tetchiri ¥19,800 (prices before tax) · takeout bento, sushi and the house shabu-shabu sauce · sake and shochu
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Shinmachi, a hideaway for seasonal Japanese cooking at honest prices] A small Japanese restaurant tucked into the ground floor of an apartment block near Nishi-Ohashi, opened in 2017 by a chef who trained at a long-established Osaka restaurant and was head chef at the Michelin-starred Sōsaku Ryori Kawahara in Ehime, the chef's home prefecture. Everything rests on a delicate dashi of Rishiri kelp and honkarebushi. Lunch is the draw: the Wakei set lays out about a dozen bite-sized seasonal dishes (sesame tofu, duck, fried horse mackerel, vegetable jellies) with seasonal rice, and the fuller version adds two sashimi and tempura, the thick-cut eggplant and the sweet Awaji onion singled out by diners. Kaiseki lunches and dinner omakase run up to fugu, wagyu shabu-shabu and matsutake in season. There is a counter and one sunken-kotatsu private room, popular for family celebrations; a 90-year-old guest who could not eat raw food was cooked for and finished everything (April 2026). Everything is by reservation; lunch closes when nobody has booked.

chef_bio.origin: Ehime Prefecture, the chef's hometown (Tabelog, shop-provided)
chef_bio.background: Trained at a long-established restaurant in Osaka, then head chef at the Michelin one-star "Sōsaku Ryori Kawahara" in Ehime, before opening Wakei on 20 November 2017 (Tabelog, shop-provided). A September 2025 review calls the chef "a chef from Kiccho"; another says the head chef "comes from a high-end Japanese restaurant and manages several establishments", and the course page notes "we also operate a shabu-shabu specialty restaurant".
chef_bio.philosophy: To share the beauty of Japanese cuisine: the finest seasonal seafood and local vegetables on a dashi of Rishiri kelp and honkarebushi, at honest prices (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Wakei set lunch of a dozen small dishes; tempura; shabu-shabu with a house dipping sauce.

anecdotes.text: "The chef asked, 'Have you ever tried tempura of grilled eel?'" — and served it with figs, September 2025, Wakei Gozen ¥2,750.
"My mother, who is 90 and cannot eat raw food, was well taken care of and finished everything." — April 2026, a Mother's Day lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店の公式情報): 新町 和けい、大阪市西区新町2-3-13 ライオンズマンション四ツ橋 105、西大橋駅1番出口から徒歩3分、四ツ橋駅2番出口から徒歩8分、毎日12:00〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・18:00〜24:00、昼は予約がなければ休み、夜は予約のみ (市場の休みで当日予約は難しいことも)、不定休、アレルギーや苦手な食材は予約時に、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、サービス料5%・個室料5%、15席、掘りごたつの個室1室 (4〜8人)、貸切20人まで、オープン日2017年11月20日。店の紹介: 大阪の老舗で修業し、故郷 Ehime のミシュラン一つ星 Sōsaku Ryori Kawahara の料理長を経て独立、利尻昆布と本枯節のだし、旬の魚と地元の野菜、正直な値段。メニュー (2026年8月更新): Wakei Gozen 1600円、刺身と天ぷら付き2500円、三段弁当3500円 (1日2食)、昼の会席4300円から、天ぷら会席6500円・8000円、おまかせ10000円から、松茸、Yamasan の牛肉のしゃぶしゃぶのコース、豚しゃぶのコース、てっちりのコース、しゃぶしゃぶ専門店も営業。口コミ(2023年5月〜2026年9月): 約12品の小鉢、刺身2種、天ぷら (厚切りの茄子、Awaji の玉ねぎ、海老)、季節のご飯、焼いた鰻の天ぷら、おぼろ豆腐、Sumire の会席4500円、個室でゆっくり、90歳の母も完食、料理長は Kiccho 出身という声、気さくで説明がていねい。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation needed for every meal; book by phone (070-3224-3014) or online through Tabelog (2026).

staff_allergy_handling.text: The shop asks guests to say which foods they are allergic to or dislike when booking, and offers to make dishes to suit (Tabelog reservation note, shop-provided).

places.name: 布目の里 (Nunome no Sato)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; mains are cooked with soy-based and oyster sauces and the menu includes curry.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu has a stir-fried vegetable set and a vegetable curry, but nothing says whether the miso soup, sauces or side dishes use fish stock, and most sets centre on pork, chicken or fish.
places.hours_raw: Hours not listed (Tabelog gives none; the shop website nunomenosato.net did not resolve on 2026-10-30). Reviews show weekday lunch from about 12:00, full by 12:10 on a weekday (May 2025), a Saturday visit at 14:00 (April 2026) and set meals in the evening for ¥100 more (2022–2023 reviews). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats: 6 at the counter, three tables of 4; non-smoking; reservations and private hire possible (Tabelog). Punch cards sold (October 2026 review). Vegetables sold in and outside the shop (November 2023 review).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-34-20, Noble Square Shinmachi 1F — about 360 m from Nishi-Ohashi Stn
places.cuisine: Set-meal restaurant built on vegetables from Yamazoe Village in Nara and fish shipped direct from Wakayama (18 seats) · sets of about ¥1,000–1,500 with mixed rice (hijiki, five-grain, seasonal greens), miso soup, salad and two small vegetable sides: ginger pork, pork steak with green-onion sauce, juhosai (stir-fry of ten ingredients in oyster sauce), simmered fish, sautéed fish, grilled fish, ginger chicken, stir-fried vegetables, vegetable curry, ajillo, a daily special, chef's choice · evenings: the same sets plus omakase and drinks · sake, shochu, wine
places.notes: [Shokudo · Shinmachi, vegetable-packed set meals from a Nara village] A clean little set-meal shop with a counter and three tables that sources its vegetables from Yamazoe Village in Nara and its fish straight from Wakayama, and sells some of that produce at the door. Every set comes with a pile of vegetables: a salad with a vegetable dressing, two small sides (wasabi-leaf ohitashi, stir-fried shirataki, wakame) and rice mixed with hijiki, grains or whatever is in season. Favourites are the ginger pork, the pork steak under green-onion sauce, the simmered fish, and the juhosai, an oyster-sauce stir-fry so full of vegetables one diner could not count them. The master cooks everything alone, so a crowd can mean a wait, and it fills with office workers by 12:10; diners call the master and staff kind. Cash only.

roles: Master and cook (handles all the cooking alone, per a November 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Set-meal restaurant in Shinmachi using vegetables from Yamazoe Village, Nara Prefecture, and fish sent direct from Wakayama Prefecture (December 2022, February 2023 and July 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Healthy set meals of fresh, seasonal vegetables and fish (2023–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Juhosai stir-fry; ginger pork; simmered fish; vegetable mixed rice.

anecdotes.text: The master handles all the cooking single-handed, so there can be a short wait depending on the timing, per a November 2025 lunch diner.
Offered a choice of yuzu rice or seri rice, an undecided diner was served half of each: "Such a thoughtful gesture!" — January 2024, juhosai set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 布目の里、大阪市西区新町1-34-20 ノーブルスクエア新町 1F、西大橋駅から約360m、営業時間の記載なし、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、18席 (カウンター6席、4人がけテーブル3卓)、禁煙、貸切可、ウェブサイト nunomenosato.net (2026年10月30日にはつながらず)。口コミ(2022年10月〜2026年10月): Yamazoe Village (Nara) の野菜と Wakayama から直送の魚の定食、生姜焼き定食、ポークステーキ定食 (ねぎソース)、Juhosai の定食 (オイスターソース) 1200円、煮魚定食1100円、魚のソテー定食、焼き魚定食、生姜の鶏むね、野菜炒め定食、野菜カレー、アヒージョ定食、日替わり、おまかせ、夜は100円増し、ひじきや雑穀や季節の混ぜご飯、サラダ、小鉢2品、平日12時10分には満席、マスターがひとりで調理、スタッフも親切、店先や店内で野菜を販売、回数券あり、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at your seat; staff take orders in seat order, so wait to be asked (November 2023). Cash only.

places.name: アグー専門店 白いとんかつ花ひらく 四ツ橋店 (Aguu Senmon Ten Shiroi Tonkatsu Hana Hiraku Yotsubashi ten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the house specialty is breaded, fried tonkatsu, and the courses add curry and minced cutlet; no gluten information from the shop.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an Agu-pork specialist; the curry is simmered from Agu pork bones and the sides include dashi omelette.
places.hours_raw: From 1 November 2026: course menu by reservation only, one dinner sitting from 18:30, up to 7 guests a day; bookings for the next month open from the 20th to the end of each month (Tabelog notice). Closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog; shop site). Until October 2026 the shop also served lunch 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and dinner 18:00–23:00 (last order 21:00) (Tabelog; shop site). Same-day bookings and whole-shop hire by phone; children who cannot eat a full course are asked not to come; no strong perfume or fabric softener; BYO drinks allowed (Tabelog). Payment: Tabelog lists no cards or e-money but PayPay, Rakuten Pay and au PAY; the shop site lists cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), e-money and QR — check when booking. 7 counter seats at a single cypress slab; non-smoking (Tabelog; shop site). Opened here 1 November 2025 (Tabelog; the shop site says 31 October 2025) after moving from Fuse (November 2025 review).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 2-17-5, GATE80 Shinsaibashi WEST III — 4 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn (Exit 1), 6 min from Nishi-Nagahori Stn (Exit 1)
places.cuisine: Okinawan Agu-pork specialist: "white" tonkatsu fried slowly below 130°C, Agu shabu-shabu and pot-cooked rice at a 7-seat counter · about 14–15 kinds of Agu from Okinawa, Ishigaki and nearby islands, aged in-house 14 days or more · courses: tonkatsu tastings of tenderloin, loin, mille-feuille and chuck eye roll; shabu-shabu with three sauces (duck broth, garlic-chive soy, Arima-sansho ponzu) plus tonkatsu ¥4,800 · dashi-maki omelette, homemade pickles, miso soup with Okinawan mozuku, black curry simmered for 30 hours from Agu bones, white-miso pudding with brown sugar · until October 2026 also lunch sets: two-cut tonkatsu gozen ¥2,750, thick loin white tonkatsu with black curry ¥1,500, 300 g Agu pork steak ¥3,000, hamburg steak · Orion beer, sake, shochu, wine
places.notes: [Tonkatsu · Shinmachi, a seven-seat counter for Okinawan Agu pork] The shop of the pork-specialist cook known on social media as Gotton, who moved it from Fuse to Shinmachi in November 2025. It serves only Okinawan Agu pork, some 14 or 15 kinds from Okinawa, Ishigaki and the nearby islands, aged in-house for two weeks or more, down to rare purebred lines such as Manten Aguu Kuro Maru. The cutlets are "white": fried slowly below 130°C in a light crumb, so the coating stays pale and the pink meat juicy, with the sweet, clean fat diners keep mentioning. Courses pair tasting cuts with Agu shabu-shabu, three sauces including a sansho ponzu, a dashi omelette, rice cooked per person, and black curry simmered for 30 hours from the bones; finish with the white-miso pudding. From November 2026 there is no lunch: one 18:30 seating for seven, courses only, booked a month ahead.

chef_bio.chef_name: 中野 順一 (Junichi Nakano, per the shop site's English page)
roles: Chef (profile on the shop site, which calls it "the shop of pork-specialist cook Gotton (SNS recipe account)")
chef_bio.origin: Born and raised in Osaka (shop site)
chef_bio.background: Pork-specialist cook who posts home-cooking recipes on social media and has handled more than 100 domestic brand pigs (shop site); an August 2026 review gives 110,000 followers. Ran Hana Hiraku in Fuse before moving it here in November 2025 (November 2025 review). Takes part in study sessions with the pork expert Professor Kuwahara, per a June 2026 review.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tasted rare brand pigs across Japan and was captivated by Agu; cooks on a base of Japanese cuisine; "the pursuit of how to apply heat still has no end in sight" (shop site).
chef_bio.specialty: Low-temperature "white" Agu tonkatsu; Agu shabu-shabu; Agu-bone black curry.

anecdotes.text: "Since there was no cooking equipment to evenly heat it at 80 degrees (unlike in Fuse), it was prepared in a balloon for a water bath." — the white-miso pudding, November 2025, lunch course ¥3,900.
"After the meal, while chatting with the chef, I learned that 'someone interested in opening a tonkatsu restaurant in Okinawa came to study here.'" — June 2026, Manten Aguu Kuro Maru course.

places.name: べつばら (Betsubara)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the shaved ice itself is plain ice with fruit syrups, but many versions carry tiramisu cream, custard, chocolate or mochi, and the shop is also listed for baked goods.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Most kakigori use milk syrup, mascarpone, cream or cheese custard; an August 2026 diner had a peach kakigori with 100% peach syrup and "no milk syrup", so a fruit-only bowl may be possible.
places.hours_raw: Wed, Thu, Sat 13:00–19:00; Fri 13:00–18:00; closed Sun, Mon, Tue; last order 18:00 (Tabelog). Reservation only: book online through the Airreserve link on the shop's Instagram (Tabelog); August and October 2026 diners describe booking the day before, with a 21:00 cut-off. Temporary closures and changes are posted on Instagram; diners report a Sunday visit (June 2026) and a special evening opening for the nearby park's Bon Odori (September 2026). No cards or e-money; PayPay (Tabelog). 10 seats; non-smoking; takeout; children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 29 May 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 2-17-3, Shinmachi Apartment 1F — about 300 m north of Nishi-Ohashi Stn
places.cuisine: Year-round kakigori shop with fresh-fruit syrups made from seasonal fruit (10 seats) · summer peach (100% peach syrup blended to order), peach oolong milk tea, watermelon, melon mascarpone with kirsch cream, chocolate-mint melon, American and Rainier cherry, apricot vanilla milk, red shiso and Shiranui early mikan · autumn pear or fig "cheese tea" with Earl Grey syrup and cheese sauce, grape, pistachio · winter and spring strawberry vanilla pistachio, strawberry cream daifuku with mochi paste, lemon tiramisu, sakura mochi · condensed milk extra · warm tea served alongside
places.notes: [Sweets · Shinmachi, reservation-only kakigori built on fresh fruit] A small, bright shaved-ice shop north of Nishi-Ohashi Station, open since 2013, where the menu turns with the fruit season and the bookings go fast. In summer the peach is the prize: the fruit is blended to order into a 100% peach syrup sweeter than the peaches on top, and it often sells out by evening. Around it come watermelon, melon with mascarpone, chocolate-mint melon and cherries; autumn brings pear or fig with the shop's signature "cheese tea" of Earl Grey syrup and cheese sauce; winter and spring bring strawberries, pistachio and mochi-paste versions. A June 2026 diner rated the pistachio the best pistachio kakigori ever eaten. The room is quiet enough that the loudest sound is the ice being shaved, and warm tea comes in a small paper cup. Book the day before through the link on the shop's Instagram.

chef_bio.background: Kakigori shop open since 29 May 2013 (Tabelog), open all year, with reservations through Airreserve (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Peach kakigori; Earl Grey "cheese tea" kakigori with seasonal fruit; pistachio.

anecdotes.text: The peaches went into the mixer after the order: "The 100% peach syrup was shockingly sweet!" — August 2026, peach kakigori ¥2,100.
"The shop is quiet, with only the sound of the phone ringing and the ice being shaved, so I don't feel awkward dining solo at all." — February 2024, double-cherry mascarpone.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: べつばら、大阪市西区新町2-17-3 新町アパート 1F、西大橋駅から約300m、水・木・土13:00〜19:00、金13:00〜18:00、日・月・火休み、完全予約制 (Instagram の Airreserve から)、臨時休業は Instagram で、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、10席、禁煙、テイクアウト可、子供可、オープン日2013年5月29日、ジャンルはかき氷・洋菓子・パン。口コミ(2024年2月〜2026年10月): 季節の果物のシロップのかき氷、桃 (注文後にミキサーで果汁100%のシロップ) 2100円、桃のウーロンミルクティー、すいか、メロンとマスカルポーネ1700円、チョコミントメロン1600円、アメリカンチェリー1900円、杏のバニラミルク、赤紫蘇と Shiranui の早生みかん1400円、梨や無花果のチーズティー (アールグレイのシロップとチーズソース) 1600円、ピスタチオ、ぶどう、いちごのバニラピスタチオ1600円、いちごの生クリーム大福、レモンのティラミス、桜餅、練乳50円、予約は前日の21時 (2026年8月・10月)、桃は夕方に売り切れることも、近くの公園の盆踊りの日は夜も営業、日曜の来店も、静かな店内、紙コップの温かいお茶、明るいスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only, online via the link on the shop's Instagram; no walk-in queue (2026).

places.name: 福満屋 (Fukumitsuya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the menu runs to gyoza, spring rolls, kara-age, sweet-and-sour pork, dan dan noodles and crispy yakisoba, and sauces are not described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: pork, chicken, shrimp, squid and scallop dishes; nothing described as vegan.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday and public holidays, and over Golden Week, Obon and New Year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire for 8 or more with a minimum order of ¥4,000 a head (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) (Tabelog). The English listing's automatic translation mentions a 10% service charge, but the original Japanese text it shows says なし (none). 13 seats: 7 at the counter, 6 at tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog; a November 2025 review confirms smoking inside). One person cooks and serves, so dishes can take a while at busy times (Tabelog; 2025 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Tokuimachi 2-2-14, 1F (same address as Jinsei Yumeji Tokumen) — 3 min from Tanimachi 4-chome Stn exit 4
places.cuisine: Bistro-style Chinese counter (13 seats) · evening drink set ¥1,100: one drink with nuts, jellyfish salad, bang bang chicken, kara-age and spring rolls (March 2025) · tasting ("trial") set ¥1,600: jellyfish, bang bang chicken, spring rolls, kara-age, grilled gyoza, sweet-and-sour pork, a mini dan dan noodles (April 2025) · sweet-and-sour pork on a bed of fried spring-roll skins ¥1,180 (March 2025) · mapo tofu served bubbling in a cast-iron pot · shrimp, scallop and cheese egg stir-fry · spicy beef and lettuce fried rice · seafood crispy yakisoba · shrimp with mayonnaise · twice-cooked pork · draft beer ¥450, two kinds of Shaoxing wine (2025)
places.notes: [Chinese · Tanimachi 4-chome, a one-person bistro counter] A dark, slightly forbidding front opens onto a black, bar-like room with a hand-painted dragon on the wall, seven counter seats and a couple of tables. One chef, with 30 years in Chinese kitchens by the shop's own account, cooks and serves everything, so dishes come at their own pace; diners say the wait pays. Solo drinkers start with the ¥1,100 evening set (a drink plus five small plates) or the ¥1,600 tasting set that ends in a mini dan dan noodles, numbing and properly spicy. The sweet-and-sour pork sits on a bed of crisp fried spring-roll skins, the mapo tofu arrives bubbling in a cast-iron pot with a rich, deep flavour rather than Sichuan heat, and a regular never skips the shrimp, scallop and cheese egg stir-fry. Smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: A Chinese chef with 30 years of experience (Tabelog, shop-provided text). Diners describe a one-person operation in which the owner cooks and serves (March, June and August 2025 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Chinese cooking that brings out the natural flavour of the ingredients, at reasonable prices, with counter seats for solo diners (Tabelog, shop-provided text).
chef_bio.specialty: Mapo tofu; sweet-and-sour pork on fried spring-roll skins; set menus.

anecdotes.text: "It seems the owner manages everything alone, so there was a bit of a wait from ordering to serving, but it was a perfect amount of time to enjoy my mild buzz." — March 2025, evening drink set ¥1,100.
"I love Mapo Tofu, and I've had it at many Chinese restaurants, but this might be my favorite! It's not the typical Sichuan style; it has a rich and deep flavor." — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ(店舗会員): 福満屋、大阪市中央区徳井町2-2-14 大阪屋徳井ビル 1F、谷町四丁目駅4番出口から徒歩3分、月〜土18:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、日祝休み、GW・お盆・年末年始休み、予約可、8名以上の貸切は1人4000円以上、カード可 (VISA、Master、JCB、AMEX)、サービス料なし、13席 (カウンター7、テーブル6)、喫煙可。店の紹介: 中華の料理人歴30年、素材の味を生かした本格中華を手頃な値段で、カウンター中心で一人でも気軽に、混雑時は提供に時間がかかることも。口コミ(2025年2月〜2026年7月): 中華ビストロ、黒を基調にしたバーのような店内に手描きの龍、店主が一人で調理と接客、夜の晩酌セット1100円、お試しセット1600円 (クラゲ、bang bang chicken、春巻き、kara-age、焼き gyoza、酢豚、ミニ担々麺)、揚げた春巻きの皮にのせた酢豚1180円、鉄鍋で熱々の mapo tofu、海老とホタテとチーズの卵炒め、牛肉とレタスのピリ辛炒飯、海鮮のかた焼きそば、生ビール450円、紹興酒は甘口と辛口、店内喫煙可。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter, one person cooking and serving; smoking allowed (Tabelog, 2025 reviews).

Dinner by reservation only; reservations taken for dinner only; tell the shop about allergies or dislikes when booking (Tabelog). places.neighborhood: Tennoji Ward, Lions Mansion Yuhigaoka 102 (address 2-1-9), across from Isshinji Temple — 8 min from Shitennoji-mae Yuhigaoka Stn or JR Tennoji Stn
places.cuisine: Refined Chinese with Sichuan roots (18 seats) · lunch: spicy dan dan noodles ¥1,000 with half fried rice ¥250 (October 2025), chilled dan dan noodles in summer ¥1,200, sweet-and-sour pork set ¥1,450 with soup, bang bang chicken and lychee (September 2026), curry fried rice set ¥1,300 with two pieces of kara-age (September 2026), shrimp chili set, mapo rice, Taiwanese-style ramen, daily noodle specials · dinner (reserve): course ¥5,500 (September 2024); à la carte such as fried chicken with lemon sauce ¥1,210, shrimp chili ¥1,760, stir-fried pork with garlic stems ¥1,540, cashew chicken ¥1,650, snow crab and cheese spring rolls (2) ¥770, shumai (3) ¥720 (September 2025)
places.notes: [Chinese · Tennoji, a couple-run hideaway across from Isshinji Temple] An easy-to-miss restaurant in the ground floor of an apartment block facing Isshinji Temple. Diners say the owner-chef spent 15 years as head chef of a well-known restaurant and won the grand prize at a Chinese cooking competition, and a newspaper article on the wall tells of years leading a renowned Sichuan kitchen; celebrity autographs hang here and there. The cooking is refined rather than greasy. Lunch is good value: the signature dan dan noodles (choose the heat), sweet-and-sour pork set with soup and lychee, or a light, spicy curry fried rice with the house kara-age. Dinner is by reservation: a ¥5,500 course might bring stir-fried beef with miso tucked into steamed buns and sizzling crispy rice. Regulars mention the warmth of the master and the master's wife, and an owner who sees guests out the door.

chef_bio.background: Served 15 years as head chef at a famous restaurant and won the grand prize in a Chinese cooking competition (September 2025 and September 2026 reviews, the latter citing the shop's Tabelog page). A newspaper article displayed in the restaurant says the master was head chef at a renowned Sichuan restaurant for many years (September 2024 review). Runs the shop with the master's wife (July 2025 and September 2024 reviews). Tabelog notes a move from Ōsu, Nagoya.
chef_bio.specialty: Dan dan noodles; sweet-and-sour pork; dinner courses.

anecdotes.text: "The master and his wife are very friendly and enjoyable to talk to. Every visit feels great." — July 2025, course meal.
"Unlike the heavy, greasy style of local Chinese food, this dish features a refined fried rice base topped with a light and spicy curry flavor." — September 2026, curry fried rice set ¥1,300.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ(店舗会員): チャイナ ダイニング アルファ、大阪市天王寺区逢阪2-1-9 ライオンズマンション夕陽丘102、四天王寺前夕陽ケ丘駅・天王寺駅・恵美須町駅から徒歩8分、月水〜日11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、火曜と第1・第3月曜休み、夜は予約のみ、アレルギーは予約時に、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay・d払い可、18席、禁煙、子供・ベビーカー可、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフあり、名古屋市中区大須3-30-6から移転。口コミ(2024年6月〜2026年10月): 一心寺の向かい、ハンバーガー店の隣、見つけにくい隠れ家、有名店で料理長を15年、中華料理のコンクールで大賞、店内の新聞記事に四川料理の名店の料理長だったと、有名人のサイン、マスターと奥さんがあたたかい、帰りに外まで見送り、ランチは担々麺1000円と半炒飯250円、夏の冷やし担々麺1200円、酢豚ランチ1450円 (スープ、bang bang chicken、ライチ)、カレー炒飯セット1300円 (kara-age 2個)、海老チリ、台湾風ラーメン、夜は予約でコース5500円、牛肉の味噌炒めを蒸したての饅頭にはさんで、おこげのあんかけ、揚げた若鶏のレモンソース1210円、海老チリ1760円、ニンニクの芽と豚の炒め1540円、カシューナッツ炒め1650円、ずわい蟹とチーズの春巻き770円、shumai 720円。

places.name: 炭焼き鶏とつくねの店 空音 (Sumiyaki Tori to Tsukune no Mise Kuune)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Lunch is wheat-noodle dan dan noodles or chicken mapo tofu; at night, yakitori and tsukune come in several flavours (salt, shiso-kombu, miso mayonnaise), and tare is not described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken restaurant; the noodles and mapo tofu are topped with minced chicken.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–12:45 (last entry for lunch) and 17:30–21:30; Sat 17:30–21:30; closed Sunday, public holidays and every other Saturday — check the monthly calendar (Tabelog). Lunch serves only dan dan noodles and chicken mapo tofu; order and pay at once (2023–2025 reviews); mostly business people at lunch (2022 review). Yakitori and tsukune at night. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 15 seats: 7 at the counter, two tables of 4; non-smoking (Tabelog). Bentos under the name Kuune Bento (Instagram kuune_obento, per Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Awajicho 1-2-8, Rejoice Awajicho 1F — about 6–7 min from Kitahama or Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stn
places.cuisine: Charcoal-grilled chicken and tsukune by night, soupless dan dan noodles by day (15 seats) · lunch: dry black dan dan noodles, simple black-sesame version ¥800 (December 2025, April 2026) or with Sichuan spices ¥830 (November 2025), topped with spiced minced chicken, bok choy, pickled ginger, kaki-pi crackers and nuts; seafood mala noodles; chilled versions in summer; extra noodles ×1.5 ¥100, rice (100 g) ¥50, soft-boiled egg; chicken mapo tofu · dinner: yakitori (heart, gizzard, thigh with green onion) and tsukune in salt, shiso-kombu or miso-mayonnaise, shrimp and cheese tsukune, chicken wings, chicken sashimi course, Kuune course ¥2,500 (February 2024), egg rice to finish, uncommon sake, black-sesame shochu
places.notes: [Yakitori · Awajicho, a couple's tsukune bar that sells dan dan noodles at lunch] A dim, homey room on the ground floor of Rejoice Awajicho, run by a couple: the chef in the kitchen, the partner out front. At night it is a charcoal yakitori and tsukune bar — order skewers singly to try more, with salt, shiso-kombu or miso-mayo tsukune, shrimp and cheese versions, and egg rice to finish. At lunch the counter fills with office workers for just two things: chicken mapo tofu, eaten like curry, and soupless dan dan noodles, the house signature. Flat, chewy noodles come in a curry plate under spiced minced chicken, black and white sesame and tahini, bok choy, sushi-style pickled ginger and crunchy kaki-pi; pick the simple black-sesame bowl or the numbing Sichuan one, add rice to mop up the sauce, and borrow the apron provided. One noodle critic found the flavour lacking; most come back.

chef_bio.background: Run by two people, the head chef in the kitchen and a hostess serving customers (December 2022 review); described as a couple (December 2023 and February 2024 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled chicken and tsukune; soupless dan dan noodles; chicken mapo tofu.

anecdotes.text: "In the evening, they serve yakitori, but during lunch, they focus on tantanmen." — November 2025, dry black tantanmen with Sichuan spices ¥830.
"The restaurant is run by two people: the head chef in the kitchen and the hostess serving customers." — December 2022.

cultural_comfort.note: Lunch: order and pay at once; noon queues of office workers (2023–2025 reviews).

places.name: 担々麵＆中華バル 辣将軍 (Tantanmen & Chuka Bar Karashogun)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tantanmen shop built on wheat noodles; the mapo rice and bar dishes are not described for gluten.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: the menu runs to fried chicken, shrimp and clams, and no plant-based tantanmen or mapo is mentioned.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–23:00; Sat and public holidays 18:00–23:00 (no lunch); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Obon: dinner only on 11–16 August (Tabelog). One May 2025 diner found it closed on weekends. Reservations accepted; no cards, other payment not listed (Tabelog). 20 seats; no smoking at lunch, smoking allowed in the evening bar hours (Tabelog). Spice is chosen when ordering, in five levels per a February 2025 review; lunch queues of office workers (2025 reviews). Opened 20 November 2016 (Tabelog). The Tabelog address reads 江子之島, a slip for 江之子島.
places.neighborhood: Enokojima 1-6-2, 1F (same address as Men LABO Yuisou) — 1 min from Awaza Stn exit 10 (Sennichimae Line), near Utsubo Park
places.cuisine: Sichuan-style tantanmen and mapo tofu from a Chinese chef (20 seats) · about ten kinds of tantanmen (February 2025), each with a choice of thin, medium-thick or flat noodles (October 2025): original Sichuan tantanmen ¥935 (February 2025), white-sesame tantanmen, Gold tantanmen, dry (soupless) tantanmen · mapo noodles ¥990, extra spicy +¥100 (July 2026) · lunch sets pairing tantanmen with mapo rice, with salad and canned mandarin: A or B set ¥950 before tax (2025), ¥1,045 with tax (February 2026), C set of half portions under ¥1,000 (August 2026) · fried rice ¥680 (April 2025) · evening bar dishes: fried peanuts, pickled mustard greens, yurinchi, stir-fried chives and egg, shrimp, clams · beer, sake, shochu, wine, cocktails
places.notes: [Ramen · Awaza, a Sichuan tantanmen counter under a painted Shoki] A small Chinese bar in an office building a minute from Awaza Station, behind a bold sign, where the owner is said to have painted the imposing wall mural of Shoki, and the chef speaks Chinese. Tantanmen is the point: around ten kinds, five spice levels, and three noodles to choose from (thin, medium-thick, or the rarer flat ones). The original Sichuan bowl brings numbing peppercorn and star anise, the white-sesame one is tangier and gentle, and 'regular' heat already makes some diners sweat — though others found medium mild. At lunch, office workers queue for sets pairing tantanmen with the even hotter mapo rice; dishes come as they are ready, finished with a few canned mandarin segments. A regular since opening felt the flavours drifted in September 2026, and another diner got overcooked noodles, but the owner's generosity (free rice, almond tofu, a rounded-down bill) wins people over.

chef_bio.origin: From "the mainland" per a February 2025 review; Tabelog calls the cooking "authentic Sichuan delicacies by a Chinese chef".
chef_bio.background: Opened 20 November 2016 (Tabelog). The owner chats casually with customers (February 2025 review), the chef speaks Chinese (May 2025 review), the owner is said to have painted the Shoki mural (March 2025 review), and a single chef runs the kitchen (September 2026 review, a regular since opening).
chef_bio.philosophy: Rich Sichuan-style tantanmen where spice, aroma and umami come together (Tabelog, shop-provided text).

anecdotes.text: "The generous owner treated us to rice and almond tofu, and even rounded down the bill for us." — August 2026, Gold tantanmen.
"For the tantanmen, I had the choice of thin, medium-thick, or flat noodles. I thought, 'Isn't flat tantanmen quite rare?'" — October 2025, B mapo rice set ¥950 before tax.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ(店舗会員): 担々麵＆中華バル 辣将軍、大阪市西区江子之島1-6-2 奥内第8ビル1F (江之子島の誤記)、阿波座駅10番出口から徒歩1分、月〜金11:30〜14:00・18:00〜23:00、土祝18:00〜23:00、日曜休み、お盆は8月11〜16日夜のみ、予約可、カード不可、20席、ランチは禁煙・バータイムは喫煙可、オープン日2016年11月20日。店の紹介: 中国人の料理人による本格四川料理、大阪初の本格四川の濃厚担々麺。口コミ(2024年5月〜2026年9月): 店主は本土の出身で気さくに客と話す、料理人は中国語を話す、壁の Shoki の絵は店主が描いたという、辛さ5段階、担々麺は10種類ほど、麺は細麺・中太麺・平打ち麺から、四川風の担々麺935円、mapo noodles 990円 (激辛+100円)、白ごまの担々麺は酸味寄り、Gold 担々麺、汁なしの担々麺、ランチは担々麺と mapo rice のセット (Aセット・Bセット950円税別、2026年2月は税込1045円、Cセットはハーフで1000円以下)、サラダとみかんの缶詰、炒飯680円、夜はピーナッツ揚げ、ザーサイ、yurinchi、ニラ玉、海老、あさり、花椒と八角の香り、普通でも汗だくという声と辛くないという声、オープン以来の常連が2026年9月に味のぶれを感じた、麺がのびていたという声、ご飯と杏仁豆腐をサービスしてくれて端数もまけてくれた。

noodles.notes: Choice of thin, medium-thick or flat noodles with each tantanmen (October 2025); the flat ones chewy (August 2026); thin noodles firm in the mapo noodles (July 2026); one February 2026 diner got overcooked noodles.

ramen.signature_bowl: Original Sichuan tantanmen ¥935 (February 2025); an April 2025 review gives ¥850 for the original tantanmen.

vegan.note: Broth not described; no plant-based bowl is mentioned.

ramen.pantheon: Awaza's Sichuan tantanmen bar: ten bowls, five heat levels and three noodles, with numbing peppercorn, star anise and rich sesame, beside a fiery mapo rice.

richness: "The tantanmen has a rich sesame flavor" (September 2026), against "slightly lacking in richness" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270105/27095877/dtlrvwlst/B496424976/, November 2024) — mid-scale.
oiliness: Oil not described in any fetched review — mid-scale.
clarity: Sesame tantanmen ("rich sesame flavor", September 2026) — opaque.
tare_strength: White-sesame tantanmen "leaned more towards a tangy flavor" (May 2024); seasoning strength not otherwise described — mid-scale.
noodle_firmness: "Firm, thin noodles" (July 2026) and chewy flat noodles (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270105/27095877/dtlrvwlst/B533255755/, August 2026), against overcooked noodles (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270105/27095877/dtlrvwlst/B522226198/, February 2026) — mid-scale.
aroma_punch: "The flavor of the Sichuan peppercorns was quite prominent" (July 2026); "the aroma of star anise and other spices" (https://tabelog.com/en/osaka/A2701/A270105/27095877/dtlrvwlst/B501749648/, February 2025).

places.name: コーヒーショップ エリカ (Coffee Shop Erika)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the food is toast, sandwiches, hot dogs, pasta and pancakes. Coffee and the boiled egg that comes with the morning sets are the wheat-free items.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the morning sets come with a boiled egg, the sandwiches hold egg and ham, the hot dogs a sausage, and the toast is topped with cheese; lattes and cappuccinos use milk. Black coffee is the option.
places.hours_raw: Daily 7:00–22:00 (Tabelog; Namba Walk shop page; July 2026 review: "Open every day"). Morning menu 7:00–11:00 (April 2025 and January 2026 reviews); a January 2026 diner found the light meals are a separate menu that starts later (the diner guessed 11:00). Order and pay first at the counter (June 2025, January–February 2026 reviews). Smoking: reviews from October 2024 to January 2026 say every seat allows smoking (an October 2024 review: it moved from a designated smoking area to full smoking; a January 2025 review: so under-18s may not enter), and the Namba Walk page lists 喫煙可能; Tabelog still says "designated smoking area" with 8 non-smoking seats added — expect smoke. Tabelog: no credit cards, no e-money, QR payments accepted; a February 2026 review paid with a transport IC card, an October 2024 review photographed a "PayPay accepted" sign, and the Namba Walk page says cashless OK. 20 seats (Tabelog); counter 21, table 1 (Namba Walk page); Wi-Fi (Namba Walk page).

places.cuisine: Kissa / coffee stand with a horseshoe counter, smoking allowed · morning sets 7:00–11:00: mini sandwich (egg and ham) with boiled egg and drink ¥470 (April 2025, January 2026), ¥500 (July 2026); hot dog with curry-flavoured cabbage, boiled egg and coffee ¥500 (July 2025, January 2026); cheese toast ¥500 (January 2026) · mixed sandwich set with salad and drink ¥700 (March and August 2025) · toast sandwich set (chicken ham, vegetables, cheese) ¥750 (January 2025) · pasta set, six pastas to choose from, with salad and drink ¥1,000 (July 2025) · pancakes (October 2026) · coffee ¥450 (January–February 2026), iced coffee ¥400 (April 2025), iced café latte ¥450 (September 2025), cappuccino
places.notes: [Kissa · Namba Walk, a smokers' coffee stand at the ticket gate] A Showa-style coffee shop in the Namba Walk underground mall, right by the Midosuji Line Namba Station ticket gate and the escalator up to Kintetsu Osaka-Namba. The kitchen sits inside a horseshoe counter, with a few tables in the middle; you order and pay first, and the food comes almost at once. It opens at 7:00, and the morning sets are the draw: a mini egg-and-ham sandwich, a hot dog with curry-flavoured cabbage, or cheese toast, each about ¥500 with a drink; the sandwich and hot dog sets add a boiled egg. One January 2026 diner called the price low enough to surprise even Nagoya. Later in the day there are sandwich sets, a pasta set and pancakes. This is one of the few cafés left where every seat allows smoking, and it is popular with salarymen; non-smokers in the 2025–2026 reviews found the smoke hard going. The coffee draws mixed notes, from aromatic to merely average, and one diner found it lukewarm.

chef_bio.background: A long-established coffee shop near the station (January 2025 review); Tabelog reviews go back to March 2017. The Namba Walk shop page lists it in the 1-bangai section as a coffee stand serving freshly ground coffee with toast and hot dogs.
chef_bio.philosophy: Freshly ground coffee to stop in for between work and shopping, with toast and hot dogs; a horseshoe counter with a grown-up feel (Namba Walk shop page).
chef_bio.specialty: Cheap morning sets; coffee where smoking is allowed.

anecdotes.text: "Outside, there was a sign advertising their morning menu, offering breakfast at an unbelievably low price that would surprise even Nagoya. This is Osaka for you." — January 2026, hot dog morning ¥500.
"I was on the 8:00 AM Limited Express Hinotori, so I decided to grab a light breakfast beforehand… Mini Sandwich Morning Set - JPY 500. It even comes with a boiled egg!" — July 2026.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the menu runs on wheat noodles (curry champon, champon, tanmen), gyoza and soy-seasoned set meals; no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken broth, pork in the noodle soups, meat-filled gyoza, sweet and sour pork and chicken dishes.

Reservations accepted by phone; can be booked for private use (Tabelog). places.neighborhood: Edobori 1-21-5, 1F — 5 min walk from Higobashi Stn (Yotsubashi Line), 338 m
places.cuisine: Local Chinese (machi-chuka), 15 seats · curry champon: chicken broth with soy sauce and a blended spicy curry powder, thin straight noodles, bean sprouts, garlic chives, cabbage, carrot, onion and pork — set with rice or a small fried rice ¥950 (March 2026) · champon · Yumen with a small fried rice ¥950 (June 2026) · tanmen with bean sprouts and cabbage · Tianjin noodles set with fried rice ¥1,050 (March 2026) · ramen and fried rice set · daily set (a vegetable soba with mini fried rice, December 2025) · sweet and sour pork set meal · moist, lightly seasoned fried rice ("yakimeshi") · gyoza (evenings only), house-made and full of vegetables, with a peppery filling · Tianjin rice · eight-treasure stir-fry · chicken simmered in a savoury sauce · bottled beer
places.notes: [Ramen · Edobori, a TV-famous machi-chuka and its curry champon] A homely local Chinese restaurant five minutes from Higobashi Station, with a short counter and four tables, featured on TV by Kendo Kobayashi as a local Chinese spot; several March–April 2026 diners came after seeing it on TV. Almost everyone orders a noodle soup, and above all the curry champon: chicken broth and soy sauce with a blended spicy curry powder, on thin straight noodles rather than the usual thick champon noodles, loaded with bean sprouts, cabbage and garlic chives. One diner found it addictive, another rather mild and reached for the chili oil. It comes as a ¥950 set with a small, moist fried rice (March 2026), good dipped in the curry soup. One regular always orders the light, comforting Yumen; another liked the tanmen packed with bean sprouts and cabbage. In the evening there is gyoza, house-made, full of vegetables and peppery, which one diner says made the visit worthwhile. One diner saw the owner apparently cooking everything alone in the lunch rush. Cash only, and smoking is allowed at the tables.

chef_bio.background: Local Chinese restaurant; the owner cooks everything alone at lunch (June 2026 review). Featured on TV by Kendo Kobayashi as a local Chinese restaurant (August 2026 review); a March 2026 diner came the day after a TV feature (March 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Curry champon with a small fried rice; evening gyoza.

anecdotes.text: "The rich flavor of the chicken broth combined with soy sauce and a uniquely blended spicy curry powder created a wonderful balance of taste… The noodles are thin and straight." — March 2026, curry champon set ¥950.
"The owner seemed to be cooking everything… which must be quite challenging during the busy lunch hours." — June 2026, Yumen and small fried rice ¥950.

"The crispy edges were perfectly fragrant, and the skin had a nice crunch while still being pleasantly chewy… just being able to try this gyoza made the visit worthwhile." — August 2026, gyoza and bottled beer near closing.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon, stand-soba noodles, Chinese noodles, tempura and kakiage, croquettes and katsu; a diner saw soy sauce go into the bowl before the broth (August 2026).

places.hours_raw: Daily 6:00–16:00; closing days not fixed; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; December 2025 review); buy a ticket at the machine and hand it over at the counter, though a raw egg can also be ordered with cash (August 2026 review). 6 counter seats, a standing area in front and chairs at the back (Tabelog); "6 counter seats and 2 chairs" (January 2026 review). Non-smoking (Tabelog; December 2025 review).

places.cuisine: Stand-up soba and udon shop on a station stair landing (6 counter seats, standing room, a few chairs) · kake soba ¥320 · tanuki (kitsune) soba with two pieces of fried tofu ¥400 · kakiage soba ¥420 · kakiage udon ¥420 with corn and green beans in the kakiage · tempura udon or soba ¥440 with shrimp tempura, kakiage and wakame · kasu udon ¥550 · katsu udon ¥550 · curry udon with braised beef · croquette soba · "Ekimae soba" (station-front soba): yellow Chinese noodles in the dashi with dashimaki egg, fried tofu, tempura bits, wakame, bean sprouts, green onions and kamaboko · soba set or udon-and-soba set ¥500 (noodles, a rice ball or rice and a croquette) · tsukimi soba set ¥530 · raw egg ¥90 (August 2026), boiled egg ¥70 (June 2025)
places.notes: [Stand-up soba · Tennoji, a stair-landing noodle stop from 6 am] Hard to spot the first time: a noren on the landing of the stairs between the underground central gate of Kintetsu Osaka-Abenobashi Station and JR Tennoji, with standing room in front and a few chairs at the back. It opens at 6 am for commuters and travellers, and the prices are the draw: kake soba ¥320, tempura udon with shrimp and kakiage ¥440, and a one-coin set of soba, rice and a croquette for ¥500. The soy sauce goes into the bowl before the broth, the way a ramen shop does it, and diners praise the light Kansai dashi more than the noodles, which are soft in the stand-soba way; a few wanted more bonito, or a hotter bowl. Try the big kakiage, the kasu udon with fried pork fat, or the curry udon with braised beef. There is also an "Ekimae soba" with yellow Chinese noodles in the dashi. Cash at the ticket machine.

chef_bio.background: An old stand-up noodle shop on the Kintetsu Osaka-Abenobashi Station stairs; diners call it an old shop with character and a Showa-era feel (2024–2026 reviews). A September 2024 diner found it run by an older man and a young woman; a December 2025 diner was served by a friendly woman at the counter while the owner fried the kakiage and boiled the noodles. Diners disagree on the tempura: a December 2025 diner says it is commercial-grade, a January 2026 diner that all of it is made in-house by the chef.
chef_bio.specialty: Kakiage soba and udon; one-coin soba sets.

anecdotes.text: "The highlight here is definitely the delicious broth, which rivals that of high-end restaurants." — January 2026, tanuki (kitsune) soba ¥400.
The soy sauce goes into the bowl before the broth, "which reminded me of a ramen shop. The flavor was good, with a strong dashi taste." — August 2026, tempura soba ¥440 with a raw egg ¥90.
"The kakiage is colorful, filled with corn and green beans, and it's quite large." — January 2026, kakiage udon ¥420.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 王冠、うどん・立ち食いそば・ラーメン、大阪市阿倍野区阿倍野筋1-1-43 大阪阿部野橋駅 改札外 B1F、地下中央改札を出て1番出口の階段を上がる途中、大阪阿部野橋駅から33m、毎日6:00〜16:00、定休日不定、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、カウンター6席と手前に立ち食い、奥に椅子、禁煙。口コミ(2024年9月〜2026年8月): 階段の踊り場にあるのれんの店、朝6時から、券売機で食券を買って渡す、かけそば320円、きつねそば400円、かき揚げそば420円、かき揚げうどん420円 (コーンといんげん入りの大きなかき揚げ)、天ぷらうどん440円 (えび天、かき揚げ、わかめ)、天ぷらそば440円、かすうどん550円、カツうどん550円、牛肉を煮込んだカレーうどん、コロッケそば、黄色い中華麺をだしで食べる Ekimae soba、そばセット500円 (そば、ご飯、コロッケ)、うどんとそばのセットは450円から500円に、月見そば定食530円、生卵90円 (以前は70円)、ゆで卵70円、醤油を先に入れてからだしを注ぐ、あっさりした関西風のだしがおいしいという声と、麺はやわらかく平凡という声、天ぷらは業務用という声と店で揚げているという声、年配の男性と若い女性の店員、昭和の雰囲気、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine, cash only; hard to find the first time (December 2025).

places.name: ぐう (Gu)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles in soy or miso broth, and Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki built on wheat batter and noodles.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone broth and chashu in the ramen; pork and squid tempura on the okonomiyaki.
places.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sat 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–21:30; Sun 18:00–21:30; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reviews differ on weekends: an April 2025 diner says Saturday is dinner only, and a September 2025 diner lists 16:30–21:30 on weekends and holidays, so check before a weekend lunch. Ramen at lunch; at night Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki, teppan dishes, side dishes and drinks, with the ramen still on offer (2025–2026 reviews). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cards or e-money (Tabelog); a September 2025 diner notes pay-after with cashless options. 20 seats: a counter in front, tables and raised-floor seating at the back (Tabelog; reviews). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Moved here from Daido 2-5-7, Tennoji-ku (Tabelog); an October 2025 diner heard it used to be at the Teradacho intersection.

places.cuisine: Ramen by day, Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki and drinks by night (20 seats) · shoyu, miso and shio ramen with pork-bone broth; shoyu and miso also "hearty" (thick curly noodles, about 200 g; the others medium-thin, about 130 g) · shoyu chashu ramen ¥900, shio chashu ramen ¥900 (September 2025) · hearty shoyu ramen with chashu and egg ¥980 (April 2025) · plenty of egg and green onion as a topping; extra noodles come with chashu · lunch: free kimchi, rice and kimchi ¥200, pork rice bowl or egg rice ¥380 (May 2025) · hiyashi chuka · Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki with pork ¥870, ika-ten · at night a blackboard of side dishes and teppan dishes, including homemade chashu ¥500, macaroni salad ¥380, cheese spring rolls, grilled stingray fin, Botanyaki · sake, shochu, wine, large bottled lager ¥700
places.notes: [Ramen · Teradacho, shoyu ramen at lunch and Hiroshima okonomiyaki at night] A 20-seat neighbourhood place by the Teradacho crossing that changes with the clock: ramen at lunch, and at night Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki, a blackboard of side dishes and drinks, with the ramen still there to finish. Ramen fans come for a shoyu bowl compared to the Akira style: a sharp soy sauce over a pork-bone broth with an old-fashioned simmered-pork aroma, plenty of green onion and generous chashu. Shoyu and miso come "hearty", meaning about 200 g of thick, curly, chewy noodles instead of the medium-thin 130 g; shio is also on the menu. At lunch the kimchi is free, and rice is ¥200. The okonomiyaki is layered with crisp fried noodles and lots of cabbage, cut into pieces for easy eating. A friendly couple runs it, and diners talk about the regulars, and one found the owner remembered a customer from a single earlier ramen visit. Closed Tuesday; reviews disagree on weekend lunch.

chef_bio.background: Ramen and Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki shop that moved here from Daido 2-5-7, Tennoji-ku (Tabelog). "Run by a very friendly couple" (September 2025 review); one person working the kitchen alone that day (November 2025 review). The owner brought the side-dish menu over and remembered a diner who had come once before for ramen (May 2025 review). Diners mention many regulars (October 2025; April 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Shoyu chashu ramen, "hearty" with thick noodles; Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki.

anecdotes.text: "The richness and acidity of the soy sauce combined with the umami of the pork created a taste reminiscent of Akira-style ramen." — October 2025, hearty shoyu ramen with chashu and egg.
"I was worried about whether there would be snacks for beer, but the owner reassured me, 'We have plenty!'" — April 2026, first night visit.
"The interior has depth, with a counter in the front and table seating in the back, run by a very friendly couple." — September 2025, shio and shoyu chashu ramen ¥900 each.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ぐう、ラーメン・お好み焼き、大阪市天王寺区寺田町2-1-12、JR環状線寺田町駅北口を出て国道25号を西へ徒歩5分、月曜・水曜〜土曜12:00〜14:00と18:00〜21:30、日曜18:00〜21:30、火曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、20席 (テーブル6席と4席、小上がり4席×3卓)、禁煙、日本酒・焼酎・ワイン、天王寺区大道2-5-7から移転。口コミ(2025年4月〜2026年5月): 昼はラーメン、夜は広島風お好み焼きと一品と酒、夜もラーメンあり、醤油・味噌・塩、醤油と味噌に hearty (太いちぢれ麺200g) があり、ほかは中細麺130g、醤油チャーシュー900円、塩チャーシュー900円 (2025年9月)、hearty の醤油チャーシューに玉子980円 (2025年4月)、たまごとねぎたっぷり、替え玉にもチャーシュー、昼はキムチ無料、ご飯とキムチ200円、ご飯もの380円、hiyashi chuka、広島風お好み焼き豚870円、ika-ten、自家製チャーシュー小500円、マカロニサラダ380円、チーズ春巻き、エイヒレ、瓶ビール大700円、鉄板焼き、豚骨の香りとキレのある醤油、Akira 系の味という声、あっさりという声、もちもちの太麺、チャーシューたっぷり、キャベツたっぷりでパリッとした麺のお好み焼き、とても気さくな夫婦の店、常連が多い、土曜は夜のみという声と、土日祝は16:30〜21:30という声、後払いでキャッシュレス可という声。

noodles.notes: Two noodles: the "hearty" shoyu and miso use thick, curly, chewy noodles (about 200 g); the other bowls use medium-thin noodles (about 130 g) (April 2025 review); the thick noodles have "a nice chewy texture" (May 2026 review).

ramen.chashu: Generous, thick chashu (October 2025; April 2025); one May 2026 diner found the chashu not large but flavorful.

oiliness: Pork-bone shoyu; oil not described — mid-scale (inferred).

cultural_comfort.note: Neighbourhood shop with many regulars; side dishes on a blackboard at night (April 2026).

places.name: ピッコロ なんばウォーク店 (Piccolo Namba Walk)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information for the curry sauce (the maker's retort version, sold as the shop's taste, lists spices, fruit, vegetables, beef, chutney and cream but no full ingredient list); the katsu curry and karaage are breaded or fried, so skip those.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature Piccolo curry is a beef curry finished with cream (the maker's own description), the hayashi sauce is a brown sauce with loin meat finished with cream and yoghurt (also the maker's description), and the omurice is egg over chicken rice.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00, last order 21:30 (Piccolo shop list, read 2026-10-30); Tabelog gives 10:30–22:00, closed on irregular days and New Year's Day. Omurice is served 11:00–15:00 (July 2026 review). 8 counter seats, with the Namba Walk passage right behind them (Tabelog; August and October 2026 reviews). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No reservations; non-smoking; takeout; the shop also sells the retort curries to take home (shop list: お持ち帰り・レトルトカレー販売店). Fukujinzuke pickles are free; rakkyo ¥110 (August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Namba Walk underground mall, west side (Namba 2, Namba Walk 1-9) — a short walk from the north-west exits of Midosuji Line Namba and Osaka Namba stations
places.cuisine: Osaka curry shop, counter only · three bases: Piccolo sauce curry (beef), spicy curry and Piccolo hayashi; two on one plate as the "W sauce" (July 2026) or half-and-half (April 2026) · katsu curry ¥1,100 (August 2026) · beef curry with raw egg topping (June 2026) · small katsu curry (June 2026) · karaage (August 2026) · omurice 11:00–15:00 with tomato sauce ¥800, curry sauce ¥950 or hayashi sauce ¥1,050 (July 2026) · free fukujinzuke, rakkyo ¥110 (August 2026) · retort curries to take home
places.notes: [Curry · Namba Walk, the underground branch of an Umeda institution] A counter-only curry stand on the west side of the Namba Walk underground mall, so small that the walkway runs right behind your stool. Piccolo began in the Umeda underground mall over 40 years ago, by the maker's account (a 2026 review says over 50), and magazines once called it the "King of Curry". The house curry is a beef curry slow-cooked from thirty-odd spices with fruit and vegetables, rounded off with chutney and cream: sweet and rich rather than hot. For more heat there is a spicy curry with a lighter colour, and the "W sauce" puts both on one plate. Food comes fast, often within minutes, which suits a lunch break; free fukujinzuke sits on the counter. Katsu curry was ¥1,100 in August 2026, and omurice with tomato, curry or hayashi sauce runs ¥800–1,050 at lunch. Opinions run from "incredibly delicious" to "classic, just average". Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Run by ミツヤ食品工業株式会社 (head office Shinsaibashisuji 2-3-16; factory in Higashi-Osaka), which also makes Piccolo retort curries. The company's shop list names five Piccolo shops: Namba Walk, Whity Umeda, Hankyu Kappa Yokocho, JR Osaka Station and Nishinomiya Hankyu. Per the company site, Piccolo opened in the Umeda underground mall "over 40 years ago" as a pioneering curry specialist and was introduced as the "King of Curry" in magazines such as L Magazine; 2026 reviews give "nearly half a century" and "over 50 years". A long-time diner called the Namba Walk branch "Piccolo Junior", with a menu slightly different from Umeda's.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh, carefully chosen ingredients, a blend of thirty-odd spices, and beef cooked separately so the meat itself can be tasted (company site).
chef_bio.specialty: Piccolo beef curry; spicy curry; the two together as the W sauce.

anecdotes.text: "Including the time it takes to fry the katsu, my stay was just 15 minutes from arrival to checkout." — August 2026, katsu curry ¥1,100.
"In the past, I used to enjoy beef curry at the same restaurant in Umeda… the prices have increased by about 30% for similar dishes. So, I opted for the half-and-half curry." — April 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ピッコロ なんばウォーク店、カレー・オムライス、大阪市中央区難波2 虹の街1-9、近鉄難波駅・地下鉄御堂筋線なんば駅すぐ、10:30〜22:00、不定休と元日、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、カウンター8席、禁煙、テイクアウト可。ピッコロカリーのサイト (ミツヤ食品工業株式会社、本社 大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-16、東大阪工場): 店舗はなんばウォーク店 (なんばウォーク1-9、11:00〜22:00、オーダーストップ21:30)、ホワイティ梅田店、阪急かっぱ横丁店、JR大阪駅店、西宮阪急店、お持ち帰り・レトルトカレー販売店 (店内でお召し上がりいただけます)。40余年前に梅田の地下街に開いたカレー専門店で、Lマガジンなどで「キングオブカリー」と紹介された。ピッコロビーフカリーは30数種のスパイスに果実と野菜、牛肉を加えて長時間煮込み、チャツネと生クリームで仕上げる。口コミ (2026年): ピッコロソースカリー、スパイシーカリー、ピッコロハヤシの3種、2種がけのWソース、カツカレー1100円、オムライス (11:00〜15:00) はトマトソース800円・カレーソース950円・ハヤシソース1050円、福神漬は無料、らっきょうは110円、提供が速い、席のすぐ後ろが通路、梅田の店から通う人も、値段は以前より3割ほど上がったという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; tiny counter, quick service (2026).

places.name: 寿司 天ぷら 明 難波 心斎橋店 (Sushi × Tempura Akira)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: half the menu is tempura and fried dishes (wheat batter), the sushi is eaten with soy sauce, and there is a ramen to finish. Sashimi exists, but there is no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; the dashimaki is egg soaked in chicken broth (March 2025), the ramen is a sea-bream broth, and the tempura comes with a homemade dipping sauce whose makeup no source gives.
places.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–16:00 (last order food 15:00, drinks 15:30) and 17:00–23:30 (last order food 22:30, drinks 23:00); closed on irregular days (Tabelog; reviews dated March 2025 and July 2026 give 12:00–23:30 and "Closed: Irregular holidays"). Appetizer charge ¥350 per person (Tabelog; a June 2026 diner's appetizer was katsuo tataki at ¥350); one drink per person is the rule (September 2026 review). Reservations taken; book ahead, it was nearly full on a weekday (September 2026 review); the all-you-can-eat sushi course is limited to three groups a day, by phone only (Tabelog). Cards, QUICPay, PayPay and Alipay accepted. 20 seats, counter and tables; non-smoking, with a smoking spot outside. English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Opened 5 September 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sennichimae 1-5-16, Nanchi Building 1F — about 5 min from Namba and Nippombashi stations; from Namba Walk exit 26, turn right after the shopping arcade (May 2024 review)
places.cuisine: Casual sushi-and-tempura izakaya, fish bought at the market every morning, red-vinegar sushi rice · nigiri by the piece ¥150–480 (Tabelog menu, October 2026) · signature seafood overflow sushi heaped with ikura ¥2,180 · assorted sashimi ¥1,180 per serving, from two · nigiri sets of 5, 7 or 10 pieces ¥990–2,480 · rolls (toro-taku, eel and cucumber) · tempura omakase of 5 or 7 ¥930–1,350, single pieces from ¥130 · rare salmon tempura with ikura tartare ¥1,480 · Akira's seafood yukhoe ¥1,280 · raw shrimp mayo yukhoe · dashimaki with shirasu · potato salad with soft egg and ikura · rice bowls · sea-bream broth white ramen ¥980 · courses ¥4,000 (11 dishes) and ¥5,000 (13 dishes), all-you-can-drink +¥1,000 · 60-minute all-you-can-eat sushi course ¥4,000 (March 2025), with drinks ¥5,000 (June 2026) · local sake and fruit sours
places.notes: [Izakaya · Sennichimae, red-vinegar sushi and tempura from noon] A bright, casual sushi-and-tempura tavern a few minutes from Namba, open from noon, with fish bought at the market each morning. The sushi rice is seasoned with red vinegar and you can order a single piece (from ¥150 on the October 2026 menu). Two dishes are on almost every table: the "seafood overflow sushi", chunks of fish piled on a roll and buried in ikura (in May 2024 served to the beat of a drum), and rare salmon tempura with ikura tartare. The tempura is light and thin-battered, there are creative plates like a seafood yukhoe you tip out of its bowl, and a sea-bream broth ramen to finish. A 60-minute all-you-can-eat sushi course is limited to three groups a day. It is lively, young and full of overseas visitors, and the owner was described as young and friendly in 2025–2026. One October 2026 diner's reservation was not on file, and found the hamachi less than fresh.

chef_bio.background: Opened 5 September 2022 (Tabelog). A January 2023 diner wrote that "the experienced chef, who has worked at renowned restaurants, skillfully manages this establishment"; a March 2025 diner, that "a friendly young man who fits perfectly with the welcoming atmosphere runs the place"; a July 2026 diner, that "the charming and friendly owner runs the place with a refreshing demeanor". Tabelog mentions sake chosen by the manager. Reviews call it the Namba Shinsaibashi branch, but no other branch was found.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh fish from the market, sushi on a house blend of red vinegar from ¥110 a piece, and freshly fried tempura at casual prices (Tabelog shop description).
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood overflow sushi with ikura; rare salmon tempura with ikura tartare; red-vinegar nigiri by the piece.

anecdotes.text: "An entertaining dish where heaps of ikura (salmon roe) are generously piled on while the din-din drum plays!" — May 2024, seafood overflow sushi ¥1,958.
"The shrimp mayo served raw is a dish you don't hear about often, but the heads were crispy fried while the shrimp meat was fresh and raw." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司 天ぷら 明 難波 心斎橋店 (寿司×天ぷら 明)、居酒屋・寿司・天ぷら、大阪市中央区千日前1-5-16 南地ビル 1F、各線難波駅・日本橋駅から徒歩5分、12:00〜16:00 (L.O. 料理15:00、ドリンク15:30)、17:00〜23:30 (L.O. 料理22:30、ドリンク23:00)、不定休、予約可、お通し代おひとり様350円、カード・QUICPay・PayPay・Alipay可、20席、禁煙 (店の前に喫煙所)、英語メニュー・英語を話すスタッフ、オープン日2022年9月5日。市場直送の鮮魚、自家製ブレンドの赤酢のシャリで1貫から、名物は海鮮こぼれ寿司のいくらぶっかけとサーモンのレア天のいくらタルタル、寿司食べ放題のコースは1日3組限定で電話予約のみ。食べログのメニュー (2026年10月4日更新): 海鮮こぼれ寿司2180円、お造り盛り合わせ1人前1180円 (2人前から)、にぎり1貫150〜480円、天ぷらおまかせ5種930円・7種1350円、サーモンのレア天1480円、名物。明の海鮮ユッケ1280円、自家製の鯛だしの白湯ラーメン980円、コース4000円 (11品) と5000円 (13品)、飲み放題は+1000円。口コミ (2023年1月〜2026年10月): 毎朝市場で仕入れる魚、赤酢のシャリ、海鮮こぼれ寿司 (2024年5月は1958円)、60分の寿司食べ放題4000円 (2025年3月)、飲み放題つき5000円 (2026年6月)、若い客と外国からの客が多い、平日でも満席に近い、名店で経験を積んだ料理人 (2023年1月)、気さくな若い店主 (2025年3月、2026年7月)、予約が通っていなかった、はまちの鮮度が気になったという声も (2026年10月)。

places.name: Sakurai (サクライ)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; fresh pasta is the heart of the menu, with garlic toast, gratins and a herb-crumb fish, though several pastas can be had as risotto (squid ink, gorgonzola, porcini) and there are grilled meats and carpaccio. Ask when booking.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: prosciutto, foie gras, crab, fish, lamb, beef and cheese run through the menu.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00; closed Sunday, and occasionally on other days, so book first (Tabelog). Reservation only; parties of five or more take a course (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥550 per person, private rooms another ¥550 per person; one drink each, or ¥770 (Tabelog). Same-day cancellations are charged (Tabelog). Smoking allowed, so under-20s are not admitted; non-smokers are pointed to the private rooms (Tabelog). 18 seats: 6 at the counter and 2 private rooms (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). BYO and sommelier listed (Tabelog). Opened 17 December 2015 (Tabelog); closed for a time during COVID-19 and reopened (December 2021 review).
places.neighborhood: Soemoncho 3-7, Bravi Soemoncho 5F-E — about 3 min from Nippombashi Station, 5 min from Namba exit 14; inside a mixed-use building on the busy Soemoncho street
places.cuisine: Italian and wine, à la carte or a seasonal course · assorted appetizer plate (crab-miso brûlée, pâté de campagne, herb-stewed tripe and more) ¥2,400 (September 2024) · "Grandma's" bagna cauda · onion soup with Awaji onions · fresh pasta: Bolognese ¥2,200 (September 2024), Sorrento-style scallop and lemon cream, shirasu and mint lemon butter, squid ink, truffle cream, duck and leek lemon cream peperoncino · risotto (squid ink, gorgonzola, porcini) · fish of the day four ways · roast lamb, beef fillet, "emperor-style" beef fillet ¥4,300 (September 2024), beef tartare · cheese plate · panna cotta, tiramisu, zabaglione · 20+ wines by the glass, ¥950 a glass (October 2024), 300+ bottles; grappa
places.notes: [Italian · Soemoncho, a chef-sommelier's hideaway above the neon] An Italian restaurant on the fifth floor of a mixed-use building on busy Soemoncho street; one diner warned that the walk in makes first-timers wonder whether a restaurant can really be up there. Inside it is calm, with jazz, a six-seat counter and private rooms. It opened in December 2015; Chef Sakurai holds a sommelier certification, per a regular's 2020 review, and a 2024 review says the chef trained in Italy. The wine list is the other half of the draw: twenty-odd by the glass and over 300 bottles, with pairings matched to your taste, and a regular called the grappa selection perhaps the best in Osaka. Start with the assorted appetizer plate, where the crab-miso brûlée is the dish people remember, then fresh pasta, ordered to share. Several diners from 2021 to 2025 call it the best Italian in Minami, or in Osaka; one April 2025 diner found most dishes average. Smoking is allowed, so no under-20s.

roles: Chef (Tabelog: "authentic Italian cuisine crafted by Chef Sakurai")
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop description, Chef Sakurai has honed the craft over many years and cooks authentic Italian food "perfected by on-site exploration". A February 2024 diner wrote that the restaurant "is run by a chef who trained in authentic Italy". A long-time regular (July 2020 visit) wrote that "the owner-chef has a sommelier certification for wine". Opened 17 December 2015 (Tabelog); a regular who has come since the opening marked its 7th anniversary in December 2022. In October 2024 a diner saw the chef cooking and serving alone at 6 pm on a weekday; 2025–2026 reviews also mention staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: To deliver the true flavours of Italy: fresh pasta and appetizer plates, à la carte or as a course, paired with wine (Tabelog shop description).
chef_bio.specialty: Assorted appetizer plate with crab-miso brûlée; fresh pasta; wine pairings by the glass.

anecdotes.text: "It seemed like the chef was working alone; there were a couple of other groups besides us, but I didn't see any assistance throughout our time there." — October 2024.
"Located on the 5th floor of a mixed-use building, Sakurai has stayed there while many other suspicious places have turned over frequently on the same floor." — December 2022.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Sakurai (サクライ)、イタリアン・ワインバー・ダイニングバー、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町3-7 Bravi宗右衛門町 5F-E、日本橋駅から徒歩3分、なんば駅14番出口から徒歩5分ほど、月〜土18:00〜24:00、日曜休み (ほかにも休むことがある)、完全予約制、5名以上はコースのみ、全席チャージ550円、個室は別途1人550円、ワンドリンク制 (注文がなければ1人770円)、当日キャンセルは料金あり、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、18席 (カウンター6席、個室2室)、喫煙可のため20歳未満は入店不可、オープン日2015年12月17日、ソムリエあり、持ち込み可。店の紹介: 長年腕を磨いたシェフ Sakurai の本場のイタリア料理、生パスタと前菜、アラカルトとコース、グラスワイン20種以上、ボトル300種以上、カウンターと個室、ジャズ。食べログのメニュー (2025年8月4日更新): 前菜盛り合わせ、蟹味噌のブリュレ、おばあちゃんのバーニャカウダ、淡路島の玉ねぎのオニオンスープ、ボロネーゼ、イカ墨のパスタかリゾット、しらすとミントのレモンバターパスタ、ソレント風ホタテとレモンのクリームパスタ、トリュフのクリームパスタ、鮮魚、仔羊のロースト、皇帝風牛フィレ、チーズ、パンナコッタ、ティラミス。口コミ (2016年〜2026年10月): 前菜盛り合わせ2400円、ボロネーゼ2200円、皇帝風牛フィレ4300円 (2024年9月)、グラスワイン950円 (2024年10月)、オーナーシェフはソムリエの資格 (2020年)、本場イタリアで修業したシェフ (2024年2月)、平日にシェフが1人で切り盛り (2024年10月)、コロナで休業のあと再開 (2021年12月)、グラッパの品ぞろえ、ミナミでいちばんのイタリアンという声、2025年4月には料理は普通という声も。

places.name: 居酒屋ひさ (Izakaya Hisa)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the centre of the menu is breaded, deep-fried kushikatsu dipped in a shared sauce, along with fried chicken, fried Camembert and a baguette with the ajillo. No gluten-free dishes are marked.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef, pork, chicken and seafood skewers, beef-tendon dote-yaki, dashi-rolled omelette, salmon dishes and prosciutto. Vegetable kushikatsu (eggplant, leek, potato, lotus root and more) are on the menu, but the batter and frying oil are not described, so ask.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); Sun 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closing days not fixed, and it may close on Sundays or the last day of a holiday run (Tabelog). The shop's own site says 18:00–27:00 (food last order 26:00, drinks 26:30), closed Sunday unless booked ahead. Reservations accepted (Tabelog, which also takes bookings online). Cards: VISA and Master (Tabelog); the site also lists AMEX and Diners. Table charge (otoshi) ¥324 (Tabelog). 16 seats: 4 at the counter, 12 at tables; private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; an October 2023 diner: "Smoking is allowed at the table."). Courses with all-you-can-drink have a two-hour limit (an August 2026 review; the site: 120 minutes, last order at 90).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-5-6, room 102, ground floor of a tenant building just south of Suo-cho street — from Shinsaibashi Station Exit 6 go right along the Shinsaibashi-suji arcade, left onto Suo-cho street, then right at the Kintetsu Taxi stand and about 10 m on (Tabelog); 5 min on foot from Shinsaibashi, Nagahoribashi or Nippombashi
places.cuisine: Kushikatsu bar: Osaka kushikatsu plus Western bar dishes and homemade desserts (16 seats) · kushikatsu dipped in a shared stainless-steel tray of sauce, no double-dipping: beef, pork, chicken ¥130, vegetables ¥100–200, shrimp and scallop ¥200, salmon ¥150, chef's assortment of 5 ¥600 or 10 ¥1,200 (Tabelog menu, last updated April 2016) · beef-tendon dote-yaki in sweet miso ¥400 · dashi-rolled omelette ¥400, with mentaiko ¥450 · salmon and avocado caprese ¥580 · white leek marinade wrapped in prosciutto ¥380 · shrimp ajillo (2016 menu ¥580) with baguette · grilled avocado with mentaiko mayonnaise · desserts that change daily, such as cookie cheesecake, chocolate mousse, fondant au chocolat (shop site) · courses with all-you-can-drink: ¥3,380 with the table charge (September 2023), ¥3,000 with 10 skewers each (June 2026) · draft beer, highballs, shochu, sake, wine, cocktails
places.notes: [Izakaya · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a late kushikatsu bar to melodic-hardcore records] A small kushikatsu bar on the ground floor of a tenant building just off Suo-cho street, in the thick of the Higashi-Shinsaibashi nightlife, open until 3:00. The shop calls itself a mix of Shinsekai-style kushikatsu and a Western bar: alongside the skewers, which you dip once in a shared stainless-steel tray of sweet, light sauce, there are ajillo, salmon carpaccio and caprese, dashi-rolled omelette and beef-tendon dote-yaki. Diners find the kushikatsu light and crisp, with a slightly coarser crumb than most Osaka shops, and one singled out the salmon (September 2025). Desserts are made by the owner, who has worked as a pastry chef. The music is loud melodic hardcore and punk, and records and bass guitars decorate the room. Several reviewers came for the ¥3,000 course with two hours of drinks and ten skewers each. Several 2023 reviews complained about service and cleanliness; later reviews mostly found the staff friendly. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 April 2015 (Tabelog; the shop's blog on 30 March 2016: "四月一日に一周年になります"). The shop's site says the owner has worked as a pastry chef ("パティシエ経験ありのオーナーが作るデザート"); its Tabelog page (auto-translated) mentions "dishes by a French-trained owner" and calls it a family-run shop. A January 2026 diner found the manager serving every customer alone; a September 2024 diner had a good conversation with the owner.
chef_bio.philosophy: Osaka's famous kushikatsu fused with a bar: Shinsekai-style kushikatsu with Western dishes such as ajillo, prosciutto marinade and caprese, Japanese dishes too, and a daily dessert (shop site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kushikatsu with the shared sauce tray; homemade desserts.

anecdotes.text: "I was pleased to discover that the BGM was by Hi-STANDARD, a detail shared by my host, and I had a nice chat with the manager." — April 2022, two 10-skewer platters with dote-yaki and tako-wasa.
"In Osaka, many places serve finely crushed breadcrumbs, but here they use a slightly coarser texture that enhances the flavor of the ingredients." — November 2023.
"Despite being only JPY 3000, we received 10 skewers per person, and the variety of dishes was impressive." — June 2026, course with all-you-can-drink.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 居酒屋ひさ、居酒屋・串揚げ・イタリアン、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-5-6 つく志会館 102、心斎橋駅6番出口から心斎橋筋商店街を右へ、周防町通りを左、近鉄タクシーの乗り場を右に曲がって約10m、月〜土18:00〜3:00 (L.O. 2:00)、日曜18:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、定休日不定 (日曜か祝日の最終日は休みのことも)、予約可、カード可 (VISA、Master)、お通し324円、16席 (カウンター4席、テーブル12席)、貸切20人まで、喫煙可、2015年4月1日オープン、メニューは2016年4月更新: 串カツ牛・豚・とりもも130円、野菜100〜200円、海老・帆立200円、サーモン150円、おまかせ5種600円・10種1200円、牛すじどて焼400円、出汁巻卵400円、出汁巻明太450円、サーモンとアボカドのカプレーゼ580円、白ネギマリネ生ハム包み380円、アヒージョ(エビ)580円。店のサイト: 串カツバル HiSA (居酒屋ひさ)、大阪名物の串カツとバルの融合、新世界仕込みの串カツに洋風な一品、パティシエ経験ありのオーナーが作る日替わりのデザート、BGMはハイスタ、メロコア部屋 (オーナーおすすめのアルバムや曲)、ソースの二度づけ禁止、OPEN 18:00〜CLOSE 27:00、日曜定休 (予約は要相談)、飲み放題付きコース2500円・3000円・4000円 (飲み放題120分)。口コミ (2022年4月〜2026年8月): 周防町通りの少し南、テナントビルの1階、ステンレスの四角いソース入れ、少し粗めの衣で軽い串カツ、サーモンの串カツがおいしい、プチトマトが2個、海老のアヒージョ、アボカドの明太マヨ炙り、どて焼、BGMはハイスタ、ベースギターやレコード、飲み放題と串カツ10本のコース3000円 (2026年6月)、お通し込み3380円 (2023年9月)、2時間制、2023年には接客や清潔さへの不満の声、2024〜2026年は店員が気さくという声、2026年1月は店長がひとりで接客。

places.name: 長崎堂 心斎橋本店 (Nagasaki Do Shinsaibashi honten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the house sweet is castella (a wheat sponge), and the dorayaki, Waffel wafers and pudding à la mode set are wheat-based too. The liqueur-filled Crystal Bonbon sugar candies and the red-rice sweet might be wheat-free, but no ingredient list was found — ask.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: castella and dorayaki are made with egg, the Waffel has a cream filling, and there is pudding. No vegan statement; the sugar candies are unconfirmed — ask.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 10:00–17:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog; official shop page: 営業時間 10:00～17:30, 定休日 毎週水曜日). Hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); a May 2025 diner notes the red-rice sweet, sold only on the 1st and 15th of the month, can be reserved. Crystal Bonbons sell out: limit of two per person (May 2025 review; a September 2025 diner believed the same), and a May 2025 diner found a line just before the 10:00 opening. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR payments accepted (Tabelog). 10 seats in the tea room, non-smoking, wheelchair access, children welcome, takeout (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashi-suji 2-1-29, on Europe-dori (April 2025 review) — 2 min from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 6
places.cuisine: Castella house founded 1919, head shop with a 10-seat tea room · castella with crunchy coarse sugar on the base · Hon-ten set (main-store set) ¥1,100 with coffee or tea: Crystal Bonbon, Rainbow Fragments (kakera) sugar sweets, and castella or the red-rice sweet (May and June 2025) · Crystal Bonbon, sugar candies filled with anisette, maraschino and Cointreau, ¥2,160 a box (May 2025) · chestnut dorayaki ("Kuri Mikasa") ¥183 (March 2025), ¥184 (June 2026) · Ice Dorayaki set (August 2026) · pudding à la mode with a drink (April 2025) · red-rice sweet (赤米寿), sold only on the 1st and 15th · Waffel cream wafers · seasonal castellas: sakura (March 2025), a Myaku-Myaku Expo castella (October 2025) · iced coffee served with jelly (September 2026)
places.notes: [Sweets · Shinsaibashi, a 1919 castella house and its tea room] The head shop of Nagasaki Do, a castella maker founded in Nagasaki in 1919 that moved to Osaka in 1924; the second-generation head put up its sign on this corner of Shinsaibashi-suji in 1951, and the building was renewed in 2013. Downstairs is the shop, with castella, dorayaki, Waffel cream wafers and the jewel-like Crystal Bonbons, thin sugar shells filled with three liqueurs, sold since around 1980 and still so popular that there is a limit of two per person and a line at opening. A small tea room serves the Hon-ten set, only at this shop: Crystal Bonbons, Rainbow Fragments (kakera) sugar sweets and a slice of castella (or the red-rice sweet), with coffee or a pot of tea, for ¥1,100. A big disc music box bought around 1973 still plays; one 2025 diner played it with a special coin. The red-rice sweet is sold only on the 1st and 15th of the month. Diners praise the moist castella with its crunchy sugar base and the kind staff; one April 2025 diner found the bonbons and castella ordinary. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Founded in 1919 (Taisho 8) as a castella shop in Dejima, Nagasaki, by the founder, a former Mitsubishi Nagasaki Shipyard employee; moved to Osaka in 1924 as 合資会社長崎堂. The second generation hung the 「本舗 長崎堂」 sign at this address in 1951; the head office is here. A canned castella patent (1934, a second in 1951) and a castella carried on the 1951 Annapurna expedition. Rebuilt in 1960 under the third generation, who in 1982 developed a "restored castella" from a late-Taisho recipe. The fourth generation became president in 2003; the shop was renewed in 2013 with the 「1919長崎堂」 line (all from the official history page). The official shop page lists two own shops (this one and Sumiyoshi) plus sales through supermarkets, airports and Shin-Osaka station. An October 2025 diner found its Waffel at the Expo 2025 official shop. The official group-company page names the Nagasaki Do group as the parent of three brands: Nagasaki Do, QUOLOFUNE (head shop in Jiyugaoka, Tokyo; quolofune.com) and Zen Kashoin (Kyoto; zen-kashoin.com).
chef_bio.philosophy: Honest ingredients, made with "the feeling of a mother feeding a child" (official site, 「母親が子どもに食べさせる気持ち」).
chef_bio.specialty: Castella; Crystal Bonbon; Hon-ten set in the tea room.

anecdotes.text: "The presentation was beautiful, and the castella had a layer of crunchy sugar on the bottom, making it sweet and delicious… while waiting, I was able to listen to a mechanical music box!" — June 2025, Main Branch Set ¥1,100.

"We arrived around 9:45 AM, just before opening. A few elegant ladies from Osaka started to line up. It seems this famous confectionery sells out quickly, with a limit of two pieces per person." — May 2025, Crystal Bonbon ¥2,160.
"Inside the shop, there is a large disc organ, and I was able to play music with a special coin." — April 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 長崎堂 心斎橋本店、和菓子・カフェ・洋菓子、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-1-29、心斎橋駅6号出口から徒歩約2分、月・火・木〜日10:00〜17:30、水曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QRコード決済可、10席、禁煙、車椅子可、子供可、テイクアウト可。公式サイト: 1919年(大正8年)創業、カステラを中心にクリスタルボンボン、虹のかけら、どら焼き、ヴァッフェル。初代荒木源四郎が長崎の出島で菓子店「扇正軒」を創業、1924年に大阪へ移り合資会社長崎堂、1934年に缶詰カステーラの特許、1951年に二代目敏夫が周防町 (現 心斎橋筋2-1-29) に「本舗 長崎堂」の看板、缶詰カステーラがアンナプルナ登山隊の携行食に、1960年に三代目荒木一郎のもと株式会社大阪長崎堂、1973年頃に本店のオルゴールを購入、1980年頃クリスタルボンボン発売、1981年に田辺聖子が本店を訪れ「苺をつぶしながら」に登場、1982年に復元カステーラ、赤米寿は月の一日と十五日のみ、2003年に四代目荒木貴史が代表取締役、2013年に心斎橋本店をリニューアルし「1919長崎堂」、2019年に百周年。店舗: 心斎橋本店と住吉店、ほかに量販店と土産店舗 (関西空港、伊丹空港、新大阪駅ほか)。代表取締役会長 荒木貴史。グループ会社のページ: 長崎堂グループは長﨑堂、黒船 (東京自由が丘に本店)、然花抄院 (京都室町) の3ブランドを統括する運営母体。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年10月): 本店セット1100円 (クリスタルボンボン、虹のかけら、カステラか赤米寿、コーヒーかポットの紅茶)、クリスタルボンボン2160円で一人二個まで、開店前に行列、栗入りどら焼き183〜184円、アイスどら焼きのセット、プリンアラモード、桜のカステラ、万博のキャラクターのカステラ、ヴァッフェル、底にざらめのしっとりしたカステラ、大きなオルゴールを専用コインで鳴らせる、店員が親切、ボンボンもカステラも普通という人も。

cultural_comfort.note: Order from the counter or the tea-room menu; come at the 10:00 opening for the Crystal Bonbons (May 2025 review).
