places.name: 焼肉 福家 (Yakiniku Fukuya)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: no gluten information; sauces and marinades are not described. The salted tongue is seasoned with sesame oil and a house salt-and-pepper blend (Tabelog menu) — ask about the seasoning. Cold noodles, bibimbap and gukbap round out the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef and offal yakiniku house. Seasonal local grilled vegetables, salads and namul are on the menu, but nothing is described as vegan — ask.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); closed Thursday; open straight through 28 December–4 January (Tabelog, shop-maintained listing). Savor Japan (USEN) instead lists Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00, closed Monday — call to check. Reservations accepted; phone 06-6211-2667 (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR payments (Tabelog). 15 seats: 6 at the counter and two tables of 4; whole-shop booking for up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; a May 2023 diner: the whole restaurant allows smoking). Average ¥8,000–9,999 a head (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-3-1, the quieter east end of Dotonbori — 4 min from Kintetsu Nippombashi Stn, 7 min from Namba
places.cuisine: Small yakiniku and offal house, Imari beef and black wagyu · noodle appetizer on arrival (warm in March 2025, cold in May 2026) · specialty salted tongue, thin slices grilled quickly and wrapped round green onion and lemon ¥1,980 (premium) / ¥1,100 (regular) · outside skirt from ¥1,210, special premium ¥3,180, served last · premium mino tripe ¥1,100, special ¥1,430 · wagyu tetchan (small intestine) ¥990 · heart, honeycomb tripe, omasum, red omasum and other wagyu offal ¥880 each · yukhoe · red-meat cuts ¥2,750 · tenderloin ¥3,300 · chateaubriand ¥7,480 · seasonal local grilled vegetables ¥440 · kimchi ¥550 · cold noodles ¥990 · stone-grilled bibimbap ¥1,100 · chuhai with whole seasonal fruit · sake (menu prices from the Tabelog menu page, last updated March 2021)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Dotonbori, a 15-seat offal and salted-tongue house] A small yakiniku counter at the quiet east end of Dotonbori, with six counter seats and two tables, known for Imari beef and fresh wagyu offal. Dinner opens with a bowl of noodles as an appetizer, and the staff grill the first piece; several diners started with the specialty salted tongue: thin slices seared quickly and wrapped round a heap of green onion with lemon. The owner steers the order, recommending rare cuts and the tripe, and the outside skirt comes last, after which no more meat is served (a December 2024 diner). Diners praise the honeycomb tripe, mino, tetchan, yukhoe and thick-cut tongue, and the staff's grilling; a 2023 diner found the lean cuts average next to the offal. Expect about ¥8,000–10,000 a head. Diners call the owner friendly and entertaining, and the shop has been on TV and is said to be a favourite of Yoshimoto comedians. Smoking is allowed; book ahead. Closed Thursday on Tabelog (Monday on Savor Japan).

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing headed "Dotonbori Premium Salted beef tongue". A beloved local yakiniku restaurant serving Imari beef (September 2024 review); "All the meat is made from Imari beef" (October 2025 review). Savor Japan photo captions: 「伊万里牛をはじめとした厳選の黒毛和牛」, 「希少な黒毛和牛100％のタン『名物塩タン』」, 「日本酒ソムリエが選ぶ、肉に合う季節の日本酒」. The owner and two staff members taught a family to grill (October 2024 review). An October 2025 diner came after seeing it on TV; a May 2023 diner heard it is popular with Yoshimoto comedians. Onions and green onions from Osaka (November 2022 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Each piece of meat carefully selected, and the owner talks passionately about quality (October 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Salted tongue wrapped round green onion; outside skirt as the last dish; wagyu offal.

anecdotes.text: "I've been told that the outside skirt (harami) is served last, and once it comes out, they won't serve any more meat. However, once I tasted it, I understood why." — December 2024.

"I ordered my favorites, tongue and outside skirt, but the chef advised me to eat the outside skirt first, as it would leave me wanting more after trying other dishes. So, I changed my order to start with the fresh omasum" — September 2025.
"The cold noodles served as an appetizer were delicious! … Above all, the owner was kind, friendly, and a wonderful person!" — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 焼肉 福家 (フクヤ)、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-3-1、近鉄日本橋駅から徒歩4分、なんば駅から徒歩7分、月〜水・金〜日17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、木曜定休、12月28日〜1月4日も休まず営業、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QRコード決済不可、15席 (カウンター6席、4人がけテーブル2卓)、貸切は20人まで、喫煙可、平均8000〜9999円。食べログのメニュー (2021年3月更新): 名物の塩タン、薄切りのタンをさっと焼いてねぎとレモンを巻く 1980円 (上)・1100円、ハラミ1210円から、特上は3180円で最後に、ミノ1100円・特上1430円、黒毛和牛のテッチャン990円、ハツやハチノスなどの和牛ホルモン各880円、赤身2750円、ヒレ3300円、シャトーブリアン7480円、季節の地野菜の焼き野菜440円、キムチ550円、冷麺990円、石焼ビビンバ1100円、季節の果物まるごとのチューハイ。Savor Japan (USEN): 焼肉福家、火〜日・祝 17:00〜24:00、月曜定休、カード可、喫煙可、カウンター席、写真の説明に「伊万里牛をはじめとした厳選の黒毛和牛」「名物塩タン」「特選ハラミ」「特上ミノ」「テッチャン」「日本酒ソムリエが選ぶ、肉に合う季節の日本酒」。口コミ (2022年8月〜2026年8月): 伊万里牛、最初に麺の前菜 (温かい麺、冷麺)、最初の一枚やタンは店員が焼いてくれる、ハラミが出たら最後、店主のおすすめで希少部位、ハチノスやミノがおいしい、ユッケ、赤身は普通という声も、店主が気さくで楽しい、テレビで見て来たという人、吉本の芸人に人気という話、全席喫煙、誕生日に小さなアイスケーキ、大阪産の玉ねぎやねぎ。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter shop; staff grill the first piece and explain how to grill the rest (2024–2026 reviews). Smoking allowed.

places.name: 宇治香園 大阪心斎橋店 (Uji Koen)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The soft serve comes in a cone and the tea room has served a roll cake; among the teas the shop sells is barley tea (mugicha), which is not gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The matcha soft serve, matcha latte and roll cake are not described, so assume dairy or egg unless told otherwise; brewed teas are served in the tea room, but nothing on how they are served (milk, sweets) is stated.
places.hours_raw: Shop daily 12:00–19:00; takeout (soft serve and drinks) 12:00–18:30; tea room Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays only, 14:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); closed over the New Year holidays (shop site and Tabelog). The shop site says the tea room was closed for renovation until 31 October 2026 and reopens on 1 November, with different hours on some November days (check the shop calendar). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transport IC cards, WAON, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai, Alipay, WeChat Pay, Merpay (Tabelog). 5 counter seats in the tea room; non-smoking (Tabelog); a bench for two by the takeout counter (December 2023 review).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashisuji 1-5-19, on the Shinsaibashi-suji shopping arcade — from Shinsaibashi Station (Midosuji Line) Exit 6, 3 min along the arcade towards Namba
places.cuisine: Japanese tea shop with a tea room at the back (5 seats) · takeout: rich matcha soft serve dusted with matcha powder (¥500 in August 2025, ¥400 in December 2023), a matcha-and-milk mix, matcha latte · tea room (Fri–Sun and holidays): gyokuro brewed at the seat with an hourglass timer and refills, hojicha, matcha ice cream, hojicha roll cake (reviews 2023–2025) · leaf tea, tea bags and gift boxes to take home: matcha, sencha, gyokuro, hojicha, genmaicha, Japanese black tea
places.notes: [Cafe · Shinsaibashi-suji, an 80-year-old tea shop with a hidden tea room] The Osaka shop of Uji Koen, a Kyoto tea maker founded in 1865, which opened on Shinsaibashi-suji in 1946, just after the war, and is today the company's only shop besides its head office and factory in Kyoto. Most people stop at the front for the rich matcha soft serve — deep green, slightly bitter, heaped with matcha powder that one diner warns will leave a green ring round your lips. Behind the noren is a quiet five-seat counter (Friday to Sunday and holidays, 14:00–17:00) where tea is brewed at your seat: one diner brewed gyokuro with lukewarm water and an hourglass timer, took refills and shared a hojicha roll cake. Two reviewers only learned later that it was there. The shelves hold matcha, sencha, gyokuro and hojicha in the white packaging that won an iF Design Award (2021) and a Good Design Award (2025).

chef_bio.background: Uji Koen (株式会社 宇治香園) began as a tea peddler in Yamashiro, Kyoto, in 1865, exported tea to the United States through Kobe from about 1878, and opened the Shinsaibashi shop in 1946; the shop added its Japanese-tea tea room in 2003. The company marked its 160th year in 2025 (shop site, history page). Its company page lists only the Kyoto head office and factory and this Osaka Shinsaibashi shop.
chef_bio.philosophy: A Japanese tea specialist that first-timers can drop into, helping customers choose tea for every day or as a gift; tea brewed in a kyusu in a quiet room away from the bustle of Shinsaibashi-suji (shop site).
chef_bio.specialty: Rich matcha soft serve; gyokuro and hojicha in the tea room.

anecdotes.text: "Although it faces Shinsaibashi, I didn't realize there was an eat-in area in the back, making it a hidden gem." — March 2025, second visit; the tea room had to be opened on request just after 14:00.
"I poured lukewarm water over it and used the hourglass timer. It was incredibly sweet and fragrant gyokuro." — November 2023, gyokuro and a hojicha roll cake in the tea room.
"While it tastes great, be careful as the powder tends to stick around your mouth. I ended up walking around Namba all day with green around my lips." — October 2025, matcha soft serve.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 店のサイト: 宇治香園 大阪心斎橋店、昭和21年に心斎橋筋に日本茶専門店を構え、店の奥に喫茶、店舗12:00〜19:00、テイクアウト12:00〜18:30、喫茶は金・土・日・祝のみ14:00〜17:00 (L.O. 16:30)、休みは年末年始、喫茶は改修工事で10月31日まで休業し11月1日から再開、急須で淹れる日本茶の喫茶、テイクアウトのドリンクや抹茶ソフトクリーム、お茶の淹れ方教室「いちわん茶会」は休止中。会社情報: 株式会社 宇治香園、創業は慶應元年 (1865年)、京都本社・工場と大阪心斎橋店。あゆみ: 京都山城で茶の行商から始まり、明治11年ごろからアメリカ向けに輸出、昭和21年に大阪心斎橋店、平成15年に日本茶専門の喫茶、令和3年に iF デザインアワード、令和7年に創業百六十年とグッドデザイン賞。食べログ (店舗会員): 大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-5-19、心斎橋駅6番出口から心斎橋筋をなんば方面に徒歩3分、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、カウンター5席、禁煙。口コミ (2021年10月〜2025年10月): 抹茶パウダーをたっぷりかけた濃い抹茶ソフト (2023年12月400円、2025年8月500円)、抹茶とミルクのミックス、抹茶ラテ、奥の喫茶で砂時計を使って淹れる玉露とおかわり、ほうじ茶、ほうじ茶のロールケーキ、抹茶アイス、ほうじ茶と玉露のティーバッグ、店頭にベンチ。

cultural_comfort.note: Order soft serve at the front counter; tea room only Fri–Sun and holidays, 14:00–17:00.

places.name: すし居酒屋 しんご (Sushi Izakaya Shingo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; sushi with soy sauce, a sweet soy sauce on some dishes, and fried dishes (mentaiko tempura, fried chicken, fried octopus) on the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi, sashimi, seafood and wagyu dishes, and chawanmushi.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 17:30–23:30 (last order: food 23:00, drinks 23:15); closed Sunday; closing time may move with stock (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog), also by Instagram DM to @sushi_shingo (2022 review); the one table is hard to get (April 2026 review) and a Friday in September 2025 was fully booked. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and one table for 8; private hire possible; smoking allowed (Tabelog). The owner usually works alone, so food can take a while when full (2024–2025 reviews). Opened 22 June 2021 (a regular's June 2022 review marks the first anniversary that day).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-4-19, Tamayacho Galaxy Bldg No. 3, ground floor, at the entrance; small sign — 4 min (300 m) from Nagahoribashi Stn Exit 7
places.cuisine: Sushi izakaya (16 seats): nigiri and small rolls alongside izakaya dishes · examples with prices (December 2023): seafood bukkake sushi (a bite-size roll piled with chopped salmon, yellowtail, sea bream and tobiko) ¥1,280, shirako ponzu ¥900, wagyu yukhoe ¥1,380, raw shrimp ¥350, draft beer ¥550 · Japanese-style potato salad with tobiko and smoked daikon · mentaiko tempura · drinkable chawanmushi · wagyu sukiyaki roll dipped in egg · seafood yukhoe · nigiri such as butter eel, anago, seared scallop, tuna with uni, seared wagyu, toro-taku · an 8-dish course (sashimi platter, butter-soy scallops, grilled yellowtail collar, seared beef sushi with uni and ikura, nigiri, hosomaki, chawanmushi; September 2025) · winter "gout hot pot" of oysters, shirako and monkfish liver in yuzu miso, by reservation (February 2024) · sake
places.notes: [Sushi izakaya · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a one-person counter with a fiercely loyal following] A small sushi izakaya with a small sign on the ground floor of a Galaxy building in the Higashi-Shinsaibashi back streets, opened in June 2021. Despite the name, the owner is Koji, not Shingo — a regular who has been more than 50 times had to learn that too. Koji is young, quiet ('a samurai vibe', April 2026), may seem unfriendly at first and turns out to be very kind, and usually cooks, makes the sushi and serves alone, so a full house means waits. The menu changes often: seafood bukkake sushi under a heap of chopped fish and tobiko, potato salad with tobiko and smoked daikon, mentaiko tempura, a wagyu sukiyaki roll dipped in egg, and in winter a reserved hot pot of oysters, shirako and monkfish liver that diners call the 'gout hot pot'. Book the one table early: on one Friday in September 2025 the place was full and many walk-ins were turned away.

chef_bio.background: Opened Sushi Izakaya Shingo on 22 June 2021 (first-anniversary review, June 2022). "Just to clarify, the owner is not Shingo-san, but Koji-san." (June 2022 review). Reviewers describe a young chef who runs the shop single-handed (August 2025; also October 2024, December 2024, February 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi with izakaya dishes; seafood bukkake sushi; potato salad with tobiko.

anecdotes.text: "I laughed when I first called Koji-san Shingo-san. Just to clarify, the owner is not Shingo-san, but Koji-san." — June 2022, on the first anniversary.
"The head chef has a quiet demeanor that gives off a samurai vibe, which might be appealing!" — April 2026, omakase course at a business dinner.

"The Seafood Bukkake Sushi was delightful. On top of a bite-sized sushi roll, there was a generous amount of chopped salmon, yellowtail, sea bream, and other seafood, all topped with a large serving of tobiko." — December 2023.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): すし居酒屋 しんご、居酒屋・寿司・海鮮、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-4-19 玉屋町ギャラクシービル3号館 1F、長堀橋駅7番出口から徒歩4分 (300m)、月〜土・祝17:30〜23:30 (L.O. 料理23:00、ドリンク23:15)、日曜休み、在庫で閉店時間が変わることも、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、16席 (カウンター8、8人のテーブル1)、貸切可、喫煙可、魚と日本酒にこだわり。口コミ (2022年1月〜2026年4月): 2021年6月22日オープン、店主は Koji さん (しんごさんではない)、インスタ @sushi_shingo のDMで予約、若い大将がひとりで切り盛り、最初は無愛想に見えるがいい人、侍のような静かな大将、看板が小さく見つけにくい、海鮮ぶっかけ寿司1280円、白子ポン酢900円、wagyu のユッケ1380円、生えび350円、生ビール550円 (2023年12月)、とびこと燻製の大根の入ったポテトサラダ、明太子の天ぷら、飲めるような茶碗蒸し、wagyu のすき焼き巻き、海鮮ユッケ、うなぎのバター焼き、穴子、ほたての炙り、うに乗せのまぐろ、トロたく、8品のコース (2025年9月)、冬は予約制の牡蠣・白子・あん肝の柚子味噌の鍋 (gout hot pot)、2025年9月の金曜は満席で断られる人も、テーブルは1つだけ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead, especially for the one table; one person cooks and serves, so expect waits; smoking allowed.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; an omakase of sushi with soy sauce (the horse-meat nigiri comes with a slightly sweet soy sauce), red miso soup, simmered dishes and low-temperature-fried ayu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase course of fish, shellfish and horse meat, with chawanmushi and tamago.
places.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–2:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; call to change or cancel; tell the shop ahead if bringing children (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 7 counter seats; private hire for up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 5 October 2022 (Tabelog). Omakase course ¥22,000 (August 2026 reviews), about two hours; à la carte also available (August 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-5-31, 月虎51番館 3F — 5 min on foot from Nagahoribashi Stn (Sakaisuji Line) or Shinsaibashi Stn (Midosuji Line)
places.cuisine: Omakase sushi counter (7 seats) built on seafood from the chef's home prefecture, Kumamoto, and Amakusa · omakase ¥22,000 (August 2026): small dishes, sashimi, a seasonal simmered dish, a grilled dish, 6–8 nigiri, rolls, chawanmushi, soup and dessert · examples (2024–2026): chilled chawanmushi with king crab or Kumamoto red eggplant, ayu confit, monkfish liver with Nara-zuke, three kinds of gari (napa cabbage, lotus root, ginger), Amakusa sea bream, marinated tuna, toro (including three-year-aged toro), kohada, aori squid with sea urchin, kuruma shrimp, horse-meat nigiri with a slightly sweet soy sauce, simmered anago, red miso soup, a pudding-like tamago · sake chosen by the chef, who holds a sake diploma
places.notes: [Sushi · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a late-night Kumamoto omakase counter] A seven-seat hinoki counter on the third floor of a Higashi-Shinsaibashi building, calm and Japanese in a way the outside gives no hint of, open from 18:00 to 2:00 — one diner sneaked out after putting the kids to bed. The chef, from Kumamoto, builds the ¥22,000 omakase on fish from Kumamoto and Amakusa: chilled chawanmushi, ayu confit, monkfish liver with Nara-zuke, three kinds of house gari, then nigiri from Amakusa sea bream to aori squid crowned with sea urchin. The signature is horse-meat nigiri from Kumamoto with a slightly sweet soy sauce, which brought one reviewer to tears. The chef holds a sake diploma and pairs sake with the courses; one August 2026 review says the chef trained at a Michelin three-star restaurant. In June 2024 the chef was working solo and still kept a good pace.

chef_bio.background: Opened 5 October 2022 (Tabelog). From Kumamoto; craftsmanship "honed through traditional Japanese cuisine" (July 2026 review); one August 2026 review: "Run by a chef from a Michelin three-star restaurant" (the restaurant is not named). Holds a sake diploma (July and August 2026 reviews). Working solo at a June 2024 visit.
chef_bio.philosophy: Omakase built on seasonal fish and other ingredients from Kumamoto and Amakusa(Tabelog headline; 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Horse-meat nigiri; three kinds of gari; monkfish liver with Nara-zuke.

anecdotes.text: "The chef, hailing from Kumamoto, confidently serves this horse meat sushi. With each bite, the umami and sweetness overflowed, making it an exquisite piece." — August 2026, omakase, second visit.
"I tried the three-year-aged toro (fatty tuna) for the first time, and it was exciting. However, I think it might be a matter of personal preference." — August 2026.
"The chef was friendly, creating a relaxed atmosphere at the counter, making it easy to enjoy the meal without feeling too tense." — August 2026, omakase.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): すし堤、寿司・海鮮・居酒屋、Kumamoto の食材を使ったすし、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-5-31 月虎51番館 3F、長堀橋駅 (堺筋線) から徒歩5分・心斎橋駅 (御堂筋線) から徒歩5分、毎日18:00〜2:00、定休日不定、予約可 (変更・キャンセルは電話で)、子供連れは事前に連絡、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、カウンター7席、貸切20人まで、禁煙、オープン日2022年10月5日。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年10月): Kumamoto 出身の大将がKumamoto とAmakusa の魚を中心に使うおまかせ、22000円 (2026年8月)、約2時間、アラカルトもあり、ひのきのカウンターと土壁、冷たい茶碗蒸し (タラバガニ、Kumamoto の赤なす)、鮎のコンフィ、あん肝と奈良漬、白菜・れんこん・しょうがの3種のガリ、Amakusa の鯛、漬けまぐろ、トロ、3年熟成のトロ、こはだ、アオリイカとうに、車えび、少し甘い醤油の馬刺しの握り、穴子、赤だし、プリンのような玉子、日本酒のディプロマを持つ大将が選ぶ日本酒、ミシュラン三つ星の店出身という声、2024年6月は大将ひとり、深夜まですしが食べられる。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (7 seats); omakase about two hours; open until 2:00.

places.name: 二代目憲 hirayama (Nidaime Norihirayama)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the bonito tataki can be had with salt instead of ponzu or sauce, but tempura, fried oysters and a deep-fried eel dish are on the menu, so ask what is safe.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Tosa fish-and-meat izakaya built around bonito tataki.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); closed Sunday and on a Monday after a public holiday; open until sold out (Tabelog). The shop says it stays closed on days when it cannot get bonito good enough (Tabelog, shop-provided). Reservations accepted; courses for two or more must be booked by the day before (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥300 (Tabelog). 18 seats; the shop describes 4 counter seats and 3 tables that join for groups, private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; an April 2026 review). On the 2nd floor of the Sayoka Building; the building entrance is hard to spot (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-4-6, Sayoka Bldg 2F — 2 min from Nagahoribashi Stn Exit 7, 8 min from Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: Tosa (Kochi) izakaya with a sake focus, cooked by an owner from Kochi (Tabelog) · straw-grilled fresh bonito tataki, whole fish sourced by the owner, grilled over burning straw in front of you, thick or thin cut, with salt, wasabi or sauce · Kochi ingredients such as Utsubo, Tougoro and Chambara-gai shellfish; seasonally sunfish, bear and sea turtle (Tabelog) · white shrimp tempura, red beef tataki, grilled eel (shirayaki), straw-grilled mentaiko, Tosa maki, firefly squid, fried oysters, deep-fried eel, steak, tea soba with egg yolk, honey sweet potato ice cream (2025–2026 reviews) · courses with a small hot pot (hamo and eel shabu-shabu, beef shabu-shabu, grouper; 2022–2025 reviews) · all-Kochi sake and shochu, including the chestnut shochu Dabada Hiburi and Suigei sake (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Kochi-style straw-grilled bonito by Nagahoribashi] A second-floor Tosa-cuisine izakaya two minutes from Nagahoribashi Station, run by an owner from Kochi who sources whole fresh bonito and sears it over flaming straw in front of you — and keeps the shop shut on days the fish isn't good enough. Regulars all give the same advice: order the tataki thick-cut with salt; one reviewer reports that people from Kochi call it the best in Osaka. Around it come Kochi rarities (Utsubo, Tougoro, Chambara-gai clams, and in season sunfish, bear or sea turtle), white shrimp tempura, red-beef tataki, straw-grilled mentaiko and a tea soba finished with egg yolk, with an all-Kochi sake list. Courses for two or more (book a day ahead) bring a small hot pot. Portions are generous; smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Tosa-cuisine izakaya whose owner comes from Kochi and sources the bonito directly (Tabelog, shop-provided). A diner calls the owner quite handsome (September 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Serve only the best bonito: the shop stays closed on days the catch is not up to standard (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Straw-grilled fresh bonito tataki, thick-cut with salt.

anecdotes.text: "The Katsuo no Tataki here is truly delicious—so much so that people from Kochi say this place is the best in Osaka! I highly recommend trying it thickly sliced with salt." — May 2026.

"They are famous for their grilled dishes, especially the thick cuts that come with a slit in the middle, allowing you to insert condiments and enjoy them with salt!" — August 2023, a regular's second of six visits through November 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 二代目憲 hirayama、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-4-6 さよかビル 2F、長堀橋駅7番出口から徒歩2分、心斎橋駅から徒歩8分、月〜土18:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、日曜と祝日明けの月曜休み、売り切れ次第終了、予約可 (コースは2名から前日まで)、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、付き出し一品300円、18席、喫煙可。店の紹介: 高知出身の店主の本格土佐料理、店主が仕入れる丸ごとの生カツオを目の前で藁焼き、良いカツオがない日は休み、厚切りか薄切り、塩・わさび・タレで、Utsubo・Tougoro・Chambara-gai などの高知の食材、季節によってマンボウ・熊・ウミガメ、高知の地酒と焼酎 (Dabada Hiburi、Suigei)、カウンター4席とテーブル3卓、貸切20名まで。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年10月): 厚切りの塩たたきがいちばん、高知の人も大阪一という、白海老の天ぷら、赤牛のたたき、鰻の白焼き、藁焼きの明太子、土佐巻き、ホタルイカ、カキフライ、鰻の揚げもの、ステーキ、卵黄をからめる茶そば、蜂蜜さつまいものアイス、量が多い、たばこが吸える、ポン酢は別がよかったという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Book courses a day ahead; smoking allowed inside (2026).

places.name: 神戸牛すてーきはうす香西 (Kobe Beef Steak House Kozai)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; steaks and the hamburg come with salt or a house steak sauce, and courses add corn potage, a homemade dressing and garlic rice, so ask about sauces and seasonings.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: teppanyaki courses of Kobe beef, Wagyu and seafood.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00, last seating 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00, last seating 21:30); open year-round except the New Year break, 31 December–2 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; parties of 5 or more by phone (Tabelog). Cards; PayPay and Alipay; no e-money; no service charge (Tabelog). 12 seats at two 6-seat counters, up to 15 by arrangement; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; English menu; children welcome, kids menu (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-17-15, 丸清ビル 2F, just off Shinsaibashi-suji — 3 min from Shinsaibashi Stn Exit 5 or 6
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki steak counter (12 seats) · Kobe beef and black Wagyu grilled in front of you · Premium Kobe Beef Loin Steak Course 120g, 7 items ¥15,970; with two seafood items ¥18,170; Special Wagyu Ribeye Steak Course 120g ¥8,800 (Tabelog) · lobster tail and foie gras to order (Tabelog) · a February 2026 course: appetizer, sweet corn potage, shrimp and scallops with lemon butter sauce, salad with homemade dressing and salted kombu, four grilled vegetables, 120 g ribeye (filet on request), garlic rice, dessert · lunch: Wagyu hamburg course from ¥1,540 with salad, corn soup, dessert and coffee; black Wagyu sirloin-and-filet lunch with rice and tsukudani (2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a Showa-era steak counter with a bargain lunch] Up a flight of stairs in an old building just off Shinsaibashi-suji, a stylish, dimly lit teppan counter that one regular says has a nostalgic Showa feel with a hint of the bubble years. Dinner is courses built around Kobe beef or black Wagyu — ribeye, loin or filet with shrimp and scallops, grilled vegetables and garlic rice — for celebrations and anniversaries. Lunch is the famous deal: a Wagyu hamburg grilled on the teppan in front of you with salad, corn soup, dessert and coffee for ¥1,540, a price a returning diner was surprised to find unchanged in May 2026. Try it with the Andes salt. English menu; open every day.

chef_bio.background: Teppanyaki steak house serving Kobe beef and Wagyu at the counter (Tabelog, shop-provided). A May 2026 diner remembered the lunch from years earlier.
chef_bio.philosophy: The chef prepares the beef in front of each guest, tailored to the guest's preferences and pace (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Kobe beef loin and Wagyu ribeye courses; Wagyu hamburg lunch.

anecdotes.text: "To my surprise, I saw that they were still offering a Wagyu Hamburg Steak grilled right in front of me for just JPY 1540, tax included!" — May 2026, lunch.
"It has a nostalgic Showa-era vibe with a hint of bubble economy charm." — July 2026, black Wagyu lunch course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 神戸牛すてーきはうす香西 (コウザイ)、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-15 丸清ビル 2F、心斎橋駅5・6番出口から徒歩3分、毎日11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)・17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、年中無休 (12月31日〜1月2日休み)、予約可 (5名以上は電話)、カード可、PayPay・Alipay可、電子マネー不可、サービス料なし、12席 (カウンター6席×2)、禁煙、英語メニューあり、子供可。コース: 神戸牛ロースのステーキコース120g 15970円、海鮮2品つき18170円、和牛リブロースのステーキコース120g 8800円、ランチの和牛ハンバーグのコース1540円から。口コミ(2025年3月〜2026年8月): 古いビルの2階、昭和でバブルの香りの内装、コーンスープ、自家製ドレッシング、海老と帆立のレモンバター、焼き野菜、ガーリックライス、ハンバーグはアンデスの塩とステーキソースで、値段が変わらず驚いた、ランチはお得、焼き手が感じよくイケメンという声も。

places.name: なかむら (Nakamura)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; sushi and sashimi come with soy sauce, and simmered dishes and unagi kabayaki are glazed, so ask before ordering.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and shellfish sushi counter.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 16:00–23:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, and the counter is often full by 19:00 (2025–2026 reviews); good fish can run out if you come late (August 2025 review). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; non-smoking; takeout (Tabelog). Very small and cramped inside (August 2025 review). One diner saw a menu on the wall plus off-menu dishes (August 2025); another found no menu or prices (July 2026).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 2-1-19 — 358 m from Nagahoribashi Stn
places.cuisine: À la carte sushi counter (10 seats), ordered a piece at a time · fresh fish shown in a case and a tank, bought that day · sashimi platters made to your taste · live sweet shrimp, botan shrimp, scallops, surf clams, squid, mackerel, fatty tuna, yellowtail, white fish, toro-taku · grilled hamo, hamo deboned in front of you, unagi kabayaki, grilled shrimp, simmered dishes · sake lees soup to finish · beer, shochu
places.notes: [Sushi · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, an old-school counter run on regulars] A tiny, long-established sushi counter where almost everyone is a regular — one diner came back after nearly 20 years and was remembered. Fish bought that day sits in the case and the tank; you order à la carte, one piece at a time, and the sashimi platter is put together to your taste. Live sweet shrimp, scallops, botan shrimp and the eel come up again and again in reviews, along with hamo deboned with a satisfying crunch in front of you, and a bowl of sake lees soup to finish. Reviewers find the prices fair for the quality, though one found the rice portions too small to balance the fish. Opens at 16:00, Saturday included; book, because it's often full by 19:00.

chef_bio.background: Long-established sushi counter in Shinsaibashi (August 2025 review); a diner who came often about 20 years ago was remembered on returning (August 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Traditional sushi that balances quality fish with fair prices (August 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte nigiri and sashimi; live sweet shrimp; sake lees soup.

anecdotes.text: "After nearly 20 years, it was touching to be remembered since I used to come here often in my younger days." — August 2025.
"The conger eel was expertly deboned right in front of me, producing a satisfying sound that felt great." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: なかむら、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-1-19、長堀橋駅から358m、月〜土16:00〜23:00、日曜休み、予約可、カード可 (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、電子マネー・QR不可、10席 (カウンター)、禁煙、テイクアウト可。口コミ(2025年8月〜2026年10月): 心斎橋の老舗のすし屋、客の多くは常連、ショーケースと水槽にその日の魚、一貫ずつのお好みで注文、好みに合わせたお造りの盛り合わせ、甘海老、ボタン海老、帆立、ホッキ貝、イカ、鯖、トロ、ハマチ、トロたく、炙った鱧の刺身、目の前で骨切りする鱧、鰻の蒲焼き、焼き海老、炊いたもの、締めに粕汁、20年ぶりでも覚えていてくれた、値段は手ごろ、とても狭い、遅いと魚がなくなる、シャリが小さすぎるという声も、メニューも値段もないという声も。

places.name: イタメシヤ フジ (Itameshiya Fuji)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; pizza, pasta and gratin are central, and some dishes use soy-based sauces (abalone risotto with liver soy sauce), so ask what can be made without wheat.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: charcoal-grilled meats, seafood and cheese run through the menu; no vegan dishes are mentioned.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Thu 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); Fri 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); Sat–Sun 15:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Monday (Tabelog). Happy hour with cheap drinks until 18:00 (December 2024 review): a wine decanter ¥400 (April 2026), sparkling wine ¥350 (May 2025). All-you-can-drink available (January 2026 review). Reservations accepted; no service charge (Tabelog). Cards, transport IC, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY (Tabelog). 16 seats: 10 at the counter and a private room for 6 (up to 8); private hire up to 20; non-smoking, smoking area outside; children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 27 January 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-6-10, リップル周防町 1F — 3 min from Nagahoribashi Stn, 6 min from Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: Casual Italian with a charcoal grill and wine (16 seats) · Fuji assorted appetizer platter of about 8 dishes (smoked salmon, water eggplant with mascarpone, potato salad) · smoked chicken wings, smoked in front of you · charcoal-grilled beef, pork and lamb; three-meat platter (Angus outside skirt, beef tongue) · pizza stretched and baked to order (Margherita; sakura shrimp and bamboo shoots in spring; squid, shrimp and mushroom) · pasta (aglio e olio, cold tomato cappellini, squid and sudachi cold pasta, horse mackerel and mitsuba green pasta) · abalone risotto with liver soy sauce · eggplant Bolognese · vegetable gratin · acqua pazza · venison · figs with prosciutto and mascarpone · roast beef course · 18 wines (Tabelog), highballs, coffee
places.notes: [Italian · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, charcoal grill, pizza and a cheap happy hour] A casual Italian near Nagahoribashi with a counter at the front and a private room at the back, where meat and vegetables go over charcoal and pizzas are stretched and baked to order. Everyone starts with the Fuji appetizer platter of about eight small dishes; regulars then order the smoked chicken wings (smoked in front of you), a three-meat grill platter, and the abalone risotto with liver soy sauce. Seasonal specials change — a spring pizza of sakura shrimp and bamboo shoots, cold tomato cappellini in summer. Happy hour runs until 18:00 with wine by the decanter for a few hundred yen, and weekends open at 15:00. On an October 2026 visit the chef was working alone and the food still came quickly.

chef_bio.background: Casual Italian that opened on 27 January 2020 (Tabelog); a frequent diner has come since it opened (August 2026 review). The chef ("the master") was cooking alone on an October 2026 visit.
chef_bio.philosophy: Carefully selected beef, pork and lamb over charcoal with crisp, fluffy pizzas and wines to match (Tabelog, shop-provided); a creative, seasonal menu with distinctive sauces (May 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Fuji assorted appetizers; smoked chicken wings; abalone risotto with liver soy sauce.

anecdotes.text: "I always order the smoked chicken wings, and they smoke them right in front of you." — April 2026, happy hour, sixth visit.
"Although the master was working solo, we didn't have to wait long, and the prices were reasonable." — October 2026, family dinner.

places.cuisine: Omakase sushi counter of the 881 Group (8 seats) · one course ¥4,400, 15 items: three small appetizers, three kinds of sashimi, about 8–10 nigiri, a mini fish-bone paitan ramen and dessert · much of the fish from Sukumo, Kochi · shari of white vinegar or red vinegar to suit the topping · examples (June–October 2026): medai with green eggplant sauce, mozuku vinegar with figs and Shine Muscat grapes, charcoal-grilled eel, vinegar-washed horse mackerel, seared sardine, kuro-mutsu, marinated tuna on red-vinegar rice, bonito with hidden mustard, sea urchin and abalone in a light broth, toro-taku avocado hand roll, anago in white or dark soy, almond tofu · extra nigiri: nodoguro, white shrimp, sea urchin · sake chosen by the chef (about 10–20 kinds), half servings
places.notes: [Sushi · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a ¥4,400 omakase of Kochi fish from women chefs] An eight-seat L-shaped counter on the third floor of a mixed-use building off Sakaisuji, part of the 881 Group, whose sushi counters all charge ¥4,400 for one course but buy and cook in their own way. Here the fish comes largely from Sukumo in Kochi, the owner's home prefecture, and the meal opens with a short video about Kochi's seas. A September 2026 diner calls it the group's only sushi counter run by a woman chef; per a January 2026 review, a chef called Kazue, formerly of the Michelin-listed Sushi Chiharu in Fukushima, joined that month. Expect three appetizers, three sashimi, nigiri on white- or red-vinegar rice to suit each fish, a mini fish-bone ramen in a soup bowl (the broth simmered 3–4 hours, per a June 2026 diner) and almond tofu, then extra nigiri such as nodoguro or sea urchin. A charcoal grill went in during summer 2026 for the eel. Regulars return every few months; a few diners found the fish ordinary, the room cramped and snack-bar-like, and the drinks pricey.

roles: Chef Kazue (named in a January 2026 review)
chef_bio.origin: The owner is from Kochi (August and September 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.background: Sushi counter of the 881 Group, whose counters all serve one ¥4,400 course (2026 reviews); opened 6 January 2026 per Tabelog, formerly Sushi Asami (September 2026 review). The listing describes a woman chef with 10 years of experience who trained at a well-known restaurant. The owner cooks at the counter with two staff on drinks (August 2026 review), chooses the sake and installed a charcoal grill for eel in July 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fish from the owner's home waters in Kochi; rice seasoned with white or red vinegar to suit each topping (June 2026 review).

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Much of the menu is wheat-based (curry udon, handmade pasta, takoyaki, naan pizza, tonkatsu, squid tempura), and the dashimaki is made with soy sauce; caprese and the cheese platter are among the few likely exceptions.

Course reservations accepted; seat-only bookings order on the day (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats: 12 counter, 8 table; whole-shop hire for up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 23 November 2016 (official site). places.cuisine: Fortune-telling dining bar, all homemade food (official site; the fries are frozen, it admits) · curry udon ¥1,320 · mapo tofu from a recipe by the owner's son ¥1,320 · handmade mentaiko cream pasta ¥1,265 · shrimp or beef-tendon fried rice ¥1,188 · Napolitan ¥1,518 · five-egg dashimaki ¥1,320 · stewed hamburg with egg or cheese ¥1,100 · takoyaki, 10, cooked to order ¥880 · shrimp shumai, shrimp mayo, karaage, tonkatsu · cheese spring rolls, squid tempura, caprese, cheese platter · milk kakigori ¥913–968 · cocktails named for lucky colours and kinds of luck (prices from the official site, read October 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Amerikamura, a dining bar where every member of staff reads fortunes] A cosy, snack-bar-like room on the ground floor of Bamboo Alley where the cover charge buys a fortune-telling session. Everyone gets a printed personality sheet drawn from each guest's birth date and an animal card, then a reading of choice (tarot, four pillars of destiny or palm reading) at the table, from a staff of fortune-tellers. The owner goes by the shop's name, Ogawa no Okan ('Ogawa's mum'), and per the official site was a bank clerk, then ran an MC and narration company and school, then turned to fortune-telling (25 years of it by 2023); the dashimaki came from studying with a teacher from the owner's cooking days, and the mapo tofu from the owner's son, who trained in a Chinese restaurant. The menu is long and homey (curry udon, mentaiko cream pasta, a five-egg dashimaki, hamburg, takoyaki made to order), with cocktails matched to your lucky colour. Diners mostly come for the readings, some finding them uncannily accurate and others not, and praise the food too; a January 2025 diner saw it fill up soon after 6:30 pm on a weekday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 小川のおかん (Ogawa no Okan)
roles: Owner and fortune-teller (goes by the shop name)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: first worked at a bank, quit after a row with a boss, ran a company and school for MCs and narration, passed the company to a friend and became a fortune-teller, with 25 years of fortune-telling as of 2023; reads four pillars of destiny, personality psychology, biorhythms and tarot. Studied dashimaki with a teacher from the owner's days as a cook before opening the bar on 23 November 2016. The owner's son trained at a Chinese restaurant and wrote the mapo tofu recipe. A head cook and a manager are on the staff list. The bar sits in a group company with a vocal-training school (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Fortune-telling made open and free, with the talk among friends afterwards as the best part (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Free fortune-telling with drinks; curry udon; mapo tofu; dashimaki.

anecdotes.text: "While chatting with her, she said, 'Let me take a look at your cards,' and the tarot reading began, which was surprisingly accurate—what a shock!" — June 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 占いダイニングバー 小川のおかん、2016年11月23日に大阪心斎橋アメ村にオープン、スタッフ全員が占い師で占いは無料 (四柱推命、ISD個性心理学、バイオリズム、タロット、手相)、年間1万人以上を占う、完全手作りのメニュー (ポテト系は冷食)、名物のカレーうどん1,320円、おかんの息子が作ったこだわり麻婆豆腐1,320円、手打ちの明太子クリームパスタ1,265円、大きな大きなだし巻き卵1,320円、煮込みハンバーグ1,100円、オーダー後に焼くたこ焼き (10個) 880円、ミルクかき氷913〜968円、運気アップのカクテル。おかんSTORY: 最初は銀行員、上司と喧嘩してすぐに退職、司会ナレーションの会社・スクール経営、会社を友人に譲渡して占い師に、占い歴25年 (2023年現在)、調理師時代の恩師にだし巻き卵を習う、息子は中華料理屋で修行した麻婆豆腐をレシピ化。グループ会社に Vocal Space B と日本音楽株式会社、2024年9月に小川のおかんを間借りした麻婆豆腐のランチの店。食べログ (店舗会員): 西心斎橋1-9-20 Bamboo Alley 1F、毎日18:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:30)、不定休、テーブルチャージ2,200円 (税込)、カード・PayPay可、20席 (カウンター12、テーブル8)、貸切20名まで、禁煙。口コミ(2024年10月〜2026年9月): 誕生日から出す性格の分析シートと動物占い、タロットや手相、スナックのような家庭的な雰囲気、平日の18時半ごろからすぐ満席に、当たったという声も当たらなかったという声も、料理もおいしい。

places.notes: [Yakiniku · Amerikamura, an eight-seat hideaway counter open until 2 am] Up a flight of stairs on the second floor of a busy building in Amerikamura, a dimly lit eight-seat counter grilling only domestic beef chosen for low odour and fat. Diners keep to the same run of signatures: thick tongue wrapped round sweet Kujo green onion, the ume-shio horumon whose honey-plum tartness and shiso cut the rich colon (one diner who seldom eats horumon could not stop), a lightly seared fresh liver with sesame oil, a toro-taku yukke to wrap in nori, a quickly seared outside skirt, then cold noodles bright with sudachi and a sweet-potato brûlée whose plate gets a powdered-sugar cat. Cat figurines dot the room; one diner took the owner for a cat lover. Good for a date; Tabelog puts the budget at ¥6,000–7,999, and there is a 10% service charge. Smoking is allowed at the counter.

chef_bio.background: Yakiniku counter opened on 17 November 2023 (Tabelog, shop-maintained); domestic beef chosen for low odour and fat, sourced through the shop's own channels (Tabelog). Cat figurines around the room; "It seems the owner is a cat lover" (October 2026 review). Attentive male staff (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Only high-quality domestic beef, in a calm hideaway (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kujo green-onion-wrapped tongue; ume-shio horumon; sweet-potato brûlée.

anecdotes.text: "Among them, I was particularly impressed by the signature dish, 'Ume Shio Horumon'. I usually don't eat Horumon much, but this one was so delicious that I couldn't help but keep eating it." — October 2026.

places.notes: [Yakitori · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a 20-year-old binchotan yakitori upstairs] A second-floor yakitori and wine bar between Shinsaibashi and Namba, nearer Sakaisuji, open since 2006, in a wood-toned Japanese room with a counter close to the staff and spacious tables. The draw is jidori over binchotan: sashimi and seared tataki of chicken, then skewers; one regular orders at least five tsukune every time, and diners also like the liver pâté, the grilled lamb, and beef marushin and tongue. The omakase with two hours of all-you-can-drink is ¥5,500, which a 2025 diner called great value; a chicken zosui makes a filling finish. Diners call the owner and staff friendly and the room relaxed; one found every skewer good but none unforgettable. Smoking is allowed, and same-day bookings usually work.

chef_bio.background: Yakitori and izakaya opened on 7 March 2006 (Tabelog, shop-maintained); jidori grilled slowly over binchotan charcoal (Tabelog). "A friendly owner and staff" (February 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Chicken dishes with carefully chosen wine and sake, in a calm, modern Japanese room (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Neighbourhood izakaya for horse meat, seasonal hot pots and regional sake (17 seats) · horse sashimi from Kumamoto: lean, tongue, futaego, tategami, barahimo, raw liver (reserve), platters of three to five cuts, sakura-toro rice bowl · autumn–winter: monkfish hot pot thick with dissolved monkfish liver, finished with udon and zosui; spring: moray eel from Kochi; summer: live hamo and Awaji onion hot pot · Miyazaki jidori grilled with salt · fried fugu, fugu skin, whale bacon, grilled yellowtail collar, tempura, kara-age · oysters from Kurahashi-jima (winter) and Oki (rock oysters); fish from Onagawa and Yawatahama · rotating regional sake by the glass, Ozeki junmai daiginjo drawn from a keg, shochu bottle keep
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shinmachi, horse sashimi and the monkfish-liver hot pot] A homely table-seat izakaya west of Nishi-Ohashi, known for two things. One is horse sashimi from Kumamoto, cut to order in up to five kinds, including tongue, futaego and the mane fat; it takes up to an hour to thaw and slice, so reserve it with your table. The other is the autumn–winter monkfish hot pot, a broth made thick with a great deal of dissolved monkfish liver; follow the house way of cooking it, and finish with udon and rice porridge. One diner booked a month ahead for it, and a March 2024 diner saw walk-ins turned away, so phone first. From 28 October 2026 the pot is ¥5,700 a person (two minimum), or ¥7,000 with a horse sashimi platter; the head cook can only fillet so many monkfish this season, so it sells out. Summer brings a live hamo and Awaji onion hot pot, spring moray eel from Kochi. The fridge holds rotating sake from small breweries, and the walls carry signed photos of visiting celebrities; the late actor Haruma Miura came three times. Cash only, smoking allowed, adults only.

roles: Head cook (大将, who fillets the monkfish, per the shop website)
Run by an elderly couple (August 2022 review)
chef_bio.background: Izakaya run by the small company 有限会社アイランド・フィールド (shop website). An August 2022 diner describes "an elderly couple who work hard together"; a December 2021 diner felt "a warm motherly presence". Ingredients come direct from the source: horse meat from Kumamoto, jidori from Miyazaki, winter oysters from Kurahashi-jima (Hiroshima), rock oysters from Oki (Shimane), fish from Onagawa (Miyagi) and Yawatahama (Ehime) (shop website). Chosen by Ozeki as one of 100 shops in Japan to pour its keg-fresh junmai daiginjo (shop notice, May 2026). Long closures in 2025 and 2026 for illness and surgery; reopened 20 October 2026 (shop notices).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients and regional sake, open every day (shop website).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 新鮮処ととろ、大阪市西区新町2-17-10、西大橋駅1番出口から徒歩5分、西長堀駅1番出口から徒歩7分、毎日18:00〜22:30 (閉店は目安で食材がなくなれば早めに閉店)、10月20日の火曜から入院・療養明けで営業再開、10月27日の火曜は臨時休業、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、お通しあり、17席 (2018年9月の改装で全席テーブル)、貸切20人まで、喫煙可で20歳未満は入店不可、大阪市プレミアム付き商品券は2027年1月15日まで使用可。店のサイト: 有限会社アイランド・フィールド、営業時間18:00〜22:30 (閉店時間は目安)、ラストオーダー22:00 (馬肉料理21:30)、無休 (臨時休業あり)、現金のみ、最初にお通し2品550円、馬肉は熊本県、地鶏は宮崎県、冬の真がきは広島県倉橋島、岩がきは島根県隠岐の島、鮮魚は宮城県女川漁港や愛媛県八幡浜などから産地直送、小さな蔵元の珍しい地酒を季節ごとに。桜肉の刺身: タン、バラひも、フタエゴ各1500円、生レバー2600円 (予約優先)、赤身1700円、タテガミ1500円、桜トロ丼1600円、3種盛3500円・4種盛4000円・5種盛4600円、当日の注文は40分〜1時間かかる。地鶏の名物 もも塩焼900円。ふぐ唐揚げ990円、ふぐの皮の湯引き、くじらベーコン、ぶりかま塩焼、えびの天ぷら、とり唐揚げ、焼き味噌 (そばの実入り)。2026年10月28日から秋冬の名物 あんこう肝だらけ鍋、1人前5700円、馬刺し盛り合わせとのセット1人前7000円、どちらも2人前から、セットは前日までの予約、大将があんこうをさばける数に限りがあり売り切れ御免。夏は活きたはもと玉ねぎの淡路島鍋、春は高知県産のうつぼ。大関の純米大吟醸 蔵出し生原酒を国内100店舗限定で提供 (2026年5月)、地酒はグラス90mlと片口徳利1合。2025年8月の終わりから10月10日までスタッフの体調不良で休業、2026年春は手術・療養で休業、2026年7月1日から病気療養で休業し10月20日に再開。口コミ(2021年12月〜2026年3月): あんこう肝だらけ鍋は濃厚、店のやり方どおりに半分を火をつけずに入れる、締めのうどんと雑炊、だしが減ると肝のだしを足してくれる、馬刺し専用の醤油、1か月前に予約、予約なしの客は断られていた、有名人のサイン入り写真、Haruma Miura が3回来店、年配のご夫婦が営む、あたたかい母のような雰囲気、テーブル席のみでもひとりで入れる、カード不可、1人8000円〜1万円ほど。

places.name: 新町あだち (Shinmachi Adachi)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking: the shop asks for allergies in the reservation request and says it may not be able to handle them on the day. No gluten information; the courses run on dashi with sashimi soy sauce and ponzu, and include tempura and fried dishes.

places.hours_raw: Dinner Mon–Sat in two seatings, entry at 18:00 or 19:00 (first) and 20:30 (second); all guests at a seating start together; closing time not published (shop website; Tabelog). Lunch Wednesday and Saturday only, everyone starting at 12:00; on Tuesday, Thursday and Friday lunch can be booked privately by groups of four or more (shop website; Tabelog). Closed Sundays, public holidays and the 1st of each month, when the menu and tableware change (Tabelog; the website lists Sundays and holidays). The hours grid shows start times only. Reservations by phone or online (TableCheck, Ikyu); arrive on time, since late arrivals may get fewer dishes; tell the shop about allergies and dislikes when booking (Tabelog; TableCheck). Cancellations 50% the day before, 100% on the day (Tabelog; shop website). Service charge 5% at lunch, 10% at dinner (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 7 counter seats; non-smoking; private use for up to 7 (Tabelog; shop website). Opened 28 February 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 3-8-10, 1F, the quiet west end of Shinmachi — 3 min from Nishi-Nagahori Stn (Exit 1), 7 min from Awaza Stn
places.cuisine: Seven-seat kaiseki counter, an omakase course that changes monthly with the season and the yearly festivals (Michelin Guide listed) · dinner ¥16,500 for ten courses, or ¥9,900 for eight at the 20:30 seating; lunch ¥9,900 for eight (Wednesday and Saturday); December ¥19,800 / ¥12,100; tax included, service extra · a typical course: appetizer, a small rice dish, soup, sashimi, hassun, a substantial dish, a single dish, fried dish, clay-pot rice, dessert · examples (2026): sea urchin and shrimp with jelly, steamed abalone rice with liver sauce, young-eel and winter-melon soup, red sea urchin and needle squid sashimi, Miyazaki beef with matsutake, hamo tempura, grilled ayu, seasonal clay-pot rice with house chirimen sansho, dashimaki, warabi mochi · a wide sake list by the glass, including rare labels and Jikon; sake cups to choose from, Old Baccarat among them
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Shinmachi, a seven-seat counter that cooks the calendar] A calm counter with tea-ceremony utensils, tucked into the west end of Shinmachi, open since 2020 and in the Michelin Guide within a year. The owner loves Japan's traditional culture and builds each monthly course around the season and its customs: New Year, Setsubun, the Doll Festival, a moon-viewing dish in autumn, chrysanthemums for the Double Ninth in September, Tanabata strips on the July hassun. The menu card lists only the ingredients, so part of the fun is learning how to read them, and the tableware changes with the month. Expect careful dashi, very fresh fish (one diner tasted red sea urchin, Akashi sea bream and needle squid in October 2026), Miyazaki or Kagoshima beef with mushroom sauces, and a clay-pot rice blended for the shop, with leftovers made into rice balls to take home. Everyone at a seating starts together, so be on time; the 20:30 seating offers a shorter, cheaper course. Diners describe a lively, entertaining chef and a deep sake list by the glass, with a choice of sake cups.

roles: Owner (named as "Mr. Adachi" in an August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened Shinmachi Adachi on 28 February 2020 (Tabelog) and was featured in the Michelin Guide within a year of opening (Tabelog, shop-provided); listed in the Michelin Guide with no star (Michelin Guide). The shop text describes a chef adding personal twists to dishes learned in training, and a sake-loving owner who picks rare labels such as Jikon (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Because we were born and raised in Japan, we want guests to touch the culture and customs handed down from long ago" (shop website). The Michelin Guide calls the owner a lover of traditional Japanese culture who weaves New Year, Setsubun and the Doll Festival into the menu (Michelin Guide).
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly seasonal kaiseki; clay-pot rice; seasonal tableware.

anecdotes.text: "I found myself going back for more. Seeing this, the chef kindly prepared a dashimaki (Japanese omelette) as a complimentary dish." — October 2026, 20:30 course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 新町あだち、大阪市西区新町3-8-10 エステムコート大阪新町 1F、西長堀駅1番出口から徒歩3分、阿波座駅から徒歩7分、昼は水曜・土曜のみ12:00一斉スタート、火・木・金は4名以上で貸切可、夜は月曜〜土曜、1部18:00か19:00、2部20:30、日曜・祝日・毎月1日 (献立と器の入れ替え) 休み、予約可、アレルギーや苦手なものは予約のリクエスト欄に、当日の食材変更は不可、遅れると品数が減ることも、前日のキャンセル50%・当日100%、サービス料 昼5%・夜10%、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、カウンター7席、禁煙、貸切可、オープン日2020年2月28日。店の紹介: 月替わりの旬の献立と器、修業で学んだ料理に独自の工夫、開店1年でミシュランガイドに掲載、日本酒好きの店主が純米大吟醸やJikon などの希少な銘柄から季節限定まで揃える。店のサイト: 一日七席、日本で生まれ育ったからこそ古くより受け継がれてきた文化や風習に触れていただきたい、入店は18:00・19:00・20:30で入れ替え制ではない、おまかせコース16500円 (前菜、お凌ぎ、お椀、お造り、八寸、強肴、一品、揚物、食事、甘味)、品書きには敢えて食材の名前だけ、器も月替わり、酒器はオールドバカラなど、土鍋ご飯の米は当店専用のブレンド、昼9900円、日曜・祝日休み。TableCheck: 昼の懐石9900円 (8品)、夜の懐石16500円 (10品)、2部20:30限定の9900円 (8品)、12月は夜19800円・昼12100円 (セコガニなど)、アレルギー・苦手なものは詳細を、当日だと対応できない場合も。ミシュランガイド: 日本の伝統文化を愛する主人、正月、節分、ひな祭りといった暮らしの文化を献立に織り込む。口コミ(2026年5月〜10月): Adachi さんが店主、茶道具を飾ったカウンター、全員一斉スタート、5月の端午の節句、7月の七夕の八寸、9月の重陽の節句の菊、10月のお月見、ムラサキウニ、アワビの蒸しご飯と肝のソース、赤ウニ、明石の鯛、剣先イカ、鮎の塩焼き、ハモの天ぷら、宮崎の牛と松茸、鹿児島の牛ときのこのソース、土鍋ご飯、ちりめん山椒、残りのご飯をおにぎりにして持ち帰り、ご飯のおかわりに出汁巻をサービス、グラスで頼める日本酒、ガラスや陶器の酒器から選ぶ、にぎやかで楽しい大将と弟子たち、京都にいるような繊細な味。

places.cuisine: Retro-cute kissa for breakfast and home-style lunch (17 seats) · breakfast to 11:00: buttered toast set with drink and boiled egg from ¥500, nori-cheese toast, French toast with maple syrup and cinnamon · lunch from 11:30: mushroom omurice with sausage and a side salad, chicken curry, daily plate (a main such as teriyaki pork-and-vegetable rolls, shiso-cheese chicken fry or grated-daikon hamburg steak, with potato salad, small sides, miso soup and salad) · seasonal pudding (pumpkin in October 2026), homemade cookies and cakes · coffee, hassaku lemonade
places.notes: [Kissa · Minamihorie, omurice and a daily plate that tastes like home] A small corner café with a retro interior of old school-style chairs, soft light from a little window onto the park, and a following among neighbours and office workers alike; it has been around since at least 2017. Mornings bring buttered toast sets from ¥500, a nori-and-cheese toast and a fluffy French toast you season yourself with maple syrup and cinnamon. From 11:30 the draw is the mushroom omurice, chicken rice packed with shimeji and sausage under a soft omelette (¥850 in October 2026), or the daily plate (¥950 in December 2025): a main like teriyaki pork rolled around vegetables or a shiso-and-cheese chicken fry, with a generous potato salad, small home-style sides, miso soup and salad. One couple has eaten here nine times since 2020 and still calls it a favourite. Finish with a seasonal pudding or a homemade cookie. Cash only, closed Tuesdays, and it fills up at lunch.

chef_bio.background: Neighbourhood kissa open since at least 2017 (a diner's first visit, August 2017). A September 2020 diner noted that it is "run by two women" and praised the cooking behind an ordinary-looking front.
chef_bio.specialty: Mushroom omurice; the daily plate lunch.

anecdotes.text: "From the outside, it looks like an ordinary café, but it has remarkable culinary skills." — September 2020, daily plate ¥1,000 with coffee.

places.name: 中華食堂ノロマツ (Chuka Shokudo Noromatsu)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a Chinese diner of wheat noodles (yakisoba, chuka soba), gyoza and soy-based sauces; no gluten information.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fried rice with meat, pork yakisoba, a pork-and-chicken soy broth, gyoza, sweet and sour pork; no vegan dishes described.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closing days may vary (Tabelog). Opened 15 July 2026 (Tabelog), with a ¥500 yakisoba and fried-rice set for the first three days (opening coverage). A short wait at Saturday lunch and a line by mid-evening (October 2026 reviews). places.cuisine: Town Chinese diner, the second shop of 野呂松飯店 in Toyonaka (18 seats) · two signatures: quick-fried yakimeshi (fried rice) in regular, garlic, special and five-ingredient versions, sizes up to extra-large, with refillable egg soup; Chinese-style yakisoba of thin noodles in a soy-based sauce (add vinegar halfway) · yakisoba-and-mini-fried-rice set · chuka soba (clear soy broth, thin straight noodles), miso ramen, stamina ramen · tenshinhan, mapo rice bowl, omurice (a staff meal that made the menu), gyoza, sweet and sour pork, stir-fried greens, nira-tama · beer, sake, shochu
places.notes: [Chinese diner · Uehommachi, fried rice and yakisoba under the station] An old-style town Chinese diner on the basement floor of the rebuilt Uehommachi Haihai Town, opened in July 2026 as the second shop of 野呂松飯店, a popular machi-chuka near Okamachi Station in Toyonaka that supervises the cooking. It sells itself on two dishes. The fried rice is quick-fried, fluffy and not greasy, in plain, garlic (studded with chunks), special and five-ingredient versions, with egg soup you can refill. The yakisoba uses thin noodles in a salty, soy-based Chinese-style sauce; diners are told to add a splash of vinegar halfway. The usual order is the yakisoba-and-mini-fried-rice set (¥1,188 in October 2026). The chuka soba, a gentle, slightly sweet clear soy broth with thin straight noodles, is a side act here. The omurice began as a staff meal. Evenings turn into a casual drinking spot with gyoza (¥308) and nira-tama. Order by QR code; expect a wait at weekend lunch.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 15 July 2026 (Tabelog) as the second shop of 野呂松飯店, a town Chinese restaurant in Toyonaka (goguynet Tennoji, June and July 2026), and a franchise shop supervised by it — 野呂松飯店 is by Hankyu Okamachi Station (pre-opening reception post, July 2026). A Tabelog corporate-member listing.
chef_bio.philosophy: "A Chinese diner you'll want to visit every day"; fried rice that is both fast and delicious (Tabelog, shop-provided).

anecdotes.text: "I heard it became popular as a staff meal and was eventually put on the menu, and I can see why—it's really tasty." — August 2026, omurice.
"I was recommended to add vinegar to the yakisoba, and doing so made it refreshing and just right." — July 2026, yakisoba with mini fried rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華食堂ノロマツ、大阪市天王寺区上本町6-3-31 ハイハイタウン B1F、大阪上本町駅直結、毎日11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、不定休、予約可、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay・PayPay可、18席 (カウンター10席、4人掛けテーブル2卓)、禁煙、子供可、テイクアウト、デリバリー、英語を話せるスタッフ、写真付きメニュー、オープン日2026年7月15日。店の紹介: 豊中の「野呂松飯店」の味をハイハイタウンで、名物の焼きめしは「早い」「うまい」、醤油ベースの中華風ソースと焼きそば専用麺の焼きそば、醤油ベースのスープと細いストレート麺の中華そば、焼きめしとのセットがおすすめ。号外NET 天王寺・阿倍野 (2026年6月16日): 豊中の人気町中華「野呂松飯店」の2号店、監修。(2026年7月20日): 焼きめしと焼きそばが名物、天津飯、酢豚、餃子。関西開店 (2026年7月15日): 野呂松飯店の監修、2大名物の焼きめしと焼きそば、中華そば、味噌ラーメン、スタミナラーメン、天津飯、麻婆丼、餃子。ブログ (2026年7月15日、レセプション): 阪急岡町駅の野呂松飯店監修のFC店、7月15日から17日までは焼きそばと焼飯のセット500円、焼きめしはパラパラ系でにんにく風味、中華そばは鶏ガラや豚の清湯醤油、中細ストレート麺。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): QRコードで注文、焼きそばとミニ焼きめしのセット1188円、中華そばとにんにく焼きめし1298円、大盛と特盛、おかわり自由の卵スープ、焼きそばは細麺で途中で酢を、中華そばはやさしく少し甘めの昔ながらの味、オムライスはまかないから、餃子308円、ニラ玉638円、Aka boshi 中瓶638円、土曜の昼は満席で少し待つ、夜は店の外に行列。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff and photo menu (Tabelog); order by QR code on your phone (2026).

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; sushi with soy sauce, conger eel grilled with a sauce, chirashi with shiitake and conger eel, and takeout rolls with dried gourd and shiitake.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi and chirashi of fish and shellfish, with chawanmushi and soup in every set.

places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashisuji 1-10-12, トレスビル 3F, a mixed-use building — 2 min on foot from Shinsaibashi Station (Midosuji Line), near Daimaru and PARCO
places.cuisine: Sushi (6 counter seats, 16 at tables) · lunch, 11:30–14:00 (Tabelog menu, updated September 2026, tax included): Jō (premium) nigiri, 8 pieces with a thin roll, chawanmushi and soup ¥3,850; special nigiri, 10 pieces ¥5,500; chirashi sushi (kombu, shiitake, conger eel, boiled octopus, egg, shrimp) ¥3,300; conger-eel chirashi ¥3,300; deluxe chirashi ¥4,950 · courses: Sakura (2 starters, sashimi, 8 nigiri, a hand roll, red miso or clear soup) ¥16,500; Hana (4 starters, sashimi, 10 nigiri, a hand roll, soup) ¥22,000 · omakase and à la carte at the counter: aged bluefin otoro, Yura sea urchin from Awaji, kohada, firefly squid, homemade karasumi, grilled shirako, kuruma shrimp, conger eel grilled with sauce, tamago (reviews 2024–2026) · to take home: nori rolls ¥1,728, premium rolls ¥4,104, chirashi ¥3,240, conger-eel roll ¥3,780, pressed sushi of conger eel, mackerel, horse mackerel or sea bream ¥2,484 · sake, shochu, wine
places.notes: [Sushi · Shinsaibashi, a couple-run sushi room a minute from the station] A sushi shop on the third floor of an older building on Shinsaibashi-suji, bright and spacious inside, with a six-seat counter and tables for sixteen. The shop says its chefs bring more than 30 years at Osaka's Fukki Sushi; a March 2024 diner found it run by a couple — the owner, the owner's wife, a long-time chef friend and a part-timer. Lunch is the easy way in and is often fully booked: nigiri sets from ¥3,850 and chirashi from ¥3,300, each with chawanmushi and soup, and warm mozuku to start (2024–2025 reviews). At the counter the omakase runs to aged bluefin otoro ('I could easily eat 20 pieces'), Yura sea urchin from Awaji, kohada, conger eel grilled with sauce and the tamago — the last two the shop's specialties, per an April 2026 diner who ordered the Yura uni so many times that the lunch bill 'made my head spin'. A few lunch diners found it pricey for what came.

roles: Owner (with the owner's wife, per a March 2024 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 7 December 2017 (Tabelog). The shop text on Tabelog says: "Freshness of the ingredients is guaranteed, with over 30 years of experience from Osaka Fukki Sushi's skilled chefs." A March 2024 review: "The restaurant is run by a couple, and it was operated by four people including the owner, [the owner's] wife, a long-time friend who is a chef, and a part-timer." Reviewers since 2023 call it long-established.
chef_bio.philosophy: Reasonably priced sushi near the station at lunch; courses for business dinners and parties, and à la carte at the counter (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Aged otoro; Yura sea urchin; conger eel grilled with sauce; tamago.

anecdotes.text: "What really shocked me was the aged fatty tuna (otoro), which was perfectly firm with no excess moisture or fat. I could easily eat 20 pieces of that quality otoro." — March 2024, omakase.

"I got carried away by how delicious the Yura uni was and ended up ordering it multiple times, resulting in a bill that made my head spin, even for lunch." — April 2026; on a May 2026 return the same diner ordered the ¥10,000 "Kiwami" lunch and spent about ¥20,000 less.
"It was the best chirashi sushi I've had recently." — May 2025, lunch chirashi with anago, sea bream and sea urchin, sea-bream ushio soup and chawanmushi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 心斎橋 鮨 おか崎、寿司、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-10-12 トレスビル 3F、心斎橋駅から徒歩2分、月・火・木・金・土11:30〜14:00と17:00〜19:00 (夜は19:00最終入店)、日曜は昼のみ、水曜休み、月に2回の不定の連休、売り切れまで、予約可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、20席 (カウンター6、テーブル16)、貸切可、禁煙、車椅子可、オープン日2017年12月7日。メニュー (2026年9月更新、税込): 上にぎり3850円、特上にぎり5500円、ちらし寿司3300円、穴子ちらし3300円、特上ちらし4950円、Sakura のコース16500円、Hana のコース22000円、持ち帰りの巻きずし、ちらし、穴子の巻き、押し寿司 (穴子、さば、あじ、鯛)。店の紹介: Fukki Sushi で30年以上の経験を持つ職人。口コミ (2021年12月〜2026年5月): 夫婦で営む店、店主と奥さん、料理人の古い友人、アルバイトの4人 (2024年3月)、明るく広い店内、昼はいつも満席に近い、温かいもずく、茶碗蒸し、熟成の大トロ、Yura のうに、こはだ、ホタルイカ、自家製のからすみ、白子焼き、車えび、タレで焼いた穴子と玉子が名物、昼に少し高いと感じた人も。

places.name: 藤久 (Fuji Kyuu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; courses and à la carte include tempura and other fried dishes, soy-grilled fish and simmered dishes, and the shop will adapt dishes to what is in stock.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki courses of fish, crab, shamo chicken and game, with dashi-based soups and simmered dishes.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:00); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; seat requests cannot be guaranteed (Tabelog). The Tabelog reservation notes (machine-translated) give a lunch minimum spend of ¥20,000 and a dinner minimum of ¥30,000 for table seating; the menu page (updated November 2024) says private rooms are for bookings over ¥20,000, others sit at the counter, and lunch bookings need at least ¥10,000 — neither says whether per person or per group, so ask when booking. Children only when the whole shop is reserved (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: a counter on the ground floor, tatami and a table room upstairs for up to 12; private hire possible; non-smoking (Tabelog). The chef often works alone, so dishes can come slowly (2018 and 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Nipponbashi 2-7-28, in a narrow alley between Namba and Nipponbashi (Ura Namba); white wooden lattice at the door — 3 min from Nipponbashi Stn (Sennichimae Line)
places.cuisine: Kaiseki and à la carte Japanese cooking with seasonal fish (14 seats) · omakase courses (Tabelog course page, tax included): lunch only ¥4,180; ¥6,600; ¥9,900; ¥13,200 · examples: sea-bream soup, tuna, flounder and swordtip-squid sashimi, teriyaki Spanish mackerel, simmered winter melon, burdock and pumpkin, mushroom rice (¥6,600 course, September 2026); sea-urchin somen, Ajimaimo from Nara, Seiko crab with male-crab legs, a pressed sushi with more fish than rice (top course, November 2025); certified Matsuba crab, sesame tofu, saba sushi, soy-grilled shamo (November 2025); a shamo hot pot (lunch course, June 2025) · à la carte by season (menu page, November 2024): fugu and tiger puffer, tuna sashimi and tuna shabu-shabu, yellowtail, Matsuba and Seko crab, shiroguchi, sashimi platters, assorted tempura, ayu, oysters, cod milt, shamo chicken, whale, aokubi duck, wild boar, beef, horse meat, pork shabu-shabu · charcoal-grilled eel ¥10,000 (June 2025) · seasonal rice to finish (sea bream, bamboo shoot), leftovers wrapped to take home · about 10 sakes, wine, champagne
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Nipponbashi, a 30-year-old alley hideaway with a chef who trained at Kiccho] A small Japanese restaurant behind a white wooden lattice in a narrow alley between Namba and Nipponbashi, in business for about 30 years: a counter downstairs, tatami and a table room upstairs. Reviewers say the quiet chef trained at Kiccho (two name it Ajikiccho) and, as often as not, cooks and serves alone — one September 2026 diner reckons that is how a full kaiseki course can cost ¥6,600. Courses run from a ¥4,180 lunch to ¥13,200; regulars order à la carte from whatever the season brings (fugu, Matsuba crab, ayu grilled at the table, wild boar, even bear meat in March 2025), and the kitchen will cook something off the menu if it has the ingredients. Rice comes at the end in a pot, and what you can't finish goes home with you: wrapped sea-bream rice in February 2026, bamboo-shoot rice made into rice balls for each guest in April 2026. A visitor from Minato Ward who has kept coming back since 2017 calls it a must-visit for Japanese food in Kansai.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers: "run by a chef who trained at Yoshikichi" (November 2025); "the chef has trained for many years at Ajikichou" (March 2025); "the chef here is from Kiccho" (December 2024, per the diner's companion); "The owner is from 'Ajikiccho' in Osaka and seems to run the place with [the owner's] wife, while a young part-time staff member handles the floor" (June 2025); "Kaiseki cuisine offered at a low price by a chef from Kiccho" (September 2026). In business for about 30 years (Tabelog shop text; June 2025 review). "Typically, the owner manages everything alone" (April 2018); "The chef operates the restaurant alone" (September 2026); in July 2017 a server and the head chef.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Japanese cooking with seasonal ingredients delivered directly from the source, attention to detail from presentation to delicate flavours, and around 10 sakes from rare brands to seasonal ones (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Kaiseki courses; seasonal à la carte (crab, fugu, ayu, game); pot-cooked rice.

anecdotes.text: "Even if a dish isn't on the menu, they are flexible and will prepare it in a recommended way if the ingredients are available, which is truly impressive." — March 2025, à la carte: sashimi, tempura, bear meat, oyster tempura, oyakodon.
"Since we couldn't finish it all, they kindly made the leftovers into rice balls for each of us, and my family praised them when I brought them home." — April 2026, bamboo-shoot rice.

"The chef operates the restaurant alone, which means the food may take a little longer to be served, but I believe this style allows [the chef] to offer such a course at this price." — September 2026, ¥6,600 omakase.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 藤久 (ふじきゅう)、日本料理、大阪市中央区日本橋2-7-28、地下鉄千日前線日本橋駅から徒歩3分、毎日11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:30〜21:00 (L.O. 20:00)、不定休、予約可 (席の指定はできない)、昼と夜の最低料金の案内 (テーブル席)、子供は貸切のときのみ、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、14席 (1階カウンター、2階は座敷とテーブル12人まで)、貸切可、禁煙。店の紹介: 日本橋で30年、産地直送の旬の食材、盛り付けから繊細な味まで、日本酒は約10種。コース: 昼だけのおまかせ4180円、おまかせ6600円、9900円、13200円。一品 (2024年11月更新): ふぐ、まぐろの刺身としゃぶしゃぶ、ぶり、Matsuba crab と Seko crab、shiroguchi、刺身の盛り合わせ、天ぷら、鮎、牡蠣、白子、軍鶏、鯨、青首鴨、猪肉、牛、馬肉、豚しゃぶ。口コミ (2017年7月〜2026年9月): 狭い路地の白い格子戸、2025年11月の口コミでは入口と1階カウンターが改装済み、Kiccho (Ajikiccho という声も) で修業した物静かな大将、ひとりで切り盛りすることが多く料理が出るのに時間がかかることも、2025年6月は奥さんらしき人とアルバイト、ごま豆腐、蟹、軍鶏の鍋、うにそうめん、Ajimaimo、Seko crab、炭火の鰻10000円、熊肉、牡蠣の天ぷら、親子丼、tairagi の刺身、鯛めしや筍ご飯の残りを持ち帰りに包んでくれる。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone (06-6632-4037); ask about the minimum spend when booking; the chef often works alone, so allow time.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog tags the shop "Vegetarian options", but nothing on the menu is labeled vegan and most dishes use cheese, cream, ham or seafood; ask whether a vegetable dish can be made without animal products.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); Sunday lunch only, dinner by reservation; closed Monday and the 1st and 3rd Sundays (official site; Tabelog remarks also name the 5th Sunday). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥300 before tax (Tabelog); the dinner menu on the site lists a table charge of ¥330 per person with three homemade breads including focaccia (focaccia refills free). places.neighborhood: Nambanaka 2-6-20 (Naniwa Ward) — 1 min from Nankai Namba Stn, 5 min from Namba Stn (Midosuji Line), on the way to the electric town
places.cuisine: Southern-Italian osteria cooked by an owner-chef who trained in Italy (Tabelog; official site) · lunch sets: pranzo A ¥1,100 (dish of the day, pasta of the day), B ¥1,400 (adds dessert and espresso or tea), C ¥2,000 (antipasti platter and pasta), pranzo speciale ¥3,000 by reservation (official site); two pastas of the day on one plate, large size +¥200 (2026 reviews) · dinner à la carte: antipasti platter piccola ¥1,400 / grande ¥2,100, fresh-fish carpaccio, handmade tagliatelle with sea-urchin tomato cream ¥2,100, potato gnocchi or penne with gorgonzola and walnut ¥1,550, roast duck breast with Marsala orange sauce ¥2,000, veal cotoletta, beef cheek braised in red wine, porcini and prosciutto risotto, pizzas from ¥1,350 (official site) · courses ¥3,400–¥6,000 (Tabelog; official site) · over 40 wines, mostly Italian (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Italian · Nambanaka, a small southern-Italian osteria by Nankai Namba] A 16-seat osteria open since 2006, a minute from Nankai Namba Station on the walk to the electric town, cooked by an owner-chef who trained in Italy. Lunch is the draw: from ¥1,100 you get the dish of the day, homemade focaccia with free refills and two of the day's three pastas on one plate (tomato, oil or cream; +¥200 for a large size), and several diners return again and again for it. Dinner runs to an antipasti platter, handmade tagliatelle with sea-urchin tomato cream, gnocchi with gorgonzola and walnut, roast duck with Marsala orange sauce and pizzas, with over 40 mostly Italian wines; Tuesday is half-price glass-wine day. One diner was put out that the dish of the day was swapped without a word when it ran out. No cards (PayPay is fine); closed Mondays and the 1st and 3rd Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Owner-chef who trained in Italy (Tabelog, shop-provided: "an Owner Chef with Authentic Experience", "our chef, who trained in Italy"; official site owner's greeting: イタリアで修業を積んだ).
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Italian food at prices for everyday use, with the flavor of each ingredient brought forward (official site).

anecdotes.text: "For the fish dish, I had sautéed sea bream with porcini sauce. The sauce was exceptionally delicious, and the sea bream was flaky." — September 2026, a dinner on half-price glass-wine Tuesday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: OSTERIA SUDO (オステリアスドウ)、大阪市浪速区難波中2-6-20、各線難波駅から徒歩5分、火〜土・日・祝 ランチ11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)、ディナー18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、第1・3日曜と月曜休み、16席 (テーブル・カウンター)。オーナー挨拶: イタリアで修業を積んだ本場の味。ランチ: pranzo A 1100円 (本日の一皿、本日のパスタ)、B 1400円 (デザート、エスプレッソか紅茶つき)、C 2000円 (前菜の盛り合わせ、本日のパスタ)、pranzo speciale 3000円 (予約制)、1人1オーダー、ベビーカーは控えて。ディナー: テーブルチャージ1人330円、自家製パン3種 (グリッシーニ、ペットレ、フォカッチャ、フォカッチャはおかわり可)、いろいろ前菜盛合せ 小1400円・大2100円、鮮魚のカルパッチョ、生うにのトマトクリームソース手打ちタリアテッレ2100円、じゃがいものニョッキ ゴルゴンゾーラとくるみのソース1550円、合鴨胸肉のロースト マルサラオレンジのソース2000円、仔牛のコトレッタ、牛ほほ肉の赤ワイン煮込み、生ハムとポルチーニ茸のリゾット、マルゲリータ1350円、コース3400円〜6000円。HP限定クーポン: 19時までの来店でグラスドリンクが1時間半額 (要予約、現金のみ)。食べログ (英語版): 2006年10月10日開店、イタリア中心のワイン40種以上、火曜はハウスワインとグラスのスパークリングが半額、木曜は4000円以上のボトルが1000円引き、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、お通し300円 (税抜)、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10)、禁煙、ベジタリアンメニューあり。口コミ(2026年7〜10月): ランチは本日のパスタ3種から2種を1皿に、大盛り200円、フォカッチャはおかわり自由、紅茶がいつも濃い、人気なので予約がおすすめ、ディナーは真鯛のソテー ポルチーニソース、合鴨のロースト、ゴルゴンゾーラのペンネ、本日の一皿が品切れで説明なく替わったという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash or PayPay only; book for lunch, it fills up (2026).

places.name: 炉端とカツラ｡ @日本橋 (Robata to Katsura. At Nipponbashi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; sashimi and charcoal-grilled fish, meat and vegetable skewers could suit, but the signature dishes include a breaded beef cutlet in sauce, fried shrimp with chili mayo and tempura, so ask what is safe.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a robata izakaya built around fresh fish, Ise lobster, wagyu and pork-wrapped vegetable skewers.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the days before and after a public holiday 15:00–23:30; Sat, Sun and public holidays 13:00–23:30; last orders food 22:30, drinks 23:00 (Tabelog). No closing day listed. Reopened as Robata to Katsura on 8 October 2026 (Tabelog remarks; an October 2026 review); the listing opened 17 January 2026 under the earlier name Isshin. Reservations accepted; a table booked for two may be seated at the counter; one-drink minimum (Tabelog). Ise lobster and hairy crab need a reservation (October 2026 review). No service charge (Tabelog, original Japanese "なし"). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 15 seats (7 counter, 2 tables); private hire possible; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Menus in English, Chinese and Korean; English- and Korean-speaking staff (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Robatayaki and seafood izakaya (Tabelog) · fresh fish sent daily from around the country as sashimi, straw-grilled (wara-yaki) and charcoal-grilled; vegetable skewers wrapped in pork (Tabelog, shop-provided) · signature dishes: "Drowning" beef cutlet with sauce poured at the table ¥1,980, giant shrimp with chili mayo ¥1,580 (October 2026 reviews) · aged red and fatty tuna sashimi from Nagasaki, premium wagyu chateaubriand over charcoal ¥5,980, fig and cheese tempura ¥780, grilled wagyu yukhoe ¥1,380, salmon rare cutlet with Shiba-zuke tartare ¥1,380, Ise Chikara pork sausage ¥1,180, whole grilled fatty hokke ¥1,980, fried zucchini ¥680, bonjiri ¥800 (October 2026 reviews) · Ise lobster sashimi ¥11,000 with the head made into miso soup, hairy crab, by reservation (October 2026 reviews) · all-you-can-drink courses for 4–8 people ¥6,600–¥10,000 (Tabelog) · whisky focus (Yamazaki, Chita, rarities), sake and wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Nambanaka, a robata bar where the staff wear wigs] A 15-seat robata izakaya by Nankai Namba's south exit, relaunched on 8 October 2026 under a new name and a new gimmick: the staff work in wigs, afros and pilot hats, and one diner was welcomed with a drum performance. Diners agree the food is no joke. Fresh fish arrives daily from around Japan for sashimi (aged Nagasaki tuna, red and fatty) and straw or charcoal grilling, and the skewers are vegetables wrapped in pork. The signature is the "Drowning" beef cutlet, rare wagyu with sauce poured over it at the table (¥1,980), alongside a giant shrimp in chili mayo hanging off the plate (¥1,580). Splurges run to wagyu chateaubriand and Ise lobster sashimi (¥11,000, book ahead), its head returned as miso soup. Open from mid-afternoon every day; smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.origin: Listing opened 17 January 2026; earlier reviews (June–July 2026) call the shop Isshin, and a July 2026 diner had visited "the Higashi-Umeda branch" with "mostly the same" menu. Reopened as Robata to Katsura on 8 October 2026 (Tabelog).

chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh fish and charcoal and straw grilling at a good price (Tabelog, shop-provided).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (英語版): 炉端とカツラ｡ @日本橋、大阪市浪速区難波中2-6-20 1F、南海なんば駅南口から徒歩2分、地下鉄御堂筋線なんば駅から徒歩5分、月〜金・祝前日・祝後日15:00〜23:30、土日祝13:00〜23:30 (L.O. 料理22:30、ドリンク23:00)、10月8日から「炉端とカツラ｡」として営業、予約可 (2名のテーブル予約でもカウンターになる場合あり)、ワンドリンク制、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、15席 (カウンター7、テーブル2)、喫煙可、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、英語・韓国語のスタッフ。店の紹介: 全国から毎日届く鮮魚の刺身、藁焼きと炭火焼き、野菜の豚巻き串、Yamazaki や Chita などのウイスキー、日本酒、ワイン、飲み放題つきのコース6600円〜10000円 (4〜8名)。口コミ(2026年10月): スタッフはみなカツラ、アフロやパイロットの帽子、太鼓の出迎え、看板の牛カツは目の前でソースをたっぷりかける1980円、大海老のチリマヨ1580円、Nagasaki の熟成本鮪の赤身とトロ、和牛シャトーブリアン5980円、無花果とチーズの天ぷら780円、伊勢海老のお造り11000円と頭の味噌汁 (伊勢海老と毛蟹は要予約)、焼きズッキーニ680円、ぼんじり800円、見た目はふざけているが料理は本気という声。6〜7月の口コミでは店名は Isshin、7月の口コミ: Higashi-Umeda の店とメニューはほぼ同じ。

places.name: ルッジェーリ (RUGGERI)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; gelato comes in a cup or cone, and some flavors carry biscuit, pie, granola or other mix-ins (tiramisu, mille-feuille, the yogurt-and-granola ジェラノーラ), so ask which flavors are wheat-free. Tabelog lists allergy information as available.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Most flavors are milk-based, but the shop makes a line of fruit sorbets (raspberry, mango, Amaou strawberry, fig and others); nothing is labeled dairy- or egg-free, so ask about the day's sorbets. Tabelog tags the shop "Vegetarian options".
places.hours_raw: Mon and Thu–Sun, public holidays and the days before and after them 11:00–19:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday, but open on public holidays; a longer break over New Year; details on the shop's Instagram or X (Tabelog). Closing moved from a later hour to 19:00 on 1 October 2026 (official site; an October 2026 review). No reservations; takeout up to 2 hours, with dry ice for longer trips (Tabelog; official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transit IC, iD, QUICPay and QR (PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted (Tabelog). 8 counter seats and 3 on the terrace; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Opened 1 July 2011 (Tabelog).
