places.cuisine: Handmade Italian gelato shop, Tabelog Ice cream/Gelato "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026 (Tabelog) · 13–16 flavors at a time, about 100 over a year, changing with the seasons (official site; Tabelog) · sizes Solo (1 flavor, 98 ml), Duo (140 ml), Medio (180 ml), cup or cone (October 2026 review) · premium flavors at extra cost, such as Sicilian Pistachio from Bronte and a blond-chocolate gelato (official site) · milk-based flavors (rich milk, chocolate and hazelnut, New York rare cheese, Maple Walnut) and fruit sorbets (raspberry, Amaou strawberry, fig, plum, fruit tomato with lemon) (official site) · autumn flavors such as Italian Mont Blanc and pumpkin (October 2026 reviews) · yogurt gelato with granola (ジェラノーラ) ¥450 (official site) · gift sets shipped and an online shop (official site)
places.notes: [Sweets · Nambanaka, Tabelog-100 Italian gelato by Namba Station] A small gelateria a few minutes from Namba Station, open since 2011 and twice picked for Tabelog's gelato "Tabelog 100" (2023, 2026). Everything is handmade, with 13 to 16 flavors in the case at a time and about 100 over a year, and the case itself is dressed up with seasonal fruit (for Halloween in October 2026). The best seller is the Sicilian Pistachio made with Bronte pistachios, one of the premium flavors that cost a little extra; autumn brings an Italian Mont Blanc with bits of chestnut and a rich pumpkin. Pick a Solo, Duo or Medio in a cup or cone; one diner calls the prices reasonable, another found the premium surcharges add up. There are eight counter seats, a small terrace and a restroom at the back. One early visitor noticed more flavors appear about an hour after opening. Closes at 7 pm; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Handmade Italian gelato shop that also sells wholesale and makes custom flavors for other businesses (official site); Tabelog Ice cream/Gelato "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Delicious beyond the ingredients": each recipe is balanced so the gelato tastes richer than the fruit itself, fruit is ripened and the recipe adjusted to its sugar level, and gelato is served at about −13 °C (official site; Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Sicilian Pistachio (Bronte pistachios); seasonal fruit gelato and sorbets.

anecdotes.text: "The gelato is made with the finest pistachios from Bronte, Sicily. It had a wonderful roasted flavor and was incredibly rich and delicious!" — October 2026, Sicilian Pistachio Solo cone ¥450 plus ¥100 premium.
"The Italian Mont Blanc, in particular, had bits of chestnut mixed in, providing a delightful textural contrast that evoked the feeling of autumn." — October 2026.
"Compared to other nut-based gelatos I've had, the nuts in this one were quite large." — October 2026, Maple Walnut Solo ¥500.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: イタリアンスイーツ Ruggeri、大阪市浪速区難波中2丁目8-93、11時〜19時 (2026年10月1日から19時閉店)、火曜・水曜休み。常に13〜16種類のジェラート、ソロはお持ち帰り可、ドライアイスあり、プレミアムジェラートは50円〜追加。素材以上においしくする配合、果実は熟成させ糖度に合わせて配合、本場のなめらかさは−13℃程度、まずは店頭で。プレミアム: シチリアピスタチオ (シチリアブロンテ産、一番人気)、チョコラートビオンド、マンドルラート、ティラミスドルチェ、メープルゴルゴンゾーラ。季節限定: ペスカマトゥーロ、イタリアンモンブラン、グアバランチャ、さくらもち、クレマトルティメーラ。ミルク系: ミルクロッソ、ニューヨークレアチーズ、ジャンドゥイア。ソルベ系: あまおう ソルベ、アグルーメデコポン、イチジク ソルベ、すもも ソルベ、ポモリモーネ。ジェラノーラ450円 (ヨーグルトのジェラートとグラノーラ、店舗のみ)、ギフトセットの発送、オンラインショップ、卸販売と共同開発。食べログ (英語版): 食べログ アイス・ジェラート 百名店 2023・2026、2011年7月1日開店、年間約100種類、予約不可、テイクアウトは2時間まで、カード・電子マネー・QR可、カウンター8席とテラス3席、禁煙、アレルギー表示あり、ベジタリアンメニューあり、子ども・ベビーカー歓迎。口コミ(2026年10月): 季節の果物で立体的に飾ったショーケース (ハロウィン)、ソロ (98ml)・デュオ (140ml)・メディオ (180ml)、カップかコーン、シチリアピスタチオのソロのコーン450円とプレミアム100円、メープルウォールナッツのソロ500円、イタリアンモンブラン、かぼちゃ、紫芋のスイートポテトパイ、グアバとオレンジ、Jewelry Viola、カウンター席と奥にトイレ、開店1時間後にほかのフレーバーが並ぶという声、値段は手ごろ。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose at the showcase; 8 counter seats and a small terrace (Tabelog). A diner saw a family of overseas visitors enjoying it inside (October 2026).

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the lunch curries are dashi-based spice curries served with fried vegetables, and evenings bring gyoza, shrimp bread and fried dishes, so ask what is wheat-free.

Happy hour 18:00–19:00: draft beer, chuhai and Kaku highball ¥300 (Tabelog). places.cuisine: Home-style izakaya with teppanyaki by night, spice curry made with Japanese dashi at weekday lunch (Tabelog) · lunch: a classic black mapo curry ("Makyaku Curry", with tofu and Sichuan pepper) plus a curry of the day, changing on Mondays and Thursdays (dried shrimp; zucchini and chicken keema; butter curry with gizzard; butter curry with chicken mince and mushrooms), served as a combination of both ¥950, with a lassi set ¥1,100, large rice free, topped with fried vegetables (2026 reviews) · evening: obanzai from ¥300, teppanyaki, shrimp bread, mapo tofu, fried rice (Tabelog) · bean sprout namul, boiled peanuts, chouchin-yaki gyoza, shrimp and broccoli with tartar sauce, eggplant yukhoe, chicken skewers (August and October 2026 reviews) · all-you-can-drink courses ¥3,300 (two people) and ¥5,500 (Tabelog) · sake and shochu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Nambanaka, dashi spice curry by day and obanzai by night] A small hideaway izakaya next to Edion Arena Osaka, five minutes from Namba Station, that runs two ways. On weekday lunchtimes it serves spice curry made with Japanese dashi: a regular black mapo curry with tofu and Sichuan pepper and a curry of the day that changes on Mondays and Thursdays, best as the two-curry combination for ¥950 (large rice free), piled with fried vegetables. Several diners call it mild for its color and a bargain; the shop said that in this area going over ¥1,000 makes it hard to draw customers. At night it turns into a cosy izakaya with obanzai from ¥300, teppanyaki, gyoza, shrimp bread and fried rice, and a ¥300 happy hour from 6 to 7. Book on Friday nights; smoking is allowed. Closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Izakaya serving dashi-based spice curry at lunch (Tabelog, shop-provided). One staff member was running the shop alone at a September 2026 lunch.
chef_bio.philosophy: Keep lunch under ¥1,000: "In this area, if it goes over JPY 1000, it's tough to attract customers" (September 2026 review). The mapo curry keeps the flavor of the mapo served at night (September 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: "The total came to JPY 950! Isn't that a great price?" Asked about it, the shop answered: "In this area, if it goes over JPY 1000, it's tough to attract customers." — September 2026.
"The 'Magic' curry offers a delightful blend of spiciness from the spices and a numbing sensation from the Sichuan peppercorns, enhanced by the tofu." — October 2026.
"I had a great time chatting, so I decided to visit again that very night." — October 2026, curry for lunch, then drinks in the evening.

places.name: カグノミ堂 (KAGUNOMI-DOU)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Most of the small cakes are tarts, financier-based or sponge (the tigre is a financier filled with ganache); the ice creams (beet, leche merengada) and the meringue-covered Kagunomi may be the exceptions, but nothing is stated.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cakes made with cream, butter, eggs and meringue; nothing is described as vegan.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Wed and Fri 14:00–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–20:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). No table bookings, but cakes can be reserved for takeaway (Tabelog). Order and pay at the register, then sit (August 2026 review). Popular cakes sell out: some were gone at opening on an August 2026 visit and at 13:30 on a September 2026 holiday. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), IC cards, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 8 counter seats along the wall; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog; February 2026 review). Opened 21 May 2017 (Tabelog). A May 2026 diner recalls it once being takeaway only.
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-27-17, just off the main street — 1 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn, 3 min from Yotsubashi Stn
places.cuisine: Finger-sized cakes (petit gâteaux), about 10–15 kinds in the case, to take away or eat at an 8-seat counter · the house cake Kagunomi: orange jelly under fluffy meringue on a crunchy chocolate base (macaroni, 2022) · tigre, a financier filled with ganache, plain ¥380 or kinako ¥390 (August 2026) · Nocciola: hazelnut, chocolate and mascarpone mousse (September 2026) · Patata: sweet potato and chestnut on a moist financier-like base (September 2026) · pistachio cake, strawberry tart, banana cream tart, chocolate cake (January–February 2026) · beet ice cream and leche merengada (a Spanish iced meringue with cinnamon and lemon), two flavours ¥600 (August 2026) · cookies and financiers · coffee, tea, wine and sparkling wine
places.notes: [Sweets · Shinmachi, a bar-style shop for two-bite cakes] A small pastry shop a minute from Nishi-Ohashi station that makes only finger-sized cakes, so three of them come to about one ordinary slice and a birthday can mean nine kinds at once. The owner-patissier told rurubu in 2019 the idea was a bar-style sweets shop, to make cakes something you drop in for casually, and there is wine as well as coffee. Choose from the case, pay, and sit at the eight-seat counter along the wall. The line-up changes with the seasons: in 2026 diners singled out a smooth hazelnut-mascarpone Nocciola, a sweet-potato-and-chestnut Patata, a pistachio cake and a chilled tigre (financier with ganache), plus beet and Spanish leche merengada ice cream. Diners call the cakes pretty, well balanced and fairly priced, and buy boxes as gifts; come early, as favourites sell out.

roles: Owner and patissier (named 鳥井 in a July 2019 rurubu article; no later source names the owner)
chef_bio.background: Opened 21 May 2017 (Tabelog). Per a rurubu article updated July 2019, the owner-patissier set out to try "a new format, a bar-style sweets shop", with more than 15 kinds of petit gâteaux in the case at ¥250–300 before tax, plus coffee, tea, wine and sparkling wine and an eat-in space hung with wine glasses.
chef_bio.philosophy: To make sweets something to enjoy casually, close at hand (owner, rurubu 2019).
chef_bio.specialty: Two-bite cakes; the Kagunomi (meringue, orange jelly, chocolate crunch).

anecdotes.text: "I ordered three, and the portion was about the same as one regular cake, which I personally appreciated as it allowed me to enjoy a variety of flavors." — August 2026, Sunday evening.
"The 'Nocciola' with hazelnuts, chocolate, and mascarpone was absolutely delicious! The mousse was incredibly smooth with no graininess at all." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: るるぶ&more (2019年7月更新): 新町のカグノミ堂、オーナー兼パティシエの鳥井さん、バールスタイルのスイーツショップという新しい業態、スイーツをもっと身近に気軽に味わう文化を作りたい、ショーケースには常時15種類以上のプチガトー (税抜き250〜300円)、コーヒー、紅茶、ワイン、スパークリングワイン、ワイングラスを吊るしたイートインスペース、クッキーやフィナンシェも。macaroni (2022年8月更新): 水色を基調としたかわいらしいパティスリー、ひと口サイズのケーキ、名物のカグノミはふわふわのメレンゲの中にオレンジジュレ、土台はクランチチョコレート、西区新町1丁目27-17。食べログ: 西区新町1-27-17、月・火・水・金14:00〜22:00、土・日・祝12:00〜20:00、木曜休み、イートインの予約は不可、ケーキのテイクアウトは予約可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、8席、禁煙、子ども連れ歓迎、2017年5月21日オープン。口コミ(2026年1月〜9月): 指先サイズのケーキが10種類ほど、壁ぞいのカウンター8席、ティグレ (プレーン380円、きなこ390円)、ビーツと leche merengada のアイス600円、季節で新作、早い時間でも売り切れがある、手みやげに。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the cakes in the case, pay at the register, then sit (2026).

places.name: 鮨 利修 (Sushi Rishu)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Soy sauce on nigiri and in simmered dishes, tempura, fried fugu and eel sauce all likely contain wheat; plain sashimi and salt-grilled fish may be simpler, but nothing is stated.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and shellfish counter.
places.hours_raw: Daily except Wednesday 17:30–23:30; also closed the third and fourth Thursdays of each month (Tabelog; a March 2025 review gives Wednesdays and the third Thursday). Reservations accepted online and by phone; the listing warns an online booking may be declined if phone bookings fill the seats first (Tabelog). A May 2025 diner found it fully booked two days running; a June 2026 diner walked in alone. Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 seats: 6 at the counter, a private room for 4; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; school-age children welcome (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-27-16, on the second floor of a building in a quiet side street — 3 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn, 4 min from Yotsubashi Stn
places.cuisine: Sushi counter where you order à la carte instead of a set course (6 counter seats and a private room) · domestic wild fish chosen from the case and cooked to order: sashimi, grilled, simmered or as tempura · assorted sashimi, 5 kinds ¥3,500; surf clam ¥1,300; ark shell ¥1,200; dried swordfish ¥1,200; omakase nigiri, 5 pieces ¥2,900 (September 2025) · examples (2024–2026): whole Ezo abalone with its liver as a sauce to mix with rice, simmered akou, white-grilled Kagoshima eel, grilled kinki, sake-steamed clams, seasoned monkfish liver with Nara pickles, Ise lobster nigiri, eel-and-cucumber or toro-taku rolls · fugu course with tetchiri hot pot and zosui, 5 items ¥11,000 for 2–4 people (Tabelog) · local sake, some rare, plus shochu, whisky, wine and plum wine
places.notes: [Sushi · Shinmachi, an à la carte sushi counter upstairs in a side street] A quiet second-floor sushi bar near Nishi-Ohashi station with six counter seats and one private room, where, unusually for a counter this polished, there is no set course: you pick fish from the case and say how you want it. The listing credits the chef with 50 years of experience and puts the counter just 90 cm from the board. Diners praise the knife work on squid, the whole abalone served with its liver sauce to stir into rice, seasoned monkfish liver, simmered akou, and a toro-taku roll to finish; in winter there is a fugu course of sashimi, fried and grilled fugu, hot pot and zosui. Regulars come monthly for the value (a June 2026 diner had sashimi, abalone, six nigiri, a roll, two beers and three sakes for under ¥15,000) and call the chef calm, warm and well groomed. Book ahead; it fills up.

roles: Chef (50 years of experience, per the Tabelog listing; unnamed)
chef_bio.background: The shop-maintained Tabelog listing describes a chef with 50 years of experience making nigiri with speed and a beautiful shape in front of guests, domestic wild fish and seasonal produce, and local sake sourced to match. Diners describe the chef as calm, friendly and sharp, with an impeccably styled haircut (2024–2025 reviews), and talkative about the fish (April 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Nigiri that keeps its shape after it is made, eaten at your own pace from an à la carte menu (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte sushi and sashimi; abalone with liver sauce; fugu in winter.

anecdotes.text: "They prepared a whole abalone for me, serving not just the meat but also the liver and the foot, lightly boiled." — June 2026, alone, without a reservation.
"I usually can't stand ankimo… But Rishu's ankimo was truly possibly the best I've ever had." — July 2024.
"I always order the toro-taku roll to finish off my meal! You absolutely have to try it!" — March 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 利修、寿司・鍋・日本料理、大阪市西区新町1-27-16、西大橋駅から徒歩3分、四ツ橋駅から徒歩4分、17:30〜23:30、水曜と毎月第3・第4木曜休み、予約可 (電話の予約で埋まるとネット予約を断ることも)、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、10席 (カウンター6、4名の個室)、禁煙、Wi-Fi、小学生以上の子ども可。店の紹介: 経験50年の大将、国産の天然魚と旬の食材の鮨、握ったあとも形の美しい鮨、カウンターとの距離は90cm、刺身の盛り合わせ・焼き物・煮物などの一品料理とコース、旬の魚介に合わせた地酒、珍しい銘柄も、ふぐ鍋とふぐの盛り合わせのふぐコース5品11,000円 (2〜4名)。口コミ(2023年10月〜2026年6月): コースではなく一品ずつ頼める、刺身5種盛り3,500円、ほっき貝1,300円、赤貝1,200円、swordfish の干物1,200円、おまかせにぎり5貫2,900円 (2025年9月)、アワビの肝ソースをシャリに混ぜて、あん肝、イカの包丁仕事、トロたく巻き、穏やかで気さくな大将、毎月通う常連も、2日先まで満席の日も。

cultural_comfort.note: À la carte from the fish case, no set course to lean on; book ahead (2025–2026).

places.name: 鉄板Kitchen DAI (Teppan Kitchen DAI)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Much of the menu is wheat-based (teppan pizza, Napolitan, bifkatsu, garlic toast, French toast), and the hamburg comes with a house sauce; salt-and-garlic steak, grilled vegetables and seafood may be simpler, but share surfaces with the rest. The site asks for food requests at booking.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a steak, seafood and egg teppan; the grilled-vegetable platter may suit, but nothing is described as vegan.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00 per Tabelog, 22:30 per the official site); closed Monday (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted, online through Tabelog or by phone; a September 2026 diner walked in. Starter charge ¥330 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY (Tabelog). Tabelog gives 20 seats (12 at an L-shaped counter, tables for 2, 2 and 4), the official site 15; whole-shop hire; non-smoking; English menu; children welcome, with a kids' menu (Tabelog). The official site carries a notice of the move to this address (closed from a Monday, 1 August, for the move; year not given) and of a crowdfunding for the shop's 15th anniversary; Tabelog's opening date reads 26 March 1981.
places.neighborhood: Kitahorie 2-5-3, on the first street west of the Naniwa-suji and Horie-dori crossing, heading north — 3 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn exit 3, 5 min from Yotsubashi Stn exit 6
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki of wagyu, seafood and vegetables with wine, plus teppan pizza and pasta (prices from the official site, tax included, read October 2026) · Seafood course ¥6,270; Special beef steak course with 130 g black-wagyu fillet ¥8,030; SPECIAL DAI course with seafood and fillet ¥8,580; pair course for two ¥22,000 · black-wagyu fillet from ¥4,158 per 100 g · fluffy wagyu hamburg with a fried egg ¥1,848 · bifkatsu ¥2,728 · pork loin tonteki ¥1,430 · grilled vegetables, 3/5/7 kinds ¥748/¥1,188/¥1,628 · Aomori scallops ¥1,188 · live kuruma prawns in butter ¥1,595 · Akashi octopus with garlic and anchovy ¥1,078 · dashimaki ¥968 · teppan pizza from ¥1,188 · Napolitan from ¥1,298 · omurice ¥1,188 · garlic rice with meat ¥858 · Ise lobster and live abalone on request · blackboard specials such as foie gras with daikon steak (September 2026) and teppan French toast · wine by the glass from ¥880, sparkling from ¥1,100
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Kitahorie, a couple's homey teppan for steak and hamburg] An L-shaped counter in a warm grey-and-wood room a few minutes from Nishi-Ohashi, run by a husband-and-wife team (November 2024 review), where the owner, who is from Miyazaki per a December 2024 diner, cooks and talks across the plate. It aims to be the teppan you went to as a child and come back to as an adult: the site says some regulars have done exactly that, and families with small children are welcome, with a kids' plate. Three courses run ¥6,270–8,580; à la carte there is black-wagyu fillet by weight, a fluffy wagyu hamburg under a fried egg, grilled vegetables that one diner rated the tastiest found at any teppan, blackboard specials such as foie gras on daikon, and a teppan French toast that one diner called the best ever and others single out too. Birthdays can get a message plate and fireworks on request. Diners call the owner warm and easy to talk to; one found the beef choice narrow.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed; from Miyazaki per a December 2024 review)
Run by a husband-and-wife team (November 2024 review)
chef_bio.origin: From Miyazaki (December 2024 review: "the owner, who is from Miyazaki, serves steaks made with Miyazaki beef").
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the owner (店主) chooses the beef, suggests wines and plans the seasonal courses, and the shop wants to be the teppan where children who loved its hamburg come back as adults. The site carries a notice of the move to 北堀江2-5-3 and of a crowdfunding for the 15th anniversary. A November 2024 diner describes it as "run by a husband and wife team"; a January 2026 diner: "I think many people come back because they like the owner's personality."
chef_bio.philosophy: Teppanyaki and wine at prices as reasonable as possible, for dates, celebrations and families with children (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Black-wagyu fillet; wagyu hamburg with fried egg; grilled vegetables; teppan French toast.

anecdotes.text: "The restaurant has 10 counter seats and about 8 table seats, run by a husband and wife team." — November 2024, à la carte.
"Finally, I ordered French toast with ice cream. The French toast here is exceptional! It's a must-order!" — May 2024.
"I really liked the flambéed kaki-pi created by Sharan Q's Batake-san; it pairs perfectly with drinks." — August 2024 (as machine-translated on Tabelog).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 大阪・心斎橋・堀江の鉄板焼き「鉄板Kitchen DAI（ダイ）」、ハンバーグや和牛ステーキ、伊勢海老などの鉄板焼きをアットホームな隠れ家空間でワインとリーズナブルに、デートや誕生日、記念日、小さな子ども連れの家族も歓迎、子どもの頃から大人になった今も通う常連も、肉を知り尽くした店主が選ぶステーキ、メインの席はカウンター、お子様プレート、コース3種 (魚貝を楽しむシーフードコース6,270円、特選ビーフステーキコース8,030円、SPECIAL DAIコース8,580円)、ペアコース2名22,000円、黒毛和牛のフィレステーキ100g 4,158円〜、ふわふわ和牛ハンバーグ目玉焼き乗せ1,848円、懐かしのビフカツ2,728円、焼き野菜3種748円〜7種1,628円、鉄板ピザ、ナポリタン、オムライス、グラスワイン880円〜、ワインは店主が提案、北堀江2-5-3に移転、15周年のクラウドファンディング、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、月曜休み。食べログ (店舗会員): 火〜日17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、先付け330円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、20席 (カウンター12、テーブル8)、貸切可、禁煙、英語メニュー、子ども可。口コミ(2022年11月〜2026年9月): 夫婦で営む店、Miyazaki 出身のオーナー、気さくな店主、焼き野菜、ハンバーグ、フレンチトースト、誕生日のプレートと花火、フォアグラと大根のステーキ、肉の種類が少ないという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); counter teppanyaki with courses or à la carte (2024–2026).

staff_allergy_handling: The official site asks diners to state dislikes and requests when booking a course.

places.name: wad omotenashi cafe
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The teas themselves and the kakigori syrups are likely simpler, but the tea-leaf salad is dressed with soy sauce and the sweets (monaka, zenzai with grilled mochi, karinto) are not described; ask.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain teas (sencha, matcha, hojicha, Chinese tea) and kakigori with tea syrup and no milk may suit; lattes and condensed milk are dairy, and the leftover tea leaves come as a salad with bonito flakes.
places.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–19:00 (last order 18:30), closing days not fixed (Tabelog; official site, "for the time being"). No reservations; cash only (official site; Tabelog: no cards, e-money or QR). At busy times take a number and wait elsewhere; the shop phones when your turn comes (September 2026 reviews: waits of 40 minutes to about an hour and a half). Loud talk, laptop work and watching videos are not allowed (September 2026 review). 20 seats including a counter facing the tea preparation; non-smoking (Tabelog). Up the outside iron stairs to 2F; the 3F gallery wad+ opens during exhibitions (official site).
places.neighborhood: Minami-Senba 4-9-3, 2F, up the outside stairs off a narrow alley, diagonally across from the Organic Building (オーガニックビル) — 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 3
places.cuisine: Japanese tea brewed by hand in a pot, with tea sweets and kakigori, served in pieces by contemporary potters · tea from farms in Kyoto and Shizuoka (official site) · matcha prepared in front of you, in a bowl you choose from 14, ¥1,000 (September 2026) · sencha such as kabuse sencha, served first in a small cup with cooler water, then hotter; the spent leaves come back as a salad with soy sauce and bonito flakes · Chinese tea, refilled up to five times · matcha latte and hojicha latte, the matcha syrup poured by you and refillable · koji tea latte · kakigori, large: Uji syrup ¥1,300 (+¥100 milk), hojicha syrup ¥1,300, Uji syrup and condensed milk ¥1,400, small sizes too; black syrup, white syrup and Uji all year, hojicha and Japanese black tea seasonal (September 2026) · wad monaka (brown rice) · Tanba black-bean zenzai with grilled mochi and salted kombu · grilled rice cakes · tea snacks such as burdock, karinto and black beans · tea leaves, antiques and potters' work for sale at the entrance
places.notes: [Cafe · Minami-Senba, a tea-and-tableware cafe up an iron stair] Up worn iron stairs beside a narrow alley in Minami-Senba, a dim, quiet room of concrete floor, old wooden furniture and large ceramics where Japanese tea is made by hand, one cup at a time. The shop calls its idea the good things of Japan and its tea service a modern take on the spirit of the tea ceremony; the tea comes straight from farms in Kyoto and Shizuoka, and the cups and bowls are by contemporary potters, sold at the door and shown in the gallery upstairs, which also runs kintsugi classes. Pick your own matcha bowl from fourteen (one diner chose a Shigaraki piece by a late potter), drink a sencha through several changing infusions and then eat the leaves as a salad, or order the towering kakigori with Uji or hojicha syrup to pour yourself. One of Tabelog's top 100 cafes (WEST, 2025). It is popular, with overseas visitors among the crowd per September 2026 diners, so expect to take a number and wait; the shop phones when a seat is free. Cash only; keep voices low.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: wad (和道) offers "good things of Japan" chosen one by one; a cafe for enjoying tableware and ingredients in an arrangement of the spirit of the tea ceremony (2F), a gallery for contemporary potters (3F, wad+, exhibitions once or twice a month) and kintsugi classes. Tea comes directly from farms in Kyoto (和束町) and Shizuoka (牧之原), poured in the shop's own way; tea leaves, the owner's choice of antiques and gallery artists' work are sold at the cafe entrance. Selected for Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: "百杯100style": each cup prepared with care, in the spirit of hospitality (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha in a bowl you choose; kakigori with tea syrups; sencha in several infusions.

anecdotes.text: "You can choose your favorite tea bowl from 14 different matcha bowls, and they will prepare the tea in the bowl you select." — September 2026.
"At the end, the remaining tea leaves were served as a salad with soy sauce and bonito flakes, which was quite surprising and interesting." — September 2026, kabuse sencha.
"It's a popular spot, and I waited about an hour and a half to get in, but I was able to explore the nearby America Village while waiting, thanks to a phone call notification." — September 2026.

Weekday buffet ¥1,680 for 90 minutes in September 2026, with a notice of a price change from 1 October (September 2026 review). Dinner table charge ¥498 per person; private rooms (4, 6 or 8 people, dinner only) ¥770 per person with a 4-person minimum (Tabelog). places.cuisine: Northern Thai (Chiang Mai) cooking plus dishes from across Thailand · lunch: a self-service buffet of 15–20 dishes with desserts — weekday ¥1,680 and weekends and holidays ¥2,390 (Tabelog lunch menu, last updated November 2025; a review notes a price change from 1 October 2026), soft-drink bar +¥450/550, 70-minute free-flow Singha draft ¥1,791 · buffet dishes rotate: green curry, red curry, gapao, Pad Thai, Khao Man Gai, rice porridge, Isan larb salads, Hakodate squid salads, herb-mayo vegetables, Thai desserts; Khao Soi at weekends (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · dinner à la carte (tax included, Tabelog menu updated 21 October 2026): fresh spring rolls ¥843, Tom Yum Goong with river prawn ¥951, Tom Kha Gai for two ¥1,167, tod man pla ¥714, Gai Yang ¥1,059, moo satay ¥735, pad krapow ¥1,059, soft-shell crab Poo Nim Pad Pong Curry ¥1,707, Khao Soi Gai ¥1,026, Pad Thai with shrimp ¥1,026, green curry with chicken and eggplant for two ¥1,167, Chiang Mai sticky rice in a basket ¥519, larb kua ¥1,059 · seasonal whole mud crab Pad Thai or fried rice ¥2,948 (Tabelog) · Thai wines and Singha on draft
places.notes: [Thai · Kitahorie, a Chiang Mai-style Thai house with a famous lunch buffet] Opened in 2001 near Nishi-Ohashi station, this is the original of a small Osaka Thai group, and the listing calls it the first Thai restaurant in Kansai to hold the Thai government's five-star certification. The room is dressed with things the shop says it sourced in Thailand: celadon tiles, teak, Jim Thompson silks, temple roof ornaments, and no clocks. Lunch is a buffet of 15 to 20 dishes that keeps the tables full — a September 2026 diner found four groups queuing before 11:30 — with green curry, gapao, Pad Thai and Khao Man Gai, plus Khao Soi at weekends. Dinner is à la carte or courses: try the Chiang Mai Khao Soi, sticky rice in a basket, soft-shell crab curry or the green curry that an October 2026 diner called the best dish of the night. Some find it spicy or salty, others tuned to Japanese tastes; book for weekend lunch.

roles: Thai chefs (unnamed); the listing credits "native Chiang Mai chefs" with the Khao Soi
chef_bio.origin: Thai chefs; the Khao Soi is "made by native Chiang Mai chefs" (Tabelog menu).
chef_bio.background: Opened 20 December 2001 (Tabelog). The listing calls it the first Thai restaurant in Kansai certified with a five-star rating by the Thai government, and says its Thai chefs have worked in London, Switzerland, Germany, the UAE, Hong Kong, Singapore and Africa, about 250 years of experience combined. The official site lists it as THAI SELECT Signature, one of 19 such shops among about 180 in Japan, and as the honten of a group that added HERBIS ENT (2011), Yodoyabashi (2012), KOHSAMUI BY CHEDI LUANG and KRABI BY CHEDI LUANG (2021). The site describes the honten interior as furnished from Thailand: celadon tableware and tiles, teak, rattan, brass furniture, Jim Thompson fabrics and silk, wicker, hammered Ayutthaya cutlery, temple roof ornaments and lotus candles, with no clocks. The site also says the group prepares menus to serve overseas (inbound) visitors with confidence.
chef_bio.philosophy: Northern Thai cooking from Chiang Mai: fresh vegetables, sticky rice and herbs for a healthy, delicate flavour (Tabelog listing).
chef_bio.specialty: Khao Soi Gai; green curry; the lunch buffet.

anecdotes.text: "I arrived 10 minutes before my reservation and found a line of four groups waiting outside. The restaurant opened at 11:30." — September 2026, lunch buffet.
"All the dishes were tasty, but the standout was definitely the Green Curry. The balance of creamy coconut richness, aromatic spices, and heat was exceptional." — October 2026, dinner à la carte.
"When I mentioned my wife couldn't come, they kindly said, 'If you call us in situations like this, we won't charge a cancellation fee.'" — October 2026, dinner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (chedi.jp): 本格タイ料理チェディルアン、タイ政府5つ星認定、THAI SELECT Signature (全国約180店中19店舗のみ)、2001年開店の北堀江本店はタイの文化・様式・素材・クラフトワークを理解し、できる限り現地で企画調達、セラドンの食器やタイル、チーク、ラタン、真鍮の家具、ジムトンプソンのファブリックやシルク、ウィッカーワーク、アユタヤの叩き仕上げのカトラリー、寺院からの屋根飾り、蓮の蝋燭、ここには時計はありません、タイ北部チェンマイの伝統料理、シンハードラフト設置店、ほかにハービスENT (2011年)、淀屋橋 (2012年)、コサムイ バイ チェディルアン、クラビ バイ チェディルアン (2021年)、ランチビュッフェは平日15種類以上・土日祝20種類以上でデザート付き、90分制、インバウンドの方にも自信をもってお持て成しできるメニュー。食べログ (店舗会員): 西区北堀江1-17-11、西大橋駅4番出口から徒歩2分、火〜木11:30〜15:00・17:30〜22:00、金は夜22:30まで、土祝11:30〜15:30・17:30〜22:30、日11:30〜15:30・17:30〜22:00、月曜休み、ランチはビュッフェのみ、ディナーはコースかアラカルト、テーブルチャージ498円、個室料770円、65席、禁煙、子ども可、2001年12月20日オープン、食べログ アジア・エスニック WEST 百名店 2022・2023・2024・2026。口コミ(2023年12月〜2026年10月): 開店前から行列、平日ビュッフェ1,680円 (90分)、グリーンカレー、gapao、Pad Thai、カオマンガイ、辛めや塩辛めという声も、日本人向けで食べやすいという声も、スタッフの対応が温かい。

places.name: やまもと菓子店 (YAMAMOTO KASHITEN)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Almost everything is tart, sponge, choux or Basque-cake based (the Mont Blanc and fig cake sit on tart bases; the quiche has a cookie crust); the vanilla-anise pudding may be the exception, but nothing is stated.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream, butter, eggs, cheese and chocolate cakes; nothing is described as vegan.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 17:00–20:00, until sold out; closed Sunday and Monday, and it may close unexpectedly (Tabelog). The opening time is not fixed: the shop opens when the cakes are ready, at 17:25 on two September 2026 visits, and diners watch the owner's Instagram for news (2025–2026 reviews). Favourites sell out by about 18:00–19:00 (2026 reviews). One group inside at a time; wait outside (2026 reviews). Photos allowed only of the showcase, with permission (2026 reviews). Takeaway only; ice packs added by the hour of travel; cakes are for same-day eating (2026 reviews). Cash only (Tabelog; September 2026 review). No reservations (Tabelog). Opened 2011 (September 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-21-3, Kobayashi Bldg 1F, south of the Orix Theater, between Yotsubashi and Nishi-Ohashi Stns — 4 min walk from either; no sign out front
places.cuisine: Takeaway-only patisserie of "adult" cakes built around spirits and liqueurs, about ten kinds in the case plus baked goods on the shelf · Chocolate Mont Blanc with Amarena cherries and almond eau-de-vie ¥860–880 (March–September 2026) · fig tart: figs poached in Madeira wine over Parmigiano cheese ¥860–880 (August–September 2026) · chocolate cake with pistachio cream and blue cheese ¥780 (March and August 2026) · strawberry tart with aged balsamic and pistachio cream ¥840 (March 2026) · banana and Glenlivet 12 chocolate gâteau basque ¥860 (March 2026) · chocolate éclair ¥350 (March and September 2026) · Tahitian vanilla and anise pudding ¥340 (September 2026) · shortcake with Nagano Purple grapes and Marc de Champagne (September 2026) · Marjolaine (September 2026) · Aberfeldy 12 rare cheesecake with lemon cream and almond praline (July 2026) · mango and ginger tart, banana or apple tatin, a winter Volbolon (ボルボロン, as a review writes it) (2024–2025) · Saturday-only quiche on a cookie crust, ¥540 (July 2025)
places.notes: [Sweets · Shinmachi, an evening-only shop of liqueur-laced cakes] A patisserie with no sign, in the ground floor of a building between Yotsubashi and Nishi-Ohashi stations, that opens in the evening when the cakes are ready (17:25 on two September 2026 visits) and closes when they run out. Inside, the room is the kitchen itself, with a small case of about ten cakes, and the owner, working alone, serves one group at a time while the rest wait outside. Almost every cake is built around a spirit: a chocolate Mont Blanc with Amarena cherries and almond eau-de-vie that two diners call the best they have had, whole figs poached in Madeira on Parmigiano, pistachio and blue-cheese chocolate cake, a Nagano Purple shortcake with Marc de Champagne, plus an éclair and a vanilla-anise pudding at about ¥350. Tabelog Sweets WEST 100 (2023, 2026). Cash only, photos of the case only, and go early.

chef_bio.background: Opened 2011 and repeatedly selected for the Tabelog Sweets WEST 100 (September 2026 review; Tabelog lists 2023 and 2026). A long-time customer since 2017–2018 notes the chocolate has become house-made over the years (2026 reviews). Diners describe the owner as reserved and stoic, with service some find curt — a September 2026 diner saw a companion told off for photographing from outside — and read it as an artisan's nature (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: "If I had the budget for advertising or hiring people, I would rather use it to buy better ingredients and make even more delicious cakes." (owner, quoted in an August 2026 review)
chef_bio.specialty: Cakes built around spirits and liqueurs; the chocolate Mont Blanc with Amarena cherries.

anecdotes.text: The owner, "somewhat reserved", chatted a little: "If I had the budget for advertising or hiring people, I would rather use it to buy better ingredients and make even more delicious cakes." — August 2026.
"Finally opened at 17:25! Please note that entry is one person at a time." — September 2026, a rainy Friday.
"This year, the Mont Blanc I had, or perhaps the best cake I've tasted, was the chocolate Mont Blanc with Amarena cherries." — September 2026, a customer since 2017–2018.

Closed Monday, open when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog; official site); the site lists November 2026 closing days of 2, 9, 17, 24 and 30 November, with the 16th booked for a private party. Reservations accepted; fewer slots online, so phone; cancellation fees may apply (Tabelog). A May 2026 diner booked by phone the same day, an October 2026 diner the same week. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay (Tabelog). 36 seats: 10 at the counter, ten tables for two, a private room for six; terrace; heated tobacco only, in the private room; Wi-Fi; BYO and a sommelier (Tabelog). places.cuisine: Italian with seasonal seafood and handmade pasta, à la carte or omakase, and a list of over 1,000 wines · omakase course of three antipasti, two pasta and a main, with dessert and coffee, ¥9,000 / ¥12,000 / ¥15,000 before tax; Italian autumn truffle on one dish +¥6,000 (official site, autumn menu) · reviews: Chef's Omakase Course ¥14,300 (March 2026), an ¥11,000 course (October 2026) · autumn à la carte (before tax, official site): sea bream carpaccio with risoni and Sardinian bottarga ¥3,200; Hokkaido oyster meunière with mushroom cappuccino and truffle ¥3,600; Awaji blue crab chitarra in fruit-tomato sauce ¥3,400; herb tagliolini with roe-laden ayu confit and matsutake ¥3,400; agnolotti del plin with truffle ¥6,800; Saga beef stracotto ¥5,200 · always (tax included, Tabelog menu May 2026): charcoal-grilled A5 Saga beef with pickled-onion sauce ¥6,600, Saga beef bolognese tagliatelle ¥4,180, gnocchi in fruit-tomato sauce with mozzarella ¥3,520, aglio e olio ¥1,980, truffle risotto with soft egg ¥9,240, tiramisu with caramel gelato ¥990 · pasta is not served on its own
places.notes: [Italian · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, handmade pasta and a big wine cellar near Nagahoribashi] An upscale Italian room a couple of minutes from Nagahoribashi station, open since 2010, with a long counter by the kitchen, tables and a private room further back, a terrace, and goldfish motifs through the interior (June 2026). Order à la carte or hand it over to the omakase course of three antipasti, two pastas and a main; the pasta is mostly handmade, and the list runs to over 1,000 bottles. Diners single out the pasta — squid-ink tagliolini with Setouchi baby squid and Sardinian bottarga, a truffle risotto with a runny egg — along with charcoal-grilled A5 Saga beef, the ravioli and tiramisu, and a rare, fragrant olive oil for the house bread. It is on the pricey side (¥15,000–20,000 a head is typical) but staff are warm, explain each dish, and will pick a wine to your taste. Tabelog Italian WEST 100 (2021, 2025).

roles: Chef (unnamed); "experienced chef" per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing

chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients from spring through winter, in courses and à la carte (Tabelog listing).
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade pasta; truffle risotto; charcoal-grilled Saga beef.

anecdotes.text: "Squid Ink Tagliolini with Setouchi Baby Squid and Summer Vegetables, Topped with Sardinian Bottarga… Just like last time, the pasta was a highlight." — September 2026, course with wine pairing.

places.name: ビストロ ダ アンジュ (Bistro d'Ange)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Bread is served free-flow with every course, sauces are classic French (meunière, Américaine, cream), and desserts include a meringue-based Mont Blanc, savarin and quiche; grilled meats and fish may be simpler, but nothing is marked gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a French bistro of meat, fish, butter and cream; nothing is described as vegan.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–16:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:30–22:30 (L.O. 21:30; last entry 21:15); closed Monday, or Tuesday when Monday is a holiday (official site; Tabelog). Tabelog notes closures on 10 and 24 November 2026. Special hours apply during guest-chef fairs (official site, October 2026). Reservations online 24 hours, events by phone; a booking is cancelled 30 minutes after the time without notice; tell the shop ahead if bringing a stroller (Tabelog; official site). Often fully booked (2025–2026 reviews). No separate checks (October 2026 review). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and cash; no e-money or QR (Tabelog; official site). 32 seats in a basement; non-smoking; children welcome; whole-shop hire for 20–50 and restaurant weddings (Tabelog). Founded 1972 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashi-suji 2-6-18, Shinsaibashi Hayakawa Bldg B1F, in a back street — 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 4-B or from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: French bistro classics with monthly-changing mains (prices tax included, Tabelog menu updated 27 October 2026) · dinner: Ange Course ¥5,500 — choose a starter, main and dessert from the carte, with bread and an after-dinner drink (some choices cost extra) · à la carte, portions for two: salad of prosciutto and French herb salami ¥2,400, pâté de campagne ¥2,500, Burgundy escargot gratin ¥1,800, moules marinière ¥2,400, Awaji flounder meunière ¥4,400, pork shoulder and plums braised in red wine ¥4,400, crisp duck leg confit ¥5,500, cheeses ¥770 each or four for ¥2,680, bread ¥440, Isigny butter ¥250, chocolate mousse with Grand Marnier ¥770, purple sweet potato Mont Blanc ¥770, crème caramel · lunch: Ange Lunch (weekdays) ¥1,980 — soup or salad, a main such as chicken thigh confit with mushroom cream or fish and shrimp quenelles in Américaine sauce, dessert, bread and a drink; Bistro Lunch ¥2,500 weekdays / ¥2,680 weekends and holidays — appetizer platter, a main such as pork shoulder with cider and apple sauce or semi-cooked salmon with pear cream sauce, dessert, bread and drink; beef bavette café de Paris +¥550; flambéed savarin +¥220 · teas imported directly from France with the group's アルション blends · European wines imported directly and chosen by the sommelier (Tabelog)
places.notes: [French · Shinsaibashi, a Parisian-style bistro in a basement since 1972] Down a stair in a back street between Shinsaibashi and Namba, this 32-seat bistro has been serving French classics since 1972 with the motto, on its own site, of good things at reasonable prices like a restaurant in the backstreets of Paris. It belongs to a Kansai group of patisseries and tea rooms (アンジュ＆アルション, run by 株式会社かめいあんじゅ), which is why the teas are the group's own French blends. The lunch courses (¥1,980–2,680) are the big draw and fill up even on weekdays: an appetizer platter, a monthly main such as braised pork shoulder or semi-cooked salmon with pear cream, a purple-sweet-potato Mont Blanc, and free-flow bread. At dinner, the ¥5,500 Ange Course lets you pick three dishes from the carte; à la carte plates are sized for two. In October 2026 a guest chef from France cooked a ten-day fair. Service is warm, though one October 2026 table waited 70 minutes for dessert. Book ahead.

roles: Guest chef from France, パトリック・テリアン (spelt "Patrick Terrian" in a translated review), for a ten-day fair in October 2026 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Founded in Osaka's Minami in 1972, inspired by Parisian bistros; its motto since opening is to offer good things at reasonable prices, like a restaurant in the backstreets of Paris (official site). Run by 株式会社かめいあんじゅ, whose site lists patisseries (アルション), a boulangerie, a crêperie, a tea salon and other restaurants (anjou.co.jp). The listing says wines are imported directly from Europe and chosen by the house sommelier, and vegetables come straight from farmers. Tabelog Bistro 100 (2021). In October 2026 the site announced a special fair with the visiting French chef パトリック・テリアン from 8 to 18 October, with changed hours.
chef_bio.philosophy: Unpretentious and properly good: a neighbourhood bistro that does not change (official site, 気取らず、きちんとおいしい).
chef_bio.specialty: Choose-your-own course; monthly-changing mains; purple sweet potato Mont Blanc.

anecdotes.text: "For the à la carte, I was informed that each dish is meant for two people… Everything was delicious, but the roasted lamb was particularly outstanding." — August 2026, first visit.
"For an additional 1280 yen, I upgraded to a salad with lobster and caviar… The Mont Blanc dessert had a crispy meringue base, and I ended up eating two servings." — October 2026, ¥5,500 course.
"The main dish, braised pork shoulder, was incredibly tender and flavorful—no need for teeth to enjoy it!" — September 2026, ¥2,500 lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ビストロ・ダ・アンジュ、A little Paris in Osaka, since 1972、心ほどける大阪の小さなパリ、旬の食材を使ったフランス料理と生産者から届くワイン、1972年に大阪ミナミに誕生、パリの下町にあるレストランのように良いものをリーズナブルに楽しんでいただくことが開店当時からのモットー、気取らず、きちんとおいしい、ずっと変わらない街のビストロ、32席、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-6-18 心斎橋早川ビル B1F、心斎橋駅4-B号出口から徒歩5分、ランチ11:30〜16:00 (L.O.14:30)、ディナー17:30〜22:30 (L.O.21:30、入店は21:15まで)、月曜休み (祝日は営業し翌火曜休み)、現金・クレジットカード、2026年10月はパトリック・テリアンシェフ来日特別料理フェア (10月8日〜18日、営業時間の変更)。株式会社かめいあんじゅ (anjou.co.jp): パティスリー、ブーランジェリー、クレープリー、サロン・ド・テ アルションなど。食べログ (店舗会員): 1972年創業のビストロ、ヨーロッパから直輸入でソムリエが選ぶワイン、農家から直送の野菜、アンジュコース5,500円、平日のアンジュランチ1,980円、ビストロランチ平日2,500円・土日祝2,680円、32席、禁煙、子ども可、食べログ ビストロ 百名店 2021。口コミ(2025年2月〜2026年10月): いつも満席なので予約を、アラカルトは2人前、豚肩肉の煮込み、紫芋のモンブラン、パンはおかわり自由、会計は別々にできない、デザートまで70分かかった日も。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick a starter, main and dessert from a set course; book ahead (2026).

places.name: リュミエール (lumière)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. The shop's Tabelog page says 99% of its dishes use no butter, cream, flour or sugar, and the official site says the same of its sauces, so most plates may be free of wheat flour, but nothing is called gluten-free, and courses include bread (Karato bread), pâté en croûte, a lotus-root galette, financiers and other small sweets (2026 reviews). Ask which dishes can be swapped.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables lead every plate, but the courses are built around fish and meat, the opening soup is a vegetable and chicken consommé (July 2026), and no vegan course is listed.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:00), dinner 18:00–21:00 (last order 19:00); closed Monday, or the next day when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog; official site). Courses only. Reservations online (Tabelog says phone lines may be closed; book online). Service charge 10% (Tabelog; official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 39 seats at tables plus one private room for up to 8 (room fee ¥4,000 in one place on the listing, ¥4,400 in another); non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Children welcome, with a kids' menu; children under elementary-school age are seated in the private room (Tabelog). Opened 20 December 2006 (Tabelog; official site: 2006).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-19-15, Unagidani Block 3F — 3 min from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 2 (Midosuji Line)
places.cuisine: "Vegetable gourmet" French courses with 99% of dishes made without butter, cream, flour or sugar, seasoned mainly with salt and pepper (official site; Tabelog) · lunch 8 dishes ¥8,800; dinner A 9 dishes ¥13,200, B 10 dishes ¥17,600, special 10 dishes ¥22,000; plus 10% service (official site, tax included, read October 2026); Tabelog also lists a 9-dish lunch at ¥11,000 · main-course choice with supplements, e.g. Kagoshima black pork loin, domestic beef fillet, Australian lamb rack +¥1,100, Landes pigeon +¥1,650, Yamagata wagyu fillet +¥2,200 (July 2026) · signatures: a soup of 20 vegetables finished at the table, the "Crystal Amusement Park" of six bite-sized starters in glassware, foie gras with lotus-root galette, fish sent direct from the source and slow-cooked, a "small vegetable dessert" of komatsuna, celery, burdock and daikon, Karato bread with tomato paste (February 2026) · over 200 wines chosen by a senior sommelier, sake pairings, vegetable cocktails and non-alcoholic drinks
places.notes: [French · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, vegetable-led haute cuisine from a long-running chef] The head restaurant of chef Yasushi Karato, who opened it in 2006 around one idea, which the chef calls vegetable gourmet: French cooking in which vegetables carry the flavour and 99% of the dishes do without butter, cream, flour and sugar. The group's site says it topped the Zagat Survey in its first year and has held a Michelin star 12 years running since the guide was first published, and in October 2026 the chef was made a Chevalier of France's Mérite agricole. Courses open with a soup of 20 vegetables poured at the table, then the house "Crystal Amusement Park", six small starters in glass, before fish, a meat you choose (supplements for lamb, pigeon or wagyu), a dessert made from garden vegetables and a fruit dessert. Diners in 2026 called it art on a plate and came from as far as Nagoya; one found the bill about double the ¥8,800 lunch once supplements and drinks were added. A calm, spacious third-floor room with a private room, popular for birthdays and three-generation family meals. Book online; closed Mondays.

roles: Owner-chef (Tabelog: "Owner Chef: Mr. Yasushi Karato"; official site)
Head of the Lumière Group (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official chef page: trained at many well-known restaurants and hotels, then opened lumière in Shinsaibashi in 2006; top ranking in the Zagat Survey in its first year; a star in every Michelin Guide since it was first published, 12 years running (as the site puts it); runs the restaurant business, produces other food ventures and imports the French tea house Dammann Frères; heads the Lumière Group, now 10 shops (7 run directly, 3 supervised); a planning member of 文化芸術観光ネットワーク大阪 and a board member of クラブ・デュ・タスキドール (as written; no romaji given); author of the book 野菜の美食. On 14 October 2026 the site announced the chef had been made a Chevalier of the Ordre du Mérite agricole. The chef of Junsei in the same building (osaka_junsei_higashishinsaibashi, address_ja "東心斎橋1-19-15 UNAGIDANI BLOCK 1F.2F") trained under Karato at lumière from 2017 (Junsei official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Beautiful to the eye, surprising to the tongue, kind to the body" — a feast three generations can share; recipes are never fixed and keep being upgraded (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable-led French courses; the Crystal Amusement Park starters; vegetable desserts.

anecdotes.text: "I came all the way from Nagoya because I wanted to try it. This restaurant has fundamentally changed my perception of French cuisine." — May 2026, ¥17,400 course.
"I made a reservation for the lunch course priced at JPY 8,800 (tax included). However, the final bill was about double that amount." — July 2026.
"I also appreciated being able to choose the color of the Laguiole knife." — August 2026, group booking in the private room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (k-coeur.com): リュミエール本店、2006年心斎橋にオープンしたリュミエールグループの本店、開業1年目にザガットサーベイでトップランキング、シェフ唐渡泰、テーマは「野菜の美食」、ソースにワイン・バター・クリーム・小麦粉・砂糖を99％使用しない、ミシュランガイド発刊以来12年連続で星、リュミエールグループ代表として10店舗 (直営7、監修3)、ダマンフレールの輸入、著書「野菜の美食」、2026年10月に農事功労章シュヴァリエを受章、ランチ8皿8,800円、ディナーA 9皿13,200円、B 10皿17,600円、特別コース22,000円 (税込、別途サービス料10%)、シニアソムリエ、日本酒や野菜のカクテル、デザートのスペシャリテ「野菜のデザート」、完全個室、親子孫3世代で楽しめるレストラン、東心斎橋1-19-15 UNAGIDANI BLOCK 3F。食べログ (店舗会員): フレンチ WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2025、火〜日 12:00〜15:00 (L.O.13:00)、18:00〜21:00 (L.O.19:00)、月曜休み (祝日の場合は翌日)、サービス料10%、カード可、39席、個室あり、車椅子可、子ども可 (未就学児は個室)、ワイン200種類以上、2006年12月20日オープン。口コミ(2026年2月〜10月): 20種類の野菜のスープ、クリスタル遊園地、フォアグラ、Karato bread、小松菜・セロリ・牛蒡・大根の野菜のデザート、メインは追加料金で選べる、ランチ8,800円が追加とドリンクで約2倍に、Nagoya から来た人も、誕生日や家族の記念日に。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses booked online; staff explain each dish (July 2026); the main course is chosen from a short list.

places.name: サロン・ド・テ・アルション 法善寺本店 (Salon de Thé Alcyon)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The teas themselves are plain leaf blends, but every cake on the shop's own list names wheat, milk and egg as allergens, and the lunches are wheat-heavy (croissant sandwich, penne gratin, cheese pie, bread with the sets). The crème brûlée is not described either way.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Straight and flavoured teas, rooibos and herbal infusions may suit (served in a pot; milk tea is separate); every cake lists milk and egg, and the lunches use meat, ham, cheese and cream.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Fri (and the days before and after a holiday) 11:30–20:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–20:00; last food order 19:00; closed Monday, open when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog). The official site lists closing days as irregular and gave Mondays 5, 19 and 26 October 2026 off. The 2F salon closes at 17:00 (last order 15:30) on tea-party event days (Tabelog; official site). 1F boutique for takeaway cakes, baked goods and tea; 2F salon of 36 seats, up steep stairs (official site; October 2026 review). Salon bookings only for meals or sets (Tabelog; official site); a September 2026 diner waited 28 minutes at noon on a Saturday. Pay at the register upstairs (April 2025 review). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, Discover per the official site); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). A takeaway bag costs ¥50 (October 2026 review). Opened 2 November 1986 (Tabelog; the official site marks its 40th anniversary on 2 November 2026).
places.neighborhood: Namba 1-6-20, by Hozenji, behind a red door — 3 min from Namba Walk exits B-12 or B-14 (Namba Stn, Kintetsu Osaka-Namba Stn); Crêperie Alcyon is a minute away
places.cuisine: French-style salon de thé: tea in a pot with plated desserts, cakes and light French-leaning meals (prices from the official site, tax included, read October 2026) · plated desserts made to order, with tea: Puits d'amour (caramelised chiboust with apple in spiced red wine, autumn) ¥2,500; the 40th-anniversary Mont Blanc (the original recipe: browned meringue, cream, chestnut cream) ¥2,700; caramelised salted-caramel castella with vanilla ice cream ¥1,800 · Alcyon Blue crème brûlée ¥1,250; savarin flambéed with rum ¥1,250; tea scones, two with French strawberry jam and cream, ¥900 · petit afternoon tea ¥2,980 (with cake) or ¥3,280 (with plated dessert); seasonal Halloween afternoon tea ¥5,000/¥5,300 · one-plate lunch until 14:00 (soup, ham Caesar salad, croissant sandwich, octopus and broccoli marinade, penne gratin, cheese pie, cake and drink) ¥2,500/¥2,830; Alcyon set A, chicken cacciatore ¥1,980/¥2,310; set B, beef cheek in red wine or hamburg with demi-glace ¥2,310/¥2,640 · flavoured teas ¥860, e.g. the house Alcyon Blue (lavender, strawberry, rhubarb, cornflower petals); single-estate Assam, Darjeeling, Uva, Kandy, Dimbula, Nilgiri ¥840; rooibos and herbal teas · tea cocktails from 17:00, ¥950 · boutique cakes such as Mont Blanc, strawberry shortcake, Pistachio Mania, Naruto kintoki sweet-potato tart ¥680, pumpkin Basque cheesecake ¥600; takeaway iced tea ¥700
places.notes: [Tea salon · Namba, a 40-year-old French salon de thé by Hozenji] Behind a red door a few steps from Hozenji Yokocho, a cake and tea shop downstairs and, up steep stairs, an antique-furnished salon where tea comes in a pot. Opened in 1986, it turns 40 on 2 November 2026; a 2026 reviewer calls it a pioneer of the salon de thé in Kansai, and the crêpe shop Crêperie Alcyon nearby grew out of it. Order a plated dessert made to order (the original Mont Blanc of crisp browned meringue and chestnut cream, a puits d'amour, a salted-caramel castella with hot caramel poured at the table), a cake from the case, or a set lunch with soup, a main, dessert and drink from about ¥2,000. The teas are naturally scented blends; the house Alcyon Blue of lavender, strawberry and rhubarb is the favourite. On Tabelog's Sweets WEST 100 list in 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2026. Busy at weekends (a 28-minute wait at noon on a Saturday in September 2026); an October 2026 diner found about 80% of an evening crowd were overseas visitors. Closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Run by 株式会社かめいあんじゅ (KameiAnjou Inc., per the site's copyright line), which also runs Crêperie Alcyon (osaka_creperie_alcyon_namba), Bistro da Anjou, patisseries and a bakery (company site). The cakes come each morning from the group's Atelier Alcyon pastry kitchen, and the site credits the plated desserts to an Alcyon patissier who won an award from the Ministry of Agriculture's secretariat (農林水産省大臣官房長賞). Teas are blends from the Paris tea house George Cannon, naturally scented (official site; an October 2026 review). Opened 2 November 1986 (Tabelog); 40th-anniversary events with old recipes revived, July–November 2026 (official site). Selected for Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" in 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: For people in France a salon de thé is a place to drop into any time, to rest and talk over tea; enjoy teas and desserts found only here (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Plated desserts made to order; the original Mont Blanc; Alcyon Blue tea.

anecdotes.text: "As a pioneer of authentic salon de thé culture in Kansai, Alcyon has garnered overwhelming support for nearly 40 years." — October 2026, Alcyon set and one-plate lunch.
"It was a weekday evening, and the restaurant was almost full, with about 80% of the customers being international visitors." — October 2026.
"If it becomes too strong, you can switch to milk tea, and they might even offer hot water for a refill." — October 2026, Mont Blanc and tea.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (anjou.co.jp): サロン・ド・テ アルション法善寺本店、1F/boutique と 2F/salon (36席、全席禁煙)、難波1-6-20、なんばウォークB-12またはB-14出口から徒歩3分、平日11:30〜20:00、土日祝11:00〜20:00、2Fは19:00 L.O.、不定休、席の予約は食事の利用のみ、カード可、2026年11月2日に40周年、昔のレシピを再現したケーキやデセールを7月〜11月に、農林水産省大臣官房長賞を受賞したパティシエ考案のできたてデセール (ピュイダムール2,500円、40thこだわりモンブラン2,700円、塩キャラメルカステラ1,800円、いずれも紅茶付き)、アルションブルーのクレームブリュレ1,250円、サヴァラン1,250円、スコーン2個900円、プティアフタヌーンティーセット2,980円〜、ワンプレートランチ2,500円〜 (〜14:00)、アルションセットA 1,980円〜、B 2,310円〜、フレーバーティー860円、ノンフレーバーティー840円、夜だけのティーカクテル950円、ケーキはアトリエ・アルションから毎朝届く、特定原材料: 小麦、乳、卵、紅茶は「ジョルジュ・キャノン」の天然香料のブレンド。運営は株式会社かめいあんじゅ。食べログ: スイーツ WEST 百名店 2020・2022・2023・2026、月曜休み (祝日は営業)、36席、1986年11月2日オープン、クレープリー・アルションまで徒歩1分。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 和栗のモンブラン、苺のショートケーキ、Vin Fig のティーソーダ、土曜の昼に28分待ち、急な階段の先のアンティークな空間、アルションセット1,980円、ワンプレートランチ2,500円、紅茶はポットで、夜は海外の客が約8割、持ち帰りの紙袋50円。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site has an English page; many overseas visitors (October 2026); choose cakes from the case or the salon menu.

places.name: ダンケ 心斎橋 (Danke Shinsaibashi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Plain coffee and tea are the safe ground; the food is cakes (chiffon, cheesecake with a cookie base, chocolate cake), toast and sandwiches, all wheat-based as described.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The house blends are all based on the butter-blend beans (the owner, per a September 2026 review), so the coffee itself contains butter; iced tea, Indian leaf tea and avocado juice are the likelier options.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–23:30 (last order 23:00) since 1 November 2021; closed only on New Year's Day (Tabelog; September 2026 review). No reservations; cash only (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 35 seats: 6 at the counter, 29 at tables (Tabelog). The front counter area is non-smoking; a back area of tables allows electronic cigarettes only (September 2026 reviews). Second floor, up a spiral staircase (September 2026 review). Children welcome; takeaway available (Tabelog). Opened 1 November 2010 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Kissaten built around Butter Blend Coffee: beans infused with butter during roasting, paper-dripped one cup at a time, sold under the line "coffee that makes milk unnecessary" (2026 reviews) · Butter Blend Coffee ¥700 (September 2026); stronger versions Strong and Schwarz use two to three times the beans (owner, September 2026) · iced coffee, Wiener coffee, café au lait · iced tea ¥750; tea from leaves imported directly from India (October 2026) · chiffon cake with cream ¥950 (September 2026); cheesecake and coffee set ¥1,400 (September–October 2026); a rich cheesecake from the Ashiya cake shop feu; chocolate cake · pork shabu-shabu sandwich; fig and strained-yogurt toast (September 2026) · avocado juice · feu cookies and coffee beans for sale
places.notes: [Kissaten · Shinsaibashi, late-night butter-blend coffee upstairs] Up a spiral stair to a dim, wood-filled second floor a minute from Shinsaibashi station, a retro coffee house open until 23:30 every day but New Year's Day. The draw is Butter Blend Coffee: the beans take on butter as they roast, then each cup is paper-dripped to order, and the sign promises coffee that needs no milk. Diners find it smooth and mellow rather than buttery (one noticed a faint milky finish); ask for Strong or Schwarz if you want more beans in the cup. The counter is a single slab of Yoshino cedar said to be 200 years old, and the shelves hold Wedgwood and Okura cups; a September 2026 diner got to choose the cup. Pair it with a fluffy chiffon cake, a cheesecake from feu in Ashiya, or a sandwich. One of Tabelog's 100 kissaten (2022, 2026). The back tables allow e-cigarettes. Cash only, no bookings.

roles: Owner (unnamed; "the calm and kind owner" behind the counter, September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 November 2010 (Tabelog). A September 2026 reviewer calls Danke "a popular café established in 1977"; Tabelog's opening date for this shop is 2010, and the earlier date is not explained. Per a September 2026 diner, the owner explained that the house blends differ only in the amount of beans, all based on the Butter Blend. Selected for Tabelog Kissaten "Tabelog 100" in 2022 and 2026. A Tabelog matome article (July 2026) describes the butter-blend method and a retro room behind a heavy wooden door.
chef_bio.specialty: Butter Blend Coffee, paper-dripped per cup; chiffon cake.

anecdotes.text: "The counter features a single slab of Yoshino cedar that is 200 years old, and the shelves are adorned with Wedgwood and Okura porcelain cups." — October 2026.

"When I asked the calm and kind owner about the differences, [the owner] explained that the variations were in the amount of beans used—two to three times more, but all were based on the Butter Blend." — September 2026.
"I visited around 22:30 on a Tuesday. There were about 10 customers inside." — September 2026.

places.name: 焼鳥 サイヒ (Yakitori Saihi)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Many skewers are salted, but some come with tare (a heart with tare, July 2026), the chawanmushi and seasoned rice are made with dashi and seasoning, and the set course leaves little room to choose; ask what can be done with salt only.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken omakase course, with dashi in the chawanmushi; the vegetable skewers (tomato, shiitake, young corn) come within it.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat, one seating at 19:00 (Tabelog lists 19:00–21:30); the course runs about 2.5–3 hours (TableCheck; September 2026 reviews); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservation only, course only, through TableCheck (Tabelog; July and September 2026 reviews); a September 2026 diner booked about a month ahead. 7 counter seats; whole-shop hire for six or more (September 2026 review). Smart-casual dress code (Tabelog). English menu available (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking. Opened 13 December 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Minami-Senba 4-10-22, at the back of the Senba back alley (a renovated old house), easy to walk past — 8 min from Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: One omakase yakitori course a night, changing monthly, with extra skewers after (TableCheck: omakase ¥12,000 tax included, read October 2026; diners report ¥10,000–19,999 with drinks) · three kinds of chicken: Satsuma Gokkei (さつま極鶏) 大摩桜, Ehime chicken, Yamato chicken, plus Himekko jidori (2026 reviews) · examples (May–September 2026): thigh tataki seared over straw and charcoal; breast with vinegared vegetables; skin-on neck (皮付きせせり); negima; chawanmushi of a double chicken soup; liver pâté; pickles and grated daikon to reset the palate; bonjiri, gizzard, heart, wing wrapped round neck meat; chicken tender with plum; tsukune with salt; vegetable skewers such as tomato, shiitake, zucchini and young corn; breast with Shine Muscat and white miso · extra skewers: furisode, cartilage with mayonnaise, wings · to finish, clay-pot rice (eel in July, fresh ginger in September), chicken soup, and a dessert such as pudding, white peach or sweet-potato vanilla ice cream · sake and wine (no champagne or sparkling, per a July 2026 diner), shochu
places.notes: [Yakitori · Minami-Senba, a one-owner omakase counter at the end of an alley] Seven seats at the back of the Senba back alley, in a renovated old house you may walk past more than once, where one woman owner grills, cooks and serves alone, which diners note is rare for yakitori. One seating a night at 19:00, and a course of about 20 plates that runs two and a half to three hours: straw-and-charcoal thigh tataki, skin-on neck, liver pâté, a chawanmushi of double chicken soup, then skewers of three kinds of chicken and seasonal vegetables, pickles to reset, extra skewers if you still have room, and clay-pot rice to finish (eel in July, ginger in September; one diner ate four bowls). The course changes monthly. Diners call the grilling precise and the flavours gentle; one regular says it gets better every visit. A September 2026 diner notes the name is the character 花 (flower) taken apart. On Tabelog's Yakitori WEST 100 list in 2024 and 2025. Book about a month ahead on TableCheck; smart casual; closed Sundays.

roles: Owner and grill master (unnamed; a woman who runs the shop alone, per September 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 13 December 2021 (Tabelog). September 2026 reviews: "The female owner manages everything by herself"; "The owner runs the restaurant solo and provides attentive service with great care." A July 2026 diner: "The owner knows the size, grilling technique, and salt level of every yakitori." Selected for Tabelog Yakitori WEST "Tabelog 100" in 2024 and 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Straw-and-charcoal chicken tataki; skin-on neck; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "Not only was the yakitori delicious, but the clay pot rice to finish off the meal was also amazing! Before I knew it, I had eaten four servings!" — May 2026, first visit.
"Every time I visit, the food gets better." — September 2026, a third visit.
"The character for 'flower' is broken down into 'Saihi.'" — September 2026.

places.name: SUGALABO V
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. The single omakase course includes wheat in several dishes (gougères, tartine, a fried fish course, tagliatelle, mille-feuille, madeleines in 2024–2026 menus) and ends with SUGALABO curry. The listing warns that guests with extensive allergies may be turned down.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a single omakase course built on seafood, wagyu, pork, duck, ham and dairy.
places.hours_raw: Wed–Sun and holidays 17:00–23:00; closed Monday and Tuesday, and on some other days (Tabelog). Reviews give seatings at 17:00 and 19:00 (May 2026) or 17:00 and 20:30 (February 2024); one diner reports a lunch visit (May 2026). Reservation only: some seats are offered to Tabelog members, the booker must attend, and all guests start together; late arrivals may miss courses (Tabelog). Earlier by invitation only; now bookable through OMAKASE (July 2026 review). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 24 seats, no private room (semi-private seating); non-smoking, smoking on the terrace; guests 12 and older eat the adult course; smart casual, no shorts or sandals (Tabelog). Entrance: not through the Louis Vuitton store but a mirrored door on Yahata-suji (with your back to the store, on the left), then the lift to 7F (Tabelog). Opened 1 February 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashi-suji 2-8-16, 7F of Louis Vuitton Maison Osaka Midosuji; separate mirrored door on Yahata-suji — 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: One omakase course built on Japanese produce, each producer named on the menu (from ¥50,000, varying to ¥70,000 with the day's buying, tax included; Tabelog) · Menu V ¥55,000 and a drinks pairing ¥18,000 (May 2026); ¥48,000 in February 2024 · May 2026 course: Funka Bay baby clams in a Kyoto monaka, sakura-shrimp gougère, Osaka eggplant with Mangalitsa pork, 24-month aged ham with SUGALABO rice, aori squid, white asparagus with caviar, sea bream, Choshu wagyu with morels, SUGALABO curry, citrus and mango desserts, madeleines · an October 2026 diner singled out sanma, the ham and a duck main · the SUGALABO curry closes the savoury courses, in a regular or large serving (September 2026) · wine and sake, with a sommelier (Tabelog) · baked sweets to take home
places.notes: [French · Shinsaibashi, Louis Vuitton's restaurant floor] The Osaka outpost of Tokyo's SUGALABO sits on the seventh floor of the Louis Vuitton building on Midosuji, reached by its own mirrored door on the side street and a lift, and is the only Louis Vuitton collaboration restaurant in Japan (Tabelog). An open kitchen and Louis Vuitton-designed furniture, cutlery and trunks frame a single omakase course of Japanese produce, each producer named on the menu and each ingredient introduced at the table before its dish; the savoury run ends with the house curry, in a large serving if you still have room. It has won a Tabelog Bronze award every year from 2021 to 2026. Expect ¥55,000 for the food plus a ¥18,000 pairing and 10% service (May 2026). The executive chef Nagahama cooked a farewell dinner in February 2026; diners in July and September 2026 found the cooking still delicious under the new kitchen, and one was asked mid-course whether smaller portions would suit. Book ahead; dress smart casual.

roles: Creative lead: Yosuke Suga of SUGALABO, Tokyo (My Concierge Japan)
Executive chef until early 2026: Nagahama ("Ryo Nagahama" per My Concierge Japan; "Chef Ryosuke Nagahama" in a February 2026 review)
Current chef unnamed in the sources read (a September 2026 review notes the chef changed)
chef_bio.background: Per My Concierge Japan (undated): Yosuke Suga, "a renowned protégé of the legendary Chef Joël Robuchon", founded SUGALABO in Tokyo in 2015 as a "laboratory"; SUGALABO V opened in 2020 as "the world's first Louis Vuitton-attached café, bar, and restaurant". Its executive chef Nagahama had been an owner-chef in Chablis, Burgundy, planning to open a restaurant back in Japan at 40, and took the role after an offer from Suga. A February 2026 diner describes a farewell "Last Supper" by Nagahama; a July 2026 diner writes of the first visit "since Chef Nagahama's departure". Tabelog Award Bronze 2021–2026; Tabelog French WEST 100 in 2021, 2023 and 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Producers named on the menu, and each ingredient introduced at the table before its dish is served (July 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase course; aged ham with SUGALABO rice; SUGALABO curry.

anecdotes.text: "Moreover, before each dish is served, they introduce each ingredient right in front of you." — July 2026, a second visit, to celebrate a friend's birthday.
"This was my first visit to SUGALABO V since Chef Nagahama's departure. … Once again, the food was delicious." — July 2026, a third visit.
"The portions are quite generous, and the chef even asked if we wanted smaller servings halfway through" — September 2026, a birthday dinner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): SUGALABO V (スガラボヴィー)、フレンチ、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-8-16 ルイ・ヴィトンメゾン 大阪御堂筋 7F、心斎橋駅から徒歩5分、店の入口はルイ・ヴィトンの店舗とは別、Yahata-suji 沿いの鏡の扉からエレベーターで7階へ、水〜日・祝17:00〜23:00、月・火休み、不定休あり、完全予約制 (食べログ会員向けの席あり、予約者本人の来店、一斉スタート、遅刻や途中退席でコースの一部が出ないことも、アレルギーが多い場合は予約を断ることも)、おまかせコース50,000円〜70,000円 (仕入れによる、税込)、サービス料10%、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、24席、半個室あり、貸切20〜50名、禁煙 (テラスで喫煙可)、12歳以上は大人と同じコース、スマートカジュアル推奨、短パン・サンダル不可、ソムリエ、2020年2月1日オープン、日本で唯一のルイ・ヴィトンとのコラボレーションレストラン、東京・Kamiyacho のイノベーティブ「SUGALABO」の料理、ルイ・ヴィトンがデザインした家具。The Tabelog Award 2021〜2026 Bronze、フレンチ WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2025。口コミ(2024年2月〜2026年10月): Menu V 55,000円とペアリング18,000円 (2026年5月)、生産者の名前入りのメニュー、料理の前に食材を見せて説明、締めの SUGALABO カレー (普通と大盛り)、持ち帰りの焼き菓子、以前は紹介制で今は OMAKASE で予約、2026年2月に Nagahama シェフの最後の晩餐、シェフ交代後も料理はおいしいという声 (2026年7月・9月)。

places.name: Bar マスダ (Bar Masuda)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. A cocktail and whisky bar; the food is snacks to go with drinks: peanuts, an assortment of prosciutto and cheese, raisin butter. Nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Most cocktails are spirits, fruit and mixers, and peanuts come as the starter; the food otherwise is prosciutto, cheese and raisin butter.
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00, last order 22:30 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted by phone; give time, party size, name and a mobile number, and a booking is cancelled if you are late without calling (Tabelog). places.cuisine: Cocktail and whisky bar since 1958, on three floors · a cocktail list running to hundreds, classics and house originals ("Masuda Original"; two originals as a set ¥5,500, Tabelog) · originals named in 2026 reviews: Enishi, En, Kurenai Sakura, Sixth Sense, Wave Motion Moscow Mule; the Blue Blazer II poured with fire and the Nitro Fruit March made with liquid nitrogen (October 2026) · fresh-fruit and frozen fruit cocktails, e.g. watermelon with a salt rim (July 2026) · drinks around ¥1,500 each (August 2026) · rare whisky: an Ardbeg Dolce and a Kanosuke tasting set with Madeira (July 2026) · food: Kagoshima black-pork prosciutto (Tabelog), prosciutto and cheese assortment (September 2026), raisin butter (October 2026), peanuts as the starter
places.notes: [Bar · Souemoncho, a cocktail bar since 1958] A brick-fronted bar on the Souemoncho street, steps from the Dotonbori Glico sign, that has poured drinks since 1958 and was named a Tabelog Bar 100 in 2022. The ground floor is an eight-metre solid-wood counter with about ten seats, where several bartenders work in front of you; there are booths on the second floor and a third floor for groups with karaoke. The cocktail list runs to hundreds: tell the bartender what you like and a drink is made to fit, or try house originals like Enishi, a Wave Motion Moscow Mule, the flaming Blue Blazer II or the liquid-nitrogen Nitro Fruit March, whose show had other tables ordering it too (October 2026). Rare whiskies as well. Food is for drinking: peanuts to start, prosciutto (Kagoshima black pork) with cheese, raisin butter. Diners call the master charming and the staff friendly even to bar novices. Cover ¥1,100; drinks about ¥1,500; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: established in 1958, "we have grown alongside the history of Souemoncho", with an 8-meter solid wood counter, a plaster-finished bar and tables for up to 20 on the third floor; a wide range of cocktails including the signature "Masuda Original" and an extensive range of whiskies. Tabelog Bar 100, 2022. Diners mention the master (July, September and October 2026) and a manager (October 2026) behind the counter.
chef_bio.philosophy: Cocktails made to your mood and preferences (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The fire performance of the Blue Blazer II and the liquid nitrogen display of the Nitro Fruit March were so impressive that other customers ended up ordering them as well." — October 2026.
"I ordered watermelon since it's popular here. The fresh watermelon paired perfectly with the salt around the rim of the glass!" — July 2026.
"Even if you're not well-versed in alcohol, the staff will gladly suggest options that suit your preferences" — August 2026.
