places.cuisine: Kissaten since 1951 roasting its own coffee and brewing it by flannel drip (prices from the official site, tax included, read October 2026) · ARABIYA blend ¥650 · single origins ¥860–890 (Brazil, Colombia, Kilimanjaro, Mandheling, Mocha Mattari, Papua New Guinea), Elephant Mountain peaberry ¥1,050 · original iced coffee ¥720, Dutch iced coffee ¥840, coffee float ¥880 · café au lait ¥720 · Arabiya sandwich of ham and egg cooked together and sandwiched in toast ¥1,010 (1.5 times the egg ¥1,210) · toast with jam or butter ¥420, toast with fresh seasonal-fruit jam ¥420, honey toast ¥770 · French toast ¥910 · pizza toast ¥1,010 · pancakes ¥950 · homemade pudding ¥880, homemade coffee jelly ¥880, gâteau chocolat ¥800, cheesecake with caramelised apple ¥830 · boiled egg ¥170 · fresh banana, orange and lemon juices · blend and pudding came to ¥1,530 in October 2026
places.notes: [Kissaten · Namba, a family coffee house since 1951] A coffee house on the short lane between Ebisubashi-suji and Hozenji, marked by a roaster on its signboard, opened in 1951 and now in the hands of the founder's eldest son. Beans are roasted at the company's own roastery in Taisho and brought in daily and brewed through flannel filters made by hand from cloth found in Senba; the house blend is mild and fragrant, made to drink cup after cup. The founder fought customers who called it weak in the age of strong coffee, carved the wooden reliefs on the walls and wrote the slogans; upstairs, the founder's treasures, including the hand-cranked roaster used at the opening, fill a quieter room. Eat the Arabiya sandwich of ham and egg on toast, toast with fresh fruit jam, or the firm, old-style homemade pudding with a blend (¥1,530 together in October 2026). In 2026 diners found it packed, many of them overseas visitors, and were seen off with a friendly "ookini" from the owner.

roles: Second-generation owner, representative director of 有限会社アラビヤコーヒー (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site ("アラビヤ物語", quoting Meets Regional 1998 and 2001 and the 2000 CAFE BOOK): the founder 高坂光明 left life as an elite officer to start in coffee on 9 February 1951, aged 25, and refused to make the coffee stronger for customers who called it thin. The founder had hoped to play professional baseball but was a little short, loved skiing and golf, carved the wooden reliefs in the shop, wrote its slogans, and chose Namba because a dance hall was nearby. The founder's wife was a star player of the women's professional baseball league of about 1950–55, a department-store worker at Sogo Shinsaibashi as well as a player, and met the founder there. The second generation, 明郎, helped in the shop from junior high school: "my father never once told me to take it over, but I took it for granted." A 2001 tribute on the site by the actor 坂東三津五郎 (the tenth of the name) recalls being told of the shop's coffee and Arabiya sandwich by 中村富十郎, eating breakfast there every day during Osaka performances, and playing early-morning baseball with the eldest son 明朗, the same age. The shop marked its 70th year on 9 February 2021 and aims for 100.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Work as hard as you can, but enjoy life" (めいっぱい働き、でも人生は愉しく; official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Flannel-drip house blend roasted in-house; Arabiya sandwich; homemade pudding.

anecdotes.text: "The friendly owner's 'Okinī' as I left the shop was a nice touch." — October 2026, blend coffee and pudding for JPY 1,530.
"The homemade pudding is of the traditional hard type—actually, it has a firmer texture than the usual old-fashioned pudding. It holds its shape even when cut with a spoon." — October 2026.
"What surprised me first upon entering was that most of the customers were foreigners." — October 2026, over an Elephant Mountain.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: アラビヤコーヒー、SINCE 1951、戎橋から南へ二筋目を左、戎橋筋と法善寺を東西に結ぶ中間、焙煎機の看板が目印、1階テーブル4卓16席と奥の予約テーブル最大8名、カウンター7席 (先代がテーブルを改造して作った椅子)、2階には先代からの宝物と開店当時の手回し焙煎機、テーブル4卓16〜20席、毎朝の焙煎、大正区三軒家東の自社の焙煎所から毎日店へ、アラビヤ式熱風焙煎と直火焙煎、月〜金12:00〜18:00、土・日・祝10:00〜19:00、水曜日不定休。アラビヤ物語: 先代の高坂光明がエリート将校から転じて1951年2月9日 (25才) に珈琲の人生を始めた、濃い珈琲の全盛に「薄い」という客とケンカもしばしば、本物至上主義は二代目の明郎へ、ブラジルやコロンビアなど南米の豆を粗めに挽いて船場で探した生地で手作りしたネルでドリップ、プロ野球選手を目指したが背が低めで断念、スキーとゴルフ、店内の木彫りのレリーフは手作りでキャッチコピーも自作、近所のダンスホールが理由で難波に、奥さんは昭和25年〜30年頃の女子プロ野球の花形選手で心斎橋そごうのデパガ兼選手、二代目は中学時代から店でアルバイト、「店を継げなんて親父が言ったことはないけど、継ぐのがあたり前やと思ってた」(Meets Regional 2001年1月号・1998年4月号、2000年 CAFE BOOK)。十代目坂東三津五郎の寄稿 (2001年1月): 中村富十郎からアラビヤのコーヒーとアラビヤサンドを教わり、大阪公演中の朝食は毎日ここ、同い年の長男の明朗さんと早朝野球。2021年2月9日に70周年、100周年を目指す、有限会社アラビヤコーヒー代表取締役 高坂明郎。メニュー (税込): ブレンドコーヒー650円、ストレート860〜890円、エレファントマウンテン・ピーベリー1,050円、アイスコーヒー720円、ダッチコーヒー840円、アラビヤサンド1,010円、トースト390円、ジャムかバターのトースト420円、生ジャムトースト420円、ハニートースト770円、フレンチトースト910円、ピザ風トースト1,010円、ホットケーキ950円、自家製プリン880円、自家製コーヒーゼリー880円、ゆでたまご170円。食べログ: 中央区難波1-6-7、なんば駅14番出口から徒歩2分、予約可、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可、50席 (カウンター7、テーブル43)、禁煙、1951年2月9日オープン、食べログ 喫茶店 百名店 2021・2022・2026。口コミ(2025年12月〜2026年10月): ブレンドとプリンで1,530円、固いプリン、香りのよいブレンド、外で待つ人、海外の客が多い、店主の「おおきに」、生ジャムトーストが売り切れの日も、朝食メニューはなくアラカルト。

places.notes: [Yoshoku · Minami-Senba, a mountain lodge under Midosuji] Down in the basement of an older office building on Midosuji, a wooden mountain-lodge room with a retro, dance-hall feel serves yoshoku that keeps landing on Tabelog's Yoshoku 100 lists. It belongs to the family of 洋食Katsui 山の辺の道, a yoshoku restaurant in Tenri, Nara (katsui1999.com). Lunch is set meals only, with free rice refills, a varied salad and a pork miso soup diners keep praising: head-on fried shrimp with tartare, wagyu grilled with a rich soy seasoning, a sizzling demi-glace hamburg with a poached egg, or the weekday Western-style bento of hamburg, crab cream croquette, shrimp and sashimi. Dinner is à la carte or courses, and one diner, on an eighth visit, came back for the seafood gratin and the Yujiro, cold espresso under milk gelato. Lunch runs ¥2,000–2,800; dinner about ¥6,000–8,000. Book weekend lunches, which fill by noon; weekdays are for children of school age and up.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (katsui1999.com): 洋食Katsui 山の辺の道、御堂筋ロッヂ、柳本駅中食堂 ピクトン、喫茶マウンテンの4店、勝井ファミリー、「お腹の空いた方もお酒を飲みたい方もたくさんのオードブルと洋食でおもてなしいたします」。御堂筋ロッヂ: 大阪市中央区南船場4-3-11 大阪豊田ビル B1F、心斎橋駅3番出口 (御堂筋側)、ランチ水〜金11:00〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)、土・日・祝11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、ディナー水〜土17:00〜21:30 (L.O.21:00)、日・祝17:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、月・火定休 (祝日も休み)、平日は小学生以上、土・日・祝は小学生未満も可 (2021年7月から)。ランチは定食のみ: 洋食弁当 (平日限定15食) 2,000円、ハンバーグステーキ (平日限定) 2,000円、エビフライ3尾2,000円・5尾2,800円、コンビネーション (黒毛和牛網焼きとエビフライ、土日祝限定) 2,800円、黒毛和牛ロース網焼き2,800円、エビフライとクリームコロッケ2,200円、山形豚バラ網焼き2,000円、パワーランチ (黒毛和牛ロース塩焼き) 4,500円。ディナー: 前菜盛り合わせ1,600円、タスマニアサーモンマリネ1,600円、エビフライ2尾1,600円、黒毛和牛ロース網焼き3,000円、黒毛和牛フィレビーフカツレツ4,000円、特製オムライス1,650円、メインディッシュコース4,800円〜10,000円、お土産に黒毛和牛網焼弁当2,500円、ミンチカツサンド2,000円、黒毛和牛フィレカツサンド4,500円、税込。食べログ: 予約可、土日祝のランチは11:30〜と13:30〜の二部制、チャージなし、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、禁煙、ベビーカー不可、テイクアウト、2011年9月19日オープン、食べログ 洋食 百名店 2020・2022・2023、洋食 WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ(2024年10月〜2026年10月): ご飯のおかわり自由、豚汁、梅干し、頭まで食べられるエビフライとタルタル、山椒の香る黒毛和牛の網焼き、鉄板のハンバーグとデミグラスと落とし卵、シーフードグラタン、Yujiro、プリン、ガーリックライス、山小屋のような店内、土曜は正午に満席。

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. places.cuisine: Steak izakaya with natural wine (Tabelog); prices from the Tabelog menu updated 12 July 2026, tax included · signature chunk steak, lean wagyu cut to order from blocks shown at the table, grilled over charcoal in four stages to medium-rare and sliced (allow 30 minutes or more): Hokkaido Kamui beef uchihira ¥154 per 10g (350g ¥5,390, 450g ¥6,930), Kagoshima black wagyu uchihira ¥176 per 10g (280g was ¥4,928 in September 2026), top sirloin ¥220 per 10g and sirloin cap ¥242 per 10g, both limited · salt and pepper only, with more than ten condiments: wasabi, rock salt, Kagoshima sweet soy sauce, yuzu-kosho ponzu, A1 sauce from Okinawa · courses from ¥6,500 with all-you-can-drink, an Oita beef L-bone steak only in the ¥10,500 course (Tabelog) · sides: crispy green peppers ("Paripi") with the butcher's meat miso ¥495, warm butter potato salad ¥495, wagyu tendon with grated daikon and ponzu ¥550, the founding-recipe stew of offal and tendon in red wine and dashi ¥550, wagyu heart sashimi ¥968, white omasum sashimi with chojang ¥858, peperoncino cabbage ¥528, Okinawa mozuku kimchi ¥550, tomato salad of Kumamoto salt tomatoes ¥968 (half ¥748), charcoal-grilled intestine, salt-grilled wagyu heart and sausages ¥968 each · rice ¥418, roast-beef yukhoe bowl ¥1,138, grated-daikon soba to finish ¥968 · reviews add corn tempura ¥480 and tomato kimchi ¥528 (September 2026), mozuku with grated yam (July and October 2026)
places.notes: [Steak izakaya · Namba, chunk steak by the gram] A lively two-floor meat tavern a couple of minutes from Nankai Namba, one of three Genbee shops (with Tenma and Tennoji), named to Tabelog's Steak・Teppanyaki WEST 100 in 2025. The draw is the chunk steak: staff bring blocks of lean wagyu to the table, you choose one by the gram (Hokkaido Kamui beef or Kagoshima black wagyu, or the limited sirloin cap), and it is grilled slowly over charcoal to a juicy medium-rare, shown again before it is sliced, with only salt and pepper so you can play with a tray of condiments from wasabi to Kagoshima sweet soy. Diners call the lean meat tender and light; one with bad teeth found it easy to eat (October 2026). Order the founding-recipe stew of offal in red wine, the crisp green peppers, the tomato salad, and cold soba to finish. A September 2026 solo diner paid about ¥6,700 with 280g of black wagyu, two sides and drinks; that month two repeat visitors noticed new staff, and one of the two prices creeping up. Book for 18:00–20:00; a 5% fee applies after 22:00.

roles: Kitchen and grill staff (unnamed); a cheerful manager mentioned in a September 2026 review
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: Genbee aims to serve "meat dishes that are less likely to cause stomach discomfort the next day", sampled many kinds of beef and settled on Kamui beef for lean flavour and black wagyu for a balance of lean and marbling; the chunk steak is grilled by a four-stage charcoal method of its own. The menu speaks of "our butcher" choosing the tendon and making the meat miso. Branches: Genbee Tenma main store and Genbee Tennoji Abeno (Tabelog). Opened 20 December 2018; Tabelog Steak・Teppanyaki WEST 100 and Hot Restaurant, 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Lean domestic beef, salt and pepper only, and condiments for the guest to vary (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Chunk steak of lean wagyu by the gram; offal stew in red wine.

anecdotes.text: "They showed me the meat before and after grilling. While taking photos of the grilling process, they encouraged me to capture the flames" — July 2026, 470g of Kamui beef after donating blood.
"We ordered the lean cuts of meat grilled as a whole, which received high praise from my wife and daughter, who are not fond of fatty meat." — October 2026, a third visit.
"The grilled meat was so tender that even with my bad teeth, I could enjoy it deliciously." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 源兵衛 なんば店、ステーキ・居酒屋、赤身ステーキ × 居酒屋 × 自然派ワイン、大阪市中央区難波千日前7-15、南海なんば駅から徒歩2分、毎日15:00〜23:30、不定休、12月31日・1月1日休み、2025年3月29日からランチ休止、「2024年12月より22時以降のご来店の方を対象に「深夜利用料として5％」を頂戴しています」、予約可 (18時〜20時に集中、20時以降は取りやすい、10名以上と貸切は電話で)、カード・PayPay 可、65席、個室なし、貸切20〜50名、1・2階禁煙 (喫煙スペースあり)、子ども・ベビーカー可、2018年12月20日オープン、Tenma と Tennoji にも店。名物は塊肉ステーキ (国産和牛の赤身、炭火で4段階に焼くミディアムレア、塩こしょうだけ、10種類以上の薬味)、飲み放題つきコース6,500円から4種、10,500円のコースだけの Oita の牛の L-bone ステーキ。食べログ ステーキ・鉄板焼き WEST 百名店 2025、ホットレストラン 2025。メニュー (2026年7月12日更新、税込): Kamui 牛の uchihira 10gあたり154円、Kagoshima の黒毛和牛の uchihira 10gあたり176円、ほかに限定の部位、ピーマン495円、煮込み550円、ハツ刺し968円、トマトサラダ968円など。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): 焼く前と後に肉を見せてくれる、ふたを開ける演出、2時間制、ハッピーアワーのハイボール、9月に一人で黒毛和牛280g4,928円と2品と飲み物で約6,700円、スタッフが入れ替わり値段も少しずつ上がったという声、やわらかい赤身、締めのそば。

places.name: 乃呂 (Noro)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Much of the menu is breaded or sauced: beef cutlet in fine crumbs, minced cutlet, fried shrimp and oysters, a demi-glace that is the house signature, gratin, savarin and an orange tart. The wagyu grill was born from a yakiniku-style sauce (official site), which usually contains soy sauce and wheat.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yoshoku kitchen of wagyu, tongue, seafood and egg, with a demi-glace built on beef.
places.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 17:30–21:00 (last order 19:30); closed Wednesdays, with occasional other closures, so the shop asks you to phone before coming (official site). Tabelog lists longer hours (lunch to 15:00, dinner from 17:00, last order 20:30); the official site is followed here. Reservations by phone or online (Ikyu, Gurunavi) (official site). Private room at the back of 2F for 5 or more, course orders only (official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 36 seats: 6 at the counter, 30 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Takeout and New Year osechi through the shop's online store (official site). Founded 1958 (official site).

places.cuisine: Yoshoku with French technique, eaten with chopsticks if you like, rice, pickles and red miso soup on the side (official site); prices from the official site, tax included, read November 2026 · lunch plates with bread and soup or rice and red miso soup: Noro-style hamburg steak ¥3,850 (bubbling in a clay pot under a demi-glace and tomato sauce with a soft-boiled egg; ¥3,300 in September–December 2025), minced cutlet ¥3,850, fried shrimp ¥3,850, fried oysters (autumn and winter) ¥3,850, bite-size wagyu cutlet ¥4,400, wagyu loin grill ¥4,950, tongue stew ¥4,950, beef stew ¥4,950, wagyu fillet beef cutlet ¥6,050 · lunch mini-kaiseki course ¥6,050 · monthly Noro-style kaiseki course, lunch or dinner, priced by the main: hamburg ¥8,800, beef or tongue stew ¥9,900, wagyu grill ¥12,100, fillet tataki or beef cutlet ¥13,750, black-wagyu steak 120g ¥19,800 (November 2026: foie gras terrine, octopus simmered pink (sakura-ni) in soy-based dashi, chowder, oyster gratin, persimmon salad, granita) · à la carte: hors d'oeuvre platter ¥2,200, house wagyu grill ¥4,950, beef stew ¥4,950, fillet beef cutlet ¥6,050, live kuruma prawn fry ¥6,600, black-wagyu fillet steak 150g ¥14,300, rice with pickles and red miso ¥1,320 · desserts: savarin, orange tart
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a Suocho grill since 1958] A grown-up Western-style restaurant on Suocho, the street once called Europe-dori, opened in 1958 as Grill Noro by 野呂伸一, who came from the renowned Higobashi Western-cuisine house アラスカ, and now run by the second generation, 野呂太一. The founder cooked without a menu or recipes, and the house wagyu grill was born when a regular wanted a change and the founder grilled beef in the yakiniku sauce made for the family. The demi-glace, made light by skimming away the fat over two weeks, carries the beef and tongue stews; the hamburg comes bubbling in an engraved clay pot under a half-demi, half-tomato sauce with a soft-boiled egg to break into it. Eat it with chopsticks, rice and red miso soup if you like. Lunch plates run ¥3,850–6,050 (the hamburg was ¥3,300 in 2025); the monthly Noro-style kaiseki course, French technique with the seasons, starts at ¥8,800. Diners praise the calm second floor and attentive service; one found the hamburg good but not worth ¥3,300 (December 2025).

roles: Owner (店主) and second-generation chef (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, quoting あまから手帖's 2010 book 大阪名店の凄み: the founder 野呂伸一 came from the Western-cuisine house アラスカ in Higobashi and opened on Suocho in 1958 (as グリル乃呂, per the greeting on the site). The founder kept no menu and left no recipes, cooking whatever customers asked for; around the time of the Osaka Expo thick steaks sold best, and when a regular asked for something different, the founder grilled beef in the yakiniku sauce prepared for the family, creating the standing "牛肉の網焼き". "My father always told me to make food that is light yet rich," says the second generation, 太一; the demi-glace is skimmed of fat and cooked with vegetables for two weeks, and the founder, late in life, insisted on a horsehair strainer rather than a metal one to keep it smooth. The monthly 乃呂風懐石, adding French technique to bring the seasons into yoshoku, is 太一's creation. Media listed on the site: Louis Vuitton City Guide Osaka, Japanese edition (April 2025); a 2020 book by the novelist 伊集院静 on the shops the author loved; 家庭画報 December 2020 (tongue stew to order in); あまから手帖 March 2020 (the demi-glace). Tabelog Yoshoku WEST 100, 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Make food that is light yet rich" (the founder, as quoted by 太一 on the official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Noro-style hamburg steak; beef and tongue stew; wagyu grill; beef cutlet.

anecdotes.text: "I discovered a soft-boiled egg halfway through, a delightful surprise! Mixing it in made it even better!" — September 2025, Noro-style hamburg steak ¥3,300 on a quiet Sunday afternoon.
"I felt a sense of affection for the clay pot with the engraved letters on the hamburg steak." — September 2025.
"The sauce was rich yet not overwhelming, making it easy to enjoy with rice, so I even asked for a refill." — October 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (レストラン乃呂): 1958年に先代の野呂伸一が心斎橋周防町に『グリル乃呂』を創業、約65年、店主 野呂太一、LOUIS VUITTON シティ･ガイド 大阪 日本語版 (2025年4月発行) に掲載、ランチ11:30〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)、ディナー17:30〜21:00 (L.O.19:30)、毎週水曜定休・臨時休業あり、来店前に電話を、予約は電話か Web (一休、ぐるなび)、2階奥の個室は5名から・コース料理のみ、おせちとテイクアウト。紹介 (あまから手帖 別冊「大阪名店の凄み」2010年より): 初代・野呂伸一は肥後橋の西洋料理の名門『アラスカ』出身、メニューもレシピもなく客の要望で何でも作った、大阪万博のころは厚いステーキ、常連に違うものをと言われ家族用の焼肉のタレで肉を焼いて出したのが定番「牛肉の網焼き」の始まり、「さっぱりとしていて、コクのある料理を作れというのが父の口癖でした」と二代目の太一、脂を取り除き野菜の旨みを加えて2週間かけるデミグラスソース、初代は馬の毛の毛漉しを使うよう命じた、細かく薄いパン粉のビーフカツレツとトマトソース、デミとトマトを半々にしたソースと半熟の黄身の特製ハンバーグステーキ、お箸、ご飯、香の物、赤だし、頼めばウスターソース、二代目の月替わりの「乃呂風懐石」。メニュー (税込): ハンバーグ乃呂風3,850円、メンチカツ3,850円、海老フライ3,850円、牡蠣フライ (秋冬) 3,850円、和牛一口カツ4,400円、和牛ロース網焼き4,950円、タンシチュー4,950円、ビーフシチュー4,950円、和牛フィレビーフカツ6,050円、お昼のミニ会席コース6,050円、乃呂風懐石コース8,800円〜19,800円 (11月はフォアグラのテリーヌ、蛸の桜煮、チャウダースープ、牡蠣のグラタン、柿のサラダ、グラニテ)、アラカルトのオードブル盛合せ2,200円、活 車海老のフライ6,600円、黒毛和牛フィレステーキ150g14,300円、デザートのサヴァランとオレンジのタルト。メディア: 伊集院静の本 (2020年)、家庭画報2020年12月号、あまから手帖2020年3月号。食べログ: 東心斎橋1-16-10、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、36席 (カウンター6、テーブル30)、個室あり、禁煙、洋食 WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年9月): 土鍋のハンバーグとシチュー、半熟卵、2025年は3,300円・2026年5月は3,850円、2階の落ち着いた席、ていねいなサービス、値段に見合わないという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Japanese-only official menu; chopsticks, rice and red miso soup available (official site). No English evidence found.

places.name: 法善寺横丁 やき然 (Hozenji Yokocho Yakizen)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: okonomiyaki, negiyaki, yakisoba and the Yokocho-yaki (double the batter) are all built on a wheat-flour batter or wheat noodles, finished with sauce; no gluten-free option described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the okonomiyaki are filled with pork, squid, beef tendon or shrimp, a diner praised the flavourful dashi (September 2026), and the doteyaki is beef tendon.
places.hours_raw: Daily except Wednesday: 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:15) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed every Wednesday for the time being, opening when Wednesday is a holiday and closing the Thursday after instead (official site). Tabelog gives a weekday lunch closing of 14:00 and last seating at about 13:15–13:30 on weekdays, about 14:00 at weekends and about 21:00 in the evening (machine-translated there as "guided tours will end"). Reservations accepted; give a mobile number, and a booking may be cancelled if you are more than 15 minutes late (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 28 seats: 13 at the 1F counter (no teppan), and 2F tables with teppan; parties up to 8; non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). Opened 30 November 2003 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Namba 1-1-18, inside Hozenji Yokocho — 4 min from Namba Stn exit 14
places.cuisine: Okonomiyaki and teppanyaki in Hozenji Yokocho (Tabelog) · okonomiyaki grilled slowly for 15–20 minutes, with domestic pork, squid and beef tendon, hand-cut cabbage and green onion, and a house sauce refined over 20 years (Tabelog) · the famous Modan-yaki with pork, squid and noodles ¥1,750 and negiyaki with beef tendon ¥1,720 (August 2026) · on the English menu: pork, squid, beef tendon, shrimp, cheese and mochi okonomiyaki, shrimp and cheese in shiso, Hozenji okonomiyaki with pork, squid, shrimp and scallops; negiyaki in the house soy blend; yakisoba and salt yakisoba, a yakisoba omelet (large serving +¥260) · the Yokocho-yaki, the owner's bite-size idea with double the batter, crisp outside and chewy, good even cold and sold to take away · doteyaki of domestic beef tendon simmered about two hours in Saikyo white miso (Tabelog) · teppan dishes: beef tendon with green onion and ponzu, yam steak, squid legs, tonpei-yaki, shrimp, scallops and mushrooms in butter; skewers, chilled tofu salad, yuzu sherbet · a Mentaiko Cheese W (double mentaiko) okonomiyaki appeared in October 2026 · bottle beer ¥800 (August 2026) · the house sauce sold in 180ml bottles
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Hozenji Yokocho, a Tabelog 100 regular] An okonomiyaki house in the flagstoned Hozenji Yokocho, open since 2003 and named a Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100 four times (2018, 2019, 2022, 2024). Each okonomiyaki is grilled slowly for 15 to 20 minutes, crisp outside and fluffy inside, from domestic pork, squid and beef tendon, hand-cut cabbage and a house sauce refined over twenty years; the famous one is the Modan-yaki with noodles (¥1,750, August 2026). Sit at the wooden counter downstairs to watch it cooked, or at the teppan tables upstairs. Try the negiyaki with beef tendon in soy, the sweet-mild doteyaki stewed in Saikyo white miso, and the Yokocho-yaki, the owner's bite-size double-batter snack. Menus come in English, Chinese and Korean, and many 2026 diners shared the room with overseas visitors. Most found it delicious and the owner easy to talk to; one found the flavours bland and the staff curt, another merely average (September and October 2026). Book ahead; closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: opened 30 November 2003; the okonomiyaki is cooked slowly over low heat and finished with a homemade sauce "perfected over 20 years"; the Yokocho-yaki was "born from the owner's playful spirit". Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100 in 2018, 2019, 2022 and 2024. The official site, in Osaka dialect, describes a batter that is not floury and stays moist and chewy even cold, finished with a secret sauce, and an old-fashioned okonomiyaki that is "simple and delicious, a nostalgic Osaka taste". The Yokocho-yaki is sold through the Takashimaya online store (linked from the site). A September 2026 diner found the owner easy to talk to.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Come and eat lots of good food, nice and relaxed" (おいしいもんぎょうさん食べに来てや; official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Modan-yaki; negiyaki with beef tendon; doteyaki; Yokocho-yaki.

anecdotes.text: "My absolute favorite here is the Sugi Negi-yaki, which is flavored with soy sauce and includes beef tendon." — August 2026.
"Even though it was a holiday, the place was nearly full just 20 minutes after opening" — September 2026, Yokocho-yaki and suji-yaki at the 1F counter.
"The owner was easy to talk to, and I definitely want to come back!" — September 2026, Modan-yaki, salt yakisoba and doteyaki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: お好み焼き・鉄板焼き、大阪・ミナミのど真ん中、和気あいあいの法善寺横丁、「美味しいもんぎょうさん作るんでほっこりと食べに来てや〜」、名物「モダン焼き」、ねぎ焼き、塩焼きそば、焼きそば、どて焼き、横丁焼、粉っぽくなく冷めてもしっとりもっちりの特製生地と秘伝のソース、「昔ながらのお好み焼き」懐かしい大阪の味、全28席、11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:15)、17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、当面の間毎週水曜定休 (祝日なら営業、木曜に振替休業)、メニューは日本語・英語・中国語・韓国語の PDF、高島屋オンラインストアで横丁焼を販売。食べログ (店舗会員): 中央区難波1-1-18、なんば駅14番出口から徒歩4分、予約可 (当日連絡のつく携帯番号、15分以上の遅れは取り消すことも)、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、28席 (カウンター13、4人テーブル3、3人テーブル1)、1階は鉄板のないカウンター、2階は鉄板のテーブル、最大8名、禁煙、子ども可、テイクアウト、2003年11月30日オープン、お好み焼き 百名店 2018・2019・2022・2024。15〜20分かけて焼く、国産の豚・イカ・すじ、手切りのキャベツとねぎ、20年かけた自家製ソース、Saikyo の白みそで約2時間煮る国産牛すじのどて焼き、店主の遊び心から生まれた横丁焼 (生地は倍)。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): モダン焼き1,750円、すじ入りのねぎ焼き1,720円、瓶ビール800円、醤油味のすじ入りのねぎ焼き、豚のお好み焼き、塩焼きそば、きゅうり入りのどて焼き、10月の新メニューの Mentaiko Cheese W、話しやすい店主、海外の客が多い、味が薄くスタッフの対応が悪かったという声、普通という声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in Japanese, English, Chinese and Korean on the official site; many overseas diners (2026).

places.name: おかる (Okaru)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: okonomiyaki, yakisoba, yaki udon and akashiyaki are all wheat batter or wheat noodles, finished with sauce; the menu also has kushikatsu. No gluten-free option described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an egg-rich batter (September 2026) with pork, minced meat, squid, shrimp or octopus, and a yakisoba that tastes of dashi and soy (August 2026).
places.hours_raw: 12:00–14:30 and 17:00–21:30; closed Thursday; hours may change, so check before visiting (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); a queue forms before the noon opening, and one diner waited about 50 minutes on a Saturday after 17:00 (September 2026). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; July and September 2026). 50 seats at tables with teppan; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sennichimae 1-9-19 — 4 min from Nihonbashi Stn exit 2 or Namba Stn exit 15A
places.cuisine: Okonomiyaki, yakisoba and akashiyaki, all cooked at your table by the staff (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · okonomiyaki mixed in the shop's own way, spread, flipped and steamed under a lid, fluffy and yellow with egg, a little yam in the batter; a slightly sweet house sauce, with a thinner sauce on the table (2026 reviews) · choice of pork, minced meat, squid, shrimp or octopus, a special with two fillings of your choice, oysters in winter, and modern-yaki with noodles (Tabelog menu, 2016) · special okonomiyaki ¥1,600 and squid ¥1,000 (July 2026); both okonomiyaki and yakisoba now four-digit prices (August 2026) · Dotonbori yakisoba with thick noodles, tasting of dashi and soy (August 2026); yaki udon · finished with sauce, aonori, bonito flakes and a mayonnaise picture drawn to order · sides: akashiyaki, grilled squid, yakitori, kushikatsu, rice balls with miso soup, nori chazuke · a set of rice, miso soup and pickles to go with it · fruit sherbets · bottled Coke and orange juice ¥300 (July 2026)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Sennichimae, mayonnaise pictures] A back-street okonomiyaki house in Sennichimae, named a Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100 in 2018 and 2019, where you never touch the spatula: staff cook everything on the teppan at your table, pressing and steaming the okonomiyaki under a lid until it is fluffy and bright yellow with egg, then finish it with sauce, bonito and a mayonnaise picture to order: Osaka Castle, Tsutenkaku, Hello Kitty or Myakumyaku. Tabelog's write-up credits the previous owner with switching from aluminium to stainless-steel spatulas ordered from Doguya-suji. Choose two fillings for the special (¥1,600 in July 2026), add Dotonbori yakisoba with thick noodles and some akashiyaki, and a set of rice and miso soup if you eat Kansai style. A September 2026 diner laughed all through the banter of the Kansai-style staff member who cooked, while another found the turnover slow and the taste disappointing after a 50-minute wait (September 2026). Many guests were from overseas (June 2026). No reservations; queue before noon; cash only; closed Thursdays.

roles: Table-side staff who cook for each table (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing's write-up (machine-translated): semi-private teppan tables, an Osaka-dialect-speaking lady who appears at the table, and okonomiyaki finished with mayonnaise drawings; "the previous owner pioneered the use of stainless steel spatulas, ordering them from a hardware store in Dōguya-suji (previously, they used aluminum), establishing the method of pressing and steaming". Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100 in 2018 and 2019.
chef_bio.specialty: Okonomiyaki with mayonnaise pictures; Dotonbori yakisoba; akashiyaki.

anecdotes.text: "I requested a design of Myakumyaku, and it turned out beautifully. … The Korean couple next to us had a Hello Kitty design and were absolutely thrilled." — June 2026, the house special.
"As a secret strategy, I decided to line up at 'Okaru,' which opens at noon, starting from 11:30 AM." — September 2026, pork and shrimp okonomiyaki.
"At the end, they decorated it with sauce, aonori (seaweed), katsuobushi (dried bonito flakes), and mayonnaise, creating a design of the Tsutenkaku Tower." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おかる、お好み焼き・焼きそば・明石焼き、大阪市中央区千日前1-9-19、日本橋駅2番出口・なんば駅15A出口から徒歩4分、12:00〜14:30、17:00〜21:30、木曜定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、50席 (テーブル)、禁煙、子ども可、お好み焼き 百名店 2018・2019。店の紹介 (英訳): 半個室の鉄板のテーブル、大阪弁の女性、マヨネーズで絵を描くお好み焼き、先代が Doguya-suji の金物屋にステンレスのコテを注文した (それまではアルミ)、押さえて蒸す焼き方。メニュー (2016年更新): 豚、肉 (ミンチ)、イカ、えび、タコ、冬はカキ、2種を選ぶスペシャル、モダン焼き、焼きそばと焼きうどん、イカの塩焼き、焼き鳥、串カツ、明石焼き、おにぎり、のり茶漬け、定食 (ご飯、漬物、みそ汁)、シャーベット。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): スタッフが席で焼いてくれる、ふたをして蒸す、ふわふわで卵たっぷり、山芋、甘めのソースとテーブルのさらっとしたソース、マヨネーズで Osaka Castle・Tsutenkaku・Hello Kitty・Myakumyaku・「Osaka」、スペシャル1,600円、イカ1,000円、瓶のコーラとオレンジ300円、太麺でだしと醤油の味の Dotonbori yakisoba、明石焼き、現金のみ、開店前の行列、土曜夕方に50分待ち、海外の客が多い、「おおきに」。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff cook everything at the table, so there is little to order beyond fillings; many overseas guests (June 2026). No English menu evidence found.

places.name: Le Premier Cafe 心斎橋本店 (Le Premier Cafe Shinsaibashi honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The food is toast, sandwiches, hot dogs and cakes (cheesecakes, chocolate cake, pound cake, a pudding cake), all likely wheat; black coffee itself is simply coffee, but nothing is stated.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Black drip and iced coffee may suit; most arranged drinks use milk or cream, and the food uses egg, bacon, ham, cheese and butter. Nothing is described as vegan.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Thu and Sun 10:00–23:30; Fri and Sat 10:00–24:00; last order 30 minutes before closing; the first Thursday of each month opens at 12:00 (official site; Tabelog gives the same hours and adds public holidays to the 23:30 days). Breakfast menu: Tabelog says weekends and holidays 10:00–11:30; an October 2026 diner had the morning set on a weekday, ¥200–550 added to the drink. No reservations; up to 90 minutes when busy (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money, PayPay and au PAY (Tabelog). 27 seats, 12 at the counter, plus sofa seats; non-smoking since 2012; free Wi-Fi; takeout (Tabelog; official site). No black tea (Tabelog); a "juice of the day" for those who cannot drink coffee (official menu).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashi-suji 1-3-28, 3F of ビギ1stビル — 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: Specialty-coffee kissa roasting its own beans: two blends and about ten single origins at any time (official site) · Strong Blend ¥750 (October 2026); drip coffee ¥850, café mocha ¥850 (October 2026); decaf on offer (Ethiopia, October 2026) · arranged coffees: coffee with brandy and Kahlúa ¥1,300, Irish coffee ¥1,200, hot milk coffee with honey ¥950, cappuccino-style caramel milk coffee ¥900, iced coffee with vanilla ice cream and cream ¥900, café au lait topped with thick cream ¥900, café au lait ¥800, iced coffee strong or mild from ¥720, coffee jelly in summer ¥980 (official menu) · toast ¥320, honey toast ¥680, hot-pressed sandwich ¥700, hot dog or teriyaki-chicken dog ¥750, egg-and-bacon sandwich ¥950, club sandwich ¥1,100 (official menu) · cake set: drink + ¥600, cake alone ¥800 — baked or rare cheesecake, chocolate cake, dark-rum-and-raisin pound cake, a pudding cake made with plenty of free-range Koshu eggs; two half slices allowed (official menu) · weekend and holiday breakfast with a grilled egg sandwich (Tabelog; October 2026)
places.notes: [Kissa · Shinsaibashi, a coffee bar for after dinner, open to midnight] A wood-panelled third-floor coffee room just off the Shinsaibashi shopping street, opened in 1997 by an owner who, per the shop's own history, does not take to alcohol but loves coffee, and wanted a bar-like place to linger over a good cup after dinner. It moved to this building in 2002, dropped black tea and juices in 2006 to serve coffee only, went non-smoking in 2012 and began roasting its own beans in 2014; there are now two blends and about ten single origins, plus decaf. It is a Tabelog Kissaten 100 shop (2022 and 2026). The shop says the room fills late with people who want a coffee to close a night of eating and drinking. Order a Strong Blend (¥750 in October 2026) or an arranged drink such as an Irish coffee, with a slice from the cake set: diners in October 2026 liked a firm rare cheesecake with a hint of cinnamon and the caramel pudding cake. Mornings bring a grilled egg sandwich set. Cups differ from guest to guest. One diner, finding it loud with young groups at 10 pm on a Saturday, suggested a weekday afternoon instead.

roles: Founder; representative director of 株式会社Keep running, which runs the three Le Premier Cafe shops (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official greeting, the founder did not drink coffee at all, applied for a part-time job at a coffee chain only because the hourly wage was high, came to need coffee every day, and opened Le Premier Cafe in September 1997 to make a space where coffee would lift people's spirits. Shop history (official site): opened 5 September 1997 in a tucked-away ground-floor spot near Shinsaibashi; moved to the third floor of ビギ1stビル in July 2002; coffee-only from January 2006; non-smoking from 2012; own roasting from 2014 on a small Fuji Royal Discovery roaster; Le Premier Cafe Roastery, a stand and roasting works in 湊町, Namba, from September 2017 with a 12 kg Probat; a shop on Awaji Island, in the ei-to complex, from December 2023. Incorporated as 株式会社Keep running on 1 February 2022; seven staff including part-timers (company page). The founder loves the Hanshin Tigers and watching combat sports, ran ultramarathons and ultra-trail races through the forties, and still runs in Osaka Castle Park (official greeting and staff pages). A March 2026 diner mentions an energetic owner.
chef_bio.philosophy: "To deliver a cup that life cannot do without" (人生になくてはならない一杯を届けたい); motto: always smiling, bright and cheerful, facing forward whatever happens, grateful for everything (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Self-roasted specialty coffee; Strong Blend; cake set.

anecdotes.text: "It might have been over 20 years since I last visited… The Strong Blend for JPY 750 was so good that I could really savor it after such a long time." — October 2026.
"The flavor was pleasantly bitter yet refreshing, making it easy to drink. I was able to relax and take my time, even when alone." — October 2026, Strong Blend.
"This time I came on a Saturday around 10 PM, and it was quite noisy with many young people… This place might be better suited for a weekday afternoon visit." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 株式会社Keep running が運営、代表取締役 税所 孝広、1997年9月5日ル プルミエ カフェオープン、お酒が苦手で珈琲が大好きなオーナーが食事のあとにバーのような空間でゆっくり珈琲を飲める店をと開業、2002年7月に現在のビギ1stビル 3階へ移転、2006年1月に紅茶やジュース等を廃止し珈琲のみに、2012年全席禁煙、2014年自家焙煎スタート (フジローヤルのディスカバリー)、2017年9月に難波・湊町のルネッサ難波ビル1Fにロースタリー (プロバット12kg釜)、2023年12月に淡路島の ei-to 内に出店、現在3店舗。代表挨拶: 珈琲をまったく飲まなかったが時給が高いという理由でコーヒーチェーンのアルバイトに、毎日飲むうちに欠かせないものに、阪神タイガースと格闘技 (見る方)、40代はウルトラマラソンとウルトラトレイル、いまも大阪城公園を走る。会社概要: 2022年2月1日法人化、従業員7名 (アルバイト含む)。心斎橋本店: 心斎橋筋1-3-28 ビギ1stビル 3F、月〜木・日10:00〜23:30、金・土10:00〜24:00、毎月第一木曜は12時から、L.O.は閉店30分前、全席禁煙、夜遅くまで珈琲が飲める心斎橋の少し落ち着いた空間、食事や飲みのあとの締めに。メニュー: ブレンド2種類とシングルオリジン10種類程度、カフェスペルべ1,300円、アイリッシュコーヒー1,200円、コーヒーゼリー (夏季限定) 980円、ハニーカフェコンレーチェ950円、カフェ・モカ850円、ウィンナー・コーヒー850円、カフェ・オ・レ800円、濃いめのアイスコーヒー750円、本日のジュース840円、トースト320円、はちみつトースト680円、ホットプレスサンド700円、ホットドッグ750円、たまごとベーコンのサンドウィッチ950円、クラブハウスサンドウィッチ1,100円、ケーキセットはお飲み物代金+600円 (ケーキのみ800円)、甲州放牧自然卵のプリンのケーキなど5種、半分ずつ2種も可。食べログ: 喫茶店 百名店 2022・2026、27席 (カウンター12)、予約不可、混雑時90分制、紅茶なし、カード・電子マネー・QR可、Wi-Fi、土日祝はモーニング10:00〜11:30。口コミ(2026年3月〜10月): ストロングブレンド750円、デカフェ、レアチーズケーキにシナモン、プリンのケーキ、コーヒーゼリー、モーニングは飲み物代+200〜550円、カップは一人ずつ違う、土曜22時は若い人でにぎやか。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter, table and sofa seats; quiet by day, busy late on weekends (2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: オーパス ワン (Opus One)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses end with fried rice, soup noodles or zongzi, and the dishes diners name include sweet-and-sour pork, kara-age, mapo tofu, shrimp chili and braised shark fin (2026 reviews); nothing is stated about wheat or soy sauce. Every course page asks diners to state allergies.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Cantonese seafood kitchen whose courses are built on shark fin, crab, abalone and Ise lobster; nothing is described as vegan.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Monday and the third Tuesday of each month (Tabelog). The lunch course can be booked for 12:00–14:30, 90 minutes at the table; the other courses run 2 hours (Tabelog course pages). Reservations accepted, online through Tabelog or by phone; a September 2026 diner found solo bookings are now allowed; in October 2026 a friend phoned after a Bunraku performance and got a table. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), QUICPay and QR payments including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 34 seats: 26 at tables, 8 at the counter; whole-restaurant hire; non-smoking; takeout (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kozu 3-3-29, ground floor of プレステージ高津 — 5 min from Nipponbashi Stn exit 8 (Sennichimae Line); "tucked away just past Kuromon Market" (October 2026 review)
places.cuisine: Cantonese seafood with an open kitchen (Retty), as courses or à la carte · courses, tax included (Tabelog, 2026): Lunch Course ¥5,500 (appetizers, three omakase dishes, a rice dish, dessert); Shiro Midori ¥8,690 (adds shark fin soup); Hekigyoku ¥12,540 (crab and abalone, four omakase dishes); Moegi ¥15,840 (braised shark fin); Mokuran ¥21,340 (crab, abalone and Ise lobster) — each ends with a choice of fried rice, soup noodles or zongzi (粽子 on the Chinese-language Tabelog page), then dessert · signature: Chinese-style sea bream sashimi, served as a salad with coriander (October 2026) · à la carte examples (September 2026): clams marinated in Shaoxing wine, cucumber with jellyfish or with wood ear, stone bream sashimi, bird's nest soup, braised shark fin, tenderloin steak, boiled lettuce, sweet-and-sour pork, kara-age, mapo tofu, fried rice, shrimp with noodles · shrimp chili, blue crab, abalone (2026) · beer, sake, shochu, wine, jar-drawn (kame-dashi) Shaoxing wine
places.notes: [Chinese · Kozu near Kuromon Market, a Cantonese seafood counter for courses] A Cantonese restaurant tucked away just past Kuromon Market, where you can watch the flames and fresh fish in the open kitchen (Retty) from an eight-seat counter or sit at one of the tables. It has been a Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 pick in 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026. Diners praise a light, refined touch unusual for Chinese food, with ingredients that taste of themselves; the dish diners single out is the recommended Chinese-style sashimi of sea bream with coriander, served like a salad, one October 2026 diner's best ever. Lunch is a ¥5,500 course; dinner courses climb from ¥8,690 to ¥21,340 with shark fin, crab, abalone and Ise lobster, and à la carte works too: a diner on a third visit ordered shark fin, sweet-and-sour pork and fried rice among favourites. One diner wished the dishes had been explained; another found the ¥15,840 Moegi course somewhat average for its price. The sign out front sparkles enough that one diner joked about a love hotel.

roles: Kitchen team (unnamed in every source read)
chef_bio.background: A Cantonese restaurant with an open kitchen where flames rise and fresh fish is cooked as diners watch (Retty shop introduction). A Retty review posted March 2023 calls it a long-established Chinese restaurant in Kozu (高津にある老舗中華料理屋) that put stone-bream sashimi on its menu decades ago, ahead of others, preparing it in front of guests. Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 in 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026. Diners describe staff who adapted the pace for a rushed lunch (October 2026); one diner wished the course dishes had been described (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Chinese-style sea bream sashimi with coriander; braised shark fin; seafood courses.

anecdotes.text: "The appetizer, a Chinese-style sashimi, was the best I've ever had! The cilantro added an ethnic flavor, and the smooth texture of the sea bream was exceptional." — October 2026, lunch course.
"The dishes were relatively light and had a refined taste." — September 2026, à la carte, with kame-dashi Shaoxing wine.
"The entrance sign sparkled, and I couldn't help but think it looked a bit like a love hotel sign, haha." — September 2026, ¥15,840 dinner course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): オーパス ワン、中華料理、大阪市中央区高津3-3-29 プレステージ高津 1F、日本橋駅8番出口から徒歩5分、火〜日12:00〜14:00・17:00〜22:00、月曜と毎月第3火曜休み、予約可、カード・QUICPay・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay など) 可、34席 (テーブル26、カウンター8)、貸切可、禁煙、テイクアウト、食べログ 中国料理 WEST 百名店 2021・2023・2024・2026。コース (税込): ランチコース5,500円 (前菜、おまかせ3品、ご飯もの、デザート、12:00〜14:30、90分)、Shiro Midori 8,690円 (フカヒレスープ)、Hekigyoku 12,540円 (蟹と鮑、おまかせ4品)、Moegi 15,840円 (フカヒレの姿煮)、Mokuran 21,340円 (蟹、鮑、Ise lobster)、ご飯もの (中国語版の食べログでは粽子、炒飯、湯麵から一品)、アレルギーは要相談。Retty: 炎があがり、新鮮な魚が調理される厨房をみながら食事を楽しめる広東料理屋、ジャンル 中華・広東料理、2023年3月投稿の口コミで高津にある老舗中華料理屋、石鯛の造りを何十年も前から先駆者的にメニューに取り入れて客の前でパフォーマンスしてた。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 香菜を添えたサラダ仕立ての鯛の中華風 sashimi、紹興酒漬けの貝、クラゲとキュウリ、燕の巣のスープ、フカヒレの姿煮、酢豚、kara-age、麻婆豆腐、炒飯、海老チリ、蟹、鮑、あっさり上品な味、一人でも予約できるように、料理の説明がほしかったという声、黒門市場を過ぎたところ。

staff_allergy_handling: Each Tabelog course page asks diners to state allergies.

places.name: 肉匠なか田 本店 (Nikushou Nakata Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Much of the meat is meant for the salts, but courses also have sauce-marinated cuts, wagyu sukiyaki, curry or dan dan noodles to finish and desserts; the dipping options include soy sauce and ponzu (December 2025 review).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant; the grilled vegetables and bagna càuda come within meat courses.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–23:00; last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30, courses 21:00; closed Monday (Tuesday when Monday is a holiday) and over New Year (Tabelog; official site). Reservations online through Tabelog or by phone; no same-day online bookings after 16:00; a full course charge, or ¥11,000 per person for a seat-only booking, for same-day cancellations; overseas guests must answer a confirmation email or the booking is cancelled (Tabelog). 2-hour seating; no children under 10 (Tabelog; official site). Service charge 10%, appetizer charge ¥550 per person, private room ¥3,300 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 34 seats: an 8-seat counter at an open kitchen, tables for 4, 4 and 6, a private room for 2 to 5 (official site; Tabelog says for 4); non-smoking since April 2025; English menu (official site; Tabelog). Opened 7 March 2001 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Namba 1-7-16, 5F of 現代こいさんビル — 1 min from Namba Stn exit 14; "a little east of the Dotonbori area, past the Harishige on Mido-suji" (September 2024 review)
places.cuisine: Charcoal yakiniku of A5 black wagyu, the loin cuts aged 21 or 35 days (official site), grilled over binchotan by the staff (Tabelog) and eaten with seven salts chosen each day from 32 natural salts (official site) · courses, tax included (official site, read October 2026): 35-day aged meat course ¥13,200; Special Filet (hire) course ¥16,800; Special Chateaubriand course ¥19,800 — each with assorted appetizers, the trademarked Toro-tan, salt-grilled cuts, seasonal grilled and fresh vegetables, wagyu sukiyaki, aged sirloin or rib roast, a rice dish and dessert; a yakiniku-only version without sukiyaki can be booked ahead (Tabelog) · à la carte (Tabelog menu, May 2024): Toro tongue ¥5,500; thin-sliced toro tongue ¥5,500; special tenderloin ¥9,800; special Chateaubriand ¥12,800; aged strip loin or Spencer roll ¥9,800; kakumaku (skirt) ¥3,850; special kalbi ¥3,850; special thigh ¥3,460 · wagyu tail slices, bagna càuda with vegetables, oni-oroshi with ponzu, beef-tendon curry, wagyu sushi, beef ochazuke (2022–2025 reviews) · finishes such as homemade curry or dan dan noodles and desserts like chestnut Mont Blanc (2026) · wine, sake, shochu, cocktails
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Namba, aged A5 wagyu grilled for you over charcoal, with seven salts] A dim, hotel-bar-like room on the fifth floor of a building near Dotonbori that opened in 2001 and that one September 2026 diner, back after visiting soon after the opening, called essentially the original high-end yakiniku restaurant. Staff grill the meat in front of you over binchotan (one diner was taught to grill the tail), the eight-seat counter is set around an irori-style hearth, and the staff suggest which of the day's seven salts (chosen from 32) suits each cut. The beef is 大黒千牛 (Daikoku Sengyu), a brand of A5 heifers aged in a large aging house in Kakogawa, Hyogo. Courses run ¥13,200–19,800 and start with a kaiseki-like appetizer plate; the house signature is Toro-tan, a thick cut from the root of the tongue, then Chateaubriand or fillet, sirloin, wagyu sukiyaki, and a curry that one January 2026 diner ranked among the best ever eaten. One regular, back for a seventh time in August 2026, has written of usually ordering Toro-tan, Chateaubriand and wagyu tail slices à la carte (2022–2025 visits). A Tabelog yakiniku/grill WEST 100 pick every year from 2020 to 2026, and in 2018. One diner found the private room smoky; another wanted to be asked about doneness.

roles: Grilling staff and chef (unnamed); run by 株式会社フルスティームアヘッド (FULL STEAM AHEAD co. ltd.), representative 森川 宣洋 (official company page; "led by Nobuhiro Morikawa" per a March 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the official company page, 株式会社フルスティームアヘッド was founded in March 2001, runs 肉匠なか田 and opens further shops, and sells its 大黒千牛 beef online; the official site lists one other shop, the wagyu-bento shop 匠のお重 和牛 韋駄天 (IDATEN) in Namba. The site describes 大黒千牛 as A5 heifers fattened for 29 months or more, longer than other brands, and aged 21 or 35 days at 0°C and 90% humidity in one of the largest aging houses in western Japan, in Kakogawa, Hyogo. A March 2026 reviewer describes the meat that day as 35-day-aged A5 female Nagi wagyu from Okayama and the Toro-tan as from Kumamoto. Diners describe staff who explain each dish and the salts, time the grilling and greet guests warmly (2024–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: The right salt for each cut: seven natural salts a day, picked from 32 from around the world, served in Baccarat glasses (official site; Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Toro-tan (thick root-of-the-tongue cut, a registered 3D trademark); special Chateaubriand; 35-day aged sirloin or rib roast.

anecdotes.text: "While high-end yakiniku restaurants are common now, at that time, this place was truly a pioneer in the genre, essentially the original high-end yakiniku restaurant." — September 2026, back after a first visit soon after the opening.
"This Yakiniku is particularly enjoyed with salt… Apparently, the spice level increases in a clockwise direction—such a detailed approach!" — September 2024, ¥9,800 standard course.
"As a finale, when the homemade curry was served… after one bite, I was blown away by how delicious it was. It ranks among the best curries I have ever had." — January 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 大阪道頓堀から徒歩2分の高級和牛焼肉、オープンキッチンの長いカウンター (8席) と和モダンの店内、熟練の焼き手が目の前で焼く、世界各地32種類の天然塩からその日の肉に合う7種類を厳選、テーブル4名×2・6名×1、2〜5名の個室 (チャージ3,300円)、総席数34席、特選シャトーブリアンコース19,800円、特選ヘレコース16,800円、35日熟成肉コース13,200円 (前菜盛り合わせ、名物トロタン (立体商標登録商品)、塩焼き、旬の焼野菜、とれたて野菜、和牛すきやき、熟成サーロインまたは熟成リブロース、御飯物、デザート)、アラカルトもある、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、毎週月曜と年末年始休み、サービス料10%、2025年4月1日から全席禁煙、10歳以下は入店不可。大黒千牛: 29ヶ月以上肥育したA5ランクの雌牛だけ、兵庫県加古川市の西日本最大級の熟成庫で湿度90%・温度0℃で21日または35日熟成。会社概要: 株式会社フルスティームアヘッド、代表者 森川 宣洋、創業2001年3月、肉匠なか田の運営と店舗展開、大黒千牛のオンラインショップ。店舗: 本店と 匠のお重 和牛 韋駄天 (IDATEN)。食べログ (店舗会員): 難波1-7-16 現代こいさんビル 5F、なんば駅14番出口から徒歩1分、コースのL.O.21:00、月曜が祝日なら火曜休み、2時間制、お通し550円、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、英語メニュー、オープン2001年3月7日、焼肉 WEST 百名店 2020〜2026 と 2018。口コミ(2024年9月〜2026年10月): トロタン、シャトーブリアン、テールスライス、バーニャカウダ、Oni Oroshi、牛すじカレー、wagyu sushi、牛の ochazuke、白菜のジュレ、和牛のローストビーフ、自家製カレー、Dan Dan noodles、栗のモンブラン、uni、ikura、鮑の一品、matsutake、卵黄で食べるすきやき、iroriのようなカウンター、塩は時計回りに辛くなる、個室は煙がこもる、焼き加減を聞いてほしかったという声。

places.notes: [Udon · Dotonbori, the old house for Osaka kitsune udon, under the willow] A calm, traditional noodle house on the Dotonbori strip, marked by a willow tree at the door, serving Osaka-style soft udon in a pale golden dashi of kombu and fish flakes, perfected in 1949 and still the base of the taste, per the shop's history. Order the kitsune udon (¥930), with two large sheets of sweet, fluffy fried tofu that spill broth as you bite; one October 2026 diner drank every drop. Duck-and-egg udon with sansho, grilled-mochi kachin udon, nabeyaki udon and grilled-conger anago udon are other favourites, and there is a seasonal soba each month. The family behind it ran a theatre teahouse and then a Western musical instrument shop in Dotonbori until the air raids burned the family out; back in 1946 the family sold shaved ice, zenzai and chestnuts, and the noodles sold on the side are what customers came for. It was a Tabelog Udon 100 shop from 2017 to 2020. Lunch queues are long: take a number from the machine out front and you are called in groups.

roles: Run by 株式会社今井 (founded November 1946, incorporated December 1956), representative director 今井 徹 (official company page); the seventh generation, president since 1995 (official history)
Shop manager 水野 浩明 (official shop page)
chef_bio.origin: Family in Dotonbori since about 1815, when the first generation moved there from 今井町 in Nara (official history).
chef_bio.background: Per the official history, the family traces its Dotonbori roots to a theatre teahouse, 稲竹, opposite the 中座 theatre, opened by the founder's only daughter (1838 per the history page; about 1780 per the company page). Later the family handed the teahouse on and the fifth generation, 今井寛三, opened 今井楽器店, a Western musical instrument shop that, per the site, ranked among the top three in Japan. Burned out in the war (the shop was lost in March 1945, per the company page), the family returned to Dotonbori in 1946 and sold kanten and shaved ice in summer and zenzai and roasted chestnuts in autumn, and quietly noodles too; when customers came for them, 寛三's wife マチ子 felt "this is it", and the noodle shop 御蕎麦処 今井 began. マチ子 perfected the dashi in 1949, the base of the taste today. The sixth generation, 清三, became president (1957 per the history page; April 1964 per the company page) and added seasonal soba and 点心 to the menu ("udon and soba need a sense of the seasons too"); the seventh, 徹, became president in 1995. A September 2002 fire at the 中座 spread to the main shop, which reopened in July 2003; since then the company has opened new shops and takeaway lines. The company page lists the main shop, dine-in shops at リーガロイヤルホテル, inside Shin-Osaka station, 大丸心斎橋 and 泉北タカシマヤ, takeaway counters in four Osaka department stores and a franchise at Itami airport, with 198 staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Taste, of course, plus the seasons and Japanese form and shape" (6th generation 清三, official history); dashi made fresh, never ahead (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Kitsune udon; ankake udon; nabeyaki udon; seasonal soba.

anecdotes.text: "The area has become quite touristy, but Dotonbori Imai, standing under the willow tree, retains its unchanged atmosphere… Of course, I finished every drop of the broth." — October 2026, kitsune udon and set C.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 昭和21年創業「道頓堀今井」、昔ながらの八升釜で一杯ずつ浪花の味、店長 水野 浩明、道頓堀1丁目7番22号、なんば駅から徒歩5分、11:30〜21:30 (L.O.21:00)、お鍋料理のL.O.は午後7時30分、水曜 (祝日は営業)・第4火曜 (12月を除く) 休み、現金・電子マネー・クレジットカード、予約は電話のみ、きつねうどん930円、鍋焼うどん1,850円、親子丼 (吸い物付) 1,500円、うどん寄せ鍋お一人様5,500円、10月の季節そば 栗むしあんそば2,000円、りんごのワイン煮580円 (2026年10月)、氷わらび650円 (2026年7月)。お出し: 北海道道南産の天然真昆布と九州産のさば節・うるめ節 (宗田鰹も)、昆布をアルカリ水で小一時間、最後は八升釜で。アレルギー: 同一の厨房で調理、調理・洗浄機器も共通のため微量に混入の可能性。歴史: 芝居茶屋「稲竹」(1838年、初代 今井佐兵衛の一人娘たけ)、5代目 今井寛三が今井楽器店を創業、西洋楽器を売る店として全国でも3本の指に、大阪大空襲で焼け出され1946年に道頓堀に戻り、夏は寒天・氷水、秋はぜんざい・焼き栗、めん類も内緒で販売、寛三の妻マチ子が「これだ」と感じて「御蕎麦処 今井」が始まる、1949年にマチ子が今井の出汁を完成、1956年に株式会社今井、1957年に6代目 清三が社長 (会社概要の沿革では1964年4月)、季節そば・点心を追加、1995年に7代目 徹が社長、2002年の火災で本店が類焼 (会社概要: 2002年9月 中座火事により類焼、2003年7月 道頓堀本店オープン)。会社概要: 代表取締役 今井 徹、創業昭和21年11月、会社設立昭和31年12月、従業員198人 (社員70人)、1945年3月 戦火にて今井楽器店焼失、本店、リーガロイヤルホテル店、大阪のれんめぐり店 (新大阪駅)、泉北タカシマヤ店、大丸心斎橋店、テイクアウト専門の大丸梅田・近鉄上本町・高島屋大阪・あべのハルカス、伊丹空港店 (FC)。食べログ (店舗会員): うどん 百名店 2017〜2020、138席、個室、座敷、掘りごたつ、車椅子可、禁煙、子ども可、鍋などのコースは前日までに予約。口コミ(2026年10月): 柳の木の下、店の前の発券機で番号札、5人ずつ呼ばれる、きつねうどん、C セット (小丼、小さな煮物、漬物) +800円、鴨とじうどん1,600円、かちんうどん (焼いた餅が3つ)、穴子うどん、栗の蒸しあんそば、おでん、わらび餅、Tai Sasamaki Sushi 280円、観光客が多い。

places.cuisine: Edo-mae sushi courses (Tabelog, tax included) · 10 nigiri with a starter, red miso soup and dessert ¥7,700 · 15 nigiri course with starters, red miso soup and dessert ¥11,000 · "Kiwami" course of starters, three kinds of sashimi, a grilled dish and 10 nigiri ¥16,500 · an October 2026 15-piece course: simmered seafood and root vegetables, wild flounder with engawa, aori squid, wild sea bream, wild striped jack, domestic salmon, bluefin akami and chutoro, bonito, sawara, shime saba, octopus, kombu-cured botan shrimp, sardine, scallop, anago with Arima sansho · the scallop comes seared at the end (October 2026) · aged tuna (October 2026) · pickled ginger cut in cubes (October 2026) · dessert: Hokkaido milk gelato with homemade black syrup and kinako · sake from around Japan, some rare, plus beer and shochu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Sushi · Umeda, a back-street counter] A small sushi restaurant on a back street north of Umeda, near the Grand Front North Building, opened in September 2025; the shop says its fish is chosen with "years of experience running a high-end sushi restaurant" (Tabelog). Eight counter seats look onto fresh wasabi and the chef's knife work, with three tables for groups. The courses are fixed and fair for the station area: ten nigiri with a starter, red miso soup and dessert for ¥7,700, or fifteen for ¥11,000 (October 2026), each piece finished at the counter, "a different experience than simply enjoying sushi with soy sauce" (October 2026). Diners single out the wild flounder, the bonito, the shime saba and the chutoro, and the dessert of Hokkaido milk gelato with black syrup and kinako. The chef explains each piece and talks with the counter. One October 2026 diner found most of the room were overseas visitors. Book ahead; weekend lunch too.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: the seafood is chosen "with years of experience running a high-end sushi restaurant", arrives from the market every morning and is served the same day, with the aim of "bringing the deliciousness of Japan to the world"; the rice is seasoned with a house blend of vinegars. Opened 1 September 2025. The operator named on the listing's website link is 株式会社WILL (will-food.com, read 2026-11-01, shows only the company name).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Sushi enjoyed with seasonal vinegars in perfectly seasoned rice" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: 10- and 15-nigiri courses; milk gelato with black syrup and kinako.

anecdotes.text: "Sitting at the counter, the chef explained each dish as it was served. … The chef was friendly and made the experience enjoyable." — October 2026, a lunch omakase.

places.cuisine: Casual kappo of fresh fish, obanzai and tempura with sake (official site) · seasonal board (official site, tax included, read November 2026): seven-kind omakase sashimi ¥1,200, new-season sanma salt-grilled or as sashimi ¥950, ma-fugu milt as tempura or soy-grilled ¥980, live hamo blanched, seared or as tempura ¥1,500, salt-seared tataki of autumn bonito ¥950 · takeaway nigiri, 15 pieces ¥2,980 or 20 pieces ¥3,980 · about 20 sakes, Dassai and Kameizumi among them (Tabelog) · dishes named in October 2026 reviews: the sashimi assortment (with tuna; kue on one night), salt-dressed bonito sashimi, Bungo beef tataki topped with sea urchin and salmon roe, crab miso with cream cheese, uzaku, water eggplant, lotus root with sansho, sesame tofu, fried eggplant soaked in broth, eel spring rolls, shrimp tempura, a small braised-beef rice bowl, grilled sanma · duck (August 2026) · two diners ate and drank for about ¥7,000 (October 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Umeda, a fish counter under the station buildings] A narrow counter two floors down in Osaka Station Front Building No. 1, a minute from Kitashinchi Station, open since 2013 and the main shop (本店) of the small Ishimon group, with a second shop in Building No. 2 and a sushi shop. The official site calls it a casual kappo of fresh fish, obanzai and tempura at fair prices, with sake chosen to match. The order everyone makes is the sashimi assortment, thick-cut and fresh, with kue in it on one October 2026 night; around it go seasonal fish like salt-grilled sanma or live hamo, and small plates: uzaku, water eggplant, sesame tofu, fried eggplant in broth, eel spring rolls, Bungo beef tataki under sea urchin and salmon roe. One October 2026 diner liked the side dishes more than the fish. Two people eat and drink for about ¥7,000. It fills from opening, so book, and expect a time limit; solo diners get an hour.

roles: Kitchen and counter staff of ishimon LLC (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (sakanaya-ishimon.com, company name ishimon LLC; read 2026-11-01): 酒菜や いしもん (the title gives the reading サカナヤ) 本店, a 大衆割烹 serving fresh fish, obanzai and tempura at fair prices with sake chosen to go with the food, each dish "made with care, picturing the customer's smile". The group's brands are いしもん and すし処 いしもん; the Tabelog remarks list the sister shops ２ビルのいしもん ("Ishimon in 2 Building" on Tabelog, in Osaka Station Front Building No. 2) and すし処 いしもん. Opened 2 April 2013 (Tabelog).

chef_bio.specialty: Omakase sashimi assortment; obanzai; seasonal fish.

anecdotes.text: "It was only 5 PM, but the place was almost full. I managed to get a table for just one hour!" — October 2026, a holiday weekend.

"I was seated at the counter, separated from the person next to me by a tape line, which felt a bit awkward when I accidentally crossed it." — October 2026, a Friday; the sashimi assortment included kue.
"The Bungo beef tataki was lavishly topped with sea urchin and salmon roe." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 酒菜や (サカナヤ) いしもん 本店、北新地駅・西梅田駅から徒歩1分、新鮮な鮮魚、おばんざい、天ぷらなどを手頃に楽しめる大衆割烹、料理に合わせた日本酒、一品一品お客様の笑顔を思い浮かべながら真心こめて、定休日なし、日15:00〜22:00、月〜木17:00〜23:30、金17:00〜24:00、土16:00〜23:00。料理 (税込): おまかせ造り盛り七種1,200円、新サンマ塩焼き950円、新サンマ造り950円、真フグ白子 (天ぷら・醤油焼き) 980円、活ハモ (湯引き・焼霜・天ぷら) 1,500円、戻りカツオ塩タタキ950円。テイクアウト: にぎり鮨 並15貫2,980円、並20貫3,980円。新店舗「２ビルのいしもん」の案内。会社名 ishimon LLC、ブランドはいしもんとすし処 いしもん。食べログ (店舗会員): いしもん 本店、居酒屋・海鮮・日本酒バー、大阪市北区梅田1-3-1 大阪駅前第一ビル B2F、北新地駅・西梅田駅から徒歩1分、営業時間は公式サイトと同じ、不定休、予約可、混雑時は2時間制、ひとりは電話で (1時間)、月〜木は60分の席のみ予約 (席料なし)、カードと電子マネー可、QR 不可、13席、電子タバコのみ可、テイクアウト、2013年4月2日オープン、日本酒は約20種 (Dassai、Kameizumi など)、姉妹店は２ビルのいしもんとすし処 いしもん。口コミ(2025年6月〜2026年10月): 刺身の盛り合わせ (厚切り、Kue が入った日も)、カツオの塩、Bungo の牛のタタキにウニとイクラ、カニみそとクリームチーズ、うざく、水なす、レンコンの山椒、ごま豆腐、なすの揚げびたし、うなぎの春巻き、エビの天ぷら、牛肉の煮込みの小丼、サンマの塩焼き、鴨、2人で約7,000円、5時でほぼ満席、カウンターはテープで仕切り、魚より小鉢がおいしいという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: A busy counter with a time limit; book by phone for a table or a solo visit (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

places.name: 梅田かに食堂 (Umeda Kani Shokudo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. All-you-can-eat courses of boiled crab with shabu-shabu, sushi and many side dishes; fried dishes, kushikatsu and sukiyaki are among them, and staff could not explain course differences to one diner (December 2025).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses built on crab, beef, pork and sushi. Tabelog's feature list ticks "vegetarian options", but no vegetarian dish is named.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Thu and Sun 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 16:00–24:00; Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 12:00–15:00 and 16:00–01:00; no orders 15:00–16:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Courses of 100 or 120 minutes, last order 30 minutes before the end, at most two dishes ordered at a time per person (Tabelog). A booking is cancelled if you are more than 15 minutes late without notice; course bookings are charged in full from 23:00 the day before, seat-only bookings ¥3,000 a head (Tabelog). Cover charge ¥418; a 10% year-end fee from early December to 5 January (Tabelog); a December 2025 diner was asked at the table to accept a busy-season surcharge of about 10% or ¥1,000. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 250 seats, private rooms for 6 to over 30; smoking allowed (Tabelog), including at the tables (June 2025). Orders by QR code on your phone; drinks from a drink bar, some food buffet-style (November 2025). Opened 1 October 2020 (Tabelog), formerly 韓国屋台 オンチョン.
places.neighborhood: 小松原町1-16, 4F of モコビル, a mixed-use building of restaurants off Hankyu Higashi-dori — 5 min from Umeda (Midosuji Line), Osaka Umeda (Hankyu) and JR Osaka
places.cuisine: All-you-can-eat crab, shabu-shabu and sushi (Tabelog plans, tax included) · lunch all-you-can-eat from ¥2,480 · snow crab and beef-tongue shabu-shabu with sushi, 81 dishes, 100 minutes ¥6,980 (listed down from ¥8,980) · "Goku" course of sushi, meat sushi, beef tongue and A5 wagyu shabu-shabu or sukiyaki, 129 dishes, 120 minutes ¥6,000 · king crab, A5 wagyu and meat sushi, 114 dishes, 100 minutes ¥14,800 (listed down from ¥18,000) · drinks added: soft drinks ¥550, alcohol ¥1,100 · also kushikatsu and meat sushi (Tabelog) · reviews: all-you-can-eat sushi ¥3,000, drinks ¥1,000 more (June 2025); crab hot pot with fried chicken cartilage, kimchi and sushi (July 2025); crab shells for the broth and a crab zosui to finish (September 2025); red snow crab with self-service refills (December 2025); king crab and A5 wagyu loin shabu-shabu ¥14,800 (August 2026)
places.notes: [Crab all-you-can-eat · Higashi-Umeda, a 250-seat crab hall] A big all-you-can-eat hall on the fourth floor of a building full of restaurants near Higashi-dori, where you pay one price for 100 or 120 minutes of boiled snow crab or king crab, a shabu-shabu pot, sushi and dozens of side dishes, ordered by QR code with a drink bar alongside. Yakiniku and shabu-shabu sit in separate areas, and the neon-lit room draws a young, lively crowd (November 2025); one diner felt it still looked like the Korean restaurant it replaced (December 2025). Reviews split: fans praise packed crab legs, the broth made from the shells and a crab zosui at the end (2025), while others found thin crab, slow peeling and a busy-season surcharge raised only at the table (December 2025). Snow-crab courses run about ¥5,000–7,000 (2025 reviews; ¥6,980 on Tabelog), king crab ¥14,800; lunch from ¥2,480. Smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: 250 seats in the heart of Umeda for parties up to 250, all-you-can-eat and all-you-can-drink, with kushikatsu and meat sushi; former name 韓国屋台 オンチョン; opened 1 October 2020. The Tabelog invoice number T2120001214766 is registered to 株式会社ファイブディアライフ (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-01). A December 2025 diner noted the room still seemed set up for the previous restaurant, "more like a Korean restaurant".
chef_bio.specialty: All-you-can-eat snow crab and king crab with shabu-shabu and sushi.

anecdotes.text: "You order by scanning a QR code on your smartphone, and the all-you-can-drink option is set up like a drink bar … The yakiniku and shabu-shabu areas are separated, which is nice because you don't get the smell of grilled meat." — November 2025, the ¥6,980 snow-crab course.
"I used the crab shells to make a flavorful broth, and finished off with crab zosui (rice porridge)." — September 2025.
"As soon as I was seated, the staff asked me if I was okay with an additional charge of about 10% or JPY 1,000 due to the busy season." — December 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 梅田かに食堂 (旧店名 韓国屋台 オンチョン)、かに・寿司・しゃぶしゃぶ、大阪市北区小松原町1-16 モコビル 4F、梅田駅・大阪梅田駅・大阪駅から徒歩5分、月〜木・日12:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、16:00〜24:00、金・土・祝前日12:00〜15:00、16:00〜翌1:00、15時〜16時は注文不可、不定休、15分以上の連絡なしの遅れは自動キャンセル、お通し代418円、年末年始は10%、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、250席、個室あり、喫煙可、2020年10月1日オープン。プラン (税込): ランチの食べ放題2,480円から、ズワイガニと牛タンのしゃぶしゃぶと寿司の食べ放題81品100分6,980円、寿司、肉寿司、牛タンと A5 和牛のしゃぶしゃぶかすき焼きの「極」129品120分6,000円、タラバガニと A5 和牛と肉寿司114品100分14,800円、飲み放題はソフトドリンク550円、アルコール1,100円、ひとり2品ずつの注文。口コミ(2025年6月〜2026年8月): 寿司の食べ放題3,000円、席でたばこ、カニ鍋、軟骨の揚げ物、キムチ、殻でだし、カニ雑炊、QR コードで注文、ドリンクバー、焼肉としゃぶしゃぶのエリアは別、ネオンでにぎやか、紅ズワイガニのおかわりはセルフ、身が少ないという声、席で繁忙期の追加料金をたずねられた、タラバガニと A5 和牛ロースのしゃぶしゃぶ14,800円。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by QR code on your phone; drink bar and some buffet dishes (November 2025). No English evidence found.

places.name: 野口 グラングリーン大阪 (Noguchi Grand Green Osaka)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. A single omakase course with tempura hand rolls, fried dishes and a choice of noodles to finish (soba, somen, Kitakata ramen, spaghetti, dandan noodles). The shop asks for allergies in advance and treats a booking whose allergies affect two or more dishes of the course as a cancellation (Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the listing says the shop cannot accommodate broad dietary restrictions such as vegetarian diets; the course is built on fish, shellfish, beef, duck and dashi.
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:30–23:00; irregular holidays, ask the shop (Tabelog). Reservation by phone or online, with start times every 30 minutes rather than one seating (October 2026). Cancellation fees: 30% of the booking 7 to 4 days before, 50% 3 to 2 days before, 100% the day before or on the day (Tabelog). Drinks and extra dishes are paid on the day (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats: 12 at the counter and 6 at tables; private rooms for 4 and 6, ¥5,000 when used by two; non-smoking; no strong perfume; children of school age welcome, with a kids' menu (Tabelog). Opened 21 March 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 大深町5-54, ground floor of the Grand Green Osaka South Building (グラングリーン大阪南館), the building of the Waldorf hotel — 3 min from the west exit of JR Osaka Stn; diners call it hard to find, so allow extra time
places.cuisine: One omakase course of Kyoto cooking, ¥38,000 tax included (Tabelog); a September 2026 bill came to just over ¥40,000 with drinks · an August 2026 course: abalone, turban shell, junsai and white yam; a tempura hand roll of bonito; beef shabu-shabu in a new-lotus-root soup; Biwa trout and sea bream sashimi; fried ayu with onion sauce; grilled hamo with plum soy sauce; fried Kamo eggplant; Azumigawa ayu with corn; fish-bone crackers; eel with green chilli; sea-bream rice; a sorbet of pineapple and white wine · an October 2026 course: matsutake chawanmushi, a squid and sea-urchin hand roll, soft-shell turtle soup with turtle mochi, sea bream and tuna sashimi, fried small potatoes with sesame sauce, fried matsutake with beef in sansho sauce, nameko ohitashi, vinegared mackerel, grilled duck with eggplant and fig sauce, rice with sea bream and nozawana · then a choice of about eight finishing dishes in small, regular or large: karasumi soba, sudachi soba or somen, Kitakata ramen, meat-sauce spaghetti, cold dandan noodles, ikura rice, jako rice, tekka-don, ochazuke · portions run large (2026) · sake and wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Umekita, Kyoto cooking in Grand Green] The Osaka branch of 京天神野口, a Kyoto restaurant near Kitano Tenmangu that a 2026 diner describes as referral-only, opened in March 2025 on the ground floor of Grand Green Osaka's South Building, the Waldorf hotel's building, and won a Tabelog Bronze award for 2026. A head chef trained at the Kyoto restaurant runs it with a team of three (August 2026), and the head chef of the Kyoto restaurant is said to come on Thursdays and Fridays, the hardest days to book. One ¥38,000 omakase course of seasonal Kyoto cooking comes in big portions: hamo with plum soy sauce and ayu in summer, matsutake and soft-shell turtle in autumn, then sea-bream rice, after which you choose from about eight finishing dishes, from karasumi soba to Kitakata ramen or cold dandan noodles, in the size you can manage. Start times are flexible. The Grand Green complex is confusing, so arrive early.

roles: Owner of 京天神野口 (official site: "Daisuke Noguchi, the Restaurant owner")
Head chef of the Osaka shop: trained at the Kyoto restaurant (Tabelog); unnamed, described as young (August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (kyotenjin-noguchi.com, read 2026-11-01): 京天神野口 runs three restaurants, 京天神野口, のぐち継 and 野口 グラングリーン大阪, and the owner's greeting speaks of cooking rooted in the culture and climate of Kyoto, following the changing seasons. Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: 京天神野口 is a Kyoto restaurant "known for being fully booked a year in advance"; the Osaka shop opened 21 March 2025 under a head chef trained at the main restaurant; Tabelog Award 2026 Bronze. Per reviews: the Kyoto restaurant near Kitano Tenmangu holds two Michelin stars (August 2026), has won Tabelog Silver awards in a row (August 2026) and takes guests by referral only (October 2026); the head chef of the Kyoto restaurant comes to Osaka on Thursdays and Fridays (August and October 2026), and the Osaka kitchen is a team of three (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "I hope you can experience the essence of Kyoto cuisine here in Umeda, Osaka, through traditional yet innovative dishes made with carefully selected seasonal ingredients" (Daisuke Noguchi, Tabelog listing).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase course of Kyoto cooking; choice of finishing noodles and rice.

anecdotes.text: "The dishes were served at different times rather than all at once, which made me imagine there must be a large team behind the scenes. To my surprise, there were only three people!" — August 2026.
"Sudachi soba, Kitakata ramen, ikura rice, jako rice, tekka don … I was surprised to learn that we could order all of these!" — October 2026, of the finishing dishes.
"It was fully booked since the head chef was there that day." — September 2026, a birthday dinner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京天神 野口、京の四季に寄り添う味、移ろう季節と向き合い、その日その時の旬を大切に一皿一皿に心を込める、京都の文化や風土に根ざした料理、店主 野口 大介。店舗案内: 京天神野口、のぐち継、野口 グラングリーン大阪。食べログ (店舗会員): 野口 グラングリーン大阪、日本料理、大阪市北区大深町5-54 グラングリーン大阪南館 1F、JR 大阪駅西口から徒歩3分、毎日17:30〜23:00、不定休、おまかせコース38,000円 (税込)、飲み物と追加の料理は当日払い、キャンセル料 (7〜4日前30%、3〜2日前50%、前日・当日100%)、アレルギーや苦手な食材がコースの2品以上にかかる場合はキャンセル扱い、ベジタリアンなど幅広い食事制限には対応できない、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、18席 (カウンター12、テーブル6)、個室4名・6名 (2名での利用は5,000円)、禁煙、香水など強い香りは控える、小学生から、お子様メニューあり、2025年3月21日オープン、The Tabelog Award 2026 Bronze、一年先まで予約で埋まる京都の京天神野口の新しい店、料理長は本店で修業。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): Kitano Tenmangu の近くの本店、紹介制、量が多い、3人で切り盛り、木・金は本店の大将が来る、開始時間は30分ごとに選べる、アワビ、ハモ、アユ、マツタケ、スッポン、鯛ごはん、締めは約8種から (からすみそば、すだちそば、Kitakata ラーメン、ミートソース、冷やし担々麺、いくらごはん、じゃこごはん、鉄火丼、お茶漬け)、小・普通・大、グラングリーンは迷いやすい。

cultural_comfort.note: One omakase course, booked online or by phone; the owner's site has an English page. No English service evidence found.

Tabelog listing: allergies or dislikes affecting two or more dishes of the course are treated as a cancellation; broad restrictions such as vegetarian diets cannot be accommodated.

places.name: プーサン (Poussin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Nothing is called gluten-free. The puddings are custard-style (eggs, milk, cream, caramel sauce) and no flour is mentioned for them, but the case also holds wheat-based sweets (pistachio cream puff in choux pastry, a seasonal egg tart), the caramel almond pudding has a crumble on top (shop menu), and a March 2026 roll pudding sat on a rice-flour almond sponge. Ask about each pudding before you buy.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the puddings are made with eggs, milk and cream, and the shop's own menu says even the organic soy-milk pudding contains dairy. The pistachio gelato and the douhua-style pudding are not described either way.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 10:00–20:00, until sold out; closed Sunday, public holidays and the first Tuesday of each month (Tabelog; the holiday line adds "closed only on Mondays" in translation, which is unclear). Reservations to hold puddings are taken 10:00–19:00 (Tabelog); one diner booked by phone and through the shop's Instagram messages (January–February 2026). Pistachio puddings can sell out to reservations by early afternoon (October 2026). Takeaway only (Tabelog: "Takeout specialty store"; September 2026 review); two chairs outside where kakigori and gelato can be eaten (September 2026). A small shop that serves one customer at a time (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB), iD, QUICPay, PayPay, Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Prices rose in May 2026 (kakigori ¥650 to ¥750, rum-raisin pudding ¥300 to ¥330), which a diner tied to a naphtha shortage, and some packaging is now charged (May 2026 review). Opened 10 July 2008 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 3-4-2, ミーネ新町館 1F (Nishi-ku), on a quiet street just north of Nagahori-dori — 3 min from Nishi-Ohashi or Nishi-Nagahori Stn (Nagahori Tsurumi-ryokuchi Line)
places.cuisine: Takeaway pudding shop: about 30 puddings rotate through the case, classics plus daily and seasonal specials, most at ¥330 (shop menu on Tabelog, read November 2026) · the signature Delicious Custard Pudding ¥300, with vanilla bean and eggs from Kannan Farm in Hyogo (October 2026 review); in the cool season topped with Hokkaido whipped cream · rich organic chocolate ¥380; cheesecake "Demi Blanc", baked Hokkaido cream-cheese cheesecake over custard pudding, ¥330 · daily specials ¥330: additive-free black sesame, world honey (sweetened only with honey), almond (apricot-kernel pudding over custard), salted caramel, rum raisin, Kyoto kinako, royal milk tea with Earl Grey, organic hojicha, organic coffee with Sekine Coffee beans, Okinawa brown sugar, organic soy milk (both with black syrup at the bottom, February and June 2026) · seasonal: corn, edamame, Taiwanese jasmine tea and ruby grapefruit in early summer; Sukuna pumpkin from Hida in late summer; Anno sweet potato under white-sesame blancmange in winter; baked apple (January 2026) · pistachio line: puddings with Sicilian ("Elegant") or American ("Wild") pistachios ¥380; pistachio cream puff, Basque cheesecake and crème brûlée ¥500 each; pistachio gelato ¥600 · in season, pudding-topped kakigori ¥750 (strawberry, kiwi, mango, ruby grapefruit in 2026), pistachio kakigori ¥750, açaí bowl with pudding ¥980, mixed juice with crushed pudding ¥450, douhua-style pudding with ginger syrup ¥500
places.notes: [Sweets · Shinmachi, a couple's pudding shop with some 30 flavours] A small takeaway shop on a quiet Shinmachi street a few minutes from Nishi-Ohashi station, selling puddings and pistachio sweets since 2008; a couple runs it. The case holds classics such as the vanilla-scented Delicious Custard Pudding at ¥300 and changes through the year: corn and edamame in early summer, Sukuna pumpkin from Hida in late summer, Anno sweet potato with sesame blancmange in winter, and daily specials from rum raisin to hojicha, world honey and organic coffee. The Sicilian-pistachio pudding, a pistachio cream puff and pistachio gelato have their own following, and pistachio items can sell out to reservations by early afternoon, so phone ahead to hold one. In summer there is pudding-topped kakigori to eat on the two chairs outside. Diners find the puddings small, about ¥300 each, and good as gifts. Tabelog Sweets WEST 100 in 2023 and 2026. Closed Sundays, holidays and the first Tuesday of the month.

roles: Owner couple (unnamed): "the owner couple" and "the owner's wife" in one diner's reviews, January–June 2026; "the friendly owner" (October 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 10 July 2008 in Shinmachi (Tabelog); a takeout-only pudding specialist (Tabelog remarks) whose shop-maintained Tabelog menu lists about 30 puddings plus pistachio sweets. Tabelog Sweets WEST 100 in 2023 and 2026. One diner, on a 28th visit since July 2024, describes the couple behind the counter recommending seasonal puddings, holding puddings booked by phone or Instagram message, and announcing new flavours on the shop's Instagram; the owner told that diner the organic coffee pudding takes three days to make (January 2026). An October 2026 reviewer credits the eggs in the custard pudding to Kannan Farm in Hyogo.
chef_bio.specialty: Delicious Custard Pudding; pistachio puddings and sweets; seasonal puddings.

anecdotes.text: "When I spoke with the owner, I learned that the organic coffee pudding is rarer and takes three days to prepare with great care." — January 2026, an 18th visit.
"Unfortunately, both the 'Anno Sweet Potato Pudding and White Sesame Blancmange' and the 'Pistachio Pudding' were already sold out due to reservations." — October 2026, around 1 PM on a Monday.
"Just a few minutes east of Nishinagahori Station, the shop is small and serves customers one at a time." — October 2026.

places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Kitahorie, okonomiyaki with Korean home cooking and a terrace] Okonomi Tamachan began, says the TableCheck page of its LUCUA Osaka branch, in 2008 as a 7-tsubo shop in Horie, built on clinking glasses, the smell of grilling offal and "the omoni flavors passed down from Tamachan's mother"; an October 2026 diner calls this Kitahorie shop, open since 2012, the main branch. Diners come as much for the Korean side as for the okonomiyaki: homemade steamed pork wrapped in perilla with kimchi and spicy miso, the house horumon grilled with egg and sauce or with garlic salt, namul and kimchi. Walls of graffiti, old posters and signatures of famous visitors; a terrace where smoking and pets are allowed. Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100 in 2024 and 2025. Busy most evenings, so book on Tabelog; open daily to midnight.
