places.notes: [Kissaten · Dotonbori, a 1946 coffee parlour with a spiral staircase] Founded in 1946 by the grandparents (祖父母) of the family that runs it now, first under the name 花月 at another spot, then moved here and renamed American; the third generation runs it today (official site). Inside the entrance a spiral staircase from the 1963 rebuild curves up past a 1975 wall of 640 pieces of wood set with stained glass; the second floor has 川島織物 carpet-weave panels, and the back wall is Italian red marble. The owner roasts the seven-bean house blend on a German Probat and arranges the flowers each week, the staff wear six made-to-order uniforms, and the site says American was the first in Osaka with double automatic doors and a jukebox. The whole menu runs all day: hotcakes, omurice with house ketchup, napolitan-style "Italian" spaghetti, beef-cutlet sandwiches, pudding sundaes, fruit à la mode, anmitsu. With 245 seats on two floors a wait is rare (none at noon on an October 2026 holiday), and diners range from long-time patrons to teenagers. Opinions on the food vary: one October 2026 diner loved the moist hotcakes, another found margarine and whipped topping and missed maple syrup. Tabelog Kissaten 100 in 2021, 2022 and 2026. No photos of the room, only of your own order. Closed 31 December and about three Thursdays a month.

roles: The owner roasts and blends the coffee and arranges the flowers each week (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in 1946 (昭和21年) by the grandparents (祖父母), at first elsewhere under the name 花月, since "American" could hardly be used so soon after the war; after the move to this spot it became "American", a name easy for anyone to remember and say. The third generation runs it now. The spiral staircase was added when the building was renovated in 1963 (a stonemason first turned the curve down); the 1F wall of 640 pieces of various woods set with stained glass cost as much as a house in 1975; 2F walls carry a 川島織物 dantsu weave; the red marble came from Italy. The site says American was said to be the first in Osaka to install double-opening automatic doors and a jukebox, and tells of customers who met here at an arranged meeting, married, and now come with great-grandchildren in tow. Coffee is roasted in-house on a German Probat, once by a dedicated roaster and now by the owner. Tabelog Kissaten 100 in 2021, 2022 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: The founder's saying "儲けは全て、お店につぎ込む" (put every profit back into the shop), taken to mean caring for the room as much as the food; no ready-made products, the best ingredients of the day, everything made from scratch; the customer comes first (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: House-roasted flannel-drip coffee; hotcakes; omurice; pudding sundae; fruit à la mode.

anecdotes.text: "I understood why this place, established in 1946, continues to be loved; the nostalgic flavors were delightful." — October 2026, hotcakes and a cake set.
"The high ceiling features a flower-shaped chandelier adorned with lights similar to those found in Las Vegas." — October 2026, matcha parfait ¥1,100.
"I tried to take photos inside the shop but was kindly asked not to." — October 2026.

places.name: ベアフット カリー リンクス梅田店 (barefoot curry Rinkusu umeda ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Every set comes with naan (wheat), plain or cheese, alongside a mini rice; one diner swapped the naan for rice (May 2026). Ask whether the curries are thickened with flour.
places.vegan_detail: Shop statement (Tabelog): "For vegans and vegetarians, we offer flexible cooking options"; Tabelog lists vegan, vegetarian, halal and Hindu options, and the official page says the shop is popular with vegetarian and vegan guests. The Dal Bhat set is lentil curry, rice, greens and vegetables (official site). Ask which curries suit, and for rice instead of naan, since naan recipes often use dairy.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00, last order 22:30, open all year (Tabelog; official site). Official site: lunch 11:00–16:00, café time 15:00–17:00, dinner 16:00–23:00. Reservations accepted (Tabelog); whole-shop hire from 30 people on weekdays after 17:00 (official site). No cover charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay and more (Tabelog). 50 seats: 7 at the counter, tables for 2 and for 4–5; non-smoking, smoking room on the same floor; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; English menu and English-speaking staff; kids menu, strollers welcome (Tabelog). Parking in the Yodobashi Camera car park (Tabelog). Opened 21 June 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Links Umeda 8F (the restaurant floor of Yodobashi Camera Umeda), Ohfuka-cho 1-1 — just past the Midosuji Line Umeda Stn north gate; 5–6 min from JR Osaka Stn
places.cuisine: Indian and Nepali curry house (official site) · sets with unlimited freshly baked naan and rice (Tabelog; August 2026) · two curries chosen from nine for the naan set (June 2026); spice level to order · official menu (undated, tax included): BBQ Lunch Set with chicken tikka, cheese naan and mini rice ¥1,298 (one curry) or ¥1,518 (two); Dal Bhat Set ¥2,255; Cheese Nan Set ¥1,870 or ¥2,090; barefoot Dinner Set with chicken kebab and tikka ¥2,420 · reviewers paid ¥1,850 for a two-curry naan set plus ¥200 for mutton curry (July 2026) and ¥1,650 for two curries (August 2026) · butter chicken, spinach, chicken, mutton and vegetable curries; shrimp curry; tandoori shrimp (2 pieces ¥780, May 2026); tandoori chicken; Tukpa, a spicy mutton curry soup (July 2026); mutton BBQ skewers and lamb chops (Tabelog) · sweet naans (anko, chocolate) and carrot halwa in café time (official site) · Pair Set for two ¥5,500 with a drink and dessert; party plans from ¥2,365 for four or more (Tabelog) · Kaku highball ¥480 (July 2026); world beers and wine
places.notes: [Curry · Umeda, Links Umeda 8F] An Indian and Nepali curry house on the restaurant floor of the Yodobashi Camera building, a few steps from the subway's north gate. The founders write of coming from Nepal and of naming the shop after a grandmother's barefoot strength; the chef trained in India before coming to Japan (official site). Sets bring two curries with unlimited naan and rice: diners name the butter chicken and the spinach curry, and a cheese naan that is "chewy and delicious" but filling. Spice levels are chosen when you order; a curry called extra spicy was not very spicy for one diner (May 2026), while the mutton Tukpa soup made another's lips tingle (July 2026). A naan set with two curries ran ¥1,650–1,850 in summer 2026. The shop states that it adapts dishes for vegans and vegetarians, and the Nepali Dal Bhat set is lentils, rice and vegetables. Almost full at lunch on one May 2026 visit, quiet at 12:30 on a July weekday; one May 2026 diner felt awkward when a staff member loudly asked "Just curry?"

chef_bio.origin: The founders write "私たちはインドの北に位置する小さな国ネパールから来ました" (we came from Nepal, a small country north of India); official site.
chef_bio.background: Official site (read 2026-11-01): the name comes from the barefoot strength of a grandmother who lived rooted in the land, and from the Buddha's words "walk alone like a rhinoceros horn"; "barefoot curryのシェフは、インドで厳しい下積み修行を経て来日しました" (the chef came to Japan after a hard apprenticeship in India). A 50 cm singing bowl from Nepal, engraved with the Buddha's footprint, greets guests at the entrance. Links Umeda opened in 2023 (official site); the company also runs a Minami Senba shop and Wanowa Cafe in Abeno Bel-ta. Thirty kinds of curry, biryani and mutton BBQ skewers are the popular dishes (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: In India and Nepal it is a virtue to feed family and friends until full; the staff treat guests as family (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Two-curry sets with unlimited naan; cheese naan; Dal Bhat set.

anecdotes.text: "The tandoori shrimp were surprisingly large, with two pieces that made me think, 'Is this a case of reverse sample fraud?'" — May 2026, tandoori shrimp ¥780.

"I mistakenly thought the Tukpa, which looked like it had a clear broth from the food samples outside, would not be spicy … It was a curry soup. The mutton was delicious, and there were plenty of vegetables." — July 2026, a weekday lunch.
"I was eager to order a second helping, but I ended up getting too full and couldn't do it" — July 2026, after butter chicken and spinach curry with naan.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: barefoot LLC の店、ネパールから来た人たちのインド・ネパール料理、店名は祖母の裸足のたくましさから、シェフはインドで修行して来日、リンクス梅田店は2023年オープン、カレー30種類、ビリヤニ、マトンBBQ串が人気、ナン食べ放題、ベジタリアンや VEGAN の人にも好評、ランチ11:00〜16:00、カフェ15:00〜17:00、ディナー16:00〜23:00、ダルバートセット2,255円 (税込)、チーズナンセット1,870円・2,090円、ほかに南船場店とあべのベルタのわのわカフェ。食べログ (店舗会員): 大阪市北区大深町1-1 リンクス梅田 8F、毎日11:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、年中無休、50席、禁煙、英語メニュー、英語を話すスタッフ、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・ハラール・ヒンドゥーのオプション、2023年6月21日オープン。口コミ (2026年5〜8月): カレー2種のナンのセット1,650〜1,850円、ナンとご飯はおかわり自由、チーズナン、バターチキン、ほうれん草のカレー、タンドリーシュリンプ780円、辛いマトンの Tukpa、辛さを選べる。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); order by calling the staff to the table (May 2026); Indian diners and many overseas visitors at lunch and dinner (July 2026 reviews; official site).

positives.text: Shop statement (Tabelog): "For vegans and vegetarians, we offer flexible cooking options to accommodate your needs"; Tabelog lists vegan, vegetarian, halal and Hindu options.
Official site: popular with vegetarian and VEGAN guests (ベジタリアン、VEGANの方にも好評).

places.name: 蛸之徹 角田店 (Tako no Tetsu Kakuda ten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki and okonomiyaki are made from a wheat-flour batter (the official site calls it a "wheat flour-based batter"), and the rest of the menu is yakisoba, yaki-udon and other griddle dishes cooked on the same plates.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the batter is made with dashi (official site), bonito flakes go on top, and most dishes hold octopus, pork, beef or seafood. Tabelog shows a vegetarian-options flag, but no dish is described.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–23:00, last order 22:30; weekday lunch menu 11:30–15:00, with the regular menu also served (Tabelog; official site). Closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, and booked online through Tabelog by one September 2026 diner; a Friday-night wait (August 2026). No cover charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 47 seats with tatami and sunken-kotatsu seating, a semi-private room for 6, whole-shop hire 20–50; non-smoking; English menu; children welcome, kids menu; takeout (Tabelog). Opened 1 August 1979 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kakuta-cho 1-10, くろふねビル 1F, just behind HEP FIVE — 3 min from Hankyu Umeda Stn, 8 min from JR Osaka Stn
places.cuisine: Cook-your-own takoyaki on the table teppan since 1979; the official site calls it the original shop where you make takoyaki yourself · staff start the batter and octopus and help first-timers (official site; August 2026) · a serving is 12 pieces (September 2026) · takoyaki ¥860, tako-shiso cheese ¥960, Tako no Tetsu-yaki with octopus, beef and shrimp ¥960, Tako no Tetsu sour ¥650 (September 2026) · official menu (undated): tropical-yaki with corn, cheese and pineapple, taiyo-yaki with changja and cheese, buta-tama and other okonomiyaki, modern-yaki, pizza-flavour yaki, yakisoba or yaki-udon with pork and squid, soba-meshi, tonpei-yaki · sauces (six per Tabelog; the official site describes five): the house sauce made with Oliver Sauce, sesame soy made daily by the head chef, thick doro sauce, bonito-dashi tako-tsuyu for Akashi-yaki style dipping, ponzu (official site) · weekday lunch sets with a drink and free refills of rice and miso soup (official site) · courses with 120-minute all-you-can-drink: 7 dishes ¥4,300, 8 dishes ¥5,000, three or more (Tabelog) · house sauce and frozen shiso takoyaki to take home (official site)
places.notes: [Takoyaki · Umeda, behind HEP FIVE] A takoyaki shop where you grill your own at the table, as guests have since 1979; the official site calls it the original of the style. Staff pour in the batter and octopus to start you off and help if yours won't come out round; then add pickled ginger and tenkasu, shape, and choose from the house sauce made with Oliver Sauce, a spicy doro sauce, sesame soy, ponzu or a bonito-dashi dip. The smokeless tables were patented by the previous owner, and the griddles have been in use since the shop opened (Tabelog). Walls are covered in celebrity autographs. A serving of 12 is ¥860; okonomiyaki, yakisoba (one diner's highlight was the ponzu yakisoba), soba-meshi and an all-you-can-drink course from ¥4,300 make it a group spot, with tatami and sunken seating. Diners call it fun more than gourmet: one found home-grilled takoyaki short of a professional's (October 2026). Sister shops at KITTE Osaka and Grand Green Osaka.

roles: Head chef (料理長, unnamed), who makes the sesame soy sauce daily (official site)
Previous owner (先代, unnamed), who developed the patented smokeless table and the batter recipe (official site; Tabelog)
chef_bio.origin: Opened in 1979 (official site; Tabelog opening date 1 August 1979).
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (read 2026-11-01): "1979年の蛸之徹創業以来 楽しく・美味しく・変わらぬ味にこだわり続ける 元祖【自分でたこ焼を焼いて食べるお店】"; the smokeless table developed and patented by the previous owner and the teppan inherited from the founding; the batter recipe the previous owner devised, unchanged since 1979; octopus never frozen, bought fresh daily; Kujo green onions from a contracted Kyoto farm; the house sauce developed with Oliver Sauce. The shop listing says over 2,000 well-known guests have visited (Tabelog). Branches: Grand Green Osaka and KITTE Osaka (opening notice dated 31 July 2024); a closure notice for the Marubiru shop is dated 25 May 2023 (official site news).
chef_bio.philosophy: "楽しく・美味しく・変わらぬ味" — fun, delicious, an unchanging taste (official site).

anecdotes.text: "The staff helped by adding the octopus and batter to get us started! I added some pickled ginger and tenkasu, and started shaping them." — August 2026, a lunch before heading home.
"Feeling frustrated about not grilling it well the first time, I ordered another serving to challenge myself, and I was able to grill it better than the first time" — September 2026, takoyaki ¥860.
"The walls are adorned with signatures from famous personalities, making the wait for the takoyaki enjoyable." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 1979年創業、元祖「自分でたこ焼を焼いて食べるお店」、先代が開発し特許を取った無煙テーブル、創業からの鉄板、先代が調合した秘伝の生地、冷凍しない生だこを毎日仕入れ、京都の契約農家の九条ネギ、花かつお、オリバーソースと共同開発の特製ソース、料理長が毎日作るゴマ醤油、どろソース、たこつゆ、ポン酢、たこ焼860円、蛸之徹焼960円、たこシソチーズ焼960円、平日のランチはドリンクつき、ご飯とみそ汁のおかわり無料、ほかにグラングリーン大阪店と KITTE大阪店 (2024年7月31日付けのオープンのお知らせ)、マルビル店の閉店のお知らせは2023年5月25日付け。食べログ (店舗会員): 大阪市北区角田町1-10 くろふねビル 1F、毎日11:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、平日ランチ11:30〜15:00、不定休、47席、座敷と掘りごたつ、半個室6名、禁煙、英語メニュー、子ども歓迎、飲み放題つきコース4,300円・5,000円、1979年8月1日オープン。口コミ (2026年8〜10月): スタッフが最初に生地とたこを入れてくれる、1人前12個、有名人のサインの壁、ポン酢の焼きそば、金曜の夜は待ちが出た、自分で焼くとプロの味にはかなわないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog) and a bilingual official site; staff help first-time grillers (official site; 2026 reviews). Popular with visitors to Osaka (2026 reviews).

places.name: 北新地 鮨 天ぷら いわい 別邸 (Kitashinchi Sushi Tempura Iwai Bettei)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Courses combine sushi with tempura (wheat batter) and side dishes such as a fish katsu sandwich (July 2026); sushi is usually served with soy sauce or a soy glaze, which normally contains wheat.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses of sushi, seafood and tempura.

Reservations accepted; phone cancellations are not taken outside business hours (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: counter and private rooms for 2, 4 and 6; whole-shop hire up to 20; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 10 September 2023 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Edo-style sushi and tempura in one course, from the Iwai group that began as a tempura and wine restaurant in Ashiya (official site; Tabelog) · lunch: weekday nigiri set ¥4,990 (13 items), Omakase Upper ¥6,990 (15 items), Premium Omakase with tempura ¥9,990 (18 items) (Tabelog, tax included) · a ¥6,990 course (August 2026); a ¥10,000 course of appetizers, tempura and sushi (July 2026) · an August 2026 dinner: Akashi octopus, sea bream with shuto, fruit-tomato frappé, steamed abalone, amberjack, bonito, grilled cutlassfish, marinated lean tuna, a one-bite ikura bowl, chawanmushi with shirasu, kombu-cured sea bream, seared kinmedai, toro, red miso soup, tamago, toro-taku roll, fruit · a kaiseki course in October 2026: three appetizers, seven nigiri, ikura bowl, seafood chawanmushi, maki, tamago, soup, seasonal-fruit dessert · shrimp tempura and a fish katsu sandwich (summer 2026) · rare sake and beer (August 2026); wine, shochu and cocktails (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, sushi and tempura in one course] The Kitashinchi branch of Iwai, a group that grew from a tempura and wine restaurant in Ashiya whose Michelin star two years running made its name (official site); here the tempura shares a course with Edo-style sushi. Weekday lunch starts at a ¥4,990 nigiri set and climbs to a ¥9,990 premium omakase with tempura, which makes it one of the gentler ways into a Kitashinchi counter; at dinner diners report spending ¥10,000–14,999 (Tabelog). Courses open with small seasonal dishes (Akashi octopus, a fruit-tomato frappé, steamed abalone in August 2026), then tempura and nigiri such as kombu-cured sea bream, seared kinmedai and toro. Diners describe a chef who talks diners through each dish and puts nervous first-timers at ease; the tempura is soft rather than crisp, which a June 2026 diner did not care for and a July 2026 diner called a matter of taste. Private rooms for two to six (a December 2025 diner booked one for a business dinner); tell the chef if you are short of time. Service charge 10%.

roles: Head chef (unnamed), who explains each dish (July 2026 review)
chef_bio.origin: Branch of 鮨 天ぷら いわい, which began in Ashiya, Hyogo as 天ぷら&ワイン いわい (official site).
chef_bio.background: Group site (read 2026-11-01): the original Ashiya restaurant earned a Michelin star two years running ("ミシュランガイドで2年連続一つ星を獲得"), then opened in Gion (Kyoto), Ginza (Tokyo), Hiroshima and elsewhere, some shops adding Edo-style sushi; the shops listed now are Kitashinchi, Hiroshima, Gion, Kichijoji and Ginza. The group's owner (店主, unnamed) holds wine-sommelier and vegetable-sommelier qualifications, grew up in a family that ran a Japanese restaurant, and has long hotel experience. The Tabelog listing calls this shop the Kitashinchi opening of the Michelin-listed "Ashiya Iwai"; the group site lists the same address as 北新地 鮨 天ぷら いわい. In 2026 reviews the owner is "very approachable" (August) and the head chef explains each dish (July).
chef_bio.philosophy: "自然の物語を天ぷらに閉じ込める" — sealing nature's story into tempura, with seasonal produce (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi and tempura in one course.

anecdotes.text: "As soon as we were seated, the chef kindly engaged us in conversation, helping my wife, who is usually shy, to relax." — August 2026, a second visit, with family.
"Given the location, the staff is mindful of time, so if you're in a hurry, it might be a good idea to inform the chef in advance!" — July 2026, a family celebration on the ¥10,000 course.
"Since we were seated at the counter, we could watch the sushi being prepared right in front of us" — October 2026, lunch on the Omakase Premium Course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 鮨 天ぷら いわい、兵庫県芦屋市の「天ぷら&ワイン いわい」から始まり、ミシュランガイドで2年連続一つ星、その後祇園、銀座、広島などに出店、一部の店では江戸前寿司も、店主はワインソムリエと野菜ソムリエの資格を持ち、日本料理店が生家でホテルでの経験も豊富、店舗は北新地、広島、祇園、吉祥寺、銀座。北新地の店: 大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-9-11 1F、ランチ11:30〜14:00、ディナー17:00〜23:00 (土日祝16:00〜23:00)、不定休、サービス料10%。食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 鮨 天ぷら いわい 別邸、北新地駅から徒歩2分、平日限定ランチのにぎりのセット4,990円、ランチのおまかせ6,990円、天ぷらつきの Premium Omakase 9,990円、20席、個室2・4・6名、禁煙、子ども可、2023年9月10日オープン。口コミ (2026年1〜10月): 1万円のコース、6,990円のコース、前菜、天ぷら、握り、いくらの小さな丼、茶碗蒸し、大将が料理を説明して緊張をほぐしてくれる、珍しい日本酒とビール、天ぷらはさくさくではなくやわらかめ、急ぐなら先に伝えて。

places.cuisine: Seven-seat sushi counter; fish chosen by the chef every morning, rice cooked in a clay pot, red-vinegar rice (Tabelog; reviews) · menu changes monthly (Tabelog) · dinner omakase ¥13,200 tax included (Tabelog; September 2026); lunch courses ¥6,600 and ¥8,800 (Tabelog; an ¥8,800 lunch in September 2026) · a ¥9,900 course in December 2024 and ¥9,000 in June 2024 · September 2026 omakase: butternut-squash potage with crab, tsurumurasaki flowers and pink pepper; seared bonito with corn sauce; ayu spring rolls with Manganji pepper and shiso, served with grapes; sanma sushi with matsutake, chives and a heap of ikura; hamo with fried eggplant in matsutake ankake; then nigiri such as finely scored squid, flounder, sweet shrimp, sawara with yuzu pepper, sea urchin, marinated lean tuna, toro, oyster, kinmedai and lightly simmered anago; aosa red miso soup · October 2026: kensaki squid and steamed sawara with white miso · sake and wine
places.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi main street, seven seats] A seven-seat counter on Kitashinchi's main street that began as a standing sushi bar; the sign still said so in December 2024, but everyone sits now. The chef picks the fish each morning, the rice is cooked in a clay pot and seasoned with red vinegar, and the monthly omakase mixes inventive small plates with small, easy nigiri: in September 2026, a butternut-squash potage with crab, seared bonito with a corn sauce, ayu spring rolls, sanma sushi heaped with ikura, then about ten nigiri including oyster, marinated tuna and fluffy anago. At ¥13,200 for dinner (lunch ¥6,600 or ¥8,800), diners call it remarkably reasonable for Kitashinchi. The chef is friendly and full of jokes, described in a December 2024 review as multilingual. One December 2025 diner felt rushed by sushi piling up; on a return in September 2026 the same diner found the service much improved. Seats are close together. No children below junior-high age; book ahead.

roles: Chef (unnamed), who chooses the fish each morning (Tabelog; December 2024 review)
Owner (unnamed; mentioned in a September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened on 28 November 2013 (Tabelog); first a standing sushi bar, now seated (reviews, December 2024 and September 2026). Tabelog Sushi WEST 100, 2021. The shop text: sushi has become more exclusive over time, and the shop aims to bring back the casualness and joy of sushi's origins, travelling the country to choose ingredients (Tabelog). Diners describe a "friendly and skilled chef" who "runs the establishment with charm" (September 2026), a chef "sharing some silly jokes to lighten the mood" (September 2026), and a "multilingual and friendly chef" (December 2024); a June 2024 diner heard that the chef is "quite the eccentric cook".
chef_bio.philosophy: To recreate the casualness and joy of sushi's origins and show each ingredient at its best (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly omakase of small plates and nigiri on red-vinegar rice.

anecdotes.text: "Next was the Katsuo no Tataki. I was told to enjoy it with a sauce made from corn paste... I thought it was a bold dish, but it paired perfectly and was delicious!" — September 2026, the ¥13,200 course.
"Although it mentions standing sushi, you can now enjoy it seated at a leisurely pace." — September 2026, the ¥12,000 omakase (before tax).
"I visited after 9 months, and it seems there has been some training implemented. The service has significantly improved." — September 2026, a return after a December 2025 visit that felt rushed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨 惣五郎、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-3-32 新地リバティービル 1F、北新地駅から徒歩2分、毎日11:30〜14:00、17:00〜23:00、営業中は電話に出られないことがあるのでネット予約を、おまかせ13,200円、ランチ6,600円と8,800円 (税込、月替わり)、年末年始は追加料金、カード (VISA、Master)、カウンター7席 (すべて椅子)、禁煙、中学生未満は不可、香水は控えめに、毎朝仕入れる食材、土鍋で炊くご飯、2013年11月28日オープン、寿司 WEST 百名店 2021。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年10月): 赤酢のシャリ、小ぶりの握り、かぼちゃのポタージュ、カツオとコーンのソース、鮎の春巻き、いくらをのせたサンマの鮨、はもと茄子の松茸あんかけ、牡蠣の握り、もとは立ち鮨で今は座って食べる、冗談の好きな気さくな大将、2025年12月に急かされたと感じた人が2026年9月にはサービスがよくなったと書いている。

cultural_comfort.note: One omakase course explained at the counter; book online (Tabelog). A December 2024 review calls the chef multilingual and notes many international guests; no English menu listed.

places.name: CRITTERS BURGER (クリッターズバーガー)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Every burger comes on the house bun of Hokkaido wheat (Kansai Walker 2018; a September 2026 review), and pancakes, fries and onion rings fill out the menu; no gluten-free bun is described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the burgers are built on an all-beef patty with mayonnaise, bacon, cheese or egg, and no meat-free burger appears in the sources read.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00, last order 21:00; weekday lunch 11:00–16:00; open all year (Tabelog). Reservations only for the evening, from 18:00; walk in at lunch, when a few groups may be waiting at opening (Tabelog; September–October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) for bills over ¥5,000, e-money and QR payments; PayPay (Tabelog; October 2026 review). 25 seats, tables only; smoking allowed from 17:00, non-smoking until then; pets allowed; take-out (Tabelog). Opened 23 May 2009 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-10-35, アルシュ11 1F, in Amerikamura — 1 min from Yotsubashi Stn, 3 min from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 7
places.cuisine: American-style burgers on house buns of Hokkaido wheat and natural yeast, baked at the sister bakery West Wood Bakers, with an all-beef patty, no filler, of domestic and imported beef, and mayonnaise and mustard in place of sauce (Kansai Walker 2018) · Double Cheeseburger ¥2,365 (October 2026) · spinach bacon burger with sautéed spinach, the No. 1 seller in 2018 and still ordered in 2026 · avocado cheeseburger, avocado bacon cheeseburger · jalapeño cheeseburger · mozzarella mushroom burger · double burger · a seasonal maitake béchamel burger (October 2026) · burgers come with fries, or fries and salad at lunch · onion rings · bacon-and-egg pancakes · shakes such as chocolate banana · ginger ale, Dr Pepper, guava juice, draft beer
places.notes: [Burgers · Amerikamura, a pioneer since 2009] A wood-fronted American burger house in Amerikamura that opened in 2009, before gourmet burgers had caught on in Kansai, and has been in Tabelog's Hamburger 100 seven times since 2017. The bun is the point: made from Hokkaido wheat and natural yeast at the sister bakery, toasted, fluffy inside and firm enough to hold the juicy all-beef patty to the last bite. Order the double cheeseburger (¥2,365 in October 2026), or the spinach bacon burger, the house favourite since at least 2018. Expect a few groups waiting at the 11:00 opening and many overseas visitors; evening tables can be booked from 18:00. Note that smoking is allowed from 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Kansai Walker (2018): the representative 栗田宗太朗 went to an international school hoping to study at an American university, then trained at an architecture college, qualified as an architect and worked three or four years as a site supervisor for a housebuilder. The father, a programmer, baked bread as a hobby and opened a bakery near the family home, baking every morning while the mother sold the bread; the younger brother, three years younger, came in to help. The brothers decided to make burgers with that bread, ran a mobile stall for about a year around 淀屋橋 and at festivals, and opened the shop in Shinsaibashi, an area known since high school, in 2009 with 20 burgers on the menu. The first two years were hard and delivery kept the shop going. When the family bakery could no longer keep up with the buns, West Wood Bakers opened in 2013, then The Pie Shop in 2016 (Kansai Walker). Time Out (2025) calls it a pioneer of high-end beef burgers in Osaka. Tabelog Hamburger 100 in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Bring American food culture to Japan and serve it with an arrangement of our own" (Kansai Walker 2018, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Spinach bacon burger; double cheeseburger; house buns of Hokkaido wheat.

anecdotes.text: "The bun was fluffy on top and firmer on the bottom, with a slight sweetness from the bread and richness from the cheese" — October 2026, a Double Cheeseburger for JPY 2,365 on a Sunday at 5:50 PM; full 15 minutes later.
"The music playing in the restaurant happened to be my favorite Southern American artists like Dr. John and Lynyrd Skynyrd" — September 2026, a spinach bacon burger before a concert.
"I entered the restaurant a bit hesitantly, but I was warmly welcomed." — September 2026, the mozzarella mushroom burger lunch set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 関西ウォーカー (ウォーカープラス、2018年): クリッターズバーガー、まだ関西にグルメバーガーの波が来ていなかった2009年から関西のハンバーガー界を牽引、代表の栗田宗太朗さん、高校はインターナショナルスクール、建築の専門学校で建築士の資格、ハウスメーカーの現場監督を3、4年、プログラマーの父が趣味でパンを作り家の近所にパン屋、毎朝父が焼き母が売る、3つ下の弟が手伝い、兄弟でハンバーガーを作ることに、淀屋橋やフェスで移動販売を約1年、心斎橋に路面店、メニューは最初から20種、最初の2年は苦労してデリバリーで食いつなぐ、2013年にウエストウッドベーカーズ、2016年にザ パイ ショップ、バンズは姉妹店で焼く北海道産小麦100%のブレンドと天然酵母の長時間発酵、パティは牛100%つなぎなし、国産牛と輸入牛のブレンド、ソースは使わずマヨネーズとマスタードのみ、人気ナンバーワンはスピナッチ（ホウレンソウ）ベーコンバーガー、ベーコンエッグパンケーキも人気、テーブル席のみ、テラス席、創業2009年5月23日。公式サイト: 大阪市中央区西心斎橋一丁目10-35 1階、無休、姉妹店 Critters Pizza、West Wood Bakers、The Pie Shop。食べログ (店舗会員): 毎日11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、平日ランチ11:00〜16:00、夜のみ予約可 (18時以降)、カードは5,000円以上、電子マネー・QR可、25席、17時まで禁煙でその後は喫煙可、ペット可、テイクアウト可、ハンバーガー 百名店 2017〜2019・2021・2022・2024・2026。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): ダブルチーズバーガー2,365円、トーストしたふわふわのバンズ、ジューシーなパティ、ほうれん草とベーコンのバーガー、開店時から数組が待つ、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: A photo menu at the entrance (October 2026); many overseas visitors (August and October 2026); covered in English by Time Out. No English menu evidence found.

places.name: Cafe 婆沙羅 かえる堂 (Cafe Basara Kaeru dou)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The house curry is a thick sauce simmered for 100 hours with no stated ingredients, and much of the menu is breaded or wrapped: katsu curry, croquettes, fried vegetables, omurice with demi-glace, curry ramen; the monthly Inaka Gozen has included grilled fresh wheat gluten (July 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. There is a vegetable curry (September 2026), the monthly Inaka Gozen is mostly vegetables (July 2026), and the omurice can come with a soy-milk cream sauce (September 2026), but nothing is stated about the curry base, stock or dairy.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:00–20:00; Wed 11:00–15:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Weekday lunch until 15:00 includes a free coffee or tea (July and October 2026 reviews). Lunch fills up around noon; mid-afternoon is quieter (2026 reviews). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 40 seats with sofas and a terrace; smoking only on the terrace; dogs welcome on the terrace; children welcome (Tabelog). The monthly Inaka Gozen menu is posted on Instagram at the start of each month (July 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Kita-Horie 2-2-24, PRADIPA 1F, a slightly hidden spot — 1 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn exit 3; 5 min from Yotsubashi Stn
places.cuisine: Curry café with a long menu · the house curry, fruits and vegetables simmered 100 hours until they melt into a thick, fruity sauce that turns spicy at the end (BAILA blog; July 2026 review) · Tonchi curry with grilled pork like chashu and cheese ¥1,200 (August 2026) · as a plate with salad, yogurt and fruit · katsu curry · croquette curry · vegetable curry · toppings such as cheese chashu, croquettes and piled-up fried vegetables (lotus root, green beans, pumpkin, eggplant) · jambalaya, fried rice with chopped Tonchi and takana under the curry · omurice in small, medium or large, with the curry, with demi-glace, or W sauce of soy-milk cream and demi-glace · cheese Indian omurice ¥1,300 (October 2026) · Inaka Gozen ¥1,500, a monthly set of many small dishes (July 2026); in September 2026 it was a tenderloin-cutlet curry with 13 dishes · curry ramen; chilled Chinese noodles in summer · parfaits, zenzai · ginger chai, Tropical Paradise juice, melon cream soda, coffee, draft beer
places.notes: [Curry café · Kita-Horie by Nishi-Ohashi Stn] A slightly hidden, old-style café a minute from Nishi-Ohashi Station, where the smell of curry reaches the street. The curry is the reason to come: fruits and vegetables simmered for 100 hours into a thick sauce, sweet and fruity at first and then building heat. Order the Tonchi curry with grilled pork and cheese (¥1,200 in August 2026), add croquettes or a pile of fried vegetables, or have it over omurice; at weekday lunch a coffee or tea comes free, and a large rice gets a refill. The monthly Inaka Gozen of small vegetable dishes is the lighter choice. The owner cooks everything alone, so busy lunches mean a short wait (September 2026). Dogs are welcome on the terrace. Cash only. Tabelog Cafe WEST 100 in 2021, 2022 and 2025.

roles: Owner-cook, unnamed in the sources read
chef_bio.background: A September 2026 diner writes that the owner cooks everything alone, with staff serving, and describes a table at the back that carries "the owner's unique atmosphere". The BAILA blog (2024, updated 2026) calls it an old-house-style café known for a curry of fruits and vegetables simmered 100 hours, and a past Tabelog 100 shop. Tabelog Cafe WEST 100 in 2021, 2022 and 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: 100-hour curry; Tonchi curry; omurice with curry and demi-glace.

anecdotes.text: "The presentation was impressive, with fried vegetables piled high on top of the katsu." — September 2026, a katsu curry plate after 1 PM, with a short wait because the owner cooks everything alone.
"The staff kindly changed my partner's order to the large size because they were happy to see us enjoying our meal." — October 2026, on the terrace.
"The curry is simmered for 100 hours, resulting in a thick, sauce-like consistency that is wonderfully rich. It doesn't contain any chunks of ingredients." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: BAILA (ブログ、2024年、2026年更新): Cafe 婆沙羅 かえる堂、「100時間煮込んだカレー」が評判の古民家風カフェ、西大橋駅から徒歩1分ほどの隠れ家、どこか懐かしい店内、ランチ時は満席になりがち、自家製オムライスに100時間煮込んだカレーとデミグラスソース、カレーはフルーツの甘い味わいのあとにジワジワ辛さ、濃厚でコクがある、ジャンバラヤのカレーがけ、カツカレー、果物と野菜をとろけるまで100時間煮込む、過去に百名店。食べログ: 大阪市西区北堀江2-2-24 PRADIPA 1F、西大橋駅3番出口から徒歩1分、月・火・金・土・日11:00〜20:00、水11:00〜15:00、木曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、40席、ソファ席とオープンテラス、喫煙はテラス席のみ、ペットはテラス席のみ、子ども可、カフェ WEST 百名店 2021・2022・2025。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): Tonchi カレー1,200円、プレートはサラダ、ヨーグルト、フルーツ付き、平日ランチはコーヒーか紅茶のサービス、Cheese Indian omurice 1,300円、Inaka Gozen 1,500円は月替わりで小鉢がたくさん、ライス大盛りはおかわり可、オーナーがひとりで料理を作る、テラスは犬連れ可、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the table from a long menu with a cute design (July 2026); staff described as kind and attentive (2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: 味乃家 本店 (Ajinoya Honten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: okonomiyaki and negiyaki are wheat-batter dishes and the yakisoba uses the house noodles; no gluten-free option described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every okonomiyaki, negiyaki and yakisoba on the official menu carries pork, beef, seafood, egg or cheese.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00, a full close at 22:00; closed Monday and New Year's Day, and sometimes the last Monday and Tuesday of the month (official site). Tabelog gives last order 21:30, and on Friday and Saturday 11:00–22:30 (last order 22:00). No same-day bookings and no bookings by phone or email; a TableCheck FastPass buys a timed place at the front of the queue (up to 4 people, valid 15 minutes after the slot, the whole party present, 90 minutes at busy times), and bookings through AutoReserve are void (official site). The queue is otherwise long: an hour or more at 17:00–18:00 in October 2026, with a check-in terminal outside that sends an SMS as your turn nears, and orders taken while you wait. Each okonomiyaki takes about 15 minutes to cook (official site). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 10 counter seats and 10 tables, up to 45 people (official site; Tabelog says 50 seats); non-smoking; English menu; children welcome (Tabelog). Founded 1965 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Namba 1-7-16, 現代こいさんビル 2F, opposite the 松竹座 stage door, between Midosuji and Shinsaibashi-suji — 3 min from Namba Stn exit 14
places.cuisine: Osaka okonomiyaki cooked by the staff on the teppan at your table (prices from the official menu, tax included, revised 15 April 2026) · Ajinoya Mix okonomiyaki with squid, octopus, pork, minced beef and prawn ¥1,780 (the No. 1 seller) · fresh tomato and cheese okonomiyaki ¥1,780 · mochi okonomiyaki with cheese ¥1,680 · special mix with whole prawn, scallop, beef and corn ¥3,480 · Hiroshima-yaki with pork and noodles ¥1,580 · pork, squid or prawn okonomiyaki ¥1,100 · Kujo green-onion negiyaki with stewed beef tendon ¥1,580, or with squid, pork or prawn ¥1,380, served with ponzu and sesame sauce · mix yakisoba topped with a fried egg ¥1,980 (large ¥2,230) · house-made stewed beef tendon ¥980 · tonpeiyaki ¥780 · yam steak ¥580 · Chinese-cabbage kimchi ¥480 · fluffy takoyaki ¥980 (limited) · set B for two, mix okonomiyaki, mix yakisoba and tendon negiyaki ¥5,340 · beer, highballs (Black Nikka ¥600 in October 2026), chuhai, sake, shochu
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Namba, a queue since 1965] An okonomiyaki house founded in 1965, on a second floor opposite the stage door of the 松竹座 theatre, with a retro interior that the shop itself likens to a trip back to an old downtown okonomiyaki stand. Staff mix, pour, flip and sauce every okonomiyaki on the iron plate at your table; the batter is light, the result fluffy, sweetish sauce on top. Order the Ajinoya Mix, the tomato and cheese, or the Kujo green-onion negiyaki with beef tendon, which October 2026 diners singled out. The queue is the catch: in October 2026 an hour or more at dinner, so register at the terminal outside, walk off and come back on the text message, or buy a FastPass. In Tabelog's Okonomiyaki 100 most years since 2018, it now has two sister shops, 味乃家はなれ and 四代目味乃家, the second opened in July 2026 at the Namba Oriental Hotel.

roles: Shop manager (店舗責任者) of the main shop: 空山 嘉津子 (official site)
Operator: Ajinoya Inc.; news on the official site is signed 味乃家 店主
chef_bio.background: Founded 1965 in Namba and "passed down through four generations" (Tabelog shop text). The official site describes over 50 years of okonomiyaki grilled in front of the customer, so that diners enjoy the sizzle, the smell and the fluffy texture. Sister shops: 味乃家はなれ (reservation only, formerly the 寺田町 central kitchen, 天王寺区) and 四代目味乃家 (opened 31 July 2026 in The Namba Central Eatery, Namba Oriental Hotel 1F). Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100 in 2018, 2019, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025; an October 2026 diner writes that it has consistently received a Bib Gourmand.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Each one grilled with care, one at a time" (official site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Ajinoya Mix okonomiyaki; Kujo green-onion negiyaki with beef tendon; mix yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: "After checking in at the terminal outside, we were assigned number 19. … the restaurant has a system that sends an SMS notification to your registered phone number as your turn approaches" — October 2026, seated after about an hour.
"What stood out the most was the Kujo Negi-yaki. The abundant flavor and aroma of the Kujo green onions were exceptional" — October 2026.
"While there are many table seats, solo diners are directed to the counter." — October 2026, Ajinoya Mix for JPY 1,780 at about 4 PM on a weekday, with four people ahead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 味乃家 本店、1965年創業、食いだおれ大阪・難波で50年以上続くお好み焼きの老舗、松竹座の向い楽屋口前、大阪市中央区難波1-7-16 現代こいさんビル 2階、店舗責任者 空山 嘉津子、カウンター席10席、テーブル10卓、最大45名、火〜日・祝11:00〜22:00 (22時に完全閉店)、月曜と元日休み、最終月曜と火曜が休みになることも、当日予約不可、電話・メールの予約不可、TableCheck の FastPass (1回1〜4名、指定時間から15分まで有効、混雑時は90分制、全員揃って来店)、AutoReserve 経由の予約は無効、焼き上がりまで約15分、2026年4月15日からメニューの一部見直しと価格改定、味乃家ミックスお好み焼き1,780円 (人気1位)、ミックス焼きそば1,980円 (人気2位)、京都九条ネギ入りネギ焼き すじ肉1,580円 (人気3位、ポン酢とゴマダレ付き)、新鮮トマトと特選チーズのお好み焼き1,780円、餅入りお好み焼き1,680円、スペシャルミックスお好み焼き3,480円、広島焼き1,580円、自家製牛すじ煮込み980円、味乃家特選Bセット5,340円 (2名向き)、税込。姉妹店に味乃家はなれ (完全予約制、旧 寺田町セントラルキッチン店、天王寺区大道2-5-11) と四代目味乃家 (2026年7月31日オープン、なんばオリエンタルホテル1階)。食べログ (店舗会員): 4代にわたる味、キャベツたっぷりで生地は軽め、ふわふわのお好み焼き、PayPay 可、カード不可、禁煙、英語メニューあり、お好み焼き 百名店 2018・2019・2022〜2025。口コミ(2026年10月): 1時間以上の行列、外の端末で受付して順番が近づくと SMS、並びながら注文、各テーブルの鉄板でスタッフが焼く、九条ネギのネギ焼きが好評、ひとり客はカウンター、海外の客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); the official site has English, Chinese and Korean pages; staff cook at the table; many overseas customers (October 2026).

places.name: ペスカ 心斎橋店 (PESCA Shinsaibashi)

The signature "Paitza" is a pizza on flaky pastry, and pasta, baguette and cakes run through the courses; carpaccio, steak, duck and garlic rice are dishes without obvious wheat, but nothing is stated about their sauces.

No sign on the ground floor: take the lift to the top, 10th floor and walk to the far end of the outdoor corridor (September 2026 reviews).

places.notes: [Italian · Nishi-Shinsaibashi, a 10th-floor hideaway] An Italian restaurant with no sign at street level: take the lift of an apartment-like building on the Amerikamura side to the top floor and walk to the end of the open corridor. Inside are a counter of about ten, two tables and soft light, with one chef at the counter, a cook behind and two people serving (September 2026). Order the carpaccio of three fish, which several 2026 diners singled out, and the "Paitza", a pizza on crisp, flaky pastry, then a pasta, such as mackerel and bottarga or duck and porcini cream. Couples, groups of friends and birthday dinners fill it, and the kitchen will write a message on the dessert plate. Tabelog puts the average at ¥5,000–5,999 a head, and the courses run ¥6,600–8,800; open from 15:00 to midnight. Tabelog Italian 100 in 2021; there is a sister shop in Namba.

roles: Chef unnamed in the sources read

A September 2026 diner saw one main chef at the counter, two staff serving and one person in the kitchen. A regular's June 2025 note says the restaurant had recently been featured on TV. Reviews mention a Namba branch and 食堂ペスカ (September 2026). Tabelog Italian 100 in 2021.

places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Souemoncho, until 4 a.m.] A third-floor okonomiyaki counter in a mixed-use building on the Souemoncho street, easy to miss among the touts below, and open until four in the morning, which makes it a late-night favourite of local drinkers; it was named a Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100 in 2025. The okonomiyaki is fluffy and light, with cabbage that keeps its crunch and a sweetish sauce, and it comes to the teppan in front of you, with room on the counter for a proper plate. Start with grilled squid or plump shrimp with mayonnaise and mustard over a drink, then a pork okonomiyaki (¥950 in October 2026, or ¥1,350 for a double), a beef and egg modern-yaki or the yakisoba omelet one diner rated above everything else. Mains run ¥950–2,100. Book: an August 2026 diner found every seat reserved. Closed Sundays; holidays close at 21:00.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100, 2025. Reviewers call it long-established and a favourite of local drinkers (August and September 2026). No owner or chef is named in the sources read.

places.notes: [Chinese · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, dim sum and a live tank] A large Hong Kong-style dining room up a lift above a 7-Eleven, with a tank of live sea bream, abalone and kuruma prawns at the door and round tables for groups; named a Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 in 2021. The dim sum is made by a chef holding China's special-grade dim sum master qualification, the wrappers in house, and the tank fish is cooked as you choose, including a Chinese-style sashimi dressed with soy, sesame and cashews. Lunch is the bargain: weekly sets from ¥850 with free rice and soup (a ¥1,000 pork and vegetable set came with gyoza, tofu and almond jelly in August 2026), or dim sum courses from ¥1,950 for two. Evenings lean to banquets: about ¥6,000–7,000 for a course with all-you-can-drink. Diners in 2026 praised the gentle spice and the homemade dim sum wrappers, while one found the staff blunt (September 2026) and another was unimpressed in a near-empty room (October 2026). Add 3% service. The company also runs a branch in Umeda and a hotel in Shima.

roles: Dim sum chef (unnamed) holding China's 特級点心師 qualification (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the dim sum is made by a 特級点心師, a Chinese national qualification for cooks with eight grades taken one at a time in exams held every two years, so that it takes at least fifteen years to reach; the chef has more than twenty years of cooking. Seafood bought from the market goes live into the tank and is cooked to order. The shop is the 心斎橋本店 of 會通株式会社, which also runs a branch in Umeda (Breeze Breeze 6F) and the 一楽温泉ホテル in Shima, Mie (honkonkaisen.com); Tabelog says seafood comes direct from that hotel. Tabelog Chinese WEST 100, 2021. An August 2026 diner notes the staff are Chinese.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Warm human contact" and "handmade" food, not service bound by a manual (company site).
chef_bio.specialty: Dim sum; live-tank sea bream and abalone; Chinese-style sashimi.

anecdotes.text: "Not only was the filling of the dim sum delicious, but the wrappers were also homemade, and the shark fin soup was delightful." — October 2026, a dim sum lunch course.
"Both rice and soup are refillable. … I was truly impressed that such a meal was available at this price." — August 2026, stir-fried pork and vegetable set ¥1,000.
"As someone who isn't fond of spicy food, I asked, 'Is this dish spicy?' and was met with a blunt response" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 香港海鮮飲茶樓 心斎橋本店、本格海鮮料理と香港飲茶、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-12-17 ロンスカール高吉ビル2F、心斎橋駅から徒歩6分、長堀橋駅から徒歩4分、セブンイレブンの二階、ランチ11:00〜15:00、ディナー17:00〜23:00 (平日L.O.22:30、土日祝L.O.22:00)、不定休、入口から段差なしで車いす可、5,000円以上で提携駐車場1時間分。特級点心師 (中国の国家資格、八段階、最低十五年) が作る点心、料理経験二十年以上、市場直送の活魚を店内のいけすへ、中華風特選ソースとゴマ・カシューナッツの中華風刺身、伝統の美容茶「九龍茶」と茶芸のパフォーマンス、アレルギーや苦手な食材には出来る限り料理の変更に対応。ランチ: 週替わり850円〜1,300円、ご飯とスープおかわり自由、本格飲茶コース1,950円、自家製飲茶コース2,480円、ヘルシーコース3,590円、小籠包セット1,480円、五種点心セット1,750円。お品書き: 活魚5,500円〜、活あわび1,540円〜、海老のマヨネーズ1,520円、XO醤入り蟹と春雨の土鍋1,850円、北京ダック (1本) 660円、酢豚1,680円、フカヒレの姿煮8,800円、あわびの姿煮5,500円。運営は會通株式会社 (梅田店、一楽温泉ホテルも)。食べログ (店舗会員): 毎日11:00〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、祝日は夜のみ、年中無休、サービス料3%、110席、個室、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、子ども・ベビーカー可、飲み放題つきコース5,980円から、中国料理 WEST 百名店 2021。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 1,000円の定食、週末も同じランチ、自家製の皮の点心、フカヒレスープ、マイルドな辛さの麻婆豆腐、海鮮豆腐、小籠包、11品と90分飲み放題で6,980円、エレベーターで店内へ、中国人のスタッフ、そっけない対応という声、昔の百名店の面影はないという声。

places.cuisine: French set courses with a choice of mains (prices as listed on Ikyu, per an April 2026 review): lunch ¥3,800 and ¥5,300, dinner ¥7,700, ¥11,000 and ¥16,500 · ¥3,800 lunch with a choice of starter, main and dessert, in generous portions (January and March 2026) · the ¥16,500 dinner in April 2026: new-onion bavarois with chilled pea soup, young bluefin (yokowa) tuna tartare with tomato jelly, lobster terrine, seafood sauté in soup (conger eel, shrimp, squid, octopus), sea bream with américaine sauce, a choice of four meats (Ezo venison with red wine sauce, lamb breast roast and others), Ezo venison meat sauce with pilaf, brown-sugar bavarois, coffee; baguette refills · other 2025–26 dishes: gougères, country pâté, Rausu mackerel tartare, Hungarian duckling roast, Iberico pork, roast goose, strawberry mille-feuille · a wine cellar
places.notes: [French · Shinmachi, generous courses on a quiet corner] A calm French restaurant on a back-street corner in Shinmachi, a few minutes from Yotsubashi, at this address since 2003 and named a Tabelog French WEST 100 in 2021. Courses come with a choice of mains and portions that diners keep calling generous: three appetisers before the fish, a lobster terrine that more than one diner singles out, then a pick of four meats such as Ezo venison, lamb or duckling, and a small serving of venison meat sauce with pilaf to finish. Lunch at ¥3,800 lets you choose starter, main and dessert; dinner courses run ¥7,700–16,500. Staff pace the courses well, and took a commemorative photo for one birthday table (November 2025); ask for the half-circle sofa at the back. Some diners found the seasoning salty (2025) or the top course short of its price (March 2026). Closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog notes the restaurant moved to Shinmachi in 2003; Tabelog French WEST 100, 2021. No chef is named in the listing or the reviews read, and no official site was found.
chef_bio.specialty: Lobster terrine; choice of four meats; meat sauce with pilaf.

anecdotes.text: "With 8 dishes plus the baguette and drinks, the first courses include the amuse-bouche and three appetizers, each with generous portions. These are definitely not just appetizers!" — April 2026, the ¥16,500 course.
"It was a dish where you mixed apple puree with the lobster terrine and enjoyed it together, and it was delightful." — November 2025, a birthday dinner on the half-circle sofa.
"For JPY 3800, you can select from appetizers, main courses, and desserts. The first thing I noticed was the wide variety of choices" — March 2026, lunch.

Reservations accepted; cancel by the day before (Tabelog). Since 1982 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Horse meat only, since 1982 (prices from the official site, undated, read November 2026) · two starters ¥1,000 · raw: 高根, collagen-rich meat from under the mane ¥800; horse sashimi ¥3,800; raw liver ¥3,800; sakura yukke ¥900; sakura natto, winter-only straw-wrapped natto from Kumamoto mixed with horse meat ¥950 · saiboshi, smoked horse ¥1,600 · grilled: korikori, a rare chewy cut ¥3,200; seared sashimi cut ¥3,800; yakiniku set ¥6,300 a person (two or more); horse steak ¥6,500 · harihari hot pot of horse meat and mizuna in a horse-tendon broth, Chinese noodles to finish ¥5,000 · courses for two or more, per person: hot pot course ¥7,500, steak course with takikomi rice ¥8,600, W course of steak and hot pot ¥10,500 · draft beer ¥680, highball ¥660, sake from ¥660 a go; a Biwa Min sour (October 2026)
places.notes: [Horse meat · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, since 1982] A horse-meat specialist in Higashi-Shinsaibashi, cooking nothing else since 1982. Diners describe the meat as Kumamoto horse, sweet, clean and light, and the menu runs from sashimi through grilling to a hot pot: sashimi of three cuts including 高根, the collagen-rich meat from under the mane; smoked saiboshi with a drink; grilled horse yakiniku or a tender steak; and the harihari nabe of horse meat and mizuna in a broth drawn from horse tendon, finished with Chinese noodles or rice. Most people take a course (¥7,500 for the hot pot, ¥10,500 for steak and hot pot), and staff explain the hot pot to first-timers. A December 2025 diner found the owner kind, and many customers seemed to be regulars; one in March 2026 felt the price outran the experience on a quiet weekend night. English menu. Closed Sundays and holidays.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing: "Since 1982, dedicated to horse meat!" A February 2026 diner calls it a horse-meat restaurant with 45 years of history. The official site sources its winter sakura natto from Kumamoto; a December 2025 diner describes the horse meat as from Kumamoto and the owner as very kind and attentive.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Delicious horse meat for beauty and health" (おいしい馬肉で美容と健康; official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Horse sashimi; harihari hot pot; horse steak.

anecdotes.text: "The Harihari hot pot was light yet packed with flavor … The staff kindly explained how to prepare the hot pot, which made me feel at ease as a first-timer." — December 2025, a first taste of horse meat.
"The staff provided detailed and clear explanations of the dishes, even asking if I wanted to add garlic." — April 2026, the W course.
"I added just a bit of pepper to change the flavor. Then I added some shichimi for another twist. The power of the broth is truly impressive." — March 2026, grilled and hot pot course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 馬肉料理専門店ホース、おいしい馬肉で美容と健康、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-3-12、地下鉄心斎橋駅6番出口から徒歩10分、ラストオーダー22:00、日曜・祝日定休、カウンター6席・テーブル3・2階10〜20名、禁煙。メニュー: 付出し2品1,000円、高根 (タテガミの下でコラーゲンたっぷり) 800円、馬刺し3,800円、生レバー3,800円、桜なっとう (熊本から取り寄せる冬限定のわらに包まれたなっとうに馬肉) 950円、桜ユッケ900円、サイボシ (馬の燻製) 1,600円、コリコリ3,200円、あみ焼き3,800円、焼肉セット1人前6,300円 (2人前から)、馬ステーキ6,500円、馬のはりはり鍋 (馬スジからダシを取った秘伝のスープ、しめの中華そば) 5,000円、コースは2人前から: 鍋コース7,500円、ステーキコース8,600円、Ｗコース10,500円、生ビール680円。食べログ (店舗会員): 月〜土17:00〜21:30、日・祝休み、予約可 (キャンセルは前日まで)、カード可、41席、2階は9名以上で貸切可、掘りごたつ、禁煙、英語メニュー、子ども可、1982年から馬肉ひとすじ。口コミ(2025年12月〜2026年10月): Kumamoto の馬肉、親切な店主、常連が多い、鍋の食べ方を教えてくれる、三種のお造り、サイボシ、ステーキ、はりはり鍋、炊き込みご飯、しめの麺、桜ユッケ、45年の歴史、値段ほどの満足感はなかったという声。

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Most cuts can be ordered with salt instead of the house sauce, and the aged lean beef comes with salt and grated-daikon ponzu or the dipping sauce; the horumon is dressed in a miso sauce, the sukiyaki-style strip loin is grilled in a homemade warishita, the soups are finished with a house dashi soy sauce, and the cold noodles are described only as using buckwheat flour (Tabelog menu, September 2026). places.neighborhood: Minami-Semba 4-11-22, basement of the YOC Building, on a one-way street just off Route 1 — 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn (Midosuji Line exit 3, Yotsubashi Line exit 1-A)
places.cuisine: Yakiniku of black wagyu aged cut by cut, with dry aging; the name means "the tongue rejoices" (Tabelog) · courses, tax included (Tabelog, 2026): Casual Course 10 items ¥7,700; Namba Senba Course 11 items ¥9,350; Kitan Course 14 items ¥11,000 (the most booked); Premium Course 16 items ¥13,000; all-you-can-drink party courses for 5–15 people ¥10,000 and ¥13,000 (90 minutes) · à la carte (Tabelog menu, updated 8 September 2026, tax included): aged tongue served with sudachi instead of lemon — thick-cut tongue grilled by the grill master ¥3,100, premium thick-cut salted tongue ¥2,300 (half ¥1,380), premium salted tongue ¥2,100; aged lean beef with salt and grated-daikon ponzu or sauce — top sirloin ¥1,980, rump ¥2,200, sirloin cap ¥2,530, a sampler of three ¥3,050; special karubi ¥2,700; premium tenderloin ¥4,700; Chateaubriand ¥6,200; dry-aged U.S. Prime outside skirt ¥2,300; special strip loin grilled sukiyaki-style with Oita eggs ¥4,000; horumon in a miso sauce, ¥880–1,300 · special wagyu sushi platter ¥2,750; seared wagyu yukhoe-style ¥1,540–1,820; raw white omasum sashimi ¥990 · kimchi platter ¥990, Jeju-style japchae ¥680 · rice from a rice master's blend, stone-grilled bibimbap ¥1,950, cold noodles ¥1,210, sudachi cold noodles ¥1,430, wagyu oxtail gomtang ¥1,100 · desserts: French toast with ice cream ¥750, crème brûlée ¥600, sorbet · sake, shochu, wine, cocktails · takeout: a whole aged tongue (about 40 slices) ¥9,000
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Minami-Semba, aged wagyu in private rooms] The original shop of the small Kitan yakiniku group (a September 2026 diner), in a basement off Route 1 near Shinsaibashi, where every table is in its own room, for two up to twenty. The kitchen ages black wagyu cut by cut, including dry aging, and the aged tongue is the thing to order: a thick-cut salted tongue (¥2,300), or the thick-cut tongue the grill master cooks for you (¥3,100), served with sudachi instead of lemon. Aged lean cuts come as a sampler of three with salt and grated-daikon ponzu; the house signature is a strip loin grilled sukiyaki-style and dipped in egg. Courses run ¥7,700–13,000, à la carte works too, and diners in 2026 praised the tongue, the outside skirt, the omasum sashimi and the wagyu sushi. It suits families: a kids menu, free toys, baby seats. One diner found the much-advertised French toast a letdown after the meat; another had hoped for more kinds of tongue. Tabelog Yakiniku WEST 100 2021 and Grill WEST 100 2024.

places.name: トラットリア パッパ (TRATTORIA Pappa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Pasta is central, bread comes with the cover charge, and there are gratins and desserts; the carpaccio, grilled and steamed fish and other seafood mains may suit, but nothing is stated. The shop asks diners to state likes and dislikes.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-only Italian kitchen (official site; Tabelog). Seasonal vegetables such as the early-summer Wakayama tomatoes appear within seafood dishes.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last entry 20:00); closed Sunday and on irregular days listed on the official schedule (official site; Tabelog). The set lunch menus ended on 29 November 2025; lunch and dinner now offer à la carte and courses, with courses booked by the day before (official site). Reservations online (TableCheck) or by phone; one course per table; a booking may be treated as cancelled 20 minutes after the time if the shop cannot reach you (Tabelog). At dinner only diners of middle-school age and older (Tabelog). Coperto (bread and table charge) ¥500 per person plus tax at dinner, ¥550 with tax on Tabelog. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 31 seats: 13 at the counter, 18 at tables; non-smoking; whole-restaurant hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Opened 22 February 2002 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 2-3-9, ground floor of センユー四ツ橋 — 4 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn exit 1 (Nagahori Tsurumi-ryokuchi Line)
places.cuisine: Seafood-only Italian (no meat dishes, Tabelog; the official site makes an exception for lunch), the fish bought each morning by the owner-chef at the Osaka central wholesale market (official site) · omakase courses, tax excluded (official site, read November 2026): ¥4,000 (lunch only), ¥6,000, ¥10,000, ¥15,000, ¥25,000 (book two days ahead) — appetizer, pasta, main, dessert, coffee, changing daily · the shop suggests custom orders: a drinking course of several appetizers ending with pasta, a pasta course, a whole fish, Italian cheese instead of dessert · à la carte antipasti, pasta and secondi, written up daily · seasonal: Wakayama tomatoes from the Yamanaka family, broccoli, white asparagus, truffle, Pacific saury, cod milt, tiger puffer, ayu (official site) · from reviews: chilled capellini with sea urchin and tomato in summer (July 2026), mackerel and tomato pasta (August and October 2026), cabbage and anchovy oil pasta (October 2026), clam and broccoli cream pasta (October 2026), shrimp gratin and a white-tomato jelly with onion mousse (June 2026), crisp-skinned fish main (October 2026), Gorgonzola ice cream (September 2026) · regulars ask for ingredients and leave the method to the chef: Ise lobster, abalone, eel and sea urchin with summer truffle (July 2026); lobster with caviar, booked ahead (October 2026); Ezo venison in December (2021, 2022) · wine, sake, shochu
places.notes: [Italian · Shinmachi, a seafood-only trattoria at a thousand-year-old counter] An owner-chef's Italian in Shinmachi since 2002 that cooks only seafood: the chef goes to Osaka's central wholesale market every morning and makes trips to fishing ports around Japan a life's work, and fish also arrive from people met on those trips (official site). The open kitchen faces a counter cut from a single slab of African bubinga about a thousand years old, and the walls carry work by the artist TALA. Order the daily omakase course (¥6,000–25,000 before tax at dinner, ¥4,000 at lunch), or tell the staff what you want: a drinking course, a pasta course, a whole fish. The summer chilled capellini with sea urchin and tomato is a seasonal favourite (July 2025 and July 2026), and diners in 2026 praised mackerel-and-tomato pasta, a shrimp gratin and crisp-skinned fish. One regular on a twentieth visit (October 2026) pre-orders lobster with caviar. The set lunches ended in November 2025, and at dinner only diners of middle-school age and up are seated. Tabelog Italian WEST 100 2021 and 2023.

roles: Owner-chef (オーナーシェフ) and representative (official site); "Matsumoto" in English reviews
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: after cooking school, trained in Italian cooking under chef 鮎田淳治 at ラ・コメータ in Tokyo, then sharpened technique at Fontana in Hotel New Otani Osaka (ホテルニューオータニ大阪) and helped launch Italian restaurants, learning how to build a shop; opened Trattoria Pappa independently in 2002, and in 2005 バール・パッパ and パッパバー, both closed on 31 May 2020 when their building was to be rebuilt. The chef loves seafood, hence the seafood-only menu, buys fish at the Osaka central wholesale market every morning, and travels to fishing ports around Japan as a life's work. A painting by 少路和伸, made for the chef's 50th birthday, hangs in the shop. An October 2026 diner first saw the restaurant about 15 years earlier on the MBS programme "Kitchen Puipui" and met the owner-chef on the visit; a June 2026 diner found the chef friendly and fun to talk to.
chef_bio.philosophy: "I love seafood! So the Italian at Pappa is seafood only. I want people to eat Italian casually at Pappa, drink wine and recharge" (official site, owner-chef 松本).
chef_bio.specialty: Daily omakase of market seafood; seasonal chilled capellini; pasta.

anecdotes.text: "If you're visiting in summer, you absolutely must try this chilled uni pasta… The thin capellini is topped with juicy fresh tomatoes and plenty of uni." — July 2026.
"When I asked the staff, I learned that it was a single slab of Bubinga wood over 1,000 years old." — August 2026, mackerel and tomato pasta at lunch.
"It was a fresh and juicy tomato sauce that, while not overly rich, was packed with flavor and truly delicious." — October 2026, mackerel in tomato sauce.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 大阪市西区のイタリア料理店 トラットリアパッパ、魚介系パワフルイタリアン、ガラス貼りのオープンキッチン、オーナーシェフ松本「魚介類が大好きなんです！だからパッパで出すイタリアンも魚介系オンリー (ランチは除く)」、毎朝大阪中央卸売市場に通い新鮮な魚介類を仕入れ、全国各地の漁港を尋ねる旅をライフワーク、初夏の和歌山の山中さんのトマト、樹齢約1000年のアフリカ産ブビンガのカウンター、アーティストTALAさんの作品、画家・少路和伸さんが50歳の誕生日の記念に描いた絵画。おまかせコース (税別): 4,000円 (ランチタイムのみ)、6,000円・10,000円・15,000円・25,000円 (25,000円は前々日までの予約)、1テーブル1コース、Coperto (パン代・テーブル使用料等) お一人様500円 (ディナーのみ)、酒飲みコース、パスタコース、魚を1匹丸ごと、デザートの代わりにイタリアのチーズ、季節のトマト、ブロッコリー、ホワイトアスパラ、トリュフ、秋刀魚、タラの白子、とらふぐ、鮎。ランチメニュー終了のお知らせ: 2002年開店当初からのランチセットメニューを2025年11月29日で終了、ランチもディナーもアラカルトとコース、コースは前日までの予約、Pappa店主 松本喜宏。Pappa代表 松本 喜宏: 1964年北海道生まれ、調理師学校を卒業後、東京「ラ･コメータ」鮎田淳治シェフのもとで修業、ホテルニューオータニ大阪「Fontana」、イタリア料理店の立ち上げ、2002年独立して「トラットリア・パッパ」を開店、05年に「バール・パッパ」「パッパ・バー」(2020年5月31日閉店)。営業時間 11:30〜14:00／17:30〜 最終入店20:00、日曜日・不定休。食べログ (店舗会員): 新町2-3-9、西大橋駅1番出口から徒歩4分、魚介イタリアン専門で肉料理はなし、ディナーは中学生以上、予約時間から20分連絡がつかなければキャンセル扱いの場合あり、コペルト550円 (税込、ランチなし)、カード・PayPay可、31席 (テーブル18、カウンター13)、禁煙、貸切20〜50名、オープン2002年2月22日、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2021・2023。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): 夏の冷製カッペリーニ (ウニとトマト)、サバとトマトのパスタ、キャベツとアンチョビのオイルソース、アサリとブロッコリーのクリームパスタ、海老のグラタン、白いトマトのジュレと玉ねぎのムース、皮がパリッとした魚、ゴルゴンゾーラのアイス、常連は食材を伝えて調理法はシェフにおまかせ (Ise lobster、鮑、鰻、ウニ、夏トリュフ、キャビアをのせたオマール)、MBS「Kitchen Puipui」で見た、ランチのコース4,400円、テーブルに塩とこしょう。

places.cuisine: Korean home cooking and late-night grills (Tabelog) · menu dated May 2024, tax may be extra (Tabelog): dak hanmari ¥4,500 in a broth of Korean ginseng, garlic, ginkgo, chestnut and herbal ingredients, finished as rice porridge; samgyeopsal set ¥2,000 (from 2 people); cheese dak galbi set ¥2,000; LA kalbi ¥5,000; samgyetang ¥2,500; army stew, gamjatang, pork bulgogi with mushrooms, tteokbokki hot pot, ttukbaegi stew, simmered cutlassfish or mackerel ¥3,000 each (2–4 people); seafood or potato chijimi ¥1,500, kimchi, chive or pumpkin chijimi ¥1,000; bossam ¥2,500; yangnyeom gejang ¥2,500; pork trotters ¥4,000; kimchi, sundubu or miso chige ¥1,000; yukgaejang ¥1,000; oxtail soup ¥1,200; stone-grilled bibimbap ¥1,200; cold noodles ¥1,000; ramen ¥800 · 2026 prices are higher: ttukbaegi samgyetang ¥6,000 (for 3–4) and potato jeon ¥1,850 (September 2026) · from reviews: free banchan (thin potatoes, seaweed, daikon kimchi, greens, konjac, fish cake, black beans), samgyeopsal grilled whole on the teppan and wrapped in perilla with kimchi, sannakji, ganjang gejang (not always available), cheese kimchi omelette (2026) · all-you-can-drink "C" course ¥6,600 for 3–34 people (Tabelog) · makgeolli, sake, shochu, wine
places.notes: [Korean · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Korean cooking to 4 am] A bright, roomy Korean restaurant that moved from Soemoncho to Higashi-Shinsaibashi and stays open until 4 am six nights a week, a Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST 100 pick in 2026. Free banchan arrive first, then the choice is wide: thick samgyeopsal grilled whole and wrapped in perilla with kimchi, a bossam whose napa cabbage one October 2026 diner singled out alongside the pork, dak hanmari in a ginseng-and-herb broth (one diner found the herbs strong), oxtail soup, ganjang gejang, chijimi and bubbling chige. Portions are big; one diner suggests coming as four to try a hot pot and samgyeopsal both. One diner found the samgyeopsal ordinary and dear; another made it the late-night finish after drinking. Smoking is allowed.

roles: Kitchen and owners unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text, the restaurant moved in May 2016 to its present, bright and spacious premises (Tabelog opening day 24 May 2017); an October 2026 review says it was formerly in Soemoncho. Diners in 2026 describe it as authentic Korean cooking; a reviewer who had spent a long time in Korea agreed.

anecdotes.text: "What arrived on the teppan was a generous portion of thick-cut pork belly… it's cut into manageable pieces and wrapped in Korean perilla leaves with kimchi and onions that have soaked up the pork fat." — October 2026, late-night samgyeopsal.
"The Ttukbaegi Samgyetang was enough for 3 to 4 people, and I ended up feeling quite full." — September 2026, ¥6,000.
"I recommend coming with about four people so you can order both the hot pot and Samgyeopsal for a perfect experience." — October 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Every steak course includes a mini wagyu burger in a bun and ends with fried rice; the monthly course has a teppan tonpeiyaki. The steak, grilled vegetables and champagne-steamed lobster may be simpler, but sauces are not described. The booking page asks diners to write allergies in the comments.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu steak and seafood teppanyaki restaurant; the roasted vegetables come within meat courses.
places.hours_raw: Dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00), irregular closures listed on the official site (official site; Tabelog). Lunch 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) on irregular days only; the official site calls lunch fully reserved, while its lunch page says the steak sets need no booking; dinner courses at lunch need booking 3 days ahead (official site). Reservations strongly preferred: dishes are prepared to the bookings, walk-ins may be turned away, and a seat-only booking gets the Steak Course (Tabelog). Same-day cancellations may be charged 100% (official site). One drink per person required; water other than chasers is charged; card payment needs a ¥20,000 minimum except for solo diners (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay (Tabelog; official site). 24 seats on Tabelog, 26 on the official site: a counter, tables and semi-private rooms for up to 12; non-smoking (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Children welcome; kids plate ¥6,000 (official site).

places.cuisine: Teppanyaki of A4–A5 Miyazaki beef and Kobe beef (a registered Kobe beef shop, Tabelog), cooked on a 2 cm iron plate (official site) · courses, tax included (official site, read November 2026): Steak Course with a 120 g Chateaubriand from ¥15,900, a 120 g fillet from ¥13,900, or two brands' Chateaubriand compared, 100 g each, from ¥20,000 — soup, chef's small plate, the house mini wagyu burger, homemade chicken tsukune with egg yolk, champagne-steamed lobster tail with américaine sauce or grilled sirloin shabu-shabu with ponzu, roasted vegetables, steak, fried rice of a blend from the rice merchant 八代目儀兵衛, dessert; Kobe beef course ¥38,000 (Kobe and Miyazaki Chateaubriand compared); monthly omakase from ¥17,500, by the day before, with tonpeiyaki "the taste since we opened", paper-steamed seasonal fish, Kobe beef chuck sukiyaki and a 70 g Miyazaki A5 Chateaubriand; seafood grill course ¥13,800 (English site); weekday mini fillet course ¥8,500 (Tabelog) · lunch on open days: Miyazaki sirloin steak set 150 g ¥5,000, fillet course 100 g ¥7,000, fried rice instead of white rice +¥800 · no wine list: the sommelier suggests wines; pairing sets of four ¥4,500 or six ¥6,000 · takeout by 3 days ahead: wagyu Philly cheese steak ¥1,900 (popular at Expo 2025), mini burger set ¥1,500
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Dotonbori, wagyu steak over the canal] A teppanyaki room on the second floor of a building by the Dotonbori canal, near Harishige, where you eat A5 Miyazaki beef or Kobe beef with a view of the water. The official English site says the Toyoshima brothers have run it since 2005 (Tabelog's opening day is September 2009). Courses follow one pattern: a soup, small plates, the house's famous mini wagyu burger (a repeat diner's favourite), lobster steamed in champagne or grilled sirloin shabu-shabu, then the steak, flambéed in front of you, and fried rice; the 120 g Chateaubriand course from ¥15,900 is the one most people book. A September 2026 diner was shown the Miyakonojo wagyu's certificate; a July 2025 diner seated at a table was invited to the counter for the flambé. There is no wine list: the sommelier pours to your taste. Book ahead; drinks push the bill up (one December 2025 diner paid just under ¥20,000 in all). Tabelog Steak/Teppanyaki WEST 100 2024.

roles: Run by the Toyoshima brothers (official English site); cooks with more than 20 years of experience and a sommelier (official site); individual names not given
chef_bio.background: The official English site says the Toyoshima brothers have shared teppanyaki with locals and overseas diners since 2005; Tabelog gives the opening day as 9 September 2009, and its shop text speaks of 20 years. The beef is A4–A5 Miyazaki beef bought through the shop's own route and Kobe beef (official site); a September 2026 diner was served Miyakonojo wagyu from Miyazaki and shown its certificate. Diners describe a friendly chef who flambés at the table and staff who show the meat before cooking (2024–2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Each cut judged by an experienced cook and grilled to the right doneness on a 2 cm plate; no wine list, the sommelier chooses for the day's food and your taste (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Miyazaki A5 Chateaubriand; mini wagyu burger; champagne-steamed lobster.

places.notes: [Spanish-Italian bar · Umeda, Osaka Station Front Building No. 2 B1F] A small tapas bar tucked into the back of the basement of Osaka Station Front Building No. 2 (one group found it on the building map), the second shop of the Spanish bar El Sol in Kitashinchi. The aim is the chef's own Spanish and Italian cooking at low prices: a tapas platter at ¥693, jamón carved from the leg, ajillo with just the right salt, pizza, pastas and squid-ink paella, in portions small enough for a solo diner to try several. Happy hour pours beer and highballs at ¥198 until 18:15 on weekdays (August 2026), and women's groups drink at half price on Tuesdays. One regular always starts with sparkling wine, poured until it overflows the glass. Counter seats suit one or two; a back room takes groups of seven or more for 3-hour all-you-can-drink courses (¥5,800 in September 2026), and staff set out candles for a birthday cake guests brought. Fills soon after opening; book even at short notice.

chef_bio.origin: Second shop of Spanish Bar El Sol Kitashinchi (Tabelog listing remarks; August 2026 review).
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): authentic dishes made by the chef at the most affordable prices, on a base of Spanish and Italian cooking with budget-friendly wines and tapas; private rooms for welcome and farewell parties; private use of the Kitashinchi bar for larger groups. Opened 15 April 2022.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic dishes at the most affordable prices (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Tapas platter; squid-ink paella; sparkling wine.

anecdotes.text: "The plate under the champagne glasses was also overflowing with bubbles, which made me so happy" — January 2026, a regular's second stop of the night.
"Every time I visit, there are always many women here, and the owner is very considerate, making it a place where even a woman can come alone!" — February 2026, Ladies' Day.

"We were celebrating a birthday and brought our own cake. The staff kindly accommodated our requests, serving the cake and even setting up candles for us." — September 2026, a group of eight on the 3-hour course.

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter or table from a tapas and wine menu; book online or by phone (2026). No English evidence found.

places.vegan_detail: Ask ahead. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the hotel takes dietary requests in advance (official page), but no vegan dish is described; the breakfast buffet has salads and fruit alongside eggs, fish and meat (June 2026).
places.hours_raw: Daily: breakfast 6:30–10:30; lunch 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:00); dinner 17:30–21:30 (last order 20:00), no dinner on Tuesday and Wednesday, except dinner on Wednesday 23 December 2026 (official page; Tabelog, from 1 August 2026). Hours and prices may change in festive periods (Golden Week, Obon, Christmas, New Year) and on promotion days (official page). Breakfast ¥4,500 (13 and over), ¥2,250 (6–12); set lunch from ¥5,800; set dinner from ¥7,800; à la carte from ¥700; tax and service charge (15% per Tabelog) added to listed prices (official page). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (AMEX, UnionPay, Diners, Master, Visa, JCB); no e-money or QR (official page; Tabelog); a diner was asked to pay cash because of a terminal fault (August 2026). 81 seats: 67 in the room and a private room for up to 14 (an extra ¥18,000 for parties of six or fewer); non-smoking; step-free for wheelchairs and strollers; children's tableware and chairs; parking free for 2 hours with ¥10,000 spent (official page). English menu and English-speaking staff; smart casual (Tabelog). Opened 6 September 2024 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: All-day dining of dishes from around the world made with Osaka produce, served on Japanese small plates, with a live cooking station (official page) · breakfast buffet ¥4,500: made-to-order omelettes, salads, Japanese sides (grilled mackerel, hijiki, natto) with rice and miso soup, yakisoba, curry rice, fruit and a strawberry-chia parfait, and a "TACO Juice" of tea, tomato, apple, carrot and orange (June 2026) · lunch: CC: Quick Lunch ¥4,500 with stone-oven bread and tomato butter, octopus salad, edamame hummus, fried squid with romesco and a prosciutto pizza (August 2026); pizza lunch set ¥4,500, 7-dish sets ¥5,800 and ¥7,800 with three starters, a main and dessert (Tabelog) · "Italian lifestyle" lunch and dinner plans (official page); a September 2026 diner found the cooking Italian with Japanese delicacy · an Obon lunch buffet with porchetta from the live kitchen (August 2026) · dinner à la carte: small starters and a salty prosciutto pizza (October 2026) · wine
places.notes: [International · Umeda, Grand Green Osaka hotel restaurant] The all-day restaurant on the 11th floor of the Canopy by Hilton in Grand Green Osaka's north building, with windows over Umekita park and the Osaka Station area; one diner watched the view turn from evening to night (September 2026). The kitchen cooks dishes from around the world with Osaka produce and plates them small, Japanese-style, with a live cooking station; the room nods to Osaka food culture, with a ceiling of Sumiyoshi bamboo craft and lights shaped like kushikatsu (August 2026). Breakfast is a ¥4,500 buffet with omelettes made to order, Japanese sides, yakisoba and fresh juices, praised in June 2026 and found ordinary by an October 2026 hotel guest. Lunch sets start at ¥4,500 including tax and service; dinner is à la carte or sets from ¥7,800. Diners note loud music at a business lunch, slow notice at dinner (October 2026), and a calm room even at weekends. The hotel takes allergy requests in advance.

roles: Hotel kitchen team (chef unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.origin: The all-day dining restaurant of Canopy by Hilton Osaka Umeda (official page).
chef_bio.background: Official page (read 2026-11-01): "シェフの遊び心満載の世界各国の味を、美しい小皿スタイルで" — the chef's playful takes on world dishes, using local Osaka ingredients, in Japanese small plates; a live cooking station; interior modelled on an Osaka market arcade and the rice bags of the old Osaka rice exchange; a private room for up to 14 with charging sockets for business meals. Opened 6 September 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Dishes from around the world, each giving a taste of its country's lifestyle and culture, made with local ingredients (official page).

anecdotes.text: "The interior, which I initially thought was just stylish, actually incorporates elements of Osaka culture, such as the ceiling made of Sumiyoshi bamboo craft and the hanging lights inspired by kushikatsu" — August 2026, a business lunch.
"The location offered a stunning view of the Osaka Station area. The transition of the scenery from evening to night was truly beautiful." — September 2026.
"The staff was attentive, promptly bringing my coffee even amidst the busy atmosphere." — October 2026, the breakfast buffet.
