places.cuisine: Creative bistro on the theme of "adult play": charcoal-grilled dishes and twists on bistro classics such as a charcoal-grilled smoked "meat bomb", butter chicken and zucchini gratin, melon gazpacho; wine and gin, with music (Tabelog) · assorted appetizers ¥1,419 a person (August 2026): shime-saba potato salad, kanpachi carpaccio, shirasu omelette, yodare chicken, roasted peas, salmon confit · omelettes: shirasu and fresh tomato (July 2026), tomato and herb (August 2026); an eel omelette, sold out that night · salmon mi-cuit, mackerel potato salad with a red sauce, fritters, gratin (July 2026) · zeppole with mentaiko sauce, roast beef, cream pasta (August 2026); hamburg steak (September 2026) · hojicha Basque cheesecake with black syrup (August 2026) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): OYD Standard ¥4,510 (7 dishes), weekday casual course ¥4,280 (Tue–Thu, booked 7 days ahead, 2 hours), OYD Special ¥5,680 · unusual shochu (July 2026); orange juice over ¥700 (August 2026)
places.notes: [Bistro · behind Umekita, a quiet street ten minutes from Osaka Station] A 19-seat creative bistro on a quiet street past Grand Green Osaka, themed on "adult play": charcoal-grilled dishes and bistro classics with a twist, wine and gin, and a soundtrack worth listening to. Diners come for the colourful appetizer platter (¥1,419 a person in August 2026: shime-saba potato salad, kanpachi carpaccio, a shirasu omelette, yodare chicken, salmon confit) and the soft omelettes, with tomato, shirasu or, when it has not sold out, eel. Most praise the presentation and the sauces; others found portions small for the price, waited half an hour for the platter, or found the room hot and the high stools hard (September 2026). Courses run ¥4,280–5,680. Book for 7 pm; it is easier after 9. No cards; PayPay accepted.

roles: Chef and staff (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a creative bistro near Osaka Station and Umeda themed on "adult play", with unique twists on classic bistro dishes, fine wine or gin, and quality music; charcoal-grilled dishes and carefully chosen domestic drinks. Opened 22 November 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Adult play" in bistro cooking (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "We ordered an appetizer platter for one, but since there were two of us" the portion was adjusted for two — August 2026, back home in Kansai for Obon.
"For dessert, I had the hojicha Basque cheesecake. It was drizzled with black syrup, giving it a Japanese twist." — August 2026, a solo visit after work.
"The omelet, generously topped with shirasu (whitebait) and fresh tomatoes, was exquisite with its perfectly creamy texture and refreshing acidity." — July 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Order à la carte or a set course; book ahead for 7 pm (2026). No English evidence found.

places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Every course includes a beef cutlet sandwich (bread and breaded cutlet), and reviews describe spring rolls, beef-tongue curry and dan dan noodles on a May 2025 menu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses built on wagyu, with seafood, soups and broths.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00, last order food 21:00, drinks 22:00; closed Sundays, holidays, Obon, Golden Week and New Year (Tabelog; official site). Courses start at 18:00 or 20:30 (official site). Reservation only (Tabelog); online booking on the official site. Service charge 10% (Tabelog). places.cuisine: Meat kappo: wagyu chosen from across Japan, served as sashimi, seared, charcoal-grilled and simmered, in a monthly omakase course (official site) · omakase ¥17,600, special course ¥24,200, Kobe beef course ¥33,000, tax included; wine pairing (6 glasses) ¥10,000 or the house pairing of champagne, sake and wine (7) ¥10,000 (official site) · a July 2026 course: oxtail and soft-shelled turtle soup; fried yuba with shrimp and fig; surf clam with Kujo green onion; sea-urchin yukke hand roll; oxtail and porcini spring roll; beef cheek with shark fin and crab sauce; beef cutlet sandwich; charcoal-grilled tenderloin; kamameshi with mentaiko, beef-tongue curry and gyudon to choose from; red miso soup; fruit punch · other dishes in reviews: beef tongue, liver, toro-taku, Kobe beef with turnip and truffle (December 2025), tongue with green pepper, abalone and matsutake (August 2026) · a katsu sandwich to take home (Tabelog) · champagne, wine, sake; juices for non-drinkers (May 2026)
places.notes: [Meat kappo · Kitashinchi, a wagyu counter] A counter in Kitashinchi where the owner-chef, 三井秀和 (official site), cooks wagyu from producers across Japan in front of you, course by course: soup, seasonal small dishes, raw and seared beef, a thick beef cutlet sandwich that diners photograph again and again, charcoal-grilled tenderloin, then kamameshi with a choice of toppings such as beef-tongue curry, gyudon and mentaiko. Two 2026 reviews say the owner was formerly head chef at Tsuru Ton Tan; one called the owner a comedian who keeps the counter laughing (July 2026), and at an April 2026 birthday all the guests joined in the song. Courses run ¥17,600–33,000 with 10% service; pairings ¥10,000. Portions are large: come hungry. Private room for business dinners; a loud group at the counter spoiled one November 2025 evening. A sister yakiniku shop, 北新地 焼肉友ゆり, opened in October 2026.

roles: Formerly head chef at Tsuru Ton Tan (August and October 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Official site (read 2026-11-01): "オーナーシェフ 三井秀和"; the owner-chef pairs carefully chosen meat with seasonal ingredients, using skills built up over the years and ingredients from trusted producers, and finishes each dish while talking with guests at the counter. Reviews: "The cheerful master, who has been the head chef at Tsuru Ton Tan for a long time" (August 2026); "The owner here was formerly the head chef at Tsuru Ton Tan" (October 2026). A July 2026 diner writes that the shop specialises in Iga beef and Tsushima beef. Opened 22 April 2023 (Tabelog); a sister shop, 北新地 焼肉友ゆり, opened in Kitashinchi on 13 October 2026 (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Hospitality through meat dishes made with care, finished while talking with each guest (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Meat kappo course; beef cutlet sandwich; kamameshi finale.

anecdotes.text: "I had heard from my friend beforehand that while the food is delicious, the owner can be a bit loud (laughs), so I was prepared for that. However, I found out that the loudness was more of a comedic style rather than intimidating!" — July 2026.
"The head chef was very friendly, and even though it was my first time at the restaurant, all the guests joined in to sing a birthday song for me" — April 2026, a birthday dinner.
"The beef katsu sandwich was a huge hit, with many guests taking multiple photos of it!" — September 2025, a fourth visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 肉割烹 友百合 (ともゆり)、ライブ感のある割烹、全国から取り寄せた和牛を刺身、炙り、炭焼き、煮物などで、ソムリエが選ぶシャンパン、ワイン、日本酒、オーナーシェフ 三井秀和、月替りおまかせコース (神戸牛コース33,000円、特選コース24,200円、おまかせコース17,600円、税込)、コースは18:00〜と20:30〜、ワインペアリング6種10,000円、友百合オリジナルペアリング7種10,000円、サービス料は別、カウンター12席とテーブル1席 (6名まで半個室)、18時〜23時、日曜・祝日・盆・正月・ゴールデンウィーク休み、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1丁目3番26号 ぐらんぱれビル1階、姉妹店の北新地 焼肉友ゆりが2026年10月13日に開店。食べログ (店舗会員): 予約制、子ども用のプレート5,500円、20席、サービス料10%、加熱式たばこは個室のみ、お土産のカツサンド、2023年4月22日オープン。口コミ (2023年12月〜2026年10月): 牛カツサンド、ウニとユッケの手巻き、炭火焼き、釜めしと選べるご飯のお供、大将は以前 Tsuru Ton Tan の料理長、冗談の多い楽しい大将、量が多い。

places.name: ダマン リュミエール 高島屋大阪店 (DAMMANN lumière Takashimaya Osaka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The Tabelog listing says allergy information is available, but nothing is called gluten-free. Much of the food is wheat (pasta, croque monsieur, French toast, scones, pancakes, baguettes with the lunch); the galettes are not described as buckwheat-only. Teas themselves are leaf blends. The steaks and the pudding are the dishes to ask about.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. More than 60 Dammann Frères teas (official site) served in a pot are the safe ground; milk tea is an option (September 2026). The food uses cream, egg, butter, cheese, meat and seafood; no vegan dish is listed.
places.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–20:00 (last order 19:00); closed when Takashimaya Osaka closes (Tabelog; official site). Reservations on weekdays only, for two or more; a private room for up to 6 on weekdays for groups of 5 or more (Tabelog). Afternoon tea is served on weekdays from 13:00 (shop menu on Tabelog; a September 2026 diner missed it on a weekend). Lunch fills up: half full at 11:45, full by 12:30 on a weekday (October 2026); one diner queued (September 2026). Cards, e-money and QR accepted; non-smoking; parking in the store's contracted car park (Tabelog). Seats: 36 (Tabelog) or 52 including the private room (official store page). Opened 3 March 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Namba 5-1-5, Takashimaya Osaka 2F, among the brand boutiques — by Namba Stn (Midosuji Line), Nankai Namba and Kintetsu Osaka-Namba
places.cuisine: French tea salon and boutique of Dammann Frères teas with food from the lumière kitchen (prices from the shop menu on Tabelog, tax included, read November 2026) · over 60 teas (official site), served in a pot with the leaves removed (October 2026), numbered on the menu; e.g. グールース, a French take on Earl Grey (official site; "Goulus" in a September 2026 review), Jardin Bleu, Oriental Noa (Ceylon with passion fruit, peach and wild strawberry), Anichai with ginger, Oriental rooibos (2025–2026 reviews) · afternoon tea with free-flow tea ¥4,950, weekdays from 13:00 (logo macarons, salmon, chocolate-orange in September 2026) · galettes ¥1,760–¥1,870 (prosciutto with tomato sauce; salmon with mushroom cream; shrimp with lobster sauce and a warm egg); pastas ¥1,760–¥1,870; vegetable croque monsieur ¥1,760; healthy lunch set ¥1,430 (salad, pumpkin soup and two baguettes in October 2026); a seasonal one-plate lunch of fish, meat and vegetables on a large Ginori plate (July and October 2026); Japanese strip loin ¥5,500 and bavette ¥4,400 with bread, soup and salad · sweets ¥1,430–¥1,980: modern French toast, pancakes with berry sauce, chocolate cake with cream espuma, a Mont Blanc, a "Dragon Egg" and Jersey-milk pudding, the special scone; seasonal dessert set (a grape parfait with rooibos aroma and a choice of three teas) ¥2,200 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Café · Namba, a French tea salon in Takashimaya] Up on Takashimaya's second floor among the brand boutiques, a calm, black-toned salon that the official site calls Japan's first tea salon and boutique made with Dammann Frères, the Paris tea house given France's tea monopoly by Louis XIV in 1692, and chef Yasushi Karato of lumière in Shinsaibashi. Pick from more than 60 teas, served in a pot with the leaves taken out so they do not stew, alongside food from the lumière side: galettes folded around shrimp in lobster sauce or salmon, a seasonal one-plate lunch, a croque monsieur, steaks, and sweets from French toast to a Mont Blanc. The weekday afternoon tea (¥4,950, from 13:00) comes with free-flow tea. Weekday lunches fill by 12:30. Tabelog Cafe 100 in 2021 and Cafe WEST 100 in 2025. Teas and tea accessories are sold too. Open daily 10:00–20:00 with the store.

roles: Producer: chef Yasushi Karato of lumière (osaka_lumiere_higashishinsaibashi), head of the Lumière Group (official sites)
Run by the Lumière Group as one of its two DAMMANN lumière tea salons (k-coeur.com; dammann.jp)
chef_bio.background: Per dammann.jp: DAMMANN lumière is a collaboration between Dammann Frères and the French restaurant lumière, produced by Yasushi Karato, and Japan's first tea salon and boutique for the brand; besides Dammann Frères teas and accessories it serves seasonal dishes and desserts with more than 60 teas. Dammann Frères dates its history to 1692, when Louis XIV granted サー・ダマン (as written) the sole right to sell tea in France, and blends more than 300 teas, among them グールース, a French take on Earl Grey. The second DAMMANN lumière is in Daimaru Ashiya. Per the store page and Karato's profile there: trained at many famous restaurants and hotels, opened lumière in 2006, imports Dammann Frères, and heads a ten-shop group. This salon opened on 3 March 2011 (Tabelog). A September 2026 diner calls it "a well-known collaboration between Chef Takawata and Daman Frere" (as written).
chef_bio.specialty: Dammann Frères teas in the pot; galettes; afternoon tea; French toast.

anecdotes.text: "When I arrived at 11:45 AM, about half of the seats were filled, but by 12:30 PM, it was completely full. It's clear that this place is popular even on weekdays." — October 2026, a sixth visit, one-plate lunch with Anichai tea.
"I appreciated that [the staff] removed the tea leaves, so it didn't become overly bitter even if I took my time." — October 2026, Darjeeling with a sweets set.
"There was a brief explanation about Goulus included, which I thought was a nice touch." — September 2026, the seasonal dessert set, ¥2,200.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ダマンフレール公式サイト (dammann.jp): ダマンフレールの歴史は1692年、ルイ14世からフランス国内での紅茶の独占販売権を許可されたことに始まる、「グールース」をはじめ300種以上のブレンドティー、12年連続でミシュランの星を獲得したシェフ唐渡泰がオーナーシェフのフレンチレストラン「リュミエール」とのコラボレーションによる日本初のティーサロン&ブティック「ダマンリュミエール」、旬の食材の料理やデザートと60種類以上の紅茶。店舗: ダマンリュミエール 高島屋大阪店、難波5丁目1番5号 高島屋大阪店2F、10:00-20:00 (LO19:00)、定休日は施設に準ずる、52席 (個室あり)。芦屋店 (大丸芦屋店1階) も。リュミエールグループ (k-coeur.com): ティーサロンとして DAMMANN lumière 高島屋大阪店と芦屋店。食べログ (店舗会員): カフェ・フレンチ・スイーツ、平日のみ2名から予約可、個室は平日5名以上、36席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、アレルギー表示あり、2011年3月3日オープン、カフェ 百名店 2021、カフェ WEST 百名店 2025。食べログのメニュー (英訳で確認): アフタヌーンティー4,950円 (平日13時から、紅茶はおかわり自由)、ガレット1,760〜1,870円、パスタ、クロックムッシュ、ヘルシーランチセット1,430円、ステーキ、フレンチトースト1,980円、モンブラン、スコーン。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年10月): 番号で選ぶ紅茶、ポットで茶葉を抜いて出す、Ginori の大皿のワンプレートランチ、エビのガレット、平日の昼は満席に、季節のデザートセット2,200円、グールースの説明つき、週末はアフタヌーンティーなし。

cultural_comfort.note: Teas are numbered on the menu; reservations on weekdays only. No English evidence found.

places.name: 北極 難波本店 (Hokkyoku Namba Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The milk ice candy's label lists sweetened condensed milk, sugar, starch and flavouring (October 2026 review); the type of starch is not given, and the other flavours' ingredients are not published.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The milk ice candy is made with condensed milk and the soft serve with Hokkaido milk; the azuki (Tokachi beans, per the shop), fruit, ramune and matcha candies are not described, so ask about milk in them.
places.hours_raw: Daily 10:30–20:00, open all year (official company page; an October 2026 review gives the same). Tabelog lists 10:00–20:00. No reservations (Tabelog). The ground floor is takeaway only, with a bin but no seats (October 2026); the 2F café opened on 25 April 2023 (Tabelog) and asks for one drink per person, with a last order (October 2026). Free dry ice for up to an hour with six candies (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR (PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY); no e-money (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Online shop and shipping (official site). Founded 1945 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Namba 3-8-22, on the Ebisubashi-suji shopping street (light-blue sign with two penguins) — 3 min from Namba Stn (Midosuji Line)
places.cuisine: Handmade ice candy since 1945 (official site; prices tax included) · ice candy ¥200: milk, cocoa, matcha, azuki, pineapple; ¥230: mixed juice, mango, strawberry, ramune, grape (new in August 2026) · cup ice ¥380: mango, milk, hyuganatsu, Osaka mixed juice · soft serve ¥500: Hokkaido milk, Uji matcha, or the two mixed (October 2026) · reduced-price candies in the case at times, ¥150–¥180 (October 2026) · a separate menu at the 2F café (October 2026) · penguin goods
places.notes: [Sweets · Namba, Osaka's 1945 ice-candy shop] On the Ebisubashi-suji shopping street under a light-blue sign with two penguins, the ice-candy maker Osaka has known since just after the war. The founder started in 1945, when hardly any shop around Namba had food to sell, wanting to give children and women something cold and sweet, using precious sugar and selling each candy for ¥20 (official site). The milk, azuki and pineapple of that first year are still made, now with cocoa (first made in 1946 with cocoa imported from the occupation forces), matcha, strawberry, mango, ramune, mixed juice and, since August 2026, grape. Eight craftsmen make about 6,000 a day by hand, sweetened with white sugar crystals rather than sweeteners, with Tokachi azuki and diagonal sticks of Yoshino hinoki and cedar. Most are ¥200–¥230; soft serve of Hokkaido milk and Uji matcha is ¥500. Takeaway downstairs, a café upstairs since 2023. Tabelog Ice cream/gelato 100 in 2023 and 2026. Open daily 10:30–20:00.

roles: Representative: 久保田光恵 (as written; no romaji given), since 2005, of 株式会社アークティック (official company page)
chef_bio.background: Per the official history and company pages: founded in Namba in 1945 (昭和20年), selling milk, azuki and pineapple ice candy at ¥20; in 1946 made cocoa ice candy with cocoa imported from the occupation forces; radio advertising from 1952 and television and film advertising from 1953; in 1955 the Hokkyoku Building was completed, with a factory in the basement and a café and light meals on the first and second floors, also selling Western cakes and Japanese sweets; it was the second shop in Namba with an automatic door and brought in a colour television, filling the room for 力道山 wrestling broadcasts. In 2005 久保田光恵 became representative and 株式会社アークティック was set up. The company page recalls children who came for candy then and now buy them as gifts as grown men. Eight craftsmen make about 6,000 candies a day, 700,000 a year. The 2F café opened on 25 April 2023 (Tabelog). Tabelog Ice cream/gelato 100 in 2023 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: From the founder on: a cold, tasty ice candy for children and women in the hungry years after the war; a place to relax on the Ebisubashi shopping street; the same handmade taste then and now (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Milk ice candy; azuki ice candy; soft serve.

anecdotes.text: "My parents used to frequent it when [my parents] were kids." — October 2026, soft serve mix, ¥500.
"The ice candy here features a stick (a chopstick from Yoshino, Nara) inserted diagonally, which is a unique touch for easier eating." — October 2026, milk ice candy ¥200.
"Thanks to years of commercials, it's hard to find someone who hasn't heard of it." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hokkyoku.jp): 北極、なんば戎橋筋、大阪名物手作りアイスキャンデー、創業昭和20年、当初からの味「ミルク」「あずき」「パイン」、現在は「ココア」「イチゴ」「抹茶」「マンゴー」「ラムネ」「ぶどう」も、職人が一本一本手作り。歴史: 昭和20年大阪難波にて創業 (当時20円)、昭和21年進駐軍からココアを輸入しココア味を製造、昭和27年ラジオCM、昭和28年東宝映画とテレビCM、昭和30年北極ビル完成 (地下に工場、1階・2階で喫茶・軽食、洋菓子や和菓子も)、難波で2番目に自動ドア、カラーテレビで力道山のプロレス中継は毎回満席、平成17年久保田光恵が代表に就任、株式会社アークティック設立。会社概要: 終戦直後に初代が「せめて、子供達や女性にだけでも冷たくて美味しいアイスキャンデーを造ってあげたい」と思ったのがきっかけ、難波3-8-22、10:30-20:00、年中無休。こだわり: 奈良県吉野産のひのきと杉の棒を斜めに刺す、白双糖を使い甘味料は使わない、北海道の十勝産あずき100%、8人の職人で1日6000本、年間70万本。商品: ミルク・ココア・抹茶・あずき・パイン200円、ミックスジュース・マンゴー・イチゴ・ラムネ・ぶどう230円、カップ380円 (マンゴー、ミルク、日向夏、大阪名物ミックスジュース)。食べログ: アイスクリーム・ジェラート 百名店 2023・2026、2023年4月25日に2階にカフェ、予約不可、カード・QR可。口コミ(2026年10月〜11月): ソフトクリーム500円 (北海道のミルク、宇治抹茶、ミックス)、1階は持ち帰りのみ、2階カフェはワンドリンク制、6本でドライアイス1時間無料、値引きのアイス。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose from the two cases and pay; staff are friendly (October 2026).

places.name: 心斎橋かわぐち (Shinsaibashi Kawaguchi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Salt skewers and chicken sashimi (with wasabi or salt) are the plainest; tsukune comes with sauce (October 2026), the rice with raw egg uses soy-sauce koji (April 2025), and side dishes include kara-age, keema curry and truffle salt bread.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken restaurant. Vegetable skewers (shiitake, tomato, ginkgo, raw-eatable corn in season) are on the menu, but nothing is described as vegan.
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30) (official site; Tabelog). Reservations through the official site (Tabelog; official site); often fully booked even on the day, so book ahead (2025–2026 reviews), though a diner walked in after 22:00 on a July 2026 holiday. Cards: JCB, AMEX and Diners only; no e-money or QR (official site; Tabelog). Smoking allowed (official site). 14 seats at a counter facing the charcoal, plus private rooms for 4, 6 or 8 (official site; Tabelog); an October 2025 diner mentions a separate area on the third floor. No parking (official site).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-19-11, ピテカントロプスビル 1F, in an alley of the Unagidani area — 3 min from Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: Binchotan yakitori of morning-slaughtered jidori, with chicken sashimi (official site) · the sashimi platter of six cuts (breast, thigh, tender, heart, gizzard, liver) that diners call the must-order; seasoned liver sashimi ¥850; red-chicken yukke; smoked liver; tataki · skewers: neck, white liver, heart, gizzard, tamahimo, chicken tail (served medium-rare, October 2026), tsukune with egg yolk, breast with wasabi or ume-shiso, "sori", a rare cut (2025–2026 reviews); vegetables such as Tokushima shiitake, tomato and ginkgo · side dishes: tamahimo shigure-ni (a soy simmer), dashimaki with minced chicken inside, kara-age, potato salad, truffle salt bread with keema curry, a limited five servings of keema curry, sweet-potato brûlée · finish with rice and raw egg · courses ¥6,600 (official site) and an omakase of six skewers and three dishes (September 2026) · a back bar of premium sake, plus shochu and wine (Tabelog; 2024 review) · diners report ¥6,000–¥14,999 a head (2026). The chicken is named as Satsuma chicken in May 2024 and October 2026 reviews and as Ise Akadori from Mie in another October 2026 review
places.notes: [Yakitori · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, chicken sashimi and binchotan skewers in an alley] A 14-seat counter in a Shinsaibashi back alley, where you watch each skewer grilled over the charcoal in front of you; the official site counts six Tabelog Yakitori 100 selections (2018–2024). Start with the six-cut platter of morning-slaughtered chicken sashimi, which diners call the dish you would regret skipping, then move to the offal skewers the kitchen is known for (liver that even liver-haters eat, white liver, heart, neck, tamahimo) and finish with rice and raw egg. Side dishes are generous: a dashimaki with minced chicken inside, keema curry, truffle salt bread, a sweet-potato brûlée. It is almost always full, so book through the site; one diner who has come for over ten years, with children, recommends it to anyone asking for yakitori, while a busy September 2026 night meant an hour for the first three skewers. Smoking is allowed; JCB, AMEX and Diners only. Open daily 17:00–24:00.

roles: Grill cooks and a manager (unnamed; "the person grilling in front of the charcoal", April 2026; "Thank you, manager", August 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (built on AutoReserve and linked from the Tabelog listing): a charcoal yakitori shop in a Shinsaibashi alley, selected for Tabelog Yakitori 100 in 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024; morning-slaughtered jidori, a six-cut sashimi platter, offal skewers grilled so the liver stays soft and the heart juicy, tamahimo shigure-ni (a soy simmer), Tokushima shiitake, and rice with raw egg to finish; 14 seats including the counter and small private rooms. No opening date or owner is given in the sources read. Diners name the chicken as Satsuma chicken (May 2024; a Satsuma chicken tataki in October 2026) and as Ise Akadori from Mie (another October 2026 review). A September 2026 reviewer calls the shop "Kawaguchi Hanare", a name not found elsewhere.
chef_bio.philosophy: Freshness of morning-slaughtered chicken and careful charcoal heat in every skewer (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken sashimi platter; white liver; rice with raw egg.

anecdotes.text: "I've been a regular at this restaurant for over 10 years, and I used to visit every month. My kids love it too!" — August 2026.
"I had the chicken tail served medium-rare, and it was exceptional as well! Only restaurants confident in their freshness serve chicken tail this way." — October 2026, a third visit.
"Given the crowd, it was understandable that [the staff] forgot my drink order, and it took an hour for just three skewers to arrive." — September 2026, the omakase course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kawaguchi-9489.com): 心斎橋かわぐち、心斎橋の路地で朝引き地鶏を炭火で焼き上げる百名店の焼き鳥店、心斎橋駅から徒歩3分、食べログ焼鳥百名店に2018・2019・2021・2022・2023・2024年の6度選出、朝引き地鶏のむね・もも・ささみ・こころ・ずり・きもの6種盛りお造り、内臓系の炭火串 (レバーは柔らかくトロトロ、こころはジューシー)、玉ひもしぐれ煮、徳島産じいじいしいたけ、〆の卵かけご飯、6,000円コース (6,600円)、味肝のお造り850円、カウンター席と少人数向けの個室で14席、予約必須、月〜日 17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:30)、駐車場なし、カードは JCB・AMEX・Diners、電子マネー・QR不可、店内で喫煙可、東心斎橋1-19-11 ピテカントロプスビル 1F。食べログ: 焼き鳥・鶏料理・創作料理、予約は公式サイトから、個室 (4、6、8名)、日本酒・焼酎・ワインにこだわり。口コミ(2025年4月〜2026年10月): お造り盛り合わせは必須、白レバー、ぼんじり、つくね、ささみのわさび、トリュフの塩パン、キーマカレー、肉入りのだし巻き、卵かけご飯、いつも満席で予約必須、10年以上通う人も、Ise Akadori (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book on the official site, which has an English version; order à la carte or a course at the counter.

places.name: 丑寅 (Ushi Tora)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi, grilled fish and salt-grilled chicken neck are the plainest; kara-age, tempura (conger eel, maitake, ginger), macaroni salads, rice noodles and dishes in sauce or broth are not.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu is mainly seafood and meat, and several small plates use broth (fried eggplant in broth, dashi omelette). Grilled shiitake and ginger tempura appear on the menu; ask what is in the batter and sauces.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 16:00–23:00; Sat–Sun 15:00–23:00; public holidays 15:00–22:00; open all year (Tabelog). No reservations; often a short queue outside (2026 reviews). From October 2026 the shop takes no groups of three or more; come alone or as a pair (Tabelog notice). No soft drinks; no minors (Tabelog). The shop asks you not to linger (Tabelog), and diners describe drinking quickly and moving on (2024–2026). No cards or e-money (Tabelog). 28 standing places at the counter; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Behind Takashimaya, near Nankai Namba Station, behind a vinyl curtain (September 2026 reviews).
places.neighborhood: Namba Sennichimae 15-19, in Ura Namba behind Takashimaya — 3 min from Nankai Namba Stn, 5 min from Namba Stn (Midosuji Line)
places.cuisine: Standing bar of creative Japanese small plates and seafood (dated from 2026 reviews; shop menu on Tabelog) · a three-item assortment for solo drinkers ¥500 (September 2026), the obanzai of the day laid out along the counter: e.g. motsu-ni, shrimp and avocado mentaiko macaroni, spinach (October 2026) · sashimi platter for one, fresh bluefin tuna, namero with yuzu · the house kara-age with rakkyo tartar sauce ¥350 a piece (shop menu), double-fried · grilled and simmered conger eel, conger-eel jelly, uzaku, unagi shirayaki · fried eggplant in broth, dashi omelette with pickled ginger, tsukune and thick fried tofu in chilli sauce ¥400, mentaiko-tomato macaroni with clams ¥380, seaweed rolls ¥580 (October 2026); lamb, chicken neck grilled with salt and black shichimi; ginger tempura ¥180 (shop menu) · bottled Sapporo beer, mega Kaku highball ¥700, imo shochu soda, seasonal sours and a wide sake list; no soft drinks · a typical visit ¥1,750–¥3,660 (2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Ura Namba, a standing bar for one or two] Behind a vinyl curtain in the lanes behind Takashimaya, a long standing counter for 28, lined with the day's small plates. The shop's own words: a place for a quick drink after work, not for lingering or large groups, and since October 2026 for one or two only, with no soft drinks. Order the ¥500 assortment of three plates for one, then sashimi, the double-fried kara-age with rakkyo tartar sauce (a diner on a 21st visit jokes about quitting work to make the tartar sauce), conger eel grilled or set in jelly, and whatever is on the counter. Staff, mostly women in an October 2026 visit, keep it moving. Tabelog Tachinomi 100 in 2025. Expect a short wait outside; open daily from 16:00, 15:00 at weekends.

roles: Staff (unnamed; "mostly women" in an October 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing with the shop's own welcome note for first-time visitors; no opening date or owner is given. October 2026 reviewers call it a long-established standing bar and "a pioneer of the standing bar boom". Tabelog Tachinomi 100, 2025. Several diners have visited 11 to 24 times (2024–2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: A standing bar for a quick drink without lingering, a cozy spot to unwind after work; come alone or as a pair (shop note on Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Three-plate assortment for one; kara-age with rakkyo tartar sauce; conger eel.

anecdotes.text: "I love it so much that I'm considering quitting my job to become a pickled shallot tartar sauce vendor." — September 2026, a 21st visit; kara-age, sashimi platter, roast pork and a highball, ¥3,080.
"The jelly-like dish was beautifully garnished with chrysanthemum flowers, and I was once again amazed that this is a standing bar in the back streets of Namba." — September 2026, a tenth visit.
"It seems like the rule here is to drink quickly and not linger, as everyone seems to understand" — June 2024, a 12th visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 丑寅、立ち飲み、難波千日前15-19、地下鉄なんば駅から徒歩5分、南海なんば駅から徒歩3分、月〜金 16:00〜23:00、土日 15:00〜23:00、祝日 15:00〜22:00、年中無休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、28名の立ち飲み、喫煙可、未成年は入店不可、ソフトドリンクなし、2026年10月から3名以上の団体は不可、立ち飲み 百名店 2025。食べログのメニュー (英訳で確認): kara-age のらっきょうタルタル350円、生姜の天ぷら180円。口コミ(2024年6月〜2026年10月): おひとりさまの3種盛り500円、カウンターに並ぶおばんざい、刺身盛り、本まぐろ、なめろう、穴子の白焼き、うざく、だし巻き、kara-age、メガ角ハイボール700円、日本酒の品ぞろえ、長居しないのがルール、外で少し待つ、スタッフは女性が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: A crowded standing counter; order from the dishes laid out or the menu; one or two people only; no soft drinks. No English evidence found.

places.name: 焼肉割烹 YP流 西心斎橋店 (Yakiniku Kappou YPryu Nishi-Shinsaibashi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The meat is eaten with a washing sauce, salt or wasabi (official site), and some courses include a sukiyaki-style seasoning, a fillet-cutlet sandwich and a wagyu dashi chazuke; none is described as gluten-free.

places.hours_raw: Dinner daily 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); lunch Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00); closed on some days, posted on Instagram (official site). places.cuisine: Course yakiniku of long-fed wagyu heifers (prices from the official site, tax included, read November 2026) · Introductory course (weekdays) ¥5,000 · Challenge course ¥7,000, the one the shop recommends to everyone: three starters, seared yukhoe, a mini bowl of wagyu with sea urchin and salmon roe, the fillet-cutlet sandwich only this branch makes, the six-cut "flower staircase" platter, wagyu dashi chazuke, yuzu sherbet · Heritage course ¥9,000 · Anniversary course ¥10,000 with a cake in a treasure chest · all-you-can-drink ¥2,000 more · extra grilled cuts for course guests, e.g. sirloin cap and ribeye (October 2026) · lunch: a limited wagyu rice box with dashi to pour over, ¥1,500 or ¥3,000 (October 2026) · drinks such as white wine ¥748 (October 2026)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishi-Shinsaibashi, the staircase platter] The quieter of the two YP流 shops, down a staircase into a calm, Japanese-modern basement a minute from Shinsaibashi Station, serving 'yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach': long-fed heifers such as Yamagata beef, eaten with a light washing sauce, salt or wasabi rather than heavy sauce. Dinner is courses only. The ¥7,000 Challenge course is the one to book: seared yukhoe, a wagyu bowl with sea urchin and salmon roe, a thick, tender fillet-cutlet sandwich made only at this branch, then the six-cut 'flower staircase' platter you eat from the top step down (the tongue grilled well, the rest lightly), and wagyu dashi chazuke to finish. Diners in October 2026 found it light to the end and good for dates and business; one birthday party found the young part-time staff short of high-end service. Weekend lunch is a wagyu rice box. Ring the intercom; no sandals.

roles: Representative (unnamed) who buys at the auctions; meat craftsmen at the counter
chef_bio.background: Per the two official sites (ypryu-nishi.com, ypryu-honten.com): "Japanese-style yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach" (胃もたれしない、和の焼肉), using only long-fed heifers chosen for bloodline and producer, such as Noto beef and Yamagata beef, eaten with a washing sauce (洗いダレ), salt and wasabi; the signature is the "flower staircase" platter (花の階段盛り), six cuts set out on a stepped stand; anniversary courses end with a cake in a treasure chest. The founding wish: "to make a place where young customers can look good" (若いお客様でも格好の付けれるお店を作りたい), a "first high-end restaurant", and the site says many guests are twenty-somethings (20代のお客様に数多く御来店). Per the Nishi-Shinsaibashi Tabelog listing, the company's representative goes to the auctions personally to buy long-reared female cattle. Two shops: the Souemoncho main shop (opened 29 September 2017) and Nishi-Shinsaibashi (5 June 2022), per Tabelog.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Japanese-style yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Flower staircase platter; fillet-cutlet sandwich (this branch only); wagyu dashi chazuke.

anecdotes.text: "It's suggested to grill the tongue well, while the others should be grilled lightly." — October 2026, the Challenge course ¥7,000.
"Premium Salted Tongue, Sirloin Cap, Top Sirloin, Gluteus Accessorius, Premium Loin, and Special Loin! … personally, I especially loved the Sirloin Cap!" — October 2026, the staircase platter.
"While the children enjoyed udon, we were constantly amazed by the flavor of the meat." — October 2026, a birthday lunch in the private room.

places.cuisine: Specialty coffee roasted in-house, with three bean options and five brewing methods to choose from (Tabelog): siphon, AeroPress and others · Kenya with chocolate and blackberry notes (August 2026), Colombia medium roast by siphon, light-roast Ethiopia, seasonal Mexico · each cup comes with a card describing the beans (2026) · sweets: tiramisu made with the house blend, baked cheesecake, affogato · coffee float with rum-raisin or vanilla ice cream · seasonal coffee-and-dessert pairings, e.g. Mexico coffee with sweet potato, cream and nuts ¥1,300 with a refill pot (October 2026) · beans, brewing gear and LiLo goods to buy
places.notes: [Kissaten · Shinsaibashi, beans and brew to order] A retro second-floor coffee room between the Shinsaibashi-suji arcade and Midosuji, the sister of LiLo Coffee Roasters in Nishi-Shinsaibashi. The staff explain each bean in detail, then you choose the beans and the method (siphon, AeroPress and more) and get a card describing your cup; a September 2026 couple had a dark Kenya by AeroPress and a medium Colombia by siphon. The room keeps the look of the cocoa shop that was here before (Akatori, per the staff), Showa-era walls, clocks and chairs. Pair a cup with the tiramisu made from the house blend, the rich cheesecake, or a float with rum-raisin ice cream; a seasonal coffee-and-dessert set was ¥1,300 in October 2026. Expect a 20–30 minute queue on the stairs in the afternoon; staff take orders as you wait and explain in English. PayPay or cash.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing: specialty coffee roasted in-house, baristas who ask about your taste and mood, three specialty coffees and five brewing methods, seasonal drinks and sweets, beans, equipment and original LiLo goods. Opened 6 June 2018. Sister of LiLo Coffee Roasters at Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-10-28 (osaka_lilo_coffee_roasters_shinsaibashi; same website). An August 2026 diner was told by the staff that the room was formerly a cocoa specialty shop called Akatori, and that its atmosphere was kept.
chef_bio.specialty: Choice of beans and brewing method; tiramisu with the house blend; coffee float with rum-raisin ice cream.

anecdotes.text: "I learned from the staff that this used to be a cocoa specialty shop called 'Akatori.' They have maintained the atmosphere from that time" — August 2026, a Kenya by siphon.
"The staff explained everything in English very carefully, which made me feel that the place is popular among foreigners!" — October 2026, tiramisu and coffee.
"While waiting, they kindly took my order in advance, so I was able to enjoy my drink quickly." — October 2026, a seasonal Mexico coffee pairing ¥1,300.

places.name: おおさか料理 淺井 (Osaka Ryori Asai)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. The daily menu runs to 150-plus dishes, including tempura, fried skewers and a beef cutlet, and Osaka cooking is built on dashi and soy sauce. The official menu page asks guests to tell the restaurant about allergies in advance.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Osaka-style cooking of fish, shellfish, whale and meat, seasoned with dashi.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00; holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday (official site). Tabelog lists holidays as closed; ask before a holiday visit. Reservations recommended, preferably by phone (official site; July 2026). Cash or cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (official site). 45 seats: a 16-seat counter, tables for up to 30, private rooms on two floors (1F and 7F); designated smoking area; children welcome with a kids menu (Tabelog; official site). Takeaway: sansho jako, sardines for chazuke and bento boxes (official site). Formerly named おおさか料理 喜川 浅井 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-6-19, ロイヤル中家 1F, in a back street — 4 min from Nagahoribashi Stn, 5 min from Shinsaibashi
places.cuisine: Osaka cooking: more than 150 dishes, Japanese, Western and Chinese, on a long handwritten scroll menu that changes daily with the morning market (official site); prices are not shown on it (2026 reviews) · courses (official site, tax included): 竹 seven dishes with rice and dessert ¥14,300, 梅 ¥18,700, 楽 six dishes plus one of your choice ¥22,000; or five dishes left to the chef at ¥14,300 or ¥18,700 · hamo shabu-shabu, tecchiri and crab hot pot on request · dishes in 2026 reviews: assorted sashimi, tender simmered octopus, beef cutlet with a rare centre, hamo with plum, grilled abalone with asparagus in butter, red clam with junsai, tempura of spring vegetables and young ayu, fried whale skewers, eggplant and crab in a thickened sauce, marinated tuna rice bowl with fish broth, Nara-zuke with cream cheese · two diners spent just under ¥30,000 with drinks (June 2026) · to take home: sansho jako ¥2,200, simmered sardines for chazuke ¥2,200, bento from ¥4,320 (official site)
places.notes: [Osaka ryori · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a 150-dish scroll] A busy Osaka-cuisine counter in a Higashi-Shinsaibashi back street, where a scroll-long handwritten menu of more than 150 dishes is rewritten every day from the morning market and carries no prices; the restaurant was formerly called Kikawa Asai. Sit at the 16-seat counter to watch a kitchen of about seven cooks (May 2026), and order freely: sashimi, tender simmered octopus, hamo in summer, a beef cutlet with a rare centre that one regular never skips, fried whale skewers, Nara-zuke with cream cheese, a tuna bowl with fish broth to finish. Or let the chef choose five dishes (¥14,300 or ¥18,700) or take a course. Two diners spent just under ¥30,000 with drinks (June 2026). Diners praise the dashi and the staff; one found it flawless but unexciting (September 2026). Book by phone. Closed Sundays.

roles: Kitchen of about seven cooks (unnamed; May 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: run by 株式会社一是; "おおさか うまいもん"; the day's menu is decided by what comes from the market each morning, with more than 150 dishes on a scroll-like menu, Japanese, Western and Chinese; guests choose freely or leave it to the chef; "the traditional taste and skill of Osaka cuisine". Tabelog gives the former name おおさか料理 喜川 浅井, and a 2020 review calls it a branch from the famous restaurant Kikawa. The official site writes the name 淺井; Tabelog 浅井.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Seasonal Japanese ingredients, cooked with time and care", to be picked at "with idle chatter" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Scroll menu of 150-plus dishes; beef cutlet; hamo.

anecdotes.text: "Upon entering, the first thing that surprises you is the number of chefs! For the size of the restaurant, it seems like only 2 or 3 would be enough, but there are about 7!" — May 2026.
"Among the dishes, the beef cutlet is a must-try. It's perfectly cooked, with a crispy coating and a beautifully rare center." — September 2026, a regular's third visit.
"The menu does not display prices, which can be a bit nerve-wracking at first. However, for two people, we spent just under JPY 30,000" — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: おおさか料理 淺井、運営は株式会社一是、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-19 ロイヤル中家1F・7F、長堀橋駅から徒歩4分、心斎橋駅から徒歩5分、月〜土17:00〜23:00、祝日17:00〜22:00、日曜定休、カウンター16席、テーブル30席、現金・カード可、予約は電話がおすすめ。「おおさか うまいもん」、日本の旬を活かし手間暇をかけて調理、毎朝市場から仕入れた食材でその日の献立、巻物の如く長いお品書きに常時150種以上、和洋中、好きな料理を選ぶか板前のお任せコース、おおさか料理伝統の味と技。コース (税込): 竹コース14,300円、梅コース18,700円、楽コース22,000円、お任せ5品14,300円・18,700円、鱧しゃぶ・てっちり・カニ鍋も、苦手な食材やアレルギーは事前に。お土産: 山椒じゃこ2,200円、お茶漬け用鰯2,200円、お弁当4,320円〜。食べログ: 旧店名 おおさか料理 喜川 浅井、45席、個室、分煙、子ども・キッズメニュー可、日・祝休み。口コミ(2026年4月〜10月): 値段の書いていない長いお品書き、板前が7人ほど、カウンターがおすすめ、お造り、タコのやわらか煮、ビーフカツ、鱧、梅肉の鱧、アワビとアスパラのバター焼き、赤貝と junsai、春野菜と稚鮎の天ぷら、クジラの串揚げ、なすと蟹のあんかけ、マグロの漬け丼、Nara-zuke とクリームチーズ、2人で3万円弱、だしの深い味わい、電話予約で外国人スタッフが対応、完璧だが面白みはないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site has an English version; a foreign staff member took one diner's phone booking (August 2026). The menu itself is a handwritten Japanese scroll without prices.

staff_allergy_handling: Official menu page: "苦手な食材、アレルギーなどのご要望がございましたら事前にお知らせください" (tell the restaurant about dislikes and allergies in advance).

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: course yakiniku of wagyu, with yukhoe, sukiyaki and beef dashi.

places.cuisine: Course yakiniku of long-fed wagyu heifers, plated (prices from the official site, tax included, read November 2026) · each plate course has nine grilled cuts, three of tongue, three salt-grilled and three in sauce, plus wagyu sukiyaki dipped in egg: meat-only omakase ¥5,500, Souemoncho course with starters, rice and dessert ¥7,700 (the most popular per an October 2026 review), Kobe beef course with a mini steak ¥10,000, anniversary course with a cake in a treasure chest ¥10,000, premium anniversary ¥12,000, clay-pot course ending with tongue and salmon-roe rice ¥11,000; all-you-can-drink ¥2,000 more · the "flower staircase" platter of six cuts in other courses (October 2026) · house dishes: wagyu dashi chazuke, a soy-milk bun in a warm thickened sauce (official site) · cuts named in October 2026 reviews: Yamagata, Omi, Kobe and Kagoshima beef, tongue three ways, misuji, chuck tender, ribeye, sirloin cap · starters of three kimchi and three namul, seared yukhoe with egg yolk, beef shigureni, wakame soup, yuzu sherbet · lunch: wagyu and salmon-roe bowl with broth, 15 a day (October 2026), or the same courses as dinner
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Souemoncho, the YP流 main shop] The first YP流, behind a locked door in a basement on the east side of Souemoncho, a minute from Dotonbori: course yakiniku of long-fed wagyu heifers, served with salt, wasabi or a light washing sauce, 'yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach'. The ¥7,700 Souemoncho course is the favourite: kimchi and namul, seared yukhoe with egg yolk, three cuts of tongue, three salt-grilled and three sauce-grilled cuts from Yamagata, Omi or Kobe beef, then wagyu sukiyaki, rice and yuzu sherbet; staff time each plate to your pace and butcher at the counter in front of you. The shop says some 2,000 parties a year come for anniversaries, with cake in a treasure chest. Lunch at weekends brings a limited wagyu and salmon-roe bowl or the full course; one diner found the lunch meat thin for the price (October 2026). From late October 2026 single dishes can be ordered too. Ring the intercom.

chef_bio.background: Per the two official sites (ypryu-nishi.com, ypryu-honten.com): "Japanese-style yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach" (胃もたれしない、和の焼肉), using only long-fed heifers chosen for bloodline and producer, such as Noto beef and Yamagata beef, eaten with a washing sauce (洗いダレ), salt and wasabi; the signature is the "flower staircase" platter (花の階段盛り), six cuts set out on a stepped stand; anniversary courses end with a cake in a treasure chest. The founding wish: "to make a place where young customers can look good" (若いお客様でも格好の付けれるお店を作りたい), a "first high-end restaurant", and the site says many guests are twenty-somethings (20代のお客様に数多く御来店). Per the Nishi-Shinsaibashi Tabelog listing, the company's representative goes to the auctions personally to buy long-reared female cattle. Two shops: the Souemoncho main shop (opened 29 September 2017) and Nishi-Shinsaibashi (5 June 2022), per Tabelog. The Souemoncho site adds that about 2,000 parties a year choose the shop for anniversaries, and that it serves its own wagyu dashi chazuke and a soy-milk bun in warm sauce. Tabelog notes guests include young people, couples and international travellers, and points business diners to the quieter Nishi-Shinsaibashi shop.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Japanese-style yakiniku that won't weigh on your stomach" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Plate courses of nine cuts with wagyu sukiyaki; flower staircase platter.

anecdotes.text: "Moreover, I appreciated how they timed the serving of the next meat based on my pace." — October 2026, the Pure Yakiniku Course ¥7,700.
"Watching the butchering process right in front of me added to the overall experience! There were many young regulars dining alone" — October 2026, a first visit.
"I was delighted to learn that I could enjoy the same course for lunch as I would for dinner" — October 2026, the last day of a trip to Osaka.

cultural_comfort.note: Official site and courses in English, Chinese and Korean; international travellers among the guests (Tabelog).

places.name: 肉料理とワイン YUZAN 南船場 (Niku Ryori to Wine YUZAN Minamisenba)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Seasoning is kept simple, but the shop names a naturally brewed, three-year soy sauce and miso among its seasonings (official site), and dipping sauces of soy, miso and sudachi come with the meat (August 2026); courses end with a spice curry or cold noodles.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an aged-beef and horumon restaurant; the vegetables come with the meat courses and the red-wine shabu-shabu.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 17:30–23:00, last order 22:30 (official site); Tabelog gives 17:00–23:00 with last order food 21:30, drinks 22:00, and says closing time can depend on how much meat is left; closed Sunday and Monday, with occasional irregular closures. Reservations by phone (official site) or online (Tabelog). Cancellation: 30% of the course two days before, 50% the day before, 100% on the day (official site; Tabelog gives 50% and 100%). Table charge ¥550 per person (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 47 seats: tables for 4 ×7 and 6 ×2, a private room for 7, rooms up to 15; non-smoking, smoking area on the terrace; whole-restaurant hire up to 50 (Tabelog; official site). Children only when a private room is free (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Minami-Semba 1-10-2, in a quiet office district between Nagahoribashi and Matsuyamachi — 3–5 min from Nagahoribashi Stn exit 1
places.cuisine: Charcoal-grilled aged beef, all aged on the bone (official site): Omi beef rump and ichibo and older cows from サカエヤ in Kusatsu, Shiga; grazed shorthorn T-bone and misuji from Hokkaido's エレゾ; fresh black-wagyu heifers from やまさん牧場, a farm of more than 100 years whose cattle eat fermented pineapple and sugarcane (fillet, shintama and other rare cuts); horumon from fully free-grazing "jibeef" cattle of 様似牧場 in Hokkaido · no chemical seasonings since opening; seasonings named by the shop include three-year-brewed soy sauce and miso from 井上本店, apple and rice vinegar, special salts and Awaji Island sun-dried salt (official site) · courses, tax excluded (official site, read November 2026): own-pace yakiniku course ¥8,500, a modest course ¥10,000, a full run of YUZAN's chosen meats ¥13,000 (Kagoshima black wagyu fillet), a block of meat grilled by the chef ¥15,000–25,000; red-wine shabu-shabu ¥12,000, premium ¥15,000 with Chateaubriand · on Tabelog the same yakiniku courses are ¥9,350, ¥11,000 and ¥14,300 with tax · à la carte (tax excluded): seared black-wagyu carpaccio ¥2,300, 100% beef terrine ¥1,800, stewed jibeef horumon ¥850, special salted tongue ¥2,000, meat and horumon platter ¥5,000; a glass of wine with appetizers for solo diners · from reviews: omasum with a miso-based sauce, horumon in tomato sauce, horumon pâté, 40-day and 3-week aged top sirloin, Kikaijima-farm Chateaubriand (January 2025), spice curry with mango chutney to finish (July 2025, June 2026), sudachi sorbet (August 2026) · a walk-in wine cellar chosen by the owner-sommelier
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Minami-Semba, bone-in aged beef with a walk-in wine cellar] A quiet, spacious meat-and-wine restaurant in an office district near Nagahoribashi, open since the early 1990s and moved here from Ikuno Ward (a June 2025 diner). Everything is aged on the bone: Omi beef from Shiga, grazed shorthorn from Hokkaido, and black wagyu from a century-old Kagoshima farm; the horumon is from free-roaming Hokkaido ジビーフ (jibeef) cattle, lean and grassy. The owner-chef brings a bone-in block to the table, explains each cut and grills it over Kishu binchotan (January 2025). Start with the seared wagyu carpaccio, a must-order for one returning diner, then a course from ¥9,350 with tax, the red-wine shabu-shabu, or à la carte down to a glass of wine and appetizers for one; finish with the spice curry and mango chutney. Diners pick bottles inside the cellar (January 2026). One diner found the soy, miso and sudachi sauces short of punch. Tabelog Yakiniku WEST 100 2020 and 2021.

roles: Owner-sommelier and owner-chef ("Yasuda" in a September 2024 review; no Japanese source names the owner)
Head chef (料理長) grills the blocks at the table (official site)
Operator: the company behind a-nest.co.jp, which also runs 薪火 全 (Makibi Zen) on Awaji Island
chef_bio.background: The official site gives the founding as 1990 in one place and 1992 in another; Tabelog's opening day is 4 November 1993, and its shop text speaks of 34 years and aged Omi beef that draws fans from afar. A June 2025 diner knew it long ago in Ikuno Ward before the move to Minami-Semba. The same operator runs 薪火 全 (Makibi Zen), an 8-seat wood-fire counter in a national park on Awaji Island with one guest room (official site), open on weekends per 2024–2025 reviews. Diners describe the owner-chef explaining each cut's origin and rearing (September 2024) and an attentive owner couple (January 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Seasoning kept to the simplest, so you taste the difference between meats"; no chemical seasonings since opening, "not just delicious, but easy on the body" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Bone-in aged beef; jibeef horumon; seared wagyu carpaccio; spice curry.

anecdotes.text: "The carpaccio remains delicious as ever. It's a must-order… For the finale, I recommend the curry. Be sure to add mango chutney for a perfect finish." — July 2025, back after five years or more.
"I was able to enter the wine cellar and choose my wine while receiving explanations!" — January 2026.
"The Premium Salted Tongue and Aged Omi Beef were surprisingly delicious… The staff kindly explained the characteristics of the meat and the benefits of aged meat." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (a-nest.co.jp): 肉料理とワイン 遊山 Yuzan、心斎橋にほど近い静かなエリアの隠れ家レストラン、1990年創業以来 (別の箇所では1992年の創業以来)、熟成肉は全て骨付き、近江牛ランプ・イチボ / 経産牛は滋賀県草津「サカエヤ」、放牧の短角牛 Tボーン / ミスジは北海道エレゾ、創業100年を超える「やまさん牧場」の発酵したパイナップルやさとうきびを食べた雌の黒毛和牛 (ヒレ / シンタマ など希少部位)、ホルモンは北海道の様似牧場の完全放牧「ジビーフ」(日本で一番自由な牛)、化学調味料は一切使用せず、井上本店の天然醸造 三年熟成の醤油と味噌、内堀醸造のりんご酢・米酢、田野屋塩二郎の塩、淡路島の天日塩、クラタペッパー、オーナーソムリエ厳選ワインのセラー、ワインとアテで一人呑みも、個室、最大50名の貸し切り。お料理例 (外税): 自分のペースで焼肉コース8,500円、控えめな量でリーズナブルに10,000円、遊山の厳選肉を一通り13,000円 (発酵食で育った鹿児島県産 黒毛和牛 極上ヒレ)、シェフが焼く塊肉の特別コース15,000〜25,000円 (料理長が目の前で焼く)、赤ワインしゃぶしゃぶ12,000円・プレミアム15,000円 (シャトーブリアン)、炙り黒毛和牛肉のカルパッチョ2,300円、牛肉100%テリーヌ1,800円、ジビーフホルモンの煮込み850円、特上塩タン2,000円、肉盛5,000円、ほろ酔いセット。営業時間 火曜日〜土曜日17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、予約は電話、キャンセル料は前々日30%・前日50%・当日100%、南船場1-10-2、長堀橋1番出口から徒歩5分。同じ会社の店: 薪火 全 (淡路島の国定公園内、カウンター8席の薪料理専門店、一日一組のゲストルーム)。食べログ (店舗会員): 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理21:30・ドリンク22:00)、日・月休み、チャージ550円、47席、テラスに喫煙所、子どもは個室が空いているときのみ、オープン1993年11月4日、焼肉 WEST 百名店 2020・2021、コース (税込) 9,350円・11,000円・14,300円。口コミ(2024年9月〜2026年9月): オーナーシェフが骨付きの塊肉を持ってきて産地と部位を説明、Kishu binchotan、センマイと味噌ベースのたれ、和牛のカルパッチョ、ホルモンのトマト煮込みとパテ、40日熟成と3週間熟成のトップサーロイン、Kikaijima の牧場のシャトーブリアン、スパイスカレーにマンゴーチャツネ、赤ワインしゃぶしゃぶ、ワインセラーに入って選べる、以前は Ikuno 区、醤油・味噌・sudachi のたれは物足りないという声、sudachi のソルベは酸っぱかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site has an English version; staff explain each cut (2024–2026).

places.name: 中国料理 龍門 (Chinese Ryomon)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu leans on gyoza, spring rolls, yakisoba, champon and other wheat-noodle dishes, kara-age and sauced stir-fries; nothing is said about what goes into the curry fried rice, which diners season with Worcestershire or soy sauce from the table.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg covers the signature fried rice, and the menu is meat, squid and shrimp stir-fries, gyoza and soups; nothing is described as vegan.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–13:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Saturday and Sunday (Tabelog; reviews). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); group omakase dinners are booked ahead (April 2026), and Friday nights fill up (September 2026). At weekday lunch it fills by noon; the Tianjin curry fried rice can take a while, and staff may suggest another dish (September and October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). About 50 seats, tatami room, non-smoking (Tabelog). Not a shop-maintained listing.
places.neighborhood: Fushimimachi 2-2-6, basement of 青山ビル, a retro building registered as a tangible cultural property; down a narrow stair through a door on the right — 1 min from Kitahama Stn exit 6
places.cuisine: Long-established machi-chuka (local Chinese), menu unchanged since it opened (August 2026) · signature: Tianjin curry fried rice under a thick, soft omelette, ¥1,000, large ¥1,200, with soup (2026); Tianjin fried rice without curry; Tianjin noodles · weekday lunch special of two dishes with rice and soup ¥1,100 (e.g. shrimp chili and mapo glass noodles, August–September 2026) · also: ankake yakisoba (a signature for some regulars), champon with a sweetish thick sauce, ramen, mapo noodles · evening: gyoza made without garlic, spring rolls, salad of Mongolian squid and daikon sprouts, steamed chicken with sesame miso, cold roast pork and cucumber, eggplant and meat miso stir-fry, eggs with wood ear, mapo tofu, sweet-and-sour pork, beef with green peppers · omakase for groups ¥3,500 (April 2026) · Shaoxing wine, hot sake, beer
places.notes: [Chinese · Kitahama, the curry fried rice under an omelette, in a listed basement] A long-established local Chinese restaurant, over 40 years by one diner's count, down a narrow stair into the basement of a retro Kitahama building registered as a tangible cultural property; you go in through the entrance of the omurice shop Kitakousei and take the door on the right. Weekday lunch fills up by noon, and most diners order the same thing: Tianjin curry fried rice, a mound of curry-flavoured rice under a thick, soft omelette (¥1,000, large ¥1,200), served with a soup that changes day to day. It can take time, so the ¥1,100 two-dish daily lunch is the quick choice. Evenings it turns into a lively group dinner spot: garlic-free gyoza, crisp spring rolls, a Mongolian-squid salad, mapo tofu, ankake yakisoba and plenty of Shaoxing wine. Mind your head on the stairs. Closed at weekends. Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 2021.

roles: Owner and kitchen unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: A long-established local Chinese restaurant with over 40 years of history (September 2026 review), in the basement of 青山ビル, which reviewers describe as a registered tangible cultural property (September and October 2026). Diners describe an always cheerful, lively owner who welcomes regulars (May 2025) and a lively, assertive hostess with an Osaka manner (October 2026); a reviewer recalls it on TV (August 2026). Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 2021.
chef_bio.specialty: Tianjin curry fried rice; gyoza; Mongolian-squid salad; ankake yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: "That said, about 80% of the other diners also ordered the Tenshin Curry Fried Rice." — October 2026, two lunches on consecutive days.
"Please be careful not to bump your head on the narrow stairs at the entrance (even if you know, you'll hit it about one out of three times)." — May 2025.
"The gyoza is delicious even without garlic." — May 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (英語版): Chinese Ryomon (チュウゴクリョウリ リュウモン)、中国料理・ラーメン、伏見町2-2-6 青山ビル B1F、北浜駅6番出口からすぐ、月〜金11:00〜13:00・17:30〜21:00、土日休み、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、50席、座敷、禁煙、中国料理 WEST 百名店 2021。口コミ(2025年5月〜2026年10月): 40年以上の歴史、登録有形文化財のレトロなビルの地下、Kitakousei の入口から入って右の扉から階段を下りる、狭い階段で頭をぶつける、昼は満席、ランチ客の8割が天津カレー炒飯 (1,000円、大盛り1,200円、日替わりのスープ付き)、ふわふわの卵の下にカレー味の炒飯、ソースや醤油をかけても、時間がかかるので日替わりランチ1,100円 (2品、ご飯、スープ) を勧められることも、天津麺、ankake yakisoba、少し甘めのあんの champon、ラーメン、麻婆麺、夜はにんにくなしの gyoza、春巻き、Mongolian squid と kaiware のサラダ、蒸し鶏の胡麻 miso、茄子の肉味噌炒め、きくらげと卵の炒め、麻婆豆腐、酢豚、団体のおまかせ3,500円、紹興酒、元気な店主、開店以来変わらないメニュー、テレビで見た。

cultural_comfort.note: Orders taken verbally; a long Japanese menu, but most lunch diners just order the curry fried rice (2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: 生餃子製造トコロ てんしんのきもち (Nama Gyoza Seizo Tokoro Tenshin no Kimochi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: every gyoza is wrapped in wheat dough made from Hokkaido Haruyutaka flour (Tabelog), and the menu adds fried gyoza, mazesoba and soy-based dipping sauces.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the gyoza are meat- or shrimp-filled, and the courses add oysters, chicken and beef; nothing is described as vegan.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30), open year-round; set lunches until 14:00, and lunch ends when the rice runs out (Tabelog). Lunch reservations only for the 11:00 opening, and a booking is cancelled if you are not there when called; from 14:00 one drink per person (Tabelog). The phone may go unanswered at lunch. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), PayPay and au PAY; no e-money (Tabelog). 44 seats: 12 at the counter, 34 at tables; non-smoking; hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Children welcome all day, kids menu (Tabelog). English menu, menu with photos, digital menu (Tabelog). Takeout; frozen gyoza by mail order (official site). Opened 6 April 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sangenya-nishi 1-2-11, Taisho — 1 min from JR and Osaka Metro Taisho Stn; 6 min from Dome-mae and Dome-mae Chiyozaki Stns (Kyocera Dome)
places.cuisine: Handmade gyoza from a workshop on the premises: the dough of 100% Hokkaido Haruyutaka wheat is kneaded and every dumpling wrapped by hand daily, with no preservatives (Tabelog; official site) · plates of two, ¥380–580 (October 2026): pan-fried gyoza bursting with juice, boiled gyoza, crispy fried gyoza, fried gyoza with tartar sauce, steamed gyoza in rich sesame sauce, truffle gyoza, shrimp dumplings, "Tenshin-style" gyoza, two kinds of steamed shumai; extra pieces to order singly; garlic-free (2026 reviews) · lunch sets until 14:00: fried gyoza set ¥1,180 with herb-and-coriander salad, soup and zha cai (October 2026); a set of boiled and pan-fried gyoza with Chinese chawanmushi (November 2026); four kinds of gyoza with rice ¥1,720 (October 2026) · Taiwanese mazesoba, mapo tofu, Taiwanese paper-wrapped chicken, beef katsu with black pepper sauce · seasonal banquet with fresh oysters, 12 items, ¥5,000 until 31 January; party courses with all-you-can-drink, from about ¥2,000 (October 2026) · Tsingtao beer, shochu, cocktails · frozen gyoza by mail, 24 or 96 pieces (official site)
places.notes: [Gyoza · Taisho, handmade gyoza by the station, open to midnight] A spacious gyoza tavern a minute from Taisho Station, handy before a game or concert at Kyocera Dome, where the wrappers are rolled from Hokkaido Haruyutaka wheat and every dumpling is wrapped by hand in the workshop on site. Plates of two (¥380–580) let you compare: juicy pan-fried, chewy boiled, crisp fried, fried with tartar sauce, and the favourite of one October 2026 diner, steamed gyoza in a rich sesame sauce; staff explain which sauce goes with which, and there's no garlic. Lunch sets (fried gyoza set ¥1,180) come with an herb salad, soup and self-serve zha cai; the pickled mustard greens alone won over one returning diner. Evenings bring Taiwanese mazesoba, mapo tofu and all-you-can-drink courses. One drink per person after 2 pm, and one diner found dishes cooling when served all at once. Tabelog Gyoza 100 2024.

roles: Kitchen and owner unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the shop makes everything by hand, from kneading the dough to wrapping, "going against the times" of mechanisation for quality, and sells its preservative-free frozen gyoza online; site posts from February 2021 announce the gyoza tavern with an attached workshop opening in April in Taisho-ku and a switch to Tsumagoi highland cabbage. Tabelog's opening day is 6 April 2021; Gyoza 100 2024. Diners describe kind staff who explain how to eat each kind (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "No preservatives, all handmade": an analogue process kept on purpose, to make gyoza that digital efficiency cannot (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade gyoza: pan-fried, boiled, fried and sesame-sauce steamed.

anecdotes.text: "The chewy steamed gyoza coated in rich sesame sauce is a match made in heaven! You can really taste the sesame flavor, making it my top pick!" — October 2026, four kinds of gyoza and rice for ¥1,720.
"Particularly noteworthy is the appetizer, the pickled mustard greens… so delicious that it could overshadow the star of the show, the gyoza." — October 2026, lunch.
"As expected from a gyoza specialty shop, the gyoza was chewy and juicy. Plus, it was garlic-free, so I could enjoy it without worry." — October 2026, fried gyoza set ¥1,180.

places.cuisine: Omakase kushiage with wine; there is no menu, only the course (official site) · course ¥10,800 with tax: about 20 creative skewers starting with a live-killed kuruma prawn, a vegetable platter, homemade bread, homemade dessert and coffee (official site; Tabelog) · seasonal ingredients from Kuromon Market and producers around Japan (official site) · skewers in 2026 reviews: kuruma prawn, beef fillet, scallop, edamame or pea croquette, tonburi with minced chicken, myoga with pork fillet, anago with makomo, hamo, ginkgo, duck, shiitake, salmon, kisu with mitsuba, lotus root, cheese; extra skewers to order (August–September 2026) · vegetables to dip in sauce or salt as you like, rice-flour bread and bagels with cheese cream, a choice of three desserts, pudding (2026) · each skewer comes with a suggested salt or sauce; the sauce pot is your own (August 2026) · a large wine cellar, wines chosen by a sommelier to suit each guest
places.notes: [Kushiage · Kuromon Market, an omakase of 20 skewers with wine] A kushiage house upstairs in the Kuromon Market arcade, founded in 1980 and here since 1995, that serves only an omakase: about 20 skewers (¥10,800), from a live-killed kuruma prawn through seasonal pairings like tonburi with minced chicken, myoga with pork fillet and anago with makomo, each with its suggested salt or sauce. A light, crisp batter keeps people eating, vegetables come to dip between skewers, and just when you're full the rice-flour bread arrives. Skewers keep coming until you say stop. A sommelier pairs wine, a big part of the house's identity; one regular uses it as the benchmark for kushikatsu in Osaka. Finish with the pudding. Closed Wednesday; there is a Ginza branch. The name comes from a mentor's advice to cherish the "six senses".

roles: Kitchen unnamed; the company 株式会社 六覺燈 is led by representative director 水野幾郎 (official company page)
chef_bio.background: Per the company page: founded in Konohana-ku, Osaka, in November 1980; moved into Kuromon Market, Nipponbashi, in June 1995; incorporated as 株式会社 六覺燈 in September 1998; a Ginza shop opened in October 2004. A wine importer, 株式会社エイマーケット (A-MARKeT, founded 2012), is listed alongside. Site news: lunch ended December 2022; a 六覺燈カフェ opened in April 2024; a new brand, 燈のひとさじ, in 2026. A September 2026 reviewer also mentions a counter in the Daimaru Shinsaibashi food hall. Per the site, the name comes from a master's advice on entering the kitchen to value the "six senses": sight, hearing, smell, taste, touch and the cook's sense; "燈" is a vow not to let the first light go out. The site says the shop chose kushikatsu after studying many cuisines, because it goes with any drink and can take on any genre. Diners describe a friendly distance with the frying master at the counter (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Stick to the obvious": cleanliness, good ingredients, effort to please and enjoying the work are all taken as given (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase kushiage of about 20 skewers; wine pairing.

anecdotes.text: "The combinations of ingredients are unique, such as tonburi with minced chicken, myoga with pork tenderloin, and anago with makomo mushrooms." — August 2026.
"Even when you think you're full, the light and crispy batter makes you want to keep going for just one more, and then another." — September 2026.
"Personally, I use the quality and price range of this restaurant as a benchmark to evaluate other kushikatsu places." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 六覺燈 黒門本店、串揚げ専門店、黒門市場のアーケードの中、1980年創業、全国の生産者から直送される旬の食材、メニュー表はなく全ておまかせのコース、苦手な食材は申し付けを、おまかせコース 活〆車海老をはじめとする創作串20本・お野菜盛合せ・自家製パン・自家製デザート・コーヒー 10,800円 (税込)、17時〜22時、年末年始・水曜日休み、60席、全席禁煙、カード可、手作りのパンとデザート、世界の銘醸地に自ら足を運んで仕入れたワイン。六覺燈について: 「六覚を大事にしろ」という親方の言葉 (視覚・聴覚・嗅覚・味覚・触覚と料理人のセンス)、初心を忘れず燈を消さない、「あたりまえにこだわる」、串かつはどんな飲み物とも相性が良い。会社概要: 株式会社 六覺燈、代表取締役 水野幾郎、1980年11月 大阪市此花区で創業、1995年6月 黒門市場内に移転、1998年9月 法人化、2004年10月 銀座店オープン、株式会社エイマーケット (ワイン輸入販売、代表取締役 水野冨貴子)。お知らせ: 2022年12月 ランチ営業終了、2024年4月 六覺燈カフェオープン、2026年10月 新ブランド「燈のひとさじ」、冬季休暇 2025年12月31日〜2026年1月7日。食べログ (店舗会員): 日本橋1-21-16 たこそうビル 2F、日本橋駅から徒歩3分、L.O.21:30、20時30分からの90分のコース、サービス料10%、ベジタリアンメニューありの表示、子どもは食べた分だけ。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 車海老、牛ヒレ、帆立、edamame のコロッケ、トンブリと鶏のミンチ、茗荷と豚ヒレ、Anago と Makomo、Hamo、銀杏、鴨、Shiitake、鮭、キスと三つ葉、蓮根、チーズ、野菜は食べ放題、米粉のパンとベーグルにチーズクリーム、デザートは3種から、プリン、ストップと言うまで出てくる、串ごとに塩かソースをすすめる、ソースは一人ずつ、ワインとの組み合わせ、銀座と大丸心斎橋のフードホールにも店がある、軽い衣。

places.notes: [Yakiniku · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Friday and Saturday after 23:00] When the hard-to-book yakiniku restaurant Pome closes for the night, the curtain changes and the same room reopens as Jiru, an à la carte horumon bar for the small hours, open only on Friday and Saturday from 23:00 to 04:00. Diners rate the quality as Pome's, without the course: black tongue, tsurami that one diner ordered three times, an outside skirt so tender it cuts with chopsticks, a horumon platter of tetchan, akasen, mino and more, then a spicy ramen loaded with horumon that some come for alone. Expect ¥5,000–10,000 a head in 2026, cash only, plus a ¥300 table charge. Book by Instagram DM or phone for 23:00; walk-ins sometimes find a seat later. Tabelog Yakiniku 100 in 2026.

places.notes: [Yakitori · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a basement of aged jidori] Down a flight of stairs off a Higashi-Shinsaibashi street is a calm, modern room with a long wooden counter in front of the charcoal, tables and private rooms, and jazz playing (2026). Three jidori breeds are aged whole at low temperature, broken down and skewered in house, and grilled over Kishu binchotan by a chef with 20 years of experience (September 2026 reviews). Book the 7 Assorted Yakitori course: small plates of confit breast, vinegared offal and chicken ham with figs, a consommé, homemade tofu, seven skewers with a choice of tsukune (truffle shaved at the table, or kumquat yolk), then a golden TKG under gold leaf and a chicken white soup. Reservation only, ¥7,500–7,800 for the course plus drinks. Tabelog Yakitori WEST 100 in 2023.

roles: Grill chef with 20 years of experience, unnamed (September 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: "as much as possible by our own hands"; Miyazaki Jitokko, Niwa Jidori and Awa Oidori are aged one bird at a time at low temperature, broken down by hand and skewered, and grilled slowly over Kishu binchotan; mizutaki and sukiyaki are also served. Two September 2026 diners describe the skewers as grilled by a chef with 20 years of experience. An August 2026 group with a member who avoids raw food was given well-cooked alternatives. Opened 18 July 2017; Tabelog Yakitori WEST 100 in 2023.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information, but every burger can be served on a salad plate instead of the bun (official menu). Fries, onion rings in beer batter, chicken bites and sauces are not described for gluten, and nothing is labelled gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu marks one burger vegetarian: the tofu steak burger of seasoned deep-fried tofu with a choice of ketchup, teriyaki, BBQ, chipotle or peanut butter (official menu). Its bun, special sauce and frying oil are not described, so ask whether it can be made vegan.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:30, last order 22:00; closed over New Year (Tabelog; the official menu gives the same hours). Reservations from 16:00 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC cards, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 23 seats: a counter of 7, tables and a terrace counter; smoking on the terrace only; dogs on the terrace; take-out at the same prices as eating in (Tabelog; official menu). English menu (official site). Opened 11 November 2015 (Tabelog; Kansai Walker).
places.neighborhood: Kita-Horie 1-6-12, a small corner shop with a terrace — about 30 seconds from Yotsubashi Stn
places.cuisine: Burgers with a patty of 100% domestic beef ground in the shop every day and shaped by hand, no filler (official site); sizes petit, regular, double; each with a free side of fries, onion rings, salad or soup (prices from the official menu, tax included) · Craft Burger ¥890 / ¥1,550 / ¥2,250 · Craft Cheese Burger ¥990 / ¥1,650 / ¥2,450 · Craft Burger Deluxe with bacon, avocado and NZ cheddar ¥1,190 / ¥1,990 / ¥2,690 (¥1,990 in August and October 2026) · Western BBQ ¥1,190 / ¥1,890 · Onion Smash ¥1,590 / ¥2,390 / triple ¥3,190 · Gorgonzola, Swiss Mushroom ¥1,090 / ¥1,790 · Peanut Butter ¥1,790 · Pulled Pork ¥1,290 · Grilled Salmon ¥1,290 / ¥2,490 · Spicy Chicken and Teriyaki Chicken ¥790 / ¥1,290 · Tofu Steak Burger (vegetarian) ¥790 / ¥1,290 · craft fries, truffle fries, onion rings in beer batter · salads · lunch set with a domestic-beef burger ¥1,390 (August 2026) · shakes · draft beer including Minoh Beer, cocktails
places.notes: [Burgers · Kita-Horie by Yotsubashi Stn] A small burger shop with a terrace, half a minute from Yotsubashi Station, opened in 2015 by an Australian owner and a Japanese co-owner, a married couple. The patty is 100% domestic beef, ground in the shop every day and shaped by hand, the sauces are made in house, and each burger tastes different by design. Get the Craft Burger Deluxe with bacon, avocado and cheddar (¥1,990 in 2026), or a smaller petit size; every burger comes with fries, onion rings, salad or soup, and can be served on a salad instead of the bun. There is a tofu steak burger marked vegetarian. A lunch set was ¥1,390 in August 2026. Drink a Minoh Beer on the terrace. Tabelog Hamburger 100 in 2019, 2021, 2022 and 2024.

chef_bio.chef_name: パット アゴスティネリ
roles: Co-owner: 美希, married to the owner (Kansai Walker 2018)
chef_bio.background: Per Kansai Walker (2018): the owner パット アゴスティネリ came to Japan from Australia at 30 to change course in life and taught English for seven years; the co-owner 美希 had worked part-time in cafés, McDonald's and びっくりドンキー before a staff job at a civil-engineering firm. The two met at a friend's bar in Higashi-Shinsaibashi and married. After a plan to co-run a relative's friend's burger shop fell through, the couple opened Craft Burger co. on 11 November 2015, aiming to change the image of burgers in Japan with an original, healthier menu; the "co." was a hope of becoming a company, realised as a godo kaisha in January 2018. A second shop opened in Dojima on 18 June 2018. A TV feature and English comments on Google Maps brought overseas visitors (Kansai Walker). Tabelog Hamburger 100 in 2019, 2021, 2022 and 2024.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Our burgers are not like an ordinary burger shop's: buns, sauces and meat are all handmade, so we are the same as a restaurant" (official site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Craft Burger Deluxe; hand-shaped 100% domestic beef patties.

anecdotes.text: "I ordered the 100% domestic beef burger lunch set for JPY 1,390, with fries on the side and BBQ sauce. … It came with whole grain mustard, which might be Tasmanian mustard." — August 2026.
"They offer a mini size for those with smaller appetites, which is a nice touch." — October 2026, Craft Burger Deluxe for JPY 1,990.
"I felt the vibe of Amerikamura with some foreign customers around, which was nice!" — August 2026, Craft Burger Deluxe for JPY 1,990.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: Craft Burger co、2015年より創業、無添加100%国産牛、北海道産のこだわり部位を毎日お店でミンチにして手でパティを作る、つなぎなし、バンズ、ソース、肉、全て手作りでレストランと同じ、チーズは世界各地から直輸入、日本語と英語のメニュー: 堀江店 大阪市西区北堀江1-6-12、毎日11:00〜22:30、サイズはプチ、レギュラー、ダブル、無料サイド (ポテト、オニオンリング、サラダ、スープ)、バンズの代わりにサラダプレートに変更できる、クラフトバーガー890円・1,550円・2,250円、クラフトバーガーデラックス1,190円・1,990円・2,690円、豆腐ステーキバーガー (ベジタリアン) 790円・1,290円、税込、店内とテイクアウトは同じ値段。関西ウォーカー (2018年): オーストラリア人のオーナー パット アゴスティネリさんと共同オーナーで妻の美希さん、北堀江店は2015年11月11日オープン、堂島店は2018年6月18日、合同会社に。食べログ (店舗会員): 23席 (カウンター7)、テラスで喫煙可、ペットはテラスのみ、16時から予約可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、箕面ビールなど、ハンバーガー 百名店 2019・2021・2022・2024。口コミ(2026年5月〜10月): デラックス1,990円、ランチセット1,390円、プチサイズ、海外の客も。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu on the official site; the owner is Australian (Kansai Walker 2018); some overseas customers (August 2026).

places.name: ステーキ＆ワイン オクソン (Steak & Wine OXON)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. The steak can be eaten with salt, wasabi, ponzu, garlic soy sauce or the house sauce (2025–2026 reviews); courses also bring a quiche, a consommé or potage, garlic rice and cakes in the salon. Nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: teppanyaki courses of Kobe and black wagyu beef and live seafood, with beef consommé and dairy desserts.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and the day before a holiday 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00; Tabelog says 21:30); closed Sunday and holidays, but dinner is served every day in December (official site). Reservations by phone, 11:30–21:00 except Sundays and holidays; cancellation fee 50% the day before, 100% on the day (official site). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (official site; Tabelog). 32 seats: a counter for up to 13 around the teppan, a table for up to 7 and a private room for 10–15; smoking only in the private room; children welcome; sommelier (official site; Tabelog). Founded 1974 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Shinsaibashi 2-3-9, オクソンビル 1F, west of Midosuji north of Namba — 4 min from Kintetsu Osaka-Namba Stn, 6 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki steak house: A5 Kobe beef from black-haired heifers, seasonal live seafood and vegetables grilled at the counter (official site; Tabelog) · dinner courses (Tabelog): Kusaemon course with two live-seafood dishes and 130 g premium black wagyu ¥24,000, Special Kobe Beef Strip Loin course 130 g ¥29,600, Chateaubriand course of A5 heifer fillet 130 g ¥23,000 · a course runs sea-bream carpaccio, beef consommé or potage, seasonal salad, steak (fillet, sirloin or half and half, with salt, wasabi, ponzu or sauce) and garlic rice, then a lemon sorbet (2025–2026 reviews) · lunch sets with wagyu steak; garlic rice instead of white rice for a supplement (2025–2026 reviews) · after the meal, homemade cakes (panna cotta, tiramisu, baked cheesecake in July 2026) and siphon coffee in the basement salon · a long wine list including Romanée-Conti; the house's own balsamic vinegar (official site)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Nishi-Shinsaibashi, a 1974 steak house with a salon below] Behind a heavy door north of Namba is a steak house from 1974 furnished with Art Nouveau antiques, stained glass and lamps, where chefs grill A5 Kobe heifer beef and live seafood on the teppan in front of you, with a paper apron at your place. After the garlic rice you are led downstairs to a salon of antiques for homemade cakes and siphon coffee, and on some evenings a classical concert there (October 2025, February and July 2026). The owner, a woman, looks after the room in person and chats with guests (2026 reviews). Dinner courses cost ¥23,000–29,600 (Tabelog), while lunch averages ¥4,000–4,999 (Tabelog). Book by phone; closed Sundays. Tabelog Steak 100 in 2021.

roles: Owner, a woman, unnamed in the sources read (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a steak house founded in 1974 in Osaka Minami, with seasonal starters, soups and vegetables made by experienced chefs, Art Nouveau antiques, a basement salon for desserts and digestifs, its own balsamic vinegar and a rooftop garden; past events include a special dinner by the executive chef of the Imperial Hotel in Vienna and wine evenings with a former president of the Japan Sommelier Association, and the menu carried contributions by the writers 藤本義一 and 桐島洋子. The house holds OXON concerts (オクソン音楽会). Reviews from February, March and May 2026 describe the female owner looking after guests in person; a May 2026 diner repeats a saying attributed to Shigeo Nagashima, "the mountain is Fuji, and the meat is Oxon". The 2F of the building houses the sister restaurant なにわ懐石しゃぶしゃぶ 久壷庵 (official site). Tabelog Steak 100 in 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients brought out by the skill of experienced chefs, in pursuit of the real taste (official site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: A5 Kobe heifer steak on the teppan; desserts in the basement salon.

anecdotes.text: "For dessert, we moved to a room downstairs where we were celebrated with live music." — July 2026, a celebratory dinner.
"The lovely owner also took the time to chat with us, and before we knew it, time flew by." — March 2026, a return after many years.
"Table Set. You will be given a paper apron when seated." — July 2026, an early birthday dinner; fillet and sirloin shared half and half.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ステーキ＆ワイン オクソン、大阪ミナミの1974年創業のステーキ専門店、豊富なワインリスト、季節の前菜やスープ、野菜、デザートは階下サロンで手作りスイーツと食後酒、アールヌーボーのアンティーク、黒毛雌神戸牛A5ステーキ、カウンター13名まで、テーブル7名まで、個室10〜15名、ロマネ・コンティなど希少なワイン、サイフォンのコーヒー、オクソン音楽会、自家醸造バルサミコ酢、屋上庭園、オープン当時のメニュー、ウィーン・インペリアルホテル総料理長を招いた特別ディナー、日本ソムリエ協会会長を務めた人を招いたワイン会、メニュー表には藤本義一さんと桐島洋子さんの寄稿、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-3-9、大阪難波駅から徒歩4分、なんば駅から徒歩6分、月〜土・祝前11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)、17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、日曜・祝日休み (12月のディナーは無休)、電話予約、前日キャンセル50%、当日100%、カード可 (銀聯も)、2階は なにわ懐石しゃぶしゃぶ 久壷庵。食べログ (店舗会員): サービス料10%、32席、個室のみ喫煙可、ステーキ 百名店 2021、コース 2万3千〜2万9,600円。口コミ(2025年2月〜2026年7月): 鯛のカルパッチョ、コンソメかポタージュ、サラダ、ヒレかサーロイン、ガーリックライス、紙のエプロン、地下のサロンでケーキとサイフォンのコーヒー、地下での音楽会、女性のオーナーが自ら接客。

cultural_comfort.note: Set teppanyaki courses with the chef cooking in front of you; reservations by phone (2026). No English evidence found.
