places.cuisine: Italian with seasonal ingredients, seafood from the central market and homemade pasta; no fixed menu, the dishes change daily and the menu names only the main ingredient (Tabelog; July 2026) · pasta lunch ¥1,500 with a platter of about six appetizers, the day's pasta, focaccia and a drink (June 2026; ¥1,400 in June 2025, ¥100 less for a small portion or no drink); premium pastas extra, e.g. tomato and pecorino +¥800, or beef tongue and venison braised in red wine at no extra charge (June 2026) · lunch courses by reservation · evening: start with a chef's selection of 3–5 small dishes, then homemade pasta or a main (Tabelog) · dishes in 2026 reviews: chilled corn soup, sea bream carpaccio with kombu, Spanish ham (18-month per Tabelog, 24-month per a July 2026 review), breaded horse mackerel with brown butter, baked eggplant with smoked mozzarella, shirasu and lemon cream pasta, pork shoulder with yuzu, mushroom gratin, braised pork belly risotto, roast black pork · three wines by the glass, about ten by the bottle, a house lemon sour of Hiroshima lemons (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Italian · Shinmachi, a daily-changing menu] A small, wood-warm Italian in Shinmachi west of Nishi-Ohashi, with a single-slab counter cut from a tree said to be 2,000 years old and window seats for solo diners. There is no fixed menu: seafood comes from the central market each morning, and the list names only the main ingredient, leaving the cooking as a surprise. In the evening order three to five small plates (Spanish ham, baked eggplant with smoked mozzarella, horse mackerel with brown butter) and then a homemade pasta or a main; lunch is the bargain, ¥1,500 for a colourful appetizer plate, the day's pasta, focaccia and a drink (June 2026), and it queues at noon. One eight-time regular came back for a pasta of beef tongue and venison braised in red wine. Some dishes sell out early. Closed Tuesdays.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: seasonal ingredients, fresh seafood from the central market and produce from trusted vendors; no fixed menu; dinner courses to budget; counter and tables from a large tree about 2,000 years old; family-friendly. Opened 13 September 2021. A July 2026 diner describes "a talented young chef who has undergone rigorous training".

places.notes: [Mediterranean · Umeda, falafel and salads under KITTE] An all-day Mediterranean bar and canteen in the basement of KITTE Osaka, straight off the JR station, open from 8:00 for breakfast plates and açaí bowls, through lunch to dinner with absinthe cocktails. The draw is the falafel: fried to order, three to a regular salad bowl with hummus, pickles and a spicy tahini dressing (¥1,100, July 2026), or stuffed into warm pita to take away. Vegans get a plate of vegetables and beans, a vegan lunch with a chickpea dip and a vegan wrap, and one October 2026 diner called vegan food here a rare find in Japan. Meat eaters have grilled chicken or beef kebab in pita, and the apple pie, a whole apple in crust, is the one a diner knew from Absinthe Cafe in Yotsubashi (October 2026). Many take away; the eat-in room was quiet on a weekday noon (August 2026). Dinner courses with drinks start at ¥5,500.

An October 2026 diner had eaten the same apple pie at "Absinthe Cafe in Yotsubashi". A September 2026 diner notes staff who were international students, "serious and kind".

anecdotes.text: "Even the regular size is quite generous, featuring three falafels along with a mix of greens, tomatoes, cucumbers, purple cabbage, and several types of pickles." — July 2026, falafel salad regular JPY 1,100 to take away, fried to order.

places.notes: [Italian · Umekita, a lunch buffet over the city] A big, bright café-restaurant on the restaurant floor of Grand Front Osaka's North Building, named after a museum and meant as "a playground for adults" (official site), with sofa seats facing the Umeda night view. Lunch is the draw: pick a main (weekly pasta, a keema curry or grilled fish) and the price includes a buffet of farm-vegetable salads, starters and thin, crisp stone-oven pizza, plus free drinks that run to red and white wine, with apple and chocolate dessert pizzas brought out late (August–October 2026). Expect ¥1,900–2,400, a little less if seated before 11:30. At night it is a wine bar of pizza, pasta, ajillo and grills, one drink and one dish each. Diners praise the value; one found it noisy and the staff's language casual (September 2026). Book the weekday buffet.

places.notes: [Izakaya · Umeda, teppan skewers under the station buildings] A loud, Showa-retro skewer bar in the basement arcade of Osaka Ekimae Dai-2 Building, a minute from Kitashinchi Station, open from late morning to 23:30 since 2013, one of two shops of 株式会社しん家 with a takoyaki bar in the Dai-4 Building. Skewers start at ¥100 and are cooked on a flat iron, not a grill: beef skirt, chicken neck and tail, a fluffy yam set with egg, spam steak, and seasonal seafood. Around them go Okinawa-style yakisoba with a shisa-shaped fishcake, rare wagyu shabu under an egg yolk, garlic rice with horumon, and blackboard specials. A regular missed the old staff and the louder calls of "Oi oi! Yoi yoi!" (April and July 2026), but found the food as good as ever. All-you-can-drink was ¥1,000 a head (June 2026). Smoking is allowed at every seat.

roles: Grill and floor staff of 株式会社しん家 (unnamed)

Per Tabelog: teppan skewers from ¥100 in a Showa-retro room; seasonal "seafood skewers"; opened 29 May 2013. A regular on an eighth visit noted that the staff had completely changed by April 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan skewers; grilled yam; Okinawa-style yakisoba.

places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Teppanyaki steak is seared plainly, but the courses include a house sauce, the signature shrimp in an egg sauce and glaze, red miso soup and a rice dish that may be curry or fried rice.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Kobe-beef and wagyu teppanyaki courses with shrimp, beef appetizers and red miso soup.
places.hours_raw: Dinner Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00 (last order 20:30); lunch on some Thursdays to Saturdays 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:30), on days marked "L" in the monthly calendar on the official site; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog; official site). Reservations by phone, best 12:00–17:30 or 20:00–21:00; online booking too; groups of five or more by phone only (Tabelog; official site). Prices include tax; 10% service charge at dinner (Tabelog; official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 17 seats: an L-shaped counter of 10 around the teppan and a private room for up to 7; non-smoking; BYO drinks allowed (Tabelog). Founded 1964 (official site).
places.neighborhood: 曽根崎新地1-10-2, ground floor of 北新地プレイス — 1 min from Kitashinchi Stn (JR Tozai Line), 2 min from Nishi-Umeda Stn
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki of Kobe beef from 太田牧場 (Ota Farm), grilled in front of you at the counter (official site; prices tax included, plus 10% service) · Steak Ron since-1964 special dinner course from ¥13,200, priced by the cut and weight: a seasonal dish, Kobe-beef appetizer of the day, the signature golden-grilled wild shrimp, the day's recommendation, steak, grilled seasonal vegetables, onion salad with sesame, a rice dish (Kobe-beef shigure-ni with egg over rice, spicy curry, fried rice with beef tendon, or garlic rice), red miso soup and pickles, dessert, coffee or tea · steaks: Kobe sirloin or fillet 100 g ¥19,800, 120 g ¥22,000, 150 g ¥24,750; Kobe chateaubriand 100 g ¥24,200 to 150 g ¥29,700; black-wagyu fillet 100 g ¥13,200 to 150 g ¥16,500; black-wagyu chateaubriand 100 g ¥15,950 to 150 g ¥19,800 · set courses 雪 (Kobe steak 120 g) ¥19,800 and 月 (150 g) ¥22,000 · lunch C course ¥13,200; Christmas course ¥26,400, 23–25 December 2026 (Tabelog) · beef appetizers such as Kobe sirloin sashimi and charcoal-grilled Kobe hiuchi; the shop holds a licence to serve raw meat (official site) · from reviews: oxtail and shark-fin double consommé, sirloin sashimi with yama wasabi, tartare monaka, roast beef, a Kesennuma shark-fin steak added on request, lily-bulb rice (December 2025); vichyssoise (May 2026); corn rice (June 2026) · rice is specially grown Koshihikari from 鳥取県 (official site)
places.notes: [Steak · Kitashinchi, Kobe-beef teppanyaki since 1964] A Kitashinchi steakhouse that has grilled there for some sixty years, renovated in 2020 with Baccarat lamps and glassware, a ten-seat L-shaped counter and a private room for seven. Every seat faces the iron, where the cook grills Kobe beef from Ota Farm, timing each piece to your pace (official site). The dish diners single out is the golden-grilled wild shrimp, a house signature since the opening, glazed in an egg sauce one August 2026 diner compared to sukiyaki: "you could come here just for this dish". Courses run from ¥13,200 for black wagyu to ¥29,700 for 150 g of Kobe chateaubriand, plus 10% service, and end with a choice of rice, from Kobe-beef shigure on rice to garlic rice. One September 2026 diner found the room dark and heavy; others call it a place for birthdays and business dinners.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site (steakron.com, read 2026-11-01): founded in Kitashinchi in 1964 ("北新地で創業60年"); exterior and interior renewed in 2020; a ten-seat L-shaped counter and a private room for up to seven, with Baccarat lamps and glasses; steaks of Kobe beef from 太田牧場; a licence to serve raw beef; "天然海老の黄金焼き" has been a signature since the founding; steaks are cooked to the temperature and doneness that suit each guest's pace. A July 2026 diner noted foreign guests and some foreign staff and believed English-speaking guests can be looked after.
chef_bio.philosophy: "本物だけがもつ極上の味わいと贅沢な時間" (the finest flavour and luxurious time that only the real thing has; official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kobe-beef steak from Ota Farm; golden-grilled wild shrimp.

anecdotes.text: "The signature dish, grilled shrimp in golden sauce, is unlike anything I've ever tasted. … Honestly, you could come here just for this dish!" — August 2026, a course with both strip loin and fillet.
"Kesennuma Shark Fin Steak with Ron Style Sauce. I always request this as an addition when making a reservation." — December 2025, an eighth visit, on the last day of the year.
"I've always disliked the sharpness of wasabi, so I never ate it before, but the wasabi here was truly delicious!" — June 2026, in the private room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 北新地 ステーキ ロン、太田牧場産 神戸牛専門の鉄板焼き、北新地駅から徒歩約1分、北新地で創業60年、2020年に外観・内観をリニューアル、10席のL字カウンターと最大7名の個室、バカラのランプやグラス、客席はすべて鉄板に面する、食べるスピードに合わせて温度と焼き加減を調整、神戸牛のサーロインのお刺身や神戸牛ヒウチの炭火焼などのオードブル、生食販売の許可、創業以来の名物「天然海老の黄金焼き」。ステーキロン〜since1964〜スペシャルディナーコース13,200円〜 (肉の種類とグラム数で変わる): 神戸牛サーロインまたはフィレ100g19,800円・120g22,000円・150g24,750円、神戸牛シャトーブリアン100g24,200円〜150g29,700円、特選黒毛和牛フィレ100g13,200円〜150g16,500円、特選黒毛和牛シャトーブリアン100g15,950円〜150g19,800円、季節の焼野菜、色彩胡麻風味のオニオンサラダ、〆のご飯もの (神戸牛のしぐれ煮と赤玉子かけご飯、スパイシーカレー、牛すじ入り焼きめし、ガーリックライス)、赤だし、香の物、特製アシェットデセール、珈琲・紅茶・ハーブティー。コース 雪19,800円 (120g)、月22,000円 (150g)。鳥取県産特別栽培米コシヒカリ。税込、別途サービス料10%。月ごとの定休日とランチ営業日のお知らせ。食べログ (店舗会員): ステーキ・ハンバーグ・鉄板焼き、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-10-2 北新地プレイス 1F、月〜水17:00〜22:00 (L.O.20:30)、木〜土11:30〜14:30 (L.O.13:30)、17:00〜22:00、日・祝休み、ランチは決まった日のみ、電話は12時〜17時半か20時〜21時に、5名以上は電話のみ、サービス料10% (ディナー)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、17席、禁煙、持ち込み可、雪コース19,800円、ランチ C コース13,200円、クリスマスコース26,400円。口コミ(2025年12月〜2026年10月): テールとフカヒレのダブルコンソメ、サーロインのお刺身と yama wasabi、タルタルの最中、ローストビーフ、天然海老、Kesennuma のフカヒレステーキ、百合根の炊き込みご飯、ヴィシソワーズ、とうもろこしご飯、黄金焼きは卵のソースで、すき焼きのような味、雰囲気が暗いという声、海外の客とスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter teppanyaki cooked in front of you; a July 2026 diner saw foreign staff and believed English-speaking guests can be served. Book by phone.

places.name: 大衆酒場 ちょーちんスピカ 新大阪東口店 (Taishu Sakaba Chochin Supika Shin'osaka higashiguchi ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The signatures are gyoza, a 25 cm salmon cutlet and fried dishes, with okonomiyaki, kushiage, Neapolitan spaghetti and ramen in the courses; sashimi and the seafood bowl are the plainer options, but nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an izakaya of seafood, chicken, beef offal and gyoza, with dishes simmered in oden dashi or marinated in ago dashi (official site). Tabelog ticks "vegetarian options" but names none.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Thu, Sun and holidays 16:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 16:00–01:00 (last order 24:00); closing day: none (official site), "not fixed" (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; groups of about ten welcome on the day; whole-shop hire up to 70 (Tabelog; official site). 78 seats with a counter and tables for ten (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog); a February 2026 diner noted smoking at the seats had ended. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR payment (Tabelog). Takeaway; children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 7 February 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 東中島1-20-9, 2nd floor of 新大阪池永ビル, right in front of the east exit of Shin-Osaka Stn — 1 min on foot (official site; Tabelog says 30 seconds)
places.cuisine: Izakaya of seafood and gyoza with sake (official site, prices undated, read November 2026) · the shop's three signatures: the Spica special grilled gyoza ¥530, big and served sizzling on an iron plate (also garlic-free ¥580, cheese ¥660, fried ¥630); the "gout bowl" (痛風丼) ¥980, a seafood rice bowl the shop calls a loss leader; a 25 cm salmon "rare katsu" ¥980 for two or three · a tower salad named after the Shin-Osaka station building, with a soft-boiled egg inside and a local-sake sauce ¥980 · sashimi: salmon, toro-taku, tuna, thin-sliced octopus ¥780 each; a four-kind chicken sashimi plate ¥1,480 · doteyaki "bistro Spica style" ¥580; shime saba with shiso and mustard soy ¥480; beef tripe with kimchi ¥530; rolled omelette on the iron plate ¥540; kara-age marinated in ago dashi, two pieces ¥440; Neapolitan spaghetti Spica style ¥680; homemade pudding ¥440 · over ten sakes chosen by the owner; Spica highball ¥430 (official site) · courses with two hours of drinks, from two people: Tsuruhashi beef-offal hot pot with ramen to finish ¥4,500 / ¥5,000 / ¥6,000; okonomiyaki course ¥4,500 / ¥5,000 / ¥6,000; snack course ¥4,000 (official site, tax included) · reviews: the gout bowl is "about the size of a tea bowl" but heaped with seafood (February 2026); the ¥5,000 course of sashimi, starters, Caesar salad, gyoza, kara-age and fries, rolled omelette, okonomiyaki and fried rice (May 2026); cheese and fried gyoza, beef tripe kimchi, shochu-marinated edamame (July 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shin-Osaka east exit, a big, loud station-front tavern] A 78-seat izakaya on the second floor of a building facing the east exit of Shin-Osaka Station, open since 2017 and built for groups: it takes parties of up to 70 and walk-in groups of ten. The menu is long and jokey: big gyoza that keep sizzling on an iron plate (eat them fast, the shop warns, and one diner found half the skin burnt on, January 2026), a heaped seafood "gout bowl", a 25 cm salmon cutlet, a tower salad named after the station building, many dishes "Spica style", and over ten sakes picked by the owner. Courses with two hours of drinks run ¥4,000–6,000, with a beef-offal hot pot or okonomiyaki at the centre. Diners like the energetic staff and the late hours (to 1 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays); some found it noisy and one group of five was squeezed onto a table for four (May 2026). Now non-smoking.

roles: Owner (店主, unnamed), who chooses the sake (official site)
Manager (店長, unnamed), who chooses the tuna (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (chochin-spica.jp, read 2026-11-01): a lively station-front izakaya of creative dishes with seasonal ingredients and fresh seafood; "chochin" for the warmth of the red lantern and "Spica" for the brightest star of Virgo in the spring sky, the wish being to shine like the first star of the town; over ten sakes chosen by the owner; banquets up to 70. Per the Tabelog listing: opened 7 February 2017; also listed on Hitosara. Per reviews: energetic, friendly staff (December 2025, October 2026); a free serving of gyoza for following the shop on Instagram (January 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: "A place where 'fun' gathers every day" (毎日"楽しい"が集まる店; official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Spica special gyoza; gout bowl; salmon rare katsu.

anecdotes.text: "The gout rice bowl was surprisingly small, making me laugh. It's about the size of a tea bowl, but it was topped with plenty of seafood and tasted great." — February 2026.
"The gyoza was overcooked in the teppan, causing half of the skin to stick and burn." — January 2026.
"The gyoza here doesn't contain chives, so I ordered the cheese gyoza, which was delicious." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 大衆酒場 ちょーちんスピカ 新大阪東口店、新大阪駅東口から徒歩1分、毎日"楽しい"が集まる店、旬の食材や新鮮な海鮮を使ったお酒に合う創作料理、「ちょーちん」は赤ちょうちんのぬくもり、「スピカ」は春の夜空に輝く乙女座の一等星、店主が選んだ10種以上の日本酒、最大70名の宴会、月〜木・日・祝16:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、金・土・祝前日16:00〜25:00 (L.O.24:00)、定休日なし、78席。名物: スピカ特製 焼餃子530円、痛風丼980円 (赤字覚悟の看板メニュー)、長さ25cmのサーモンレアカツ980円、タワーサラダ「新大阪ステーションビルヂング～地酒ソース～」980円。ほかに、とろたく、まぐろ、たこの薄造り、鶏刺 4種盛り、どて焼 ビストロスピカ風、〆さば、牛ハチノスのキムチ和え、出汁巻き、あごだしの唐揚げ、なぽりたん すぴか☆風、自家製ぷりん。コース (120分飲み放題つき、税込): 鶴橋ホルモン鍋コース4,500円・5,000円・6,000円、お好み焼きコース4,500円・5,000円・6,000円、おつまみコース4,000円。食べログ (店舗会員): 居酒屋・海鮮・鍋、東淀川区東中島1-20-9 新大阪池永ビル 2F、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、78席、禁煙、テイクアウト、子ども可、2017年2月7日オープン。口コミ(2025年1月〜2026年10月): 鉄板のナポリタン、インスタのフォローで餃子のサービス、5,000円のコースは量が多い、餃子の皮が鉄板にくっついて焦げた、痛風丼は茶碗くらいの大きさ、にぎやか、どて焼、〆さば、ニラなしの餃子、チーズ餃子、揚げ餃子、牛ホルモンのキムチ、枝豆、スタッフが元気、料理が早い。

cultural_comfort.note: Big, busy izakaya; reservations by phone or online (official site). No English evidence found.

places.name: Pond Cafe
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Pizza toast and pizza in the morning and at lunch; the lunch plates are taco rice, shrimp pilaf and a spice chicken curry, none described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken curry, taco rice with minced meat, cheese and egg, mozzarella pizza toast; no vegan dish is named.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 08:30–18:00; closed Monday; hours and closing days may change (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR payment (Tabelog; April 2026). Order and pay first at the register; the food is brought or called out when ready (July and November 2025). 19 seats, tables for two and single seats; whole-cafe hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). A November 2024 diner understood there is no restroom. When busy, a sign goes up at the door (June 2026). The spice chicken curry often sells out and takes time to remake (April 2026).
places.neighborhood: 東中島1-18-27, ground floor of 新大阪丸ビル新館, on a street of business hotels diagonally across from the Shin-Osaka Youth Hotel; look for the orange sign (July 2025) — about 5 min south of the east exit of Shin-Osaka Stn (September 2026)
places.cuisine: Coffee, breakfast and cheap lunches (reviews) · morning: pizza toast set with coffee and potato salad ¥610, white mozzarella on the toast and a cherry in the potato salad (July 2025) · lunch: taco rice ¥720, special taco rice with extra meat, cheese, tomato and boiled egg ¥820, shrimp pilaf ¥720, spice chicken curry ¥720; curry and taco rice come with soup, the pilaf with soup and salad (September 2026) · the curry is thin and soupy, sharp with tomato and cloves (April 2026) · a drink with lunch for ¥80 more (2025–2026) · coffee and café au lait ¥340, herbal tea ¥360 (April 2026) · chewy margherita pizza (May 2025)
places.notes: [Cafe · Shin-Osaka east side, a one-person cafe among business hotels] A small corner cafe five minutes south of the Shin-Osaka east exit, among business hotels, with planes passing low on the way to Osaka International Airport (July 2025). One person runs it (April 2026), carefully if not chattily (June 2026): you order and pay at the register, then wait for your plate. From 8:30 there is a ¥610 pizza toast set with coffee; at lunch, taco rice, shrimp pilaf or a soupy spice chicken curry for ¥720, with a drink for ¥80 more. Quiet, mostly solo customers working or waiting for a train (2025–2026). Cash only, closed Mondays; one diner understood there is no restroom (November 2024).

roles: Owner (unnamed), runs the cafe alone (April 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: "The staff operates solo, and payment is cash only" (April 2026); "The owner may not be overly friendly, but [does the] job with care … [the shop manages] the flow by putting up a sign when it gets busy" (June 2026); a retro atmosphere (May 2025); payment in advance and self-service (July 2025). The Tabelog listing is not shop-maintained and carries no introduction.
chef_bio.specialty: Pizza toast breakfast; ¥720 taco rice and spice chicken curry.

anecdotes.text: "As I looked up, I could see planes flying close by, passing through Shin-Osaka on their way to Osaka International Airport." — July 2025, a ¥610 pizza toast breakfast.
"I had tried to order this several times before, but it was always sold out. Finally, I got to try it!" — April 2026, the ¥720 spice chicken curry.
"I often use this place during training sessions and seminars in Shin-Osaka." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Pond Cafe、カフェ、東淀川区東中島1-18-27 新大阪丸ビル新館 1F、火〜日8:30〜18:00、月曜休み (変わることあり)、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、19席 (2人席と1人席)、貸切20名まで、禁煙。口コミ(2024年11月〜2026年9月): 新大阪駅東口から南へ徒歩5分、ビジネスホテルの通り、Shin-Osaka Youth Hotel のななめ向かい、オレンジの看板、頭の上を飛行機、先に会計、セルフサービス、ピザトーストのセット610円 (コーヒー、ポテトサラダにさくらんぼ)、タコライス720円、スペシャルタコライス820円、エビピラフ720円、チキンカレー720円、ランチの飲み物は80円、コーヒー・カフェオレ340円、ハーブティー360円、マルゲリータ、カレーはよく売り切れ、ひとりで営業、現金のみ、静か、ひとりの客が多い、トイレはないらしい。

places.name: 味雅軒 (Miyabi Ken)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. A Chinese menu of gyoza, kara-age, sweet and sour pork, ramen and sauced stir-fries; nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Chinese menu built on pork, chicken and shrimp. Tabelog ticks "vegetarian options" but names none.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Lunch fills with office workers from about 11:40 (October 2026); Friday nights can be fully booked (July 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB), PayPay and d Barai; no e-money (Tabelog). 90 seats, counter and tables; private rooms for 10–30, a tatami room upstairs for up to 25; whole hire for 20–50; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 8 July 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 西中島5-8-5, a narrow street on the north side of Nishinakajima-Minamigata (October 2026; January 2020 review) — 5 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Stn, 6 min from Shin-Osaka Stn or Hankyu Minamikata (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Chinese cooking by a chef who was a head chef in China (Tabelog) · the shop's picks: mapo tofu, black vinegar pork and black vinegar shrimp (Tabelog) · lunch: daily "service lunch" sets; A was a kara-age set with curry salt (December 2025); shrimp chili set ¥950 (April 2026); C lunch of mapo ramen with half a fried rice ¥830 (October 2026) · mapo tofu built on doubanjiang and tianmianjiang with chili and Sichuan pepper (June 2026) · black vinegar pork, crisp and glossy (May 2026); shrimp chili, chive and egg stir-fry, a cheap light-drinking set (May 2026); spicy stir-fried chicken (April 2026); thick fried chicken wings and fluffy fried rice (June 2026) · all-you-can-eat-and-drink banquets ¥4,000 tax included (Tabelog), ¥3,850 in reviews (December 2025 to July 2026): five dishes first (kara-age, sweet and sour pork, gyoza, mapo tofu, shrimp chili), then order freely; almond jelly or sesame balls for dessert (December 2025)
places.notes: [Chinese · Nishinakajima, a busy Chinese canteen with a banquet floor] A 90-seat Chinese restaurant on a narrow street north of Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open since 2013, with Chinese and Taiwanese staff who speak Japanese (February 2026) and a Myanmar staff member one diner singled out for warm service (July 2026). At lunch it is packed with office workers from before noon for cheap sets: a kara-age set with curry salt, a mapo ramen with half a fried rice for ¥830 (October 2026). The mapo tofu is the dish reviewers single out, numbing with Sichuan pepper (June 2026), with black vinegar pork as the house signature. In the evening the upstairs floor hosts company parties on a two-hour all-you-can-eat-and-drink plan (about ¥3,850–4,000) that opens with five dishes and then lets you order freely. Service can slip when the room is full on a Friday (July 2026).

roles: Chef (unnamed), formerly a head chef in China (Tabelog)
Floor staff from China, Taiwan and Myanmar (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: authentic Chinese cuisine prepared by a chef who has worked as a head chef in China, from mapo tofu to black vinegar pork and a black vinegar shrimp popular with women; a second-floor tatami room for up to 25; opened 8 July 2013. Per reviews: "The staff were all Chinese or Taiwanese, but [all] spoke Japanese" (February 2026); "one of the Myanmar female staff members was exceptionally friendly and attentive" (July 2026); "I could hear Chinese being spoken from the kitchen" (October 2026); a long-time favourite of salarymen, with the upstairs room often used for company gatherings (January 2020 review, June 2026 update).
chef_bio.specialty: Mapo tofu; black vinegar pork; all-you-can-eat banquets.

anecdotes.text: "The staff kindly informed us that since it was a quiet day, we could order whatever we liked." — April 2026, the all-you-can-eat course.
"The meat, coated in a deep, glossy sauce, was crispy on the outside, and when bitten into, it released the mellow acidity and richness of the black vinegar." — May 2026.
"At 11:40 AM, the restaurant was already bustling with customers." — October 2026, the ¥830 mapo ramen lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 味雅軒、中華料理・バイキング・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島5-8-5、西中島南方駅から徒歩5分、新大阪駅と Hankyu Minamikata 駅から6分、月〜土11:00〜14:00、17:30〜23:00、日・祝休み、予約可、カード・PayPay・d払い可、電子マネー不可、90席、個室10〜30名、2階に25名までの座敷、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、2013年7月8日オープン。店の紹介: 中国で料理長をしていたシェフの本格中華、麻婆豆腐、黒酢の酢豚、女性に人気の黒酢エビ、食べ飲み放題4,000円 (税込)。口コミ(2025年5月〜2026年10月): 麻婆豆腐 (豆板醤と甜麺醤、花椒)、A と B の組み合わせ、gyoza は少し小さくなった、日替わりのサービスランチ、kara-age 定食にカレー塩、エビチリ定食950円、麻婆ラーメンと半チャーハンのランチ830円、食べ飲み放題3,850円 (最初に kara-age、酢豚、gyoza、麻婆豆腐、エビチリの5品、そのあと注文、デザートは杏仁豆腐かごま団子)、スタッフは中国や台湾の出身で日本語を話す、Myanmar 出身のスタッフも、2階の席、金曜は満席で遅れや注文もれ、黒酢の酢豚、ニラと卵の炒め物、鶏の辛い炒め物、手羽先、チャーハン。

cultural_comfort.note: Chinese and Taiwanese staff who speak Japanese (February 2026); a Myanmar staff member (July 2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: ヒラ 西中島店 (Hira Nishinakajima ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask, and ask carefully. The shop's site says "the flour we use is gluten-free" (当店で使用している小麦粉はグルテンフリーです), but 小麦粉 means wheat flour, which contains gluten, and the meals are built around naan, so the statement cannot be taken at face value. Rice is offered with every set.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog ticks "vegetarian options", and a spinach curry appeared as the daily curry (September 2026), but no dish is described as vegan and some curries come swirled with fresh cream (July 2026).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:30 (Tabelog). Lunch is full of office workers; full at 12:15 on a weekday (September 2026); the first hour after opening is quiet, and entry after 13:30 took ¥100 off a lunch (September 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 34 seats with sofas; whole-shop hire for 20–50; non-smoking with a smoking area outside; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff; photo menu; kids' menu; takeaway (Tabelog); leftovers can be taken home (November 2025).

places.cuisine: Indian curry and naan, about 30 curries with five spice levels from mild to extra hot, tandoori dishes, Indian snacks, Indian whiskey, chai and lassi (Tabelog) · lunch sets with naan refills: from ¥850 (September 2025); B lunch of two curries with seekh kebab, rice, salad, soup and lassi or chai (March 2026); C lunch ¥1,000 with tandoori chicken and two curries, spinach and keema on the day (September 2026); cheese naan set ¥1,000 (February 2026); a ladies' set with cheese naan and a choice of three curries (November 2025) · all-you-can-eat lunch of soup, salad, tandoori chicken, chicken curry, the daily curry, naan and rice, with chai or lassi: ¥1,300 (2024), ¥1,480 tax included (September 2025) · a carrot salad dressing diners refill (2025–2026) · evening set ¥900 with naan, curry, salad, soup, rice, tandoori chicken and lassi (July 2025) · prawn curry and garlic naan (March 2026) · two-hour all-you-can-eat-and-drink courses for 4–34 people, ¥3,300 for men and ¥3,000 for women (Tabelog, tax included)
places.notes: [Indian curry · Nishinakajima, an office-district naan house] A 34-seat Indian restaurant behind a blue-framed doorway near Nishinakajima-Minamigata, the most popular of the area's Indian places by one diner's count (March 2026), and packed with office workers at lunch. The sets are the draw: two curries from about 30, a spice level from mild to extra hot, a naan that hangs off the silver plate with refills included, plus salad with a carrot dressing, soup, rice and tandoori chicken or seekh kebab, from ¥850 (2025) to about ¥1,000 (2026). There is an all-you-can-eat lunch too, and at night a ¥900 set and ¥3,000–3,300 banquets with drinks. Come at opening or after 13:30 to avoid the crowd. English menu and English-speaking staff.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: authentic Indian curry, around 30 kinds with five spice levels, tandoori and Indian snacks, Indian whiskey, in "an atmosphere reminiscent of India and Nepal"; affordable sets at lunch, sets and banquets at night. The official site (hira-curry.jimdofree.com, read 2026-11-01) calls the shop 本場インドカリーの店new Hira and offers lunch, small banquets and "healthy Indian food" for a women's night out. Per reviews: one diner has come "about 20 to 30 times" (January 2026); staff "very kind" (July 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Curry sets with naan refills; all-you-can-eat lunch.

anecdotes.text: "The freshly baked naan is enormous, almost too big for the silver plate." — July 2026.
"The salad dressing is incredibly tasty, and I usually end up refilling my salad about three times." — January 2026, the all-you-can-eat lunch.
"At 12:15, the place was fully booked. It was packed with nearby office workers." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 本場インドカリーの店new Hira、NewHira!へようこそ、当店で使用している小麦粉はグルテンフリーです、ランチやってます、小宴会にどうぞ、ヘルシーなインド料理で女子会、お酒も各種あります。食べログ (店舗会員): ヒラ 西中島店、インド料理・インドカレー・ダイニングバー、大阪市淀川区西中島5-8-29 チサンマンション第３新大阪 1F、西中島南方駅と Hankyu Minamikata 駅から徒歩5分、新大阪駅から8分、毎日11:00〜15:00、17:00〜22:30、予約可、カード・交通系 IC・PayPay 可、34席、貸切20〜50名、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、Wi-Fi、英語メニュー、英語を話すスタッフ、お子様メニュー、テイクアウト。店の紹介: 約30種のカレー、辛さは5段階、タンドール料理、インドのウイスキー、チャイとラッシー、インドとネパールの雰囲気、2時間の食べ飲み放題 男性3,300円・女性3,000円。口コミ(2024年1月〜2026年9月): 青い枠の入口、大きなナン、ナンはおかわり自由、カレー2種のセット、シークカバブ、タンドリーチキン、にんじんのドレッシング、食べ放題ランチ1,300円 (2024年)・1,480円 (2025年)、ランチ850円から、13:30以降は100円引き、夜のセット900円、チーズナンのセット、エビのカレー、ガーリックナン、昼は会社員で満席。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff; photo menu (Tabelog).

places.name: お好みハウス ドンドン (DONDON)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki batter, yakisoba and gyoza are wheat-based.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the okonomiyaki batter tastes of dashi and comes under bonito flakes (October 2026), and most dishes have pork, octopus, squid or beef. Tabelog's feature list ticks "vegetarian options", but no vegetarian dish is named.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–02:00; closed Sunday; other closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations by phone, after 16:30; tables for two or more by phone; whole-shop parties of 13 to 19; a booking is cancelled if you are late without calling (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), PayPay and d Barai; no e-money (Tabelog). 19 seats: 7 at the counter and 3 tables of 4; smoking allowed; wheelchair accessible; English menu; takeaway and delivery (Tabelog). Almost full at 23:30 on a June 2026 night. Opening date 1 May 1982 on Tabelog, while the shop's own text on the same page says "established for 46 years".
places.neighborhood: 西中島6-3-32, ground floor of 第２新大阪ビル — 7 min from Shin-Osaka Stn (Midosuji Line and JR; from the JR central exit head south along the Midosuji Line, one block west of Mystays), 7 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Stn and Hankyu Minamikata (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Osaka okonomiyaki, made with several kinds of nagaimo and spices, domestic ingredients and a house blend of sauce, for a fluffy finish (Tabelog) · Hamamatsu gyoza, additive-free, with a patented garlic whose smell is said to be gone after two hours (Tabelog remarks; "three hours" on the menu, June 2026) · okonomiyaki named in reviews: pork and octopus, Osaka-yaki packed with octopus, pork and vegetables, pork kimchi, beef tendon and green onion, buta-tama (2026) · omelette yakisoba with a runny egg, salt yakisoba (2026) · teppan dishes: squid with butter, king oyster mushroom with butter, squid omelette, suji-yaki, grilled beef tendon with green onion, thick fried tofu, French fries (2026) · sweet sauce with mustard on top (May and August 2026) · a "Medical Menu" on the wall (October 2026) · beer, highballs, cocktails, sake, shochu, wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Nishinakajima, a late-night griddle by Shin-Osaka] A small okonomiyaki house seven minutes south of Shin-Osaka Station, with a retro round sign and lanterns out front, open till 2 am six nights a week and on Tabelog since 1982. That makes it a find for business travellers and for fans coming back late from concerts and ballgames; it was almost full at 23:30 on a June 2026 night. A couple runs it, per a June 2026 diner, and the okonomiyaki are grilled in the back and brought out hot rather than cooked at your seat (May and October 2026). The batter is fluffy, made with nagaimo and tasting of dashi, under a sweet sauce with a streak of mustard; pork and octopus is the classic, and the omelette yakisoba with its runny egg has its own fans. Squid or king oyster mushroom with butter, suji-yaki and Hamamatsu gyoza with a garlic said to leave no smell fill out the table. Smoking is allowed. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner at the griddle and a partner (unnamed couple)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: opening date 1 May 1982; the shop's own text says "established for 46 years" and describes okonomiyaki made with several kinds of nagaimo and spices, domestic ingredients and its own blend of sauce, "body-friendly ingredients" and most dishes available to take away. A May 2026 diner: "The okonomiyaki is grilled by the owner in the back." A June 2026 diner: "The restaurant is run by a couple, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere."
chef_bio.specialty: Fluffy Osaka okonomiyaki with house sauce and mustard; omelette yakisoba; Hamamatsu gyoza.

anecdotes.text: "I arrived at Shin-Osaka at 11 PM and headed to DONDON, which is open late. By around 11:30 PM, the place was almost full." — June 2026.
"The okonomiyaki sauce was incredibly delicious, and I felt it was something unique to DONDON that I couldn't find anywhere else." — June 2026.

"True to Osaka's spirit, the conversations of the salarymen at the table behind me were so entertaining that I found myself stifling laughter throughout my meal." — September 2026, a solo dinner of suji-yaki and okonomiyaki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: DONDON (お好みハウス ドンドン)、お好み焼き・鉄板焼き・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島6-3-32 第２新大阪ビル 1F、新大阪駅から徒歩7分、西中島南方駅と阪急 南方駅から7分、月〜土17:00〜翌2:00、日曜休み、予約は電話で16:30以降、13〜19名の貸切、カード・PayPay・d払い可、電子マネー不可、19席 (カウンター7、4人がけテーブル3)、喫煙可、車いす可、英語のメニュー、テイクアウトとデリバリー、オープン日1982年5月1日。店の紹介: 創業46年、数種類の長芋とスパイスでふわふわのお好み焼き、国産の材料、オリジナルのソース、体にやさしい材料。備考: 無添加で、においが残らない特許のにんにくを使った Hamamatsu gyoza。口コミ(2025年12月〜2026年10月): 夫婦で切り盛り、お好み焼きは奥で店主が焼いて熱々で運ばれる、豚とタコ、豚キムチ、すじねぎ、オムそば、塩焼きそば、イカバター、エリンギバター、すじ焼き、甘いソースにからし、だしのきいた生地、夜11時半にほぼ満席、壁に「Medical Menu」。

cultural_comfort.note: Tabelog lists an English menu; dishes come finished from the kitchen, not cooked at your seat. No evidence of English-speaking staff.

places.name: イチャドル韓豚丼 (Ichadoru Korean Buta-don)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The main dishes are pork stir-fried with homemade gochujang or with soy sauce (gochujang and soy sauce usually contain wheat), with japchae and a limited-time cold noodle dish on the menu. Tabelog's feature list says allergy information is available.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every main is pork, and the set side dishes include rolled omelette and kimchi; the summer cold noodles came with a bonito rice ball (July 2026).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the days before and after a holiday 11:00–21:00; closed Sat, Sun and holidays (Tabelog). Over the 2025–26 New Year it closed after Friday 26 December and reopened Monday 5 January (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Tabelog lists no cards, e-money or QR payment, but an October 2026 diner paid at the meal-ticket machine, which takes PayPay. 13 counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome; menu in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean; takeaway and delivery; allergy information available (Tabelog). Self-service water; the toilet is outside the shop (October 2026). Opened 11 November 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 西中島5-8-29, チサンマンション第3新大阪 — 5 min from Hankyu Minamikata Stn, 6 min (500 m) from Shin-Osaka (Tabelog); listed as the ground floor, described as a half-basement about 5 min south of Shin-Osaka Station and easy to miss (October 2026)
places.cuisine: Korean pork rice bowls and set meals (Tabelog) · pork stir-fried with homemade gochujang, the house specialty; a soy-sauce stir-fry for those who avoid heat · rice bowls ¥700 with miso soup and kimchi: soy-sauce pork (March, June and September 2026), gochujang pork with lettuce (July 2026) · set meals ¥1,000 with seven small side dishes (rolled omelette, hijiki, glass noodles, kimchi, blanched greens, konjac, bean-sprout namul), Korean seaweed and miso soup: gochujang pork (August and October 2026), soy-sauce pork (June 2026); large rice on request · sundubu jjigae set (spicy) and pork set with teppan japchae (spicy) (Tabelog), both sold out soon after noon in July and August 2026 · limited-time cold noodles with a large bonito and sesame-oil rice ball (July 2026)
places.notes: [Korean · Nishinakajima, pork rice bowls at a counter] A 13-seat counter a few minutes' walk south of Shin-Osaka Station, opened in November 2025, which bills itself as the first Japanese shop of Ichadol, a big Korean yakiniku chain, serving Korean pork rice bowls. The order is pork stir-fried with the shop's own gochujang, sweet and hot, or a milder soy-sauce version, as a ¥700 rice bowl with miso soup and kimchi or as a ¥1,000 set with seven little side dishes, Korean seaweed and miso soup (2026); portions are big, and staff will make the rice large if you ask. The sundubu and japchae sets sell out early: both were gone by just after noon on a July 2026 weekday. Buy a ticket at the machine (PayPay works, per an October 2026 diner, though Tabelog lists no cashless payment). One diner found the owner friendly and attentive (June 2026); another saw many overseas diners (October 2026). Weekdays only.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: "Korea's No.1 Yakiniku Chain, Ichadol, Launches Japan's First Korean Pork Bowl in Nishinakajima"; homemade gochujang; opened 11 November 2025. Reviewers: "a friendly and attentive owner" (June 2026); "a pork stir-fry specialty restaurant run by the popular Korean BBQ chain 'Ichadoru'" (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Pork stir-fried with homemade gochujang, as a rice bowl or a set with seven side dishes.

anecdotes.text: "As expected from a Korean set meal restaurant, in addition to the main dish, there were 7 small side dishes." — June 2026, the soy-sauce pork set for JPY 1,000.
"I was able to get in without waiting, but by a little after 12, both the japchae and sundubu were sold out!" — July 2026.
"I was surprised to see many foreign customers in the restaurant! People from various countries were dining here." — October 2026, the gochujang pork set for JPY 1,000.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イチャドル韓豚丼、韓国料理・食堂、大阪市淀川区西中島5-8-29 チサンマンション第3新大阪 1F、阪急 南方駅から徒歩5分、新大阪から6分 (500m)、月〜金・祝前日・祝後日11:00〜21:00、土・日・祝休み、年末年始は12月26日 (金曜) まで、1月5日 (月曜) から、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、13席 (カウンター)、禁煙、子ども可、英語・中国語 (簡体字)・韓国語のメニュー、テイクアウトとデリバリー、アレルギー表示あり、2025年11月11日オープン。店の紹介: 韓国でナンバーワンの焼肉チェーン Ichadol が日本で初めての韓豚丼を西中島に、自家製のコチュジャン、辛いのが苦手な人には醤油の炒め丼と定食、おすすめはコチュジャンの豚肉炒め、スンドゥブチゲの定食 (辛口) は7種のおかずと韓国のりつき、豚肉炒めと鉄板チャプチェの定食 (辛口)。口コミ(2026年3月〜10月): 醤油の豚肉炒め丼とコチュジャンの丼は700円でみそ汁とキムチつき、定食は1,000円で7種の小鉢 (卵焼き、ひじき、春雨、キムチ、青菜、こんにゃく、もやしのナムル) と韓国のりとみそ汁、ごはん大盛りも頼める、スンドゥブとチャプチェは昼すぎに売り切れ、期間限定の冷麺とおにぎり、食券機、PayPay 可、半地下、トイレは店の外、気さくな店主、海外からの客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at a ticket machine; Tabelog lists a menu in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean. Many overseas diners on an October 2026 visit.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. How the two curry sauces are thickened is not described; most toppings are breaded and fried (chicken katsu, ham cutlet, menchi katsu, fried shrimp, croquettes).

places.neighborhood: 東中島4-1-29, ground floor of 新大阪グランドハイツ, in a residential street — just over 5 min from the east exit of JR Shin-Osaka (the wrong exit means a long detour) (Tabelog); about 10 min from the east exit (August 2026)
places.cuisine: Two curries: A, "Addict", very hot, and B, "Best", medium-hot; or both on one plate (2025–2026) · B is fruity and sweet with heat that comes later (December 2025); A is tangy with a delayed heat (September 2026) · Best curry ¥690 with toppings: egg ¥60, meat ¥220, two fried shrimp ¥280, wiener ¥250 (June 2026) · B curry with crab cream croquette ¥910 (August 2026) · other toppings: chicken-breast katsu (December 2025), ham cutlet (May 2026), deep-fried broccoli, cream croquette, asparagus (July 2026), eggplant (September 2026), menchi katsu, a limited-time kara-age (October 2026) · large rice free; a free refill of curry sauce on orders over ¥940 (June 2026) · barley rice or brown rice instead of white (July 2026)
places.notes: [Curry · Shin-Osaka east side, a hot-curry counter] An eight-seat curry counter on a residential street east of Shin-Osaka Station, hard to find from the wrong exit, that draws a line some days (April 2025) and is quiet on others (July and September 2026). There are two sauces: A, "Addict", properly hot, and B, "Best", medium; many diners order both on one plate and keep them apart, since A takes over if mixed (May 2026). B is fruity and sweet with heat that arrives late, A tangier. The Best curry starts at ¥690, with toppings from a ¥60 egg to fried shrimp, croquettes, katsu or vegetables; large rice is free, and the sauce is refilled free on bigger orders (June 2026). Barley or brown rice on request. Cash only; closes at 17:00 Thursday to Saturday and all day Sunday.

chef_bio.background: No information about who runs the shop in the sources. Tabelog lists eight counter seats, cash only, and warns that hours and closing days may change.
chef_bio.specialty: A (Addict) and B (Best) curries, alone or together, with fried toppings.

anecdotes.text: "Be careful not to mix them too much, or the spicy curry will overpower everything!" — May 2026, A and B on one plate with ham cutlet.
"The curry was very fruity and sweet, but it had a strong spicy aftertaste. It's the kind of curry that hits you with heat later on." — December 2025, the B curry with chicken katsu.
"The presentation was impressive, with a generous amount of curry over a perfectly shaped mound of rice!" — August 2026, the B curry with crab cream croquette for JPY 910.

places.notes: [Chicken izakaya · Nishinakajima, Tajima chicken and Sichuan mapo tofu] A small chicken izakaya on the main street east of Nishinakajima-Minamigata, opened in 2021 as the sister shop of the Sichuan restaurant 華Sansyou学, so half the menu is its mapo tofu: soft silken tofu with minced meat, Sichuan pepper and a heat that comes later (2026). The rest is fresh Tajima chicken: tataki of breast or thigh with no off taste, a whole thigh grilled over charcoal with yuzu kosho, crisp kara-age, and chicken sobameshi to finish (March 2026). Weekday lunch brings about fourteen sets from ¥1,100 with free rice and egg-soup refills; one five-time visitor can never resist the chicken nanban with its shiba-zuke tartar (December 2025). Evenings fill with office workers by 18:00 (March 2026), and the all-you-can-drink courses, one built on chicken shabu-shabu, run ¥5,000–6,000. Closed weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: a sister restaurant of the Chinese restaurant 華Sansyou学 ("Hana Sansyou Gaku" on Tabelog), known for Sichuan mapo tofu, serving fresh, tender chicken "free from any gamey taste": breast tataki, chicken "Gyoopsal" (as Tabelog's English writes it), charcoal-grilled dishes, creative chicken dishes and yakitori; a specialities heading names Tajima chicken. Opened 14 October 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Freshness is What Makes Tajima Chicken Worth Tasting" (Tabelog, translated).

"Thanks to the freshly caught chicken, there's no odor, and the texture is pleasantly firm." — March 2026, the thigh tataki with green onion for JPY 1,078.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The hot-pot broth is built on soy sauces the shop selects from around Japan (Tabelog), and the usual finishes are champon noodles or udon; the cheese risotto finish uses rice. Nothing is said about wheat.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu-offal hot-pot restaurant; the vegetables and tofu cook in the offal broth.
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); open on Sundays and holidays when the website shows reservations; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; August and October 2026 reviews). Table charge ¥350 per person, not on courses (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC and other e-money, Rakuten Pay and au PAY (Tabelog). 23 seats: 3 at the counter, 20 at tables; free Wi-Fi, power outlets; English menu; takeout (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Motsu-nabe of fresh wagyu offal with local vegetables in a dashi of soy sauces chosen from around Japan (Tabelog) · broths: the classic soy sauce, soy-based with a punch of garlic (September 2026), or spicy, recommended by staff (October 2026) · in the pot: cabbage, garlic chives, bean sprouts, burdock, enoki and tofu, with extra horumon and fried tofu to add (2026) · signature side: yubiki horumon (blanched offal) with green onion and ponzu (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · steamed pork, chojyan, motsu jigoku-yaki, honey tomatoes, edamame · finishes: champon noodles, udon, and a cheese risotto with grated cheese and Tabasco (2026) · course ¥6,500 (October 2026); around ¥3,000–5,000 per person à la carte (August–September 2026) · beer, sake, shochu, wine, cocktails
places.notes: [Motsu-nabe · Shinsaibashi, wagyu-offal hot pot under baseball autographs] A small third-floor motsu-nabe room near Shinsaibashi Station, its walls covered in signed memorabilia from PL Gakuen alumni, professional baseball players and comedians (2026 reviews). The offal is wagyu, and diners remark on its freshness and lack of smell; it stays chewy in the pot. Pick the classic soy-sauce broth, with a punch of garlic, or the spicy one, start with the blanched horumon in green-onion ponzu, one diner's MVP and a must for others, then finish the pot two ways: champon noodles or udon, and then a cheese risotto with grated cheese and Tabasco. One regular on a 17th visit (September 2026) still orders both finishes. Smoking is allowed.

roles: Owner and kitchen unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text, a favourite of celebrities and athletes, using premium wagyu offal, locally grown vegetables and a dashi of soy sauces chosen from around Japan. Diners in 2026 describe walls of autographs from PL Gakuen alumni, baseball players and comedians, friendly staff and quick service.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu-offal motsu-nabe; blanched horumon with green-onion ponzu; cheese risotto finish.

anecdotes.text: "With motsu-nabe, if you cook it too long, the fat can render out, and the edible parts shrink. However, the motsu here maintains a satisfying chewiness until the very end." — October 2026.
"The first dish was the blanched Horumon with green onions and ponzu sauce. It was absolutely amazing!" — October 2026, ¥6,500 course.
"This time, I tried udon for the first time after the soy sauce hot pot, and it was so good with a nice chewy texture!… And then, from the udon to the cheese risotto." — September 2026, a 17th visit.

places.name: 岡﨑 (Okazaki)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. The monthly omakase is classic Japanese cooking built on dashi, with soy sauces served for the sashimi (July 2026); some dishes are wheat-based, such as spring rolls (October 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase of fish, dashi of bonito, and Miyazaki beef (official site).
places.hours_raw: Seatings: dinner at 18:00 and 20:30 (no time limit at the table); lunch at 12:00 on Tuesday, Friday and Sunday only, all guests starting together; closed Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). Reservation only, by phone or online (TableCheck, Tabelog); up to 10 guests a booking, private hire 10–20; cancellation 100% from two days before (official site). Service charge 10%, 15% in the private rooms (official site). Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX, JCB, Diners); no e-money (official site). 26 seats: a 10-seat counter, a table for 6, two private rooms with sunken seating; non-smoking, smoking outside (official site; Tabelog). Children only at lunch (Tue, Fri, Sun) and all day on Saturday and Sunday (official site). Opened 11 April 2023 (Tabelog) as 翠 岡﨑; renamed 岡﨑 on 1 October 2026 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-16-20, 2F of 心斎橋ステージアビル — 3 min from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 6
places.cuisine: Japanese omakase changing monthly (prices tax included, plus 10% service; official site, read November 2026): lunch 8 dishes ¥11,000 (Tue, Fri, Sun); dinner 10 dishes ¥19,800 · from the site's sample course: a clear soup of white amadai, sesame tofu and mizu, the dashi of two kombu boiled separately with karebushi and tuna flakes; Spanish mackerel and wild mushrooms grilled with the scent of charcoal, straw or firewood; a seasonal hassun, "the lead role of the course"; Miyazaki beef with wild watercress · from reviews: sashimi with several soy sauces, clay-pot rice with corn and shirasu (July 2026), sweetfish wrapped in oboro kombu (May 2026), dinner upgrades to Chateaubriand (June 2026), maitake-and-oyster spring rolls, a fillet steak and matcha with warabi mochi (October 2026 lunch); leftovers of the rice packed to take home · 15–20 sakes, about 50 wines tasted by the chef, one red and one white by the glass (official site) · mail order: hamo or hamo-and-matsutake hot-pot sets in season (official site)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a young chef's monthly omakase] The Japanese restaurant of chef 岡﨑 直哉, who spent five years at 日本料理 翠 (now 翠 大屋), rising to second-in-command, and three and a half as head chef of an Osaka ryotei, before opening here in 2023 as 翠 岡﨑 under a noren-wake from 翠; on 1 October 2026 it dropped 翠 and became simply 岡﨑, at the suggestion of 翠's chef, per a September 2026 diner (official site). A calm second-floor room with a white-wood counter of ten and two private rooms. The monthly omakase is ¥11,000 for eight dishes at lunch (Tuesday, Friday and Sunday only) and ¥19,800 for ten at dinner: a clear soup on a two-kombu dashi, fish grilled over charcoal, straw or firewood, a showpiece hassun, Miyazaki beef, and clay-pot rice so good one July 2026 diner asked for seconds. Diners find the chef friendly and talkative; one thought the grilling still has room to grow, another that a meal ran about three hours (August 2024). Listed in the Michelin Guide's Selected Osaka 2026 (May 2026 review).

roles: Chef and owner (料理人; independent shop, official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: interested in cooking from primary school; after high school went to a culinary college, and drawn to Japanese cooking for its expression of the seasons; three and a half years as head chef at a ryotei in Osaka and five years at 日本料理 翠 (now 翠 大屋), becoming second-in-command; opened 翠 岡﨑 in Higashi-Shinsaibashi in 2023 as a noren-wake; renamed 岡﨑 from 1 October 2026. The chef visits shops to pick work by contemporary potters and sometimes commissions dishes for particular courses. A September 2026 diner reports that 翠's owner-chef suggested it was time to use the chef's own name; a March 2026 diner mentions a one-night collaboration fusing Italian and Japanese cooking. Fish include catches from fisherman Fujimoto in Ehime (May and June 2026). Diners describe a young, confident, friendly chef (2025–2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Only by understanding Japanese cuisine to its roots can new techniques and presentation add meaning"; good seasonal ingredients are taken as given, and the work is in raising them into the shop's own dish (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly omakase; two-kombu dashi; hassun; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "Starting from October 2026, the name \"Sui Okazaki\" will drop the \"Sui\" and simply be \"Okazaki.\" It seems the head chef, who is the owner of Sui Oya, suggested, \"It's about time you just use your own name.\"" — September 2026, lunch.
"The corn and shirasu clay pot rice at the end was so delicious that even after ordering a large portion, I couldn't resist asking for a second helping." — July 2026.
"The owner was friendly and very easy to talk to. I enjoyed the various sights visible from the counter." — July 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 心斎橋の日本料理 岡﨑 (おかざき)、店名変更のご挨拶: 2026年10月1日より「心斎橋 翠 岡﨑」は「岡﨑 (OKAZAKI)」に、「日本料理 翠」から屋号を受け継ぐ形で東心斎橋に独立した日本料理店、伝統を大切にしながら当店独自の料理へ、カウンター席をメインに個室2部屋、料亭や割烹で培った経験、現代作家の器、料理人 岡﨑 直哉: 小学生の頃から料理に興味、高校卒業後に調理師専門学校、大阪の料亭で料理長として3年半、「日本料理 翠 (現・翠 大屋)」で5年修業し二番手に、2023年に暖簾分けの形で「翠 岡﨑」をオープン、2026年「岡﨑」へ。コース (税込、別途サービス料10%): ランチ (火・金・日、12時一斉スタート) 全8品11,000円、ディナー全10品19,800円、月替わり、椀物 (白甘鯛、胡麻豆腐、みずの実、二種類の昆布と枯れ本節・まぐろ節の出汁)、焼物 (鰆、天然茸、炭や藁、薪の香り)、八寸、肉料理 (宮崎牛、天然クレソン)、日本酒15〜20種類、ワイン50種類ほど、グラスワイン赤白1種ずつ、鱧鍋セットや鱧松茸鍋セットの通販。東心斎橋1-16-20 心斎橋ステージアビル 2階、心斎橋駅6番出口から徒歩3分、ディナー第一部18:00〜・第二部20:30〜 (時間制限なし)、ランチは火・金・日12:00〜、水曜休み、26席 (テーブル6、カウンター10、個室10)、個室サービス料15%、子どもはランチと土日終日のみ、予約は最大10名、キャンセルは2日前から100%。食べログ: オープン2023年4月11日、禁煙 (店外で喫煙可)。口コミ(2024年8月〜2026年10月): 翠の大将の弟子、名前の変更は翠の大将のすすめ、Michelin Guide の Selected Osaka 2026、Ehime の漁師 Fujimoto さんの魚、八寸、sashimi に数種類の醤油、とうもろこしと shirasu の土鍋ご飯、舞茸と牡蠣の春巻き、ヘレ、わらび餅、抹茶、ディナーはシャトーブリアン、残ったご飯は持ち帰り、気さくな大将、3時間ほどかかったという声、焼き物はまだ伸びしろという声。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site has an English page and English online booking (TableCheck); the chef talks with guests at the counter (2025–2026).

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Much of the beef comes with sauce (the Omi beef sudare-yaki is grilled coated in it), and the menu has cold noodles and bibimbap; salt-grilled tongue, shrimp and scallops may be simpler, but nothing is stated.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant; salads, namul, kimchi and lettuce are sides, and the soups are not described.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Thu, Sun and holidays 11:30–24:00 (last order 23:30); Fri and Sat 11:30–03:00 (last order 02:30); open all year, hours may change over New Year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; 2-hour seating; bookings cancelled 15 minutes after the time (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transport IC and other e-money, and QR including PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 66 seats at 17 tables over two floors, sofa seats; designated smoking area; free Wi-Fi; hire for 20–50 (Tabelog; October 2026 reviews). Children welcome; call ahead with a stroller (Tabelog). Menus in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean, with photos; ordering by tablet (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 1 December 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashi-suji 2-2-31, between Shinsaibashi and Dotonbori — 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 6 (Midosuji Line)
places.cuisine: Yakiniku of Japan's "three great wagyu", Kobe, Matsusaka and Omi beef, hand-cut, with a display case of wagyu blocks on the first floor (Tabelog; October 2026) · courses, tax included (Tabelog): Omi beef feast course ¥9,000 (the most booked; Omi beef sudare-yaki and three cuts), Kobe beef premium course ¥20,000 (seared Kobe beef yukhoe, three Kobe cuts), banquet course of 16 dishes ¥3,800 food only or ¥5,500 with drinks; 2-hour all-you-can-drink +¥1,700 · signature: the Kobe beef "tamatebako", four cuts in a box opened in a puff of smoke (Tabelog) · à la carte (October 2026 reviews): Omi beef sudare-yaki ¥3,500–3,580, Matsusaka beef premium lean ¥2,400, Matsusaka beef premium kalbi ¥3,000, Omi beef special loin ¥2,100, special thick-cut tongue steak ¥2,100, premium salted tongue ¥1,600, premium outside skirt ¥1,600, Omi beef special outside skirt ¥2,700, horumon assortment ¥1,400, fresh omasum ¥860, seared Kobe beef yukhoe ¥1,500, Matsusaka beef sirloin sushi ¥1,500, live abalone steak ¥2,980, large shrimp ¥1,280, scallops in butter ¥1,160, stone-grilled bibimbap ¥1,100–1,200, cold noodles ¥990 · lunch "tamatebako" of Kobe, Matsusaka and Omi beef with tongue, salad, soup, rice and kimchi ¥7,500 (October 2026) · Japanese sake, highballs, wine
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Shinsaibashi, Kobe, Matsusaka and Omi beef side by side, late] A two-floor yakiniku house opened in December 2025 between Shinsaibashi and Dotonbori, with a case of wagyu blocks on show downstairs, built around Japan's three famous brands: Kobe, Matsusaka and Omi beef. The house showpiece is a Kobe beef "tamatebako" box of four cuts that opens in a puff of smoke; diners in October 2026 also went for the Omi beef sudare-yaki, large cuts laid side by side and grilled coated in sauce, Matsusaka lean and kalbi, a 1 cm-thick tongue steak and wagyu sushi. Courses start at ¥9,000 (Omi beef) and lunch boxes at ¥7,500; à la carte, a pair ate well for about ¥15,600. Ordering is by tablet, menus come in English, Chinese and Korean, and on a Halloween evening the room was full of overseas visitors. Open to midnight, and to 3 am on Fridays and Saturdays. One October 2026 diner says it is produced by a former Hanshin Tigers player.

roles: Kitchen and operator unnamed; an October 2026 reviewer says the restaurant is produced by a former Hanshin Tigers player
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 December 2025 (Tabelog). Per the Tabelog shop text, it offers two of Japan's three great wagyu, Omi and Kobe beef; reviewers also order Matsusaka beef (October 2026). A reviewer describes meat hand-cut by skilled staff and a large display case of wagyu on the ground floor; staff keep the grill at the right heat (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Kobe beef tamatebako; Omi beef sudare-yaki; Matsusaka beef lean.

anecdotes.text: "The Sudare-yaki was surprisingly tender despite its impressive appearance. I couldn't resist putting it on rice and enjoying it together." — October 2026.
"On October 31st, Halloween, I made a reservation for 7:00 PM. The place was packed with many international guests!" — October 2026.
"The total bill came to JPY 15,620, which was surprisingly affordable considering how much we ate." — October 2026, a pair à la carte.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): WAGYU Oukoku (Kobe Beef wagyu House Wagyu Oukoku)、焼肉・horumon・居酒屋、心斎橋筋2-2-31、心斎橋駅6番出口から徒歩5分、月〜木・日・祝11:30〜24:00 (L.O.23:30)、金・土11:30〜翌3:00 (L.O.2:30)、年中無休、2時間制、予約時間から15分でキャンセル、カード・電子マネー・QR (PayPay、Alipay、WeChat Pay など) 可、66席 (テーブル17)、ソファ席、分煙 (喫煙スペース)、Wi-Fi、貸切20〜50名、子ども可、英語・簡体字・韓国語のメニュー、写真付き、デジタルメニュー、オープン2025年12月1日。店の説明: 日本三大和牛のうち近江牛と神戸牛、煙の演出で開ける神戸牛の「Tamatebako」(4部位)、近江牛の3種盛り、ワイン。コース (税込): 近江牛のコース9,000円、神戸牛のコース20,000円、宴会コース16品3,800円 (飲み放題付き5,500円)、飲み放題+1,700円。口コミ(2026年10月): 元 Hanshin Tigers の選手のプロデュース、1階に和牛の塊のショーケース、2階の席、タブレットで注文、近江牛の Sudare-yaki、松阪牛の上赤身と上カルビ、厚切りタンステーキ、上塩タン、ハラミ、horumon 盛り、センマイ、神戸牛の炙り Yukhoe、松阪牛の肉の sushi、活鮑のステーキ、大海老、帆立のバター焼き、石焼 bibimbap、冷麺、ランチの Tamatebako7,500円、2人で15,620円、ハロウィンの夜は海外の客でいっぱい、日本酒、ハイボール、ワイン。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean with photos; tablet ordering (Tabelog; 2026).

places.name: ラーメン家 みつ葉 あべの出張所 (Ramenya Mitsuba Abeno shucchousho)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: house-made wheat noodles of 100% domestic flour, and the shoyu tare blends four soy sauces (official site).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is pork and chicken bones, the shio tare uses scallop, and the bowls carry chashu and egg (official site).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:30, September 2026 review); irregular closures (official site; Tabelog). A counter in the Hoop Dining Court food hall: order at a touch-panel ticket machine that sends the order to the kitchen, then take a tray to any seat in the shared hall and return your dishes (2026 reviews). A line of about six on one September 2026 visit; no wait after 22:00 (August 2026). Cash, cards, QR and e-money including QUICPay now accepted; it was cash-only before (September and October 2026 reviews). Food-hall seating shared with other stalls (Tabelog lists 400 seats). Opened 13 September 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Abenosuji 1-2-30, あべのHoop B1F food hall — a short walk from Kintetsu Osaka-Abenobashi Stn; reachable under cover from Tennoji Stn through Harukas (December 2025)
places.cuisine: Foam-topped paitan ramen from Mitsuba of Tomio, Nara (founded 2011): a broth of domestic pork and chicken bones boiled about 8 hours on a high flame and stirred every 3–5 minutes, served frothed (official site; 2026 reviews) · shio ramen ¥1,100, large ¥1,250, special ¥1,500; shoyu ramen, special ¥1,500; chashu ramen, large ¥1,650 (2026 reviews) · shoyu tare of four soy sauces; shio tare of six salts with plenty of scallop and kombu (official site) · house noodles of 100% domestic wheat at 48% hydration, made daily at the main shop, chewy (official site), medium-thick (2026 reviews) · chashu seared hot then slow-cooked in the oven and hand-cut daily, served rare; menma desalted for a week and lightly seasoned; ajitama of 京たまご eggs (official site) · limited tsukemen, including a "Tsukemen Dive" and a Sichuan tsukemen, up to four servings (2025–2026) · rice ¥290 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Abeno, Nara's foam paitan in a food hall] The Abeno outpost of Mitsuba, the Nara ramen shop that opened in Tomio in 2011 and placed second nationally in the 2015 Tabelog Ramen Award (official site), here as a counter in the Hoop basement food hall, so you skip the Nara queue. The broth is pork and chicken bones boiled for eight hours and whipped to a foam that one diner compared to a bisque; it is rich and creamy, with a sharp saltiness and black pepper in the shio. Choose shio (six salts, scallop and kombu) or shoyu (four soy sauces), ¥1,100; chewy medium-thick house noodles, a thick slab of rare chashu and a long menma come on top. One regular swears by the chashu ramen and finds it the right finish after a night out. Some October 2026 diners found it monotonous or the chashu underwhelming. Buy at the touch-panel machine, take a tray, sit anywhere in the hall.

roles: Branch staff unnamed; part of ラーメン家 みつ葉 (official site)
chef_bio.origin: Tomio, Nara (the parent shop, official site).
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: ラーメン家 みつ葉 opened in Tomio, Nara, in 2011; the second shop, みつ葉 the second, at Horyuji in 2017; this あべの出張所 in Abeno Hoop in 2019; かどま出張所 at LaLaport Kadoma and a ミ・ナーラ出張所 in Nara in 2023. Awards listed on the site: the 2013 rookie grand prix of the magazine 究極のラーメン, 2nd nationwide in the 2015 Tabelog Ramen Award, 15th in 2016. Tabelog opening day 13 September 2019. Reviewers in September 2026 note a switch from cash only to a touch-panel machine with cashless payment.
chef_bio.philosophy: "The best bowl": boiling-hot soup poured into a heated bowl, chewy house noodles and toppings that take time and care (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Foam-topped pork-and-chicken paitan, shio or shoyu; chashu ramen.

anecdotes.text: "The espuma-style broth was almost like a bisque. It had depth without being heavy, so I finished it all." — May 2024, shio ramen.
"The chicken and pork broth was delicious, with a sharp saltiness and black pepper that complemented the rich, creamy soup." — August 2026, special shio ramen.
"The rich, thick broth clings perfectly to the noodles and is delicious. Even though the flavor is strong, I ended up drinking every last drop of the soup." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ラーメン家 みつ葉、奈良県奈良市富雄元町、泡系、豚骨塩ラーメン、醤油ラーメン、白湯スープ、2011年 奈良の富雄にて創業、2017年 法隆寺に みつ葉 the second、2019年 あべのHoopに みつ葉 あべの出張所、2023年 ららぽーと門真に かどま出張所、ミ・ナーラ出張所。あべの出張所: 阿倍野筋1丁目2-30 B1 Hoop、11時00分〜23時00分、不定休。こだわり: 国産のガラを強火で約8時間、3〜5分おきに撹拌して鶏と豚の旨味を引き出したスープ、国産小麦100%の自家製麺 (加水率48%の多加水麺、もっちり)、醤油は4種類の醤油のブレンド、塩は6種類の塩に貝柱と昆布、チャーシューは表面を高温で焼き内側はオーブンで低温調理、毎日手切り、国産の奴ネギ、短冊メンマを一週間かけて塩抜き、京たまごの味玉。受賞歴: 2013年 雑誌『究極のラーメン』新人賞グランプリ、2015年 食べログ ラーメンアワード ラーメン部門 全国第2位、2016年 全国第15位。メニュー (本店): 豚CHIKIしおラーメン・しょうゆラーメン1,100円、チャーシューメン1,300円。食べログ: Ramenya Mitsuba Abeno shucchousho、あべのHoop B1F、毎日11:00〜23:00、400席 (フードコート)、オープン2019年9月13日。口コミ(2024年5月〜2026年10月): 泡のスープ (エスプーマ、ビスクのよう)、濃厚でクリーミー、鶏と豚、塩はキレのある塩気と黒胡椒、中太の麺、もちもち、レアのチャーシュー、長いメンマ、味玉、塩ラーメン1,100円、大盛り1,250円、スペシャル1,500円、チャーシュー麺大盛り1,650円、ご飯290円、限定の tsukemen、券売機はタッチパネルに、キャッシュレス可、6人ほどの行列 (2026年9月)、単調、チャーシューが物足りないという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Touch-panel ticket machine and self-service tray in a food hall (2026).

places.name: 華蓮 大阪心斎橋店 (Karen Osaka Shinsaibashi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Shabu-shabu and seiro-mushi are meat and vegetables cooked in a kombu broth or steamed, but they come with ponzu and sesame sauce, the shabu-shabu ends with noodles (shabu-men), and the cutlets are breaded. Ask about the sauces and swap the noodles for rice.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every course is built on Kagoshima black beef, black pork or Satsuma chicken. A vegetable platter is sold as an add-on.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00 (drinks last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:30 (last order 21:30, last entry 21:00); closed 31 December–4 January (Tabelog). The operator's store list gives last orders of 14:00 and 22:00 (official site). One course per person at lunch (official lunch menu). Reservations: online bookings get 90 minutes at the table, up to two hours if seats allow; phone for bookings after 19:30 (Tabelog). Dinner adds a 10% service charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and IC cards, Rakuten Edy, iD; no QR (Tabelog). 90 seats, parties up to 28; private rooms for 2, 4, 6 or 8; tatami and sunken seating; non-smoking with a smoking room; wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashi-suji 2-7-18, プライムスクエア心斎橋 B1F, on Midosuji (the basement of the Dolce & Gabbana building, per a September 2026 diner) — 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: Kagoshima black beef (A5 rank) and Kagoshima black pork, with Satsuma chicken and Kagoshima vegetables (official lunch menu, tax included, uploaded April 2026; Tabelog) · seiro-mushi steamed in a wooden steamer, the house favourite: black pork ¥4,200, black beef and black pork ¥5,500, black beef rib roast ¥6,500, each with a starter, vegetable platter, rice, miso soup, pickles and dessert · shabu-shabu in a kombu broth (October 2026), ending with shabu-men: black pork ¥3,700, beef and pork ¥5,000, black beef rib roast ¥6,000 · cutlets with rice and miso soup: Satsuma young shamo chicken ¥1,600, black pork loin ¥2,000, thick-cut loin ¥2,500, black pork fillet ¥2,000, black beef sirloin ¥5,500, fillet ¥6,500 · black beef steaks: sirloin ¥6,200, fillet ¥7,200 · lunch specials: A5 black beef teppanyaki ¥2,800, black pork teppanyaki with egg-yolk ponzu ¥1,800, Karen hamburg of black beef and pork ¥2,000 · sukiyaki and set courses at dinner (diners report ¥10,000–¥19,999 a head); barley-miso soup, pickles in Kagoshima miso and sweet-potato ice cream (October 2026)
places.notes: [Shabu-shabu · Shinsaibashi, Kagoshima black beef and pork from the farmers' co-op] A calm Japanese-style basement on Midosuji with private and semi-private rooms, run directly by JA Kagoshima's economic federation, which also has Karen restaurants in Kagoshima, Hakata and Ginza. The meat is its own: A5-rank Kagoshima black beef, which the shop's menu says won the Prime Minister's Prize at the 2022 national wagyu show, and Kagoshima black pork. The favourite is seiro-mushi, the meat and a colourful load of vegetables steamed in a wooden box, which diners find light, the fat dripping away; shabu-shabu in kombu broth ends with noodles. Lunch is the bargain (black pork shabu-shabu ¥3,700, a black pork teppanyaki ¥1,800, black beef and pork hamburg ¥2,000), and meals close with barley-miso soup, Kagoshima pickles and sweet-potato ice cream. Tabelog Hot Pot 100 in 2024 and 2026. Book online; dinner adds 10% service.

roles: Run directly by JA鹿児島県経済連 (the JA Kagoshima Prefecture economic federation; "JA Kagoshima Economic Federation" in an October 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog remarks (shop-maintained listing): run directly by the federation, which also has shops in Kagoshima, Hakata and Ginza; serves Kagoshima black beef, said there to have won the overall title at the 11th National Wagyu Show and been crowned the best wagyu in Japan, plus Kagoshima black pork, black Satsuma chicken and Kagoshima vegetables. The official lunch menu (karen-ja.or.jp, April 2026) cites the 12th show in 2022: the Prime Minister's Prize, Agriculture Minister's prizes in six categories, and the best carcass prize at two shows running; all beef is A5 rank. Tabelog Hot Pot 100 in 2024 and 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Seiro-mushi of Kagoshima black beef and pork; black pork shabu-shabu.

anecdotes.text: "Steaming allows excess fat to drip away, making it surprisingly light and refreshing." — September 2026, a black pork seiro-mushi lunch.
"I was particularly impressed by the miso soup made with barley miso, which had a unique flavor different from the usual miso soup" — October 2026, beef and pork seiro-mushi.
"The prices felt a bit high, and I sensed that the pricing reflects not just the dishes, but also the location, private space, and service." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: JA鹿児島県経済連 (karen-ja.or.jp): 華蓮 店舗一覧、鹿児島店、博多店、大阪心斎橋店、鹿児島華蓮 銀座店。大阪心斎橋店: 昼 11:30〜15:00 (LO14:00)、夜 17:00〜22:30 (LO22:00)、心斎橋筋2丁目7-18 プライムスクエア心斎橋B1F。お昼のメニュー (2026年4月、税込): 鹿児島黒牛は「A5ランク」、お一人様一コース、2022年の第12回全国和牛能力共進会で内閣総理大臣賞、農林水産大臣賞六部門制覇、最優秀枝肉賞二大会連続、せいろ蒸し (先付・お肉・野菜盛り・御飯・味噌汁・香物・水物) 鹿児島黒豚4,200円、鹿児島黒牛鹿児島黒豚味わい5,500円、鹿児島黒牛6,500円、しゃぶしゃぶ (しゃぶ麺つき) 3,700円・5,000円・6,000円、カツ (さつま若しゃもカツ1,600円〜鹿児島黒牛ヒレ牛カツ6,500円)、鹿児島黒牛サーロインステーキ6,200円、ヒレステーキ7,200円、A5ランク鹿児島黒牛鉄板焼き2,800円、鹿児島黒豚鉄板焼き1,800円 (黄身ポン酢)、華蓮ハンバーグランチ2,000円。食べログ (店舗会員): しゃぶしゃぶ・すき焼き・ステーキ、ネット予約は1時間半、19時半以降は電話、ディナーはサービス料10%、90席、個室 (2〜8名)、座敷・掘りごたつ、禁煙 (喫煙室あり)、車椅子可、年末年始休み、鍋 百名店 2024・2026。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): せいろ蒸しが一番人気、昆布のだし、ゴマだれとポン酢、しゃぶ麺で締め、麦味噌の味噌汁、鹿児島の味噌の漬物、さつまいものアイス、個室で落ち着く。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses in private rooms; book online on Tabelog. The operator's site has an English page.

places.name: THE BUTCHER
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The shop offers "protein burgers" with lettuce in place of the bun (Tabelog), and steaks from the grill; sauces, the mashed-beef patty and the shared fryer (fries, onion rings, fish and chips) are not described.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetable burger is on the menu (¥1,210) but its patty and bun are not described; everything else is beef, pork, chicken, fish, egg or cheese.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–16:00 (last order 15:30) and 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); irregular closing days (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); a few tables, so expect a short queue at busy times (2024–2026 reviews). Up steep stairs to the second floor (September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay; no e-money; no service charge (Tabelog). 26 seats, counter and sofas; non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). Opened 12 May 2016 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Charcoal-grilled burgers and steaks, "made by a butcher" (shop text on Tabelog); prices from the shop menu on Tabelog, which notes they may have changed (read November 2026) · burger ¥1,320 (¥1,300 in September 2026), cheese ¥1,540, egg, bacon, avocado, pineapple, broccoli, gorgonzola and mozzarella versions ¥1,485–¥1,958; double cheese ¥2,365 · THE BUTCHER with three Brooklyn mashed-beef patties ¥2,585 (¥2,550 in October 2026); Big Macho ¥2,255, Giga Macho with four patties ¥3,575 · jalapeño cheese ¥1,738 (¥1,903 in October 2026), sriracha jalapeño; pulled pork from ¥1,375; the Jamie with blueberry and peanut butter ¥1,650; Cajun chicken from ¥1,155; fish burgers; vegetable burger ¥1,210 · protein burgers in lettuce instead of a bun ¥1,540–¥2,420 · cooked medium by default, other doneness on request (October 2026); burgers come with salad and fries (2026 reviews) · fries, broccoli fries, onion rings, Cajun popcorn shrimp, fish and chips ¥550–¥825 · steaks cut to order from the grill, 20–30 minutes · protein shakes ¥990; Heartland beer; cocktails
places.notes: [Burgers · Namba, charcoal-grilled burgers across from NGK] Up a steep staircase across the street from Namba Grand Kagetsu, a small American-style meat diner with sofas, born from the Nishi-ku burger shop BURGERLION. Patties are grilled over charcoal and served medium unless you ask otherwise, with a smoky, beefy flavour diners rate highly; the bun is tall and toasted, and burgers come with salad and fries. Pick from some 40 burgers, from the plain ¥1,320 burger to THE BUTCHER with three patties (¥2,585) and the four-patty Giga Macho, or have many of them wrapped in lettuce instead of a bun as a "protein burger". Tabelog Hamburger 100 in 2022, 2024 and 2026. Few tables and no bookings, so lines form at lunch; an October 2026 diner found most of the room were Western visitors. Open daily 11:30–21:00 with a break at 16:00.

roles: Run by the BURGERLION group (shop text and remarks on Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a meat diner born from the Nishi-ku hamburger shop BURGERLION, famous for grilled hamburgers, with sister shops BURGERLION -UTSUBO A GOGO- (Higobashi), BURGERLION -MEAT CRUSADERS- (Tamatsukuri) and LAIDBACK BY BURGERLION (Sakai). Opened 12 May 2016. Tabelog Hamburger 100 in 2022, 2024 and 2026. No owner or chef is named.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled burgers; THE BUTCHER triple; protein burgers in lettuce.

anecdotes.text: "The majority of the patrons inside were Westerners." — October 2026, THE BUTCHER burger, ¥2,550.
"Once I reached the top, I was welcomed with a friendly 'Irasshaimase!' (Welcome!)." — October 2026, a ¥1,430 burger.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): THE BUTCHER、ハンバーガー・ステーキ・カフェ、難波千日前10-13 スギモトビル 2F、各線難波駅すぐ、なんばグランド花月の向かい、毎日11:30〜16:00 (L.O.15:30)・17:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、不定休、予約不可、カード・PayPay可、サービス料なし、26席、禁煙、テイクアウト可、2016年5月12日オープン、ハンバーガー 百名店 2022・2024・2026、西区の BURGERLION から生まれたミートダイナー、バンズの代わりにレタスのプロテインバーガー、系列店 (Higobashi、Tamatsukuri、Sakai)。食べログのメニュー (英訳で確認): バーガー1,320円、チーズ1,540円、THE BUTCHER 2,585円、プロテインバーガー、ベジタブルバーガー1,210円、サイド550〜825円、ステーキは20〜30分。口コミ(2024年8月〜2026年10月): 炭火のパティ、焼き加減はミディアムが基本、サラダとポテトつき、急な階段、昼は行列、欧米の客が多い日も。

places.name: 美津の (Mizuno)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The okonomiyaki, yoshoku-yaki, modern-yaki and yakisoba are wheat-batter or noodle dishes. The shop's own menu says the yam-yaki (山芋焼) uses no flour, 100% yam ("粉を使わず山芋100％"), but it is finished with sauce or mustard mayonnaise and cooked on the shared griddle. Ask about the sauce before ordering it.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every okonomiyaki carries pork, seafood or the house minced meat, and the yam-yaki is topped with scallops and pork (2024–2026 reviews).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); no closing day since February 2026, when the Thursday closing ended (official site). Tabelog lists 11:00–21:00. No reservations (Tabelog); courses for two or more can be arranged (official site). Queues are usual: about 30 minutes on a weekday at 19:00 (September 2026) and on a December 2024 visit, shorter at weekday lunch (October 2026); orders are taken while you wait, last orders are strict near closing, and one diner felt pressed to give up the table (December 2024; September 2026). Staff cook everything at your table (September 2026). Cards from ¥3,000 (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 38 seats, 12 at the counter; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog).
