places.cuisine: Dotonbori okonomiyaki for more than 70 years (official site) · 山芋焼 yam-yaki, 100% yam with no flour, the No. 1 seller for 34 years (official site): with thick scallops and pork belly (2024–2026), ¥1,680 (shop menu on Tabelog), finished with mustard mayonnaise (October 2026) · 美津の焼 Mizuno-yaki, the house mix ¥1,450 on the Tabelog menu, ¥1,650 in September 2026; the site's mix has six fillings: pork, squid, shrimp, scallop, octopus (oysters in winter) and the house minced meat, which the previous owner added · 洋食焼 yoshoku-yaki, the thin pre-okonomiyaki pancake of early Showa, on a chewy batter handed down from the grandparents (official site) · modern-yaki with soba or udon on any okonomiyaki · 道頓焼 with diced yam, minced meat and a soft half-cooked egg, made in thanks to 安井道頓 (official site) · 道頓そば Doton soba of thick noodles and rich sauce with a fried egg, ¥1,300 (September 2026) · negiyaki · white soup ¥100 (December 2024) · draft beer, local sake, shochu, sudachi liqueur, hiyashi-ame, ramune
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Dotonbori, the 70-year-old home of yam-yaki] A few steps into the arcade from Dotonbori, a little okonomiyaki shop that has stayed on this spot for more than 70 years and always has a queue. The draw is yam-yaki: no flour at all, just grated yam with cabbage, scallops and pork, cooked by the staff at your table into something fluffy and almost creamy, and the shop's best seller for 34 years. The house mix, Mizuno-yaki, carries pork, squid, shrimp, scallops, octopus and the minced meat a previous owner added, and the old-style yoshoku-yaki keeps the grandparents' chewy batter. The shop buys from Kuromon Market and named suppliers, from tenkasu and salt to rice. Expect about half an hour in line at dinner; order while you wait. Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100 five times from 2018 to 2025. Open daily 11:00–22:00.

roles: Owner (unnamed); the family has run the shop for generations: the batter is "handed down from the grandparents" and the previous owner (先代) devised the minced meat (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a small okonomiyaki shop "with no name" that has lasted more than 70 years on this spot, just inside the arcade from Dotonbori; rooted in yoshoku-yaki; the previous owner, an "ideas man", added minced meat, rare in Osaka; the yam-yaki made of 100% yam without flour debuted 34 years ago and is the No. 1 item; ingredients from Kuromon Market, and tenkasu, salt, ichimi, ponzu and rice from named shops; fish from the fishmonger, meat from the butcher, pickles and konnyaku from specialist shops, delivered by bicycle each day. The Thursday closing ended in February 2026. Reviewers call it the birthplace of yam-yaki (September 2026). Tabelog Okonomiyaki 100 in 2018, 2019, 2022, 2024 and 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: A shop people never tire of, like the whorl of the の in its name; the best from each specialist supplier, which only a small shop can do (official site).

anecdotes.text: "Made with 100% yam, this was truly amazing. … It was fluffy, light, and had a slight crispness on the cooked edges." — September 2026, with a daughter before heading back to Nagoya.

"The staff cooked everything for us, which was a relief, and [the staff] were very kind. [The staff] even provided a large pitcher of water" — September 2026, Mizuno-yaki ¥1,650 and Doton soba ¥1,300.
"There was quite a line, mostly with foreign visitors." — October 2026, dinner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (mizuno-osaka.com): 本場大阪、道頓堀お好み焼の老舗「美津の」、2026年2月より木曜日の定休日は無くなり通常営業、道頓堀からアーケードに入ってすぐ、名も無い小さなお好み焼屋がこの地で70年以上、洋食焼から山芋焼まで、大阪の台所黒門市場から仕入れる特選素材、天かす、塩、一味、ポン酢、米も顔の見えるお店から、日本全国、海外からのお客さま、11時〜22時 (L.O.21時)、無休。こだわり: 「の」の字のうず巻き、洋食焼をルーツに持ち、アイディアマンの先代の発案でミンチを入れる、魚は魚屋、肉は肉屋、漬物は漬物屋、こんにゃくはこんにゃく屋、自転車で配達。お品書き: 豚、いか、えび、貝柱、たこ (冬季かき) と特製ミンチの6種類の具のミックス、祖父母から受け継いだ「もちもち生地」の洋食焼、デビューして34年、粉を使わず山芋100％の山芋焼は不動の人気ナンバー1、モダン焼、安井道頓さんへの感謝を形にした道頓焼、粉モン協会プロデュースのめんとソースの道頓そば、2名様からのコース、税込み。食べログ: お好み焼き 百名店 2018・2019・2022・2024・2025、予約不可、カードは3,000円から、38席 (カウンター12)、禁煙。口コミ(2024年12月〜2026年10月): いつも行列で約30分、待つ間に注文、山芋焼にホタテと豚バラ、からしマヨネーズ、美津の焼1,650円、道頓そば1,300円、店の人が焼いてくれる、海外からの客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff cook at the table; many overseas visitors in the queue (October 2026); the official site has English pages.

places.cuisine: Sukiyaki and shabu-shabu of kuroge wagyu from a butcher founded in 1919 (official site; prices include tax and service, as listed on the shop page read 1 November 2026, the day a partial price rise took effect) · sukiyaki courses named 雪 ¥9,900, 月 ¥12,100, 花 ¥14,300, 星 ¥16,500, special ¥19,800, each a different cut (October 2026: one diner ordered Yuki, Hana and Hoshi to compare) · shabu-shabu courses 銀杏 ¥9,900, 紅葉 ¥12,100, 水仙 ¥14,300, 桔梗 ¥16,500, special ¥19,800 · kaiseki from ¥12,100 and butter-yaki from ¥13,200, both to be booked · lunch: sukiyaki or shabu-shabu ¥7,150, mini kaiseki ¥9,900 (booked) · a monthly course at lunch (October 2026) · sukiyaki is started by the staff, with the sauce from the beginning rather than meat grilled first, then left to you; vegetables are mitsuba, green onion, shirataki, grilled tofu and shiitake; rice refills (2026 reviews) · sandwiches at the first-floor butcher (October 2026); beef miso-zuke by mail order (official site)
places.notes: [Sukiyaki · Dotonbori, a 1919 wagyu house at the entrance to Dotonbori] Behind the noren of an old building at the entrance to Dotonbori (as the official site puts it), a sukiyaki and shabu-shabu restaurant of a wagyu butcher. 藤本喜蔵 opened the first shop in Sakai in 1919, moved to Shinsekai with sukiyaki and a meat counter, and came to Dotonbori in 1948, when the street was full of theatres and the stars of the film era were regulars (official site). Up the old staircase are tatami and table rooms with flowers, worn tatami and long-serving staff; a server starts your sukiyaki with the sauce in from the beginning, then hands over, and the meat is dipped in egg. Courses go by cut, from 雪 (¥9,900) to 星 (¥16,500) and a special at ¥19,800, all tax and service included; lunch from ¥7,150. Tabelog Hot Pot 100 in 2024 and 2026. Book ahead; closed Tuesdays except holidays and December. Harijyu Grill, a curry shop and the butcher share the building (official site).

roles: Company: 播重 (はり重), founded by its first president 藤本喜蔵 (official site)
"The owner" prepared the first dishes at the table (October 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the official history: 藤本喜蔵 opened a small shop in Sakai in 1919 (Taisho 8); a few years later opened a sukiyaki restaurant and butcher in the middle of Shinsekai; in 1948 moved to Dotonbori and added yoshoku. Dotonbori then was full of playhouses and theatres, and stylish gentlemen and ladies, women of the hanamachi, actors, comedians, writers, foreigners and the film stars and singers of the day came for celebration meals. A second shop, Daihoji (in what is now Amerikamura), opened in 1970 and closed on 30 December 2023. Department-store meat counters followed from 1966, with eat-in corners from 2005. The company calls itself a kuroge wagyu specialist. Tabelog Hot Pot 100 in 2024 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: The best kuroge wagyu, hospitality like a high-class ryokan, and creating food culture around Dotonbori (official site).

anecdotes.text: "The historical staircase, the seasoned waitstaff, and the slightly worn tatami mats—all of it brings back memories." — September 2026, a first sukiyaki at the main restaurant in 20 years.
"I ordered one serving each of 'Yuki,' 'Hana,' and 'Hoshi.' … Since I was there, I decided to order all three types to compare." — October 2026.
"The restaurant seemed to be constantly busy with many inbound foreign customers, which might have contributed to the somewhat careless service." — September 2026, a first visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (harijyu.co.jp): 大正八年に初代社長藤本喜蔵が開業した黒毛和牛専門店、創業百年、1919年大阪府堺市で小さな店、数年後に新世界にすき焼き屋兼精肉販売の店、1948年に道頓堀に移り洋食も、芝居好きの食道楽が集う地、映画全盛の大スターや有名歌手、1970年に大宝寺店 (2023年12月30日閉店)、1966年から百貨店に精肉店、高級旅館のような店内とサービス。道頓堀本店 日本料理: 昼の部11:30〜15:30 (L.O.14:30)、夜の部17:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:00)、火曜日休み (祝日、12月は営業)、2名様から予約、すき焼き 雪9,900円・月12,100円・花14,300円・星16,500円・特撰コース19,800円、しゃぶしゃぶ 銀杏・紅葉・水仙・桔梗・特撰コース (同価格)、会席12,100円〜、バター焼き13,200円〜、昼のすき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ7,150円、ミニ会席9,900円、価格は消費税・サービス料込み。お知らせ: 2026年11月1日より和牛の価格高騰ですき焼き、しゃぶしゃぶ含むメニューの一部を価格改定、12月は営業時間とラストオーダーを1時間延長。食べログ (店舗会員): 鍋 百名店 2024・2026、200席、個室、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)、カード・PayPay可。口コミ(2026年9月〜11月): 昔ながらの階段、年季の入った畳、ベテランの仲居さん、最初は店の人が焼き、割下を最初から入れる、溶き卵、外国語のメニュー、海外からの客も多い、白いご飯のおかわり。

places.name: 鮨 うら紀 (Sushi Uraki)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: every course mixes sushi with wheat-battered tempura, fried in sunflower and cottonseed oil (September 2026), including shrimp tempura sushi; sushi is also usually finished with soy sauce, which normally contains wheat.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase of sushi, seafood and tempura.
places.hours_raw: Daily: lunch 12:00–14:30, all guests starting at 12:00; dinner 18:00–23:00, starting at 18:00, 19:00, 20:00 or 20:30 (last entry 20:30; last food order 20:30) (Tabelog). Closing days not fixed, often Monday and Thursday (Tabelog). Reservation only; the shop recommends booking through OMAKASE, a multilingual site; parties of five or more call the shop; tell the shop in advance about guests who cannot eat raw food (Tabelog). Cancellation: 50% from midnight the day before, 100% on the day; a booking is cancelled if you are 30 minutes late without contact (Tabelog). Service charge 3% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 12 seats and a private room for 4; non-smoking; wheelchair access; children welcome, with a kids menu; sommelier; no strong perfume or scented products; message cakes on two days' notice (Tabelog). Opened 21 March 2025 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Sushi kaiseki: sushi and tempura in one omakase, from a sushi chef and a tempura chef at a counter of 150-year-old hinoki (Tabelog) · lunch omakase ¥22,000 at 12:00; dinner omakase ¥33,000 at 18:00 or 19:00; plus 3% service (Tabelog, tax included) · red-vinegar rice blended from three vinegars including a three-year aged one (October 2026) · Boston tuna (208 kg) aged two weeks, marinated akami and otoro; squid scored about 200 times; Miyazu mackerel with ponzu jelly; Hokkaido purple sea urchin; simmered Tsushima anago; a small bowl of hairy crab and ikura; sweet-shrimp tempura with sushi rice and nori (September–October 2026) · tempura of seasonal vegetables and fish: hamo from Awaji with ume, okra, ginkgo, maitake, abalone simmered then fried, kisu (September–October 2026) · goya gari (August 2026) · wine and sake chosen by a sommelier, e.g. Ubushuna, Kokuryu, Kame no O (September–October 2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Umekita, sushi and tempura in Grand Green Osaka] The second restaurant of Hiroki Anguro, the sushi chef behind Sushi urag on the grounds of Enkakuji temple in Fukushima (September 2026 review), on the ground floor of Grand Green Osaka's south building. Two chefs work one counter of 150-year-old hinoki, one on sushi and one on tempura, so the omakase moves between nigiri on red-vinegar rice (two-week aged Boston tuna, squid scored some 200 times) and tempura fried in sunflower and cottonseed oil, with a hairy-crab and ikura bowl along the way. Lunch is ¥22,000 and dinner ¥33,000, plus 3%; a sommelier pours wine and rare sake. Diners mention attentive service (staff open the door and pull out chairs), a warm head chef, and walls signed by Hollywood stars (October 2026). In September 2026 the tempura chef and the sommelier changed. A staff member told one October 2026 diner that about 30% of guests come from overseas.

roles: Sushi chef, formerly head chef at luxury hotels (Tabelog)
Founder of Sushi urag, Fukushima (September 2026 review)
Tempura chef (unnamed; changed by September 2026, per a review)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): "Standing at a counter made from 150-year-old hinoki wood is Hiroki Anguro, a former head chef at luxury hotels"; a "Sushi Kaiseki" of sushi and tempura, with ageing techniques; selected in 2026 for the "Japan Brand Collection: 100 Selected Renowned Japanese Restaurants". A September 2026 review: "Sushi Uraki, the second branch of the popular restaurant 'Sushi urag' founded by sushi chef Hiroki Anguro within the grounds of Enkakuji Temple in Fukushima". Another September 2026 review notes a change of sommelier and tempura chef, the tempura "the same or even higher quality". Opened 21 March 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Dishes that are genuinely delicious rather than just visually impressive (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi and tempura omakase; aged tuna.

anecdotes.text: "The tuna was sourced from Boston, USA, weighing 208 kg. The 'Marinated Akami' had a rich umami flavor after being aged for two weeks." — September 2026, the ¥33,000 dinner.
"The rice was made with red vinegar, blended from three types, including a three-year aged red vinegar." — October 2026.
"Even though I'm not a fan of goya (bitter melon), the goya gari was so tasty that I ended up eating it all." — August 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Booking through OMAKASE, a multilingual site (Tabelog); about 30% of guests from overseas, per staff (October 2026). No English menu listed.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Tabelog: "If you have guests who cannot eat raw food, please inform us in advance before your visit."

places.name: BELLA BOCCA 阪急梅田店 (Bella Bocca Umeda)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The shop makes fresh pasta from 100% domestic wheat (Tabelog); pizzas (including a pie-crust pizza), bread with the lunch sets, and fried plates (shrimp tempura, cutlet, Camembert fries) are on the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog shows a vegetarian-options flag, and organic vegetables from the shop's own farm run through the menu (bagna cauda, vegetable cheese fondue, vegetable pie pizza), but most come with cheese, egg or meat; no vegan dish is described.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–23:00 (Tabelog). A queue forms before the lunch opening; reserved guests go in first (October and November 2026). No service or cover charge; bring-your-own drinks allowed; no split bills (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 45 seats in a basement; private hire 20–45 with projector and microphones; non-smoking, smoking outside the entrance; children welcome; takeout (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: A basement down a flight of stairs near Hankyu Umeda — 2 min from Hankyu or Midosuji Line Umeda Stn, 3 min from JR Osaka Stn
places.cuisine: Italian built on organic vegetables from the shop's own farm and growers across Japan; fresh pasta from 100% domestic wheat; wine chosen by a sommelier, also in the all-you-can-drink menu; tiramisu (Tabelog) · lunch: a one-plate lunch with cheese fondue or with an appetizer platter, and four set meals (November 2026); appetizer lunch ¥1,950 with a drink, then a plate of fries, shrimp tempura, cutlet and hamburg steak (October 2026); young chicken with lemon sauce, pumpkin gratin (October 2026) · organic vegetable cheese fondue, a rustic vegetable pie pizza, sweet potato and apple potato salad, beet potato salad, moringa sours (October 2026) · year-end courses with all-you-can-drink: A ¥5,000 (10 dishes), B ¥6,000 (11), C ¥7,000 (13), ¥500 off when booked by 20 November; bagna cauda, Chikara potatoes from Toyokawa Farm, Camembert fries, margherita pie pizza, chicken confit, skirt steak, Iberico pork, penne arrabbiata (Tabelog, tax included)
places.notes: [Italian · Umeda, a basement trattoria with its own farm] A lively basement Italian a couple of minutes from Hankyu Umeda, run by a company that grows its own organic vegetables. Lunch is the draw, with a queue before opening: a one-plate lunch built on cheese fondue or an overflowing platter of vegetable appetizers (beet potato salad among them), with bread and a drink, from about ¥1,950. Evenings bring vegetable cheese fondue, pie-crust pizzas, fresh pasta from Japanese wheat and wines picked by a sommelier, and all-you-can-drink party courses from ¥5,000. Diners praise attentive staff, one of whom saw a guest off up the stairs (October 2026); another found the room noisy with lunch crowds. You can bring your own drinks; no split bills.

chef_bio.origin: Run with three related shops: BELLA BOCCA Namba, BELLA PORTO and Tatsuya Hankyu Umeda (Tabelog remarks); the website is on kimiyu.co.jp.
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): organic vegetables from the shop's own farm and across the country; fresh pasta of 100% domestic wheat; sommelier-selected wines; "our Italian chef prepares them with care"; an authentic-recipe tiramisu; an online shop for a European-style cheesecake and a shabu-shabu set.
chef_bio.philosophy: Vegetables from its own farm, cooked Italian (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Organic vegetable cheese fondue; appetizer-platter lunch.

anecdotes.text: "The staff provided very attentive service" and saw the diner off all the way up the stairs — October 2026, the ¥1,950 appetizer lunch.

"A variety of vegetables, including beets and butternut squash, were plentiful! The sweetness of the vegetables paired perfectly with the cheese sauce" — October 2026, the organic vegetable cheese fondue.
"I was surprised to see a long line before opening time, but once inside, I realized the secret to its popularity is the staff's attentiveness." — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Lunch sets and à la carte; book to skip the queue (2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: イタリアン食べ放題 CHEESE MEAT GARDEN 梅田店 (Italian All you can eat CHEESE MEAT GARDEN Umeda ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The buffet centres on pizza (including Chicago pizza), pasta, fried pasta, fried chicken, fries and fried baguette (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: an all-you-can-eat of meat and cheese dishes. Tabelog shows a vegetarian-options flag; bagna cauda appears on the à la carte menu (October 2026).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 16:00–24:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–24:00; last order 23:00; closing days not fixed, closed 1 January (Tabelog). Weekend and holiday lunch buffets 11:00–17:30 (Tabelog). Time limit about 2 hours; a late start may shorten it (Tabelog). Every all-you-can-eat guest adds a drink plan, two drinks or all-you-can-drink, the same for the whole table (Tabelog; August 2026). Orders by smartphone QR code (August and October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, iD, QUICPay, PayPay (Tabelog). 64 seats with night-view window seats and private rooms behind hidden doors; whole-floor hire; non-smoking with a smoking area (Tabelog). Children: the listing says no children allowed, but its course pages give children's prices (3 and under free, 4 to elementary school half price). Opened 30 May 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 8F of 梅田エビスビル, near Higashi-Umeda — 4 min from JR Osaka Stn, Umeda Stn or Higashi-Umeda Stn
places.cuisine: All-you-can-eat cheese and meat Italian (Tabelog) · weekend and holiday lunch buffets: premium 76 dishes with black-wagyu steak and roast-beef bowl ¥2,880 (listed from ¥3,880), standard 59 dishes ¥2,480 (listed from ¥3,480); the hot teppan cheese and steak course, 91 dishes, ¥3,980 (listed from ¥4,980) (Tabelog, tax included) · dishes named in 2026 reviews: Chicago pizza used as a cheese-fondue bowl; domestic wagyu "avalanche cheese"; Parmigiano yukke; teppan chicken with tomato and cheese; carbonara; a cheese "flood" over vegetables and fries; honey cheese balls; roast beef under melted cheese; fried pasta; kara-age and fries to start; prosciutto and salami; a cheese platter with dried fruit · small portions so a table can try many dishes · a birthday cake on request (July 2026)
places.notes: [Italian buffet · Umeda, all-you-can-eat cheese and meat] An eighth-floor all-you-can-eat Italian near Higashi-Umeda, popular with young groups, where cheese is poured over steak, roast beef and vegetables at the table and a Chicago pizza doubles as a cheese-fondue bowl. Courses run ¥2,480–3,980 for 59 to 91 small-plate dishes ordered by smartphone, plus a compulsory drink plan chosen for the whole table; weekend lunch buffets start at 11:00. Window seats look over the night lights (one July diner, arriving before dark, saw a pachinko sign), and private rooms hide behind secret doors. Diners praise quick service and value; others note a cramped room, the oily fried baguette, a drink system nobody explained, and being seated for a different course than booked (October 2026). Open to midnight.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): all-you-can-eat Italian in a stylish setting with sofa seats, night-view tables and private rooms behind hidden doors; rare steak cuts and sizzling cheese dishes "right before your eyes". Opened 30 May 2019.
chef_bio.specialty: Cheese poured over steak and vegetables on a hot teppan; Chicago pizza.

anecdotes.text: "The pizza crust serves as a vessel for a cheese fondue style." — October 2026, the 91-dish course ¥3,980.
"Everyone must choose the same drink menu, which can be a bit tricky if someone in your group doesn't drink alcohol." — August 2026, a weekend lunch.
"There were no limits on orders, and the staff never showed any displeasure no matter how much we requested." — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Smartphone QR ordering; a drink plan is required with the buffet (2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: 日本酒と料理 くろ川 (Japan Shu to Ryori Kurokawa)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. The course includes Saikyo-yaki, a soy-dressed shirako dish (February 2026), sashimi and charcoal-grilled wagyu or chicken, usually seasoned with soy sauce or miso that can contain wheat.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a course of fish, seafood, wagyu and dashi-based dishes, with homemade sake ice cream.
places.hours_raw: Official site: 18:00–2:00 (last order 1:30); Sunday 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:30). Tabelog: Mon–Fri 18:00–3:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 18:00–24:00. Closing days not fixed; check Instagram (both). À la carte late-night service from 21:00 (Tabelog). Courses by reservation only, limited to eight course guests a day (official site; Tabelog). Service charge 5% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners; UnionPay per the official site); Tabelog says no QR, the official site lists d Barai. 12 seats at a U-shaped counter with a night view over Kitashinchi; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; no strong perfume; paid parking in front (Tabelog). The shop is run by one person, so book or phone ahead (Tabelog). Opened 10 December 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kitashinchi, ミヤプラザ 8F, with a night view — 2 min from JR Kitashinchi Stn
places.cuisine: Seasonal Japanese cooking to go with sake: over 100 sakes from across Japan, from ¥600 a glass (official site) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): Kurokawa Main Course ¥12,000 (10 dishes), Premium ¥15,500, Special Omakase ¥22,000; the official ¥12,000 course runs appetizer, sashimi, sake snacks, soup, grilled dish, a small dish, vinegared dish, charcoal-grilled black wagyu, clay-pot rice and miso soup, homemade sake ice cream · rice bought as brown rice from Hokkaido, polished in Osaka and cooked in a clay pot; natural water known as sake-brewing water used for stock and rice (official site) · a December 2025 course: low-temperature sawara with burdock purée, crab chawanmushi, bluefin, kanpachi and Ishigaki sea bream, winter-yellowtail Saikyo-yaki, charcoal-grilled chicken, clay-pot rice, sake ice cream · February 2026: shirako with rapeseed flowers and strawberries in yuzu soy, tuna sushi, clam soup, yellowtail, sea bream and striped-jack sashimi · late-night à la carte from 21:00 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Japanese · Kitashinchi, a sake counter with a night view] A one-person Japanese restaurant on the eighth floor of a Kitashinchi building, with a U-shaped counter facing the night lights and over a hundred sakes, poured from ¥600 a glass and matched to each dish. The owner, a cook who has worked only in Japanese cuisine (official site), serves a seasonal course from ¥12,000 to just eight course guests a day: sashimi, a seasonal soup, Saikyo-yaki, charcoal-grilled wagyu, and rice from Hokkaido polished in Osaka and cooked in a clay pot, ending with homemade sake ice cream. After 21:00 the counter opens for à la carte and drinks until late. Diners describe a friendly owner, and in December 2025 guests chatted easily across the counter; one found the course too slow to finish before a second booking (December 2025). A sake evening with the Ichinokura brewery was held in January 2026.

roles: Owner (店主, unnamed), who runs the shop alone (official site; Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Official site (read 2026-11-01): "これまで和食一筋で歩んできましたが、常に心にあるのは、「美味しいものを、もっと美味しく食べてもらいたい」という思いです" — the owner has worked only in Japanese cuisine and wants good food eaten at its best; chose Kitashinchi for a relaxed place despite the district's formal image. Tabelog: "We operate with a single staff member." Opened 10 December 2024. Reviews: a friendly owner (December 2025; February 2026); a sake event with the Ichinokura brewery of Miyagi (January 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "美味しいものを、もっと美味しく食べてもらいたい" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal course matched with 100+ sakes; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "I made a vague request, and they brought out many recommended sakes." — December 2025.
"From my seat at the counter, I had a great view of the cars passing by on Route 2." — February 2026.

"The course took quite a long time, and since I had a reservation at another place, I couldn't finish everything, which was disappointing. However, the friendly owner made the experience enjoyable." — December 2025, a first visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 日本酒と料理 くろ川、大阪市北区曾根崎新地1-10-22 ミヤプラザ 8F、北新地駅から徒歩2分、18:00〜翌2:00 (L.O.翌1:30)、日曜18:00〜24:00、不定休 (Instagram で確認)、日本酒は常時100種類以上、1杯600円 (税込) から、北海道から玄米で仕入れて大阪で精米し釜炊きするご飯、清酒の仕込み水として知られる自然水を使う、12,000円の10品のコース (先付け、お造り、酒肴、椀物、焼き物、一品、酢の物、黒毛和牛の炭火焼、土鍋の白ご飯と味噌汁、自家製の日本酒アイス)、1日8名様限定のコース予約制、夜景が見える和モダンの店、店主は和食一筋、WEB予約で店主のおすすめの日本酒をおちょこ1杯、カード可、QR は d払い。食べログ (店舗会員): 月〜金18:00〜3:00、土日祝18:00〜24:00、21時からアラカルトの深夜営業、コース12,000円・15,500円・22,000円、サービス料5%、U字のカウンター12席、ひとりで営業、2024年12月10日オープン。

cultural_comfort.note: Course by reservation, sake recommended by the owner; a counter where guests chat (2025–2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: 皇蘭 アルデ新大阪店 (Koran Arude shin osaka ten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a noodle and dim-sum house; the chuka soba, paitan and dandan noodles are wheat noodles, and the buns and xiaolongbao are wheat dough.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the chuka soba is a soy-sauce chicken broth with fatty chashu, the paitan a chicken broth, and the pork bun uses Kagoshima black pork.
places.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–22:30; hours and closing days may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 20 seats at tables and a counter; non-smoking (Tabelog). Renovated by February 2024 so solo diners sit comfortably (a February 2024 review). A line of three at 12:30 moved fast (April 2026).
places.neighborhood: 西中島5-16-1, in the Arde Shin-Osaka shopping area of Shin-Osaka Station, near the Midosuji Line entrance (Tabelog; October 2026); reached on foot through the underground passage from the east exit (February 2024)
places.cuisine: Kobe Motomachi chuka soba and Chinese dishes (February 2024) · Koran chuka soba with flavoured egg ¥1,080, large noodles +¥150 (October 2026): soy-sauce chicken broth, straight noodles, fatty chashu (2026) · chicken paitan ramen, creamy, with medium-thin noodles, two large slices of chashu and bean sprouts (April and October 2026) · Sichuan dandan noodles ¥1,230 (September 2026) · tomato and basil ramen (October 2026) · pork bun ¥330, with a poster naming Awaji onions and Kagoshima black pork (September 2026) · xiaolongbao (sold out on an October 2026 visit) · fried rice, half fried rice (2026) · Tianjin rice with shrimp and a sweet sauce (November 2026) · Shaoxing wine ¥600 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Chinese · Shin-Osaka Station, Kobe chuka soba by the Midosuji gates] The Shin-Osaka Station counter of Koran, a Kobe Chinese house dating from 1959 with its main shop in Nankinmachi (official site), tucked into the Arde Shin-Osaka shops by the Midosuji Line entrance and open 10:00 to 22:30 every day. Business travellers waiting for a Shinkansen come for the Koran chuka soba, a soy-sauce chicken broth with straight noodles and soft, fatty chashu, "the famous Kobe Motomachi Ramen" to one returning diner (February 2024), or the creamier chicken paitan. There are dandan noodles, a tomato-and-basil ramen, pork buns of Kagoshima black pork and Awaji onion, xiaolongbao that can sell out, and fluffy fried rice. Opinions run from "the quintessential chuka soba" to "just average" (October 2026). The line moves quickly.

roles: Kitchen and counter staff of 株式会社皇蘭 (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (kouran.com, read 2026-11-01): 株式会社皇蘭, based in Nada-ku, Kobe, with its own factory, "SINCE 1959", a main shop in Nankinmachi and other brands (山神山人, いずみヌードル). A February 2024 diner calls the bowl "the famous Kobe Motomachi Ramen".
chef_bio.philosophy: The official site speaks of "受け継いできた味と、素材へのこだわり" (a taste handed down and care over ingredients).
chef_bio.specialty: Koran chuka soba; chicken paitan ramen; pork buns.

anecdotes.text: "The fatty chashu was tender and packed with flavor. The soy-based chicken broth was just as delicious as ever." — October 2026, chuka soba as an after-party.

"I had lunch during a business trip while waiting for my Shinkansen, and even though it was already 12:30 and there was a line with three people ahead of me, the turnover was quick." — April 2026, the chicken paitan ramen.
"This is the ultimate Chinese Soba!" — October 2026, the Koran chuka soba with flavoured egg for JPY 1,080.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 皇蘭 アルデ新大阪店、飲茶・点心・ラーメン・dumpling、大阪市淀川区西中島5丁目16-1、新大阪駅、毎日10:00〜22:30、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、20席 (テーブルとカウンター)、禁煙。公式サイト: 株式会社皇蘭、神戸市灘区、工場あり、SINCE 1959、南京町本店、山神山人、いずみヌードル、受け継いできた味と素材へのこだわり。口コミ(2024年2月〜2026年11月): Midosuji 線の入口の近く、東口から地下を通って、改装でひとりでも入りやすく、Kobe Motomachi のラーメン、皇蘭の中華そば (味玉) 1,080円、麺大盛り150円、醤油の鶏ガラスープ、ストレート麺、脂身のチャーシュー、クリーミーな鶏白湯ラーメン、担々麺1,230円、トマトとバジルのラーメン、豚まん330円 (Awaji の玉ねぎと Kagoshima の黒豚)、小籠包は売り切れの日も、チャーハン、えび入りの天津飯、紹興酒600円、新幹線の前の出張の人が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: A busy station counter with a quick turnover; no English menu listed and no English evidence found.

places.name: トントン拍子 (Tonton Byoshi)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki and yakisoba are wheat-based, and the lunch sets include breaded pork cutlet, kara-age and pasta.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the one lunch set is built on pork, chicken or eggs (2024–2026), and the okonomiyaki named in reviews is pork.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–22:30; closed Sat and Sun; hours and closing days may change (Tabelog). No reservations listed (Tabelog), though the tables were all reserved on a Friday night (October 2026). No cards; e-money accepted; no QR payment (Tabelog). 20 seats; designated smoking area (Tabelog). At lunch only the daily set is served, plus a yakisoba lunch that takes about 15 minutes (August 2026); tables are shared at busy times (April 2025, April 2026).
places.neighborhood: 西宮原1-5-6 — about 560 m from Shin-Osaka Stn (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Okonomiyaki and teppan dishes at night: fluffy okonomiyaki with plenty of sauce (January 2025), pork okonomiyaki and egg fried rice (October 2026) · lunch: one daily set ¥950 tax included (April 2026; ¥900 from April 2025, ¥800 before), with salad, rice, miso soup, two small side dishes and yogurt; a yakisoba lunch ¥1,000 (August 2026) · daily mains named in reviews: pork belly, teriyaki hamburg steak with a fried egg (January 2024), roast pork cutlet with a soft fried egg (April 2025, July 2026), tonpei-yaki (July 2025), kara-age (September 2025), white-sauce omurice (April and September 2026), Tianjin rice with a mushroom and burdock sauce (August 2026) · side dishes such as potato salad, kinpira, pumpkin salad, cold tofu with ume, mini pasta (2024–2026)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Nishimiyahara, a lunch-set favourite by Shin-Osaka] A long-standing local okonomiyaki house a few minutes from Shin-Osaka Station that office workers know for its lunch: one daily set for ¥950 (April 2026), served almost the moment you sit, with a handmade main on a hot plate (pork cutlet under a soft fried egg, white-sauce omurice, tonpei-yaki), salad, rice, miso soup, two side dishes and a yogurt. One diner has eaten it more than twenty times (July 2025). In April 2025 a few older women ran lunch, and the place felt like a cozy café at 13:30 (January 2026). At night it turns back into an okonomiyaki and teppan house with fluffy, sauce-heavy okonomiyaki and drinks; the tables were all booked by 18:00 on a Friday (October 2026). Closed weekends.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Reviewers call it a long-established okonomiyaki restaurant (January 2025) and "a popular local okonomiyaki restaurant in Shin-Osaka" (April 2026); "During lunchtime, it is run by a few lovely older ladies" (April 2025); "the owner asked if I was ready for lunch" (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Daily lunch set on a hot plate; okonomiyaki at night.

anecdotes.text: "Before I even sat down, the owner asked if I was ready for lunch. I ordered immediately, and within moments … the daily special set meal arrived." — July 2026, pork cutlet with a fried egg for JPY 950.
"The great thing about Tonton Byoshi is that not only is the portion size substantial, but everything is also delicious." — July 2025, a diner on visit 23, the tonpei-yaki set.
"Every dish was delicious, especially the pork okonomiyaki and the fried rice with egg—I definitely want to have those again." — October 2026, a Friday night.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: トントン拍子、お好み焼き、大阪市淀川区西宮原1-5-6、新大阪駅から559m、月〜金11:30〜14:00、18:00〜22:30、土日休み、予約不可、カード不可、電子マネー可、QR 不可、20席、分煙。口コミ(2024年1月〜2026年10月): 昔からのお好み焼きの店、昼は日替わり定食だけで950円 (2026年4月から、2025年4月から900円、その前は800円)、サラダ、ごはん、みそ汁、小鉢2つ、ヨーグルトつき、焼きそばのランチ1,000円 (約15分)、豚バラ、照り焼きハンバーグ、ローストポークカツに半熟の目玉焼き、とん平焼き、kara-age、白いソースのオムライス、天津飯、昼は年配の女性たちが切り盛り、相席も、夜はふわふわのお好み焼き、豚玉、卵チャーハン、金曜の夜はテーブルが予約でいっぱい。

cultural_comfort.note: One daily lunch set, no choosing needed; shared tables at lunch. No English evidence found.

places.name: 西中島 光龍益 (Nishinakajima Koryumasu)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen and tsukemen noodles.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a pork-skin and chicken-bone broth with pork chashu.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat, holidays and the days before and after a holiday 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:50) and 18:00–21:00 (last order 20:50); closed Sunday; open until sold out (Tabelog). No reservations; cash only (no cards, e-money or QR) (Tabelog); buy a ticket at the machine, cash only, and hand it to the staff, who seat you (September and October 2026). 18 seats: 8 at the counter and two tables; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). A line forms soon after noon: nearly ten waiting just after 12:00 on an October 2026 day. Tsukemen takes longer, about 20 minutes on a full October 2026 lunch.
places.neighborhood: 西中島6-5-2 — 5 min from Hankyu Minamikata Stn and from Shin-Osaka (Midosuji Line) (Tabelog); a front like a kaiseki restaurant, with a noren reading "Tonpi to Tori no Koryumasu" and a "RAMEN" lantern (October 2026)
places.cuisine: White-broth ramen and tsukemen of pork skin and chicken bones (October 2026) · ticket machine: ramen, tsukemen (regular and large), salt-braised pork, rice, egg over rice, canned beer (October 2026) · ramen ¥950 (September and October 2026): potage-thick, creamy broth of pork and chicken, thin firm noodles, two slices of pork-shoulder chashu and one of salt-braised pork, menma, green onion; compared with Tenkaippin by three October 2026 diners · large ramen ¥1,050 (October 2026) · tsukemen ¥1,000 (October 2026): a thick, rich dipping soup, called chicken paitan by one diner, with chashu, green onion, menma and a lemon wedge to squeeze in · garlic on request; GABAN black pepper, shichimi and ramen tare on the table (October 2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima, potage-thick pork-skin and chicken broth] The Nishinakajima branch of "Tonpi to Tori no Koryumasu" from Sakuranomiya, behind a front that looks more like a kaiseki restaurant than a ramen shop, and a Tabelog Ramen 100 pick every year from 2023 to 2025. The broth is pork skin and chicken bones boiled to a creamy, potage-like white, rich enough that three diners in October 2026 thought of Tenkaippin, but several diners found it easy to finish. The ¥950 ramen comes with thin firm noodles, pork-shoulder chashu and a slice of salt-braised pork; the ¥1,000 tsukemen with a lemon wedge to cut the thick dip, though it takes about 20 minutes when the shop is full. Ask for garlic if you have no meetings. Buy a ticket at the cash-only machine. A line forms soon after noon; evenings are calmer. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner (unnamed) with one or two floor staff
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: the branch of "Tonpi to Tori no Koryumasu" in Sakuranomiya, which "has shone in the top 100 for nine consecutive years"; this shop "seems to be run by the owner and two female staff members". A September 2026 diner: "it seemed to be run by a couple who managed everything with care". Tabelog Ramen OSAKA 100: 2023, 2024, 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Pork-skin and chicken white-broth ramen; tsukemen with lemon.

anecdotes.text: "It's smooth and creamy like a potage, with a rich flavor of pork and chicken that follows closely behind." — October 2026, the ramen for JPY 950.
"When I started to get a bit tired of the dipping sauce, squeezing some lemon into it made it refreshing and provided a great flavor change." — October 2026, the tsukemen for JPY 1,000.
"I arrived just after 12 PM and found nearly 10 people already in line." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 西中島 光龍益、ラーメン・つけ麺、食べログ ラーメン OSAKA 百名店 2023・2024・2025、大阪市淀川区西中島6-5-2、阪急 南方駅から徒歩5分、Midosuji 線 新大阪駅から徒歩5分、月〜土・祝・祝前日・祝後日11:30〜14:00 (L.O.13:50)、18:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:50)、日曜休み、売り切れまで、予約不可、現金のみ、18席 (カウンター8、テーブル)、禁煙、子ども可。口コミ(2025年11月〜2026年10月): Sakuranomiya の「Tonpi to Tori no Koryumasu」の店、料亭のような外観にのれんと RAMEN のちょうちん、券売機 (現金のみ) でラーメン、つけ麺、塩で煮た豚、ごはん、卵かけごはん、缶ビール、ラーメン950円、大盛り1,050円、つけ麺1,000円、ポタージュのようにとろりとした豚と鶏の白いスープ、細いかための麺、肩ロースのチャーシュー2枚と塩で煮た豚、メンマ、ねぎ、Tenkaippin を思い出すという声が3人、つけ麺はレモンつきで約20分、にんにくも頼める、昼すぎは行列、店主と女性スタッフ2人、夫婦で切り盛りという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine (cash only) with a short list: ramen, tsukemen, rice, beer. No English evidence found.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen noodles in every bowl.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone, beef-bone, flying-fish and clam broths with chashu and eggs.
places.hours_raw: Mon 18:30–23:00; Tue–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:30–23:00; closed Sat and Sun; hours and closing days may change (Tabelog). No reservations; no cards, but e-money and QR payments (Tabelog); order and pay first (September 2025). 13 seats on Tabelog (3 at the counter, tables for 2 and 4); reviewers count three tables for four and one for two, with more seats upstairs on the second floor (September 2025, September 2026). Designated smoking area; no smoking at all 11:30–14:00 (Tabelog). Opened 9 December 2013 (Tabelog). Run by one person in June 2024; a woman served upstairs in September 2025.

places.cuisine: Tonkotsu ramen and a cheap daily special · Premium ("exquisite") tonkotsu ¥850 (March and April 2025): thick, back-fat pork-bone soy broth, thin straight or thick noodles, four slices of chashu, egg, wood ear, menma, bean sprouts, green onion, sesame; rice ¥50 at lunch (2025) · tonkotsu shoyu ¥850 with five slices of chashu and an egg, rice ¥100 (February 2026) · daily special ramen ¥650, large +¥100 (2025–2026): pork-bone shoyu (September 2026), yatai tonkotsu shio (December 2025), Hakata tonkotsu, niboshi (August 2025), a sweet beef-bone shoyu with cabbage (September 2025) · ago-dashi (flying fish) ramen with clams ¥800, a light, nearly clear broth (September 2025, July 2026) · Wakayama tonkotsu shoyu ¥800 with a rare chashu and kamaboko (September 2025) · also spicy miso and clam tsukemen (September 2026) · extra noodles ¥100 (December 2025) · draft beer, an oolong highball (2024)
places.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima, cheap tonkotsu and a daily bowl] A small ramen shop on a side street between Shin-Osaka and Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open since 2013, that repeat diners come back to for value: the daily special ramen is ¥650 (2025–2026), a different broth each time (pork-bone shoyu, yatai tonkotsu shio, Hakata tonkotsu, niboshi, beef-bone shoyu), and the house Premium tonkotsu, thick with back fat and topped with four slices of chashu and an egg, was ¥850 in 2025. There is a lighter ago-dashi bowl with clams and a Wakayama-style tonkotsu shoyu too, both ¥800 (2025). Portions are big and toppings generous. Weekday lunches fill the ground floor, and a second floor takes the overflow (September 2025). The owner was running it alone in June 2024 and is kind, per a March 2025 diner. Open till 23:00; closed weekends.

roles: Owner (unnamed), with a floor helper at times
chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 9 December 2013 (Tabelog). Reviewers: "since it's operated by one person, it might get hectic when busy" (June 2024); "the owner is a kind person" and recommends the Premium tonkotsu (March 2025); "a lady brought my order" upstairs (September 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Premium tonkotsu; daily special ramen at ¥650; ago-dashi ramen with clams.

anecdotes.text: "It's loaded with back fat and is quite rich, but surprisingly, it is easy to eat." — June 2024, the exquisite tonkotsu ramen.
"Even on the second floor, I could hear Michael Jackson singing!" — September 2025, the ago-dashi ramen for JPY 800.
"As always, the toppings were plentiful, and at JPY 750, this is quite a good deal." — September 2026, the pork-bone shoyu daily special, large.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: らぁ麺 喜希、ラーメン・つけ麺、大阪市淀川区西中島5-8-7、新大阪駅南口から徒歩5〜6分、西中島南方駅北口から5〜7分、JR 新大阪駅東口と阪急 南方駅から7〜9分、月曜18:30〜23:00、火〜金11:30〜14:00、18:30〜23:00、土日休み、予約不可、カード不可、電子マネー・QR 可、13席、分煙 (11:30〜14:00は全面禁煙)、2013年12月9日オープン。口コミ(2024年5月〜2026年9月): Premium tonkotsu 850円 (背脂、チャーシュー4枚、卵、きくらげ、メンマ、もやし、ねぎ、ごま、細麺か太麺)、昼のごはん50円、とんこつ醤油850円 (チャーシュー5枚)、日替わりラーメン650円、大盛り100円 (豚骨醤油、Yatai とんこつ塩、Hakata とんこつ、煮干し、牛骨の甘い醤油)、ago dashi ラーメンとあさり800円、Wakayama とんこつ醤油800円、辛味噌、あさりのつけ麺、替え玉100円、2階席も、ひとりで切り盛り、やさしい店主、Michael Jackson の音楽。

places.name: すし処 錦 (Sushi Dokoro Nishiki)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sushi and sashimi come with soy sauce, the set courses include tempura and the fugu course a fugu kara-age; plain nigiri or sashimi without soy sauce may be possible, but nothing is stated.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and seafood restaurant; nothing is described as vegan.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00 (counter last order 22:30; tatami rooms 17:30–22:30, last order 22:00); closed Sunday and Monday holidays (official site; Tabelog). Courses and hot pots by reservation, two days ahead; tatami rooms booked two days ahead, for 3 or more; online bookings may be followed by a phone call; a booking is cancelled if you are 20 minutes late without calling, and same-day cancellations are charged (Tabelog). Per Tabelog, reservations for guests from overseas are taken only through a hotel. 5% service charge in the tatami rooms (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Seats: a 12-seat L-shaped counter (official site; Tabelog says 10) and 18–20 tatami seats with sunken tables upstairs, private rooms for 2–20; non-smoking; children only in the tatami rooms; takeout (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Sennichimae 1-7-6, a minute east of Hozenji (Tabelog) — 3 min from Nipponbashi Stn, 6 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Sushi and fish dishes from fish bought each morning at the Osaka central wholesale market (official site) · nigiri per piece, tax included (official site): from ¥550 (kohada, house tamagoyaki, saba, hamachi, ebi, ikura, maguro, kanpachi, ken-ika, hirame, akagai, scallop, tsubugai), from ¥770 (anago, uni, fugu, unagi), from ¥1,980 (toro, abalone, kuruma ebi); thin rolls from ¥2,200, toro rolls ¥4,180 · omakase kaiseki, booked two days ahead: ¥7,535 (three appetizers, sashimi, grilled fish, tempura, chawanmushi, vinegared dish, five nigiri, red miso soup, fruit) and ¥8,800 (with dobin-mushi), from ¥11,000 on request · winter tecchiri courses of live tora-fugu, three-year fish of about 1.8 kg, ¥13,200 and ¥17,200; extra grilled shirako ¥2,750, fugu kara-age ¥3,850, tessa ¥2,530 (official site) · saba bo-zushi with gyuhi kombu, a take-home favourite; rice a blend of old and new Noto Koshihikari (official site) · from reviews: hamo sashimi with plum, salad roll, blue crab, grilled kinki, young ayu tempura (June 2026); simmered sea-bream head, dobin-mushi, grilled eel (June 2026); toro-taku to finish (February 2026) · sake from around Japan, several from Ehime; a house shochu (official site; June 2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Sennichimae, an old-school Minami sushi-ya where you order what you like] A long-established sushi restaurant of some 40 years (a December 2025 diner) on a lively Sennichimae street east of Hozenji, with an L-shaped counter downstairs and tatami rooms above. Fish come from the central wholesale market each morning, and the draw is ordering à la carte from the glass case rather than a fixed, all-start-together course, which diners in 2025–2026 say is now rare: sashimi, grilled kinki, simmered sea-bream head, dobin-mushi, then nigiri from ¥550 a piece. Winter brings live tora-fugu tecchiri courses (¥13,200 and up), and the saba bo-zushi with gyuhi kombu is the house souvenir. A regular of more than 30 years praises the head chef's warmth and the talkative owner; one June 2026 diner found the ¥7,535 course ordinary for the price. Many of the floor staff are from abroad and speak good Japanese (June and September 2026). Per Tabelog, overseas visitors can book only through a hotel.

roles: Head chef and owner, both unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: A Minami sushi restaurant of about 40 years (December 2025 review) that a regular has visited for more than 30 years (July 2026). Per the official site, the fish are chosen each morning at the Osaka central wholesale market (the head chef buys at the eastern market for the kaiseki), fugu are three-year fish of about 1.8 kg, and the sushi rice is a house blend of old and new Noto Koshihikari; drinking water and the rice water are 財宝 spring water from Kagoshima. Diners describe a warm, cheerful head chef and a talkative, attentive owner (2025–2026), and floor staff from abroad with excellent Japanese (June and September 2026). One June 2026 diner noted several Ehime sakes and guessed the owner might be from Ehime.
chef_bio.philosophy: "The same topping may not be there tomorrow": each day's best seafood, cooked to bring out its flavour (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte sushi and fish dishes; tora-fugu tecchiri; saba bo-zushi.

anecdotes.text: "In today's world of sushi restaurants that all offer set courses with a simultaneous start, this place stands out as a rare gem where you can enjoy your favorite items while looking at the traditional display case." — September 2026.

"I've been coming here for over 30 years since my first visit… The warm and cheerful character of the head chef, along with the talkative yet attentive owner, creates a wonderful atmosphere." — July 2026.
"When you think of summer in Osaka, you think of hamo (pike eel). The hamo was thick and fluffy, and paired perfectly with plum sauce." — June 2026, on a 41st visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: すし処 錦、毎朝大阪中央卸売市場でその日一番の新鮮な魚を仕入れ、お寿司、一品料理、鍋料理、会席料理、お座敷で鍋宴会 (20名まで)、個室、宴会は前日までに予約、おまかせ宴会コース7,535円 (税込)〜、錦の鍋宴会コース13,200円〜 (河豚は3年物、1.8kg前後)。おしながき (税込): 寿司ネタ1貫550円〜 (こはだ、特製玉子焼き、さば、はまち、えび、いくら、まぐろ、かんぱち、剣いか、ひらめ、赤貝、貝柱、つぶ貝)、770円〜 (穴子、うに、ふぐ、うなぎ)、1,980円〜 (とろ、あわび、車えび)、細巻2,200円〜、とろ鉄火巻・ねぎとろ巻・たくとろ巻4,180円、活とらふぐのてっちりコース13,200円・17,200円 (二日前までの予約)、焼白子2,750円、ふぐ唐揚3,850円、てっさ2,530円、料理長おまかせ会席7,535円・8,800円 (11,000円〜も)、お座敷はサービス料5%、日本酒は久保田 萬寿、呉春、愛媛の吹毛剣、五億年など。こだわり: さば棒寿司は求肥昆布で、シャリは能登産コシヒカリの古米・新米のブレンド、和らぎの水と炊飯に鹿児島・財宝温泉水、当店ブランドの焼酎。店舗案内: カウンター12席、座敷20席 (掘りごたつ、3〜20名)、個室。千日前1丁目7-6、17:00〜23:00 (お座敷は22:00ラストオーダー)、日曜日・月曜日の祝日休み。食べログ (店舗会員): Hozenji から東へ1分、日本橋駅から3分、28席 (カウンター10、座敷18)、20分連絡がなければキャンセル、当日キャンセルは料金、海外からの客の予約はホテル経由のみ、カード可、禁煙、子どもは座敷のみ。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年9月): 創業40年、L字のカウンターと2階の座敷、ネタケースを見て好きなものを、刺身盛り合わせ、ふぐ刺し、白子の醤油焼き、ハマチのカマ、活甘海老、土瓶蒸し、鯛のあら炊き、鰻の蒲焼、toro-taku、鱧と梅、サラダ巻き、渡り蟹、きんきの塩焼き、稚鮎の天ぷら、30年以上通う常連、明るい料理長と話好きの店主、海外から来たスタッフ、7,535円のコースはふつうだったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order à la carte from the fish case at the counter; per Tabelog, overseas guests book through a hotel (2026).

places.name: 月島屋 (Tsukishima Ya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Much of the meat is sauced (a slightly sweet soy-based tare, June 2026), the courses end with ramen, cold noodles or gukbap, and there is chijimi; salt-grilled tongue and other salt cuts may be simpler, but nothing is stated.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant; kimchi, namul, salad and grilled vegetables are sides.
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); lunch on Saturday and Sunday only, 12:00–15:00; open all year except over New Year (official site; Tabelog). Dinner bookings for 2 or more; weekend lunch bookings only at 12:00 for 4 or more; otherwise write your name on the board (people start at 10:00 or half an hour before opening, 2026 reviews). Tabelog lists cards and PayPay; a July 2026 diner says cards are no longer accepted and paid by PayPay. 50 seats: 20 at tables on 1F, 30 on 2F in private tatami rooms with sunken seating for 2–18; smoking only in the private rooms (Tabelog; official site).
places.neighborhood: Sennichimae 2-7-13, Ura Namba — 2 min from Namba Stn exit B25 (Midosuji Line), 4 min from Nipponbashi Stn exit 10
places.cuisine: Yakiniku of A5 black wagyu chosen for flavour whatever the region, at moderate prices through the shop's own buying route (official site) · sets (official menu, read November 2026): Tsukishima set of kalbi, loin and belly ¥4,980; premium set of kalbi, loin and kainomi ¥6,500; limited three-cut platter of special loin, ichibo and Chateaubriand (salt) ¥4,400; tongue trio ¥2,500; horumon tasting of five ¥1,680 · wagyu à la carte: belly ¥1,480, kalbi and loin ¥1,880, harami ¥2,200, ichibo and premium kalbi ¥2,300, fillet ¥3,200, Chateaubriand 130 g ¥5,500; kurashita loin sukiyaki-style with egg ¥2,200; yaki-shabu ¥3,000; Kobe beef loin ¥3,800–6,800 and Kobe beef nigiri ¥1,280; special thick or thin salted tongue ¥2,880, salted tongue ¥1,880 · courses, tax included, booked the day before: Sennichimae ¥5,500, Tsukishima ¥6,800, Takumi ¥9,800, each ending with ramen, cold noodles or gukbap and dessert (official site) · weekend lunch: yakiniku set meal, large ¥1,980 (140–150 g), with rice, soup, kimchi, namul and Korean seaweed; with cold noodles ¥2,380 (2026) · from reviews: black-wagyu tail braised in soy sauce ¥780 (July 2026), yukhoe, tongue sashimi, stone-grilled bibimbap · wine, sake, shochu, cocktails
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Ura Namba, A5 wagyu at fair prices and a weekend lunch worth the queue] A two-floor yakiniku house in Sennichimae, tables downstairs and private tatami rooms upstairs, that buys A5 black wagyu by taste rather than by brand through its own supply route, which diners agree keeps prices kind. At night start with the Tsukishima set (¥4,980 for 300 g of kalbi, loin and belly), the salted tongue whose sweetness one regular raves about, and the soy-braised wagyu tail; one October 2026 diner came for the Chateaubriand (¥5,500 for 130 g), a bargain. The famous deal is the weekend-only lunch: a large yakiniku set of 140–150 g of wagyu with rice and soup for ¥1,980, with names written on a board from 10 am. Many inbound diners at lunch (September 2026). One September 2026 group found the meat average for the price.

roles: Owner and kitchen unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the shop chooses the best A5 black wagyu of the season regardless of origin and buys it through its own route to keep prices reasonable; its motto is "delicious, fun, comfortable" (美味しく。楽しく。心地よく。). A June 2026 diner was told it uses only female black wagyu. Diners describe friendly, attentive staff from booking to bill (2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Delicious. Fun. Comfortable." (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Weekend yakiniku lunch; Tsukishima set; salted tongue; Chateaubriand.

anecdotes.text: "You need to write your name down at 10 AM and wait until the opening at noon, but it's worth it for the weekend-only lunch." — August 2026.
"I asked the staff how much meat was included. The regular size is 110-120g, and the large size is 140-150g." — September 2026, weekend lunch.
"Here, you can enjoy Chateaubriand for just JPY 5,500 (you can get 120g of it!)" — October 2026.

places.notes: [Izakaya · Namba, robata, red-miso motsuni and clay-pot rice by the station] A large modern izakaya opened in March 2026 on the third floor of a building a minute from Namba Station, with a counter in front of the grill, sunken-table seating and private rooms. The ¥550 appetizer is a small bowl of sweet-savoury red-miso offal stew; then robata and skewers over charcoal, the rare wagyu sirloin-cap skewer with mustard being the dish diners single out, alongside big shrimp skewers, chicken breast with wasabi and a day's sashimi platter. Leave room for the clay-pot rice, which takes about 30 minutes and comes in a pot big enough that leftovers go home as onigiri. Staff know sake well. Several diners in October 2026 found it on the pricey side (about ¥8,000 for two drinks, a side and a clay pot). Heated tobacco is allowed at the tables.

places.notes: [Tonkatsu · Ura Namba, a pink fillet katsu eaten three ways] A small second-floor sister of the Tabelog 100 tonkatsu house New Babe, opened in May 2025 a minute from Nipponbashi Station: tonkatsu at lunch, TOKYO X pork-belly shabu-shabu at night. The fillet katsu (small ¥1,980) is fried at low then high heat until the crust is light and the inside pink and moist; the rib roast is Hayashi SPF pork. The fun is in the set: dip into the slightly sweet fig sauce, then the sour curry sauce for a katsu curry, then the egg soup for a katsudon, with Spanish flake salt and mustard soy sauce on the side. Order by QR code; rice refills are ¥220. One October 2026 diner found the fillet a little too red; another found the shabu-shabu meat less sweet than expected.

places.notes: [Sushi and washoku · Namba, a minute from exit 12] A dark, Japanese-modern room of black and brown wood a minute from Namba Station, with a ten-seat sushi counter, partitioned tables and sofa seats, run by Operation Factory, which manages restaurants and hotel dining rooms. Lunch is the draw and books out even on weekdays: the Hanakago lunch of small dishes with a main and a pot of kamameshi (¥2,790 on weekdays), or the 'triple main' of straw-seared bonito, fugu nanban and lava-grilled black wagyu (¥2,390 on weekdays, ¥2,990 at weekends), both with a small hot pot of yellowtail in golden dashi in October 2026. Dinner centres on a ¥6,000 course of nine dishes ending in Edomae nigiri, with sake picked by the house's three sake sommeliers. Diners in 2026 liked the dashi and the setting; one found the food ordinary for the price, another a sushi slightly fishy. Lunch bookings are for two or more; allergies are not accommodated.

Reopened after renovation in March 2024 (official site news). Celebrating its 21st year in November 2026 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Sushi with kaiseki courses of natural fish from around Japan, served on tableware by the ceramicist 内田鋼一 (official site) · Genji course ¥15,000 (October 2026): corn tofu, an autumn assortment (matsutake and wheat-gluten salad, fugu-skin jelly, hamo with plum, chestnuts, lotus chips, rolled omelette), dobin mushi, five sashimi, sanma sushi, Spanish mackerel grilled with miso and steamed with lotus, roast Kawachi duck, five nigiri (sea bream, white fish, lean tuna, red squid, sea urchin and salmon roe), red miso soup, Takara Farm soft-serve · the top course ¥30,000 (September 2026) · a limited luxury course of Ise lobster, abalone, matsutake and nodoguro (October 2026) · seasonal night courses (July 2026) · à la carte welcome, extra nigiri to order (Tabelog; October 2026) · takeaway sushi set for three (48 pieces and 3 rolls) ¥30,000; New Year osechi (Tabelog) · service charge ¥1,200
places.notes: [Sushi kaiseki · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, private rooms on the 4th floor] The head shop of a small sushi and Japanese-yakiniku group, on the fourth floor of a building off the Shinsaibashi crowds, marking 21 years in November 2026 (Tabelog): a counter and private rooms with sunken seating for two up to 24, laid out like a Kyoto stone lane, with dishes by the ceramicist 内田鋼一. Sushi comes inside a kaiseki course of natural fish from around Japan: the ¥15,000 Genji course in October 2026 ran from corn tofu and an autumn platter through dobin mushi, five sashimi, Spanish mackerel two ways and roast Kawachi duck to five nigiri and a soft-serve from Takara Farm that diners rave about. Families come for birthdays and the staff join in. One diner found only five pieces of sushi in the ¥30,000 course too few for a sushi house (September 2026), so add nigiri à la carte. Service ¥1,200.

roles: Head shop of 株式会社はせ川; representative director 古塚建一 (company site)
chef_bio.background: Per the company site (hasegawa-group.jp): 株式会社はせ川, founded in Kyoto in October 2001, head office at 東心斎橋1-16-20, 6 shops and about 100 staff: 寿司はせ川 心斎橋本店, 京風鉄板 はせ川 and BAR HASEGAWA in the same block, 寿司はせ川 西麻布店 in Tokyo, and 日本焼肉はせ川 in Tokyo (銀座本店, 表参道店, 別亭 銀座店). Its philosophy: "carry on the good old culture of Japan while evolving it"; a sushi house that also serves kaiseki, tableware by noted Japanese potters and late-Edo antiques, walls by a leading plasterer. Per the shop site: seasonal sushi and traditional kaiseki, a counter and private rooms for 2–24, tableware by 内田鋼一, a space evoking Kyoto's stone paving; renovated and reopened March 2024. Tabelog: 21st anniversary in November 2026, with a special course on 1–3 November.
chef_bio.philosophy: "To pass on the spirit of hospitality" (おもてなしの心を伝えたい; official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi kaiseki courses; seasonal natural fish; soft-serve dessert.

anecdotes.text: "The grilled kamasu (barracuda) with dengaku miso was particularly memorable" — October 2026, the Genji course.
"At the end, they surprised us with a birthday celebration along with dessert, and the soft serve ice cream might just be the best I've ever had." — October 2026, in a private room with family.
"I opted for the most expensive course at JPY 30,000. The sushi itself was delicious, but after quite a wait, I only received five pieces." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 寿司はせ川 心斎橋本店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-16-20 ステージアビル4F、極上の旬の素材による寿司と日本伝統の技を大切にした懐石料理、臨場感あふれるカウンター、2〜24名の完全個室、こだわりの器 (陶芸家 内田鋼一)、京の石畳を思わせる空間、季節の設え、2024年3月にリニューアルオープン、おせちとお取り寄せ鍋セット、BAR HASEGAWA で飲み放題の貸し切りプラン。会社 (hasegawa-group.jp): 株式会社はせ川、平成13年10月設立、代表取締役 古塚建一、店舗数6、寿司はせ川 心斎橋本店、京風鉄板 はせ川、BAR HASEGAWA、寿司はせ川 西麻布店、日本焼肉はせ川 銀座本店・表参道店・別亭 銀座店、「日本の古き良き文化を継承しながら、さらに進化させていく」、著名な陶芸家の器や江戸末期の骨董品、日本を代表する左官屋の内装。食べログ (店舗会員): 毎日17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、サービス料1,200円、カード・QR可、84席、掘りごたつの個室2〜24名、テーブル4〜12名、禁煙、Wi-Fi、子ども・キッズメニュー可、テイクアウト、11月で21周年、持ち帰りの寿司セット (3人前48貫と巻物3本) 30,000円、おせち。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): Genji コース15,000円、とうもろこし豆腐、松茸と麩のサラダ、ふぐの皮の煮こごり、梅肉の鱧、dobin mushi、お造り5種、サンマの寿司、鰆の味噌焼き、Kawachi の鴨、にぎり5貫、赤だし、Takara Farm のソフトクリーム、いちばん高い30,000円のコースは寿司が5貫だけという声、伊勢海老・あわび・松茸の限定コース、誕生日のお祝い。

places.cuisine: Crab in many styles, with fugu and, in season, conger eel and eel (Tabelog) · Hokkai course of snow crab, seven dishes: crab jelly, crab sashimi, crab miso with cucumber, crab tempura, crab hot pot, rice porridge, ice cream, ¥7,980 (September–October 2026; ¥7,900 in one September 2026 review) · the Shell course of crab sashimi, crab miso, grilled crab, tempura and hot pot (Tabelog) · live snow crab from the tank cooked two ways of your choice: sashimi, boiled or hot pot (Tabelog) · branded crabs at higher prices (September 2026) · crab gratin ¥1,500, draft beer ¥680 (September 2026) · summer hitsumabushi of eel (September 2026) · crab sake, roasted crab legs steeped in hot sake (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Crab · Nippombashi, private rooms] A crab house of private rooms on two floors near Namba Grand Kagetsu, opened in 2024, with a tank of live crabs and fugu by the door. The entry course is the one to know: the ¥7,980 Hokkai course of snow crab, seven dishes from crab jelly and sweet, firm sashimi through crab miso with cucumber and crisp tempura to a hot pot whose broth turns into a rice porridge at the end. Higher courses and branded crabs cost more, and the tank crabs can be cooked two ways of your choice. In summer it serves eel hitsumabushi instead. Diners in September and October 2026 found the course good value and the rooms calm. Book on the shop's website, and note the 2-hour limit.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a crab specialist serving crab as sashimi, tempura, charcoal-grilled and sukiyaki; snow crab moults more than ten times over eight to ten years; all private rooms; opened 30 September 2024. No operator or chef named in the sources read.
chef_bio.specialty: Snow-crab courses; crab hot pot with rice porridge.

anecdotes.text: "Upon entering the restaurant, the first thing that caught my eye was a large aquarium filled with swimming crabs and fugu." — September 2026, the Hokkai course ¥7,980.
"The rich crab miso was served with cucumber for dipping!" — October 2026.
"For the third serving, I topped it with wasabi and poured dashi (broth) over it to make eel ochazuke" — September 2026, the summer hitsumabushi.

places.cuisine: Seafood izakaya: fish from the central market each day, by a cook from a former fish shop, with creative obanzai (Tabelog) · the signature assorted sashimi, some pieces lightly seared, to eat with soy sauce, salt or liver soy sauce (August–September 2026) · course ¥6,500 (August–September 2026): appetizers such as salt-boiled raw peanuts, marinated bonito and fish in sweet vinegar; salad with cheese and prosciutto; assorted sashimi; salt-grilled ayu; tempura of autumn eel and Senshu water eggplant; roast venison from Itoshima, Fukuoka; a small bowl of sakura shrimp and shirasu; dessert · à la carte: chilled chawanmushi with salmon roe, shrimp mayonnaise, bonito tataki, fried tofu, sake-steamed clams, rare tuna katsu, shrimp chili with egg, butternut squash soup, a small salmon-roe bowl, fried rice (2026 reviews) · more than 30 sakes, awamori, about 10 Italian and Sicilian wines (Tabelog) · table charge ¥500
places.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, sashimi until 2 a.m.] A hidden basement izakaya three minutes from Shinsaibashi Station, run as an independent shop by a cook who came from a fish shop, buying at the central market every day. The thing to order is the assorted sashimi, some pieces lightly seared, which staff suggest eating with salt or liver soy sauce as well as plain soy; then pick from a long list of small plates (chilled chawanmushi, sake-steamed clams, rare tuna katsu, shrimp chili with egg) or take the ¥6,500 course, which in September 2026 ran to salt-grilled ayu, eel and water-eggplant tempura and Itoshima venison. Over 30 sakes and Sicilian wines. Open every night until 2 a.m. Diners praise the freshness and the friendly staff; one found three dishes and three drinks over ¥10,000 (October 2026). Table charge ¥500.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): まえだ家、魚介料理・居酒屋・鍋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-12-19 エイトビルヂング B1F、心斎橋駅から徒歩3分、毎日17:00〜翌2:00、年中無休、予約可 (2時間制、電話の予約が優先、2〜3名はカウンターのことも、席のみの予約は人数分の盛り合わせ、予約状況により本店か別邸へ案内)、チャージ1人500円 (コースは込み)、小学生以上はチャージとワンドリンク、カード・PayPay 可、29席 (カウンター12、テーブル)、貸切20〜50名、禁煙 (店の外に灰皿)、Wi-Fi、2017年7月13日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 元魚屋のプロの料理人による魚介料理と創作おばんざい、毎日市場から仕入れる旬の食材、日本酒30種以上、泡盛、Italy と Sicily のワイン約10種、個人店なので要望にお応え、姉妹店 まえだ家 別邸 (東心斎橋1-14-23 住吉ビル B1F) と JAZZ BERRY (北堀江1-9-18)。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 名物のお造りの盛り合わせ (塩や肝醤油でも)、6,500円のコース (落花生の塩ゆで、かつおの漬け、魚の甘酢漬け、チーズと生ハムのサラダ、お造り、鮎の塩焼き、秋のうなぎと Senshu の水なすの天ぷら、Itoshima の鹿のロースト、桜えびとしらすの小丼、デザート)、冷たい茶碗蒸し、エビマヨ、かつおのたたき、あさりの酒蒸し、レアのマグロカツ、卵のエビチリ、いくらの小丼、チャーハン、スタッフが親切、3品と3杯で1万円を超えたという声。

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: wheat udon in a soy-seasoned dashi, and the niku-sui uses the same broth; no gluten-free option described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dashi is a blend of katsuo and urume sardine, and the bowls carry beef, egg or fried fat (official site; pork fat per an October 2026 review).

Buy a meal ticket from the machine by the entrance (October 2026). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; October 2026 review). places.cuisine: Niku-sui, the dish born at 千とせ: meat udon without the udon, a soft-boiled egg added (official site) · prices from the official menu, tax included: niku-sui ¥1,180, with tofu ¥1,280 · meat udon ¥1,180, half-noodle meat udon ¥1,380 · kodama, small rice with a raw egg and the house egg-rice soy sauce ¥400, large ¥500 · raw egg ¥100, soft-boiled egg ¥200, rice ¥300 / ¥400 · kasu udon with crisp fried fat (pork, per an October 2026 review) ¥1,280, meat-and-kasu udon ¥1,580 · curry udon ¥1,480, kasu curry udon ¥1,880 · kitsune udon ¥1,100, tsukimi udon ¥900 · draft beer ¥600, non-alcoholic beer ¥500
places.notes: [Udon · Namba, inside the Yoshimoto theatre] The branch of 千とせ, the Sennichimae udon house where niku-sui was born, on the ground floor of the Namba Grand Kagetsu comedy theatre. Per the shop, a hungover Yoshimoto Shinkigeki actor, 花紀京, asked for meat udon without the udon, and the then owner obliged. Order the niku-sui (¥1,180) with a kodama, rice with a raw egg and the house soy sauce, and pour the broth over the rice; the broth of katsuo and urume is light and a little sweet, with plenty of tender beef and a soft egg. The bekkan also does kasu udon and a curry udon of its own. Buy a ticket at the machine; cash only. Queues are usually shorter than at the main shop, though prices run a little higher (2026 reviews).

roles: Fourth generation, keeping the niku-sui at the bekkan (official site)
Owner of 千とせ: 森井一光, third generation (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the 千とせ noren has passed from parent to child, and the third generation 森井一光 is now the owner. 千とせ has stood in Namba Sennichimae for fifty years, first known for its meat udon and loved by Yoshimoto comedians from the nearby Namba Grand Kagetsu. Niku-sui began when the Yoshimoto Shinkigeki actor 花紀京, hungover between shows, ordered "meat udon, without the udon" and the previous owner obliged; word of mouth made it the most popular dish. The branch 千とせべっかん opened in Namba Grand Kagetsu in April 2012, where the fourth generation 森井勇貴 keeps the taste of the niku-sui.

anecdotes.text: "Nikusui is a unique dish that originated when a Yoshimoto Shinkigeki comedian ordered 'Niku Udon without the Udon' while hungover" — October 2026, after giving up on the queue at the main shop.
"The Nikusui features plenty of beef and a soft-boiled egg in a flavorful katsuobushi broth. … it's customary to pour the broth over the rice." — October 2026, with a small tamago kake gohan.
"Kasu Udon JPY 1280: The fried pork fat is crispy and adds a delightful texture." — October 2026 (the official site describes kasu udon without naming the meat).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 千とせべっかん、大阪の老舗「千とせ」がなんばグランド花月1階に、11:00〜19:30 L.O.、20:00閉店、出汁売切れの際は閉店、無休、千とせの暖簾は代々親から子へ、現在は三代目の森井一光が店主、難波千日前に店を構えて五十年、元々肉うどんのおいしい店で吉本興業の芸人にも愛された、肉吸いは吉本新喜劇の花紀京さんが二日酔いで「肉うどん、うどん抜きで」と注文し先代が応えたことから、平成24年4月に支店の千とせべっかん、四代目の森井勇貴が肉吸いの味を守る、かつおとうるめのブレンドの出汁、少し甘めの牛肉、半熟卵、青ネギ、豆腐入りも、小ごはんに生卵の「小玉」と専用醤油、肉吸い1,180円、肉吸い (豆腐入り) 1,280円、肉うどん1,180円、半玉肉うどん1,380円、小玉400円、かすうどん1,280円、肉かすうどん1,580円、カレーうどん1,480円、かすカレーうどん1,880円、きつねうどん1,100円、月見うどん900円、生ビール600円。食べログ (店舗会員): 2026年5月15日に価格改定、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、28席、禁煙、2012年4月8日オープン。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 券売機、10〜20人の行列で15〜30分、本店より少し高い、カレーうどんはべっかん限定、肉吸いに小玉をかけて。

places.name: たこ梅 本店 (Tako Ume Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The oden simmers in one shared broth with fish cakes, shumai and tempura-style items alongside daikon, egg and konnyaku, and the octopus is simmered sweet in the house broth; nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every oden item is simmered in the house broth, which takes its depth from whale tongue (official site).
places.hours_raw: Daily 16:00–21:50, last order 21:30 — shortened since 20 February 2024 for lack of staff; closed 31 December–3 January (Tabelog). Reservations by phone only, after 15:00; fan-club members book a month ahead, LINE members and others a week ahead; a booking for someone else is treated as a walk-in (Tabelog). Seat charge: an appetiser ¥275 a person (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 21 seats: a counter of 12 around the oden pot and tables for 9; non-smoking; English menu; children welcome, with care on the tall counter stools (Tabelog). Founded 1844 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-1-8, on the river near Sakaisuji, by Wins Dotonbori — exits B28/B30 of Nippombashi Stn
places.cuisine: Kanto-daki (oden) and tako kanroni, sweet simmered octopus, the house specialities since 1844, with sake warmed in tin and served in tin cups (official site) · prices in August 2026, tax included: tako kanroni ¥495 · whale saezuri (tongue) ¥990, whale suji ¥605 · octopus tempura from a kamaboko maker ¥330 · daikon ¥330, shumai ¥220, egg ¥220 · also potato, thick fried tofu, konnyaku, mochi kinchaku, rolled cabbage, wakame, mugwort fu, mozzarella, grilled eggplant, shiro-na and negima skewers dipped to order (2026 reviews) · seasonal: November 2026 whale harihari pouch ¥550 before tax; shiitake, ginkgo and shiho-chiku bamboo in autumn (official site) · a monthly sake, highballs, ponzu chuhai
places.notes: [Oden · Dotonbori, since 1844] Calling itself the oldest oden shop in Japan, Tako Ume has simmered kanto-daki on Dotonbori since 1844, a counter of twelve around the oden pot and a window at the back onto the river. The broth takes its depth from saezuri, whale tongue, which the founder first used; order it, with the tako kanroni of sweet simmered octopus eaten with mustard, then daikon, potato, egg and the seasonal items, and a cup of sake warmed in tin. Writers from 織田作之助 to 開高健 ate here (official site). Budget ¥3,000–8,000 in 2026, plus a ¥275 appetiser; book by phone after 15:00. Open 16:00–21:50 daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: an oden and sake house ("上燗屋") open since 1844 on Dotonbori, now in its fifth generation, from the founder 岡田梅次郎 to 岡田哲生, and called the oldest oden shop in Japan. The founder first used saezuri, whale tongue, which gives its kanto-daki a deep flavour; baleen-whale tongue is still bought and prepared in house, and the tako kanroni of madako has been simmered in the traditional broth since the start. Sake is warmed in tin tanpo in hot water and served in tin cups. Writers including 織田作之助, 池波正太郎, 檀一雄, 田辺聖子 and 吉田健一 were customers, and 開高健, a customer from the grandfather's day, wrote ten pages on Tako Ume in a novel. The current owner recalls an uncle, the previous owner, saying the shop lasted a hundred years because parents bring their children, who later bring theirs; that memory, on a hard winter night after the Lehman shock, set the aim of keeping the shop for the next hundred years.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Keep a place where parents bring their children, for the next hundred years" (official site, translated).

anecdotes.text: "The interior hasn't changed much at all; it still has the atmosphere of the Taisho era, not just Showa. The copper sake warming stand is the same as well." — June 2026, a first visit in 15 years.
"When I opened the window at the back, I could see the Dotonbori River flowing by" — June 2026.
"They were about to flip the sign to closed, but they let us in with the promise that our first order would be our last order." — August 2026, tako kanroni and whale saezuri, JPY 6,105 for two.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 日本一古いおでん屋「たこ梅」、関東煮 (おでん) とたこ甘露煮が名物、弘化元年 (1844年) 創業の上燗屋、初代岡田梅次郎から五代目の岡田哲生、梅次郎が初めて使った鯨の舌「さえずり®」、ヒゲ鯨の舌を独自に仕込む、真蛸を伝統の出汁でたく「たこ甘露煮」、錫のタンポで燗をつけ錫のコップで、織田作之助、池波正太郎、檀一雄、田辺聖子、吉田健一らが愛し、開高健は「新しい天体」で10ページ、先代の叔父の「親が子を連れて来る店やから百年続いとる」という話、リーマンショックの冬の夜に思い出したこと、これからの百年も。お知らせ (2026年10〜11月): 11月限定の「鯨はりはり」550円 (税抜)、四方竹、さらし鯨、銀杏、椎茸、月替わりの酒。食べログ (店舗会員): 大阪市中央区道頓堀1-1-8、毎日16:00〜21:50 (L.O. 21:30)、2024年2月20日から人手不足のため時間短縮、12月31日〜1月3日休み、予約は15時以降に電話のみ、お通し275円、カード可、21席 (カウンター12、テーブル9)、禁煙、英語メニュー。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): たこ甘露煮495円、鯨さえずり990円、鯨すじ605円、大根330円、シュウマイ220円、玉子220円、ロールキャベツ、じゃがいも、厚揚げ、mochi kinchaku、yomogi fu、モッツァレラ、銅の燗付け器、裏の窓から道頓堀川。

places.notes: [Izakaya · Nishinakajima, market fish and hot-pot banquets] A 46-seat seafood and robata izakaya between Shin-Osaka and Nishinakajima-Minamigata, with a counter for one and tatami rooms for office parties. Alone at the counter you can order single pieces of nigiri at ¥250 and a plate of Taiwanese menchi katsu (August 2026). Diners mention a homey feel and attentive staff (2026). Closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: fresh seafood bought each morning at the central market, "We don't just rely on freshness; we carefully select ingredients every morning"; a five-kind sashimi platter ordered by almost every table; hamo suki nabe; private dining for 2 to 30. places.name: ラーメン坐 裕冬 (Ramenza Yuto)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thick or thin wheat noodles in a soy-based Jiro-style broth or abura soba sauce.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: niboshi, bonito and tonkotsu broths with back fat and pork chashu.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:40) and 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); hours may change (Tabelog). Buy a ticket at the machine by the door; it took no new banknotes in July 2025. Cash only (Tabelog). 20 seats, all at tables (three for four, one for eight), shared at busy times; non-smoking (Tabelog). Lunch fills with office workers and lines form outside (September 2026); after 13:30 it is quiet (September 2026). The 10th of each month is "Yuto Day", with a voucher for the next visit (September 2026). Opened 22 June 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 西中島5-8-26, among the restaurants near Nishinakajima-Minamigata Stn (September 2026) — about 10 min from Shin-Osaka Stn (April 2024)
places.cuisine: Jiro-style ramen built on niboshi, with abura soba (reviews) · niboshi ramen with seasoned egg ¥1,070, mini chashu rice bowl ¥400 (September 2026) · niboshi and bonito ramen with thick noodles ¥990 (September 2026) · tonkotsu ramen ¥1,040 (October 2026) · shoyu abura soba ¥990 (August 2026); shio abura soba with a raw egg ¥1,070, umeboshi on request (July 2025) · raw egg ¥80, rice ¥100 to finish the abura soba (September 2026) · choose noodle weight (a larger portion at no extra cost; 100 g earns a free seasoned egg), thick or thin noodles, and how much vegetables (bean sprouts and cabbage), back fat and sauce; garlic only on request (2021–2026 reviews) · cayenne pepper and vinegar on the table (2021, 2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, Jiro-style niboshi bowls] A 20-seat ramen shop among the restaurants of Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open since 2021, serving Jiro-style bowls with a niboshi (dried sardine) or bonito broth: thick chewy noodles under a heap of bean sprouts and cabbage, back fat and grilled chashu, with noodle weight, vegetables, fat and sauce chosen when you hand over your ticket. Garlic is only added on request, and cayenne pepper on the table is the house twist. Bowls run about ¥1,000; the abura soba ends with rice and a raw egg in the bowl. One diner traced the bowl to a shop in Abeno Lucias that closed in January 2024 and found the same dish here (April 2024). Opinions split on the fish broth: "strong niboshi flavor" to one (September 2026), powdery to another (August 2026). Cash only; lunch lines form.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed) and one floor staff member (July 2025, September 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: opened 22 June 2021. Per reviews: "two staff members—one female and the owner—serving" (July 2025); "one busy chef in the kitchen and one male staff member managing the dining area" at a September 2026 lunch; a diner who had eaten the same niboshi Jiro-style bowl at a shop in the Abeno Lucias basement, closed 27 January 2024, found it here (April 2024 and September 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: "Halfway through, I sprinkled on some cayenne pepper, which is a unique feature of this shop." — September 2026.
"The same dish I had at Lucias was served … it might just be a matter of crossing the Yodogawa River to get here instead." — April 2024.
"Garlic is not included by default, so there's no need to worry about the smell. Perhaps that's why there were many salarymen dining here." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラーメン坐 裕冬、ラーメン・油そば・まぜそば、大阪市淀川区西中島5-8-26、西中島南方駅から359m、毎日11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:40)、18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、現金のみ、20席 (テーブルのみ)、禁煙、2021年6月22日オープン。口コミ(2021年12月〜2026年10月): 入口の券売機、麺の量、太麺か細麺、野菜 (もやしとキャベツ)、背脂、タレを選ぶ、ニンニクは希望で、卓上にカイエンペッパーと酢、煮干しラーメン味玉1,070円、ミニチャーシュー丼400円、煮干しカツオラーメン990円、豚骨ラーメン1,040円、醤油油そば990円、塩油そば、生卵80円、ライス100円、毎月10日は裕冬の日、昼は会社員で満席、Abeno Lucias の閉店した店と同じ味、煮干しが粉っぽいという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine at the door, then choose noodles, vegetables, fat and sauce with the staff. No English evidence found.
