places.name: 鯛白湯らーめん ○de▽ (Tai Paitan Ramen ○de▽)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; the toppings include fried burdock.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sea-bream broth, sea-bream sashimi and pork chashu.
places.hours_raw: Daily 10:30–22:30 (food last order 22:00), open all year except 30 December–3 January; late arrivals welcome (Tabelog). Buy a ticket at the machine first, cash only (Tabelog; October 2026). 15 seats: 7 at the counter, one table for four, two for two; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Six people ahead at 13:00 on a weekday; half full at 18:40 on a rainy night (October 2026). Staff took a diner's suitcase without being asked (November 2026). Opened 14 November 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 西宮原1-5-6, about 5 min from exit 4 of Shin-Osaka Stn (Midosuji Line) (Tabelog); the same street number as the okonomiyaki shop osaka_tonton_byoshi_nishimiyahara
places.cuisine: Ramen built on sea bream (Tabelog: "Meccha Tai") · Tabelog Ramen 100 (OSAKA 2023–2025) · tai paitan "torori", rich and creamy, from ¥1,290 with sea-bream rice (November 2026) · special tai paitan ¥1,460 with two slices of kombu-cured sea bream, smoked seasoned egg, chashu, fried burdock and menma cut into circles and triangles (October 2026) · clear sea-bream soup ("tai clear") with crisp sea-bream skin and an oyster ajillo to add (October 2026) · "Merari", tai paitan with chili (October 2026) · tsukemen (Tabelog) · sides: sea-bream rice (to pour the broth over), "Blissful Two Pieces" of sea-bream and meat sushi ¥450 (October 2026) · large noodles ¥100 (November 2025)
places.notes: [Ramen · Shin-Osaka west, sea-bream paitan in a kaiseki-like room] A 15-seat ramen shop five minutes from the Shin-Osaka subway exit, open since 2018 and in Tabelog's Ramen 100 every year from 2023 to 2025, where everything is built on sea bream. The tai paitan is blended at the counter (one diner saw the bow-tied chef finish it with a blender) into a thick, creamy, "liquid sea bream" broth over medium-thin noodles, and the special bowl adds kombu-cured sea-bream slices, a smoked egg, fried burdock and menma cut into the ○ and ▽ of the name (¥1,460). There is a clear sea-bream soup too, tsukemen, and sea-bream rice to finish with the broth. The room is designed like a kaiseki restaurant, and the staff are attentive. On one October 2026 evening most of the customers were from overseas. Cash only.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff of 株式会社 銀の葡萄 (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a ramen shop where every main bowl features sea bream, "Meccha Tai"; an interior like a kaiseki restaurant, chosen music, roomy seats and attentive staff; opened 14 November 2018; Tabelog Ramen OSAKA 100 2023–2025. Per the operator's shop page (silver-grape.com/shop/, read 2026-11-01): 株式会社 銀の葡萄 lists 鯛白湯らーめん ○de▽ 新大阪店, 三ノ宮店 and two Hong Kong shops, describing the brand as "まるでラーメン屋じゃないみたいな店", a rich sea-bream paitan in a space that overturns the fixed idea of a ramen shop. Per reviews: a chef in a bow tie finishing the broth with a blender (October 2026); staff warmed the ladle before handing it over (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "A shop that hardly seems like a ramen shop" (まるでラーメン屋じゃないみたいな店; operator's site).
chef_bio.specialty: Tai paitan ramen; tai clear soup.

anecdotes.text: "I could see the charming chef in a bow tie finishing the broth with a blender … with a texture that felt like liquid sea bream." — October 2026.
"The staff's presentation was impressive; [the staff] even warmed the ladle before handing it to me." — October 2026; about 80% of the room were overseas visitors that evening.
スーツケースを持っていたのですが、こちらからお願いする前に気づいて声をかけ、預かってくださいました。 ("I had a suitcase, and before I asked, the staff noticed and offered to keep it.") — November 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 運営会社のサイト (株式会社 銀の葡萄、店舗紹介): 鯛白湯らーめん ○de▽ 新大阪店 (大阪市淀川区西宮原1-5-6)、三ノ宮店、香港の2店、まるでラーメン屋じゃないみたいな店、濃厚鯛白湯にラーメン屋の固定概念を覆す空間。食べログ (店舗会員): 鯛白湯らーめん ○de▽、ラーメン・つけ麺、地下鉄新大阪駅4番出口から徒歩5分、毎日10:30〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、12月30日〜1月3日休み、現金のみ、15席、禁煙、子ども可、2018年11月14日オープン、ラーメン百名店 OSAKA 2023〜2025、すべてのメインのラーメンに鯛、懐石料理店のような内装。口コミ(2025年11月〜2026年11月): 鯛白湯とろり＋鯛めし1,290円、具の多い特製の鯛白湯1,460円、鯛の昆布じめ、燻製の味玉、揚げごぼう、○と▽のメンマ、澄んだ鯛のスープ、牡蠣のアヒージョ、辛い Merari、鯛と肉の寿司2貫450円、蝶ネクタイの大将がブレンダーで仕上げる、スーツケースを預かってくれた、海外からの客が多い夜も。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash ticket machine; one October 2026 evening most customers were from overseas. No English menu evidence found.

places.name: SOSラーメン 新大阪 (SOS Ramen Shin osaka)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in a shoyu broth with spicy meat miso.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken-based shoyu broth (2017 review), minced-meat miso and chashu.
places.hours_raw: Thursdays only: lunch from 11:30 and dinner from 18:00, 40 bowls each, closing when the noodles or soup run out; temporary closures possible (Tabelog). A January 2025 diner mentions Thursdays and Saturdays; the current listing says Thursdays only. Cash only (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Free small rice at lunch (August 2023, January 2025).
places.neighborhood: 東中島1-13-43, ground floor of 新大阪第一ダイヤモンドマンション — 7 min from JR Shin-Osaka Stn, 12 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Spicy shoyu ramen in the style of Taiwan ramen (reviews) · SOS ramen: shoyu broth with garlic chives, bean sprouts and a generous spicy minced-meat miso (June 2026) · SOS chashu ramen ¥1,100 (July 2026) · spice levels up to 6, from two chili toppings, one fragrant and one fiercely hot (June 2024, July 2026) · grated garlic and vinegar to add (2023, October 2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Shin-Osaka east side, open Thursdays only] A self-styled "phantom" ramen counter seven minutes from the Shin-Osaka east side, with eight seats and one day a week: Thursdays, 40 bowls at lunch and 40 at dinner. The bowl is a shoyu ramen in the spirit of Taiwan ramen, with garlic chives, bean sprouts and a heap of spicy minced-meat miso, and you choose the heat from mild up to level 6 with two chili toppings, one fragrant and one painful (2024–2026). Chashu ramen is ¥1,100 (July 2026). Reviews split, from "incredibly delicious" after ten years away (August 2025) to below average (January 2025). The owner hums along to the shop's own song while cooking (June 2026). Cash only; check it is Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: open Thursdays only, 40 bowls per sitting, closing when noodles or soup run out. Per reviews: "The owner, who seemed to be of advanced age, was happily humming while preparing the dishes", with the shop's original background music playing (June 2026); "The owner looks intimidating, but [is] actually very kind once you start talking" (June 2024); "It was great to see the master looking well" after more than ten years (August 2025); the owner welcomed a diner ten minutes before the end of lunch and explained the ramen (April 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: SOS ramen with spicy meat miso.

anecdotes.text: "As I listened to the original BGM playing in the restaurant … I couldn't help but smile." — June 2026, SOS ramen at spice level 5.
"You can choose from two types of chili powder: one with a flavorful heat and the other with a painful heat." — June 2024.
"I was finally able to visit SOS Ramen after more than 10 years … It was great to see the master looking well too!" — August 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: SOSラーメン 新大阪、ラーメン、大阪市東淀川区東中島1-13-43 新大阪第一ダイヤモンドマンション 1F、JR 新大阪駅から徒歩7分、木曜のみ営業、昼11:30〜・夜18:00〜、各40杯、麺かスープがなくなりしだい終了、臨時休業あり、現金のみ、カウンター8席、禁煙。口コミ(2023年7月〜2026年10月): 木曜だけの店、醤油ラーメンに辛い肉みそ、ニラ、もやし、台湾ラーメンのよう、辛さは6まで、2種類の唐辛子、SOS chashu ramen 1,100円、昼は小ライスのサービス、おろしニンニク、店主の鼻歌とオリジナルの BGM、評価は分かれる。

cultural_comfort.note: Eight counter seats; choose a spice level. No English evidence found.

places.name: 割烹 八彩 新大阪店 (Kappou Hassai Shin osaka ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. One kaiseki course of the month built on dashi, with soy-dressed sashimi, sauced simmered dishes and fried items; nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led kaiseki course built on dashi.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–22:00; lunch on weekends and holidays 12:00–15:00 (last seating 13:00); closed Monday, but the shop says to call even on closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; when online booking shows no seats, phone (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR; no service charge (Tabelog's original text: なし). 20 seats: 8 at the counter and 3 tables for four; private rooms for 4 to 20, with groups of nine or more seated privately; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 15 March 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 宮原2-13-1, ground floor of サンパレス ("Sun Palace", September 2026 review), in a quiet residential area — 2 min from exit 4 of Higashi-Mikuni Stn, 6 min from Shin-Osaka Stn (Tabelog; March 2026)
places.cuisine: Kaiseki course of the month (Tabelog) · "Seasonal Kaiseki", 8 dishes ¥7,800 tax included (Tabelog; February–May 2026) · "Mini Kaiseki" for drinkers, the same course without rice and dessert, ¥5,800 (May 2026) · a March 2026 course: spring cabbage and sakura shrimp on a celeriac and new-potato purée; sakura domyoji with clam; Akashi sea bream with flower wasabi and irizake, and Kochi horse mackerel; lotus-root dumpling with shrimp; an assortment of firefly squid in Shaoxing wine, egg tofu, ribbonfish, anago sushi and more; a small pot of trout with watercress and Yodo daikon; clay-pot rice of mackerel and young burdock, red miso soup; mascarpone yokan · clay-pot rice with sakura shrimp, spring cabbage and young ginger at a May 2026 lunch, the leftovers wrapped as onigiri to take home · about 20 sakes and wines from a temperature-controlled showcase, with pairing advice (Tabelog; March 2026)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Higashi-Mikuni, a monthly course by the station] A 20-seat kappo in a quiet residential block two minutes from Higashi-Mikuni Station and six from Shin-Osaka, open since 2016, with an eight-seat counter where the chefs cook in front of you and private rooms for groups. There is one kaiseki course a month, eight dishes for ¥7,800 (2026), or a ¥5,800 mini version without rice and dessert for those who mainly drink. A March 2026 course ran from sakura shrimp and spring cabbage through Akashi sea bream with irizake, a small pot of trout and Yodo daikon, to mackerel clay-pot rice. About 20 sakes are kept in a showcase and matched to each dish. Diners praise the explanations and the farewell bows at the door (May 2026). Weekend lunch too.

roles: Chefs at the counter (unnamed); a sake sommelier on staff (March 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a seasonal kaiseki course in a calm space, about 20 sakes and wines by the bottle or glass, small pots of seasonal ingredients, dishes "that transcend genres"; opened 15 March 2016. Per reviews: dishes prepared in front of the counter (February and May 2026); detailed explanations of each dish and drink (May 2026); sake chosen by the sake sommelier (March 2026); staff saw guests to the door and bowed until out of sight (May 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Enjoy seasonal flavors with exquisite dishes that transcend genres" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly kaiseki course; small pots; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "The rice cooked in a clay pot with sakura shrimp, spring cabbage, and young ginger was so delicious that [the staff] kindly offered to wrap up the leftovers as onigiri for me to take home." — May 2026, a Sunday lunch.
"Everything was tasty, but as a sashimi lover, I wished there had been some in the JPY 7800 course." — February 2026.
"I tried the Mini Kaiseki Course for JPY 5,800, which featured meticulously prepared dishes full of creativity." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 割烹 八彩 新大阪店、日本料理・海鮮、大阪市淀川区宮原2-13-1 サンパレス 1F、Higashi-Mikuni 駅4番出口から徒歩2分、新大阪駅から6分、火〜日・祝17:00〜22:00、土日祝のランチ12:00〜15:00 (最終入店13:00)、月曜休み (休みの日も電話で相談可)、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、サービス料なし、20席 (カウンター8、4名テーブル3)、個室4〜20名、禁煙、2016年3月15日オープン、季節の懐石コース8品7,800円 (税込)、日本酒約20種とワイン、季節の小鍋。口コミ(2026年2月〜10月): 毎月かわる懐石、ミニ懐石5,800円、目の前で仕上げる、料理と酒のていねいな説明、日本酒のソムリエ、桜えびと春キャベツ、Akashi の鯛と irizake、小鍋、土鍋ごはん、残りはおにぎりに、見えなくなるまで見送り、Higashi-Mikuni の静かな住宅街。

cultural_comfort.note: One course with explanations at the counter (2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: おでんと、アジフライ。 バルチカ03 (Oden to Ajifurai, Barchika 03)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The fried horse mackerel is breaded (not gluten-free), and oden is simmered in a Kansai-style dashi with fishcakes and a burdock tempura among the pieces; the broth's seasoning is not described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in a dashi broth with beef tendon and egg, and fried horse mackerel.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–23:00, daytime drinking welcome (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; parties of three or fewer booked at the counter table may be moved to the counter (Tabelog). Full on a Sunday at 16:30, a short wait (September 2026); fully booked on a weekday at 19:00 (June 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards and other e-money, QR payment including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter of 12 and one counter table of 8; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 31 July 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Umeda 3-2-123, 5F of Innogate Osaka (イノゲート大阪), Barchika 03 — directly connected to the west exit of JR Osaka Stn
places.cuisine: Oden in a golden Kansai-style dashi, classic and creative pieces, and thick fried horse mackerel delivered from Sakai Port, Tottori (Tabelog) · fried horse mackerel in full and half portions, with a choice of sauces (tartar, mentaiko tartar, salt and lemon, ponzu) and fish-bone crackers on the side: ¥780 (June 2026), ¥380 (September 2026) · oden assortment ¥1,720 (June 2026); pieces named in 2026: daikon, potato, beef tendon, soft-boiled egg, konnyaku, thick fried tofu, burdock tempura, sesame tofu, a pouch stuffed with condiments · beef dote-ni in sweet miso ¥680, edamame starter (September 2026) · a wide range of shochu (June 2026) · four people with two drinks each paid ¥14,300 (June 2026)
places.notes: [Oden · Umeda, oden and fried horse mackerel over the station] A neon-lit counter on the fifth floor of Innogate Osaka, straight off the JR west exit, the second shop of an oden bar in Honmachi (Tabelog). It does two things: oden simmered in a golden Kansai dashi (daikon, beef tendon, a soft egg, sesame tofu and a pouch stuffed with condiments that diners single out), and palm-sized fried horse mackerel from Sakai Port, thick, with coarse crumbs, a choice of tartar, mentaiko tartar or salt and lemon, and its fried bones on the side. Weekend doors open at 11:30 for daytime drinking; evenings fill, so book. One June 2026 group found it a little pricey for the size (¥14,300 for four); most diners in 2026 call the fish a must-order.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "a skillful tavern near the station" with oden in a golden Kansai-style dashi and "Fried Horse Mackerel delivered fresh from Tottori Sakai Port", pop illustrations and neon inside; the main store is おでんと、アジフライ。 本町本店; opened 31 July 2024.
chef_bio.specialty: Thick fried horse mackerel; Kansai-dashi oden.

anecdotes.text: "The fish was crispy with coarse breadcrumbs and fluffy on the inside. … It also comes with crispy and fragrant fish bone crackers—delicious!" — September 2026, a Sunday at 16:30.
"What surprised me was the special condiment pouch. The unique texture combined with the deep-fried tofu and condiments was an amazing match!" — September 2026.
"The fish was thick and delicious, but I thought JPY 780 was a bit pricey for the size" — June 2026, a weekday at 19:00.

places.notes: [Kaiseki · Umeda, Japanese food 142 m up] A large Japanese restaurant on the 33rd floor of Osaka Ekimae Dai-3 Building, 142 m above Umeda, where the windows look east to the Ikoma mountains and west toward the Akashi Strait (Tabelog). Twelve private rooms with sunken kotatsu seating hold groups of five to fifty, which makes it a favourite for business dinners and family celebrations. Lunch is good value: a three-tier makunouchi bento of sashimi, simmered dishes and tempura for ¥1,980 (September 2026), or tempura and gozen sets. In the evening the monthly Kawakyu kaiseki runs from seasonal starters and sashimi to takikomi rice. Reviews are kind about the view and the price and mixed on the cooking, which some found average, with small windows in some private rooms and noisy clearing of plates (October 2026). Closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: authentic Japanese cuisine from set meals to seasonal kaiseki on the 33rd floor, 142 m above ground, with views from the Ikoma mountains in the east to the Akashi Strait; twelve private rooms with sunken kotatsu for 5 to 50. places.notes: [Kushiage · Kitashinchi, skewers and aged-pork katsu] A calm basement kushiage counter on Kitashinchi's main street, opened in 2019, where the cook breads and fries skewers of organic vegetables, domestic meat and seafood in front of a crescent-shaped counter, with private rooms for two or four. Dinner is a ten-skewer course or an omakase that runs until you call stop (¥8,800–10,000), ending with jako rice and red miso soup. Lunch is the bargain and the reason most reviewers come: tonkatsu of snow-room-aged pork, loin and fillet from ¥1,700, a minced-meat cutlet filled with foie gras (¥2,400), shiso rice refilled free and a small bowl of grated yam with wasabi to cut the fat. Book lunch; it fills by 13:00. Closed Sundays.

places.notes: [Italian · Kitashinchi, an eight-seat innovative counter] A small counter on the sixth floor of the Kitashinchi PLACE building where an owner-chef cooks one omakase of Italian-rooted dishes built on pairing ingredients, with a sommelier's wines from around the world. The listing says it has held a Michelin star in Kyoto and Osaka every year since 2022, and Tabelog named it an Innovative 100 in 2025. Diners remember the house brioche, the caviar with squid and cauliflower, Kyoto Nanatani duck and the "explosive seafood", a baked crab risotto; two 2025 diners note the chef came from Ponte Vecchio and find the cooking closer to classic Italian than avant-garde. The course is ¥26,000–31,000 plus 10% service; with pairing expect about ¥50,000 (January 2026). Two seatings a night; book ahead. Steak Ron is on the ground floor of the same building.

Book for a table upstairs, or walk in for the downstairs counter and watch the knife work; stays are 90 minutes. Open until 5 a.m. six nights a week. A free ice-cream monaka ends the meal. places.name: ムカカ (mukaka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Straw- and charcoal-grilled meat and fish come with soy-based condiments, and the menu also has pasta, pizza and fried horse mackerel; nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the menu is built on straw-grilled bonito, chicken and beef and a meat-heavy appetiser platter.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–22:30; Sat, Sun and holidays 15:00–22:30; closed irregularly; hours may be cut short when dishes sell out, so call ahead (Tabelog). Reservations recommended, with a two-hour limit; a booking is cancelled at 10 minutes late without a call; tell the staff in advance about children (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Service charge ¥250 a person (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 28 seats: a counter of 6 and tables; non-smoking, though the room fills with smoke from the smoking and straw grilling (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-11-11, スカイハイツSAWA 1F — 5 min from Nishi-Ohashi, Yotsubashi or Honmachi stations
places.cuisine: Izakaya of straw-grilled (wara-yaki) and charcoal-grilled meat and fish by a chef from a popular restaurant, with a few Italian dishes (Tabelog shop text) · the Mukamori: a boxed assortment of more than ten appetisers for at least two, e.g. smoked potato salad and grilled chicken skirt, with smoked items, dried fruit and nuts (2025–2026 reviews) · straw-grilled bonito (also wabi katsuo) with green onion, wasabi, sprouts and garlic chips · straw-grilled chicken and beef · chicken neck, fried horse mackerel · margherita pizza, clam and aosa pasta · course from ¥3,000 for four or more, with free drinks for ¥2,000 more (Tabelog) · beer, highballs, whole-lemon sour, sake, shochu, wine
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shinmachi, straw fire and a box of small plates] A busy, smoky izakaya in Shinmachi where a chef who came from a popular restaurant grills meat and fish over burning straw and charcoal, and adds a little Italian. Everyone orders the Mukamori, a wooden box of more than ten small appetisers for at least two, which is enough to fill two people on its own, so share it and add only the straw-grilled bonito, a pasta or a pizza. Book ahead (stays are two hours); weekends open at 15:00. Expect ¥4,000–6,000 a head plus a ¥250 service charge.

roles: Chef who worked at a popular restaurant, unnamed (Tabelog shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: straw-grilled and charcoal-grilled dishes by a chef who worked at a popular restaurant; quick straw smoking adds aroma to meat and fish; a few Italian dishes; seasonal recommendations and the day's fish grilled over straw.

anecdotes.text: "The Mukaka Assortment was truly generous in portion size, packed with over 10 types of appetizers in a wooden box." — September 2026.
"The grilled bonito had a wonderful aroma from the straw grilling, and I could enhance the flavors with toppings like green onions, wasabi, sprouts, and garlic chips." — October 2026.
"I visited for an early dinner, and the 3 PM opening time was a great help." — August 2026.

places.name: 心斎橋焙煎所 (Shinsaibashi Baisenjo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Coffee aside, the food is taiyaki, chiffon cake, Basque cheesecake and pudding; the pudding is the item without obvious flour, but nothing is stated about it.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Black coffee is the plain option; ask about plant milk for lattes. The cakes, pudding and taiyaki fillings use dairy and eggs or are not described.
places.hours_raw: Sources disagree on the hours: Tabelog gives daily 9:00–18:30, and a diner came at just after 9:00 on a June 2026 Friday; the official site gives 11:00–19:00. Check before an early or late visit. No reservations (Tabelog). Order downstairs, then sit upstairs; eating in needs one drink each (2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) for ¥1,000 and over, transport IC and PayPay (Tabelog). 24 seats on the skylit second floor; non-smoking; take-out; children welcome (Tabelog; official site). Opened 15 January 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nishi-Shinsaibashi 1-10-1, 1F (café upstairs), off the main street on the Amerikamura side — 137 m from Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: A roastery café: green beans from around the world roasted in front of you, blended by top Japanese baristas, espresso on a CIMBALI machine, a daily drip coffee and flavoured lattes such as caramel macchiato, honey cappuccino and chai mocha (official site) · single origins in 2026, e.g. Rwanda, Brazil Recreio, Colombia Monserrate · café latte ¥550 (September 2026) or ¥650 (October 2026), cold brew ¥750 to take away (August 2026) · Basque cheesecake with cream and rock salt ¥800 (September 2026) · pudding; pumpkin pudding and an apple-caramel upside-down cake in autumn 2026 (official site) · chiffon cakes (Earl Grey, espresso) and taiyaki from the counters in the same building, e.g. Tokachi red bean; breakfast plate of a bacon-cheese taiyaki with salad and a boiled egg (September 2026)
places.notes: [Café · Shinsaibashi, a roastery with taiyaki] A wood-clad roastery with a silver chimney just off the main street by Shinsaibashi Station, roasting beans downstairs and serving them upstairs in a skylit room. Order at the counter, then climb to the second floor; the baristas will suggest beans to your taste, and lattes come with latte art. The building also holds a taiyaki and a chiffon-cake counter, so a coffee comes with a crisp taiyaki, a bacon-cheese taiyaki breakfast plate, an Earl Grey chiffon cake or a salted Basque cheesecake. The two sources differ on hours (Tabelog 9:00–18:30; official site 11:00–19:00), and a latte cost ¥550 in September 2026 and ¥650 in October.

roles: Operator: Garden Bar & Coffee Japan (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a roastery where green beans chosen from around the world are roasted in front of customers and blended by top Japanese baristas, with a CIMBALI espresso machine and a calm skylit café on the second floor; opened in Shinsaibashi for the many kinds of people who pass through; the operator also runs Welcome the Coffee. Reviewers note that the taiyaki and chiffon cake counters in the same building appear to be run by the same company (2026). Opened 15 January 2015 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: To let many people know and enjoy the real aroma and taste of coffee (official site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: House-roasted coffee; taiyaki and chiffon cake with coffee.

anecdotes.text: "I mentioned that I'm not a fan of bitter coffee, and the staff recommended the Rwandan iced coffee. It had a refreshing acidity" — October 2026, with an espresso chiffon cake.
"A business card-sized paper explaining that today's coffee is from the Colombia Monserrate region was attached" — August 2026, a ¥750 cold brew to take away.
"You secure a seat on the 2nd floor and then place your order on the 1st floor." — June 2026, just after 9 AM on a Friday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ガーデンバール＆コーヒージャパン): 心斎橋焙煎所、木の壁から銀色の煙突が突き出た外観、店内の焙煎機、目の前で焼き上げるコーヒー豆、国内トップクラスのバリスタのブレンドの自家焙煎の豆、世界中から厳選した生豆、ラテアート、CIMBALI のエスプレッソマシン、日替わりのドリップコーヒー、キャラメルマキアート・蜂蜜カプチーノ・チャイモカなどのフレーバーラテ、2階は天窓の自然光の落ち着いたカフェ、OPEN 11:00〜CLOSE 19:00、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-10-1、2026年秋のかぼちゃプリン、林檎とキャラメルのアップサイドダウンケーキ、Welcome the Coffee も運営。食べログ: 毎日9:00〜18:30、予約不可、カードは1,000円以上、交通系IC・PayPay 可、24席、禁煙、テイクアウト、2015年1月15日オープン。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): 1階で注文して2階の席へ、イートインはワンドリンク、たい焼きとシフォンケーキの店と同じ建物、ベーコンチーズたい焼きのモーニング、バスクチーズケーキ800円、カフェラテ550円 (2026年9月) と650円 (2026年10月)、コールドブリュー750円、ルワンダ、海外の客も。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter downstairs; baristas suggest beans to your taste (2026); many overseas visitors (June 2026). No English evidence found.

places.notes: [Yakiniku · Minamisenba, black-wagyu tongue and horumon] A two-floor yakiniku room in Minamisenba, counter downstairs under signed memorabilia that a July 2026 diner took for signatures of baseball players, tables upstairs, that buys selected black wagyu for its tongue and harami and serves a long list of fresh wagyu horumon. Diners point to the special salted tongue, the tsurami and harami, and the thin chuck-eye roll eaten with sesame salt; the sauces are light. Book, even on weekdays, and expect ¥6,000–15,000 a head in 2026. Closed Wednesdays.

roles: Operator named in a July 2026 review: "Louis Valiant Co., Ltd., led by Nagisa Asai as the General Manager" (not checked elsewhere)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: carefully selected black-haired wagyu, wagyu only for the tongue and harami, a homemade sauce, fresh wagyu horumon; second-floor tables for banquets of up to 35. A July 2026 diner saw signed memorabilia, apparently of baseball players, above the first-floor counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Black-wagyu special salted tongue; wagyu horumon.

anecdotes.text: "This restaurant seems to favor salt-based sauces, and the staff recommended enjoying the meat with sesame salt." — July 2026, a same-day booking on a business trip.
"I highly recommend the 'Special Salted Tongue of Black-haired Wagyu.' … You get a satisfying portion of six large pieces." — July 2026.
"The liver here is particularly delicious—I ordered two plates." — April 2026, a fifth visit.

places.name: モジャカレー 新大阪本店 (Moja Curry Shin osaka honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The shop describes "a rich, slow-cooked roux" (roux is usually thickened with wheat flour), and a hamburg steak is among the toppings.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature is curry under sweet-simmered beef, and nothing is described as vegan; the base sauce is not described.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–20:00 (Tabelog). No reservations; takeaway orders can be booked (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 7 counter seats, tight enough that a bag on the chair blocks the way (October 2026); non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). Water is self-service; fukujinzuke sits on the counter, and other pickles cost ¥50 (October 2026). Most orders arrive in a minute or so; the hamburg-steak curry takes about 12 minutes (October 2026).
places.neighborhood: 西中島5-16-1, in the 味の小路 (Aji no Koji) food alley on the ground floor of JR Shin-Osaka Station (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Curry: "Mojya Curry" of a house spice blend and a rich, slow-cooked roux, with a choice of toppings (Tabelog) · negi beef curry, the house favourite: sweet-simmered thin-sliced beef and a heap of chopped green onion over the curry, ¥1,200 (October 2026), ¥1,250 spicy, ¥1,300 with large rice (October 2026) · BIG hamburg-steak curry ¥1,400 (October 2026) · plain Moja curry (October 2026) · spice level from mild to very hot, and the rice amount, chosen when ordering (October 2026) · a smooth, fairly runny sauce, sweet first, the heat building as you eat; one diner compared it with Osaka "Madras" curry (October 2026)
places.notes: [Curry · Shin-Osaka Station, a 7-seat counter in Aji no Koji] A tiny curry counter in the food alley on the ground floor of Shin-Osaka Station, on Tabelog's Curry WEST 100 list in 2023, 2024 and 2026, with signed celebrity photos on the wall. Its curry was created by a chef from Bangladesh, and "moja" means delicious in Bengali (October 2026). Most diners order the negi beef curry: thin beef simmered sweet, a pile of crunchy green onion, and a smooth sauce that starts sweet and lets the heat build, about ¥1,200–1,300 with the spice level and rice amount to your choice (October 2026). It usually arrives within a minute, which suits a traveller with a Shinkansen to catch. Seven seats only, cramped with luggage; the queue moves fast.

chef_bio.origin: The curry was created by a chef from Bangladesh (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: "The signature dish is a curry created by a chef from Bangladesh, featuring a perfect balance of sweetness and spiciness. 'Moja' means 'delicious' in Bengali." Per the Tabelog listing: a unique blend of spices and a rich, slow-cooked roux, balancing flavour and aroma so that depth comes through the heat. Tabelog Curry WEST 100: 2023, 2024, 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: "A curry flavor you'll never forget!" (Tabelog, translated).

anecdotes.text: "I was shocked when my order arrived in just one minute. So fast!" — October 2026, the negi beef curry for JPY 1,200.
"Many customers seem to have a routine of saying, 'When I come to Shin-Osaka Station, I start here and end here.'" — October 2026.
"While waiting for my curry, I noticed many signed photos of celebrities adorning the walls." — October 2026.

places.cuisine: Local ramen-and-fried-rice shop: ramen in shoyu, shio, miso or tonkotsu (May 2026) · shoyu ramen ¥850 (April 2026): thin straight noodles, chashu, menma, bean sprouts, green onion and a spicy miso paste to stir in · "half-chan" set of ramen and a half portion of fried rice, close to a full one, ¥1,100 (April and May 2026), ¥1,200 (August 2026) · ramen with mini fried rice, miso, ¥1,080 (April 2026) · shoyu ramen with two large plain rice balls ¥1,000 (August 2026); a free cold tofu came with it in May 2026 · ramen with mini Tianjin rice, just over ¥1,000 (September 2026) · one August 2026 diner had a rich Kyushu-style tonkotsu
places.notes: [Ramen · Nishimiyahara, a 1982 ramen-and-fried-rice counter] A small local ramen shop a few minutes' walk from the north exit of Shin-Osaka Station, open since 1982 and now in its second generation (August 2026), with red uniforms and a red sign that one diner tied to the Sanada clan's red armour behind the name (May 2026). The bowls are plain and old-style: a light shoyu ramen with thin straight noodles, bean sprouts and a dab of spicy miso to stir in, or shio, miso and tonkotsu, mostly ordered as a ¥1,100–1,200 set with a half portion of fried rice that is nearly a full one (2026). Office workers line up at noon, food comes fast, and the staff chat with everyone (May 2026). Diners call it ordinary in the best sense: nothing showy, easy to eat every day.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Per an August 2026 review: "it was established quite a while ago, in 1982, and is currently run by the second generation." A May 2026 diner: "The staff were very chatty, engaging in conversation with various customers," and the uniforms and sign are red.
chef_bio.specialty: Shoyu ramen with half fried rice.

anecdotes.text: "The staff were very chatty, engaging in conversation with various customers. It was the first time I had seen someone talk so much in a ramen shop! (laughs)" — May 2026, the half-chan ramen.
"Although it was a half portion of fried rice, it was surprisingly substantial, close to a regular serving." — August 2026, the half-chan ramen for JPY 1,200.
"Above all, I was amazed by the speed of service." — September 2026, a Saturday lunch of shoyu ramen and mini Tianjin rice.

places.name: 新大阪昼呑み酒場 SAKE ヤシマ (Shin Osaka Hirunomi Sakaba SAKE Yashima)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Small home-style dishes, spice curries, chicken tempura and a Thursday pasta are on the menu; nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Nothing is labelled vegan or vegetarian. The spice curry of lotus root and beans (July 2026) and the bean-and-vegetable curry plate (June 2026) may suit, but neither is described as meat- or fish-free, and most side dishes include meat or fish.
places.hours_raw: Mon and Sat 12:00–18:00; Wed, Thu and Fri 12:00–21:30; closed Tue and Sun (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (AMEX only), e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 18 seats: a counter downstairs and tables on the second floor (May and July 2026); non-smoking; private hire (Tabelog). Lunch can be slow with two staff: one July 2026 diner waited 40 minutes. Sake events now and then (May 2026). Opened 6 January 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 西中島7-9-15 — about 3 min from Exit 7 of Shin-Osaka Stn (Midosuji Line) (March 2026); a big sake bottle marks the front (June 2026)
places.cuisine: Daytime sake bar with healthy lunches and spice curry (Tabelog) · over 50 sakes, poured in 90 ml, 60 ml or 45 ml (March 2026), cold or warmed in the warmer on the counter (May 2026) · lunch: daily set with a main, two small side dishes and miso soup ¥1,000 (May 2026); deluxe gozen of two daily dishes and a half spice curry with brown rice ¥1,300 (June 2026: stuffed peppers, hamburg steak, a curry of lotus root, edamame, chickpeas and kidney beans, with simmered white-fish head on the side); "Hirunomi Set" of two dishes, two small bowls and two 60 ml sakes ¥1,500 (May 2026); combination spice curry of mackerel green curry and a lotus-root-and-bean dry keema (July 2026); chicken tempura (June 2026) · evening: the chef's pasta on Thursdays, sanma pasta in September 2026 · Omi beef tendon and red konnyaku unohana with a glass of Kitajima sake ¥600, a Japanese Sake Go-Around Osaka set (October 2026)
places.notes: [Sake bar · Nishinakajima, daytime drinking by Shin-Osaka] A daytime sake bar a few minutes from Shin-Osaka Station, marked by a giant sake bottle out front, opened in 2021 to serve sake from noon: over 50 kinds, poured in 45, 60 or 90 ml so you can try several, cold or warmed in the warmer on the counter, and the owner chose a kanzake for one May 2026 diner. The food is light and home-style: ¥1,000–1,300 lunch plates of small side dishes and a half portion of spice curry over brown rice, heavy on beans and lotus root, or a ¥1,500 "Hirunomi Set" that comes with two small sakes (2026). One business traveller stopped in for lunch and two small sakes before the Shinkansen back to Nagoya (May 2026). Two people run it, so lunch can be slow, 40 minutes on one July 2026 day; come with time to spare. Thursdays bring the chef's pasta.

roles: Owner (unnamed) who chooses the warm sakes, and one other staff member
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: a daytime sake specialist at the gateway to Osaka, with healthy lunches and spice curry and over 50 sakes chosen to go with the side dishes, served warm from lunchtime; opened 6 January 2021. Reviewers: the owner chose a kanzake (May 2026); "There were only two staff members, so it took a little while to prepare the food" (May 2026); occasional sake events (May 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Homemade dishes that are gentle on the body," paired with sake (March 2026 review, quoting the shop).
chef_bio.specialty: Kanzake at noon; spice curry; Hirunomi Set.

anecdotes.text: "The standard serving is 90ml, but you can also choose 60ml or 45ml, which is great for those who want to try a variety." — March 2026.
"While chilled sake is great, it's wonderful to find a place that serves delicious kanzake." — May 2026, the JPY 1,500 lunch set with two sakes before a Shinkansen back to Nagoya.
"I entered the restaurant at 12:15 PM, but my food was served at 12:55 PM." — July 2026, the combination spice curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 新大阪昼呑み酒場 SAKE ヤシマ、居酒屋・日本酒バー、大阪市淀川区西中島7-9-15、月・土12:00〜18:00、水・木・金12:00〜21:30、火・日休み、予約可、カード (AMEX)・電子マネー・QR 可、18席、禁煙、貸切可、2021年1月6日オープン。店の紹介: 新大阪駅からすぐの昼から日本酒の店、体にやさしいランチとスパイスカレー、昼からお燗、おかずに合う50種以上の日本酒。口コミ(2026年3月〜10月): Midosuji 線7番出口から約3分、90ml、60ml、45ml、日替わり定食1,000円、日替わり2品と半分のスパイスカレーと玄米の御膳1,300円、ピーマンの肉詰め、ハンバーグ、レンコンと豆のカレー、白身魚のかぶと煮、日本酒2杯つきの昼呑みセット1,500円、サバのグリーンカレーとレンコンと豆のドライキーマ、とり天、木曜はシェフのパスタ、サンマのパスタ、Omi の牛すじと赤こんにゃくの卯の花、Kitajima の日本酒、店主が選ぶお燗、2階にテーブル、日本酒のイベント、スタッフ2人で昼は時間がかかる、大きな酒瓶の看板。

cultural_comfort.note: Sake by the small glass, cold or warmed; lunch sets of small dishes. No English evidence found.

places.name: 五條家 (Gojo Ya)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: every skewer is battered and deep-fried (kushikatsu).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase of fried skewers, mostly meat and seafood (beef, shrimp, eel, scallop, conger, squid with sea-urchin sauce); vegetable skewers come in the same run.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:30–22:00; closed Sat, Sun and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog), and reviewers advise phoning ahead (April, July and October 2025). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR payment (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥300 (Tabelog's original text: 席料300円). 12 seats at a U-shaped counter; smoking allowed (Tabelog; June 2020). Lunch, once a line-out for pork-cutlet sets, has stopped (a May 2021 review).
places.neighborhood: 西中島7-3-3, 末広ハイツ 101 — 10 min from JR Shin-Osaka, 6 min from the subway station (Tabelog); just south of Exit 7 of the Midosuji Line (June 2020), on a corner of back alleys west of Shin-Midosuji, easy to miss behind a sliding door (June 2022)
places.cuisine: Kushikatsu omakase only: skewers keep coming until you say stop, or a trial course of 10 for ¥2,500 (July 2025; January 2026) · four sauces on the counter, and you lay each skewer by the sauce it goes with (July 2025) · skewers named in 2025–2026: beef, shrimp, eel with tofu, chicken breast with yam, kisu with mitsuba, satoimo dengaku, okra with bacon and cheese, shimeji wrapped in meat, minced-onion stuffing, octopus, scallop, conger eel, quail egg, squid with sea-urchin sauce, kelp with roe, pork, negima, mochi with cheese · dessert: sorbet, and a fried chocolate skewer (July 2025) · sake, shochu, wine, beer (Tabelog; 2025)
places.notes: [Kushikatsu · Nishinakajima, a couple's creative skewer counter] A 12-seat U-shaped counter behind a sliding door and a white noren on a back-alley corner near Shin-Osaka, run by a long-serving couple (2020–2021 reviews). There is no menu to choose from: the chef fries small, light-battered skewers one at a time and sets them before you until you say stop, or you take a trial ten for ¥2,500 (2025–2026). The classics are here, beef and shrimp, but people come for the inventions: eel with tofu, okra with bacon and cheese, squid under sea-urchin sauce, kelp with roe, a sweet satoimo dengaku. Four sauces sit on the counter, and each skewer is laid beside the one it should meet. The skewers are small, so some diners leave wanting more (2025). Weekday evenings only; phone ahead. Smoking is allowed.

roles: Chef at the fryer and partner (an unnamed couple)
chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Reviewers: "The experienced couple running the place provides a warm atmosphere" (June 2020); a long-established kushikatsu restaurant run by a skilled chef and the chef's wife, which used to draw lines for its pork-cutlet lunch sets; the same diner believed lunch had stopped because "the couple is now elderly" (May 2021).

anecdotes.text: "Four types of sauces were placed on the table, and freshly fried skewers were served in a bamboo tube on the counter. You're supposed to place the skewer in the same spot as the sauce you want to use." — July 2025, the trial 10-skewer course for JPY 2,500.
"Before I knew it, I found myself saying, 'One more, one more,' and ended up completely overindulging, but I have no regrets whatsoever." — October 2025, the omakase.
"The skewer, coated in a thin and delicate batter, is surprisingly light and crispy." — January 2026, the 10-skewer omakase for JPY 2,500.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 五條家、串揚げ、大阪市淀川区西中島7-3-3 末広ハイツ101、JR 新大阪駅から徒歩10分、地下鉄 新大阪駅から6分、月〜金17:30〜22:00、土・日・祝休み、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、席料300円、12席 (カウンターのみ)、喫煙可。口コミ(2020年6月〜2026年1月): Midosuji 線7番出口の南、路地のかど、白いのれんと串かつのちょうちん、引き戸、U 字のカウンター、ベテランの夫婦が切り盛り、昔は昼のとんかつ定食に行列、今は夜だけ、おまかせのみで「ストップ」まで、お試し10本2,500円、ソースは4種類で串を置く場所で決まる、牛肉、エビ、うなぎと豆腐、鶏むねと山芋、キスと三つ葉、里芋の田楽、オクラとベーコンとチーズ、しめじの肉巻き、ホタテ、穴子、うずら、イカのウニソース、子持ち昆布、豚、ねぎま、もちチーズ、デザートにシャーベットとチョコレートの串、電話で予約がおすすめ、串は小さめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Omakase only, skewers until you say stop; book by phone. No English evidence found.

places.name: 大阪泉佐野港 活鮨 グランフロント大阪店 (Osaka Izumisano Ko Katsu Zushi Guranfuronto oosaka ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sushi and tempura come with flavoured salts (matcha, hojicha, genmaicha, sweet potato) as well as the usual soy sauce, which normally contains wheat; the tempura skewers are wheat-battered.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and tempura bar; vegetable tempura (shiitake, onion, corn, lotus root, eggplant) appears in 2026 reviews, fried alongside seafood.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00, last order 21:00; closing days follow Grand Front Osaka; hours may change at New Year, Golden Week and Obon (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); easy to get in around 17:00 (September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay, PayPay (Tabelog). 20 seats: 14 at the counter and three tables for two; non-smoking (smoking area in the building); children welcome; picture menu; paid parking in the building (Tabelog). Opened 1 March 2026 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Grand Front Osaka South Building B1F — 3 min from JR Osaka Stn
places.cuisine: Sushi from ¥80 a piece, with fish from the ports, and skewered tempura (Tabelog) · fish delivered by wholesalers from Izumisano port (August 2026) · sets: nigiri and sashimi set (7 nigiri, 2 sashimi, red miso soup) ¥2,980; omakase 8-piece nigiri ¥2,680; omakase tempura assortment ¥1,050 (August–September 2026); lunch sets of tempura skewers and nigiri (October 2026) · nigiri topped with edible flowers and a different condiment on each piece; salts from a Kyoto tea shop: matcha, hojicha, genmaicha, sweet potato (August–September 2026) · tempura of shrimp, lotus root, shiitake, corn, eggplant, shishito; red snow crab gratin; sushi-shop potato salad; conger tempura (August–September 2026) · a seafood bowl (Tabelog); the shop's own sake and local sake
places.notes: [Sushi · Umeda, Grand Front Osaka South B1F] The Osaka branch of a Kyoto sushi bar known for queues, opened in March 2026 in the basement of Grand Front Osaka's south building, three minutes from the station. Nigiri start at ¥80 a piece and come dressed for the camera: edible flowers, a different condiment on each piece, and a row of coloured salts from a Kyoto tea shop (matcha, hojicha, genmaicha, sweet potato) for the sushi and the skewered tempura. Sets run about ¥2,700–3,000 for eight or nine pieces, tempura ¥1,050, and lunch sets suit a quick meal. Most 2026 diners liked the look and freshness; one September diner waited over 20 minutes for food, disliked staff working the register in blue gloves, and judged it aimed at visitors. Counter seats suit solo diners.

roles: Sushi chefs (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.origin: Second shop of a popular Kyoto sushi restaurant (Tabelog); an affiliated shop is in the Osaka Fukoku Seimei Building (Tabelog remarks).
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): fresh seafood from local waters and fishing ports, prepared by skilled chefs, from ¥80 a piece; sake, tempura and side dishes; for sightseers and after-work diners. Opened 1 March 2026. A review describes the concept as "see, eat, and enjoy" sushi (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Sushi to see as well as eat (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Flower-topped nigiri with tea salts; skewered tempura.

anecdotes.text: "The matcha salt and hojicha salt made from tea leaves sourced from a tea shop in Kyoto were also impressive." — August 2026.
"What sets this sushi apart is that each piece is topped with a different condiment, making it visually stunning" — September 2026.
"Even though it wasn't busy, it took over 20 minutes from ordering to receiving my food." — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Picture menu (Tabelog); counter seats for solo diners; one diner thought it aimed at overseas visitors (September 2026). No English menu listed.

places.name: 北新地 宿 (Kitashinchi Yado)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi, seasonal dishes and a sea-bream kamameshi (June 2026) are usually seasoned with soy sauce, which normally contains wheat.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya and course restaurant (sashimi, fugu, sea bream, meat dishes).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 18:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); Sat 18:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Sundays, holidays, Golden Week, Obon and New Year (Tabelog). Reservations: the shop phones to confirm the number given; write any end time in the request (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay for bills over ¥4,000; no e-money (Tabelog). 17 seats: counter and private rooms for 4, 6 and 8; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed, including paper cigarettes, with separate smoking rooms in the private rooms (Tabelog; March and June 2026); a December 2025 diner at the counter was bothered by the smoke. Opened 9 July 2018 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kitashinchi, サウザンドビル 3F, at the top of the stairs from Kitashinchi Stn exit 11-21 — 1 min away
places.cuisine: Seafood and seasonal Japanese dishes by a chef trained at well-known Japanese restaurants, who picks fish at the market every morning, with rare fish and local sake (Tabelog) · courses: standard course with all-you-can-drink ¥7,500 (9 dishes); omakase premium with all-you-can-drink ¥10,500; omakase, food only ¥8,500 (Tabelog, tax included); a ¥7,000 all-you-can-drink course in July 2026, sake not included in the standard drinks · à la carte too (July 2026) · sashimi platters from ports around Japan, once with fugu (December 2025, March 2026); sea-bream kamameshi (June 2026) · a range of sake, though one May 2026 diner found the sake list short
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kitashinchi, fish at the top of the station stairs] A small third-floor izakaya right at the top of the stairs from Kitashinchi station, with a counter and private rooms. The chef, trained at well-known Japanese restaurants, buys fish at the market each morning, so the sashimi platters (fugu on one March 2026 visit) change daily, and there is a sea-bream kamameshi to finish. Courses with all-you-can-drink start at about ¥7,000–7,500; à la carte is extensive. Diners praise the fish and the attentive staff; others found prices high, drinks slow (May 2026), and the counter smoky, since smoking is allowed. Open until midnight on weekdays; closed Sundays and holidays.

roles: Chef (unnamed), trained at well-known Japanese restaurants (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): the chef honed skills at renowned Japanese restaurants and visits the market every morning to choose fresh seafood, offering a daily menu of rare fish not found elsewhere, with local sake to match. Opened 9 July 2018.
chef_bio.philosophy: Daily fish from the market, cooked with care (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The sashimi is exquisite! They source seasonal fish from various fishing ports, so you won't find the same offerings elsewhere." — December 2025.
"Everything was delicious, but the sashimi platter included fugu (pufferfish), which really delighted my companion!" — March 2026, a first visit.
"The standard all-you-can-drink option does not include Japanese sake, so you can either upgrade or order it separately." — July 2026, the ¥7,000 course.

cultural_comfort.note: Courses or à la carte; the shop phones to confirm bookings (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

places.name: 北新地 焼鳥 Kawaguchi (Kitashinchi Yakitori Kawaguchi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Yakitori may be salted or brushed with tare, which is usually soy-based and contains wheat; ask for salt. The meal often ends with grilled rice-ball chazuke.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori restaurant built on whole Tamba black chickens.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:30–22:00, last order 21:30; closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Same-day bookings welcome, but same-day cancellations are not accepted with only 13 seats; private rooms for four or more by phone only; call if Tabelog shows full (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 13 seats at the counter plus private rooms (Tabelog). Smoking: allowed per Tabelog; only in the private rooms per a September 2025 review. Opened 21 February 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kitashinchi, 小西ビル 3F, opposite the Karaoke Kan by exit C60 of Kitashinchi Stn — 2 min away
places.cuisine: Yakitori of Tamba black chicken, each bird butchered in the shop for rare cuts; raw white liver of Kyo-Tanba black chicken (Tabelog) · omakase course or à la carte (2024–2026 reviews) · à la carte in January 2025: seseri tataki ¥1,200, thigh tataki ¥1,500, skewers ¥350 (special mince, skin); chicken sashimi platter; daki-mi and tsukune (July 2026); liver (October 2026) · grilled rice-ball chazuke to finish; pudding · house curry in pouches to take home (September 2025) · wine, sake and shochu chosen to pair (July 2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Kitashinchi, Tamba black chicken] A thirteen-seat yakitori counter with private rooms, up in a building opposite the Karaoke Kan by Kitashinchi station, that butchers whole Tamba black chickens each day so it can serve rare cuts and even raw white liver. Order the omakase course or à la carte (skewers from about ¥350, seared seseri or thigh tataki); diners single out the daki-mi, the tsukune and the liver, and nearly everyone ends with the grilled rice-ball chazuke. Expect ¥10,000–15,000 a head with drinks. Diners describe a friendly owner and bright staff, and in September 2026 a young chef at the grill; a few earlier diners found service brisk or skewers coming too fast. Weekdays only.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): authentic yakitori; each Tamba black chicken prepared individually from the whole bird; "Only Kawaguchi Offers White Liver Sashimi from Kyo-Tanba Black Chicken!"; the shop is only in Kitashinchi and unrelated to similarly named shops. Opened 21 February 2017.
chef_bio.philosophy: Whole birds prepared in house for rare cuts (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Tamba black chicken yakitori; white liver sashimi; grilled rice-ball chazuke.

anecdotes.text: "The portion sizes for the courses are just right", and the amount can be adjusted on request — September 2025.
"Recently, a relatively young chef has been grilling, and the quality here is top-notch." — September 2026.
"To finish off, the grilled rice balls with tea were delightful" — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter yakitori, course or à la carte; private rooms booked by phone (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

places.name: 串カツ＆ワインバル ゑしぇ蔵 (Kushi Katsu & Wine Bar Eshezo)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kushikatsu in batter and two kinds of breadcrumbs (Tabelog), fried in shared cottonseed oil.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kushikatsu of wagyu, seafood, abalone and foie gras alongside vegetables, all in the same oil.
places.hours_raw: Kushikatsu 17:00–23:00, last kushikatsu order 21:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations recommended (counter only, full on a March 2026 Friday); a booking may be cancelled after 30 minutes without a call (Tabelog). Non-smoking 17:00–22:00 (22:30 in another note), ashtray at the door; smoking allowed after that (Tabelog). Bring-your-own cake free; private wine events for 10–13 with ¥1,100 corkage; private lunch hire 13:00–16:00 for 4–5 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 11 counter seats; children welcome; dislikes and allergies asked (Tabelog). Opened 28 September 2016 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kitashinchi, 第3シンコービル 2F — 1 min from Nishi-Umeda Stn, 2 min from Kitashinchi Stn
places.cuisine: Kushikatsu of ingredients from western Japan (wagyu, fresh seafood, abalone, foie gras, seasonal vegetables), fried in cottonseed oil in two kinds of breadcrumbs; seven kushikatsu courses or single skewers (Tabelog) · about 100 drinks in a sommelier-chosen all-you-can-drink (2 hours), all staff sommeliers (Tabelog) · 10th-anniversary offers (Tabelog): 15 skewers and ice cream ¥4,950 (19 October–30 November), all-you-can-drink ¥2,750 more; 11-skewer course with a three-sake tasting (Jūyondai, Aramasa Cosmos, Jikon) and all-you-can-drink ¥8,800 (November); a stop-when-you-like format · special 12-skewer course ¥8,800 (May 2026) with snow-crab cream croquette, abalone, seafood fried sushi, foie gras, Tanba chicken (March 2026) · casual 9-skewer course: Yamato pork, Awaji onion, black wagyu, Ehime sea bream, Tokushima shiitake, shrimp, asparagus (June 2026) · unlimited cabbage, burdock salad, five sauces; sushi, olive somen and espresso ice cream to finish (2026)
places.notes: [Kushikatsu · Kitashinchi, an eleven-seat counter with a big drinks list] A second-floor kushikatsu counter a minute from Nishi-Umeda station, where every staff member is a sommelier and the all-you-can-drink runs to about a hundred wines and sakes, rare bottles included. Skewers of western-Japan produce (Nara pork, Awaji onion, Ehime sea bream, black wagyu, abalone, foie gras) come fresh from cottonseed oil in a thin batter, with five sauces and unlimited cabbage, and courses end with sushi, olive somen and ice cream. Courses run about ¥5,000–8,800; a 10th-anniversary 15-skewer course was ¥4,950 in autumn 2026. Diners call it a place they return to; one September 2026 diner found little for non-drinkers beyond oolong tea. Counter only, so book. Smoking allowed late in the evening.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a kushikatsu specialist using carefully selected ingredients from western Japan; high-quality cottonseed oil; fresh and roasted breadcrumbs matched to each ingredient; seven courses; a premium all-you-can-drink of about 100 drinks chosen by a sommelier; "All Staff are Sommeliers". Opened 28 September 2016; tenth anniversary in 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Bring out each ingredient in a thin, crisp batter (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: "I was blown away by the thin batter that highlighted the ingredients." — March 2026, a Friday when the counter was fully booked.
"October 1st is Sake Day. After enjoying three special types of sake, we dove into the all-you-can-drink option for adults." — October 2026.
"The only soft drink available was Oolong tea, and there were very few other beverages, making it a bit difficult to bring non-sake drinkers along." — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter of 11; staff explain each skewer and suggest drinks (2026). No English evidence found.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Tabelog: "We will also ask you about any food you don't like or allergies."

places.name: アマーク ド パラディ (Hamac de Paradis)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The signature is a breaded cream croquette with demi-glace, and lunches come with bread or rice; pasta and cakes fill much of the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog marks vegetarian options, but there is no vegan information; the croquette is a cream filling and most plates use meat or fish.
places.hours_raw: Daily: lunch 11:30–15:00, dinner 17:00–21:00, café and drinks 11:30–21:30 (last orders), closing 22:00 (official site); Tabelog gives dinner from 17:30. Open year-round (Tabelog). Lunch can be booked only at weekends and holidays for 11:30–12:00; seat-only bookings are limited to 90 minutes when busy; café-only visits cannot be booked (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay (Tabelog). 112 seats: 42 at tables on 1F and 2F around an atrium, a 10-seat counter, and a 3F sofa room for up to 60–70 with karaoke and a projector for private hire; non-smoking (Tabelog). Since 1995 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Minami-Senba 4-12-21 — 3 min from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 3 or Yotsubashi Stn exit 1A
places.cuisine: Modern bistro of simple European cooking with seasonal touches, and a café (official site; Tabelog) · the signature croquette, loved since the shop opened (official site): a creamy filling full of mushrooms and porcini under a crisp crust, with demi-glace (October 2026) · croquette lunch ¥1,200 with bread or rice and salad (October 2026); daily main plate with rice ¥1,200, croquette added ¥300 (September 2026); drink with lunch +¥200; half an angel-food cake ¥300; daily pasta (October 2026) · anniversary course ¥5,000, all-you-can-drink +¥1,800, with a message plate (Tabelog) · party courses with appetizers, pasta and bone-in spare ribs (September 2026) · over 50 wines, mainly Italian, chosen by a sommelier (Tabelog) · desserts such as tiramisu and chocolate cake
places.notes: [Bistro and café · Minami-Senba, the croquette lunch] A big, long-running Minami-Senba bistro and café open since 1995, black and white with modern art, mosaic tiles and a striking 'Dear Ingo' lamp, with a counter and tables around a two-storey atrium. Lunch is what fills it with nearby office workers: the house croquette, crisp outside and creamy with mushrooms and porcini, under demi-glace, with fresh-baked bread or rice and a salad with a homemade dressing for ¥1,200 (October 2026). Evenings bring a seasonal bistro menu with more than 50 wines, mainly Italian, and party courses; a third-floor sofa room with karaoke takes groups. Daily events (a free drink one day, Halloween candy for a password another) are posted on Instagram. One diner found the portions small but the cooking careful (September 2026).

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a café and restaurant in Minami-Senba since 1995, "an established presence" with counter seats and an atrium; a dynamic lamp by Dear Ingo, monochrome decor with modern art and mosaic tiles; the croquette has been loved since the founding. Tabelog: featured on the TV show "Gochi ni Narimasu!" on 20 April 2023; over 50 wines, mainly Italian. A diner in October 2026 mentions sister restaurants.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Simple, modern European cooking with seasonal colour" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Cream croquette with mushrooms and demi-glace.

anecdotes.text: "The croquette was a rich cream croquette with a strong porcini flavor, and the daily dessert was a decadent chocolate cake." — October 2026, lunch.
"By noon, the place was packed with people from nearby offices coming in for lunch." — October 2026, a weekday.
"They have some kind of event every day, and since Halloween is approaching, if you say the secret phrase, you get a free piece of candy!" — October 2026, croquette lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: Hamac de Paradis アマーク・ド・パラディ、心斎橋・南船場のモダンビストロ、since 1995、南船場の中でも老舗の存在感、LIVE感を楽しむカウンター席・吹き抜け空間、Dear Ingo のライト、モノクロを基調にモダンアートやモザイクタイル、シンプルモダンな欧風料理に季節の彩り、日替わりプレート、創業時から愛される名物コロッケ (外はサクサク、中はホクホク、手作り)、パーティーや結婚式の二次会、最大50名までの貸切、LUNCH 11:30〜15:00 (l.o.)、DINNER 17:00〜21:00 (l.o.)、CAFE DRINK 11:30〜21:30 (l.o.)、CLOSE 22:00、大阪市中央区南船場4-12-21。食べログ (店舗会員): 年中無休、ランチの予約は土日祝の11:30〜12:00のみ、混雑時は90分、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、112席 (1・2階テーブル42、カウンター10、3階ソファ席60)、3階はカラオケとプロジェクター、禁煙、ベジタリアンメニューあり、イタリアを中心に50種以上のワイン、記念日コース5,000円 (飲み放題1,800円)、2023年4月20日の「Gochi ni Narimasu!」に出演。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 名物のコロッケランチ1,200円 (パンかご飯)、きのことポルチーニのクリームコロッケとデミグラス、日替わりプレート1,200円にコロッケ300円、ランチのドリンク200円、エンゼルケーキのハーフ300円、近くの会社員で満席、毎日のイベント (ハロウィンのキャンディなど)、量は少なめという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Set lunches from a short menu; a lively, casual room (2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: カフェ シャルボン (CAFE CHARBON)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Lunches come with bread (refills) or rice, and the mains are pasta, pizza, risotto and sauced meats; the salad bar is the plainest part.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The lunch salad bar has fresh vegetables and vegetable obanzai with soup; the mains are meat, fish, cheese and cream.
places.hours_raw: Sun–Thu and holidays 11:30–22:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); Fri, Sat and nights before holidays 11:30–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); lunch menu until 14:30, then the café menu; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, but not for café-only visits at lunch or dinner time; groups by phone (Tabelog); some weekend days are booked out for parties (September 2026). No cover charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 65 seats with sofa seats and a private room; private hire up to 100 seated (weddings, reunions); non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Ordering by QR code (October 2026). Opened 8 December 1999 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kitahorie 1-6-23 — 1 min from Yotsubashi Stn exit 4, 3 min from Shinsaibashi
places.cuisine: Café and Italian-leaning dining (Tabelog) · lunch: choose a main and help yourself to a salad bar of fresh vegetables, vegetable obanzai and soup (September 2026); hashed pork with bread and three homemade jams ¥1,000 (September 2026); a daily special, e.g. pork kimchi on Thursdays, with rice in your choice of size (September 2026); pasta, pizza, risotto, steak (2026 reviews) · "Smart Lunch Course" ¥2,500: welcome drink, an appetizer plate with ham salad, pasta or risotto, dessert, coffee, with bread refills (October 2026) · café: lattes with latte art, tiramisu and other cakes (October 2026) · birthday dessert plate ¥1,500 (Tabelog) · courses for parties and weddings (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Café · Kitahorie, a converted lumber warehouse] One of the long-running cafés of the Horie side of Shinsaibashi, open since 1999 in a renovated timber warehouse with an eight-metre ceiling, exposed wooden beams, big windows and candlelight at night, a minute from Yotsubashi Station. Lunch is the value: pick a main (hashed pork, a daily special, pasta, risotto or pizza) and help yourself to a salad bar of fresh vegetables, obanzai and soup, with bread, rice and homemade jams; the hashed pork was ¥1,000 in September 2026, and a ¥2,500 lunch course adds a drink, an appetizer plate and dessert. In the afternoon it is a café for a latte and cake; at night it books out for parties and even weddings. Ordering is by QR code; one diner disliked that and the rushed payment, another found the steak average (October 2026).

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a stylish, long-established café of the Shinsaibashi and Horie area, a renovated lumber warehouse with an 8 m ceiling and wooden interior lit by candles at night; menus centred on Italian cooking; private hire for weddings, reunions and company events. Opened 8 December 1999.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch with a salad bar; pasta and risotto.

anecdotes.text: "The meal came with a salad bar, which had a decent variety of options, along with soup ... There were also three types of jam available for unlimited servings." — September 2026, hashed pork lunch ¥1,000.
"The exposed wooden beams on the ceiling create a retro and warm space." — October 2026, an evening drink.
"Just be careful not to get too caught up in the appetizers, or the carbonara might get cold!" — September 2026, a regular.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): カフェ シャルボン (CAFE CHARBON)、カフェ・イタリアン・バー、大阪市西区北堀江1-6-23、四ツ橋駅4番出口から徒歩1分、日〜木・祝11:30〜22:00 (料理L.O.21:00)、金・土・祝前日11:30〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:00)、ランチは14:30 L.O.、その後はカフェメニュー、不定休、予約可 (ランチとディナーの時間はカフェのみの予約不可、団体は電話で)、チャージなし、カード・Suica・PayPay 可、65席、貸切は着席100名まで、禁煙、Wi-Fi、誕生日のデザートプレート1,500円、1999年12月8日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 心斎橋・堀江の老舗のおしゃれなカフェ、材木倉庫を改装した天井8メートルの空間、夜はキャンドル、イタリアンを中心にしたコース、結婚式の二次会や同窓会も。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): メインを選んで前菜とサラダバー、スープは食べ放題、ハッシュドポーク1,000円とパン、3種のジャム、木曜の日替わりは豚キムチ、パスタ、ピザ、リゾット、ステーキ、スマートランチコース2,500円、ラテアート、ティラミス、QR コードで注文、週末は貸切の日も、会計を急かされたという声。

places.name: 中国料理 大成閣 (Chinese Taiseikaku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Cantonese and Sichuan dishes with soy and oyster sauces, dumplings, noodles and battered fried dishes.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Chinese set meals and banquets of pork, seafood and chicken.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (food last order 20:45, drinks 21:00); New Year (3 January), Obon (13–15 August) and Golden Week 11:00–22:00 straight; closed 30 December–2 January (Tabelog). Takeaway daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–20:30, ordered ahead by phone or fax; Uber Eats and Demae-can (Tabelog). Reservations by the day before; private rooms need a course (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). Six floors, about 1,500 seats, up to 400 on one floor; private rooms for 2 to over 30, tatami and sofa rooms, karaoke; non-smoking with a smoking room on 2F; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; discount at the partner car park (Tabelog). Founded 1953, per the listing (the Tabelog opening-day field reads 12 October 1958).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-18-12 — 2 min from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 5 or 6
places.cuisine: Long-established Chinese restaurant for lunch and banquets (Tabelog) · lunch sets ¥1,000 (¥1,100 with tax): a main dish with rice, soup, salad and pickles, refills included, plus free congee, self-service coffee and, while they last, sweet-potato snacks (September–October 2026); e.g. sweet-and-sour pork set ¥1,100, green-pepper pork, mapo tofu with fried rice (2026 reviews) · limited matsutake ramen and fried-rice set ¥2,310 (October 2026) · tantanmen with bean sprouts and boiled dumplings (October 2026) · à la carte in August 2026: crab fried rice ¥1,320, black-bean mapo tofu ¥1,100, Hong Kong-style chili prawns ¥1,980, seafood stir-fry ¥1,870 · banquet and private-room courses; takeaway and delivery
places.notes: [Chinese · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, six floors since the 1950s] A Higashi-Shinsaibashi landmark of Chinese cooking for over 70 years, six floors and some 1,500 seats of Showa-modern Chinese decor, two minutes from Shinsaibashi Station. It is busiest at lunch, when ¥1,100 buys a set of sweet-and-sour pork, mapo tofu or another main with refills of rice and soup, salad, pickles, free congee and self-service coffee, and sweet-potato snacks while they last. In the evening the floors fill with banquets, weddings and reunions; à la carte runs to crab fried rice (¥1,320) and Hong Kong-style chili prawns (¥1,980). Diners in 2026 call it good value and nostalgic; one returning after ten years found it neither good nor bad. Takeaway and delivery too.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: founded in 1953 and marking its 70th anniversary; six versatile floors for one person up to about 400, used for lunch, banquets, year-end and New Year parties, reunions, concerts and weddings; featured on TV and in magazines; an online shop (taiseikaku.easy-myshop.jp). The Tabelog opening-day field gives 12 October 1958. Diners in 2026 describe coming since childhood and a Showa-modern interior.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets with free congee; banquet courses.

anecdotes.text: "For just JPY 1000 (tax included JPY 1100), you can choose a main Chinese dish, with all-you-can-eat rice, soup, salad, and pickles included." — September 2026.
"A long-established Chinese restaurant located just a short walk from Shinsaibashi Station, which I've been visiting since childhood!" — August 2026.
"As soon as the tea was placed on the table, they served the 'porridge.'" — October 2026, the matsutake ramen set ¥2,310.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 中国料理 大成閣 (タイセイカク)、中華料理・飲茶、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-18-12、心斎橋駅5・6番出口から徒歩2分、毎日11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.20:45)、12月30日〜1月2日休み、テイクアウト (電話・FAX で予約)、Uber Eats と Demae-can、予約は前日まで、個室はコースのみ、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、約1,500席 (1フロア400名まで)、6フロア、個室、座敷、ソファ席、カラオケ、禁煙 (2階に喫煙室)、車いす可、Wi-Fi、提携駐車場の割引。店の紹介 (英訳): 1953年創業、70周年、テレビや雑誌でも紹介、ランチ、宴会、忘年会、新年会、同窓会、コンサート、結婚式、オンラインショップ。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): ランチ1,000円 (税込1,100円) でご飯・スープ・サラダ・漬物はおかわり自由、お粥とコーヒーはセルフでサービス、さつまいものお菓子、酢豚の定食1,100円、松茸ラーメンとチャーハンのセット2,310円、担々麺と水餃子、カニチャーハン1,320円、麻婆豆腐1,100円、エビチリ1,980円、海鮮炒め1,870円、昭和モダンの雰囲気、子どものころから通う、良くも悪くもないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Set lunches from a short list; large banquet floors (2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: みなみの十忠八九 (Minami no Jucchu Hakku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Signatures include a breaded rare salmon fry and crab gratin, with tempura, oden and sashimi with soy sauce.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; oden and appetizers are in dashi.
places.hours_raw: Sun–Thu, holidays and the day after 17:00–01:00; Fri, Sat and nights before holidays 17:00–02:00 (Tabelog). Reservations recommended, often full (2026 reviews); a 2-hour limit when busy; a booking may be cancelled if you are 15 minutes late without contact; groups and private hire by phone (Tabelog). A walk-in on a holiday had 50 minutes to last order (September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 40 seats over 1F and 2F with a counter and sofa seats; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Menus in English, simplified Chinese and Korean, with photos (Tabelog). Opened 16 March 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Namba 4-2-6, 1F–2F of the トシヒサビル, in the back streets — 1 min from Namba Stn (Midosuji Line)
places.cuisine: Seafood izakaya with a wide range of sake (Tabelog) · signatures: a seafood yukhoe plate and fresh salmon fried rare (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · crab gratin with crab legs, grilled tuna cheek, assorted oden, horse sashimi soaked in broth, a mash-it-yourself potato salad with soft egg, hamo tempura, seafood kamameshi, crab-miso tofu as the starter (October 2026) · salmon sashimi (September 2026) · banquet courses with all-you-can-drink sake ¥4,000–8,000 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Namba, a minute from the station] A busy two-floor seafood izakaya in the back streets a minute from Namba Station, part of a small group whose main shop is a fish shop in Fukushima, open until 1 a.m. (2 a.m. at weekends) and hard to get into without a booking. The two dishes everyone orders are the seafood yukhoe plate and the salmon fried rare under sauce and condiments; then crab gratin crowned with crab legs, grilled tuna cheek, oden, horse sashimi in broth or a potato salad you mash yourself, with plenty of sake. Diners in 2026 praised the prices, the freshness and the fast, friendly staff; one found the sashimi platter and beer small for the money (October 2026). Menus in English, Chinese and Korean.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a casual eatery and tavern of fresh seafood and Japanese sake in the back streets of Namba; part of the Jucchu Hakku group with Fish Shop Jucchu Hakku Fukushima Main Store, Ohatsu no Jucchu Hakku and a bar in Fukushima (names as on the English listing). Opened 16 March 2023.
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood yukhoe plate; salmon rare fry.

anecdotes.text: "The highlight was the grilled tuna cheek—so tender and melt-in-your-mouth delicious." — October 2026.
"The Salmon Rare Fry was generously topped with sauce and condiments. The Gratin was impressively presented with crab legs" — October 2026, on a trip to Osaka.
"Even around 9 PM, it was fully booked. I think it's quite difficult to walk in without a reservation." — September 2025, a repeat visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): みなみの十忠八九 (ミナミノジュッチュウハック)、居酒屋・海鮮・日本酒バー、大阪市中央区難波4-2-6 トシヒサビル 1F・2F、地下鉄なんば駅から徒歩1分、日〜木・祝17:00〜翌1:00、金・土・祝前日17:00〜翌2:00、予約可 (混雑時は2時間制、15分連絡がないと取り消すことも、団体と貸切は電話で)、カード・PayPay 可、40席、カウンター、ソファ席、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、Wi-Fi、英語・中国語 (簡体字)・韓国語のメニュー、写真つき、2023年3月16日オープン、グループ店は Fish Shop Jucchu Hakku Fukushima Main Store、Ohatsu no Jucchu Hakku など。店の紹介 (英訳): なんばの裏通りの鮮魚と日本酒の大衆食堂・酒場、名物は海鮮ユッケ盛りとサーモンのレアフライ、日本酒飲み放題つきの宴会コース4,000〜8,000円。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年10月): サーモンのレアカツ、海鮮ユッケ、カニのグラタン、マグロのほほ肉の焼き物、おでん、だしに漬けた馬刺し、自分でつぶすポテトサラダ、鱧の天ぷら、海鮮の釜飯、お通しのカニみそ豆腐、いつも満席なので予約を、スタッフが親切で早い、刺身の盛り合わせとビールが値段のわりに小さいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, simplified Chinese and Korean, with photos (Tabelog).

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream cakes, tarts and pancakes; nothing is described as vegan.

Reservations accepted, e.g. for the lunch set (October 2026); lines at weekend afternoons (November 2026). places.cuisine: Hotel-lounge-style café with breakfast, lunch, cake and a dessert buffet (Tabelog) · large seasonal fruit tarts: Shine Muscat, peach and fig (September 2026), fig and chestnut (September 2026), a half-size pair allowed (September 2026); fruit tart and Mont Blanc with café latte (November 2026); cheese tart, tea roll cake, strawberry shortcake (October 2026) · the Kahala hotel's thin pancakes ("Shimpancake"), crêpe-like, with sauce (2025–2026 reviews) · salad lunch of salad, soup, bread, drink and cake ¥2,500 (October 2026); omurice; mixed sandwich · wine and cocktails
places.notes: [Café · Namba, big fruit tarts in Takashimaya's restaurant lobby] A large hotel-lounge-style café full of sofas on the seventh floor of Takashimaya's Namba Dining Maison, open until 10 pm. The cakes are the point: tall seasonal fruit tarts (Shine Muscat, peach, fig, chestnut in autumn 2026), Mont Blanc, cheese tart and a strawberry shortcake one diner called huge, and the Kahala hotel's thin, crêpe-like pancakes, which bring one regular back once or twice a year. There is a lunch with salad, soup and a slice of cake (¥2,500) and a dessert buffet. Prices are hotel-level, and in October 2026 one diner found the lunch salad small and the cake slice thin, another the service stretched.

roles: Operator and staff unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: Opened 2 March 2010 (Tabelog), in Takashimaya Osaka's Namba Dining Maison; its official page (rtg.jp) refused access when read. Reviewers come back for the fruit tarts and for the Kahala hotel's pancakes served here (2025–2026); one found the staff guided a solo diner kindly to a sofa (September 2026).

anecdotes.text: "I visit this place once or twice a year because I can enjoy the famous Shimpancake from Kahala Hotel here." — October 2026.
"The fruit tart was consistently delicious, and the Mont Blanc had a hint of liqueur, giving it a more sophisticated flavor." — November 2026, a sixth visit.
"The taste was delicious, but I was surprised by the small portion of the salad and the thinness of the cake." — October 2026, salad lunch ¥2,500.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): LOBBY CAFE FASCINO、カフェ・ケーキ・ビュッフェ、難波5-1-18 なんばダイニングメゾン 7F、なんば駅から徒歩5分、毎日10:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、大阪高島屋の休館日は休み、クリスマス・年末年始・ゴールデンウィークは土日祝のプラン、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、100席、ソファ席、禁煙、子ども可、テイクアウト、モーニング、デザートビュッフェ、オープン2010年3月2日、ホテルのラウンジのような空間。口コミ(2025年11月〜2026年11月): Shine Muscat、桃、いちじくのタルト、いちじくと栗のタルト、ハーフサイズで2種、フルーツタルトとモンブラン、チーズタルト、紅茶のロールケーキ、いちごのショートケーキ、Kahala Hotel のパンケーキ (Shimpancake)、クレープのよう、サラダランチ2,500円 (サラダ、スープ、パン、飲み物、ケーキ)、オムライス、ミックスサンド、夜10時まで、日曜の午後は行列、値段はホテル並み、サラダが少なくケーキが薄いという声、スタッフが少ないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Department-store café with sofa seating; staff seat you (2026). No English evidence found.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Cuts come with sauce or salt, and the menu has yukgaejang, cold noodles and other noodles; nothing is stated about wheat.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a black-wagyu yakiniku restaurant; namul, kimchi and grilled vegetables are sides.
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–02:00 (Tabelog). Reservations recommended (most guests book, October 2026); same-day cancellations by phone at least 2 hours ahead; children under 12 by phone booking only; 1 hour 45 minutes when busy (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC and QUICPay, PayPay (Tabelog). 28 seats with a counter; hire for 20–50; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 3 March 2024 (Tabelog).
