places.cuisine: Yakiniku of black wagyu chosen for its balance of fat and lean, at moderate prices, with "five-star master blend" rice cooked in a clay pot (Tabelog) · signatures: thick-cut tongue and premium kalbi (Tabelog) · from 2026 reviews: special premium salted tongue grilled with spices, special outside skirt, premium loin, premium mountain-chain tripe, local chicken thigh, fresh grilled liver, thick loin, ribeye, a three-cut platter of loin, tenderloin and flap, mixed horumon; fresh heart sashimi, raw omasum, yukhoe grilled hard; avocado kimchi, namul, kakuteki, mushroom namul; thick-cut yam and roast sweet potato; green-chili dishes; yukgaejang, cold noodles and other noodles · beef fat served for the grill (September 2026) · sake, shochu, wine
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, thick-cut wagyu late into the night] A lively third-floor yakiniku room near Shinsaibashi Station, opened in 2024, open until 2 am every night and usually full of bookings, its walls already covered in signed photos. Cuts are notably thick: the special premium salted tongue grilled with spices, outside skirt and loin, plus fresh grilled liver that diners single out, raw heart and omasum, and a clay-pot rice. The young staff serve fast and are easy to call over. One regular on a third visit (October 2026) recommends it to anyone craving yakiniku in Minami; one October 2026 diner's order went missing on a busy night. Smoking is allowed.

roles: Owner and staff unnamed; a young team (October 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 March 2024 (Tabelog), selling carefully selected black wagyu at reasonable prices with clay-pot rice (Tabelog shop text). Diners describe mostly young, friendly staff, very fast service, many signed photos of celebrities on the walls, and a fully booked room (2026). An October 2026 diner came on another yakiniku owner's recommendation.
chef_bio.specialty: Thick-cut tongue; premium kalbi; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "The grilled items, including special premium salt tongue, special outside skirt, premium loin, premium mountain chain tripe, and local chicken thigh, were undoubtedly top quality. The fresh grilled liver was incredibly tender!" — October 2026, a third visit.
"The highlight here is undoubtedly the thickly sliced tongue, which is tender and packed with flavor that intensifies with each bite." — September 2026.
"The owner of the yakiniku restaurant mentioned that this place is really great, so I decided to check it out right away." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Yakiniku Kinashi、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、東心斎橋1-19-5 ウィステリア心斎橋ビル 3F、心斎橋駅から徒歩3分、毎日17:00〜翌2:00、当日キャンセルは2時間前までに電話、12歳未満の子どもは電話予約のみ、混雑時は1時間45分制、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、28席、貸切20〜50名、喫煙可、オープン2024年3月3日。店の説明: 厳選した黒毛和牛をリーズナブルに、脂と赤身のバランス、五ツ星お米マイスターのブレンドの銀シャリを土鍋で、名物は厚切りタンと上カルビ。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 特上塩タン、特上ハラミ、上ロース、上ミノ、地鶏のもも、生レバーの焼き、厚切りのタンとロース、リブロース、ロース・ヘレ・カイノミの盛り合わせ、ホルモンミックス、ハツの sashimi、生センマイ、焼き Yukhoe、アボカドキムチ、namul、kakuteki、きのこの namul、厚い長芋と焼き芋、青唐辛子の料理、Yukgaejang、冷麺、牛脂、壁にサイン、若いスタッフ、早い、予約でいっぱい、注文が通っていなかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; quick, attentive young staff (2026). No English evidence found.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu has quiche, gratin, fritters, spring rolls, baguette and focaccia, alongside carpaccio, grilled fish and meat; nothing is stated about wheat.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a French bistro of seafood, pâté, duck and beef; nothing is described as vegan.

Reservations for two or more; five or more by phone, best called 14:00–17:00; 2½ hours per table; seat-only bookings order at least one drink and one dish each; same-day cancellations charged in full for courses and ¥4,500 a head for seats (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 28 seats: 4 at the counter, 24 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 15 November 2005 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-23-3, ground floor of 誠和ビル — 3 min from Yotsubashi Stn exit 2, 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 3
places.cuisine: Casual French with wine and draught beer (Tabelog) · Asahi "Maruefu" from a Showa-era server in four pours: one pour, two pours, three pours and mild (Tabelog; August–September 2026) · wines mainly French by the glass or bottle, sparkling, white, orange and red (Tabelog; 2026) · à la carte from 2025–2026 reviews: scallop carpaccio, assorted meat appetizers with liver pâté, quiche, corn fritters, spring rolls, green-bean and mushroom salad, gizzard confit with cream sauce, sea bass with cream sauce, pan-seared fish, rare-fried Norwegian salmon, duck, wagyu cheek braised in red wine, blue-cheese gratin, shrimp ajillo, three-cheese platter; a focaccia limited to 10 a day, kept for bookings (July 2026); about four desserts not on the menu, e.g. peach compote · all-you-can-drink plan from ¥6,500 with tax (Tabelog)
places.notes: [French · Shinmachi, bistro plates with wine and Maruefu draught] A small, calm French bistro and wine bar near Yotsubashi, open since 2005 and until midnight. It makes a point of beer as much as wine: Asahi Maruefu from a Showa-era server, poured four ways, one pour to three pours and mild, so you can taste the difference. The food is à la carte French to share: thick scallop carpaccio, a meat-appetizer plate whose liver pâté won over a liver-hater (July 2026), quiche, corn fritters, sea bass in cream, red-wine-braised wagyu cheek, and a focaccia baked ten a day. Wines by the glass run from sparkling to orange. Handy after a show at the nearby Orix Theater, as several diners note; one diner wondered whether the owner was working alone on a busy September 2026 night.

roles: Owner and kitchen unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: Opened 15 November 2005 (Tabelog). Per the Tabelog shop text, "French cuisine isn't just about wine": Maruefu draught from a Showa-era server poured four ways, with carefully chosen wines and gastronomic dishes for drinking. A regular on a fourth visit missed a two-person course with lobster that had been dropped (July 2026, November 2025). A September 2026 diner wondered whether the owner was managing everything alone.
chef_bio.philosophy: "French cuisine isn't just about wine!" (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Maruefu draught in four pours; scallop carpaccio; red-wine-braised wagyu cheek.

anecdotes.text: "For my first drink, I had a beer poured right in front of me from the tap. The smoothness and crispness of Maru Efu was absolutely fantastic!" — August 2026, after a concert at Kyocera Dome.
"The liver pâté from the assorted meat appetizers was so good that even my friend, who usually dislikes liver, enjoyed it." — July 2026.
"Especially, the Wagyu cheek meat braised in red wine was incredibly tender and flavorful." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): orange、フレンチ・ワインバー・イタリアン、新町1-23-3 誠和ビル 1F、四ツ橋駅2番出口から徒歩3分、心斎橋駅3番出口から徒歩5分、火〜金18:00〜24:00、土日祝17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、月曜休み (祝日は営業することも)、予約は2名から、5名以上は電話で (14〜17時がつながりやすい)、2時間半制、席のみの予約は1人1ドリンク1品、当日キャンセルはコース100%・席のみ1人4,500円、カード・PayPay可、28席 (カウンター4、テーブル24)、禁煙、オープン2005年11月15日。店の説明: フレンチはワインだけじゃない、昭和のビールサーバーのマルエフを一度注ぎ・二度注ぎ・三度注ぎ・まろやか注ぎの4通りで、フランス中心のワインをグラスかボトルで、飲み放題プラン6,500円 (税込) から。口コミ(2025年7月〜2026年10月): 帆立のカルパッチョ、肉の前菜盛り合わせのレバーパテ、キッシュ、とうもろこしのフリット、春巻き、いんげんときのこのサラダ、砂肝のコンフィのクリームソース、スズキのクリームソース、鮮魚のポワレ、ノルウェーサーモンのレアフライ、鴨、和牛ほほ肉の赤ワイン煮、ブルーチーズのグラタン、海老のアヒージョ、チーズ3種盛り、1日10個のフォカッチャ (予約で取り置き)、メニューにない4種ほどのデザート、桃のコンポート、スパークリング・白・オレンジ・赤のグラスワイン、Orix Theater の帰りに、ひとりで切り盛りしているのかという声、2人用のコースがなくなって残念という常連。

cultural_comfort.note: À la carte French bistro; desserts offered verbally (2026). No English evidence found.

places.cuisine: Beef tongue every way, Fukuoka-style vegetable-wrapped skewers and black-wagyu motsunabe, Kyushu flavours in Osaka (Tabelog; official site) · courses, tax included (Tabelog): beef-tongue course with tongue shabu-shabu ¥12,500 (8 dishes: A5 wagyu "Nikura", marbled tongue and uni yukke, thick-cut grilled tongue, tongue demi-glace stew, premium tongue shabu-shabu with A5 strip loin); A5 wagyu strip-loin sukiyaki course ¥15,000 (8 dishes); a third tongue course; all-you-can-drink to add · à la carte (June 2026): marbled tongue shabu-shabu ¥4,400 per serving, Okuwo's "Uniku" ¥770, marbled tongue sashimi ¥1,760 · tongue tasting platter, tongue sushi, charcoal-grilled tongue, grilled liver, pork shabu-shabu, mapo tofu, asparagus and other vegetable-wrapped skewers, spicy offal hot pot, wagyu sashimi (2024–2026 reviews) · a wide range of drinks
places.notes: [Izakaya · Sennichimae, beef-tongue shabu-shabu and vegetable-wrapped skewers] A stylish izakaya in a traditional-house style near Namba Station, with a long 17-seat counter and every table in a private room, from 株式会社おくお, which brings Kyushu food to Osaka. The dish people come back for is the marbled beef-tongue shabu-shabu (¥4,400 a serving in June 2026): thin slices swished in a kombu broth and wrapped around plenty of green onion. Around it: Fukuoka-style vegetable skewers wrapped in pork belly, tongue sashimi, sushi and thick-cut grilled tongue, a black-wagyu motsunabe, and courses from ¥12,500 that add uni yukke and A5 wagyu. One September 2026 diner found the closing tongue hot pot bland; another regular finds the appetizer never changes and the skewers average. Heated tobacco is allowed.

roles: Operator: 株式会社おくお (official site); kitchen unnamed
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 April 2017 (Tabelog). Per the official site, 株式会社おくお runs restaurants mainly in Kansai and Osaka under the line "Kyushu flavours in Kansai too!", and lists this izakaya, a lunch shop at the same address and a shop in Minami-Honmachi. Diners describe smiling, attentive service and a calm atmosphere (2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Always delicious, ever more fun" (おいしいをずっと、楽しいをもっと; official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Marbled beef-tongue shabu-shabu; vegetable-wrapped skewers; black-wagyu motsunabe.

anecdotes.text: "When I quickly dipped it in the broth, the perfect amount of fat melted away, and with each bite, the umami spread throughout my mouth." — June 2026, marbled beef-tongue shabu-shabu ¥4,400.
"The broth, infused with kombu kelp, is incredibly delicious, and I find myself coming back regularly." — October 2026.
"I was a bit disappointed with the beef tongue hot pot that came out at the end. The broth was quite bland." — September 2026, course.

places.notes: [Ramen · Shin-Osaka Station, Sakai shio ramen by the platforms] A 33-seat shio ramen shop in アルデ新大阪, the station's second-floor dining area, from the Sakai shio-ramen shop 龍旗信, open from 10:00. The classic bowl is a clear, golden chicken broth with kombu and shiitake and a mussel-salt tare, "light yet surprisingly rich" under a sheen of chicken fat (September 2026), with medium-thick straight noodles; the chicken shio adds tender chicken chashu and a citrus lift for ¥1,350. There is shio tonkotsu, a cold seafood ramen in summer, shio gyoza and kara-age. Fast: food in about five minutes, which suits a tight connection. Some regulars of the Sakai shop find it slipped (October 2026), and one diner noted staff from overseas.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff of 龍旗信 (unnamed)

places.notes: [Yoshoku · Shin-Osaka Station, beef-katsu sandwiches inside the Shinkansen gates] A five-seat counter and takeaway window in the Osaka Noren Meguri food court inside the Shinkansen gates, the station branch of YOKOO, a yoshoku house in Fukushima since 1971 where the second generation added French training (August 2026). The draw is the thick-cut beef katsu sandwich, tenderloin fried medium-rare in a light coat with a homemade sauce, and the mixed sandwich that pairs it with a deep-fried dashi omelette, an Osaka touch; both travel well as a Shinkansen bento. Beef katsu curry (¥1,880) is the sit-down choice. Prices are station prices: ¥1,180 for four small pieces, ¥1,850 for six. One diner found the frying oil tired late in the day (September 2026).

roles: Station branch staff of Restaurant YOKOO (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a specialty shop for Kansai-style thick-cut beef katsu sandwiches and omurice inside Shin-Osaka Station, with plenty to take away for the Shinkansen; opened 7 November 2016. Per reviews: "this long-established Western-style restaurant has been serving customers since 1971 in Fukushima. This station branch of 'Yokoo' continues the tradition of Western cuisine, enhanced by the second generation who learned French cooking" (August 2026); "Restaurant YOKOO has been serving Western cuisine for over 50 years" near JR Fukushima Station (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Thick-cut beef katsu sandwich; mixed sandwich with fried dashi omelette.

places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Shin-Osaka Station, Juso negiyaki inside the Shinkansen gates] The station counter of Yamamoto, the negiyaki house from Juso, in the Osaka Noren Meguri food court inside the Shinkansen gates, a last taste of Osaka before the train. Negiyaki is okonomiyaki buried in chopped green onion, crisp outside and soft inside, here with beef tendon and konnyaku and a soy-sauce finish (¥1,350), and there is a special version only at this shop with pork belly, tendon and shrimp. It is lighter than sauced okonomiyaki, though some found it salty (2025–2026). Grab a seat before ordering; at busy times the negiyaki comes fast but other dishes can take 20 minutes (September 2026). One diner found ¥1,350 a little steep (October 2026).

places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Shin-Osaka east exit, a one-man teppan and kushikatsu counter] An 18-seat L-shaped counter thirty seconds from the Shin-Osaka east exit, open since 1999, where one cheerful owner fries kushikatsu, grills okonomiyaki and pours drinks alone. Start with kushikatsu, lotus root, sausage or shiitake, served piping hot one at a time with a sauce for one dip, then move to the teppan: fluffy pork or egg okonomiyaki, a slow-cooked negiyaki with chunky green onion, tonpei-yaki, doteyaki, and squid-ink yakisoba to finish. The owner asks where you are from, chats across languages with visitors (one evening, a Taiwanese couple, October 2025) and keeps the room laughing. Book ahead; cash only; smoking allowed.

Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners; PIN needed for IC cards) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 32 seats: a 12-seat counter facing the open kitchen on 1F and tables on 2F; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 8 April 2024 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Namba Sennichimae 14-18, 道具屋筋横丁, in a narrow alley off Doguya-suji — 4 min from Namba Stn (Midosuji Line, Nankai)
places.cuisine: Japanese-Italian small plates for drinking, from the team behind PESCA (2026 reviews) · e.g. a stuffed raw green-pepper appetizer, prosciutto with fruit and mascarpone, chicken-liver pâté with walnut bread, caprese, fig-wrapped prosciutto, sea-bream carpaccio, tuna tartare, shrimp, shiso and myoga rolled in kadaif, seared spear squid with salt and sudachi, grilled salmon, tripe with root vegetables in white miso, bacon potato salad, taro fries (September–October 2026) · mains: Hirata Farm tonkatsu with truffle salt, wagyu roast-beef "sukiyaki" with egg, pasta with conger eel and karasumi, wagyu pasta, fried shrimp, curry chazuke, a sour-spicy ramen (2026) · a wide drinks list with wine including organic bottles, sake and cocktails · portions are small (several 2026 diners); about ¥4,000–¥8,000 a head (2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Namba, Japanese-Italian plates from the PESCA team] Down an alley off Doguya-suji that one diner found almost unsettling to walk, a glass-fronted counter facing an open kitchen, with tables upstairs: the second concept from the people behind the Italian restaurant PESCA, open since April 2024. Plates are small and made for drinking: kadaif-wrapped shrimp with shiso and myoga, seared spear squid with sudachi, prosciutto with fruit and mascarpone, tripe in white miso, then the dishes diners name most, a Hirata Farm tonkatsu with truffle salt, a wagyu roast-beef sukiyaki and a pasta of conger eel and karasumi. Wine runs to organic bottles. It fills up most evenings, so book; portions are modest. Open daily from 15:00 to midnight.

roles: Chefs (unnamed), working in an open kitchen (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; opened 8 April 2024. Diners call it a sister restaurant and new concept of PESCA, the Italian restaurant in Shinsaibashi (osaka_pesca_shinsaibashi; that record notes reviews mentioning a Namba branch and 食堂ペスカ). The listing says the kitchen is particular about vegetables, fish, sake and wine.
chef_bio.specialty: Hirata Farm tonkatsu with truffle salt; small Japanese-Italian plates; organic wine.

anecdotes.text: "It was a bit hard to find, and I almost walked into the sister restaurant, Italian Pesca (laughs)." — September 2026, a first visit.
"The food was incredibly tasty and satisfying, but I felt bad ordering from the busy staff" — October 2026, tripe and tonkatsu.
"However, the portions were small, making it less cost-effective for big eaters." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 食堂ペスカ、居酒屋・イタリアン・創作料理、難波千日前14-18 道具屋筋横丁、Namba 駅 (Midosuji Line・Nankai) から徒歩4分、毎日15:00〜24:00、カード・PayPay可、32席 (1階カウンター12、2階テーブル)、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、子ども可、野菜と魚にこだわり、ベジタリアンメニューあり、日本酒とワインにこだわり、2024年4月8日オープン。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 姉妹店はイタリアンのペスカ、オープンキッチンの1階カウンター、2階はテーブル、海老 大葉 みょうが カダイフ巻き、炙りヤリイカ塩すだち、生ハムとフルーツとマスカルポーネ、白味噌のトリッパ、Hirata Farm のとんかつ、和牛のローストビーフのすき焼き、鱧とからすみのパスタ、自然派のワイン、平日の夜も予約で満席、量は少なめ。

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi, salt-grilled fish and grilled vegetables are the plainest; tempura, oden, negiyaki and dishes with soy-based sauces are on the same menu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and robata izakaya; the appetizer was a shijimi clam soup and the oden and grills are fish and meat (October 2026). Grilled edamame and sliced onion appear in reviews.
places.hours_raw: Daily 16:00–23:00 (last order 22:30) (Tabelog). Reservations recommended: fully booked at 18:00 on a Saturday and at 21:00 on a Sunday (October–November 2026); seat requests are not guaranteed, two hours at a table when busy, with last orders at 90 minutes (Tabelog; October 2026), and a booking may be cancelled after 15 minutes (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 35 seats over several floors: a counter by the robata grill on 1F, tatami seating upstairs (October 2026 reviews); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). English, Simplified Chinese and Korean menus, with photos and a digital menu (Tabelog). Opened 10 June 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Namba 4-2-13 — 30 seconds from Namba Stn (Midosuji Line), 3 min from Osaka-Namba (Kintetsu) and Nankai Namba
places.cuisine: Robatayaki and seasonal seafood izakaya (2026 reviews) · sashimi assortments (three kinds, or larger), katsuo tosa-style, seafood yukhoe · the robata: grilled fish of the day (sea bream or yellowtail), kinki, scallops whose juices are finished with a small rice ball, shrimp, pork jowl, chicken neck, grilled edamame · Awaodori chicken grilled with rock salt, rare liver with garlic chives, chikuwa tempura, deep-fried stuffed peppers, seasonal ohitashi, oden while the grill works, negiyaki · a shijimi clam soup as the appetizer (October 2026) · a wide sake and drinks list; hot sake · about ¥3,000–¥6,000 a head; two people with two drinks each paid just over ¥9,000 (October 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Namba, robata and seafood a minute from the station] A lively robatayaki izakaya steps from Namba station, opened in June 2025 by the Osaka 十忠八九 group of seafood izakaya. Sit at the first-floor counter to watch the fish turn over the grill (one couple was sent to a third-floor tatami room and missed it). Diners single out the fresh, thick-cut sashimi, the grilled kinki and fish of the day, and scallops grilled in the shell whose juices come back with a small rice ball; Awaodori chicken with rock salt, rare liver with chives and oden fill the gaps. The drinks list is long and prices fair, but tables are limited to two hours when busy. Menus in English, Chinese and Korean, and on many nights much of the room is overseas guests. Book ahead; open daily 16:00–23:00.

roles: Run by the 十忠八九 group (株式会社オーゼットカンパニー; the group's link page)
chef_bio.background: Per the group's link page (lit.link/10chu89, linked from the Tabelog listing): one of ten outlets of the 十忠八九 group, which runs seafood izakaya in Fukushima, Namba and Umeda (魚屋 十忠八九, みなみの十忠八九, お初の十忠八九) as well as なにわ寿し 本店, 二階の洋品店, 生ハムとPIZZA。86ストア and MONDAY VIBES COFFEE, and opened its first Tokyo shop as its tenth (PR TIMES, as summarised in search); this is its only robata. Opened 10 June 2025 (Tabelog). An October 2026 diner names the group "Juchu Hakku". The romaji "Toyo Kobayashi" is Tabelog's for the name.
chef_bio.specialty: Robata-grilled fish of the day; sashimi; grilled scallops with rice.

anecdotes.text: "The scallops were incredibly tasty, and they left some juice behind, so make sure to add rice to it at the end! [The staff] even served a small rice ball with it!" — October 2026, a second visit.
"There's a 2-hour limit, with last orders at 1.5 hours." — October 2026, yellowtail of the day.
"The tatami seating was occupied entirely by international guests, with us being the only Japanese customers" — November 2026, fully booked at 9 PM on a Sunday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 浪速炉ばた 東洋小噺、居酒屋・海鮮・炉端焼き、難波4-2-13、Namba 駅 (Midosuji Line) から徒歩30秒、毎日16:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、予約可 (混雑時はテーブル2時間、15分過ぎるとキャンセル扱いの場合あり)、カード・PayPay可、35席、貸切20名まで、禁煙、無料Wi-Fi、英語・簡体字・韓国語のメニュー、写真つきメニュー、デジタルメニュー、2025年6月10日オープン、系列店 (なにわ寿し 本店、二階の洋品店、生ハムとPIZZA。86ストア、MONDAY VIBES COFFEE)。十忠八九グループ (lit.link/10chu89): 魚屋 十忠八九、みなみの十忠八九、お初の十忠八九、福島呑場ヒンジ、浪速炉ばた 東洋小噺、なにわ寿し 本店、二階の洋品店、生ハムとPIZZA。86ストア、MONDAY VIBES COFFEE、本酒場 満丸 東店、株式会社オーゼットカンパニー。口コミ(2026年10月〜11月): 炉端の前のカウンター、3階の座敷、刺身の盛り合わせ、本日の焼き魚、キンキ、ホタテと小さなおにぎり、Awaodori の鶏の岩塩焼き、レアなレバーとニラ、ちくわの天ぷら、おでん、しじみ汁のお通し、2時間制、海外からの客が多い夜も。

places.name: Moegi
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: negiyaki, okonomiyaki and yakisoba are wheat-batter and noodle dishes, and the sauce is soy-based (September 2026). Grilled vegetables (lotus root, asparagus, shiitake) are the simplest plates; ask about the seasoning.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The shop-maintained Tabelog listing says there are vegetarian options and that the kitchen is particular about vegetables, and there are grilled lotus root, asparagus and shiitake; but the batter has a dashi flavour (May 2026) and most dishes use pork, beef tendon or seafood.
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:15); dinner 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations taken and given priority; walk-ins queue from about 15 minutes before 18:00 (October 2026) and waited 20 minutes on a holiday evening (September 2026); lunch was easier (June and September 2026). The wait for food can be long (September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (PayPay) (Tabelog). 27 seats: 9 at the counter and 18 at tables, several with their own teppan; private hire; non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 20 September 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Namba Sennichimae 7-2, 河原ハイツ 1F, down a back alley in Ura Namba — 5 min from Namba or Nihonbashi Stn
places.cuisine: Negiyaki, okonomiyaki and teppanyaki (2026 reviews) · negiyaki, finished with dashi soy sauce rather than sauce (June 2026): beef-tendon negi-suji-yaki ¥1,250 (June and September 2026), seafood negiyaki with squid, shrimp and scallops, a negiyaki mix · okonomiyaki with plenty of cabbage and a fluffy, dashi-flavoured batter (May 2026): buta-tama, the Moegi Special with pork and seafood, bokkake, pork with beef tendon · yakisoba with a bonito-and-dashi flavour, large size available (August 2026); ume, shiso and salt yakisoba ¥1,200; sobameshi · teppan: Kaga lotus root ¥600 (grilled with salt), grilled squid with soy ¥650, horumon ¥1,450, tonpei-yaki ¥850, yam steak, spinach with bacon, bacon-wrapped scallops, Satsuma chicken tataki, garlic rice · a crepe of okonomiyaki batter with sweet bean paste and ice cream (June 2026) · draft and bottled beer (¥700 a medium bottle), Sapporo Lager, a Miyazaki hebesu sour ¥650, sake
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Ura Namba, negiyaki down a back alley] Down an Ura Namba alley that one diner would have turned back from if alone, a cosy wooden room with a counter and tables, several with their own teppan, and a queue at opening time. The house speciality is negiyaki, fluffy and charred, finished with dashi soy sauce instead of thick sauce; the okonomiyaki is cabbage-heavy with a light dashi batter, and the yakisoba leans on bonito rather than sauce, a lighter style that one Sapporo visitor missed. Start with teppan plates (salt-grilled Kaga lotus root, bacon-wrapped scallops, horumon) and end with a crepe of okonomiyaki batter filled with bean paste and ice cream. A comedian, Miki, is said by an October 2026 diner to recommend it. Many guests are overseas visitors, so book for dinner; closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; opened 20 September 2019; the listing says the kitchen is particular about vegetables, fish and sake, and has vegetarian options. No owner or chef is named in the sources read.
chef_bio.specialty: Negiyaki with beef tendon; fluffy okonomiyaki; teppan vegetables.

anecdotes.text: "Dinner service starts at 6:00 PM, and people begin to line up about 15 minutes before opening." — October 2026, a 19th visit.
"I was told it had a soy sauce flavor, and indeed it did. Hmm, I came all the way from Sapporo to Osaka for a soy sauce flavor..." — September 2026, a holiday evening.
"It was made with okonomiyaki batter, filled with red bean paste and ice cream." — June 2026, on the dessert crepe.

places.name: き多や 本店 (Kitaya Honten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery (breads, sandwiches, curry bread, French breads; some of the wheat is new-season Tokachi wheat, October 2026). Nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain breads such as the domestic-wheat French bread may suit, but most breads are filled or enriched (butter, cream, cheese, mentaiko, ham, egg); nothing is labelled vegan.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00; Sat 08:00–16:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). The official site gives 08:00 until sold out, closed Sundays and holidays; long summer breaks (20 July–17 August 2025 and 19 July–16 August 2026, official site). Takeaway only (Tabelog); coffee can be had outside (September 2026). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). A very small shop, one or two customers at a time (May and June 2026). A free rusk for following the shop on Instagram (June–October 2026); a handwritten monthly newsletter (official site; October 2026).

places.cuisine: Handmade everyday breads, a monthly special and lunch boxes (official site; 2026 reviews) · the special curry bread with curry simmered for a day ¥420, a favourite since the shop opened (April 2026) · mentaiko French ¥360, walnut-apple ¥340 with pistachio (May 2026) · aojiso and cheese épi ¥340, peanut-butter bread ¥340, cream bread, anpan, hot dog, black-bean bread, matcha melon bread, potato French, egg sandwich with snap peas (2026) · square loaf ¥420, sold by the slice, and a graham loaf (July–September 2026) · domestic new-wheat French bread from Tokachi wheat ¥247 (October 2026); croissants (sell out early) · bánh mì as a standard, sakura anpan in spring, stollen in winter (official site) · bento boxes with bread and a light cream pasta (October 2026); coffee
places.notes: [Bakery · Minami-Senba, a couple's neighbourhood bakery since 2000] A small, house-like shop among the office blocks of Minami-Senba, so small that customers take turns inside, run by a couple whose warmth regulars mention as much as the bread. A childhood friend of the founder, writing in June 2026, says the founder opened it in 2000 after cooking Spanish food and now runs it with a Spanish spouse. The long-standing star is the curry bread of curry simmered for a day; the mentaiko French is timed to come out mid-morning, and there is a monthly special announced in a handwritten newsletter (bitter-melon curry one summer, sakura anpan in spring, stollen at Christmas). Loaves can be bought by the slice, and following the shop on Instagram gets you a rusk. Opens at 08:00, closes when sold out; closed Sundays and for a month in summer.

roles: Owner-baker and spouse (unnamed): "run by a couple" (October 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per a June 2026 review by a childhood friend of the founder: the bakery started in 2000 when the founder took the plunge; the founder was originally a chef of Spanish cuisine, married a Spaniard, and now runs the shop with that spouse. An April 2026 diner also dates it to 2000 and names a second shop nearby. The official site (kitapan.com) posts a monthly newsletter, "き多パン通信", and lists summer closures. An October 2026 reviewer describes "a small restaurant run by a couple".
chef_bio.philosophy: Safe, reliable and delicious bread, and a good shop (official site, January 2026 newsletter note).
chef_bio.specialty: Special curry bread; mentaiko French; loaves by the slice.

anecdotes.text: "This bakery started in 2000 when my friend decided to take the plunge. [The founder was] originally a chef specializing in Spanish cuisine" — June 2026, a childhood friend's visit.
"The bread is, of course, delicious, but it's the couple's charming personality that makes you want to come back to this place." — October 2026, a second visit.
"When I walked in, [the staff] greeted me with 'Welcome back!'" — May 2026, returning for the mentaiko French.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kitapan.com): 手づくりパンの店 き多や、心斎橋・南船場・本町でパンを焼いてます、南船場2-8-14、営業時間8:00〜売り切れ次第終了、定休日 日・祝、き多パン通信 (毎月の紙面)、2026年3月にさくらあんぱんとコーヒー、2026年6月はバインミーが定番、2026年7月19日〜8月16日は夏期休暇、2026年9月はゴーヤ×カレー、2026年10月は新小麦、2025年12月にシュトレン、2026年1月「安心、安全はもちろん、美味しいパンづくり、店づくりで励みます」。食べログ: パン・サンドイッチ、月〜金 8:00〜17:00、土 8:00〜16:00、日曜休み、持ち帰りのみ、カード・電子マネー不可、QR可、禁煙。口コミ(2026年4月〜10月): 2000年開業、近くにもう1店、丸一日煮込んだカレーの特製カレーパン420円、明太フランス360円、くるみりんご340円、食パンを1枚から、Tokachi の新小麦のフランスパン247円、Instagram のフォローでラスク、手書きの通信、夫婦で営む店、友人によればスペイン料理のシェフだった創業者がスペイン人の伴侶とともに。

places.name: POMMIER (ポミエ)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the dishes people come for are breaded and fried (katsudon, chicken katsu, kara-age, shrimp fry) in a dashi-and-soy sauce; no gluten-free option described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the menu is built on pork, chicken and egg, with miso soup and dashi.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:00–17:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; write your name on the waiting board at the door, which can fill up before opening, and expect a queue at 11:30 on weekends (Tabelog; August–October 2026). Cash only, paid after the meal (Tabelog; October 2026 reviews). 30 seats at tables for two and four, shared when busy; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Nipponbashi 5-17-20, north of Ebisucho near Den-Den Town — 6 min from Ebisucho Stn
places.cuisine: Huge rice bowls and set meals in a café room (2026 reviews) · katsudon ¥1,550 with 400 g of rice, the egg piled over the cutlet; large ¥1,950 (October 2026, or "+¥400" in August 2026); extra egg +¥300 · chicken katsu don ¥1,550 (October 2026) · oyakodon, small ¥1,550 (August 2026) · tamago-don, rice in half (200 g) or small (300 g) portions · kara-age set meal ¥1,550, egg over rice +¥300 (August 2026); a single giant kara-age ¥200 · hamburger curry, kara-age curry · shrimp fry à la carte · bowls come with miso soup and pickles; up to 800 g of rice on request (August 2026)
places.notes: [Donburi · Nipponbashi, the big-portion café] A café-looking room near Den-Den Town that is famous for portions: the regular katsudon (¥1,550 in 2026) comes on 400 g of rice under a cutlet and a mound of soft egg that spills over the bowl, and the large and the 800 g versions are for competitive eaters. Order a half or small rice if unsure; diners in 2026 saw others leave food behind. The oyakodon and the kara-age set are the other favourites, and a single kara-age is ¥200. Write your name on the board by the door, ideally before 11:00; cash only; closed Thursdays.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe POMMIER as a café-style room known across Japan to big eaters for its portions (2026); a September 2026 diner was moved from a shared table when one came free. A regular in August 2026 notes the large katsudon cost ¥1,200 in May 2019.
chef_bio.specialty: Katsudon on 400 g of rice; oyakodon; kara-age set.

anecdotes.text: "Since I couldn't reach the rice directly, I kindly asked the staff for a separate plate to temporarily set aside some of the pork cutlet and egg" — October 2026, a third visit, the large katsudon for JPY 1,950.
"I wrote my name on the waiting board. Even though I arrived at 10 AM, there were already several names listed." — September 2026, a Sunday.
"Looking around, I noticed that both international guests and salarymen were leaving some behind, which made sense given the portion size." — September 2026, katsudon with extra egg.

places.notes: [Chinese · Shinmachi, the mapo tofu house] A modest-looking Chinese restaurant in Shinmachi whose chef, with 30 years behind the stove, is proud of the mapo tofu: numbing, meaty and balanced rather than salty. At lunch it is the only dish (Tue, Thu and Sat, ¥1,200 with free rice refills; dandan noodles on Wednesday). At dinner, order the yodare chicken, the Chinese-style sashimi of the day with vegetables and nuts, shark-fin spring rolls and the mapo tofu to finish. Book on weekend nights; expect ¥4,000–8,000 a head at dinner. Closed Mondays and the second Sunday.

places.notes: [Chinese · Higashinakajima, a machi-chuka by the Shin-Osaka east exit] A small, old-style neighbourhood Chinese restaurant a couple of minutes from the east side of Shin-Osaka Station, run by a team of women (September 2025; June 2026). The name says ramen, but most diners come for the kara-age: huge, crisp and loaded with garlic, so the owner steers pairs to the half order (June 2026). Around it go spicy gyoza, liver and chives, garlic fried rice and sweet-and-sour pork, all fast and cheap, nine dishes for four at ¥8,900 in July 2026. The shoyu ramen (¥900, March 2026) and a beef-bone shio ramen close the night for business travellers, and it fills up when a Shinkansen is delayed (September 2025). Cash only; smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Naan, baked in the tandoor, comes with every set; rice is offered too, but how the curries are thickened is not described.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list ticks "vegan options", "vegetarian options", "halal options" and "Hindu options", and a vegetable curry appears in the daily sets (2026); nothing on the menu is labelled vegan, and the sets come with naan, chicken tikka and kebab.

Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), e-money and QR payments including Alipay (Tabelog). 28 table seats; non-smoking, with ashtrays outside; children welcome, kids menu; English menu; takeaway and delivery; free Wi-Fi; one parking coupon for the Times or NPC lots by the station per ¥1,000 spent (Tabelog). places.cuisine: Indian-Nepali curries and naan from the tandoor, spice from mild to extra hot (Tabelog) · lunch: Pariwar Lunch ¥900 with a large naan, two daily curries and mini rice (August 2026); B Lunch ¥950 with two curries, naan, rice, salad, chicken tikka and seekh kebab (February 2026); the curries in the sets are chosen by the shop, e.g. keema and vegetable, vegetable and boiled egg, chicken (2026) · Garhwali lunch with naan and chai (June 2026) · dinner sets (Tabelog); a sizzling chicken dish on a hot plate with two house sauces, green and red, and a heaped salad (May 2026) · shrimp curry, chocolate naan to take away, mango lassi, chai, iced chai (2026)
places.notes: [Indian · Higashinakajima, curry and naan by the Shin-Osaka east exit] An Indian-Nepali curry house a few minutes from the east exit of Shin-Osaka Station, easy to spot by the tuk-tuk parked out front and a loud sign beside a well-known ramen shop, with Indian TV on a big screen inside (May 2026). Lunch is the deal: sets around ¥900–950 of a big tandoor naan and two daily curries, some with chicken tikka and kebab, and on Mondays and Fridays the curry and naan are refilled free (Tabelog; 2026). The shop picks the curries, often a keema and a vegetable one; staff adjusted the heat for a child (August 2026). Reviews are mixed: some praise the chewy naan and value, others found the curries thin and the naan hard once cold (February and June 2026). Open every day to 22:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: curries and naan cooked in a tandoor, the naan kneaded, fermented and baked from chosen ingredients, spice from mild to extra hot, value dinner sets. The site (pariwar.jp, read 2026-11-01) calls it an Indian restaurant and café and pictures its chef, unnamed. Moved to this site from an earlier one (February 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets with naan; free curry and naan refills on Monday and Friday lunch.

anecdotes.text: "They even have a tuk-tuk on display! I wonder if you can actually drive it? (laughs)" — May 2026.

places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Higashinakajima, a neighbourhood teppan east of Shin-Osaka] A small okonomiyaki counter a few minutes from the east gate of Shin-Osaka Station, where the owner, with "that classic Osaka uncle vibe" (August 2026), cooks okonomiyaki, modern-yaki and a much-liked horumon yakisoba on the griddle in front of you. The house has firm ideas about how to eat: one April 2026 pair loved the food but were told to stop chatting and leave after an hour. Cash only; smoking allowed. Closed Tuesday.

places.notes: [Yakitori · Higashi-Umeda, a chicken-sashimi standing bar] A standing bar on the Ohatsu Tenjin shopping street, opened in October 2025 by the people behind the yakitori restaurant Kuma no Yakitori (October 2026 review), that serves raw and barely seared chicken from Kagoshima farms. Order by QR code at the counter: the toro-momo tataki, thigh seared with a burner in front of you and dressed with a sweet sauce and onion, the silky breast sashimi, liver, wing sashimi, and a limited cubed sashimi with pickled cabbage, most around ¥500–1,100 (October 2026). Fries, an egg onigiri and a sea-urchin rice fill the gaps, and an hour of all-you-can-drink is ¥980. It opens at 14:00 at weekends, closes on Wednesdays, and shuts early if the chicken runs out. One regular has been sixteen times; another found it pricey for what it is (October 2026).

places.notes: [Yakitori · Higashi-Umeda, binchotan yakitori until dawn] A big, relaxed yakitori house a minute from Higashi-Umeda Station near Ohatsu Tenjin, open since 2012 and until 5:00 most nights, with private rooms for four to twenty added in a July 2025 renovation. Chicken comes daily from a local poultry shop and is skewered in generous pieces and grilled slowly over Tosa binchotan; the dashimaki is a house favourite. Groups book the ¥4,500 binchotan course with ninety minutes of drinks: chicken tataki, seven skewers, butter-steamed Awaji onion, fried chicken and a chicken zosui to finish (August 2026). A July 2026 diner praised the big skewers and a chicken-broth ramen to end; others found the service stretched on busy nights. Smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: chicken sourced fresh daily from a local poultry shop, skewered generously and grilled slowly over Tosa binchotan; private rooms created in a July 2025 renovation; opened 30 March 2012.

places.cuisine: Japanese izakaya of Osaka seafood and seasonal produce from around Japan, with sake, shochu and wine (Tabelog) · June 2026 à la carte: seasonal fruit (peach) and white-sesame salad ¥900, fried eggplant in dashi ¥650, three-kind sashimi ¥1,100, toro-taku ¥900, shio-koji fried chicken (4) ¥850, sea-bream rice ¥1,450 (+¥250 for bonito flakes and egg), grilled-eel kamameshi ¥1,450 · the shio-koji fried chicken praised in March–June 2026 reviews; strawberry and Earl Grey tofu salad (May 2026); bonito tataki, thick-cut sashimi, whitebait as the starter (June 2026); Izumi octopus sashimi (listing review) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): share course for three or more ¥3,300; pair course for two ¥4,180; premium course with two hours of drinks including four sakes and ten shochu ¥6,000
places.notes: [Izakaya · Umeda, a tatami izakaya under the Hankyu tracks] A Japanese izakaya on the upper floor of a narrow space under the Hankyu Umeda elevated tracks, opened in August 2025 above its own standing bar; diners say the entrance is easy to miss (May and August 2026). Upstairs is a tatami room with three private rooms, where trains rumble overhead now and then. The kitchen sends out Osaka seafood and seasonal dishes: thick-cut sashimi, bonito tataki, a peach and white-sesame salad and, the dish every reviewer names, shio-koji fried chicken; finish with sea-bream or eel kamameshi. Courses start at ¥3,300 for groups, and a ¥6,000 plan adds two hours of sake and shochu. Book through the shop's Instagram form; it is often full. No draft beer, and no children.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a Japanese izakaya of seasonal ingredients and fresh Osaka seafood with sake, shochu and wine from across Japan, three private rooms; opened 7 August 2025; often confused with its sister restaurant "Nagumo Higashidoori Main Store" (the listing's English also gives the reading "Natsukumo"). A June 2026 diner notes a branch in Nakazakicho.

anecdotes.text: "Once I went up to the second floor, it felt like a completely different space, making me wonder if I was really under the Hankyu train tracks." — May 2026.
"The kamameshi is served in a single portion (about 1 go), so we ordered two servings, one for each person. The kamameshi is a must-order!" — June 2026, a group of four.
"Although there was a loud noise when the train passed by, it allowed us to chat without worrying about others around us." — April 2026, a private room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): お料理 夏雲、居酒屋・海鮮、大阪市北区芝田1-6-11 2F、阪急大阪梅田駅から徒歩1分、JR 大阪駅から約5分、毎日16:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、予約は Instagram の予約フォームから (24時間)、席のみ予約はお通し400円 (税別)、シェアコースとペアコースは席料300円 (税別)、子ども不可、荷物はテーブルのかごに、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、20席、個室3室 (最大12名)、座敷、禁煙、2025年8月7日オープン、大阪の新鮮な魚介と全国の旬の食材、厳選した日本酒・焼酎・ワイン、シェアコース3,300円 (3名から)、ペアコース4,180円 (2名)、日本酒4種と焼酎10種の2時間飲み放題つきのコース6,000円、姉妹店「Nagumo Higashidoori Main Store」とまちがえやすい、阪急梅田の高架下。口コミ(2026年3月〜8月): 塩麹のから揚げ、季節のフルーツ (桃) の白ごまサラダ900円、なすの揚げびたし650円、刺身3種1,100円、トロたく900円、塩麹のから揚げ (4個) 850円、鯛めし1,450円 (かつお節と卵250円)、うなぎの釜めし1,450円、いちごとアールグレイの豆腐サラダ、カツオのたたき、厚切りの刺身、お通しのしらす、生ビールはない、1階は立ち飲み、2階は座敷と個室、電車の音、入口がわかりにくい、いつも予約で満席、Nakazakicho にも店。

cultural_comfort.note: Book via a Japanese form linked from Instagram; tatami seating upstairs (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. One omakase of ten dishes with dashi soups, fried sweetfish with house Worcestershire sauce, somen and soy-based sauces.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kaiseki of seafood, eel, beef, game and dashi.

Reservation only; the person who booked must attend; arriving late or leaving early may mean fewer dishes; whole-shop hire for 10 to 12, children welcome then (Tabelog). Course price includes the 10% service charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Twelve seats at a U-shaped counter; non-smoking; no perfume; menu in English, Chinese and Korean (Tabelog). Bento to order (October 2026).

places.cuisine: Kaiseki omakase of ten dishes built on "the temperature that brings out the best in each dish" and the aroma of the ingredients (Tabelog); ¥19,360 including service (Tabelog), ¥16,000 before tax and service per a July 2026 diner · two kinds of rice to finish, e.g. blackthroat seaperch rice and corn rice (August 2026) · dishes in 2026 reviews: eggplant with sea urchin and broad-bean or shrimp sauce; eel from Numajima and matsutake in a bowl with molokhia; fried sweetfish stuffed with its pounded liver and shiso, with house Worcestershire sauce; charcoal-grilled eel with fig; braised Ozaki beef; Handa somen with abalone and sea urchin; Awaji sea bass and hamo; Miyagi bonito and Akashi sea bream; agu pork and Kawachi duck dumpling hotpot; mango and passion-fruit pudding · bear meat on one August 2026 course · sake chosen by the owner (May 2026) · bento to order, e.g. for five with teriyaki yellowtail, kazunoko and two rices (October 2026)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Kitashinchi, a twelve-seat counter of temperature and aroma] A small kaiseki counter on the seventh floor of a Kitashinchi building, thirty seconds from the station, where the young owner-chef Yumiba Shinnosuke, who trained at Ogurano and went independent in 2021 (July 2026 review), serves one ten-course omakase designed around serving each dish at its best temperature and aroma (Tabelog). Expect Kitamurasaki sea urchin over eggplant, Numajima eel and matsutake in a clear bowl, sweetfish fried with its own liver, braised Ozaki beef, and two kinds of rice to finish, at about ¥20,000 with service. Regulars note the chef's steady growth and easy conversation, and a July 2026 diner mentions a Michelin selection. One August 2026 diner could not eat the bear meat on the course, so ask about game when booking. Two seatings a night; no perfume.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yumiba Shinnosuke (弓場慎之佑; romaji from the Tabelog listing)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: Japanese cuisine "that won't tire you out until the last bite", valuing the temperature of dishes and the aroma of ingredients; a 10-course omakase of seasonal ingredients; "a chef dedicated to culinary arts, weaving a food culture for the future". Per a July 2026 review: the chef trained at "Ogurano", became independent in 2021 and is still in the thirties per that diner, and the restaurant is Michelin-selected; per an October 2023 review, the chef and the chef's wife ran the restaurant.
chef_bio.philosophy: "The temperature that brings out the best in the dishes" and "the aroma of ingredients we want to deliver to our customers" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Ten-course omakase; two kinds of rice to finish.

anecdotes.text: "With each visit, the quality of the dishes has improved, and now it's a place I can confidently recommend to others." — July 2026, a fourth visit.
"As always, there were two types of rice served: blackthroat seaperch rice and corn rice. Both were delicious." — August 2026, a twenty-first visit.
"I found the bear meat to be of high quality and quite unique. I tried a bite, but unfortunately, I couldn't eat it." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): きたしんち 弓場慎之佑、日本料理、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-5-21 松木興産ビル 7F、JR 東西線 北新地駅11-21出口から徒歩30秒、月〜土 18:00〜と20:30〜の2部制、日・祝休み、完全予約制、予約者本人の来店、遅刻や早退で品数が減ることも、貸切は10〜12名 (子ども可)、コース料金にサービス料10%込み、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、U字のカウンター12席、禁煙、香水は控える、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、最後の一口まで疲れない日本料理、料理の温度と食材の香り、季節の食材のおまかせ10品19,360円。口コミ(2023年10月〜2026年10月): 2023年は大将と奥さんの二人で切り盛り、Ogurano で修業し2021年に独立、30代、ミシュランに選ばれた、16,000円のコースで税・サービス料込み2万円弱、なすとウニ、Numajima のうなぎと松茸のお椀、鮎の揚げ物に肝と自家製ウスターソース、うなぎの炭火焼きといちじく、Ozaki 牛の煮物、Handa そうめんとアワビとウニ、Awaji のスズキとハモ、Miyagi のカツオと Akashi の鯛、agu 豚とKawachi の鴨のつみれ鍋、のどぐろごはんととうもろこしごはん、マンゴーとパッションフルーツのプリン、熊肉、オーナーの選ぶ日本酒、弁当の注文。

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki, yakisoba and tonpei-yaki are wheat-based or sauced, and everything is cooked on a shared teppan; the sauces and mayonnaise are made in house (Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: okonomiyaki and teppan dishes of pork, beef tendon, offal, seafood and egg.

Two-hour limit for every table; a booking lapses 10–15 minutes after the reserved time without contact; parties of two usually sit at the counter (Tabelog). places.cuisine: Creative teppanyaki and okonomiyaki: Japanese-Western dishes by a former Italian-cuisine chef (official site); homemade sauces and mayonnaise; featured in the magazine Amakara Techou (Tabelog) · the house tonpei-yaki with braised pork belly (Tabelog; August 2026) · Ikkoku Ichijo-yaki, okonomiyaki with beef tendon, a heap of green onion and a fried egg; buta-tama; mentaiko yakisoba with dashi soy and a fried egg; salt or garlic yakisoba (2026 reviews) · teppan dishes: beef horumon 200 g, black tiger shrimp in anchovy butter, cheese-baked lotus root, squid with green onion and mayonnaise, yam with anchovy, gizzards, beef tendon stew, dashimaki, edamame with soy butter (August–October 2026) · courses: the "Osaka Kote Kote" course and a ¥5,000 all-you-can-drink course (August 2026) · beer, shochu highballs and cocktails; no sake or wine (September 2026)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Umeda, a basement teppan bar by Ohatsu Tenjin] A twenty-seat teppan bar in a basement beside the Ohatsu Tenjin shopping street, open since 2012 and, by its own account, one of the few independent shops there (Tabelog). The cooking mixes Osaka teppan with Western ideas: the shop site credits a former Italian-cuisine chef, while Tabelog's English text calls the owner "originally from Italy". Order the signature okonomiyaki loaded with beef tendon and green onion under a fried egg, the tonpei-yaki full of braised pork belly, or the mentaiko yakisoba that one October diner ordered twice; several diners found the okonomiyaki lighter than most. A ¥5,000 all-you-can-drink course is popular with groups, and an August 2026 diner noted it runs with two people. Expect ¥3,000–6,000. Smoking throughout and no under-20s; two-hour limit.

roles: Chef (unnamed), formerly an Italian-cuisine chef (official site: "元イタリアンのシェフ")
Owner (unnamed; "originally from Italy" in Tabelog's English shop text)

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: every course ends with okonomiyaki or yakisoba (wheat) from a shared teppan; grilled dishes come with ponzu and sauces, and one scallop dish had a crumble topping (September 2026).

Cover charge ¥660 a person (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 6 at the counter, two tables for 3–4 and a private room for 4 or more; non-smoking; sommelier; takeout (Tabelog; official site). Opened 7 November 2017 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Teppanyaki and okonomiyaki in a chic room, with Italian wines chosen to match (official site) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): large-plate sharing course of five dishes (grilled dishes, fish and meat mains, okonomiyaki or yakisoba) ¥6,800; luxury course of seven dishes ¥10,800 · courses in September–October 2026: thick asparagus and pork belly, teppan-grilled young chicken with salt, Hokkaido scallops and shiitake (one with a crumble), lean wagyu with garlic, salt and ponzu, homemade squid-and-celery satsuma-age, zucchini and pork-belly salad with a soft egg · okonomiyaki slow-cooked and fluffy; special thin-noodle yakisoba fried crisp, with squid · à la carte: snow-crab and green-onion omelette, pork kimchi, yam satsuma-age, tonpei-yaki (September 2026) · a birthday message written in mayonnaise on the okonomiyaki on request (August 2026)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Kitashinchi, teppan and Italian wine] A sixth-floor teppan counter by Kitashinchi station, named a Tabelog Teppanyaki WEST 100 in 2024 and 2025, that dresses Osaka okonomiyaki up for a wine list. Courses (¥6,800 or ¥10,800) move through seasonal vegetables and pork belly, crisp-skinned chicken, scallops and shiitake, a lean wagyu steak with garlic and ponzu, and end with your choice of a slow-cooked, fluffy okonomiyaki or the house thin-noodle yakisoba, fried until crisp. A sommelier pairs Italian wines; one diner in September 2026 wrote that it has even been selected by Michelin. It is booked out most nights, so reserve early and call if the online slots look full. ¥660 cover; around ¥10,000–15,000 with wine. International guests were dining in October 2026.

chef_bio.background: Official site (read 2026-11-01): "代表者名 神谷 圭介"; teppanyaki of okonomiyaki and seasonal ingredients in a chic, refined space; many Italian wines, so it also works as a wine bar; an omakase course by phone; private room from four. Tabelog Steak/Teppanyaki WEST 100 in 2024 and 2025. Opened 7 November 2017 (Tabelog). A September 2026 review says it "has even been selected by Michelin".
chef_bio.philosophy: Osaka flavours with a glass of Italian wine in hand (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan course ending in okonomiyaki or thin-noodle yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: "For the main starch, I chose okonomiyaki over yakisoba. The batter was grilled slowly, and it was finished with a vibrant sauce and mayonnaise." — September 2026, a course at the counter.
"The thin noodle yakisoba was crispy, cooked like a fried noodle, and then tossed with sauce." — October 2026.
"There was someone celebrating their birthday that day, and we consulted with the restaurant to have 'Happy Birthday' written in mayonnaise on the okonomiyaki." — August 2026, a private room.

places.cuisine: Italian bar with about 90–100 dishes: seasonal vegetable appetizers, five kinds of ajillo, pizzas, fresh pasta, lasagna; wine, beer, cocktails, sangria (Tabelog; official site) · lunch: fresh pasta (oil, cream or tomato) with salad ¥1,100, large size free (September and October 2026); +¥200 for a set with smoked duck (October 2026); gratin set with salad and drink ¥1,000, or ¥1,200 with duck (September 2026) · evening: prosciutto-wrapped figs, smoked salmon lemon-cream pasta, pizza (September 2026); smoked duck, appetizer and cheese platters; cheese fondue (October 2026); roast beef · party courses with 2-hour all-you-can-drink: Love Wine course ¥4,800 (Tabelog online only), girls' party plan ¥5,500, party plan ¥5,300 (Tabelog, tax included); an omakase plan of salad, appetizers, meat, fish ajillo, pasta, pizza and ice cream, booked by 22:00 the day before (official site)
places.notes: [Italian bar · Umeda, Osaka Station Building No. 3 B2F] A cosy Italian bar in the second basement of Osaka Station Building No. 3, connected to Kitashinchi station, with a menu of about a hundred dishes. Lunch is the draw for local office workers: chewy fresh pasta in an oil, cream or tomato sauce with salad for ¥1,100, a large portion free, and a smoked-duck add-on; a queue forms before noon. In the evening it turns into a wine bar for figs in prosciutto, five kinds of ajillo, pizzas, cheese fondue (book two days ahead) and all-you-can-drink party courses around ¥5,000. Diners like the food but report uneven service: a 30-minute wait for platters, unsmiling staff, and menu prices above those on Tabelog (September 2026), and a lukewarm fondue (October 2026). Smoking at dinner.

roles: Kitchen and bar staff (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog; official site, read 2026-11-01): Bar Gargotta, a hideaway Italian bar in 大阪駅前第3ビル; about 100 dishes, popular fresh-pasta lunches, lasagna, ajillo, pizza and wine snacks; an old-style bar room for dates, girls' nights and parties up to 20.
chef_bio.philosophy: Variety and affordability (Tabelog).

"By 11:45, people started lining up, and I was glad to be seated" — October 2026, the lunch set with cream pasta.

Private rooms for up to 15 and all-you-can-drink courses at ¥5,900–6,500 make it a company-party spot. Reviews are mixed on the seafood (no oysters and so-so sashimi on one August 2026 visit), and the tables at the back lack a call bell. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): opened with a passion for robatayaki; seasonal ingredients sourced only from Tokushima and Nagano; vegetables chosen for quality and size; rice freshly milled each time, the shop regularly visiting the farmers; Kumamoto and Miyazaki beef; 30–35 sakes. Courses with all-you-can-drink were ¥4,980 in October 2026, and the staff surprised one table with an unrequested birthday plate. Busy even on weekdays, so book. Weekend lunch from noon.

places.cuisine: Seasonal Japanese cooking and red-vinegar sushi on a top floor with a night view, every seat a sofa for two facing the window (Tabelog; official site) · lunch box of one soup and several small dishes, with house fresh tofu and miso soup of Daigen miso, rice and miso soup refills (Tabelog; October 2026): the limited box (20 a day) of Saikyo-miso autumn salmon, tempura of autumn vegetables and sea bream with fried oysters, and seared Omi-beef sushi was ¥2,380 on weekdays and ¥2,480 at weekends (October 2026); a beef and fried-oyster lunch (October 2026) · dinner course (October 2026): salmon-roe and avocado tartare on a rice cracker, seared Omi-beef sushi, toro-taku hand roll, yellowtail and sea bream in golden dashi, rare-fried salmon, six-second grilled wagyu shabu-shabu, Omi roast beef over rice with maitake, and a birthday cake · anniversary courses with a whole cake (official site) · winter à la carte: winter yellowtail, milt, snow crab, fugu (official site) · twelve birthstone cocktails, one for each month, and Japanese-style sours (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Japanese · Namba, a night view for two] A Japanese restaurant on the top floor of a Namba office tower, straight up from subway exit 6, where every seat is a sofa for two facing the windows over the city, built for dates and anniversaries; run by Operation Factory, like Kouroan nearby. Lunch is the popular slot and fills from 11:00: a box of small dishes, house-made fresh tofu and Daigen-miso soup with refills, with Saikyo-miso salmon, tempura and seared Omi-beef sushi as the mains (¥2,380 on weekdays in October 2026). In the evening, courses run from Omi-beef sushi and a toro-taku hand roll to fish in golden dashi and wagyu shabu-shabu grilled six seconds, with a cocktail for your birth month; anniversary courses come with a whole cake. Book the window row ahead; one diner found the reception curt (October 2026).

chef_bio.background: Per the official site (Operation Factory): "a first for Namba, a space for two only floating in the night sky", pair sofas with a sense of privacy, Japanese cuisine as courses or à la carte, anniversary courses with a whole cake, bookings through TableCheck. Tabelog: red-vinegar sushi by artisans, a lunch of one soup and many dishes with fresh tofu of half-day shelf life and Daigen miso soup, twelve birthstone cocktails; opened 21 May 2024. Operation Factory also runs 鮨和食 紅炉庵 なんば (osaka_kouroan_namba); an October 2026 diner calls this "the Nanba location".
chef_bio.specialty: Window pair seats; seared Omi-beef sushi; Japanese lunch box.

anecdotes.text: "I made a reservation online the night before, so the front row by the window was fully booked. However, even sitting in the second row, we could still enjoy the beautiful night view." — October 2026, a Sunday date.
"The miso soup, rich in dashi flavor, was so good that I had a second serving from the small bowl." — October 2026, beef and fried-oyster lunch.
"The birthday cake was cut into two pieces by the staff, and it was fluffy with plenty of cream" — October 2026, a dinner course.

places.notes: [Kushikatsu · Dotonbori, Giant Shirata's place] A bright third-floor kushikatsu counter in the Kuidaore building on Dotonbori, owned by the competitive eater Giant Shirata, 195 cm tall per the listing, who is often there in person greeting guests and posing for photos (September–October 2026). The batter is fine and light 'like powder snow', the skewers are large (lotus root, myoga, asparagus, quail eggs, plump shrimp), and the house sauce is the one-dip kind; finish with a fried Yukimi Daifuku. The ¥4,500 Ultimate Course is all you can eat and drink of most of the menu, and the beer comes in a giant mug. Diners call it relaxed and tourist-friendly; one found the beef thin. Queues form before 12:00 and 17:00; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: owned by the food fighter "Giant Shirata"; the owner "stands at 195cm tall"; batter like powdered snow, a carefully blended oil and a sauce that brings out each ingredient; opened 19 July 2009. The official site lists two shops, 道頓堀本店 and 南海通り店, and sells the sauce in souvenir sizes. Diners in September and October 2026 saw the owner serving customers and posing for photos; one remembered watching the owner on TV as a child.
chef_bio.specialty: Kushikatsu with a powder-snow batter; Yukimi Daifuku kushikatsu.

places.notes: [Yakitori · Sennichimae, chicken only until 2 a.m.] A two-floor yakitori house south of the Nankai-dori arcade that serves chicken and nothing else: Nara's Yamato chicken grilled over Kishu binchotan in 21 cuts, each with its own seasoning, sometimes olive oil or salted kelp instead of sauce. Start with the five-cut chicken sashimi (raw chicken is served here), then the special tsukune (¥350) and skewers of back liver and bonjiri for around ¥300, and finish with the fluffy 'torofuwa' oyakodon. It belongs to the same small group as Kamojin around the corner, opens at noon at weekends, and stays open until 2 a.m. nightly. Most 2026 diners found it juicy and good value; one solo diner thought it average (September 2026). Menus in English, Chinese and Korean.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: chicken-only cooking that explores each part, Yamato chicken from Nara over Kishu binchotan of ubame oak, 21 kinds of yakitori; sister shops nearby: Kamojin (osaka_sumibi_yakitori_kamojin_namba in data), Ojijin and Sumiyaki Shoten Yo Namba, the group's first shop.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Seriously, carefully, and slowly" over charcoal (Tabelog).

"I expected the century egg to be simply wrapped in yuba, but it was rolled up with various ingredients like daikon, Kujo green onions, and pickled vegetables" — August 2026, solo at the counter.

places.cuisine: Charcoal yakiniku of top black wagyu bought as whole cattle from around Japan, Kobe, Omi and Yamagata beef among them, in a calm room like a high-end ryotei or kappo (official site; Tabelog) · sides "taught by a Korean chef": kimchi, chijimi, ika-fe (raw squid), changja, cold noodles of the house's own noodles and Korean dishes (official site) · from 2025–2026 reviews: sukiyaki-style beef dipped in egg, rare thigh steak with a peppery egg-yolk sauce, negi-shio tongue, thick-cut tongue (book ahead), nakaochi kalbi, outside skirt, hanging tender, salted tongue, tenderloin, Chateaubriand, marinated meat in a jar, sausages, toro sushi, seafood chijimi, Ginmiya salad, abalone porridge, garlic rice; green tea or pineapple juice to finish · sake, shochu, wine, cocktails
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Shinmachi, whole-cattle black wagyu in a kappo-style room] The Shinmachi shop of Ginmiya, a five-shop Osaka yakiniku name whose Tenma shop Tabelog calls the main store. The house buys top black wagyu as whole cattle and grills it over charcoal in a quiet, ryotei-like room with private rooms, a favourite for business dinners. Diners in 2025–2026 single out the sukiyaki-style beef and the rare thigh steak dipped in a peppery egg-yolk sauce, thick-cut tongue (book ahead or it may run out), the marinated meat in a jar and the seafood chijimi; the meal ends with a glass of green tea or pineapple juice. Signed photos of celebrities line the entrance (November 2025). Diners differ on price: some call it great value, others about ¥10,000 a head with drinks (September and October 2026).

roles: Shop staff unnamed; part of the Ginmiya group of five Osaka shops (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, Ginmiya is particular about whole-cattle black wagyu, yakiniku, interiors and tableware; its sides reproduce Korean flavours "taught by a Korean chef"; shops in Tenma, Nishiku Shinmachi, Shin-Osaka, Kitahama and Baltica 03 (Innogate Osaka), the last opened at the end of July 2024. Tabelog calls Tenma the main store. A March 2026 diner heard the staff get no staff meals; a November 2025 diner saw many celebrity signed photos at the entrance.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Particular about black wagyu, about yakiniku, about the interior, about the tableware" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Whole-cattle black wagyu; sukiyaki-style beef; seafood chijimi.

anecdotes.text: "Sukiyaki → Dip it in egg before eating. It's tender, sweet, and simply delicious! Rare Steak from the Thigh → This was incredibly tasty." — August 2026, a second visit.
"What stood out the most was the marinated meat in a jar. It was surprisingly tender, with flavors deeply infused." — October 2026, private room.
"I visited on a Saturday around 8 PM. Since there was a wait, I recommend making a reservation for a guaranteed spot." — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 吟味屋、黒毛和牛一頭買いにこだわる、焼肉・内装・食器にこだわる、高級料亭や割烹店を思わせる落ち着いた和の雰囲気、全国各地から厳選された最高級の黒毛和牛を炭火で、宴会も、韓国人シェフ直伝のキムチ、チヂミ、イカフェ、チャンジャ、吟味屋独自の麺の冷麺、韓国料理、予約は各店舗に電話で。店舗: 天満店、西区新町店 (新町1-18-3)、新大阪店、北浜店、バルチカ03店 (2024年7月末オープン)。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Ginmiya Nishiku shimmachi ten、焼肉・ステーキ・韓国料理、西大橋駅・四ツ橋駅2番出口から徒歩5分、月・火・木〜日・祝17:00〜23:15 (L.O.22:45)、水曜と第3木曜休み (天満本店、新大阪店、バルチカ03店は営業)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay など) 可、40席、個室 (2〜20名)、全面禁煙、神戸牛・近江牛・山形牛。口コミ(2025年11月〜2026年10月): 卵にくぐらせるすき焼き、胡椒の効いた卵黄のたれで食べるもものレアステーキ、ねぎ塩タン、厚切りタン (予約しないとなくなるかも)、Nakaochi カルビ、ハラミ、サガリ、塩タン、ヘレ、シャトーブリアン、壺漬けの肉、ソーセージ、とろの sushi、海鮮チヂミ、吟味屋サラダ、あわび粥、ガーリックライス、締めに緑茶かパイナップルジュース、入口に有名人のサイン、予約は当日の開店ごろだけという声、待った土曜、1人1万円ほどという声、北浜店にも行ったという声。

places.cuisine: Yakiniku of black-wagyu heifers, chosen for clean-tasting fat from long-standing suppliers, with offal fresh enough for tsurami (cheek) sashimi (official site) · menu highlights (official site): special ribeye as yaki-shabu or steak cut, special wagyu assortment, tongue platter from premium to regular cuts, the day's lean thigh, seared yukhoe dipped in egg · rice of a five-star rice meister's blend cooked in a gas kama, namul and salads of vegetables bought each morning, real unpasteurised makgeolli (official site) · courses, tax included (Tabelog): Namba Senba ¥5,500 (5 items), Soujuen ¥8,800 (8 items), Goku ¥11,000 (9 items) · from 2026 reviews: special Spencer-roll (ribeye) steak about ¥3,000, tail soup, Chateaubriand, raw omasum, grilled liver, akasen, salted tongue, outside skirt · sake, shochu, wine, cocktails
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Minami-Semba, a three-generation family's second shop] The stylish second shop, opened in 2021, of 宗寿苑, a Konohana yakiniku run by its third-generation owner, 竹城成吉, for about sixty years (official site). It serves only black-wagyu heifers, picked for clean fat, and offal fresh enough to eat raw: the tsurami (cheek) sashimi is the house proof and the dish diners remember. Also order the seared yukhoe in egg yolk, the special ribeye as a steak (about ¥3,000 in September 2026) and the collagen-rich tail soup; the rice is cooked from a rice meister's blend. Counter seats downstairs, tables and private rooms up a stair lined with athletes' signatures. Courses run ¥5,500–11,000. One June 2026 diner had all the meat brought at once and remembered frozen meat on an earlier visit.

roles: 宗寿苑 owner 竹城成吉, third generation (official site); HANARE staff unnamed
Group shops listed on the site: つけ麺 雀 and きりん寺 (suzume-group.co.jp)
chef_bio.origin: Konohana, Osaka (the original 宗寿苑; official site).
chef_bio.background: Per the official greeting, 宗寿苑's owner 竹城成吉 is the third generation since the grandfather, about 60 years, keeping to the basics while adding new sensibility; heifers are bought from trusted suppliers on colour, size and fat quality; tsurami sashimi proves the offal's freshness; cuts and sauces reflect the cook's care. The site lists 宗寿苑 (Konohana), 宗寿苑 HANARE (Minami-Semba, opened 8 October 2021 per Tabelog) and 神戸 宗寿苑, and promises "the owner's distinctive talk". Diners describe friendly staff (2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Without chasing fashion, keep to the basics while adding new sensibility" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Tsurami (cheek) sashimi; seared yukhoe; special ribeye.

anecdotes.text: "What left the biggest impression on me was the tsurami sashimi. The moment I took a bite, the rich flavor of the meat spread gently in my mouth." — August 2026.
"I highly recommend the Special Spencer Roll Steak… And it's only about JPY 3000!" — September 2026.
"As mentioned in the reviews, we tried the Aburi Yukhoe and Tsurami Sashimi. They were indeed delicious… And above all, the cost performance was excellent!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 宗寿苑、店主 竹城成吉、祖父の代から三代目、約60年間、流行に左右されず基本を守りながら新しい感性を盛り込む、黒毛和牛の雌牛、色・大きさ・脂の質を見極め信頼を築いてきた取引先から、鮮度が命のホルモン、その証がつらみの刺身、食感を大切にした切り方と肉の旨みを引き出すタレ、毎朝仕入れる野菜のナムルやサラダ、五つ星お米マイスターが当店の肉を味わってブレンドした米をガス釜で、乳酸菌が生きた本場の生マッコリ、リーズナブル。メニュー: 特選リブロース (焼きしゃぶかステーキカット)、特選和牛盛合せ、タン盛り、本日の赤身モモ、炙りユッケ (卵にくぐらせて)。店舗: 宗寿苑 (此花区酉島1-14-17、ノスタルジックな本店)、宗寿苑 HANARE (南船場4-11-8、カウンター席・テーブル席・テーブル個室)、神戸 宗寿苑。グループ店: つけ麺 雀・きりん寺。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 心斎橋駅・四ツ橋駅から徒歩5分、月〜土・祝前17:00〜翌1:00、日・祝17:00〜23:00、カード・PayPay可、46席 (カウンター8、テーブル4×5)、個室、禁煙、車椅子可、オープン2021年10月8日、コース (税込): 難波船場5,500円、宗寿苑8,800円、極11,000円。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): つらみ刺し、炙り Yukhoe、生センマイ、タン、ハラミ、シャトーブリアン、炙りレバー、Akasen、特選リブロースのステーキ3,000円ほど、テールスープ、1階カウンター、2階テーブル、階段にスポーツ選手のサイン、2階は電子たばこ可、肉が一度に出てきた・以前は冷凍だったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter downstairs, tables upstairs. No English evidence found.

places.cuisine: Modern bistro and French cooking with smoked touches, Western technique on Japanese seasonal produce, over a panorama of Osaka (Tabelog) · lunch course LUMIÈRE ¥5,000, ¥4,000 on weekdays with 20% off, ¥6,000 with a drink (Tabelog); a ¥8,000 lunch course adds fish (September 2026) · dinner courses incl. CIEL (September 2026) · from 2026 reviews: thick carpaccio with French cream, cold clam chowder with corn blancmange, chicken wrapped in beef fat with a foie-gras sauce and garam masala, potato churros, white asparagus and squid with yuzu-kosho, vichyssoise or pumpkin potage with chorizo oil, salmon and lotus-root tartare with hazelnut and tapenade, sea bream and shrimp in beurre blanc, sea bream in an herb crêpe with red-wine sauce, smoked duck breast with foie-gras Madeira sauce, charcoal-grilled pork shoulder, black wagyu with wasabi sauce, smoked potato écrasée, a bread with smoked butter, sorbets, a message plate for birthdays · wines, and a wine bar with light snacks
places.notes: [French · Namba, smoked-accent courses on the 33rd floor] The top-floor brasserie of the Centara Grand Hotel Osaka, with a panorama over Minami, serving French courses with a smoky signature, smoked duck, smoked potatoes and above all a smoked butter for the bread that diners keep asking more of. A new chef took over in May 2026; a regular on an eleventh visit found the cooking now more classical, rich in butter and cream. Lunch is a four-course LUMIÈRE at ¥5,000 (¥4,000 on weekdays), or ¥8,000 with a fish course; dinner courses suit anniversaries, with a message plate on request. Views and service usually win praise, but one October 2026 diner found the courses slow, the service inattentive and a ¥1,400 oolong tea hard to justify. No children under 12.

roles: Chef unnamed; new chef from May 2026 (June 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 July 2023 as innovative French KUNSEI in the Centara Grand Hotel Osaka (Tabelog). Per the Tabelog text, it combines Western techniques with seasonal Japanese ingredients and offers wines to match. A regular since at least 2025 noted a new chef from May 2026 and a shift to classical French with plenty of butter and cream (June and August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "A supreme dining experience for all your senses" (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Smoked butter and bread; smoked duck; seasonal French courses.

anecdotes.text: "I visited the restaurant with high expectations for the new chef who took over in May. First off, I was surprised by how reasonable the prices were." — June 2026.
"Especially, the smoked butter paired with a cute brioche-like baguette was incredibly tasty and really enhanced the dishes (I ended up asking for more!)." — September 2026, lunch course.
"The course took an unexpectedly long time, and the waitstaff seemed inattentive." — October 2026.

places.notes: [Izakaya · Shinmachi, the oyakodon you want before you die, with your dog] A small, green-styled charcoal-grill izakaya near Yotsubashi, mostly counter seats, that welcomes dogs. Its name dish is billed as the oyakodon you want to eat before you die (¥1,400): a mound of chicken under a rich, almost drinkable layer of runny egg in dashi, with lemon, pickles and dashi vinegar to change the taste; at lunch it is nearly the only thing on the menu and the room is packed. Evenings bring charcoal-grilled vegetables, chicken and beef tongue and clay-pot rice in all-you-can-drink courses from ¥4,000, served on Doraemon and Heidi plates. Book a table ahead. One November 2026 diner who fears dogs was moved to the counter away from an unleashed dog; another wished the shop had asked whether the oyakodon should be shared.

roles: Owner and staff unnamed in every source read
chef_bio.background: Opened 15 September 2023 as Dining&Bar green (Tabelog). The Tabelog text calls charcoal grilling the speciality and the oyakodon the dish to eat before you die; the shop is dog-friendly and closes occasionally for staff training. Diners describe kind, attentive staff and well-timed courses (2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Oyakodon; charcoal-grilled vegetables, chicken and beef.

anecdotes.text: "It's topped with a generous amount of rich, silky egg sauce and even more egg on top, with tender chunks of chicken throughout, making it the ultimate oyakodon. It's truly a dish you can almost drink." — November 2026, ¥1,400.
"The plates were so cute, featuring characters like Doraemon and Heidi from the Alps, that I almost wanted to take them home." — September 2026.
"What stood out to me were the grilled vegetables over charcoal and the clay pot rice with beef and burdock." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): Shizen to Oniku green (旧店名 Dining&Bar green)、居酒屋、新町1-24-14 1F、四ツ橋駅・西大橋駅から徒歩3分、毎日11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30、炭火焼き・揚げ物・土鍋ご飯は閉店60分前)、研修で休むことも (Instagram でお知らせ)、15分遅れて連絡がなければキャンセル、当日キャンセルは1人5,000円、夜のみお通し439円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、21席、犬同伴可、オープン2023年9月15日。店の説明: 炭火焼きが自慢、A5和牛、新鮮な鶏、旬の野菜、名物は「死ぬまでに食べたい親子丼」、コース飲み放題付き9品4,000円・11品5,000円・13品7,500円。口コミ(2026年2月〜11月): 親子丼1,400円 (大盛り+100円)、とろとろの卵と鶏、濃いだし、レモン・漬物・だし酢で味変、昼はほぼ親子丼だけで満席、kara-age の定食も、炭火焼きの野菜・鶏・牛タン、よだれ鶏、里芋の唐揚げ、牛肉とごぼうの土鍋ご飯、ドラえもんやハイジの器、テーブルは要予約、犬が苦手な人は席を移してもらえた、親子丼を取り分けるか聞いてほしかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly counter seats; book a table ahead; dogs welcome. No English evidence found.

places.name: バッファローマン (Buffalo Man)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Steak on a hot stone plate with three condiments, a sweet sauce, ponzu and rock salt (2024–2026); the rock salt avoids the soy-based sauces, but nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a steak restaurant.
places.hours_raw: Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat and Sun 19:00–22:00 (food last order 21:30); closed Monday and Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; December 2019). 11 seats: about seven at the counter and one table at the back (November 2022); whole-shop hire possible (Tabelog). Almost full on a July 2026 weekday night. Rice refills free (October 2024, April 2025). Opened 11 December 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 東中島1-11-7, in a residential street 4 min from the east exit of JR Shin-Osaka Stn (Tabelog; November 2022)
places.cuisine: Steak grilled and sliced, served sizzling on a stone plate over bean sprouts and cabbage, with sweet sauce, ponzu and rock salt (2022–2026) · Buffalo Man regular steak ¥2,100, ribeye with sweet fat, "probably about 200g", a diner guessed (July 2026) · large steak about 280–300 g (July 2026) · double steak rice set ¥4,100 (April 2025, July 2026) · rice set with miso soup ¥400 (July 2026), rice refills free · outside skirt steak rice set (February 2024) · green onion natto with eggs (October 2023, May 2025)
places.notes: [Steak · Shin-Osaka east side, a stone-plate steak counter] An 11-seat steak counter in a residential street four minutes from the Shin-Osaka east exit, open evenings only since 2011, plainer outside than in. The steak is grilled, sliced and brought sizzling on a hot stone plate over bean sprouts and cabbage, so you finish the cooking yourself; one diner was told to rest slices on the vegetables so they would not overcook (November 2022). The regular Buffalo Man steak, ribeye with sweet fat, is ¥2,100 (July 2026), the double ¥4,100 with rice; three condiments sit on the counter, a sweet sauce, ponzu and rock salt, and rice refills are free. Cash only; closed Mondays and Thursdays. One visitor recommended it to anyone who misses "steakhouses back in the States" (May 2025).

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: steak, opened 11 December 2011, website a blog (jyanbopapa.exblog.jp). Per reviews: the steak "is cooked right in front of me on a stone plate by the passionate owner", who insists, "Don't overcook the meat, place it on top of the vegetables" (November 2022); "The staff exuded a strong sense of dedication and efficiency" (July 2026); "the owner has a quirky personality" (August 2019).
chef_bio.specialty: Stone-plate steak with sweet sauce, ponzu and rock salt.

anecdotes.text: "Given the price, I expected it to be some bland imported beef, but I was pleasantly surprised in a good way. The flavor is rich, the fat is sweet." — July 2026, the regular Buffalo Man steak ¥2,100.
"This is a great steak place near Shin Osaka station. I recommend it if you miss steakhouses back in the States." — May 2025.
"The steak is cut after being grilled, making it easy to eat with chopsticks." — July 2026, double steak rice set ¥4,100.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バッファローマン、ステーキ、大阪市東淀川区東中島1-11-7、JR 新大阪駅東口から徒歩4分、火・水・金・土・日19:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O.21:30)、月・木休み、予約可、現金のみ、11席、2011年12月11日オープン。口コミ(2019年〜2026年): 住宅街、カウンターと奥にテーブル、焼いて切ったステーキを熱い石の皿で、もやしとキャベツの上に、甘いタレ、ポン酢、岩塩、ごはんのおかわり無料、バッファローマンのレギュラーステーキ2,100円 (2026年7月の口コミでは約200gと推測)、ラージは約280〜300g、ダブルステーキのライスセット4,100円、ごはんとみそ汁400円、ねぎ納豆、平日の夜はほぼ満席、アメリカのステーキハウスが恋しい人に、という口コミ。
