places.cuisine: Red-vinegar sushi of fish from the Japan Sea, centred on Kanazawa and Hokuriku, "high quality at an affordable price", in a monochrome, modern Japanese room (Tabelog) · lunch omakase casual course ¥2,800: a small dish, the day's special, eight nigiri, red miso soup (September–October 2026) · autumn "Shinogi" course ¥7,800 in October 2026: isaki in sesame soy, tuna, chutoro, salted bonito tataki, squid, shima-aji, grilled oyster with butter and fried red-vinegar rice chips, grilled salmon, sawara, nameko miso soup, an eel hand roll · bonito carpaccio on the summer menu (September 2026) · sake, shochu and wine
places.notes: [Sushi · Shinsaibashi, Japan Sea fish in a modern room] A sleek sushi bar of dark wood and metal three minutes from Shinsaibashi Station, part of the small Nakago group, serving red-vinegar sushi of fish from the Japan Sea around Kanazawa at prices meant for everyday use. Lunch is the deal: a ¥2,800 omakase of a small dish, the day's special, eight nigiri and red miso soup (October 2026). In the evening the autumn 'Shinogi' course (¥7,800) runs from isaki in sesame soy and two cuts of tuna to a butter-grilled oyster and an eel hand roll; sit at the counter to watch the chefs. Diners like the calm, date-worthy room; two in September–October 2026 felt rushed out at the end of a sitting. No strong perfume, please.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: authentic sushi in a monochrome, modern Japanese designer space; concept "high-quality at an affordable price"; red-vinegar rice; fresh seafood from the Japan Sea centred on Kanazawa; sister shops Sushi Nakago Shinsaibashi and Meat Kaiseki Kissaki. Opened 7 November 2020. An October 2026 diner mentions a Nakago in Umeda.
chef_bio.philosophy: "High quality at an affordable price" (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "I chose the [Lunch Limited Omakase Course] for JPY 2,800. The course includes: Today's appetizer, Today's special dish, 8 pieces of nigiri, Soup" — October 2026.
"First up was Isaki (grunter) dressed in sesame soy sauce. Next, I savored two pieces of tuna nigiri." — October 2026, the Shinogi course ¥7,800.
"To maintain the ambiance, we were instructed to make phone calls outside." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 寿司 なかご 別邸、寿司・海鮮・居酒屋、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-3-2 SOPHIA NEXTビル 1F、心斎橋駅から徒歩3分、毎日12:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜22:30 (L.O.21:30)、年末年始休み、予約可、お通し330円 (税込)、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、34席、カウンター、ソファ席、カップルシート、2・4・6名の個室、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、子ども・ベビーカー可、香水や柔軟剤などの強い香りは控えて、2020年11月7日オープン、姉妹店は Sushi Nakago Shinsaibashi と Meat Kaiseki Kissaki。店の紹介 (英訳): モノクロの和モダンのデザイナーズ空間、「上質をリーズナブルに」、赤酢のシャリ、Kanazawa を中心にした日本海の鮮魚。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): ランチ限定のおまかせカジュアルコース2,800円 (小鉢、本日の一品、にぎり8貫、赤だし)、秋の「Shinogi」コース7,800円 (isaki のごま醤油、マグロ、chutoro、かつおの塩たたき、イカ、shima aji、牡蠣のバター焼き、焼き鮭、sawara、nameko の赤だし、うなぎの手巻き)、夏のかつおのカルパッチョ、電話は店の外で、時間で急かされたという声、Umeda にも店。

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Rice-noodle and rice dishes are common in Thai cooking, but sauces (oyster, soy, fish sauce) are not described, and fried spring rolls and soft-shell crab are battered.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: most dishes use fish sauce, chicken, pork or shrimp.

Reservations accepted for dinner indoors; none at lunch or for the terrace (Tabelog). places.neighborhood: Minami-Senba 2-6-21, 1F of the グラン・ビルド心斎橋 — 5 min from Nagahoribashi Stn, 7 min from Shinsaibashi
places.cuisine: Thai cooking made easy for first-timers, with a photo menu and short descriptions (Tabelog) · lunch sets, e.g. a curry and soup set, the "S-SET" of rice with a daily side and vermicelli soup (September–October 2026); tom yum noodles ¥1,050, spicy but adjustable with table condiments, no coriander (September 2026) · gapao rice, tom kha gai (Tabelog) · pad thai, pad see ew, pad kee mao, khao man gai, gai yang, green curry, yellow curry with soft-shell crab, satay with peanut sauce, fried and fresh spring rolls, minced-pork salad and omelette (2026 reviews) · Thai drinks and wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Thai · Minami-Senba, a Thai kitchen since 1999] A long-running Thai restaurant on a Minami-Senba corner with an open terrace, busy with nearby office workers at weekday lunch. The menu is long and pictured, so first-timers can point: gapao rice, khao man gai, pad thai and the rarer pad see ew and pad kee mao, yellow curry with soft-shell crab, satay with peanut sauce, and a spicy tom yum noodle soup (¥1,050 at lunch in September 2026) that comes without coriander and with condiments to tune the heat. Lunch sets pair a curry or rice dish with soup. Regulars from nearby offices come back again and again; one solo diner found the minced-pork salad hot enough to sweat. Closed Sundays; no lunch bookings.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: authentic Thai cooking made easy to enjoy, a menu with photos and simple descriptions; opened 5 December 1999.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Authentic Thai cuisine that feels just like being in Thailand" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Pad thai; tom yum noodles; khao man gai.

anecdotes.text: "I tried the Tom Yum noodles for JPY 1050. The soup is really tasty. There's no cilantro included." — September 2026, lunch.
"I work nearby, and whenever I go out for lunch with friends, we always choose this place because it's delicious!" — September 2026.
"The soft-shell crab with yellow curry and the satay with peanut sauce were delicious!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): タワンタイ (TAWANTHAI)、タイ料理・カレー・ダイニングバー、大阪市中央区南船場2-6-21 グラン・ビルド心斎橋 １Ｆ、長堀橋駅から徒歩5分、心斎橋駅から徒歩7分、月〜土11:00〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、日曜休み、テイクアウトと Uber Eats は21時まで、予約可 (ランチとテラス席は不可)、カード・電子マネー・PayPay・楽天ペイ可、30席、ソファ席、オープンテラス、禁煙 (テラスも)、子ども可、ペット不可、1999年12月5日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 日本人にも食べやすい本格タイ料理、写真と説明つきのメニュー、gapao rice、tom kha gai。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): khao man gai、tom yum の麺1,050円 (パクチーなし、調味料で辛さを調整)、pad thai、gapao rice、エビの春巻、グリーンカレー、ひき肉のサラダ、ひき肉のオムレツ、gai yang、pad kee mao、pad see ew、ソフトシェルクラブのイエローカレー、サテのピーナッツソース、カレーとスープのランチセット、平日の昼は混む、クーポンを使うと PayPay 不可。

places.name: あづま家 (Azuma Ke)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. A Chinese menu of noodles, gyoza, fried rice and sauced stir-fries; nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Chinese dishes with pork, chicken and seafood; even the vegetable gyoza and vegetable noodle soup are not described as meat-free.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:20–14:30 and 18:00–22:00; closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Lunch is busy with office workers but turns over quickly (2024–2026). Reservations accepted; cash only (Tabelog). 30 seats with a counter and a tatami room; whole hire possible (Tabelog). Second floor of the building (2020, 2024 reviews).
places.neighborhood: 西中島4-2-12, 2nd floor of CSビル, one block west of the north exit of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Stn (Tabelog; November 2020)
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood Chinese (Tabelog: Chinese, ramen, tantanmen) · lunch sets with a mini ramen and rice: daily specials such as Sichuan mapo tofu with stir-fried vegetables, or twice-cooked pork with yurinchi (2025), stamina pork loin with shrimp tempura ¥1,050 (October 2025); five-vegetable soup noodles with mini fried rice ¥950 (February 2025, July 2026); mapo tofu rice bowl set with spice levels 1 to 4 (July 2026); curry fried rice set (September 2026); vegetable tantanmen set, miso ramen set, tantanmen set (2025–2026); hot and sour noodle soup with egg, menma, tofu, squid and chicken (June 2023, September 2026); jajangmyeon with half rice (July 2024) · evening: five-ingredient fried rice ¥800, chive gyoza ¥300, vegetable gyoza ¥350 (September 2025); small plates and a blackboard menu (2020) · homemade chili oil on the tables (2025–2026)
places.notes: [Chinese · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, the office workers' Chinese canteen] A 30-seat Chinese restaurant up one flight of stairs a block from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Station, packed with office workers at lunch on weekdays and quick to turn tables. The lunch sets are the reason: a main of the day, mapo tofu, curry fried rice or a bowl of hot and sour noodles, each with a mini ramen and rice for around ¥950–1,050 (2025–2026). Flavours run light, so regulars reach for the homemade chili oil on the table. Evenings bring thin-skinned vegetable and chive gyoza and fried rice with drinks. Cash only; closed weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: Chinese, ramen and tantanmen, 30 seats with a tatami room, cash only. Per reviews: "the restaurant is committed to using high-quality ingredients, avoiding chemical seasonings, and making [its] own sauces" (November 2020 review); "a favorite among office workers … it seems there are many repeat customers" (July 2024); "Even though it's a Chinese restaurant, [the shop] provided proper cloth napkins" (September 2025); "known for its speedy service" (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets with a mini ramen; hot and sour noodles.

anecdotes.text: "I absolutely love that the set comes with a small ramen. Sometimes, it also includes a small champon or other types of ramen." — July 2026, mapo tofu rice bowl set at spice level 3.
"The chives gyoza and vegetable gyoza were as their names suggest, with the vegetables taking center stage rather than the meat, resembling the thin-skinned Utsunomiya gyoza." — September 2025.
"The dishes at Azuma Ke are light, so I always feel refreshed after eating." — March 2026, vegetable tantanmen set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: あづま家、中華料理・ラーメン・担々麺、大阪市淀川区西中島4-2-12 CSビル 2F、西中島南方駅から97m、月〜金11:20〜14:30、18:00〜22:00、土・日・祝休み、予約可、現金のみ、30席、座敷、貸切可。口コミ(2020年11月〜2026年9月): 西中島南方駅の北口から西へ一筋の2階、昼は会社員でいっぱいで回転が早い、ミニラーメンとごはんつきの日替わりランチ (四川麻婆豆腐と野菜炒め、回鍋肉と油淋鶏、豚ロースのスタミナ炒めとエビ天1,050円)、五目野菜の汁そばとミニチャーハン950円、麻婆丼セット (辛さ1〜4)、カレーチャーハンセット、野菜担々麺、みそラーメン、酸辣湯麺、ジャージャー麺、五目チャーハン800円、ニラ gyoza 300円、野菜 gyoza 350円、自家製ラー油、化学調味料を使わないという声 (2020年)、布のおしぼり、味はあっさり。

cultural_comfort.note: Busy lunch counter on a second floor; cash only. No English evidence found.

places.name: 幸ちゃん 東三国店 (Kou Chan Higashimikuni ten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in tonkotsu, miso or red-miso broth; fried rice, kara-age and gyoza on the side.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone broth and pork chashu; a beef paitan ramen too.
places.hours_raw: Sun, Mon, Wed and Thu 11:00–24:00; Fri and Sat 11:00–02:00; closed Tuesday (shop site; Tabelog agrees); open straight through the afternoon (October 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 28 seats at a counter and tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Garlic is added on request (2026 reviews). Opened 13 September 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 東三国1-33-9, by the footbridge on the south side of Higashi-Mikuni Stn, 30 seconds from exit 4 (Tabelog; March 2026); the shop site gives 東三国1丁目33-8
places.cuisine: Garlic ramen (shop name: にんにくラーメン) · a light tonkotsu broth simmered for hours, with the shop's curly noodles (shop text) · shoyu tonkotsu ramen, with or without garlic (2024–2026) · Kujo negi ramen piled with green onion ¥900 (shop) or ¥1,180 (February 2026) · red miso ramen ¥800 (shop); red miso wakame ramen ¥1,200 (March 2026); spicy miso, miso and kimchi miso ramen (2026) · kimchi chashu ramen, the regulars' order; chashu ramen ¥1,500 (July 2026); special miso chashu ramen ¥1,550 (September 2026) · tsukemen with a rich, slightly salty dip (2025–2026) · beef paitan ramen at the top of the menu (October 2026) · sides: mini chashu rice bowl ¥350, grilled chashu bowl, mini curry ¥500, fried rice set ¥400, gyoza, kara-age (2025–2026) · home-made grilled pork (shop)
places.notes: [Ramen · Higashi-Mikuni, garlic ramen by the station until late] A 28-seat ramen shop right by the footbridge at Higashi-Mikuni Station, the station-side sister of a long-running local shop, open from 11:00 to midnight and until 2 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays. The base is a light tonkotsu with curly noodles, and the staff ask whether you want garlic: say yes for the full effect, or no for a punchy shoyu tonkotsu (2026). Regulars come back for the kimchi chashu ramen and the tsukemen's rich, salty dip, and red-miso, Kujo green-onion and spicy-miso bowls fill out a long menu. The chashu rice bowls and a mini curry are side-dish favourites. A late stop after drinks for many (2025–2026); PayPay, no cards.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site (ninniku-kochan.com, read 2026-11-02): にんにくラーメン 幸ちゃん 東三国店 (reading given as ニンニクラーメン コウチャン ヒガシミクニテン); a light tonkotsu broth simmered for a long time, curly noodles, a range of miso including red miso, side dishes and courses, home-made grilled pork; open until 2:00; a sister shop linked on Tabelog. Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: opened 13 September 2011. Per reviews: "I've been going to the main branch for about 30 years. This was my first time at the station-side location" (February 2026); "Since there are two locations in Higashi-Mikuni, there wasn't a long line" and "The staff was attentive and energetic" (March 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Garlic tonkotsu ramen; kimchi chashu ramen; tsukemen.

anecdotes.text: "The tonkotsu broth was light yet flavorful, packed with umami, and the garlic really hit hard!" — October 2026, shoyu tonkotsu set with garlic.
"I've been captivated by the rich dipping sauce of the Tsukemen for about 10 years now, and it's still amazing." — November 2025.
"I opted for no garlic, and it was a punchy soy sauce tonkotsu ramen." — April 2026, with a mini curry.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog ticks "vegetarian options", there is a vegetable curry at lunch, and the Gujarati thali was a vegetarian meal of bean curry, stewed beans and potato subji (May 2026), but dairy (butter chicken, lassi, cheese naan) is common and nothing is described as vegan.

places.cuisine: Indian, including West Indian Gujarati home cooking (Tabelog; September 2025, May 2026) · lunch sets ¥880–1,500 (April 2026): KHAZANA lunch, one curry with naan ¥880, two curries ¥980 (April 2026); Indian lunch of daily curry, vegetable curry, chicken tikka, salad, saffron rice, a choice of naan and lassi ¥1,100, with a second plain naan free (September 2025; March 2026); cheese naan set ¥1,300 (July 2025); biryani lunch with lamb biryani, curry sauce, raita and a drink (May 2026); Gujarati thali lunch of bean curry, stewed beans, potato subji and more (May 2026) · thin, crisp naan (April 2026) · butter chicken, keema, green curry (2024–2026) · lassi, chai (2024–2026) · lunch delivery: curry rice ¥500, plate with sides ¥600 (April 2026)
places.notes: [Indian · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, a long-running Indian house with Gujarati food] A 30-seat Indian restaurant on a side street near Nishinakajima-Minamigata, around 25 to 30 years old by its regulars' counts (2024–2025), decorated with embroidery the owner made (May 2026) and full of incense and Indian music. Lunch is cheap and generous: two curries, chicken tikka, saffron rice and a thin, crisp naan with lassi for ¥1,100, or one curry from ¥880. What sets it apart is Gujarati food from West India, rare in Kansai: a vegetarian thali of beans and potato subji, and a lamb biryani. Indian families eat here too (April 2026). Evenings bring live music and sometimes belly dance. JCB is the only card.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who made the embroidery on the walls (May 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop site (khazana-osaka.jp, read 2026-11-02): 本格インド料理カジャナ, a long-established Indian curry restaurant in Nishinakajima-Minamigata. Per the Tabelog listing: Indian, vegetarian options, live music. Per reviews: celebrating its 25th anniversary (October 2024); "Authentic Indian Restaurant Established in Osaka for 30 Years" and "I chatted quite a bit with the owner, who mentioned that [the owner] plans to return to India in a few years" (February 2025); "Homemade dishes from Gujarat in Western India are quite rare in Kansai" (September 2025); "The interior is beautifully decorated with embroidery and other crafts made by the owner" (May 2026); "The clientele consisted of local office workers and Indian families" (April 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Gujarati thali; Indian lunch sets with thin naan.

anecdotes.text: "I wanted to fully enjoy authentic vegetarian West Indian cuisine just once, so I held back my craving for meat and ordered the Thali lunch." — May 2026.
"The naan was generally thin, with some parts being crispy." — April 2026, KHAZANA lunch with two curries ¥980.
"I learned that [the restaurant is] celebrating [its] 25th anniversary." — October 2024.

places.cuisine: Japanese-style beef offal (Tabelog: beef dishes) · The Tabelog Award Bronze 2025 and 2026 · the omakase course, about nine dishes in order, which you can stop when full (August 2026): Japanese-style motsu stew, mild and without odour; chire (spleen) sashimi or yukke; tongue stew and tail stew in a gentle demi-glace; blanched mino; smoked neck; cold tongue; grilled skewers of tongue, heart, throat; raw senmai with sesame sauce; heart sashimi with grated daikon; soy-grilled lung; and a tail soup or tail zosui to finish (2018–2026) · drinks: bottled beer ¥600, a house "special highball" ¥300, sake (August 2026) · about ¥5,000–6,300 a head with drinks (2024–2026)
places.notes: [Offal · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, the beef-offal counter people queue for] A 12-seat basement counter three minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, winner of The Tabelog Award Bronze in 2025 and 2026, where there are no bookings and the line starts before 16:00 for a 17:00 opening. Take the omakase: about nine dishes of spotless beef offal in order, from a mild Japanese-style motsu stew and spleen sashimi through tongue and tail stews in a gentle demi-glace, blanched mino, smoked neck, raw senmai with sesame sauce and heart sashimi, to a tail soup or zosui. The owner explains each dish (August 2026). With a beer and a few of the house ¥300 highballs it comes to about ¥5,000–6,300 (2024–2026). Two seatings a night, cash only; check the shop's X account before going.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who explains each dish (August 2026 review)

anecdotes.text: "On a weekday, I arrived at 3:40 PM, aiming for the first seating. Since I was at the front of the line, I sat down and waited for the opening." — August 2026, omakase of 9 dishes.

places.cuisine: Counter sushi made approachable and theatrical: an omakase of about 15 dishes for ¥4,400 with the day's fish, aged tuna, the chef's grandmother's "gyaku-sainari" (upside-down inari) and a ramen finish (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · dishes in September–October 2026: scallops and shimeji in Tosa-vinegar jelly; Kochi bonito; hamo and lotus-root tempura; squid nigiri with a dusting of bamboo charcoal; grilled sawara; Oma tuna; dessert · ramen in a broth from the day's fish trimmings, in small, medium or large (October 2026) · sake and shochu (e.g. Kurokirishima's 110th-anniversary Hyakujyusyu); Sapporo Akaboshi medium bottle ¥880 (October 2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, ¥4,400 entertainment omakase] An eight-seat sushi counter on the third floor of a Kitashinchi building that sets out to make counter sushi unintimidating. The evening starts with the lights down and a video of the chef's life on a big screen (a kendo background is part of the story), then runs through about fifteen dishes for ¥4,400: Tosa-vinegar scallops, bonito, hamo tempura, charcoal-dusted squid, aged tuna, an upside-down inari from the chef's grandmother's recipe, and a fish-bone ramen that several diners rate above most ramen shops. Two sittings a night, 17:30 and 20:00, booked online only. Diners describe a cheerful owner who chats with everyone; two people spent about ¥11,000 with drinks (October 2026). A sister of a Shinsaibashi sushi shop, per one review.

chef_bio.origin: Sister restaurant of a sushi shop in Shinsaibashi (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): friendly, authentic counter sushi in Kitashinchi, each piece made in the spirit of "ippon shobu" from kendo; an omakase of the day's freshest ingredients, aged tuna and the "gyaku-sainari" the chef's grandmother used to make; "Entertainment Sushi". A September 2026 diner describes the opening video of the chef's life; an October 2026 diner notes the head chef's kendo background. The Tabelog name field reads "Sushi Tatsuki", while its shop text calls it "Sushi Ryurai".
chef_bio.philosophy: Counter sushi that is approachable, memorable and entertaining (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The lights in the restaurant went out... In the darkness... What appeared on the large TV was... A memoir... from childhood to adulthood..." — September 2026.
"It seems like it was seasoned only with salt and sugar, but honestly, it could compete with any ramen shop!" — October 2026, the ramen finish; ¥11,000 for two.
"On top of the sweet and tender squid, there was even bamboo charcoal!" — September 2026, the ¥4,400 course.

cultural_comfort.note: One set course at an eight-seat counter, booked online; the chef talks with every guest (2026). No English evidence found.

places.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, Edomae from a Kyubey-trained chef] A basement sushi counter in Kitashinchi, opened in April 2026, where a chef trained at Ginza Kyubey serves Edomae sushi on red-vinegar rice. The ¥16,500 course runs to twenty dishes: grilled tuna cheek and brain to start, hamo jelly or seasonal simmered dishes, abalone with liver sauce, a turtle-and-shark-fin dobin-mushi, and eleven nigiri; a nigiri-only course is ¥11,000 at the late sitting. Most diners found it good value for Kitashinchi. One September 2026 diner was less happy: the same piece was made for every guest at once, sashimi soy sauce was self-serve, and staff let neighbours play videos aloud. Part of a group that also runs Gyoza no Kacchan, per that review. Dress smartly; two sittings, 18:00 and 20:30.

chef_bio.origin: Part of a restaurant group that also operates Gyoza no Kacchan (September 2026 review); "part of a group that operates several dining establishments" (July 2026 review).
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): "A chef trained at Ginza Kyubey" brings Edomae technique to Kitashinchi; red-vinegar rice; ageing, salting, vinegar curing and kombu curing; simmered, grilled and steamed dishes tailored to each ingredient. Opened 24 April 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Edomae technique with a playful spirit (Tabelog).

places.notes: [Chinese · Umeda Sky Building, 39th floor] The Chinese restaurant on the 39th floor of the Umeda Sky Building, with views over Osaka by day and a night view diners call outstanding. Courses use Cantonese technique: mango-mayonnaise prawns are the signature, alongside Peking duck, shark fin from Kesennuma, steamed amadai and braised wagyu cheek. Lunch courses (¥4,000–7,000) are the usual way in; dinners from ¥8,000, plus 10% service. Families and business lunches fill the four private rooms; book a window table or window room for the view, and mention celebrations for a message plate. Service gets mixed notes: kind staff who took family photos (October 2026), but missed orders and slow responses in a private room (September 2026) and slow drinks on a fireworks night (October 2026).

roles: Kitchen and service staff (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.origin: The Chinese restaurant of Umeda Sky Building (skybldg.co.jp).

A September 2026 diner returned after about 30 years.
chef_bio.specialty: Large prawns with mango mayonnaise; Peking duck; shark fin.

places.cuisine: Sushi omakase with fish, rice, nori, wasabi and tea chosen from across Japan; nigiri on a blend of red and white vinegar rice, with two kinds of shari to compare (Tabelog; June 2026); over ten sakes chosen by staff (Tabelog) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): Ikken omakase of 21–25 dishes ¥22,000; lunch omakase special ¥13,200; lunch "Ayakasu" course ¥5,500 of a hassun platter and nigiri; the dinner course was ¥13,200–13,600 through an online booking site (June and October 2026) · dishes in 2026 reviews: komatsuna ohitashi, Nagasaki kensaki squid, Akashi flounder and octopus, a hassun with dashimaki and grilled corn (August); three cuts of tuna sashimi, ikura, tekka maki (March); sawara, grouper, eel, panna cotta (June); bluefin, sweet shrimp, sea urchin (June) · flowers for birthdays and anniversaries (April, June, September 2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, a ten-seat counter with two kinds of rice] A ten-seat sushi counter entered from a side street in Kitashinchi, with fish, rice, nori and wasabi chosen from across Japan and nigiri served on two kinds of shari, red-vinegar and white-vinegar, to compare. The dinner omakase runs to over twenty dishes at ¥22,000 (diners booking through an online site paid ¥13,200–13,600 in 2026); lunch, Thursday to Saturday, starts at ¥5,500 for a hassun platter and nigiri. Diners praise a head chef who explains every dish (one review says the chef came from the Ritz-Carlton) and staff who adjust rice portions and mind your departure time; celebrations get a bouquet. One June 2026 diner found the tuna sashimi and sea urchin a little fishy. No strong perfume.

roles: Head chef (unnamed; "from the Ritz-Carlton", per an October 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): meticulous sourcing, preparation and cooking; fresh fish, rice, seaweed, wasabi and tea from various regions; nigiri combining red and white vinegar; over ten sakes chosen by knowledgeable staff. Opened 21 June 2023. Reviews: the chef shares a lot of information about the dishes (May 2026); "the head chef is from the Ritz-Carlton" (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Commitment to sourcing, preparation and cooking (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase with red- and white-vinegar shari.

anecdotes.text: "You can also compare two types of rice paired with the toppings, and it's absolutely delicious..." — June 2026.
"I was pleasantly surprised when they gave me a bouquet on my way out, which is fitting for the location!" — April 2026, a birthday.
"I appreciated their flexibility in adjusting the rice portion and the amount I wanted to eat." — September 2026.

places.name: スリランカ料理 ラサハラ (RASA HALA)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The plates are basmati rice with curries, dal and side dishes, and the biryani is rice-based, but nothing is described as gluten-free and the curry bases are not described.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. A Veggie Plate is on the menu, not spicy (August 2026), and the Ceylon plates include a lentil curry and a vegetable curry (October 2026), but nothing is labelled vegan and the sides are not described.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–22:00; Sun 11:00–14:00; closed Monday (Tabelog, hours changed from July 2026). Special events on Poya (full-moon) days; daily specials and days off posted on the shop's Facebook page (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 18 seats: two tables for four, three for two, four at the counter; hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Spice adjusted on request, and a children's curry made with notice (Tabelog). Opened 5 December 2011 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Sri Lankan rice and curry (Tabelog) · Special Ceylon Plate ¥1,500: basmati rice, five side dishes, an egg and three curries (meat, lentil and vegetable) (September and October 2026); Ceylon Plate lunch with a meat curry of choice (chicken, pork, mutton or pork keema) and beans and vegetables (September and November 2026) · Veggie Plate, not spicy (August 2026) · biryani: mutton ¥1,500, bone-in (September and October 2026); chicken ¥1,400 with mini salad, with fried and stewed chicken, sweet dal and tangy sides (September 2026); large portions possible · coriander sambol, fried rice with chicken curry (2026) · desserts: Kal Dothul (November 2026), ice cream on warm pastry (May 2026) · chai, iced chai; wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Sri Lankan · Higashimikuni, rice and curry by the station] A small Sri Lankan restaurant two minutes from Higashimikuni Station, open since 2011 and on Tabelog's Curry WEST 100 in 2019, where a Sri Lankan chef cooks (September 2026). The lunch to order is the Ceylon plate: basmati rice with a meat curry (chicken, pork, mutton or keema), a lentil and a vegetable curry, an egg and five small sides, ¥1,500 for the special (2026), which you mix together as you go. The meat curries can be fierce, the dal gentle; there is a mild Veggie Plate, and biryani with chicken or bone-in mutton. Kal Dothul, a sweet set like a rice cake, finishes it (November 2026). The chef is friendly; ask about heat when ordering. Closed Monday; Sunday lunch only.

chef_bio.origin: Sri Lanka, per a September 2026 review ("The Sri Lankan chef truly delivers authentic flavors").
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: opened 5 December 2011; Tabelog Curry WEST 100 2019; daily specials and days off on Facebook; spice adjusted on request and a children's curry with notice; special events on Poya (full-moon) days. A November 2026 diner: "The chef was also very friendly and had a lovely smile!"

anecdotes.text: "The Special Ceylon Plate is a colorful dish featuring basmati rice, five side dishes, an egg, and three types of curry—meat, lentil, and vegetable." — October 2026.
"The Veggie Plate wasn't spicy, so it's recommended for those who want to enjoy spices but are sensitive to heat." — August 2026.
"Kal Dothul had a texture similar to a sweet rice cake or yokan, and it was a sweet and spicy dessert." — November 2026, after a Ceylon plate with pork keema.

places.vegan_detail: Ask. The pain de Lodève is "made with just water and wheat" (March 2026) and the baguette is plain, but nothing is labelled vegan; most other breads use butter, cream, eggs, cheese or meat.

places.cuisine: Levain bakery with freshly roasted coffee (2026) · hard breads: pain de Lodève, 90% hydration, water and wheat only, ¥250 (March and July 2026); baguette ¥250, cheese and dried-fruit loaf ¥690 (July 2026); cheese levain, half ¥580 (July 2026) · Lodève pizza with potato ¥350, roast-chicken rustique sandwich ¥420, French toast ¥300, rum raisin ¥350, almond croissant ¥350 (March 2026) · salt bread ¥150, cream bread ¥260, egg pizza ¥270 (October 2026); egg sandwich ¥230 (July 2026); melon bread (March 2026) · tartines at breakfast (September 2025) · coffee ¥500 (April 2026), iced latte ¥450 (July 2026) · evenings: a snack-bread set of soup, bruschetta and all-you-can-eat French and white bread ¥500 (July 2026); three reds, one orange and three whites by the glass, and shochu (March 2026)
places.notes: [Bakery café · Higashimikuni, levain bread by day, wine by night] A small bakery and coffee bar a few minutes from Higashimikuni Station, open since 2022 behind a plant-covered front, baking levain breads that reviewers rate highly: a 90%-hydration pain de Lodève of just water and wheat for ¥250, a cheese and dried-fruit loaf, baguettes, an almond croissant and a salt bread one diner loved (2026). Eat in with freshly roasted coffee (one drink each) and warm your bread in the toaster. In the evening it doubles as a bar, with a few wines by the glass and a ¥500 snack set of soup, bruschetta and all-you-can-eat bread with salt and sunflower oil (July 2026). One April 2026 diner found the service curt and the coffee lukewarm. Cash only; open from 7:30, closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 4 August 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers: the breads are levain-based (March 2026); the "master" suggested drinks to match what one diner wanted (March 2026); an April 2026 diner wondered whether "the quiet young man" at the counter was the owner.
chef_bio.specialty: Pain de Lodève and levain breads; evening snack-bread set.

anecdotes.text: "With a hydration rate of 90%, this chewy bread is made with just water and wheat." — March 2026, the pain de Lodève for JPY 250.
"The snack bread set comes with soup and bruschetta, along with all-you-can-eat French bread for just JPY 500!" — July 2026, an evening visit.
"Upon taking a sip, I found it... lukewarm!!" — April 2026, a JPY 500 hot coffee.

places.name: うどん工房 天空 (Udon Kobo Tenku)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade wheat udon with soy sauce, and tempura.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: udon broths and kayaku rice use dashi; tempura includes chikuwa and egg; meat and sukiyaki udon.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Wed and Thu 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–20:00, evenings until sold out; Tue, Fri, Sat and holidays 11:00–14:30; closed Sunday (Tabelog). No reservations; cash, PayPay or Rakuten Pay; no cards (Tabelog). 20 seats at a counter and in a tatami room at the back; non-smoking; children welcome, three children's menus from ¥500 (Tabelog). Full by noon, with people waiting inside and out; earlier or later is easier (September 2026). Opened 22 March 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 東三国4-17-7, ground floor of メゾンハヤシ — 3 min from Higashimikuni Stn (Midosuji Line) (Tabelog), among the udon shops west of the station (March 2026)
places.cuisine: Homemade udon in the line of Umeda Hagakure (Tabelog) · Nama Shoyu Udon, cold, ¥900: long, firm noodles with green onion, grated daikon and sudachi, the soy poured and the sudachi squeezed by the owner (August and September 2026) · bukkake udon set with three tempura (chikuwa, pumpkin, egg) ¥1,250 (September 2026); bukkake tempura udon ¥1,300 (October 2026); meat and grated-eggplant tempura bukkake (summer 2026) · curry udon ¥1,200 (March 2026); cold curry tsukemen (summer 2026); sukiyaki kamatama udon ¥1,250 (September 2026); chilled kitsune udon ¥900 (September 2026) · set of three tempura +¥300; "Manpuku" with kayaku rice and three tempura +¥450 (September 2026); chikuwa tempura ¥150 (September 2026) · kayaku rice, much praised (2026) · oden (September 2026)
places.notes: [Udon · Higashimikuni, nama shoyu udon from the Hagakure line] A bright udon shop west of Higashimikuni Station, opened in 2019 by a disciple of Osaka's famous Umeda Hagakure (September 2026 reviews), with a counter and a tatami room for families. The house dish is Hagakure's Nama Shoyu Udon: cold, long, firm homemade noodles with grated daikon and green onion, finished at the table when the owner squeezes sudachi and pours a little soy over them, "udon is like sashimi", as the shop puts it (Tabelog). Bukkake, curry and seasonal udon fill the menu; add three fresh tempura for ¥300, or kayaku rice as well for ¥450, and the rice may steal the show (September 2026). It is full by noon; come early. Lunch daily except Sunday, evenings Monday, Wednesday and Thursday only.

roles: Owner (unnamed) trained at Umeda Hagakure, and staff
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: serves the "Nama Shoyu Udon" of the famous Osaka restaurant Umeda Hagakure; "The tradition of serving udon with soy sauce comes from our predecessor, who taught us that 'udon is like sashimi'"; homemade noodles; opened 22 March 2019. Reviewers: "run by one of its disciples" (September 2026); a September 2026 diner read on the shop's website that the owner trained at Hagakure in Umeda.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Udon is like sashimi" (Tabelog, the predecessor's teaching).

anecdotes.text: "The owner squeezed sudachi (Japanese citrus) and drizzled a small amount of soy sauce over the grated daikon radish." — September 2026, the cold Nama Shoyu Udon for JPY 900.
"I came to eat udon, but unexpectedly, the Kayaku Rice stole the show." — September 2026, a longtime Umeda Hagakure regular.
"The udon had an exquisite texture, completely different from the overly chewy types often found in Tokyo lately." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うどん工房 天空、うどん・天ぷら、大阪市淀川区東三国4-17-7 メゾンハヤシ 1F、Midosuji 線 東三国駅から3分、月・水・木11:00〜14:30、17:30〜20:00 (夜は売り切れまで)、火・金・土・祝11:00〜14:30、日曜休み、予約不可、カード不可、PayPay・楽天ペイ可、20席 (カウンターと奥の座敷)、禁煙、子ども可、キッズメニュー3種 (500円から)、2019年3月22日オープン。店の紹介: 大阪の有名店 Umeda Hagakure の「Nama Shoyu Udon」、ねぎ、大根おろし、すだち、選んだ醤油、「うどんは刺身のようなもの」という先代の教え、自家製麺。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月): Hagakure の弟子の店、冷たい Nama Shoyu Udon 900円、店主がすだちをしぼって醤油をかけてくれる、長くてコシのある麺、ぶっかけうどんのセット1,250円 (ちくわ、かぼちゃ、卵の天ぷら)、ぶっかけ天ぷらうどん1,300円、肉と揚げなすおろしのぶっかけ、カレーうどん1,200円、冷たいカレーつけ麺、すき焼きの釜玉うどん1,250円、冷やしきつねうどん900円、天ぷら3種のセット300円、かやくごはんと天ぷらの「Manpuku」450円、かやくごはんが絶品、おでん、昼は満席で外にも行列。

cultural_comfort.note: The owner finishes the nama shoyu udon at your seat; children's menus and tatami seats. No English evidence found.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kara-age, shrimp mayo and noodle dishes (tantanmen, mazesoba, ramen) are on every lunch menu; nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken, pork and shrimp sets with egg soup.

places.cuisine: Chinese set lunches and dinners (2025–2026) · lunch sets ¥930–1,100 with egg soup, pickles, a small dessert and free rice (May 2026): kara-age set, four pieces, ¥1,000 (April 2026); shrimp mayo set (July 2026); yodare (mouth-watering) chicken set ¥930 (May and October 2026); daily specials such as pork with green peppers (October 2026) or Sichuan horumon (February 2026); egg fried rice set (often sold out, August 2026) · mapo mazesoba ¥1,100 (February 2026); sesame tantanmen and dry tantanmen (June 2026); spicy mazesoba (August 2026); a new chicken-salt ramen with one kara-age ¥1,000 (October 2026) · evenings: a set of two dishes with a drink ¥1,380 (June 2026); all-you-can-eat-and-drink ¥3,880 (February 2026); yurinchi, beef fried rice, shrimp and egg stir-fry, spicy green-onion chashu (February 2026)
places.notes: [Chinese · Nishimiyahara, set lunches with bottomless rice] A neighbourhood Chinese restaurant in the same apartment building as Ramen Yamafuji, west of Shin-Osaka, which per one May 2026 diner began as a tsukemen shop and has grown into a fuller Chinese menu with many staff "from the region". Lunch is the draw: a ¥930–1,100 set (kara-age, shrimp mayo, yodare chicken, a daily special) with egg soup, pickles, a small dessert and rice you refill yourself from a jar in the middle of the room (2026), or a sesame tantanmen or mapo mazesoba. It gets a lunch line and the popular egg fried rice set sells out (August 2026). In the evening it turns into a drinking spot with a two-dish set for ¥1,380 or all-you-can-eat-and-drink for ¥3,880 (2026). Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.origin: A May 2026 diner: the shop "has increasingly embraced authentic Chinese cuisine, thanks to many staff members from the region".
chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Per a May 2026 review, it "started with Tsukemen but has increasingly embraced authentic Chinese cuisine"; an October 2026 diner notes decor and staff that "contribute to the authentic dining experience".
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets with free rice; tantanmen; yodare chicken.

anecdotes.text: "In the center of the restaurant, there's a self-service rice jar, allowing unlimited refills." — May 2026, the yodare chicken set for JPY 930.
"The flavor of sesame is intense, and the slight spiciness warms you up from within!" — June 2026, the sesame tantanmen.
"I noticed an all-you-can-eat and drink option for JPY 3,880! Given the current high prices, this is quite a reasonable deal for a local restaurant." — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華ダイニング 隆勝、中華料理・つけ麺・ラーメン、大阪市淀川区西宮原2-6-16 新大阪コーポビアネーズ 1F、三国駅から697m、月〜土・祝11:30〜14:30、17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、日曜休み、予約可、カード (JCB、AMEX)・電子マネー可、QR 不可、禁煙。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年10月): もとはつけ麺の店で、本場出身のスタッフが多く本格的な中華に、昼の定食930〜1,100円 (卵スープ、漬物、デザート、ごはんおかわり自由)、kara-age 定食4個1,000円、エビマヨ定食、よだれ鶏定食930円、日替わり (ピーマンと豚肉の炒め物、四川の味のホルモン)、卵チャーハン定食は売り切れも、麻婆まぜそば1,100円、ごま担々麺、汁なし担々麺、辛いまぜそば、鶏塩ラーメンと kara-age 1,000円、夜は2品とドリンクのセット1,380円、食べ放題・飲み放題3,880円、Yurinchi、牛肉チャーハン、エビと卵の炒め物、ねぎチャーシュー、券売機は新札不可、昼は行列、喫煙できる店という声も。

places.cuisine: Okonomiyaki, negiyaki (soy-sauce flavour), modern-yaki, yakisoba and omusoba, cooked in the kitchen and brought to the table on small one-person iron plates; fillings of pork, squid, octopus, shrimp, scallop, beef tendon, mushroom, cheese and mochi; mayonnaise and mustard can be left off (Tabelog menu, last updated 2023) · the batter uses a house dashi of chicken bones, kombu and other ingredients and fine cake flour (official site, Toyonaka shop) · from 2026 reviews: pork modern-yaki, mochi-cheese modern-yaki, omusoba, tonpei-yaki, potato salad
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Namba Sennichimae, iron-plate okonomiyaki without a table grill] The Namba branch, opened June 2023, of AT THE 21, an okonomiyaki house opened in 1984 in a smart Toyonaka residential area by the second son of a liquor-shop family. The founding idea, kept here, is a bright café-like room with no grill on the tables: okonomiyaki are cooked in the kitchen and served on a small one-person iron plate, so clothes and hair do not pick up the smell. Diners in 2026 praise the fluffy, thick okonomiyaki and modern-yaki and the big portions; two September and October 2026 diners found the batter dry or the sauce light and did not plan to return. Orders are by QR code. Two diners (September and November 2026) noticed many guests from abroad, and the November diner found the staff attentive and kind.

roles: Shop staff unnamed; Namba branch of AT THE 21 (official site; Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (株式会社２４, representative director 西 真澄), the founder, second son of a liquor shop, opened AT THE 21 in Toyonaka in 1984, choosing okonomiyaki as the dish closest to Osaka people; the glass-fronted, café-like shop with no noren or sign became the talk of the area, and from 2016 the house also had a shop in Panasonic Stadium Suita. The Tabelog listing for Namba (opened 2023-06-01) says the house is "recognized as one of the top 100 establishments".
chef_bio.philosophy: "Bright and modern so that solo diners and women can come in easily"; no iron plates on the tables "so that guests' smart clothes do not pick up stains or smell" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Okonomiyaki and modern-yaki on one-person iron plates.

anecdotes.text: "Since there’s no teppan right in front of you, it’s not hot, and your clothes and hair won’t pick up any odors." — September 2026.
"It was fluffy and served on the teppan, so it stayed hot until the very end—delicious!" — September 2026, mochi-cheese modern-yaki.
"The batter was dry and crumbly, like a custard with chopped green onions thrown in." — September 2026, third visit.
"The food was not particularly memorable, but the service from the staff was very attentive and kind." — November 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (株式会社２４、代表取締役 西 真澄): 酒屋の次男だった創業者が1984年に豊中市でAT THE 21を開店、大阪人に身近なお好み焼き、カフェのようなガラス張りで暖簾・看板なし、お一人様や女性も入りやすい明るくモダンな店、テーブルに鉄板を置かず焼き上がりをオーダーメイドの小さな1人用の鉄板で出す、2016年からパナソニックスタジアム吹田にも出店、生地は鶏ガラ・昆布などの自家製だしとケーキ用の上質な小麦粉、キャベツや青ねぎは季節ごとに一番美味しい産地のもの (豊中の店の説明)。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 難波千日前4-5、2023年6月1日オープン、月〜金12:00〜15:30・17:30〜22:00、土日祝12:00〜22:00、不定休、予約可、カード (VISA、Master)・PayPay、テーブル28席、禁煙、子ども歓迎。メニュー (2023年更新): お好み焼き、チーズお好み焼き、焼きそば、ネギ焼き (しょうゆ味)、モダン焼き、チーズモダン焼き、オムそば、マヨネーズとからしは抜きもできる。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月): ふわふわで分厚い、量が多い、QRコードで注文、モダン焼き (ブタ) 1,700円、海鮮のネギ焼き2,100円、外国からの客が多い、生地がぱさつく・ソースが薄いという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Orders by QR code (2026 reviews). Two diners noticed many guests from abroad (September and November 2026). No English menu or English-speaking staff found in the sources.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The harami steak comes with several dips (sauce, egg yolk, truffle, red-wine salt, wasabi, salt), and the menu also has seared nigiri, kalbi, cold noodles and namul (Tabelog menu; reviews); nothing is stated about wheat.

Courses and seats limited to 2 hours; a no-show is assumed after 15 minutes late without a call (Tabelog). 10% service charge on tax-inclusive prices (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay, d Barai, au PAY; no e-money. 24 seats (8 counter, 16 table); non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-7-8, inside Hozenji Yokocho — 7 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Yakiniku built around harami (outside skirt) of top black wagyu, Japan's first harami-specialist (Tabelog); the signature thick harami steak is grilled by the staff at the table, flambéed and sliced in the kitchen; red meat chosen weekly with the suppliers, and the manager visits cattle farms (Tabelog) · courses of 13 dishes at ¥9,900, ¥13,200 and ¥16,500 (Tabelog) · à la carte: harami yukhoe-style with truffle, harami and caviar spoon, seared nigiri, Kobe, Matsusaka and Ota beef strip loin, Chateaubriand, thick-cut tongue, kalbi, offal, namul, kimchi, truffle tamago-kake-gohan, sudachi cold noodles (Tabelog menu, May 2026) · tableware made for the house by the fifth-generation potter of やすお陶房, Shigaraki (official site) · wine chosen by a sommelier; sake, shochu, cocktails
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Hozenji Yokocho, black-wagyu harami grilled at the table] The Hozenji Yokocho shop, opened September 2018, of Kitashinchi Harami, a four-shop yakiniku name devoted to harami (outside skirt) of top black wagyu; Tabelog says it was produced by Ryuka Hattori, who trained at the Italian restaurant Ponte Vecchio. Behind a heavy wooden door on the stone-paved alley, staff grill the thick harami steak at the table, flambé it with brandy and slice it in the kitchen; it is eaten with egg yolk, truffle, red-wine salt or sauce. Most 2026 diners take the 13-dish Hozenji course and call it a place for celebrations; one says opinions about the place vary. The house says it was ranked 3rd in Japan in the fine-dining category of TripAdvisor's Best of the Best 2026. A June 2026 diner found all the other guests were from abroad.

roles: Produced by Ryuka Hattori, who trained at the Italian restaurant Ponte Vecchio (Tabelog); grill staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per harami.jp, Kitashinchi Harami runs four shops: the main shop and 北新地別邸 in Kitashinchi, the Hozenji shop and 新大宮店 in Nara (opened May 2020). Per Tabelog, harami is a rare cut of only 2–3 kg per cow, which the house gets through its own channels; the manager visits cattle farms and picks the red meat each week with lean-cut suppliers. The official site says the interiors are by a popular shop designer and the tableware was designed and fired for the house by the fifth-generation potter of やすお陶房 in Shigaraki.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Dishes that women also find easy to eat"; harami that is healthy for the body yet delicious (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Black-wagyu harami steak grilled and flambéed at the table.

anecdotes.text: "The harami steak was served rare, allowing us to enjoy it with sauce and egg yolk." — March 2026, Hozenji course.
"The staff grilled it for us until the end, making for a fun dining experience." — April 2026, at the counter.
"While there are various opinions about this place, I personally found it to be absolutely satisfying!" — May 2026.
"All the other customers were foreigners." — June 2026, ¥9,900 course.
"Highly recommend! Chef Yuji was fantastic. Above and beyond." — Google review shown on the official site.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 北新地はらみ 法善寺店、道頓堀1-7-8 仲谷ビル1F、国産高級黒毛和牛から厳選した部位だけを出すはらみ特化店、ヘルシーで美味しい、「女性も食べやすい料理」、ワインが豊富、人気店舗デザイナーの内外装、食器は信楽焼やすお陶房の五代目安兵工窯が当店のために制作、法善寺横丁にひっそり佇む木造の店、トリップアドバイザー「ベスト・オブ・ザ・ベスト2026」高級店部門日本3位 (2026年10月6日のお知らせ)。グループサイト (harami.jp): 店舗は北新地はらみ本店、北新地別邸、法善寺店、新大宮店 (奈良、2020年5月12日オープン)、名物はらみステーキはスタッフが目の前で焼く。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 2018年9月21日オープン、毎日12:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、不定休 (Instagramで告知)、コースは2時間制、サービス料10%、24席、禁煙、Ryuka Hattori (Ponte Vecchio出身) のプロデュース、日本初のはらみ専門、はらみは牛1頭から2〜3kg、店長が牧場を訪ね毎週赤身を厳選、コース9,900円・13,200円・16,500円。口コミ (2026年3月〜8月): 法善寺コース13,200円、はらみステーキをブランデーでフランベし卵黄・トリュフ・赤ワイン塩などで、厚切りタン、肉寿司、スタッフが焼いてくれる、他の客は全員外国人だった (6月)、評価はいろいろだが満足という声。

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a Neapolitan pizzeria whose pizza dough uses pizza flour from Italy (official site) and whose menu is mostly pizza and pasta (Tabelog menu). Meat and seafood dishes such as octopus carpaccio exist, but nothing is stated about wheat or the wood-fired oven.

places.cuisine: Neapolitan pizza from a wood-fired oven brought from Naples, set in the middle of the room, with pizza flour from Italy (official site; Tabelog); certified by the Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana in April 2007 as its 242nd member and the first in Osaka (Tabelog) · about twenty pizzas from marinara and Margherita to a buffalo-mozzarella Margherita DOC, a sun-shaped house pizza and porcini with truffle, half-and-half for ¥440 more; pasta such as rigatoni with Neapolitan ragù, octopus in tomato sauce and colatura spaghetti from Cetara; octopus carpaccio, burrata, fried seafood, Nakayama beef tagliata (Tabelog menu, November 2025) · lunch from ¥1,100 (official site) · wine, cocktails, sangria
places.notes: [Italian · Shinsaibashi, wood-fired Neapolitan pizza since 2004] A Neapolitan pizzeria opened in April 2004 on the second floor of a building near Shinsaibashi Daimaru, the older of the two shops of the Il Sole group, founded in 1994. In April 2007 it became the 242nd member worldwide, and the first in Osaka, of the Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana. Firewood is stacked by the Naples-built oven and Napoli shirts hang on the walls. Diners in 2026 praise the charred, chewy Margherita, the honey-drizzled four-cheese pizza and the octopus-in-tomato pasta; one lunch regular has come for about fifteen years. Portions are large; one diner found à la carte pasta pricey and lunch the better deal. Tabelog lists a menu in English, Chinese and Korean.

roles: Kitchen staff unnamed; shop of 株式会社イル・ソーレ (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the group was founded by 中西康之, a Tsuji graduate who trained in Italy from 1990, including at one-Michelin-star restaurants, and set up Il Sole in 1994; 中西 stepped down in October 2022 and stays on as adviser. The second-generation president 谷健太郎 was on the opening staff of Il Sole Rosso in 2004, became a shop manager at 26 (2009), trained in Cetara, Italy (2010), was named Kansai area leader of the Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana and qualified as a sommelier (2013), and became president in October 2022; the site names 谷 as group head manager. The group also ran other shops over the years; its current shops are Il Sole Rosso and Il Sole TEN-3 (Tenjinbashi, 2012). The Tabelog menu calls the octopus carpaccio "a dish I learned in Cetara, Southern Italy" without naming the cook.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Authentic Neapolitan pizza by a pizza-association-certified chef: chewy dough full of the fragrance of wheat" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Wood-fired Neapolitan pizza; octopus carpaccio with colatura.

anecdotes.text: "I've been a regular at this restaurant for about 15 years." — September 2026, Margherita lunch.
"Upon entering, you’ll notice the firewood stacked up and Napoli uniforms displayed, which adds to the charm of its enduring atmosphere." — October 2026.
"The a la carte pasta is a bit pricey, so lunch is a better option if you decide to go." — September 2026.
"After that, we were served pasta and pizza, but the portions were so large that we couldn't finish them." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: イルソーレ・ロッソは2004年に心斎橋でオープン、20年以上ナポリの味、ナポリピッツァ協会認定シェフの本格ナポリピッツァ、イタリアから取り寄せたピッツァ専用の小麦粉、ランチ1,100円〜、薪窯の見えるカウンター6席。会社概要 (株式会社イル・ソーレ、天神橋3-5-16、設立1994年4月): 創業者中西康之 (辻調理師専門学校卒、1990年イタリア研修、1994年創業、2022年10月退社後顧問・相談役)、2代目代表取締役兼統括店長谷健太郎 (イルソーレロッソオープニングスタッフ、2009年26歳で店長、2010年チェターラで研修、2013年真のナポリピッツァ協会関西エリアリーダー・ソムリエ、2022年代表取締役)、沿革に2004年4月ロッソ、2012年7月 TEN-3 (天神橋) など。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 2004年4月27日オープン、2007年4月に真のナポリピッツァ協会の世界242番目・大阪初の認定店、ナポリ製の薪窯、火〜日・祝11:30〜15:00・17:30〜22:00、月曜休み (祝日は営業、翌火曜休み)、月2〜4日の不定休、54席、エレベーターあり、多言語メニュー (英語・中国語・韓国語)、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン対応ありの表示。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月): マルゲリータ、はちみつの4種チーズ、タコのトマトソースパスタ、約15年通う常連、量が多い、アラカルトのパスタはやや高め、週末は行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Tabelog lists a multilingual menu (English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Korean) with photos and a digital menu. No evidence on English-speaking staff.

places.cuisine: Seafood-rich Cantonese cooking by an owner who trained for many years under a former embassy head chef; domestic vegetables and fish bought at nearby Kuromon Market (official site) · house shumai of domestic pork belly, Thai vannamei shrimp and Awaji onion, hand-wrapped and steamed, with a yuzu-pepper dipping sauce (official site) · from the Tabelog menu (December 2024): shrimp and chive gyoza, xiaolongbao, spring rolls in egg wrappers, mapo tofu, sweet and sour pork, shrimp with mayonnaise, shark-fin soup, char siu fried rice, salmon and lettuce fried rice, noodles, almond tofu, sesame balls, daily specials such as Peking duck · set lunches from about ¥1,100 with free rice refills · all-you-can-drink courses
places.notes: [Chinese · Nipponbashi, house shumai a minute from the station] A basement Chinese tavern a minute from Nippombashi Station, near Kuromon Market, where the owner, trained for many years under a former embassy head chef, cooks seafood-rich Cantonese dishes with fish bought at the market. The hand-wrapped shumai of pork and shrimp with a yuzu-pepper dip is the name dish, and several lunch regulars come back monthly for it; lunch sets of shumai with kara-age and soup draw a line, though bookings are taken. At night it turns into an izakaya with half-size plates and all-you-can-drink courses. Smoking is allowed (Tabelog).

roles: Owner (店主), unnamed, trained for many years under a former embassy head chef (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the owner cooks Cantonese food full of seafood, picks domestic vegetables and goes directly to nearby Kuromon Market for fish, sometimes serving live fish. Tabelog adds Chinese ingredients from Kobe and seafood from Toyosu and Kuromon. The company introduced a scholarship-repayment support scheme for staff from April 2024 (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Every dish made carefully, with no compromise in pursuing the flavour of the ingredients" (official site).

places.cuisine: Italian with an all-you-can-eat bread lunch and an all-you-can-eat dinner since the August 2026 renewal (Tabelog) · lunch from ¥1,800: a main (pasta such as mentaiko cream or burdock and bacon arrabbiata, grilled chicken, pan-seared sea bream, beef steak) with a starter, plus a buffet of breads from well-known bakeries, soup and a drink bar; about ten breads, e.g. sweet-potato croissant, corn bread, chocolate croissant, squid-ink mentaiko baguette, French toast, with toasters to warm them (September–October 2026); weekday and weekend prices differ (September 2026) · dinner: two hours of 45 dishes, pizza from a wood-fired oven, pasta, ajillo, prosciutto, caprese, seafood marinade, pâté de campagne, fried chicken, with a platter of bakery breads and roast chicken ¥3,500 or chicken and pork ¥4,000; drinks +¥1,000, premium wine +¥1,500, craft beer +¥1,800 (Tabelog, tax included; September 2026)
places.notes: [Italian · Chayamachi, an all-you-can-eat bread lunch] A large Italian restaurant on the eighth floor of NU Chayamachi, with a fine-weather terrace, that turned in August 2026 to all-you-can-eat. At lunch you choose a main (pasta, chicken, sea bream or steak) and help yourself to a buffet of breads from bakeries around Japan, soup and a drink bar for about ¥1,800; diners in 2026 went back for the sweet-potato croissant, corn bread and a squid-ink mentaiko baguette, warmed in the toasters. At night ¥3,500 buys two hours of 45 dishes, pizza from the wood-fired oven, pasta, prosciutto and caprese, with drinks extra. One September 2026 diner found the breads dry and the pasta choice narrow; others praise the value. No split bills.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: an all-you-can-eat bread lunch "featuring famous breads from popular bakeries across the country", authentic Italian all-you-can-eat dinners from ¥3,500, homemade-dough wood-fired pizza, renewed 10 August 2026. places.cuisine: Meat kaiseki of black wagyu in many preparations, with chateaubriand grilled over Kishu binchotan (Tabelog) · dinner courses (Tabelog, tax included): "Oborozuki" of five dishes ¥11,000; "YOITUKI", the classic course for first visits: truffle-scented wagyu yukhoe, thin and thick beef tongue, strip-loin niku-dofu in dashi, beef dishes, Kishu-binchotan chateaubriand, wagyu hand-rolled sushi, dessert ¥13,200; "Kasumizuki" with seasonal seafood and vegetables ¥16,500 · yukhoe with sea urchin and caviar and a piece of French bread (October 2025) · weekday lunch ¥1,500 each: sukiyaki set of black-wagyu chuck rib with an onsen egg, rice, cold tofu with whitebait, sake-lees soup; niku-dofu set; meat-topped dashimaki set; large rice +¥100; a koji porridge (2026) · sake and wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Wagyu · Kitashinchi, meat kaiseki by night, sukiyaki by day] A 14-seat black-wagyu restaurant on a third floor in Kitashinchi, open since 2021. In the evening it serves meat kaiseki: truffle-scented yukhoe, beef tongue cut thin and thick, a strip-loin niku-dofu in dashi, chateaubriand over Kishu binchotan and wagyu hand-rolled sushi, from ¥11,000. Weekday lunch is the famous bargain: a ¥1,500 sukiyaki set of black-wagyu chuck rib with an onsen egg, glossy freshly cooked rice, cold tofu with whitebait and a hearty sake-lees soup, or a niku-dofu or dashimaki set. Lunch takes no bookings and the counter is full within fifteen minutes of opening, so come before 11:30; one regular has been eleven times (October 2026).

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a meat kaiseki restaurant showcasing black-haired wagyu through various methods, with chateaubriand grilled over Kishu binchotan; freshly cooked rice at lunch; opened 15 June 2021. The official site is kitashinchi-tsukishiro.com.
chef_bio.philosophy: "The best dish for today's moment" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu meat kaiseki; sukiyaki lunch set.

anecdotes.text: "We arrived at 11:10 AM and there were no customers waiting yet, but soon after, a line began to form, and by the time the restaurant opened at 11:30, it was nearly full." — September 2026, the sukiyaki set meal.
"My colleague's first comment was, 'The rice looks incredibly shiny and beautiful!'" — September 2026, a sixth visit.

places.cuisine: Yakitori of Miyazaki free-range chicken grilled over binchotan, using the whole bird, with a limited daily "Jidokko" (a rare breed) and white liver (Tabelog) · skewers ordered one at a time; chicken sashimi, chicken-liver sashimi, heart, tsukune with grilled cheese, corn on the cob with sauce, potato salad (August 2026); kamameshi (cook time, order early; October 2026) · courses with two hours of drinks: 12 dishes for two ¥4,500 (seasonal salad, three skewers, oyakodon); 15 dishes for two ¥5,000 (five skewers, oyakodon, gratin of local chicken, chicken nanban with homemade tartar); Tiger course with Hakata motsunabe in garlic soy, spicy or soy-milk broth ¥4,500 (Tabelog, tax included) · a lunch set with three small dishes and soba (September 2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Ohatsu Tenjin, Miyazaki chicken over binchotan] A busy, two-storey yakitori izakaya by the Ohatsu Tenjin shrine, opened in 2020, that grills Miyazaki free-range chicken over binchotan and uses the whole bird, with a few rare Jidokko a day. Order skewers one at a time, with chicken and liver sashimi, a tsukune under grilled cheese and corn glazed in sauce, then a kamameshi that is worth ordering early. Groups book the two-hour drink courses from ¥4,500, some with a Hakata motsunabe. The ground-floor counter is cramped and smoky and the upper floor roomier (October 2026), and one August 2026 diner found the noise from a neighbouring group hard to bear. Smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: the owner prepares by hand, every day, chicken chosen out of love for it; Miyazaki free-range chicken and Jidokko, a breed said to be 1% of chicken eaten in Japan, the whole bird used; private rooms; opened 16 October 2020. The Tabelog invoice number T2120001214766 is registered to 株式会社ファイブディアライフ (NTA invoice register), also the operator of 梅田かに食堂 (osaka_umeda_kani_shokudo).

anecdotes.text: "You can order yakitori one skewer at a time, and the quality was great, including rare chicken liver sashimi, which made me very happy." — August 2026.
"The kamameshi (rice cooked in a pot) takes some time to prepare, so it might be a good idea to order it first." — October 2026.
"The first floor has only a counter and feels a bit cramped, but the second floor has table seating and is relatively spacious. I recommend the second floor." — October 2026.

places.cuisine: Japanese izakaya of fish sent direct from Numajima port on Awaji Island and natural yam from farmers, with local sake from around Japan (Tabelog) · the signature natural-yam hotpot in a bonito dashi with pork, head-on shrimp, oysters, chicken, clams and sawara under grated yam, finished with soba (December 2025) · natural yam with tuna, natural-yam somen with egg yolk, fried grated yam, yam tororo on the teppan (2026); obanzai, three as a set (March 2026) · sashimi platters (akagai, flounder, amberjack, yellowtail, tuna), simmered Numajima fish, grilled Aomori kinki, Miyazaki beef cutlet, matsutake kamameshi (September 2026); horse-meat yukhoe, miso-grilled pork shoulder, bamboo-steamed pork and river shrimp, crab cream croquettes, kara-age (2026) · courses: natural-yam hotpot course ¥6,000; well-balanced ¥6,000 course of sashimi, obanzai, tempura, simmered fish and Japanese beef roast; ¥8,000 course with grilled kinki and beef fillet cutlet; all-you-can-drink ¥2,000 extra (Tabelog, tax included; December 2025)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Kitashinchi, natural-yam hotpot until 4:00] A dim, Kyoto-townhouse-style izakaya on a second floor in Kitashinchi, open since 2013 and until 4:00 on weekdays, where you take off your shoes before sitting at the counter or tables. The kitchen buys fish direct from Numajima port on Awaji and natural yam from farmers, and the signature is a hotpot of shrimp, oysters, clams, pork and fish in bonito dashi under a blanket of grated yam, finished with soba (December 2025). Otherwise order the five-kind sashimi, simmered Awaji fish, obanzai or yam three ways. Courses from ¥6,000; a 10% charge applies after 22:00. Smoking is allowed, which one December 2025 diner minded; diners otherwise praise the food and staff.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: fresh fish delivered directly from Numajima fishing port on Awaji Island, natural yam direct from farmers used in a specialty hotpot, a space like a Kyoto townhouse, local sake from across Japan; sister shops "Kita-Shinchi Ono Meat Shop" (yakiniku and horumon) and "Kita-Shinchi Ushinokami" (premium meat); opened 4 February 2013.

anecdotes.text: "The hot pot was packed with ingredients like pork, head-on shrimp, oysters, chicken, clams, and sawara, topped with natural yam, making it incredibly tasty." — December 2025, a year-end party.
"Since smoking is allowed, the people at the table next to us were smoking quite a bit, which left a strong smell on my clothes and hair." — December 2025, the ¥6,000 course with drinks.
"…a wide variety of obanzai (traditional side dishes), including nostalgic flavors reminiscent of home-cooked meals from my childhood" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 恒雅、海鮮・日本料理・鍋、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-5-32 ボーネールビル 2F、JR 東西線 北新地駅から徒歩3分、東梅田駅・西梅田駅から5分、月〜金18:00〜翌4:00 (L.O.3:00)、土18:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、日・祝休み、年末年始休み、予約可、混雑時は2時間制、22時以降はチャージ10%、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、30席 (貸切35名まで)、喫煙可、2013年2月4日オープン、Awaji の Numajima 漁港から直送の鮮魚、農家直送の自然薯の名物鍋、京町家のような空間、全国の地酒、自然薯の鍋のコース6,000円、刺身・おばんざい・天ぷら・煮魚・和牛ローストの6,000円のコース、キンキの焼き物と牛ヒレカツの8,000円のコース、系列店は Kita-Shinchi Ono Meat Shop と Kita-Shinchi Ushinokami。口コミ(2025年12月〜2026年10月): 自然薯の鍋 (豚、有頭エビ、カキ、鶏、アサリ、サワラ)、締めのそば、カニクリームコロッケ、自然薯とマグロ、自然薯そうめんと卵黄、自然薯の揚げ物、自然薯の鉄板焼き、おばんざい3種、刺身5種 (赤貝、ヒラメ、カンパチ、ハマチ、マグロ)、Numajima の魚の煮付け、Aomori のキンキの焼き物、Miyazaki の牛カツ、松茸の釜めし、馬肉のユッケ、豚肩ロースの味噌焼き、豚と川エビのせいろ蒸し、kara-age、靴を脱いで上がる、喫煙可で服ににおい、スタッフが親切、遅くまで開いている。

places.name: 千日前 はつせ (Sennichimae Hatsuse)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the batter is a blend of four flours with Japanese dashi (official site), finished with two sauces; no gluten-free option described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the batter is made with dashi (official site) and the okonomiyaki carry pork, squid or shrimp.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–24:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–24:00; last order 23:00 (Tabelog). Open over New Year (official site, 2021 notice). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; official site). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC, Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 120 seats, all in private tatami rooms for 2 to over 30, on the second floor up a stair with no lift (official site; Tabelog; July 2026). Order by the phone in your room (September 2026). Tabelog lists it as non-smoking, while July and September 2026 diners say smoking or e-cigarettes are allowed in the closed rooms. Children welcome (Tabelog). Founded 1945 (official site).
places.neighborhood: Namba Sennichimae 11-25, はつせビル 2F, beside Namba Grand Kagetsu — 5 min from Namba or Nippombashi Stn
places.cuisine: Okonomiyaki and yakisoba you cook yourself on the teppan in a private room, with instructions on the wall (official site; 2026 reviews) · secret batter of four selected flours with Japanese dashi, crisp outside and fluffy inside; the fillings are stir-fried first, then returned to the batter; "double sauce" of a Worcester-type sauce and a sweet thick sauce (official site) · pork okonomiyaki with fresh shoulder loin, the Hatsuse original mix, deluxe series (official site) · mixed okonomiyaki ¥1,243 (September 2026); lunch mixed set ¥994 (July 2026) · modern-yaki, pork, squid and shrimp, okonomiyaki with green onion, fried pork-fat topping · yakisoba (staff cook it, October 2026), teppan dishes, sausages · courses with free drinks · beer ¥580 (August 2026)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Sennichimae, cook it yourself in a tatami room] A family okonomiyaki house next to Namba Grand Kagetsu, begun as the Hatsuse ryokan in the late Meiji era and reopened in 1945 as a canteen, where every table is a private tatami room, a holdover from the inn. You cook your own: fry the pork, squid and shrimp, fold them into the dashi batter, flip, then paint on the two house sauces, a Worcester and a sweet thick one; the instructions are on the wall. Order the mixed (¥1,243 in September 2026) or the pork, and call for more by the room phone. Up a steep stair, no lift; the rooms show their age (July 2026). Open until midnight.

roles: Founder of the okonomiyaki business (first generation), per the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded at the end of the Meiji era in Sennichimae as the Hatsuse ryokan (inn); closed during the war; in 1945 the first generation, 長谷川清之, rebuilt the burnt-out building and opened はつせ食堂, whose "Bikkuri udon" in a huge bowl was a hit; the okonomiyaki house opened later and has kept Osaka's food for some 70 years. The all-private-room layout keeps the inn's heritage, and the founder wanted visitors, couples and friends to enjoy okonomiyaki at leisure like a family meal. Featured in 旅の手帖 (May 2020) and ぴあMOOK関西 on Kansai konamon (2019) (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: A family meal at leisure, cooking okonomiyaki yourself (official site, translated).

anecdotes.text: "I will remember the advice to grill the meat and seafood first before mixing it when I return to Sapporo." — September 2026, mixed okonomiyaki for JPY 1,243.
"Is it really 40 years later? … The style of cooking your own okonomiyaki is still alive and well." — October 2026, with classmates.
"The restaurant is located on the second floor, and since there's no elevator, it was quite challenging to carry a stroller up the stairs." — July 2026, lunch soon after opening.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 大阪の味 お好み焼 千日前はつせ、明治末に千日前で「はつせ旅館」として創業、戦争で一時廃業、昭和20年に初代・長谷川清之が焼け落ちたビルを建て直し「はつせ食堂」、大きな器の「ビックリうどん」が大ヒット、その後お好み焼店、以来70年、旅館の名残りで全席個室、お好み焼も焼きそばもお客様自身で焼くスタイル、一家団欒、厳選した四種類の粉と和ダシの秘伝の生地、表面はパリっと中はふっくら、具材を軽く炒めてから生地に戻して焼く、肩ロースの豚玉、オリジナルミックス、デラックス、ウスター系と甘口特濃の「ダブルソース」、年末年始も無休、旅の手帖2020年5月号、ぴあMOOK関西、大阪市中央区難波千日前11-25 はつせビル2F。食べログ (店舗会員): 月〜金11:30〜24:00、土・日・祝11:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、120席、個室 (2名から30名以上)、禁煙、子ども可。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): 壁に焼き方、ミックス1,243円、ランチのミックス994円、ビール580円、部屋の電話で注文、個室では喫煙や電子タバコ可という口コミ、エレベーターなしで2階、古さが気になったという口コミも、焼きそばはスタッフが焼く、なんばグランド花月のすぐそば。

cultural_comfort.note: You cook it yourself with the instructions on the wall; order by the room phone (2026). No English evidence found.

places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Pasta and pizza are central and lunch comes with bread; lamb chops, roast beef, prosciutto and cheese are dishes without obvious wheat, but nothing is stated about their sauces.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The menu leans on prosciutto, cheese and meat; ask which pasta or vegetable dishes can be made without them.

Reservations accepted; lunch bookings are for courses only (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transport IC, Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and many QR payments (Tabelog). 67 seats, mostly tables for two; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; menu in English, Chinese and Korean; one hour free at Nagahori underground parking for ¥3,000 spent (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Casual Italian with a market counter of vegetables, imported prosciutto and a 35 kg wheel of Parmigiano Reggiano (Tabelog shop text) · lunch sets: Mercato lunch with an appetiser plate, bread and a choice of pasta; Pranzo Angelo with five appetisers; a lunch course ¥1,950 (October 2026); monthly special pasta, porcini cream about +¥600 (October 2026) · pasta such as cacio e pepe, penne with water eggplant and spicy tomato, genovese · aged lamb chops, roast beef of sirloin cap, burrata, prosciutto, cheese platter · desserts with a message plate on request · wines by the glass from ¥800 (13 kinds), house wine charged by the amount drunk, Italian wines imported direct, a sommelier (Tabelog) · 90-minute free-drinks courses · a monthly all-you-can-eat prosciutto event (September 2026)
places.notes: [Italian · Crysta Nagahori, a market under the street] A bright, market-style Italian in the Crysta Nagahori underground mall, reachable from the station without going outside, with prosciutto and a whole wheel of Parmigiano on show. Lunch is the draw: a set of small appetisers and a pasta that changes monthly (¥1,950 for the lunch course in October 2026); at night order the aged lamb chops and a bottle of Italian wine. Staff will add extra cheese, write a birthday plate and, one October 2026 diner saw, play a birthday song on a small accordion. Part of the Anjou group (Alcyon, Bistro d'Ange).

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: "Mercato" means market; a showcase of fresh vegetables, European prosciutto and a whole 35 kg wheel of Parmigiano Reggiano; wines chosen by a sommelier and imported directly from Italy. An October 2026 diner notes it belongs to the same group as Sant'Angelo and the Alcyon cake and crêpe shops.
chef_bio.specialty: Monthly pasta lunch; aged lamb chops.

anecdotes.text: "At the next table, a birthday celebration was taking place, and the staff played a birthday song on a small accordion" — October 2026, the JPY 1,950 lunch course.
"when I mentioned that I love cheese, the friendly staff said, 'I'll make sure to add plenty for you!'" — September 2026, a course meal.
"The pasta changes every month, so there's always something new to enjoy. This month's special was Porcini!" — October 2026, a sixth visit.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: takoyaki, okonomiyaki, negiyaki and yakisoba are wheat dishes, and kushikatsu is battered; no gluten-free option described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus takoyaki, pork and tendon negiyaki, horumon yakisoba and seafood teppan dishes.

Reservations accepted, recommended at weekend dinner when a queue forms; no same-day online changes; phone for 10 or more (Tabelog; September–October 2026). No service or seat charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC, Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 70 seats over three floors: counter and tables on 1F, tables and sunken seating on 2F, a private room on 3F (for up to 18 in the shop text, 22 in the seat list); non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). places.neighborhood: Namba 1-1-6, a narrow alley by Hozenji — 3 min from Namba Stn exit 14
places.cuisine: Konamon izakaya of the Ootako takoyaki brand, with its own sauce (Tabelog shop text) · takoyaki with big pieces of octopus, 6 to take away (October 2026) · okonomiyaki, e.g. mix, buta-tama, with a fried egg on request · negiyaki with pork and tendon, in sauce or soy (September 2026) · yakisoba, horumon yakisoba, sobameshi · kushikatsu, motsuni, dashimaki, chicken kara-age, spinach salad, seafood teppan · courses: Hozenji course for 2 or more; Dotonbori course with free drinks for 4–10 ¥6,000 (Tabelog) · beer, lemon sour, yuzu-sake highball · about ¥4,000 for two dishes and two drinks for two (September 2026)
places.notes: [Konamon · Hozenji, the Ootako sit-down shop] The sit-down branch of Honke Otako, the Dotonbori takoyaki stand known for its queue by the Glico sign, tucked in a narrow alley by Hozenji. Upstairs are sunken tables and a private room, so you can work through the whole konamon list: takoyaki with big pieces of octopus, okonomiyaki, a pork-and-tendon negiyaki in sauce or soy, yakisoba or sobameshi, and kushikatsu. Diners in 2026 found it calmer than the Dotonbori stand and good for groups; a few found the takoyaki lukewarm or the side dishes small. Open all day, every day; book for weekend evenings.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: Ootako's okonomiyaki and yakisoba with a unique sauce and expert knowledge of konamon, a third-floor private room for up to 18 and sunken seating on the second floor. A July 2026 diner remembers buying takoyaki for years at the Honke Ootako stand by the Glico sign in Dotonbori, with its long queues; a September 2026 diner contrasts this branch's atmosphere with the Dotonbori shop.

anecdotes.text: "As always, the takoyaki was generously filled with large pieces of octopus" — July 2026, a return after years of buying at the Dotonbori stand.
"I was surprised that the takoyaki was lukewarm when I expected it to be piping hot, but the negiyaki was served hot." — September 2026, about JPY 4,000 for two dishes and two drinks.
"It was great to experience both the rich sauce and the refreshing soy sauce." — September 2026, pork and tendon negiyaki at a quiet weekday lunch.

places.name: ガフーリオ (Gaffurio)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information. Pasta is the heart of the lunch courses, with bread refills; the fish and meat mains (yellowtail, flatfish, duck, chicken) are dishes without obvious wheat, but nothing is stated about their sauces.

places.cuisine: Northern Italian by a chef recognised by the Milanese chef Aldo Russo, with Italian ingredients and over 50 Italian wines, about 50 daily specials (Tabelog shop text) · lunch courses: A (one dish from the lunch menu), B ¥1,800 with four appetisers or pasta, a fish or meat main, two desserts, salad and a drink (October 2026), C with a pasta and a main · pasta such as oil pasta of spear squid and mushrooms, beef-and-pork mince oil pasta, a mushroom oil pasta · mains such as pan-seared wild yellowtail, flatfish, stuffed spear squid, duck, grilled Okutamba chicken, Nagasaki pork (2026) · bread and coffee refills at lunch · dinner à la carte with an appetiser assortment · an anniversary festival each year; 26th in 2026
places.notes: [Italian · Sennichimae, a 26-year trattoria near Nippombashi] A small northern Italian trattoria on the ground floor of an apartment block off Sennichimae, marking 26 years in 2026, with a following of regulars who fill loyalty cards. The lunch courses are the draw: the B course (¥1,800 in October 2026) brings appetisers or a pasta, a fish or meat main such as rare-seared wild yellowtail or crisp-skinned chicken, two desserts and coffee. Dinner is a long list of daily specials and over 50 Italian wines. The owner, Shibuya by name, keeps an eye on regulars' orders (September 2026). Book ahead for lunch; no strong perfume.

roles: Chef recognised by the Milanese chef Aldo Russo (Tabelog shop text); not named
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: northern Italian cuisine by a chef recognised by Aldo Russo of Milan, simple flavours, over 50 Italian wines and Italian ingredients. A September 2026 regular thanks "the owner, Mr. Shibuya" for making sure appetisers did not overlap at the annual anniversary festival, the 26th in 2026; a diner that month saw the 26th anniversary marked outside.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch courses with pasta and a main; northern Italian daily specials.

anecdotes.text: "Thanks to the owner, Mr. Shibuya, for … thoughtful communication to ensure that the appetizers didn't overlap." — September 2026, the 26th-anniversary festival.
