places.name: 寅八商店 心斎橋店 (Torahachi Shoten Shinsaibashi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The live squid and other sashimi and the bonito tataki (with salt or ponzu) are the plainest; squid legs come back as tempura unless you ask for sashimi, and there are fried dishes, takeaway sushi and soy-based sauces.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya built on live squid, bonito and sashimi.
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00; closed 31 December–4 January (Tabelog; official site: no regular closing day). Reservations; if the live squid cannot be landed in bad weather, guests who booked by the day before are told by 15:00 that day; on the day, phone to check (Tabelog). A ¥600 appetizer charge, not on course bookings (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay and Alipay; no e-money (Tabelog). 110 seats: 17 private rooms with sunken horigotatsu (shoes off), 5 tables, 4 counter seats; parties up to 90; non-smoking, with a smoking space outside; wheelchair accessible; children welcome (Tabelog). English, Simplified Chinese and Korean menus with photos (Tabelog). Rooms call staff by an intercom (August 2026). Takeaway of seared mackerel and Tosa-maki sushi (official site). Opened 16 August 2010 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-18-24, X-city SHINSAIBASHI B1F — 2 min from Shinsaibashi Stn (Midosuji Line)
places.cuisine: Seafood izakaya built on two signatures (official site): live "swimming" squid sent from Hagi, Yamaguchi, kept in tanks and cut to order, with the legs then cooked as tempura or served as sashimi (2025–2026 reviews); and bonito tataki seared over straw, sent from Kochi, with salt or ponzu (official site; August 2026) · courses with all-you-can-drink: ¥10,000 (120 minutes, online), ¥12,000, ¥15,000; a nine-dish Torahachi course with drinks from ¥2,000 extra; extra squid (50 g to 100 g) or bonito (3 to 6 pieces) for ¥1,300 each (official site, prices from April 2025) · also sashimi platters, fried oysters, water-octopus tempura, sea-bream kamameshi, bonito yukke salad, charcoal-grilled chicken thigh, live-cooked Ise lobster at ¥3,000 per 100 g (August 2026), nodoguro · local sake (nine kinds with the premium drinks plan) and a wide shochu list · diners report ¥5,000–¥19,999 a head (2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shinsaibashi, live squid and straw-seared bonito underground] Down in a basement near Shinsaibashi station, a sea-themed seafood izakaya of private horigotatsu rooms, opened in 2010 and one of three Torahachi Shoten shops (Umeda and Sannomiya are the others). Two things bring people in: squid sent live from Hagi and cut to order so the flesh is clear and crunchy, its legs returned as tempura; and Kochi bonito seared over burning straw, which one diner prefers with salt. Diners in 2026 add fried oysters, octopus tempura and sea-bream kamameshi, and note that in rough weather the squid may not arrive (the shop warns bookers by 15:00). Most groups take a course with all-you-can-drink (¥10,000–¥15,000). Some find it pricey and a few found the shellfish less fresh than the fish. In September 2026 the shop apologised after social-media criticism of how its nodoguro was described on the menu, explaining it served cut portions of a 1 kg fish and that it had rewritten the menu to show what is served. Open daily to midnight; English menus.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: one of three Torahachi Shoten shops (Umeda, Shinsaibashi, Sannomiya); the signatures are live squid sent direct from Hagi, Yamaguchi, and bonito tataki seared over straw sent direct from Kochi. On 29 September 2026 the shop posted an apology after its nodoguro menu wording was criticised on social media: it had served cut portions of large (1 kg) nodoguro, the menu wording had been misleading, and the menu now states what is actually served. Opened 16 August 2010 (Tabelog). An August 2026 diner had visited the Hatsushitenjin (Umeda) shop before.
chef_bio.philosophy: Hospitality with fresh swimming squid and straw-seared bonito that other shops cannot copy (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Live squid sashimi; straw-seared bonito tataki.

anecdotes.text: "The bonito tataki is grilled with straw right after you order it, and it's incredibly tasty. You can choose between salt or ponzu, but I highly recommend the salt." — August 2026.
"Unfortunately, due to bad weather, [the shop] couldn't source the swimming squid, which was disappointing." — September 2026, a company gathering of 26.
"The shellfish like turban shell and oysters had a bit of a fishy smell and weren't as great." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (torahachishoten.com): 寅八商店の店舗は梅田店、心斎橋店、三宮店。心斎橋店: 泳ぎイカと鰹の藁焼きタタキ、山口県萩直送の「泳ぎイカ」と高知直送の「鰹の藁焼タタキ」、直前まで生簀で泳いでいた活イカ、定休日なし、テイクアウト (炙り鯖寿司、土佐巻き寿司)、コースは2025年4月以降の価格で飲み放題付き12,000円・15,000円、120分飲み放題付きの特別コース10,000円、寅八コース (9品)、泳ぎイカ増量・カツオ増量は各1,300円、2026年9月29日「のどぐろのメニュー表記に関するお詫びと改善のお知らせ」(1kgサイズの大きなのどぐろの切り身を提供していたがメニューの記載が分かりづらく、提供内容がひと目で伝わる表記に修正)。食べログ (店舗会員): 海鮮・居酒屋・郷土料理、東心斎橋1-18-24 X-city SHINSAIBASHI B1F、毎日17:00〜24:00、年末年始休み、悪天候で泳ぎイカが入らない場合あり、お通し600円 (コースは除く)、110席 (個室17、掘りごたつ)、禁煙、車椅子可、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、2010年8月16日オープン。口コミ(2025年10月〜2026年10月): 泳ぎイカ、ゲソは天ぷらに、藁焼きのカツオは塩で、カキフライ、水だこの天ぷら、鯛の釜飯、伊勢海老は100g 3,000円、天候でイカが入らない日も、貝は生臭いという声も。

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The soufflé pancakes and parfaits with langue de chat or monaka are wheat-based; the anmitsu (soft serve, bean paste, shiratama, kanten) and plain drinks are the dishes to ask about.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soufflé pancakes, Cremia soft serve, cream and parfaits are all egg and dairy based; coffee and tea come plain.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 08:00–22:45; Sun 08:30–22:45; last entry and last order 21:30 (Tabelog; official site, "may change"). No fixed closing day; occasional short days, e.g. 08:00–17:30 on 29 October (official site) and on 10 November (Tabelog). Web and dated reservations are suspended; same-day queueing at the shop only, with a LINE notice when your turn nears (official site; July and October 2026). Private rooms can be booked through Tabelog, except Fridays, weekends and holidays (official site; Tabelog). Birthday plate ¥350, ordered 2–3 days ahead (Tabelog). Cards and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay); no e-money (Tabelog). 39 seats: 10 on 1F with an open kitchen, 29 on 2F with a private room; non-smoking; children welcome, kids' menu (official site; Tabelog). English, Chinese and Korean menus with photos; QR mobile ordering (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 9 November 2017 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Namba Sennichimae 4-20, in Ura Namba — 5 min from Namba Stn (Nankai, Midosuji Line)
places.cuisine: Soufflé pancakes made to order and parfaits, in a Japanese room of Ryukyu tatami and wood (official site) · soufflé pancakes cooked one by one on a copper griddle, about 20 minutes (October 2026): the plain NON pancake, fruit and strawberry pancakes, chocolate-banana, Japanese-style pancakes with black syrup, matcha syrup, shiratama and monaka (2026) · parfaits topped with Cremia soft serve: strawberry and melon with langue de chat, coffee jelly, chocolate, matcha (official site; 2026) · Anmitsu NON ¥1,500 with a set coffee ¥300 (August 2026); Shirokuma kakigori (July 2026) · coffee brewed by siphon cup by cup; Ronnefeldt teas (tea ¥580, August 2026); mixed juice; floats; café latte (official site; 2026)
places.notes: [Café · Ura Namba, soufflé pancakes until late] A calm two-storey café of Ryukyu tatami and wood in Ura Namba, named for the Japanese word for peace and quiet, open from breakfast until 22:45. The draw is soufflé pancakes made to order on a copper griddle, so light they vanish on the tongue (allow about 20 minutes), alongside parfaits crowned with Cremia soft serve and a generous anmitsu. Coffee is brewed by siphon a cup at a time and the teas are Ronnefeldt. Online booking is suspended: queue at the shop and LINE pings you when your turn comes (20 minutes on a July 2026 Sunday night; six groups ahead in October). Many guests are overseas visitors. Private rooms upstairs can be booked on weekdays.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a hideaway café in Namba Sennichimae/Ura Namba built around "a space to take your time"; ANNON means 安穏, calm and at ease; 1F is an open kitchen, 2F has private rooms and tables for solo guests; everything is made after ordering; pancakes from a house batter recipe; siphon coffee; Ronnefeldt tea; Cremia soft serve in the parfaits. The same company runs a Shinsaibashi shop and たまごとミルク at ららぽーと門真 (opened 17 April 2023). Opened 9 November 2017 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: A space to take your time; every dish made carefully after you order (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Soufflé pancakes; Cremia parfaits; siphon coffee.

anecdotes.text: "These pancakes are meticulously cooked one by one on a copper griddle after receiving your order. As a result, it takes about 20 minutes to serve" — October 2026, an evening visit.
"It seemed to be quite popular among foreign tourists, and there was a 20-minute wait to get in." — July 2026, a Sunday around 8 PM.
"I asked if [the staff] could remove the chocolate and banana since I don't like them together, and [the staff] kindly did." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (cafe-annon.com): CAFE ANNON なんば本店、観光客でにぎわう難波千日前・裏なんばの隠れ家的カフェ、「ゆっくり過ごせる空間」がコンセプト、琉球畳と木のぬくもりの和テイスト、ふわとろスフレパンケーキ、サイフォンで一杯ずつ淹れるコーヒー、ANNON は《安穏》の意、1階はオープンキッチン、2階に個室とお一人様のテーブル席、全メニュー注文後に作る、紅茶はロンネフェルト、パフェのソフトクリームはクレミア、WEB予約・日時指定予約は停止中で店頭での当日順番待ちのみ、個室のみ食べログで予約 (金土日祝除く)、8:00〜22:45 (最終入店とL.O.21:30)、10月29日は短縮営業、定休日なし、1階10席・2階29席、心斎橋店、たまごとミルク (ららぽーと門真、2023年4月17日オープン)。食べログ (店舗会員): カフェ・パンケーキ・スイーツ、日曜は8:30から、誕生日プレート350円、カード・QR可、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、2017年11月9日オープン。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): 銅板で1枚ずつ焼くスフレパンケーキは約20分、クレミアのパフェ、アンみつ NON 1,500円、セットのコーヒー300円、紅茶580円、LINE で順番を知らせてくれる、海外からの客も多い。

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Xiaolongbao, dim sum and most Chinese sauces use wheat or soy sauce; congee, rice and salad-bar items at lunch are the places to start asking.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Chinese dishes of pork, seafood and chicken; dim sum fillings are meat or seafood.

Reservations; walk-ins found room at a weekday lunch (October 2026). Dinner adds a table charge of ¥330, ¥660 or ¥1,100 a person depending on the seat (Tabelog). On the 2nd floor by the canal, with a night view; window views were blocked by construction in September 2026.

places.cuisine: Modern Chinese with xiaolongbao and dim sum in a blue-lit room (2026 reviews) · lunch: Chinese "gozen" set with a choice of main (e.g. six dim sum, sweet-and-sour pork) ¥2,189, with soup, salad bar, free Chinese tea and tea, and white rice or congee with refills (October 2026); a dim-sum lunch with afternoon tea for ¥1,700 more; the Yang Guifei course of dim sum, congee, afternoon-tea sweets (peach, mango) and Chinese tea ¥2,700 (September 2026) · dinner: an assortment of eight Chinese appetizers, juicy xiaolongbao, sweet-and-sour pork, shrimp fried rice, seafood and meat dishes; à la carte revamped in October 2026; courses and all-you-can-eat (Tabelog; October 2026) · shochu, wine and cocktails
places.notes: [Chinese · Minami-Horie, xiaolongbao by the canal] On the second floor of Canal Terrace Horie, a stylish Chinese restaurant lit in blue, with couple seats, sofas and big windows over the river and the night view. Lunch is the bargain: a Chinese set with a main of your choice (around ¥2,200) comes with soup, a salad bar, free Chinese tea and congee refills, or the Yang Guifei set adds afternoon-tea sweets for ¥2,700. At night the draw is juicy xiaolongbao, an eight-kind appetizer plate, sweet-and-sour pork and shrimp fried rice, from an à la carte menu rewritten in October 2026. Reviews are mostly warm; one September 2026 diner found a sticky floor and a table that needed wiping, and construction blocked the window view that month. Dinner adds a table charge of ¥330–¥1,100. Closed only on 1–2 January.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; no opening date or official site found. The listing says the kitchen is particular about fish, shochu, wine and cocktails, with a health-conscious menu; it was closed for renovation on 7–10 April 2025. A regular reports the dinner à la carte menu was revamped in October 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Xiaolongbao; dim-sum lunches; eight-kind appetizer plate.

anecdotes.text: "With homemade dim sum, a salad bar, soup, and all-you-can-drink Chinese tea, the Afternoon Set for JPY 2700 is an incredible deal!" — September 2026, the Yang Guifei set.
"After sitting down, a staff member mentioned [the staff] would wipe the table because it was a bit dirty." — September 2026, an 11:30 lunch booking.
"I heard that the dinner a la carte menu at Horie Blue has been revamped, so I decided to check it out." — October 2026, a repeat visit.

places.name: Pizzeria CUORERUDINO
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Pizza, pasta and the yudane bread are wheat; the appetizer plates, salads and meat dishes such as the T-bone steak are where to start asking.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. The site describes vegetable-heavy dishes based on Italian home cooking, but nothing is labelled vegan; most pizzas carry mozzarella.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–22:00: lunch 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00), café on weekdays 11:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); open all year (Tabelog). Reservations, but not for café or drinks only; weekend lunch bookings only for 11:30–12:00 and 13:30–15:00; seats cannot be chosen (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 70 seats with sofas, a counter and a terrace (dogs welcome on the terrace, October 2026); private rooms and hire for 10 to over 50; non-smoking, with an ashtray by the door; children welcome; takeaway and delivery (Tabelog; official site). places.neighborhood: Minami-Horie 1-14-26, facing the south side of Horie Park, behind Orange Street — 5 min from Yotsubashi Stn exit 6
places.cuisine: Wood-fired pizza with a chewy yet crisp crust, robust meat dishes and vegetable-rich home-style plates, with plenty of wine (official site) · pizza: Margherita ¥1,530, Pescatore, melanzane with fried eggplant and anchovy, a seasonal Stagione ¥2,650, the day's lunch pizza (2026) · lunch: weekly pasta lunch with appetizers and yudane bread ¥1,380, monthly fresh-pasta lunch ¥1,580, pasta set ¥2,100, pizza set from ¥2,500 (September 2026); yudane bread with salted butter as an extra · appetizers: an assortment for two ¥2,400 (quiche, prosciutto, rice croquettes, pâté, bonito tataki, soup, October 2026), grapes with buffalo mozzarella and prosciutto, grilled octopus with basil potato salad (October 2026) · CUORERUDINO T-bone steak at dinner (from February 2026), kakigori in summer 2026, a party plan with 90 minutes of drinks (official site) · Heartland draft ¥800 (October 2026); wine and cocktails
places.notes: [Pizza · Minami-Horie, wood-fired pizza facing Horie Park] A big, lively pizzeria opposite Horie Park, open since 2012, with a large wood-fired oven at the back, sofas, a counter and a terrace where dogs are welcome. The pizza has a soft, thin base and a chewy-crisp rim (Margherita ¥1,530), and diners rave about the yudane bread drenched in salted butter that comes with lunch. Lunch sets with appetizers start at ¥1,380 and are popular; at night the appetizer platter, pastas and, since February 2026, a T-bone steak come out, with plenty of wine. Weekend lunch bookings are limited to certain times. Open every day.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: pizza that is chewy yet crisp to bite, punchy meat dishes, vegetable-rich side dishes based on Italian home cooking and a full wine list; takeout, delivery and party plans; a T-bone steak at dinner from February 2026 and kakigori from June 2026. Opened 6 April 2012 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wood-fired pizza; yudane bread with butter; appetizer platters.

anecdotes.text: "I went for lunch on the terrace with my beloved dog." — October 2026, a pasta lunch.

places.notes: [Yakitori · Ura-Namba, a chicken bar a minute from NGK] A wood-warm yakitori bar a minute from Namba Grand Kagetsu, the busy downstairs sister of the course counter bird's nest, where charcoal skewers share the counter with playful chicken dishes and a long drinks list. The way in is the weekday platter for two (¥2,750 with the seat charge in September 2026), a run of small plates from liver pâté and chicken sashimi to a Worcestershire quail egg and a chicken-neck curry; then negima or the sweet-spicy Maple Chicken, and fried sweet potato with cream cheese. To drink: Asahi Maru-F poured two ways, ten-odd craft beers and a matcha-pineapple sake cocktail from Bar Hana. Lively and often full; one diner found the counter cramped. In October 2026 most of the big table was overseas guests.

roles: Yakitori chef (unnamed) trained at a high-end yakitori restaurant (September 2026 review)

The data record for bird's nest (osaka_birds_nest_namba, same address, 2F) describes Bird as "its lively sister".
chef_bio.philosophy: Ingredients handled with respect for the producers, each step without cutting corners (quoted in a September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Weekday appetizer platter; Maple Chicken; charcoal skewers.

places.notes: [Café · Minami-Senba, a roastery on a Midosuji corner] A stylish corner roastery café in Minami-Senba, built around a big NOVO MARK II hot-air roaster that a regular says was the first in Japan, where you can pick green beans and have them roasted while you wait. The coffee is a bargain for the area (an iced blend was ¥500 in October 2026), and the morning breakfast set of thick toast, bacon, a fried egg and potage is ¥800. Later, try a hazelnut latte, a donut or the coffee soft-serve dusted with coffee powder. Seats are few and many people take away, so come early; the terrace and bench outside suit a sunny day. Open daily from 9 a.m.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The sesame sauce blends 22 spices and the ponzu is house-made, but their ingredients are not given; sets end with wheat udon.

places.cuisine: Shabu-shabu specialist, one copper pot per person at the counter (Tabelog) · house sesame sauce of silver sesame roasted and ground for hours in a stone mill with 22 spices, made in the shop, which keeps its body even when diluted and is drunk as soup at the end; house ponzu; add green onion, garlic or chili (official site; Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · beef shabu-shabu set ¥1,900 with vegetables and udon (September 2026); pork shabu-shabu double (160 g) with vegetables, tofu and udon, rice and pickles refilled (October 2026); beef-and-pork mix; courses with a starter, meat by grade (premium loin, special black wagyu), udon and ice cream (September–October 2026) · all-you-can-eat black wagyu with all-you-can-drink ¥7,800 with a coupon (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Shabu-shabu · Shinsaibashi, a copper pot for one] A long-running shabu-shabu house in its own five-storey building two minutes from Shinsaibashi Station, one of four Shabu Tei shops in Osaka. On the ground floor 24 diners sit at a counter, each with a copper pot, which makes it a favourite for eating alone; upstairs are rooms for groups. The draw is the sesame sauce, silver sesame roasted and ground in a stone mill in the shop with 22 spices, rich enough to drink as soup at the end, with the house ponzu beside it. A beef set with vegetables and udon was ¥1,900 in September 2026; a double portion of pork brings 160 g of meat with unlimited rice. In October 2026 about half the counter were overseas visitors. One diner asked for separate chopsticks for raw meat.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site (shabutei.co.jp): silver sesame roasted carefully and ground for a long time in a stone mill, blended with 22 spices, so the sauce keeps its flavour and body as it thins; shops 心斎橋店 (旧清水町店), 西梅田店, 阪急かっぱ横丁店 and 三ツ寺筋店. Tabelog: a long-established shabu-shabu specialist near Shinsaibashi Station; four shops in Osaka City making over 200,000 servings of sesame sauce a year; opened 1 December 2003.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Shabu-shabu is decided by the meat and the sauce" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: One-person copper-pot shabu-shabu; house sesame sauce.

places.notes: [Italian · Minami-Senba, natural-yeast pizza underground] A cosy, antique-feeling Italian tavern in a basement a minute from Shinsaibashi Station, through the door of the building with TUDOR on the ground floor and down the stairs. The kitchen bakes natural-yeast pizza in a stone oven in two styles, fluffy Milanese or crisp Roman, from a dough of five Hokkaido flours ten years in the making, and the chef trained in Roman taverns cooks to go with wine. Most groups take the ¥5,000 course with two hours of drinks, which runs from refilled grissini and five appetizers to a pizza and pasta; lunch is a pasta set from ¥1,200. One pizza purist was put off by Tabasco on the table and no knives (September 2026). Closed Mondays.

roles: Chef trained in taverns in Rome (unnamed; Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: casual Italian street izakaya with stone-oven pizza and fresh pasta; natural-yeast pizza perfected over ten years, five Hokkaido wheat flours, sweet salt from Italy, natural yeast from Akita, a secret olive oil; all staff are pizza makers; banquet dishes by a wine-loving chef trained in Roman taverns. places.notes: [Chinese · Nishimiyahara, a red-fronted machi-chuka] A well-worn neighbourhood Chinese restaurant behind a bright red front, a short walk from Higashimikuni, packed at lunch with office workers, older locals and everyone in between (2026). The complicated set-meal board rewards pointing at the ¥900 daily set: a heaped plate of grilled pork, a rolled omelette, soup and a large bowl of rice (2025–2026). Around it go happo ramen, a ¥800 Chinese rice bowl full of meat and shrimp, six-piece kara-age, katsu curry and a ¥850 beer set with gyoza and kara-age. Portions are huge; the fried rice gets mixed reviews (2026). Smoking is allowed, even at lunch. Open every day until 23:00 or later; a sister shop stands by Higashiyodogawa Station (May 2026).

anecdotes.text: "In local Chinese restaurants like this, regulars tend to order quickly, leaving little time to carefully look over the menu." — March 2026, the daily set of pork yakiniku and rolled omelette for JPY 900.
"To my surprise, the kara-age came with six pieces!" — August 2026, kara-age for JPY 900.

places.name: 麺屋左衛門 (Menya Saemon)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade wheat noodles in every bowl.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: whole-chicken and chicken-and-seafood broths with rare chashu.

No reservations; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog); buy a ticket at the machine, paying by PayPay through a QR code you show the owner (October 2026). 10 counter seats with partitions; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Bowls take 10–15 minutes (August and October 2026). Opened 1 October 2022 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Whole-chicken chuka soba with homemade noodles (Tabelog) · Chuka SOBA ¥950: a rich, clear shoyu broth of domestic whole chicken, thin straight noodles, rare chashu and long menma; add the dashi jelly halfway to turn it toward seafood (October 2026; March 2025) · shio chuka soba on a chicken-and-seafood double broth (Tabelog), sweet to one diner, with seasoned egg and dashi jelly (August 2026) · Chicken SOBA, a frothy white broth with a soft-boiled egg (November 2025, August 2026) · spicy chuka soba (October 2026) · chicken paitan tsukemen ¥1,200 with thick noodles, two kinds of rare chashu, spinach and menma (August and October 2026) · kombu-water tsukemen with yuzu kosho and wasabi (August 2026) · cold ramen (August 2026) · rare chashu rice bowl (Tabelog; October 2026) · lemon sour (August 2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima, whole-chicken shoyu and homemade noodles] A 10-seat partitioned counter a minute from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open since 2022 and run by the owner, usually alone (October 2026). The broth is domestic whole chicken, rich but clear, and the noodles are made in house with a strong wheat flavour (Tabelog). The ¥950 Chuka SOBA is a firm shoyu with thin noodles, rare chashu and long menma; stir in the bonito dashi jelly halfway and it turns toward seafood (October 2026). There is a shio on a chicken-and-seafood broth, a frothy white Chicken SOBA, a spicy one, and a chicken paitan tsukemen with thick noodles (¥1,200). Bowls are made one at a time, so allow 10–15 minutes. Now open late, and through New Year (August 2026).

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: a rich, clear broth from domestically sourced whole chicken, homemade noodles "that have a strong wheat flavor", a shio chuka soba on a chicken-and-seafood double broth, a rare chashu don, and a partitioned counter so solo women diners feel at ease; opened 1 October 2022. An October 2026 diner: "It seems like the owner is usually working alone."
chef_bio.specialty: Chuka SOBA (whole-chicken shoyu) with dashi jelly; chicken paitan tsukemen.

anecdotes.text: "After eating about half, I was recommended to add the dashi jelly for a flavor change." — October 2026, the Chuka SOBA for JPY 950.
"The atmosphere is quiet, with no background music, allowing you to fully focus on your ramen." — August 2026, the chicken paitan tsukemen for JPY 1,200.
"I initially avoided this place thinking it was just another generic chain restaurant, but since they were open late, I decided to give it a try." — August 2026, now a regular.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu is curry with rice, hamburg steak, pasta, toast and cakes (lemon cake, tarts, cheesecake, shortcake); nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: curries with coconut milk and nuts, hamburg steak, bacon-and-egg toast and dairy cakes; nothing is described as vegan.

Order and pay at the counter, then sit (August and September 2026). 14 seats plus a terrace seat (August 2026); non-smoking; children, babies and strollers welcome; takeaway (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: A café of curry and lemon cakes: "焼きカレーと檸檬ケーキのお店" (shop site) · Kashmir curry with coconut milk and nuts, sweet first and then spicy, in a lunch set with salad and a drink (August 2026) · today's hamburg steak set with mini salad and rice ¥1,300 (September 2026); salad bowls and pasta sets (September 2026) · breakfast with a drink, toast and a boiled egg; bacon-and-egg toast (October 2026) · lemon cake, also to take away; lemon tart; light cheesecake; Basque cheesecake; classic pudding; strawberry shortcake (2025–2026) · iced café latte ¥540 (September 2026), black sesame latte, café latte, cold-brew iced coffee (2026)
places.notes: [Café · Nishinakajima, curry and lemon cake] A bright, stylish café a couple of minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, which calls itself a shop of baked curry and lemon cake (site), busy with young women from breakfast on (2026). You order and pay at the counter, then take a plush seat or the small terrace. At lunch the draw is the Kashmir curry, coconut milk and nuts, sweet before it turns spicy, served as a set with a colourful salad and a drink; there are hamburg steak and pasta sets too (2026). The rest of the day belongs to lemon cake (to take home as well), lemon tart, cheesecake and pudding with a latte. Breakfast starts at 10:00 with free toast and a boiled egg (October 2026). One diner took it for part of the neel café group (September 2026).

chef_bio.background: The shop's site (lemon-no.com, read 2026-11-02) names it "喫茶 檸檬の 新大阪店" and calls it "焼きカレーと檸檬ケーキのお店" (a shop of baked curry and lemon cake). A September 2026 diner "realized it's part of the neel chain"; the site names no group and a web search found no confirmation, so the link is that diner's impression only. Staff are young and friendly (October 2026).

anecdotes.text: "The Kashmir Curry has a unique flavor with coconut milk and nuts. … It's not just sweet. It's not just spicy either." — August 2026, the Kashmir Curry Set.
"I even bought a Lemon Cake to take home! It was absolutely delicious." — September 2026, with a black sesame latte.
"The breakfast comes with a drink, toast, and a boiled egg for free, but I wanted something more substantial, so I upgraded to a bacon and egg toast." — October 2026.

places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–24:00; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; cards (AMEX) on Tabelog, while a July 2026 diner says electronic payment and cards are accepted at the ticket machine; no e-money or QR on Tabelog. 18 seats: a counter of about ten and tables (Tabelog; July and September 2026); non-smoking (Tabelog). places.cuisine: Yokohama iekei ramen: a rich tonkotsu shoyu with a sharp soy edge, thick chewy noodles, chashu, spinach and nori, with firmness, strength and oil chosen to order (August and September 2026) · MAX ramen ¥1,050 (July 2023); Shio MAX ramen ¥1,250 (August 2026); shio negi ramen ¥1,150 (July 2026); salt tonkotsu with mini fried rice (September 2026); seasoned-egg ramen with rice (February 2026) · half-chahan set ¥1,300 (February 2026); fried rice alone ¥650 (July 2026) · spicy miso, garlic and doubanjiang on the table (September 2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima, Yokohama iekei till midnight] An 18-seat iekei ramen shop two minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open 11:00 to midnight every day since 2022. The bowl is classic iekei: a rich, oily tonkotsu shoyu with a sharp soy edge, thick chewy noodles, chashu, spinach and nori to wrap rice in, with noodle firmness, strength and oil to order; one diner likened it to Machida Shoten (February 2026), another found it salty (August 2026). The fried rice has its own fans, ordered alone for ¥650 (July 2026), and the half-chahan set is ¥1,300. Spicy miso, garlic and doubanjiang on the counter for a change of flavour. A good late stop after drinks.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 21 November 2022 (Tabelog). The osaka-kita crawl also lists 横浜家系ラーメン 天来家 大正駅前店. Reviewers find the staff energetic and friendly (August 2026).

anecdotes.text: "When I soaked the seaweed in the broth and wrapped it around rice, it was incredibly delicious!" — July 2026, a first iekei ramen.
"The balance of the perfect saltiness and the fluffy texture was exquisite." — July 2026, the fried rice on its own for JPY 650.
"Overall, it felt like a bowl that was relatively close to authentic Yokohama Iekei ramen." — August 2026, the Shio MAX ramen for JPY 1,250.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Eel is grilled with a sweet tare (usually soy-based with wheat); shirayaki (unsauced) eel and salt-grilled skewers are on the menu, and tempura is wheat-battered.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel and chicken-skewer restaurant.

The air conditioning was not working on an August 2026 visit.

places.cuisine: Eel from Mikawa Isshiki, Aichi, grilled Kansai-style over charcoal so the skin is crisp; local Osaka dishes such as Hansuke tofu and eel kushiyaki; neri-ten; seasonal sake (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · domestic or imported eel to suit your budget (July and September 2026) · unaju in several grades, including a two-tone kabayaki-and-shirayaki box (October 2026); hitsumabushi (July and September 2026); Koura unagi tamajyu with omelette; "Unagyu" of eel, omelette and beef ¥3,300 (September 2026); eel and eel-roll lunch set ¥1,100 (August 2026); lunch from about ¥1,000 to ¥3,000 · uzaku, half grilled eel, an assortment of five eel skewers, fluffy tempura, chicken skewers (2026) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): Koura unaju course ¥7,020 (7 dishes); casual unaju course ¥3,720; chicken skewer course ¥2,500 (evening)
places.notes: [Eel · Ohatsu Tenjin, charcoal-grilled unagi] A small eel restaurant on a back street of Ohatsu Tenjin, with a five-seat counter and three tables, that grills Aichi eel Kansai-style over charcoal for crisp skin and soft flesh. You choose domestic or imported eel, which keeps lunch from about ¥1,000; diners name the unaju, hitsumabushi, a two-tone kabayaki and shirayaki box, uzaku, and evening skewers of eel with a bottle of beer. It also serves Osaka dishes like Hansuke tofu, and a ¥980 hour of all-you-can-drink. Open from 10:30, so some regulars come for an eel breakfast with a drink. Diners note small rice portions, a cramped room, and a broken air conditioner one August day.

roles: Eel griller (unnamed), styled a "Kamigata unagi griller" (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): eel from Mikawa Isshiki in Aichi; the signature unaju with crisp grilled skin; neri-ten, the local Hansuke tofu and kushiyaki that show the charm of eel; seasonal sake; prices adjusted for rising costs. Tabelog's name field gives the romaji "Koura", while its shop text calls it "Takara"; a July 2026 review writes "Unagi Kushiyaki Koura".
chef_bio.philosophy: Eel in many forms, from unaju to skewers (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "I visited this place in August at night, but this time, as promised, I arrived at 10:30 AM—almost breakfast drinking time." — September 2026.
"One of the highlights here is the option to choose between 'domestic' and 'imported' eel." — July 2026.
"The half grilled eel has a crispy yet fluffy texture, typical of the Kansai region." — September 2026, a monthly regular.

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter-and-tables room; lunch menu easy to choose from (2026). No English evidence found.

places.cuisine: Yakiniku of Kobe beef, only virgin heifers of A4 rank or above from a few farms, chosen by the owner, with tare made from a Wakayama craft soy sauce (三ツ星醤油) and 80–90 wines, mostly French (official site) · courses (official site, tax included): Kobe beef tabetsukushi course ¥14,300 (¥10,780 when booked online or through the newsletter), Kobe beef couple course ¥13,200; wine pairing of four glasses ¥4,840 · courses on Tabelog: couple course of Kobe beef only ¥20,900, premium ¥27,500, super premium ¥44,000 · diners paid ¥9,000 (September–October 2026) or ¥10,780 (August 2026) for a course · dishes in 2026 reviews: seared yukke, meat (or toro-taku) kimbap, kimchi and namul platters, two kinds of tongue, three salt-grilled cuts (chuck eye roll, top sirloin, sirloin cap), two sauce-grilled cuts, yaki-shabu and yaki-suki, grilled vegetables, beef-dashi chazuke
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Ohatsu Tenjin, Kobe beef and wine from a one-man counter] A twelve-seat Kobe-beef yakiniku up a flight of stairs off Ohatsu Tenjin, run by owner-chef and sommelier 酒井 克, who trained for about fourteen years at well-known Osaka yakiniku restaurants before opening here in 2019 (official site). The shop buys only Kobe heifers, serves each cut as a single piece so you can taste many, and pours from 80–90 wines; a sauce made with a centuries-old Wakayama soy sauce goes on the sauce-grilled cuts. Courses run from about ¥9,000 to ¥14,300 on the shop's own pricing (Tabelog lists premium courses up to ¥44,000): seared yukke, kimbap, two kinds of tongue, salt- and sauce-grilled Kobe beef, yaki-suki and a beef-dashi chazuke. An August 2026 diner found the owner running the shop alone and speaking English with overseas guests. Open until 1 am; no children 12 or under.

roles: Owner-chef and sommelier (official site: "オーナーシェフ兼ソムリエの酒井克")
chef_bio.background: Official site (read 2026-11-02): "1983年大阪生まれ"; decided to become a cook through a student part-time job; trained for about 14 years, mainly at well-known Osaka yakiniku restaurants; qualified as a sommelier in 2013; opened this Kobe-beef yakiniku in April 2019. Buys only virgin Kobe heifers under the 470 kg weight limit, A4 and above; tare blended with 三ツ星醤油, a hand-made Wakayama soy sauce made the same way for over 300 years; about 80 wines, mostly French. Media: Meets (2020, 2022), Asahi Shimbun (2020), TV Gobugobu (2021), Yon-chan TV (2025). An August 2026 review: "The owner runs the place alone and is a certified sommelier, making it popular among international guests as they can communicate in English".
chef_bio.philosophy: Kobe beef and wine that please body and heart (official site).

anecdotes.text: "The owner runs the place alone and is a certified sommelier, making it popular among international guests as they can communicate in English, which was fantastic." — August 2026.
"Each cut was served as a single piece, which was perfect for someone like me who wanted to try various types!" — October 2026.
"The owner, who is also the chef and sommelier, pairs the perfect wine with the meat according to the guests' preferences." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 梅田お初天神大人の神戸牛焼肉、大阪梅田の隠れ家のような焼肉屋、シェフが選んだ神戸牛と焼肉に合うワイン、未経産の神戸牛メス牛で470kgを超えないもの、A4ランク以上、タレは和歌山の三ツ星醤油をブレンド、ソムリエの資格を持つ店主がワインを提案、フランスワイン中心に80本ほど、神戸牛食べ尽くしコース14,300円 (WEB予約やメルマガで10,780円)、神戸牛カップルコース13,200円、ソムリエのペアリング4杯4,840円、店主 酒井 克 (1983年大阪生まれ、大阪の有名焼肉店で約14年修行、2013年ソムリエ取得、2019年4月開店)、大阪市北区曽根崎2-2-12 2F、東梅田駅から徒歩約3分、17:00〜25:00、不定休、カウンター8席とテーブル4席、12歳以下の子どもは同伴不可。食べログ (店舗会員): 毎日17:00〜1:00、ワインの持ちこみ1本3,000円、禁煙、2019年3月29日オープン、スーパープレミアム44,000円、プレミアム27,500円、カップルコース20,900円。口コミ (2026年8〜10月): 9,000円や10,780円のコース、炙りユッケ、キンパ、タンの食べ比べ、塩焼き3種とタレ焼き2種、店主がひとりで切り盛りし英語も話せる。

places.cuisine: Wagyu steak, mostly lean cuts of heifers from across Japan and Matsusaka beef, roasted in a custom-built oven over binchotan (Tabelog) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): 120 g wagyu heifer chateaubriand course ¥23,100; 170 g chateaubriand course with Matsusaka and Kobe beef starters ¥33,000; lunch and dinner alike · lunch (from August 2026, reservation only): Matsusaka beef hamburg steak ¥3,520 with beef-tendon miso soup, beef-tendon kimchi and potato salad (October 2026); a hamburg steak lunch with homemade curry bread and sake-lees soup, about ¥3,850 with a drink (September 2026); a weekday seafood curry ¥1,980 with two shrimp tempura and coconut foam (September 2026); sirloin steak bento and a seared strip-loin steak box with three small dishes (October 2026) · wagyu fillet katsu sandwich to take away (Tabelog) · sparkling wine ¥700 a glass at lunch (September 2026)
places.notes: [Steak · Kitashinchi, oven-roasted wagyu] A second-floor steak counter in Kitashinchi, named a Tabelog Steak 100 in 2021 and a Steak/Teppanyaki WEST 100 in 2024 and 2025, where chateaubriand from wagyu heifers is roasted in a purpose-built oven over binchotan charcoal. The chef, Yuichi Fukuda, born in Osaka in 1973, started at a Michelin-starred Kitahama restaurant at 23 and was the opening chef at another Kitashinchi oven-steak house before opening here in 2016 (Tabelog). Dinner courses are ¥23,100 or ¥33,000 plus 10%, booked the day before. Since August 2026 there is also a reservation-only lunch with no sign outside: a Matsusaka-beef hamburg steak for about ¥3,500, a seafood curry on weekdays, or a steak bento, with no service charge. Counter, tables and a private room for eight.

roles: Chef and founder (Tabelog: "Chef Yuichi Fukuda Profile")
chef_bio.background: Tabelog chef profile (first person): "Born in Osaka in 1973, I stepped into the world of fine dining at the age of 23 when I joined the Michelin-starred restaurant Le Ponder Ciel in Kitahama. … I later became the opening chef at Fukutatei in Kitashinchi, where I perfected my craft in oven-baked steak. In December 2016, I opened Fukuda" (restaurant names as Tabelog's English spells them). The shop text also says skilled chefs from Kitayama Kitchen grill with Fukuda's techniques. Tabelog Steak 100 (2021); Steak/Teppanyaki WEST 100 (2024, 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Lean wagyu roasted in a special oven over top-grade binchotan (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Oven-roasted chateaubriand; Matsusaka beef hamburg steak at lunch.

places.cuisine: Taiwanese stone-pot cooking: seafood and mountain produce stir-fried in sesame oil in a thick stone pot and simmered in chicken broth, skimmed so only the sesame aroma stays (Tabelog) · stone-pot course October–March with four seasonal appetizers and fruit ¥7,860 (3–4 people); weekday set after 20:00 of one appetizer, the stone pot and a ramen finish ¥4,400 (Tabelog, tax included); a ¥7,200 course in February 2026 · dishes in reviews: clam soup with ginger, sea-bream Chinese salad, seafood salad, crab in chili sauce, shrimp, bang-bang chicken (chicken breast, jellyfish, white onion in soy), noodles at the end, fruit (2025–2026) · Shaoxing wine (with pickled plum), highballs, lemon sours
places.notes: [Taiwanese hot pot · Kitashinchi, stone pots on the fifth floor] A fifth-floor restaurant near Kitashinchi station serving Taiwanese ishinabe: seafood and vegetables stir-fried in sesame oil in a heavy stone pot, then simmered in chicken broth, with a run of appetizers first (ginger clam soup, sea-bream salad, crab in chili sauce) and noodles to finish. The full course is about ¥7,200–7,900 in the cooler months; after 20:00 on weekdays a ¥4,400 set brings one appetizer, the pot and ramen. Diners describe the flavour as lighter than expected and the staff, who come from Taiwan and speak Japanese, as warm and attentive. Seating is in curtained booths, which some find noisy, and food can be slow on busy nights. One regular returns every winter.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): traditional Taiwanese/Chinese stone-pot cooking; ingredients stir-fried in sesame oil and simmered in broth in a thick stone pot, the infrared effect bringing out flavour; the stone pot "beloved since our establishment"; four seasonal appetizers in the Ishinabe course; a bang-bang chicken popular with regulars, dressed with soy instead of sesame sauce. Reviews: "The staff are from Taiwan, polite, and fluent in Japanese" (December 2025); a June 2026 regular believes the dish is the shop's own creation.
chef_bio.philosophy: A light finish, keeping only the aroma of sesame oil (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "Surprisingly, the Taiwanese hot pot was quite light. The sesame sauce was really tasty!" — September 2025.
Told that a companion would be late, the staff "kindly offered me water and provided a warm welcome" — July 2026, the Ishinabe course.
"The Taiwanese hot pot is so delicious that I crave it every winter!" — December 2025.

cultural_comfort.note: Chinese-speaking staff (Tabelog); staff from Taiwan who speak Japanese (December 2025). No English menu listed.

places.cuisine: Izakaya and dining bar of fish, seasonal dishes and carefully chosen sake, shochu and wine (Tabelog; reviews) · 2025: assorted sashimi, grilled sardines, sanma simmered with plum, shirasu rice with raw egg (July and September 2025) · from 2016–2017 menus: lotus-root tempura cut thick, conger-eel tempura, freshly fried thick tofu, marinated young horse mackerel, grilled manganji peppers in dashi, Kochi fruit tomato, Tosa shuto, mini shirasu bowl with egg, root-vegetable beef stew, ¥400–1,000 a dish · unfiltered sake from around Japan and shochu such as 尾久の碧玉 (2017)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Nishinakajima, a one-man sake and fish counter] A dim, ten-seat counter in a residential street west of Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open since 2003 and in the 2010s a Michelin Bib Gourmand, according to diners at the time (2017). One person cooks and pours everything (January 2025): seasonal fish as sashimi or grilled, thick-cut lotus-root tempura, and a deep list of sake, shochu and wine. Open until 1 a.m. and on Sundays, rare locally (September 2025). The owner divides opinion: friendly and careful to one diner (September 2025), brusque to another the same month, and one 2017 visitor noted the cook is a bartender by background. Expect waits when it is busy, and call ahead.

roles: Owner (unnamed), runs the bar alone (January 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: izakaya and dining bar, about 10 counter seats, opened 8 August 2003. Per reviews: "This is a bar run by a single person, serving delicious food and drinks" (January 2025); "The friendly owner carefully prepares each dish to pair perfectly with the drinks" (September 2025); "the owner, who has a unique personality, runs the place [alone]" and one diner was upset by the service (September 2025); "the chef must have trained in traditional Japanese cuisine, but it turns out [the cook] is exclusively a bartender" (October 2016); "Chirori, the former Michelin Bib Gourmand" (February 2017); "Since the chef handles everything alone, the counter gets busy quickly" (April 2017).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fish; lotus-root tempura; sake and shochu.

anecdotes.text: "Since it's just one person managing everything, the food may take a bit longer to come out when it gets busy. Some menu items may be sold out, but that adds to the charm." — January 2025.
"I visited this place, which is rare for being open on Sundays in Nishinakajima." — September 2025, assorted sashimi and sanma simmered with plum.
"The lotus root was huge! It was perfectly fluffy, showcasing the skill of the chef." — April 2017.

places.cuisine: Ramen pub of shio ramen and Yamagata-style meat soba (Tabelog; reviews) · shio ramen, a clear, gentle broth with cabbage (June 2019); chicken shio ramen (March 2024, February 2026); also shoyu, tonkotsu, miso and dandan noodles, and odd ones like miso curry milk ramen (2017–2019) · Yamagata cold meat soba of thick dark soba, free-range chicken and a sweetish bonito broth, created by the owner over two years of trials (February 2022); cold or hot (2025–2026) · lunch sets: A, chicken soba with squid tempura, rice, kimchi and kara-age (January 2026); squid-leg tempura rice with two salt-kara-age and a side ¥1,290 (February 2026); cold chicken chuka soba with salt kara-age, kimchi, rice and cold tofu ¥1,000 (August 2026) · salt kara-age, gyoza, grilled xiao long bao (Tabelog; 2025–2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Higashi-Mikuni, a late-night ramen pub with Yamagata meat soba] A 22-seat ramen pub a few minutes from Higashi-Mikuni Station, open since 2014 until 2 a.m., where owner Sato cooks alone. The house bowl was a clear, gentle shio ramen; now the regulars come for the Yamagata-style cold meat soba Sato spent two years developing (2022): thick dark soba, chewy free-range chicken and a sweetish bonito broth, cold or hot. Lunch sets pile on squid tempura, salt kara-age, kimchi and rice for about ¥1,000–1,300 (2026), so allow 20 minutes when it is full. Late at night it is a place to drink, with salt kara-age and grilled xiao long bao. Smoking is allowed throughout; no credit cards; closed Sundays.

places.notes: [Café · Namba, pancakes a minute from the station] A pancake café opened in February 2013 on a side street a minute from Namba Station, run by 株式会社J.C.Factory. The house signature is a pancake topped with toasted marshmallows; seasonal fruit pancakes and savoury ones (an omelette pancake, a cheese-loaded one with salad) fill out the menu, and morning sets start at opening. A diner back in June 2026 after about ten years found some of the same dishes still on the menu. Diners in 2026 differ on texture, from fluffy to dense, thin and buttery; a September 2026 diner saw pancakes thrown away at the griddle and found seating a little disorganised. places.notes: [Yakiniku · Ura Namba, staff-grilled offal and yakisoba to finish] A three-storey offal yakiniku in Ura Namba, opened October 2016, where the staff do all the grilling on a sloped iron plate: the juices run down over a bed of bean sprouts into a pot, and that pan sauce becomes the finishing noodles. The course takes ten cuts in a white then a black marinade; diners in 2026 rave about the yakisoba at the end, the garlic sauce and the half-cooked liver, and like the staff's chat while grilling. Open from 11 AM to 4 AM, it serves daytime drinkers and late crowds alike. Be ready for smoke and smell; one August 2026 diner had concerns about safety and hygiene but praised taste and prices. The course price is ¥3,740 on the December 2025 menu and in a September 2026 review; an October 2026 diner gives ¥3,400.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, the shop grills on a specially designed iron plate that lets the meat juices drip down and collects them in a rich sauce for the finishing noodles; staff grill each piece to the doneness asked for, or to the staff's own judgement. The Tabelog English text calls the shop both "Sakagami" and "Horumon Sakaue". Reviews in 2026 describe the staff explaining each cut while grilling.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Savor every drop of the meat's deliciousness" (Tabelog menu).
chef_bio.specialty: Offal grilled on a sloped iron plate; yakisoba in the pan juices.

anecdotes.text: "Here, all the grilling is done by the staff on the teppan, allowing for easy conversation and a simple, enjoyable experience." — September 2026, course for four.

places.notes: [Meat bar · Nambanaka, Kagoshima wagyu roast beef] A casual wood-panelled meat bar near Namba Parks, open since September 2015, serving roast beef and steaks of black wagyu from the house's own ranch in Kagoshima. Lunch is about the roast beef bowls, generous and good value by most 2026 accounts; one August 2026 regular wished the slices were thicker. At night the draw is the tall potato salad wrapped in roast beef, meat-heavy all-you-can-drink courses and highballs served in a goldfish bowl for ten. Celebrity autographs line the stairs. A September 2026 diner found the prices on the outside menu looked high and the real bill reasonable. Tabelog lists English-speaking staff and an English, Chinese and Korean menu; the official site says the beef-tendon egg rice is a big hit with travellers from abroad.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the beef is "Yamasan beef", A4-and-above black-wagyu heifers fattened on the directly run Yamasan ranch in Izumi, Kagoshima, and the concept page speaks of "the finest lean meat raised by a 110-year-old butcher". The house slices each roast-beef cut to a different thickness to bring out texture. A second 肉タレ屋 runs in Izumisano (hotpepper.jp).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Beauty, splendour and luxurious flavour" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kagoshima black-wagyu roast beef bowls; roast-beef potato salad.

anecdotes.text: "However, the prices on the menu outside were high, making it hard to realize how reasonable it actually is, which is a shame!" — September 2026.

places.notes: [French · Minamisemba, W Osaka's brasserie on Midosuji] The all-day French brasserie on the third floor of W Osaka, opened March 2021, with big windows over the tree-lined Midosuji and a white, black and blue room with polka-dot touches. Lunch is the popular buy: courses with unlimited bread brought to the table and unlimited desserts. Most 2026 diners loved the bread and the lasagna; some found the single pasta choice limiting, the salad salty or the desserts samey. Dinner centres on steak frites, cooked rare and served with butter or sauce, against the night view. One October 2026 diner writes that the menu was developed with Chef Yusuke Takada of La Cime and the W Osaka chefs. The menu has a vegan section.

roles: Hotel kitchen team unnamed; breads and desserts by the W Osaka pastry and bakery chefs (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: A restaurant of W Osaka, opened 16 March 2021 (Tabelog). The official site describes traditional French cooking fused with Japanese ingredients and a modern sensibility, and playful presentation; the name is what the French say when surprised or excited. An October 2026 diner writes that the menu is developed by Chef Yusuke Takada of the two-Michelin-star La Cime together with the W Osaka executive chef team; no other source checked here says so.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Traditional French fused with Japanese ingredients and a modern sensibility" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Steak frites; all-you-can-eat bread and desserts.

anecdotes.text: "The staff regularly came around with fresh bread, and for dessert, we could order from the menu without having to move at all, which was a nice touch." — October 2026, weekday lunch.

Order the five-kind sashimi platter, the "Shrimp and Crab Battle" served on a crab shell, the sesame wasabi squid and a few nigiri, with sake from ¥399 a half-go. It fills up: come at the 16:00 opening (12:00 at weekends) for happy hour, or book. Expect ¥3,000–6,000 a head in 2026.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: the popular sister restaurant of Sushi Ebisu in Ebisu, Tokyo and Sannomiya, Kobe, opened in Ura-Namba; Edomae nigiri made with red vinegar in the Edo-period way, from ¥99; sake from ¥399 a half-go. Reservations accepted for tables; a booking needs one food item and one drink per person, no seat-only or drinks-only bookings; nine or more by phone (Tabelog). 90-minute limit (August 2026). Order and pay by QR code at the table; cash also accepted (September–October 2026). places.cuisine: "Farm to table" café in the Australian café style: brunch plates loaded with vegetables, homemade French toast, seasonal sweets and specialty coffee, all day (Tabelog shop text) · brunch plate of chicken with mushroom and tapenade cream sauce, sunflower seeds, spinach potage and bread (October 2026) · avocado open sandwich · French toast with half a peach (August 2026), fig French toast, salmon French toast (October 2026) · seasonal fairs: peach parfait and peach smoothie (August 2026), fig and hojicha parfait, fig mille-feuille, fig fruit soda (September–October 2026) · acai bowl, affogato · café latte, soy latte, hot chocolate with optional cream
places.notes: [Café · Namba, brunch in a hotel] A high-ceilinged brunch café on the ground floor of Hotel Royal Classic Osaka, beside Osaka-Namba Station, built on the Australian café model: specialty coffee, vegetable-heavy brunch plates and homemade French toast, served all day. The seasonal fruit is the draw: peaches in summer and figs in autumn 2026, in parfaits, French toast, mille-feuille and sodas. Order by QR code; a booking needs a food and a drink each, and stays are 90 minutes. Expect ¥2,000–3,000 a head; reserve at weekend lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: "Bringing you a farm to table lifestyle from Tsuchi"; the new Tsuchi embraces Australian café culture, with high-quality coffee and meals in a comfortable space, brunch plates and sweets all day. An October 2026 regular notes the menu is gradually expanding and a pasta set has gone.

chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fruit French toast and parfaits; vegetable brunch plates.

anecdotes.text: "The seasonal mille-feuille always uses delicious fruits, and the figs were perfectly ripe and incredibly tasty." — October 2026.

"for online reservations, it was mandatory to order both a drink and a dessert per person." — September 2026.

places.name: テーブル36 (Table 36)
places.gf_detail: Ask when booking; the listing says allergy information is available. The buffet has carved meats, salads and around 30 desserts alongside pizza, risotto, gratin and curries; nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The buffet includes seasonal vegetable salads and fruit, but most dishes are built on meat, seafood or dairy.
places.hours_raw: Breakfast daily 6:30–10:30 (last order 10:00); lunch Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30), Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:30 (last order 15:00); dinner 18:00–23:30 (last order 22:45), on Fri and Sat until 24:30 (last order 23:45) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted online 24 hours a day (Tabelog). Live music on Friday, Saturday and Sunday (Tabelog; July 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) (Tabelog). 150 seats, window seats over the city, a private room for 8–12; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; hotel parking free for 2 hours with ¥6,000 spent (Tabelog). Reach it via the 6F hotel lobby (August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Namba 5-1-60, Swissotel Nankai Osaka 36F, 147 m up — directly above Nankai Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Buffets and steak with a view from 147 m (Tabelog shop text) · weekday lunch: international buffet ¥5,900, autumn 2026 with porcini risotto, sweet-potato and chestnut gratin, Filipino pork adobo, Thai green chicken curry, live-kitchen meat (lamb top sirloin on weekdays, wagyu ribeye at weekends and holidays) and chestnut, sweet-potato and pumpkin desserts (Tabelog) · around 30 sweets: egg tarts, canelés, chocolate fondue, blueberry muffins (2026) · roast beef carved in front of you (August 2026) · breakfast buffet of Japanese, Western, Chinese, Middle Eastern and Mexican dishes, e.g. cilantro, salsa, century egg, hummus, plenty of fruit (July–September 2026) · dinner: American-style à la carte, premium wagyu and tomahawk steaks, seafood, beef tartare (Tabelog; August 2026) · free-flow drinks ¥4,400 (August 2026)
places.notes: [Buffet and steak · Namba, 36 floors up] The restaurant of Swissotel Nankai Osaka on the 36th floor, straight above Nankai Namba Station, known for its lunch buffet and the view over the city from 147 m. The weekday buffet (¥5,900 in autumn 2026) runs from international dishes and a live kitchen of carved meats to some 30 desserts that diners return to again and again; breakfast and steak dinners with live music at weekends are the other draws. Book a window table; take the lift to the 6F lobby, then on to 36F. One October 2026 diner found the floor short of staff.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: a lunch buffet and dinner with views from 147 m above ground, directly connected to Namba Station, an open kitchen, American-style à la carte and premium steaks at dinner, live performances on Friday to Sunday. A July 2026 breakfast diner notes the hotel belongs to the Accor group.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch buffet with live kitchen and desserts; wagyu and tomahawk steaks.

anecdotes.text: "I ended up ordering the egg tart, canelé, and chocolate fondue three times!" — July 2026, a window seat at lunch.
"I wasn't sure how to get to the 36th floor, so I first went to the lobby on the 6th floor and then took the elevator to the 36th floor." — August 2026, the lunch buffet.
"They offer a variety of distinctive ingredients such as cilantro, salsa, century egg, and hummus." — July 2026, breakfast at 6:30.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): テーブル36、イタリアン・ダイニングバー・洋菓子、大阪市中央区難波5-1-60 スイスホテル南海大阪 36F、南海なんば駅直結、地上147mの眺め、朝食6:30〜10:30、ランチ平日11:30〜15:00・土日祝11:00〜15:30、ディナー18:00〜23:30 (金・土は24:30まで)、ネット予約は24時間、カード可、150席、8〜12名の個室、禁煙、車いす可、駐車場 (6,000円で2時間無料)、オープンキッチン、平日のインターナショナルランチビュッフェ5,900円 (2026年秋はポルチーニのリゾット、さつまいもと栗のグラタン、フィリピンのポークアドボ、タイのグリーンカレー、平日はラムのランプ、週末はリブロース、栗・さつまいも・かぼちゃのデザート)、約30種のスイーツ、夜はアメリカンなアラカルトと和牛やトマホークのステーキ、金・土・日はライブ、アレルギー表示あり。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): 窓からの眺め、エッグタルト、カヌレ、チョコレートフォンデュ、ブルーベリーマフィン、目の前で切るローストビーフ、朝食にパクチー、サルサ、ピータン、フムス、果物、フリーフロー4,400円、6階のロビーからエレベーター、スタッフが足りないと感じた口コミも。

cultural_comfort.note: A buffet where you serve yourself, in an international hotel with many overseas guests (July 2026). No English menu evidence found.

places.name: 北新地 黒猫 (Kitashinchi Kuroneko)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The courses include a hot pie, a zeppole that tastes like takoyaki, bread with butter and a black tantanmen as one meat choice; fish, meat and dessert are chosen from several options.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses of fish, meat (duck, wagyu, foie gras, pork) and dessert; the soup is a potage; no vegetarian course is mentioned.
places.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 and dinner 18:00–22:00, Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun; closed Wednesdays and the first and third Tuesday of the month (reservations can be made for closed days) (Tabelog). One drink per person required; no service charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: a counter of 9 and a private L-shaped counter room for 3–5; whole-shop hire up to 20; non-smoking; wheelchair users asked to call ahead; children welcome (Tabelog). A queue had formed before the 12:00 opening (September 2026).
places.neighborhood: 曽根崎新地1-9-11, basement of エスパス北新地10 — 20 m east of Kitashinchi Stn exit 11-41
places.cuisine: Creative French that also borrows from Italian, Japanese and Chinese cooking, with market fish and seasonal ingredients chosen by the chef (Tabelog) · courses of an amuse, a "palette" of small starters, fish, meat, dessert, bread and coffee, with surcharges for some choices: dinner standard course ¥6,900, with a dessert platter ¥8,500, with the black-cat whole cake ¥8,900 (Tabelog, tax included); a weekday lunch course ¥6,000 (September 2026); a weekend lunch course ¥5,300 (September 2026) · pumpkin potage with homemade popcorn, a zeppole like takoyaki, chawanmushi of mackerel and pumpkin in a black-cat teapot, Ishikawa Spanish mackerel in tomato-basil cream, bonito cooked rare, Hungarian duck with glazed apples and black-vinegar sauce, + foie gras steak ¥1,000, black-wagyu and foie gras "Rossini", autumn "Japanese" parfait +¥600, baked cheesecake (September–October 2026) · signature dishes: Miyazaki black-wagyu roast beef with Hokkaido salmon roe and sea urchin in a wasabi sauce (Tabelog) · wine by the glass ¥700–900 (September 2026)
places.notes: [French · Kitashinchi, a creative course with a cat theme] A basement counter in Kitashinchi full of black-cat figurines, where the chef cooks a free-style French course that also borrows from Italian, Japanese and Chinese cooking. Each course opens with a pumpkin potage you scatter with homemade popcorn, then a 'palette' of small, intricate starters, among them a zeppole that tastes like takoyaki, before you pick a fish, a meat (the Hungarian duck with glazed apples is the favourite, foie gras extra) and a dessert such as the autumn parfait. Lunch from about ¥5,300, dinner ¥6,900. Anniversaries are a speciality: message plates and a black-cat whole cake. In October 2026 two men did all the cooking and serving. Its first shop is in Fukushima.

roles: Chef-owner (unnamed) and one other staff member
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: classic French with a free-spirited twist; the chef sources fresh seafood and seasonal ingredients from the market personally; dishes in French, Italian, Japanese and Chinese styles, "Free Style That Doesn't Conform to a 'Type'". Two October 2026 reviews call the Fukushima shop the main branch. The Tabelog invoice number T8140001077660 is registered to 株式会社ｉ　ＴＯ　ｉ, 西宮市 (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Free Style That Doesn't Conform to a 'Type'" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Palette of starters; Hungarian duck; black-cat cake.

anecdotes.text: "Throughout the restaurant, there are various cat-themed decorations, which would delight any cat lover." — September 2026, a weekend lunch course.
"I was surprised to see that each course had its own chalkboard menu!" — September 2026, a solo weekday lunch.
"The staff, two gentlemen, handled both cooking and serving" — October 2026, after an earlier visit to the main branch in Fukushima.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 黒猫、フレンチ・パスタ・洋食、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-9-11 エスパス北新地10 B1F、北新地駅の出口11-41から東へ20m、月・火・木〜日12:00〜14:30、18:00〜22:00、水曜と第1・第3火曜休み (休みの日も予約できる)、ワンドリンク制、サービス料なし、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、14席 (カウンター9、L字カウンターの個室3〜5名)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、車いすは相談、子ども可、市場の鮮魚と旬の食材、フレンチを軸にイタリアン・和・中華も、型にはまらないフリースタイル、宮崎県の黒毛和牛のローストビーフ、ディナーのスタンダードコース6,900円、デザートプレートつき8,500円、黒猫のホールケーキつき8,900円。インボイス登録は株式会社ｉ　ＴＯ　ｉ (西宮市)。口コミ(2024年7月〜2026年10月): かぼちゃのポタージュと自家製ポップコーン、パレットオードブル、たこ焼きのようなゼッポリーネ、黒猫のティーポットの茶碗蒸し、石川県のサワラ、カツオのソテー、ハンガリー産の鴨と黒酢ソース、フォアグラのステーキ、黒毛和牛とフォアグラのロッシーニ、秋の「和」のパフェ、ベイクドチーズケーキ、平日のランチコース6,000円、週末のランチコース5,300円、グラスワイン700〜900円、黒猫の置物がいっぱい、記念日のメッセージプレート、二人で調理と接客、本店は Fukushima。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter course with choices for fish, meat and dessert, and a chalkboard menu per course (2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: 焼き鳥すみえもん (Yakitori Sumiemon)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Skewers come with salt or sauce, shishito glazed with soy, chicken sashimi with a special soy sauce; the finishing dishes include chicken ramen and a tsukune rice bowl; mugwort fu is on the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori course; the two vegetable skewers come within it.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30 per an October 2026 diner); closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, walk-ins welcome; groups of 6 or more and private hire by phone; children only if eating the adult course; smart-casual dress code (Tabelog). Fills within minutes of opening on weekdays (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY (Tabelog). 20 seats around a U-shaped counter; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; one restroom, not separated by gender (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 2 April 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 曽根崎新地1-3-3, ground floor of 好陽ビル — 130 m from Kitashinchi Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori of "Kyo Bihaku Dori", a long-raised white chicken from Miyama in Kyoto, grilled over charcoal in front of a U-shaped counter (Tabelog; October 2026) · the course: ten special skewers and two vegetable skewers, or seven skewers with a salad and two finishing dishes; ¥5,280 in October 2026 reviews, ¥6,280 on the listing now (tax included) · skewers such as breast with plum, heart, gizzard, knee cartilage, tsukune, quail egg in bacon, deboned wing, crisp skin, "giza kawa", thigh with green onion, tenderloin, bonjiri, shishito, zucchini (September–October 2026) · à la carte: chicken sashimi, chicken yukhoe, free-range chicken tataki, spicy "yodare" chicken ¥770, thick fried tofu ¥550, mugwort fu, grilled cherry tomatoes; finishing dishes: "Donemon", a tsukune rice bowl, ¥900, chicken ramen ¥900, grilled rice balls with soup; homemade pudding (October 2026) · sake and shochu from around Japan, wine (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Kitashinchi, Kyoto chicken at a U-shaped counter] A 20-seat yakitori counter in Kitashinchi, open since April 2025, that grills only Kyoto's long-raised 'Bihaku' white chicken. Most diners take the course of ten skewers and two vegetable skewers, about ¥5,300 in October 2026 (¥6,280 on the listing now), served one at a time with salt or sauce: deboned wings, crisp 'giza kawa' skin, a tender breast and fluffy tsukune are the ones diners name. Add chicken sashimi or yukhoe before, and finish with the tsukune rice bowl 'Donemon' or a light chicken ramen and the house pudding. It fills within minutes on weekdays, so book; walk-ins are welcome. One diner in October 2026 found the flavours mild and the portions of sashimi small.

chef_bio.background: Per a 2025 opening article on voix.jp: opened 2 April 2025 by 株式会社hm holder (東京都港区六本木); yakitori chef 角田大輔, ten years of grilling yakitori, trained for more than ten years at a popular members-only yakitori restaurant; 20 counter seats; courses from ¥5,280. Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: yakitori chefs with over ten years of experience; "Kyo Bihaku Dori" from Kyoto.

anecdotes.text: "One skewer that particularly stood out was the rare part called 'Giza Kawa.'" — September 2026, the special skewers course.
"I made a reservation for 7 PM and the restaurant accommodated my request to leave by 8:20 PM." — October 2026, a second visit.
"If I had to point out one downside, it would be that there was only one restroom, and it wasn't separated by gender." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: voix.jp (2025年): 焼き鳥 すみえもんは2025年4月2日に北新地にオープン、運営は株式会社hm holder (東京都港区六本木)、焼き鳥職人の角田大輔さんは焼き鳥歴10年、人気の会員制の焼き鳥店で10年以上修業、大阪府北区曽根崎新地1-3-3 好陽ビル 1F、JR 北新地駅から徒歩2分、20席 (カウンターのみ)、コースは税込5,280円から、好きなペースで止められるストップ制、18:00〜23:00、日曜・祝日休み、京都府 Miyama の美白どり。食べログ (店舗会員): 焼き鳥すみえもん、月〜土18:00〜23:00、日・祝休み、予約可、6名以上と貸切は電話、子どもは大人と同じコースのみ、スマートカジュアル、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、20席 (カウンター)、禁煙、無料 Wi-Fi、特選串10本と野菜串2本、または串7本とサラダと〆2品のコース6,280円、全国の日本酒と焼酎。口コミ(2026年3月〜10月): 予約がおすすめ、平日も開店から数分で満席、ささみの梅、ハツ、砂肝、ひざなんこつ、つくね、うずらのベーコン巻き、骨を抜いた手羽、皮、giza kawa、ねぎま、ぼんじり、ししとう、ズッキーニ、鶏刺し、鶏ユッケ、地鶏のたたき、Yodare chicken 770円、厚揚げ550円、よもぎ麩、焼きミニトマト、どんぶりの「Donemon」900円、〆の鶏ラーメン900円、焼きおにぎりとスープ、プリン、コース5,280円、トイレはひとつで男女共用、味がおとなしく刺身が小さいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter course with à la carte add-ons; walk-ins welcome (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

places.name: TOLAH UMEDA
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The courses centre on pasta, thin pizza, focaccia and fritto, with a starter platter, grilled chicken and caprese alongside.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list ticks "vegetarian options" and "particular about vegetables", and the starter platter holds vegetable dishes (frittata, marinated eggplant, pumpkin), but no vegan dish is named.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 12:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closing days not fixed; New Year and long holidays may differ (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; seat choice not guaranteed (terrace included); 20 or more by phone; easiest to call 14:00–17:00 on weekdays; luggage not kept (Tabelog). Dinner seat-only bookings ¥400 + tax a head for the starter (Tabelog). Drink-inclusive courses run 90 minutes to two hours (August and October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), IC cards, PayPay (Tabelog). 45 seats at tables, a counter and an open terrace; private rooms with sofas for 6 to over 30; parties up to 40 seated or 60 standing; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Opened 22 September 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 堂山町7-22, 4F of ステージ中通りビル, a 2020 building on the Higashi-Nakadori shopping street near HEP — 8 min from the Umeda stations, 6 min from Nakazakicho Stn
places.cuisine: Resort-style Italian dining bar: colourful seasonal plates at lunch, wine and drink-inclusive courses at night (Tabelog) · lunch set of a starter platter, all-you-can-eat freshly baked focaccia and a choice of three pastas ¥1,870 (October 2026) · dinner: standard plan of five seasonal starters, pasta, creamy chicken stew and dessert ¥3,300; nine-dish course with two hours of drinks ¥4,000; premium course with ten starters and wine in the free-flow ¥5,000 (Tabelog, tax included) · ten-starter platter (pumpkin in mustard, vegetable frittata, prosciutto, salmon carpaccio, sweet-potato salad, caprese, mortadella, marinated eggplant, mimolette and potato salad), wagyu and cheese meat pasta, fries with whipped butter, grilled young chicken with lemon butter, gelato (October 2026); porcini cream pasta, tuna and anchovy pasta with autumn vegetables (September 2026); thin margherita, mushroom ajillo, a cheese platter (August–September 2026) · message plates for celebrations (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Italian · east of Umeda, drink-inclusive courses and a terrace] A large Italian dining bar on the fourth floor of a new building on the Higashi-Nakadori shopping street east of Umeda, dressed as a resort, with a terrace and sofa-lined private rooms that take birthday groups and company parties. At lunch about ¥1,900 buys a starter platter, a pasta and all the warm focaccia you want; at night the draw is the ¥5,000 course with two hours of drinks, wine included, that starts with ten colourful starters before a wagyu-and-cheese pasta, fries with whipped butter and grilled chicken. Diners in 2026 praise the portions and the price; several found the service slow when it was busy, and one October 2026 group had dessert ten minutes before its time was up.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "Umeda's resort dining for special moments", seasonal colourful dishes at lunch and a hideaway for adults at night, drink-inclusive courses from ¥4,000; opened 22 September 2021. The Tabelog invoice number T1120001253360 is registered to ＴＯＬＡＨ株式会社 at the shop's own address (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02).

anecdotes.text: "When our bread plate was empty, the staff kindly offered us more focaccia, which we appreciated!" — October 2026, the ¥1,870 lunch set.
"The appetizer platter alone is satisfying with its generous portion!" — October 2026, a birthday dinner for nine.
"Although we were told we had 90 minutes, the food took a long time to arrive, and dessert was served only 10 minutes before the end." — October 2026.

places.notes: [Yakitori · Dojima, a Hinai-chicken course] A refined, dim 12-seat yakitori counter in Dojima, on Tabelog's Yakitori WEST 100 list in 2023, 2024 and 2025, whose chef trained at Ichimatsu in Kitashinchi, the shop credited with the yakitori course. Every skewer is Hinai chicken from Akita, seasoned with chicken fat, snow salt or a sweet soy sauce and timed to each diner's pace, and the 16-dish course weaves in grilled grapes, aged chicken prosciutto, a chicken shumai and a seasonal rice. The olive-oil daikon between skewers is refillable; one diner heard of a guest who ate 33 plates (September 2026). Course ¥13,200, or ¥17,800 with four drinks; two-hour seatings, the first at 15:30 on Fridays and Saturdays. English menu and English-speaking staff.

roles: Owner-chef (named in a July 2026 review as Wada)

A July 2026 diner names the owner as Wada, trained under Takeda at Ichimatsu in Kitashinchi, and writes that the shop is where Ichimatsu used to be; an August 2026 diner was sent by Ichimatsu as its sister restaurant; a July 2026 regular wrote that a new 大将 has taken over from the previous one.

places.notes: [Izakaya · Namba, the brewery's own kushikatsu bar] The house izakaya of Dotonbori Brewery, a craft brewer in the basement of the Shochikuza theatre, in a big, calm room on the ground floor of Namba CITY South a minute from Nankai Namba. Every Dotonbori Beer is on tap, Osaka Kölsch, Porter and Alt among them, beside kushikatsu, fried chicken and giant gyoza. Lunch is good value: sets were ¥890 and ¥990 in August 2026 with free miso soup refills, and a lunch drinking set brings edamame, five kushikatsu and a pint. Private rooms and tatami halls make it a party venue, with all-you-can-drink that includes the craft beer. One August 2026 diner found the beer list limited. Hours follow the mall.

It is one of three Kaniyoshi shops in Namba, and the courses do the work: snow crab from ¥12,100, crab and fugu together for ¥13,750 (April 2026), up to a three-crab feast. Crab sashimi with a dip of egg yolk and crab miso is the dish diners remember; staff grill crab and fugu on a charcoal shichirin at the table and finish with rice porridge. Two October 2026 diners judged the crab frozen, and one found the crab tempura the weak dish. Smoking is allowed throughout. Open daily to 3 a.m.

roles: Kitchen and room staff (unnamed); staff grill and cook at the table

places.cuisine: Creative chicken dishes from fresh Daisen chicken (大山産がいなどり on the shop site) in a hideaway yakitori izakaya (official site; Tabelog) · chicken grilled on a heated rock-salt slab and served off the skewer; chicken sashimi platters with foamed soy sauce; the rare-fried breast kara-age "Mune Pon" with grated daikon and ponzu; bone-in chicken; yodare-dori; harami and seseri (official site; 2026 reviews) · broccoli with cheese fondue, potato salad, chicken-breast jerky, kakiage, oyakodon in half size to finish (2024–2026 reviews) · courses with all-you-can-drink: rock-salt grill course ¥4,400, three-hour course with 150 minutes of drinks ¥5,500 (Tabelog; June 2026) · seasonal sake, shochu such as Maho, wine and fruit liqueurs (official site; October 2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a chicken bar down an alley] A small chicken bar hidden down a Higashi-Shinsaibashi back alley, with nine counter seats downstairs and sofa tables up a steep stair. The chicken is fresh Daisen bird, and the kitchen goes beyond skewers: pieces grilled on a hot rock-salt slab and served off the stick, chicken sashimi with foamed soy sauce, and the house kara-age of breast fried rare, eaten with grated daikon and ponzu. Broccoli with cheese fondue has its own fans, and a half oyakodon makes a good finish. Courses with all-you-can-drink run ¥4,400–5,500. Diners in 2026 praised the friendly staff and the owner's good humour. Smoking is allowed. Open to 3 a.m. except Sundays.

roles: Owner (unnamed; September 2026 review) and grill staff
chef_bio.background: Official site (watoribar.com): a hideaway yakitori izakaya in a back alley six minutes from Shinsaibashi Station exit 5, using fresh 大山産がいなどり for creative chicken dishes such as sashimi, "Mune Pon" kara-age fried rare to stay tender and juicy, and chicken grilled on heated rock salt; sofa seats on 2F; a second shop in Tenma and a sister restaurant 屋台CHU華 ジャスミン. Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: creative chicken dishes from freshly sourced local chicken, smoking allowed.
chef_bio.specialty: Rock-salt grilled chicken; rare "Mune Pon" kara-age; chicken sashimi.

anecdotes.text: "Here, the grilled chicken is served on a square rock salt plate, and the seasoning is just right—elegantly balanced." — October 2026.

Non-smoking (Tabelog). Order by QR code at the table (April and July 2026). Opened 29 December 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shimanouchi 1-18-8, ground floor beside Nagahoribashi Stn exit 3
places.cuisine: Sichuan restaurant that brings in chefs and ingredients from the source (Tabelog) · mapo tofu set ¥1,000 with rice refills, two pieces of kara-age, soup and almond tofu, spice level to choose (February, April and July 2026) · stone-grilled mapo tofu finished at the table ¥1,300, twice-cooked pork ¥1,600, shark-fin soup ¥1,200, beef with green peppers ¥1,100, salted stir-fried green beans ¥1,380 (December 2025) · spicy beef noodle soup with garlic chives, coriander and egg yolk ¥1,300 (May 2026); chicken with peanuts and chilli, saliva chicken, dan dan noodles, cumin lamb, stewed beef, dried-tofu salad, stir-fried potatoes, stir-fried garlic and vegetables, candied sweet potato; a soup of blood and offal (2026 reviews) · Shaoxing wine (December 2025)
places.notes: [Sichuan · Nagahoribashi, mapo tofu by the station exit] A Sichuan restaurant right beside Nagahoribashi Station exit 3, with chefs and ingredients brought from the source (Tabelog) and Chinese staff, some speaking a little Japanese. Lunch is the bargain: a mapo tofu set with rice refills, kara-age and almond tofu was ¥1,000 in 2026, spice level your choice, ordered by QR code; at noon it was packed in December 2025 and quiet in July 2026. At dinner, try the stone-grilled mapo tofu finished at the table, twice-cooked pork, cumin lamb or saliva chicken, with Shaoxing wine. A regular notes that taste and portions shift when the chef changes, and that rice bowls had shrunk by April 2026. For hot pot, the sister Fuyo En Hot Pot Castle is the place. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: authentic Sichuan cuisine with chefs and ingredients gathered from the source, a minute from Nagahoribashi Station beside exit 3; opened 29 December 2015; hot pot at the sister shop 芙蓉苑 火鍋城 (Tabelog 27102144). Reviews in 2025–2026 describe Chinese staff, some speaking broken Japanese.

anecdotes.text: "The staff prepared it in front of us, just like stone-grilled bibimbap" — December 2025, the stone-grilled mapo tofu ¥1,300.
"I ordered the Mapo Tofu Set Meal (JPY 1000). Credit card payments are accepted!" — April 2026.
"Sometimes the chef changes, which can lead to variations in taste and portion sizes, but I accept that as part of the experience." — April 2026.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: lunch sets come with kara-age, and Taiwanese ramen, mapo noodles, fried noodles and gyoza are wheat.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Taiwanese-Chinese diner of pork, chicken and shrimp dishes; mapo tofu with minced meat.

Lunch specials are cash or PayPay only; cards (VISA, Master) are accepted for à la carte and courses (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, also for lunch (2026). 82 seats on Tabelog, tables plus private and semi-private rooms, groups up to 100 (Tabelog); a 2026 diner counted about 48 at the tables.
