places.notes: [Taiwanese-Chinese · Higashimikuni, a big diner at the station stairs] A large Taiwanese-style Chinese restaurant right at the foot of the Higashimikuni Station stairs, open since 2024 every day from 11:00 to 23:00, with tables, private rooms and courses for groups. Lunch is the bargain: a set around ¥950 of mapo tofu, Taiwanese ramen, fried noodles or fried rice with kara-age, unlimited rice and soup, and self-service coffee after (2026); it fills with office workers by 12:20. In the evening there is a ¥1,180 After Work Set of a drink, gyoza and a starter, all-you-can-drink for ¥3,580 and all-you-can-eat courses (2026). Portions are generous. Lunch specials are cash or PayPay only. Smoking is allowed at dinner.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog beyond payment notes; opened 22 March 2024 (Tabelog). The osaka-kita crawl also lists 台湾料理 営業中 福島店.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets with unlimited rice; mapo tofu; all-you-can-eat courses.

anecdotes.text: "They offer self-service coffee after the meal, with both hot and iced options available, which was a nice touch." — May 2026, the happosai set.
"For JPY 1,280, you get Mapo Tofu, stir-fried liver with garlic chives, soup, rice, and almond jelly!" — October 2026.
"A drink (like draft beer) + grilled gyoza + one appetizer for just JPY 1,180!" — September 2026, the After Work Set.

places.name: 四川辣麺 西中島店 (Sichuan Ramen Nishinakajima ten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in the tantanmen and mapo noodles; yurinchi is battered.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tantanmen with braised pork, mapo tofu with minced meat.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Wed 11:30–14:30 and 18:30–02:00; Thu–Sat 11:30–14:30 and 18:30–03:00; Sun 11:30–14:30 and 18:30–01:00; open every day; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 28 seats at counter and tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog). About 60% full at 21:00 on a Wednesday (September 2026). Follow the shop on Instagram for free rice or frozen lychee (October 2026).
places.neighborhood: 西中島3-13-8 — 2–3 min from the north exit of Nishinakajima-Minamigata Stn, 3–4 min from Hankyu Minamikata (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Sichuan noodles, mild-leaning for local tastes (Tabelog) · tantanmen in an original or a new soup: a light, mildly spicy broth with medium-thin wavy noodles and pork-belly chashu (September 2026); the "Sichuan street style" new flavour with a creamy sesame broth and braised pork (October 2026) · mapo noodles with medium-thick straight noodles, spice level normal, a little extra or extra, with rice to finish, ¥1,250 (August and October 2026) · mapo tofu rice, mild and thick (September 2026) · hot and sour noodles (September 2026) · yurinchi (September 2026) · table condiments: Sichuan pepper, chili oil, pickles, ground sesame, fried garlic, lychee vinegar (September and October 2026) · draft beer ¥480 (August 2026)
places.notes: [Sichuan noodles · Nishinakajima, tantanmen into the small hours] A dark-walled Sichuan noodle shop two minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open for lunch and again from 18:30 until 1 to 3 am every night, so it fills with late diners (September 2026). The tantanmen comes in an original, lighter version and a creamy-sesame "Sichuan street style", both with tender braised pork; the mapo noodles are the hotter choice, numbing with Sichuan pepper, with rice to drop into the last of the sauce (2026). A row of condiments, from chili oil and Sichuan pepper to lychee vinegar, lets you set the heat. Lunch can feel rushed (October 2026). Smoking is allowed. A fan from its old Hankyu Sanbangai days came back for it in October 2026.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: authentic Sichuan dishes in a casual setting, the menu in Chinese characters with Japanese descriptions and flavours adjusted to local tastes. An October 2026 diner "used to frequent Sichuan Ramen when it had a location in Hankyu Sanbangai".

anecdotes.text: "Located in the bustling area of Nishinakajima Minamikata, it stays open late, and even at this hour, the place was about 60% full." — September 2026, around 21:00 on a Wednesday.
"When I added the leftover rice to the Mapo soup, it turned into a delicious Mapo rice bowl, allowing me to savor every last drop." — August 2026, the mapo noodles for JPY 1,250.
"As a special for following on Instagram, I received frozen lychee, which was perfect for refreshing my palate after the spicy meal." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 四川辣麺 西中島店、担々麺・ラーメン、大阪市淀川区西中島3-13-8、Midosuji 線 西中島南方駅北口から徒歩2〜3分、阪急 南方駅から3〜4分、月〜水11:30〜14:30、18:30〜翌2:00、木〜土11:30〜14:30、18:30〜翌3:00、日11:30〜14:30、18:30〜翌1:00、年中無休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、28席、喫煙可。店の紹介: 気軽に本場の四川料理を、漢字のメニューに日本語の説明、日本人向けの味。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 担々麺はオリジナルと新しい味から、あっさりで辛さはひかえめ、中細のちぢれ麺、豚バラのチャーシュー、「Sichuan Street Style」の新しい味はクリーミーなごま、麻婆麺1,250円 (辛さを3段階から、締めのごはんつき)、麻婆ごはん、酸辣湯麺、Yurinchi、卓上に花椒、ラー油、漬物、すりごま、揚げにんにく、ライチの酢、Instagram のフォローでごはんか冷凍ライチ、夜21時でも6割の客、昼はあわただしいという声、Hankyu Sanbangai にあった店のファン。

places.name: Hortensia Bistro
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses include bread, a hamburg steak, fried sea bream and pastry desserts; one petit four is a rice-flour canelé (May 2026), but nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of game, meat and fish with butter, cream and egg dishes.
places.hours_raw: Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:30; Fri food 13:00) and 17:30–22:30 (last food order 20:30, drinks 22:00); Wed dinner only, 17:30–22:30, booking by phone; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; groups of five or more by phone; a booking lapses 30 minutes after the time without notice (Tabelog). Often fully booked at weekend and holiday lunches (March and May 2026). Preschool children welcome at lunch, not at dinner (Tabelog). One drink each, or a ¥1,000 seat charge (Tabelog's original text: ワンドリンク制にしております。ドリンク飲まれない方は席料1000円お願いしております。). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 on sofas, 8 at tables, 4 at the counter; an open terrace; non-smoking; wheelchair access; one parking space if free, by arrangement (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 東三国4-15-12, ground floor of シオザキビル — 2 min from Exit 5 of Higashimikuni Stn, 10 min from Shin-Osaka (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: French bistro, known for game (December 2025) · lunch course ¥3,000: assorted appetisers, soup (turnip or cauliflower), a main such as the house hamburg steak, grilled pork loin, fried sea bream or duck confit, assorted desserts, coffee (March and May 2026); a canelé with dessert for those who book (March 2026) · full lunch course with fish and meat ¥5,500, e.g. low-temperature Aomori pork (September 2026) · "Menu Hortensia" ¥8,800: truffled potato-salad amuse, two chosen starters (asparagus sauvage salad with rillettes, Dutch white asparagus with prosciutto and onsen egg), chicken consommé, grilled ayu, a main such as Kagoshima anaguma (badger) royale with foie gras (+¥2,200) or Spanish mountain-quail ballotine (+¥550), and petits fours including a rice-flour canelé (May 2026) · rabbit wrapped around angel shrimp (September 2026) · Earl Grey crème brûlée (May 2026) · a wine list to match (2023–2026) · French osechi at New Year (December 2025)
places.notes: [French · Higashimikuni, a bistro with game on the menu] A small, bright French bistro two minutes from Higashimikuni Station, with sofa seats and a little terrace, known for its game: Kagoshima badger with foie gras, Spanish mountain quail, rabbit wrapped around shrimp in the ¥8,800 Menu Hortensia (May and September 2026). Lunch is the easier way in, a ¥3,000 course of a generous appetiser platter, soup, a main such as the house hamburg steak or grilled pork, and a plate of small desserts, and it is often fully booked, so reserve (2026). Dishes are explained with care, and there is a good wine list; one drink each or a ¥1,000 seat charge. No preschool children at dinner. Closed Monday; Wednesday dinner only.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Reviewers: "a French restaurant by a famous chef" (October 2023); "This bistro is known for its game meat" (December 2025); the manager and staff were friendly and warm (May 2026); dishes and drinks are explained thoroughly (September 2026). It also makes a French osechi for New Year (December 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Game courses; lunch course with hamburg steak.

anecdotes.text: "The Assorted Appetizers were so generous that I was completely satisfied just with that!" — March 2026, a course with the fish main.
"Kagoshima Prefecture Anaguma Royale with Foie Gras" (+JPY 2,200) — May 2026, the Menu Hortensia for JPY 8,800.
"I honestly didn't have high expectations for the desserts, but I was pleasantly surprised by the assortment of petite desserts!" — May 2026, the JPY 3,000 lunch course.

places.name: 松吟庵 東三国店 (Shogin An Higashimikuni ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. The soba is ju-wari, all buckwheat (April 2026), and one diner ate it with salt; but the dipping sauce is soy-based, and tempura, chicken nanban and fried dishes share the kitchen. Ask before ordering.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba sauce and kayaku rice on dashi, beef tongue, fish and egg dishes.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Wed 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); Thu 17:30–23:00; Fri 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–24:00 (last order 23:30); Sat 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–23:00; Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; holidays 11:00–22:30; until sold out; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; call with any requests (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter downstairs and two tables of six upstairs, a private room for eight or more (Tabelog); order by QR code (June 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Lines at weekday lunch (October 2026).
places.neighborhood: 東三国1-33-21 — 2 min from Exit 4 of Higashimikuni Stn (Tabelog); down a narrow lane of houses by a cleaner's, in a renovated old house marked "Ju-wari Soba" (April 2026)
places.cuisine: Ju-wari (all-buckwheat) soba, beef tongue and sake (2025–2026) · lunch sets with cold or hot ju-wari soba: daily set ¥1,300 with kayaku rice, dashimaki and hirekatsu with grated daikon ponzu (April 2026); daily set with nikujaga, kayaku rice and dashimaki; tempura and zaru soba; maki sushi, saba sushi and zaru soba (August 2026); chicken tempura and dashimaki (October 2026) · evening: thick-cut grilled beef tongue, dashimaki, bonito tataki, chicken nanban, grilled eggplant (May 2026); sweet simmered herring, maitake tempura, pork seiro soba (June 2026); hamo in season (May 2026); fried oysters, fried taro, tempura platter, oni-oroshi bukkake soba (August 2026); fresh oysters with ponzu, shabu-shabu salad (March 2025) · sake list with Juyondai junmai daiginjo (May and July 2026) · soba tea (June 2026)
places.notes: [Soba · Higashimikuni, ju-wari soba in an old house] A soba restaurant in a renovated old house down a narrow lane two minutes from Higashimikuni Station, with an old carved ranma set into the wall and "Ju-wari Soba" on the front (April 2026). By day it serves all-buckwheat soba sets, cold or hot, with generous sides: a ¥1,300 daily set of soba, kayaku rice, freshly made dashimaki and a tenderloin cutlet with daikon ponzu (April 2026). By night it becomes a soba izakaya with thick-cut grilled beef tongue, tempura, dashimaki, seasonal fish and a sake list running to Juyondai, finished with soba (2026). One diner found prices high and the upstairs tables cramped (July 2026). Weekday lunch draws a line; order by QR code upstairs.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Reviewers: a renovated traditional house with a carved ranma "originally from the home of the former owner of this traditional house" (April 2026); soba tea is served, a sign of pride in the soba to one June 2026 diner; compared with the nearby soba shop Atariya (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Ju-wari soba; thick-cut grilled beef tongue; dashimaki.

anecdotes.text: "I sprinkled some salt from the table onto the soba and enjoyed it. The soba was chilled to perfection and paired wonderfully with the salt." — April 2026, the daily set for ¥1,300.
"The thick-cut grilled beef tongue was tender and incredibly delicious." — May 2026, with Juyondai junmai daiginjo.
"My mother wanted to eat soba, so we went on Saturday around 12:30 PM." — August 2026, tempura, sushi and daily sets with zaru soba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 松吟庵 東三国店、居酒屋・牛タン・そば、大阪市淀川区東三国1-33-21、Midosuji 線 東三国駅4番出口から徒歩2分、月〜水11:00〜14:00、17:30〜23:00、木曜17:30〜23:00、金11:00〜14:00、17:30〜24:00、土11:00〜14:30、17:30〜23:00、日11:00〜15:00、17:30〜22:00、祝11:00〜22:30、売り切れまで、不定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、20席、2階にテーブル2つ、8名以上は個室、禁煙。口コミ(2025年3月〜2026年10月): 古民家を改装、ranma、「Ju-wari Soba」の看板、昼はJu-wari そばの定食 (冷たいか温かいか)、日替わり定食1,300円 (かやくごはん、だし巻き、ヒレカツのおろしポン酢)、肉じゃがの日替わり、天ぷらとざるそば、巻き寿司とさば寿司とざるそば、とり天、夜は厚切りの牛タン、だし巻き、カツオのたたき、チキン南蛮、焼きなす、ニシンの甘露煮、舞茸の天ぷら、豚せいろ、鱧、カキフライ、里芋の揚げ物、Oni Oroshi Bukkake Soba、生ガキのポン酢、Juyondai の純米大吟醸、そば茶、QR コードで注文、平日の昼は行列、値段が高く2階は狭いという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by QR code; a narrow lane makes it hard to find. No English evidence found.

places.name: HILLMAN
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The paper chicken is marinated in a sauce sent from Singapore (August 2026), and the chili crab, black-pepper prawns, laksa and mantou all use sauces or wheat; steamed chicken and stir-fried greens are where to start asking.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Singaporean and Chinese dishes of chicken, crab, prawns and pork; sambal kangkung (water spinach) is made with sambal, which is not described.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 16:30–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–14:30 and 16:30–23:00; last orders 14:00 and 22:30 (Tabelog). A weekend and holiday lunch course ¥2,200 (September 2026). Reservations; all-you-can-drink courses and discount deals (2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 100 seats, sofas, private rooms for 6–8, private hire for over 50; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). The entrance is on the back street Sen’nichi Jizoson-dori, not the office-building side (August 2026). Opened 6 October 2014 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Namba Sennichimae 15-16, オクバビル 2F, in Ura Namba — 2 min east of Nankai Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Singaporean and Chinese dishes, as at the original Hillman Restaurant in Singapore (2026 reviews) · the signature paper chicken, marinated and cooked in paper, ¥290 a piece; the paper and sauce are sent from the Singapore restaurant (August 2026) · chili crab with prawns or king crab, with fried and steamed mantou ¥130 to mop up the sauce; black-pepper prawns, half ¥1,900; seafood chili combo with blue crab (2026) · bak kut teh of spare ribs simmered with spices and pepper; laksa with chewy noodles; Hillman fried rice; mapo tofu; a hot pot for two (2026) · sambal kangkung (water spinach) half ¥900; steamed chicken with scallion sauce ¥750; cilantro salad, half ¥650; a four-kind appetizer plate over ¥1,200 (2026) · weekend lunch course ¥2,200 with salads, steamed chicken, greens, spring rolls, bak kut teh or laksa, paper chicken and almond jelly (September 2026) · all-you-can-drink courses
places.notes: [Singaporean · Ura Namba, Hillman's paper chicken in Osaka] The Osaka branch of Singapore's Hillman Restaurant, upstairs on an Ura Namba back street since 2014 (an older Kitashinchi branch has closed, a September 2026 diner notes). The dish to order is the paper chicken, marinated chicken cooked sealed in paper with paper and sauce sent from Singapore, one piece at a time for ¥290. Then chili crab with fried mantou to wipe up the sauce, black-pepper prawns, bak kut teh, laksa and sambal water spinach. The heat is gentler than some expect (October 2026). A roomy, stylish space for groups, with all-you-can-drink courses and a ¥2,200 weekend lunch course. Diners in 2026 were mostly pleased; one found the appetizer plate poor value. Find the entrance from Sen’nichi Jizoson-dori. Open evenings daily, plus weekend lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: the Osaka branch of Hillman Restaurant in Singapore, known there for paper chicken; the paper and the sauce for it are sent from the Singapore original (the manager, per an August 2026 diner); a former Kitashinchi branch has closed, leaving Namba and Singapore (September 2026). Opened 6 October 2014 (Tabelog). The official site carries little beyond the shop name and booking link.
chef_bio.specialty: Paper chicken; chili crab with mantou; bak kut teh.

anecdotes.text: "I also learned that the paper and sauce are sent from the original restaurant in Singapore." — August 2026, a second visit after first eating the paper chicken in Singapore seven years earlier.
"The mantou (fried bread) served with the chili crab was especially amazing!" — August 2026.
"The initial assortment of four appetizers was a bit disappointing for over JPY 1200." — September 2026, a diner who knew the old Kitashinchi branch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): HILLMAN、シンガポール料理・アジア・エスニック・中華料理、難波千日前15-16 オクバビル 2F、Nankai Namba 駅から東へ徒歩約2分、月〜金 16:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、土日祝 12:00〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)・16:30〜23:00、カード・電子マネー・QR可、100席、個室 (6・8名)、貸切50名以上、禁煙、子ども・ベビーカー可、テイクアウト、2014年10月6日オープン。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): シンガポールの本店のペーパーチキン、紙とソースは本店から送られてくる、1個290円、チリクラブと揚げ・蒸し饅頭130円、ブラックペッパーのエビ、バクテー、ラクサ、空芯菜のサンバル炒め、葱ソースの蒸し鶏750円、パクチーサラダ、土日祝のランチコース2,200円、飲み放題のコース、入口は Sen’nichi Jizōson-dōri 側、前菜の盛り合わせは割高という声、Kitashinchi にあった店は閉店。

cultural_comfort.note: Order à la carte or by course; groups welcome. No English evidence found.

places.name: Micasadeco&Cafe
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Every pancake, toast and pasta is wheat-based; omelette rice, keema curry and salads are where to start asking.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: ricotta pancakes, egg dishes and cream-topped seasonal pancakes; no vegan item is listed at this shop.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 (last order 16:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 09:00–18:00 (last order 17:00); closed 31 December–3 January (official site; Tabelog). Morning menu 09:00–11:00 at this shop only; pancakes and food from 11:00 (official site). Hours may change; check Instagram (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Order from your phone (July and October 2026); free Wi-Fi; separate bills possible (July 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 27 seats with sofas; non-smoking, ashtrays outside; children and strollers welcome; takeaway and delivery (Tabelog). Opened 16 September 2013 (Tabelog), the first shop of the brand (official site).
places.neighborhood: Saiwaicho 1-2-8, Minatomachi82bld 1F (Naniwa-ku), by Namba Hatch — 3 min from exit 26-B of JR Namba / Osaka-Namba / Namba (Yotsubashi Line)
places.cuisine: Pancakes and café food in a "Cool & Cute" room (official site) · the No. 1 ricotta cheese pancake, three fluffy layers made to order that wobble at the table, ¥1,750 (August–September 2026; about 20 minutes, August 2026) · coconut custard pancake; the chewy plain pancake, good cold and for takeaway (official site) · autumn 2026 specials: espresso pancake with cinnamon apple and nuts ¥2,400; pumpkin-pie chewy pancake ¥2,200; seasonal drinks ¥750–¥900 (official site) · food: pasta of Italian sausage and zucchini in lemon cream, mozzarella-tomato pasta, ricotta and smoked salmon salad, truffle omelette rice, spicy keema curry (official site); avocado ricotta toast ¥1,200, croque monsieur ¥1,500, croque madame, eggs Benedict with smoked salmon and avocado ¥1,500, a savoury plate with omelette (2026) · teas ¥600, hojicha latte, matcha latte (2026)
places.notes: [Café · Namba, the original ricotta "dancing pancake"] The first Micasadeco&Cafe, opened in 2013 beside Namba Hatch, where the brand's ricotta pancakes became known as "dancing pancakes" for the way the three tall, wobbly layers arrive at the table; the site says the ricotta pancake won three stars at the SARAH Japan Menu Award 2018 for Kansai pancakes. They are made to order (about 20 minutes), light and only lightly sweet, at ¥1,750; there are chewy plain pancakes, seasonal specials, brunch plates and pasta too, and a morning menu here from 9:00. The queues of the pancake boom have gone and you can usually walk in, order from your phone and stay a while. A 2026 regular and others note that nearly all the guests, and some staff, come from overseas, which the site says is the target. Open daytime only, closed over the New Year.

roles: Run by 株式会社インデペンデント (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: "Mi casa" is Spanish for "my home" and "Deco" stands for decoration; the first shop opened in Osaka Namba in 2013; the brand now has shops in Osaka (Namba and THE PARK in なノにわ), Tokyo (Jingumae) and Kyoto, and invites franchise enquiries; its theme is "Cool & Cute", aimed at overseas visitors and fashion-minded young people; the ricotta pancake, cooked one at a time after ordering, won three stars, the top rating, in the Kansai pancake section of the SARAH Japan Menu Award 2018 (second half). Opened 16 September 2013 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: A place to feel at home, away from everyday life: "delicious, cute, fun" (official site).

anecdotes.text: "When the staff brought them over, the pancakes were wobbling side to side, looking so soft and beautifully pale." — August 2026, a twenty-minute wait.
"A few years ago, when I visited, there was a huge line due to the pancake craze, and I had to wait every time. But now, it seems the trend has passed" — May 2026.
"Since it was just before 11 AM on a weekday, the restaurant was mostly filled with foreign customers." — September 2026, a seventh visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (micasadecoandcafe.com): MICASADECO & CAFE、“Mi casa” はスペイン語で“我が家”、“Deco” は“Decoration”、2013年に1号店の大阪難波店がオープン、テーマは“Cool & Cute”、外国人観光客や Z世代の若者がターゲット、大阪・東京 (神宮前)・京都に店舗、THE PARK (なノにわ) も、フランチャイズの募集、看板は注文後に1枚ずつ焼くふわふわリコッタパンケーキで「踊るパンケーキ」として話題に、SARAH JAPAN MENU AWARD 2018 下半期の関西エリアパンケーキ部門で星3、難波店限定で9:00〜11:00にモーニング、平日9:00〜17:00 (L.O.16:00)、週末9:00〜18:00 (L.O.17:00)、定休日12/31〜1/3、季節のパンケーキ (シナモン香るリンゴとナッツのエスプレッソパンケーキ2,400円、パンプキンパイ風もちもちパンケーキ2,200円)、ココナッツカスタードパンケーキ、もちもちのプレーンパンケーキ、パスタ、トリュフ香る大人のオムライス、キーマカレー。食べログ (店舗会員): パンケーキ・イタリアン・カフェ、浪速区幸町1-2-8 Minatomachi82bld 1F、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、27席、禁煙、テイクアウト・デリバリー、無料Wi-Fi、2013年9月16日オープン。口コミ(2026年3月〜10月): リコッタパンケーキ1,750円、約20分、スマホで注文、行列のブームは去って並ばずに入れる、客の多くは海外から。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site has an English page and the brand targets overseas visitors; order by smartphone (July and October 2026).

places.name: 佐海屋 (DINING STAGE Sakaiya Asahi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi, grilled fish and dashimaki are the plainest; the signature croquettes, large fried prawns, tempura, fried oysters and the ramen are wheat-based.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; the croquettes contain meat (nikujaga) or cream, and the set meals come with fish and miso soup.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed over the New Year (Tabelog). Reservations; two hours when busy (Tabelog). Dinner adds a ¥500 appetizer charge (choose two small dishes, October 2026) (Tabelog). Order by tablet; rice and miso soup refills at lunch (2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, iD, QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 80 seats: 12 at the counter, tables, and a horigotatsu room for 15–20; private hire up to 50; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nambanaka 1-10-4, 南海野村ビル B1F (Naniwa-ku), just southwest across the road from Takashimaya — 30 seconds from subway exit 6, 1 min from Nankai Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Seafood izakaya with lunch set meals (2026 reviews) · lunch: croquette set with a fist-sized nikujaga croquette and a seasonal croquette (e.g. spinach cream), large fried-prawn set, grilled mackerel set ¥1,440 with a croquette; the Sakaiya colourful one-plate ¥1,280–¥1,350 (choice of croquette or large fried prawn, with sides such as marinated tuna, dashimaki, salted mackerel, pickles, hijiki and miso soup); daily sets such as rare salmon cutlet, kara-age or tonkatsu (September–October 2026) · dinner: sashimi, large prawn tempura with tartar sauce, fried oysters, steamed clams, firefly squid marinated in soy, chicken-thigh tataki, dashimaki, croquettes, grilled fish, a ramen to finish; courses with all-you-can-drink (2026); a "mega" highball · sake and shochu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Namba, the relocated Sakaiya of croquette lunches] A basement seafood izakaya across the road from Takashimaya that many diners know as the old Sakaiya, a popular Namba lunch spot that closed and has reopened here as DINING STAGE Sakaiya Asahi ('the location and owner have moved and reopened', an October 2026 reviewer writes). The fist-sized croquettes are back: nikujaga or a seasonal cream croquette, on a set or a one-plate lunch with many small sides and free refills of rice. At night it is sashimi, big tempura prawns, fried oysters and chicken tataki, with all-you-can-drink courses. Returning regulars are split: some are delighted it survived, others find the lunch smaller and the grilled fish and rice weaker than before (October 2026). Open daily for lunch and dinner.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: the former "Sakaiya" in Namba (one diner says in Namba CITY) closed, and the shop reopened at this address as "DINING STAGE Sakaiya Asahi"; an October 2026 diner writes that "the location and owner have moved and reopened"; ordering moved to a tablet; the lunch menu was revamped in October 2026. Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; no opening date given. The listing says the kitchen is particular about fish, sake and shochu.
chef_bio.specialty: Croquette set meals; large fried prawns; seafood.

anecdotes.text: "It was a shame to see the popular 'Sakaiya' in Namba CITY close down, but I'm really glad that 'DINING STAGE Sakaiya Asahi' has taken over and is thriving under the same name!" — September 2026, croquette set.

"Astonishing! … It seems the location and owner have moved and reopened, which is an immense joy. However, has the lunch portion size decreased a bit?" — October 2026, large fried-prawn one-plate ¥1,350.
"I ordered a Mega Highball for the first toast, and I was surprised by its size—I couldn't finish it!" — October 2026, an 11th visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): DINING STAGE 佐海屋 (Sakaiya Asahi)、居酒屋・海鮮・天ぷら、浪速区難波中1-10-4 南海野村ビル B1F、Takashimaya の南西の道向かい、地下鉄6番出口から30秒、Nankai Namba 駅から徒歩1分、毎日11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O.料理21:00・ドリンク21:30)、年末年始休み、予約可、混雑時は2時間、夜はお通し500円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、80席 (カウンター12、テーブル、掘りごたつ15〜20名)、貸切50名まで、禁煙、無料Wi-Fi、魚・日本酒・焼酎にこだわり。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 以前の佐海屋が移転して再開、場所とオーナーが移って再開したという声、げんこつほどのコロッケ定食 (肉じゃがコロッケ、季節のクリームコロッケ)、大海老フライ、彩りワンプレート1,280〜1,350円、鯖の塩焼き定食1,440円、ご飯と味噌汁のおかわり、タブレットで注文、お通しは2品選べる、刺身、海老天、カキフライ、鶏ももたたき、締めのラーメン、メガハイボール、量が減った、魚やご飯が前より落ちたという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by tablet; a digital menu (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

places.name: 宮崎郷土料理 どぎゃん 本店 (Miyazaki Regional Cuisine Dogyan Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Charcoal-grilled chicken and chicken sashimi are the plainest; chicken nanban, kara-age, the ramen and the tare dishes are wheat- or soy-based.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Miyazaki chicken izakaya; the ramen broths are chicken and fish based (June 2026).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri lunch 11:30–14:00 and dinner 17:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); Sat 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Lunch is weekdays only; order before 12:00 for a free raw egg or small side (August 2026); rice, miso soup and salad refills (August 2026). Book by the day before, especially on Fridays; a reservation assumes at least ¥2,500 a head, and a no-show after 15 minutes may be cancelled; seat-only or drinks-only bookings carry a ¥350 charge, not on courses (Tabelog). Cards for bills of ¥3,500 (before tax) or more, not with all-you-can-drink or discounts; PayPay and LINE Pay (Tabelog). 38 seats including a raised tatami area for 14; smoking allowed (after 13:00 at lunch, June 2026); up two flights of stairs (October 2026). Order by QR code (2026). Opened 29 September 2008 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Bakuromachi 3-1-13, 戎センタービル 2F, east of Shinsaibashi-suji — 5 min from Shinsaibashi or Honmachi Stn
places.cuisine: Miyazaki chicken dishes and ramen (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews) · charcoal-grilled thigh of long-raised hens; chicken nanban with tartar (Kimura chicken, April 2026); chicken sashimi platter, to be eaten within 30 minutes; tataki; grilled skin, outside skirt, neck with cheese; meat-wrapped rice balls; spicy tofu steak (Tabelog; 2026) · ramen, five kinds (April 2026): the signature Takaida-style chuka soba, a rich soy sauce on chicken broth with thick noodles, tender chashu and soft menma, ¥900 with extra fat (April 2026); Tsubamesanjo backfat ramen ¥1,000, chicken-bone and niboshi soy broth with thick, flat, wavy whole-wheat noodles, chashu, aosa and onion (June 2026); cold tantan noodles with meat and sesame; kasu ramen (2026) · lunch sets from ¥950 (charcoal-grilled chicken, chicken nanban; August 2026), Miyazaki chicken nanban set ¥1,100 (October 2026), pork shabu yakiniku and kara-age set (September 2026) · courses with two-hour all-you-can-drink ¥5,500–¥6,000, with a mild option for the spicy grilled chicken (Tabelog; May and August 2026) · shochu such as Kuro Kirishima and Iichiko
places.notes: [Yakitori · Bakuromachi, Miyazaki chicken and a TV-famous ramen] Up two flights of stairs east of Shinsaibashi-suji, a casual Miyazaki izakaya open since 2008, with a counter, tables and a raised tatami area, where smoking is allowed. The draw is Miyazaki chicken: charcoal-grilled thigh of long-raised hens, chicken nanban under tartar sauce, fresh chicken sashimi and tataki. Yet many come for the ramen, five kinds, led by a Takaida-style chuka soba the shop calls its most popular dish (rich soy sauce on chicken broth, thick noodles) and a rare-in-Kansai Tsubamesanjo backfat ramen. Weekday lunch sets from ¥950 come with free refills of rice and miso soup. Diners in 2026 praise the chicken and the ramen; one found the lunch chicken nanban tough and pricey, another the floor greasy. Closed Sundays.

roles: Shop manager and staff (unnamed; the site carries a 店長ブログ)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (dogyan.jp): Miyazaki regional cuisine, charcoal yakitori and ramen at this main shop and a shop in 立売堀, Nishi-ku; the same group runs the noodle and kakigori shop 麺とかき氷 ドギャン 谷四店 (osaka_men_to_kakigori_dogyan_tanimachi in data). Per the Tabelog shop text: Miyazaki dishes such as charcoal-grilled thigh of long-raised hens, chicken nanban and meat-wrapped rice balls, plus the Takaida-style chuka soba, featured on TV several times and the most popular dish. Opened 29 September 2008 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled hen thigh; chicken nanban; Takaida-style chuka soba.

anecdotes.text: "After taking a sip of the broth, I was astonished. It completely surpassed the offerings of a certain well-known Takeda-style chain." — April 2026, Takaida chuka soba with extra fat ¥900.
"I debated between Takai-da style and Tsubamesanjo style, but opted for the rare Tsubamesanjo style in Kansai." — June 2026, weekday lunch.
"This chicken cutlet had a good texture but was quite tough." — October 2026, Miyazaki chicken nanban set ¥1,100.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (dogyan.jp): 炭火焼鳥・ラーメン 宮崎郷土料理どぎゃん、心斎橋・本町立売堀、本店は中央区博労町3-1-13、立売堀店は西区立売堀1-6-14、麺とかき氷 ドギャン 谷四店 (かき氷専門店)、店長ブログ。食べログ (店舗会員): 焼き鳥・ラーメン・居酒屋、博労町3-1-13 戎センタービル 2F、Shinsaibashi 駅・Honmachi 駅から徒歩5分、月〜金 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、土 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、日祝休み、予約は前日までに、1人2,500円以上で予約成立、席のみや飲み放題のみの予約はチャージ料350円 (税別)、カードは3,500円 (税別) 以上から、PayPay・LINE Pay可、38席 (小上がり14席)、喫煙可、2008年9月29日オープン、長期飼育の親鶏もも炭火焼き、名物チキン南蛮、肉巻きおにぎり、テレビで何度も紹介された一番人気の「Takaida Chuka Soba」、飲み放題つきの宮崎郷土料理コース5,500〜6,000円。口コミ(2026年4月〜10月): Tsubamesanjo 背脂ラーメン1,000円、Takaida Chuka Soba 背脂増し900円、ラーメンは5種類、冷やし担々麺、粕ラーメン、平日のランチ定食950円から、ご飯・味噌汁・サラダのおかわり、鶏刺し、鶏のたたき、チキン南蛮は固いという声、QR で注文、階段を2回上がる。

Smoking allowed; menus in English, Chinese and Korean, with photos (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Casual izakaya of creative dishes made with plenty of sea urchin, salmon roe and wagyu; highballs and chuhai from ¥180 (Tabelog) · signature "Amazing TKG" of egg rice with sea urchin, ikura and wagyu, and a chateaubriand "juicy explosion" grill (Tabelog) · all-you-can-drink plans: standard ¥1,290, premium ¥1,680 (Tabelog) · courses with all-you-can-drink: Manzoku ¥3,600 (7 dishes: three appetizers, choregi salad, truffle-salt fries with cheese, wagyu tataki under green onion, chateaubriand, Taiwanese mazesoba); Gold ¥3,980 (three appetizers, cheese mapo tofu, wagyu grilled with green onion, egg-yolk sukiyaki tsukune, spicy shredded-onion gyoza, chicken in porcini cream, Taiwanese mazesoba); Platinum and special courses too (October 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Umeda, Higashi-dori, cheap drinks till 2 am] A fifty-seat izakaya in the Higashi-dori shopping street area, opened in July 2026, built around very cheap drinking: highballs from ¥180 and all-you-can-drink plans that run up to nine hours (three on Fridays). The food mixes Chinese-style dishes and izakaya standards with luxury touches: cheese mapo tofu, spicy gyoza, wagyu tataki under a heap of green onion, a thick chateaubriand, an egg rice topped with sea urchin, salmon roe and wagyu, and a Taiwanese mazesoba to finish. Courses with drinks are ¥3,600–3,980, popular for groups on the tatami second floor. Smoking is allowed; open until 2 am.

roles: Kitchen staff (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a casual tavern opened in July 2026 for authentic dishes at affordable prices, with creative cuisine using sea urchin, salmon roe and wagyu; drinks from ¥180; all-you-can-drink of up to nine hours.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic dishes at affordable prices (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The highlight was the Chateaubriand, cooked to perfection with an explosion of juices. To finish off, we had a hearty Taiwanese Mazesoba!" — October 2026, the 7-dish course.
"The interior features tables for 2 to 4 guests on the first floor, while the second floor boasts spacious tatami seating" — October 2026.
"I initially thought it would be mostly casual dishes since it's a public tavern, but there were also luxurious options" — October 2026, the Gold course.

places.name: 伊江人酒場 (Ienchu Sakaba)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu includes soki soba (wheat noodles), mozuku tempura, beni-imo croquettes, curry and chicken nanban; Okinawan braises like rafute are usually cooked with soy sauce.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Okinawan pork, beef and seafood dishes; jimami (peanut) tofu, sea grapes and island shallots also appear.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–7:00 (last order 6:00); Sunday 16:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closing days not fixed; if there are no customers the shop may close at 18:00 (Tabelog). Seating charge ¥450 with a small appetizer, included in courses (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay (Tabelog). 15 seats: 5 at the counter, three tables, and a second-floor private tatami room for up to 15; smoking allowed; delivery available (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Doyama, a narrow alley just north of Higashi-dori (C棟) — 7 min from Umeda Stn
places.cuisine: Okinawan cooking with ingredients from the owner's home island of Ie: Ie beef and Agu pork (Tabelog) · rafute (braised pork belly), soki nitsuke, soki soba to finish, Ie beef tataki, grilled black wagyu (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews) · mozuku tempura, goya champuru, somen champuru, pork tamago, taco rice, beni-imo croquette, jimami tofu, sea grapes, island shallots with meat miso, curly fries, nakami soup, kunchama bacon, Spam and egg salad, chicken nanban and curry (2024–2026 reviews) · awamori from Ie, the main island, Miyako, Ishigaki, Kume, Hateruma and Yonaguni (July 2026); habu sake; Okinawan fruit liqueurs such as tankan umeshu; Orion draft (Tabelog; reviews) · course of 11 dishes with all-you-can-drink ¥3,850 (Tabelog); a self-service all-you-can-drink in the second-floor room for private parties (August 2026)
places.notes: [Okinawan · Umeda, Higashi-dori, an island izakaya open till morning] A small Okinawan izakaya in a narrow alley just north of Higashi-dori, run with ingredients from the owner's home island of Ie and open until 7 am. Diners call it one of the few places in Osaka for home-style Okinawan food: rafute and soki ribs, Ie-beef tataki, goya and somen champuru, mozuku tempura, jimami tofu, and soki soba to finish, washed down with Orion draft or awamori from half a dozen islands, plus a jar of habu sake. A ¥3,850 course includes all-you-can-drink, and the second-floor tatami room takes private parties of up to 15. The room is tight and tables are small; smoking is allowed. Sundays close at 23:00.

chef_bio.origin: The owner's hometown is Ie Island, Okinawa (Tabelog).
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): Okinawan cuisine with carefully selected ingredients from the owner's hometown, Ie Island; Ie beef and Agu pork; rafute, soki soba and Ie beef tataki; awamori and limited and seasonal sakes chosen by the owner; Okinawan fruit liqueurs; open until 7 am. A December 2024 diner: "one of the few places in Osaka where I can enjoy authentic Okinawan home-cooked dishes".
chef_bio.philosophy: A hidden izakaya where you can relax on Okinawan time (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "You can enjoy Awamori from various regions such as Ie Island, the main island, Miyako Island, Ishigaki Island, Kume Island, Hateruma Island, and Yonaguni Island!" — July 2026.
"I personally recommend the Soki Nitsuke over the Rafute! Also, be sure to try the Habu Sake—it's surprisingly good!" — June 2025.
"The tofu had a simple, delicious flavor reminiscent of sesame pudding!" — June 2026, the jimami tofu.

cultural_comfort.note: Small alley izakaya; book for Friday nights (2024–2026). No English evidence found.

places.cuisine: French cooking by a former hotel chef in a dim room inspired by a church attic; foie gras dishes and à la carte (Tabelog) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): Joruri course ¥6,380 (7 dishes, cold and warm appetizers, meat and fish); Joruri Premium ¥6,580 in a 20th-anniversary campaign (¥8,580 regular); Kauin Inari course with truffle and foie gras ¥9,900 · dishes in 2026 reviews: pumpkin soup, a five-item appetizer plate with quiche, octopus carpaccio, pan-seared sea bream in soup, sole meunière in cream sauce, pork-belly steak with mash, beef steak, a three-meat platter of beef, duck and pork, foie gras omelette, shrimp cream croquettes with remoulade, foie gras pizza, truffle cheese risotto, a foie gras rice bowl or hitsumabushi to finish · beer about ¥700 (October 2026); wine
places.notes: [French · Ohatsu Tenjin, a hidden attic bar] A twelve-seat wa-French bar up a half-flight of stairs by Ohatsu Tenjin's south gate, where you ring an intercom to be let in and find a dim room made to look like a church attic. A former hotel chef cooks French dishes with plenty of foie gras: in an omelette, on a pizza, over rice at the end of the course. The Joruri course runs to seven dishes for about ¥6,400 (with an extra dish at ¥6,580 during a 20th-anniversary campaign), and à la carte comes to about ¥8,000–9,000 a head with drinks. Regulars come for birthdays, with a message on the dessert plate. A sister of the Sonjuku bars, whose Ura-Namba chef one diner recognised at the counter.

chef_bio.origin: A sister of the 村塾 (Sonjuku) restaurants; a September 2026 diner recognised the chef from the Sonjuku in Ura-Namba (osaka_sonjuku_namba).
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a calm restaurant inspired by a church attic, with a bar-like feel for after-dinner drinks; foie gras and à la carte; "authentic French cuisine crafted by a former hotel chef"; message plates for anniversaries. A 20th-anniversary campaign in autumn 2026.

anecdotes.text: "To enter, you have to ring the bell to be let in. As soon as the door opened, I made eye contact with the chef at the counter, someone I had met a few times at the Sonjuku in Ura-Namba." — September 2026.
"We celebrate each other's birthdays here every year." — October 2026, a colleague's birthday.
"The foie gras omelet, croquettes, and the three types of meat were all spot on." — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Ring the intercom to enter; dishes are explained (2026). No English evidence found.

places.cuisine: Tonkatsu of brand pork: Chami pork, Sangen pork, TOKYOX and Shinshu Taro pork (Tabelog) · dinner: a daily-changing 11-dish course with a choice of Chami pork loin, Sangen pork tenderloin or other brands, from ¥3,300, or à la carte (Tabelog) · lunch: loin and tenderloin cutlet sets from ¥1,100, with Okayama Kinu Musume rice, miso soup, pickles and shredded cabbage (Tabelog) · cutlets fried slowly at low temperature, rosy inside, eaten with truffle salt or sauce (2026 reviews) · lunch: special chateaubriand pork cutlet set ¥2,640 (September 2026); 200 g tenderloin cutlet ¥2,620, black truffle and mushroom cream croquette +¥510 (October 2026); a 100 g tenderloin of the day (September 2026) · cabbage, vegetables with a homemade dressing, dessert and tea after the meal, detox water (2026) · wine
places.notes: [Tonkatsu · Kitashinchi, rosy brand-pork cutlets] An eleven-seat tonkatsu room on a Kitashinchi third floor, named to Tabelog's Tonkatsu 100 in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2026, where brand pork is fried slowly at a low temperature so the tenderloin and chateaubriand cutlets come out pink and juicy inside. Lunch sets start at ¥1,100 (a chateaubriand cutlet set was ¥2,640 in September 2026), with a truffle-and-mushroom cream croquette as an add-on; dinner is an 11-dish course from ¥3,300 with a choice of pork brand, or à la carte. Diners rave about the tenderness; the gripes are the wait (the frying takes time), charged rice refills and, for one, dry rice. Book lunch by phone; closed Sundays, and dinner only on weekdays.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): carefully selected brand-pork tonkatsu in a relaxed, refined room of 12 seats; a dinner course of different pork brands or à la carte; set meals at lunch from 11:00. Tabelog Tonkatsu 100 in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2026. A September 2026 diner describes it as "featured in the Michelin guide".
chef_bio.philosophy: Tender brand pork, carefully fried (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "…fry it slowly at a low temperature, it took a little time to arrive!" — September 2026, the 100 g tenderloin and truffle croquette.
"It's rare to find pork Chateaubriand, but the meat was so tender that it felt like it was beyond what you would expect from pork" — October 2026.
"I wanted to order a second serving of rice, but it seemed like it wasn't free, so I decided against it." — August 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Small room; lunch booked by phone, dinner online (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

places.name: MONDAY VIBES COFFEE
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Much of the menu is bread, croissants, French toast, pancakes, pasta and churros (Tabelog menu; reviews); the meat and fish dishes are not described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: no vegan options are described; the café dishes carry egg, bacon, ham, salmon, cheese or butter, and the bar menu is meat and fish (Tabelog menu).
places.hours_raw: Daily 7:00–21:00, as café and bar (Tabelog); closed 14:00–16:30 on 13 November 2026 for maintenance. Online booking for bar use and courses only; café guests walk in or call. Café use limited to 90 minutes, bar use to 2 hours. Bar use carries a ¥330 charge (Tabelog); an October 2026 diner paid ¥400 for the bar appetizer. Orders by QR code via LINE (October 2026). Cards (incl. UnionPay), transport IC and other e-money, PayPay. 41 seats; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi and power outlets (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Namba 4-1-2, 三信ビル 1F — 1 min from Namba Stn (Midosuji Line), Osaka-Namba (Kintetsu) and Nankai Namba
places.cuisine: All-day café and Italian bar: breakfast from 7 AM (butter-toast sets, eggs Benedict, smash-croissant open sandwiches, croque-monsieur and croque-madame, sausage-egg French toast, whipped-butter pancakes), then pasta, beef-tongue stew, roast duck in red wine, whole-fish acqua pazza, fish and chips, carpaccio, salumi and small plates at night (Tabelog menu, October 2026; reviews) · coffee, espresso, lattes, smoothies, frappés; beer, highballs, wine, cocktails; takeout and delivery
places.notes: [Café · Namba, café by day and Italian bar by night] A café and Italian bar a minute from Namba Station, opened January 2025 by the ten-shop 十忠八九 group, open from 7 AM to 9 PM every day. Mornings bring breakfast sets, eggs Benedict, smash-croissant open sandwiches and French toast; from midday it turns into an Italian bar with pasta, beef-tongue stew and acqua pazza. Diners in October 2026 praise the stylish wood-toned room, the brunch dishes and the bar food; one breakfast set came with lukewarm soup, cold bread and an undressed salad, and another diner found the restroom freezing. An early-opening stop for night-bus arrivals, with Wi-Fi and outlets; an October 2026 diner found it full of young people and visitors from abroad. Tabelog lists an English, Chinese and Korean menu.

roles: Shop staff unnamed; a shop of the 十忠八九 group (株式会社オーゼットカンパニー; lit.link)
chef_bio.background: The 十忠八九 group page (lit.link) lists ten shops in Osaka (Fukushima, Namba, Umeda) and Tokyo (Takadanobaba): tavern, sushi, yoshoku and café formats, MONDAY VIBES COFFEE among them. The group's stated concept is shops "a little better than just right": "more than an izakaya, less than a ryoriya; more than a café or bar, less than a restaurant". Tabelog gives the opening as 24 January 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Create a new standard for the casual dining scene" (group page).
chef_bio.specialty: All-day brunch and Italian bar food.

anecdotes.text: "The early morning hours are great for night bus travelers, and I was the first customer." — October 2026, whipped-butter pancakes.

"I was excited by how it looked, but unfortunately, the soup was lukewarm, the bread was cold and the butter wouldn’t melt, and the salad didn’t have any dressing on it." — October 2026, breakfast set.
"They were so delicious that I switched from the café to the bar, where I had beef stew and fish and chips, along with some champagne, which was delightful." — October 2026.
"It was filled with young people and international visitors." — October 2026.

places.notes: [Italian · Minamihorie, riverside terrace on the Dotonbori River] A big glass-walled restaurant and café at Canal Terrace Horie, opened July 2008 by Balnibarbi with Osaka City as the company's first waterside restaurant, and run under a permit to use the Dotonbori River waterside. Open from 9 AM to 11 PM: morning, a weekly lunch plate, café cakes, charcoal-grilled meat at night, and in summer a terrace beer garden with all-you-can-eat-and-drink, where small sightseeing boats pass by. Diners in 2026 enjoy the calm away from central Namba and the terrace breeze; a September 2026 repeat visitor found the beer-garden spare ribs now served off the bone and the food less careful than two years earlier. The room also hosts weddings and parties of up to 400 standing.

roles: Kitchen staff unnamed; a restaurant of 株式会社バルニバービ (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per Balnibarbi's securities report (text on edinetdb.jp), the company opened the restaurant & café ムーラン in Minamihorie, Nishi-ku, in July 2008 in partnership with Osaka City, starting its waterside restaurant development; the report describes it as a restaurant & café run under a permit to use the waterside of the Dotonbori River at Canal Terrace, with barbecue among its uses. The official site shows the © of BALNIBARBI Co.Ltd.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Enjoy dinner with the night view" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Riverside terrace; charcoal-grilled meat; summer beer garden.

anecdotes.text: "When I visited about two years ago, the spare ribs were juicy and delicious with the bone still attached, but this time they were served cut off the bone, which diminished the flavor." — September 2026, terrace buffet.
"Located by the river, this place has a unique atmosphere with small tourist boats passing by." — September 2026, beer garden.
"Although it's located in Namba, which is usually chaotic with tourists, this place is a bit away from the center, making it quite peaceful." — October 2026, café.

places.cuisine: Wine bistro of a wine importer: over 40 wines by the glass and over 100 labels, unfiltered unheated "nama" wine bottled at the company's own plant in Yamanashi, all-you-can-drink plans (official site; Tabelog) · the 40-year beef stew in red wine, blue-cheese ham cutlet, directly imported cheeses, escargots, Norwegian salmon marinade, assorted appetizers, monthly seasonal dishes rich in Italian vegetables (November 2026: crab and shungiku quiche, lamb and mussels in tomato, eel and beef spring rolls, cod milt ajillo, white-fish caldoso), pasta, desserts (official site; Tabelog menu, October 2026)
places.notes: [Wine bistro · Shinsaibashi, a wine importer's restaurant since 1983] A wine bistro two minutes from Shinsaibashi Station, run directly by a wine importer and open since 1983, with a bright, flower-decked ground floor and a darker second floor for fine wine and courses. Over 40 wines come by the glass, unfiltered wine is bottled for the house in Yamanashi, and bottles from the wine shop next door can be opened for a corkage fee. The beef stew, made the same way for 40 years, survives every change of the shop's name and look, and over 80% of tables order the blue-cheese ham cutlet. Diners in 2026 praise the cheese, the wine range and the prices; some found the blue cheese strong, the liver pâté dry, the chairs hard or a smell in the room.

roles: Chef unnamed, "trained at numerous restaurants" (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, 徳蔵 (とくぞう) is a long-established wine restaurant founded in 1983 and run directly by a wine importer; the company bottles wine at its own plant in Yamanashi and runs the wine shop next door, with about 2,000 wines. The beef stew has been made for 40 years and can use red wine freely "because this is a shop run directly by a wine trading company". Tabelog speaks of a predecessor, "Wainya", loved as an izakaya-style restaurant; a September 2026 regular notes that the name and look have changed several times.
chef_bio.philosophy: "We always want guests to taste many wines at reasonable prices" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Beef stew of 40 years; blue-cheese ham cutlet; wine by the glass.

anecdotes.text: "The name and appearance have changed several times, but it remains a classic." — September 2026, second visit.

"The biggest disappointment was the liver pâté. It lacked moisture" — October 2026, all-you-can-drink plan.
"The beef stew, sardine cutlet, pasta, and chocolate cake were all excellent, and the all-you-can-drink wine menu was impressive." — October 2026, retirement party.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ワインとチーズと旨い肴のBAR à VIN 徳蔵 とくぞう 心斎橋、ワインインポーターが経営する創業1983年の老舗レストラン、グラスワイン常時40種以上・常時100種類以上の銘柄、隣のワインショップから持ち込み料2,000円で持ち込み可 (約2,000種)、山梨県の自社工場でボトリングした無濾過・非加熱の生ワイン、1階は生花で彩る明るくカジュアルな空間、2階は高級ワインとコース料理のシックな空間 (TOKUZO FIFTYS)、数々のレストランで修行を積んだシェフ、40年の伝統の特製ビーフシチュー (ワイン商社直営だから赤ワインを惜しげもなく)、直輸入チーズ、11月の旬菜 (仔羊とムール貝のトマト煮込み、真鯛昆布締めと洋ナシのカルパッチョ、紅ズワイカニと春菊のキッシュ、うなぎと牛肉の春巻き、かきとベーコンのカツレツ、タラ白子のアヒージョ、鰆の味噌漬け)、ブルーチーズをはさんだハムカツ、エスカルゴ、ノルウェー産サーモンマリネ、当日キャンセルは全額の場合あり。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 1983年10月3日オープン、月〜木12:00〜22:00、金・土・祝前日12:00〜23:00、日・祝12:00〜21:00、47席、2時間制、前身は居酒屋風の「Wainya」、ハムカツの注文率8割以上。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月): ビーフシチューは名前が変わっても同じ味、チーズの質、グラスワインの種類、ブルーチーズが強い、レバーパテが乾いていた、椅子が硬い、店内のにおい、バーコードで注文、飲み放題。

Most 2026 diners rave about the appetizer platter; some found the portions one bite each, the pasta sauce heavy or the drinks pricey, and one was charged ¥400 for two small pieces of bread.

roles: Kitchen staff unnamed; a sommelier on staff (official site)

The Shinmachi page says the fish comes from Kyushu and Shikoku. Tabelog gives the opening as 2 May 2008.

places.cuisine: Tsukemen with homemade, aged, thick straight noodles; large size free (2024–2025) · three tsukemen: chicken paitan tsukemen ¥950, tangy and rich (January 2025); sweet-and-spicy tsukemen ¥980 with a choice of heat (December 2025); shrimp cream tsukemen ¥1,000, thick with shrimp aroma and a little fresh cream (August and September 2025) · two chashu, black-pepper chicken and grilled pork, half a seasoned egg, menma, mizuna (2022–2024) · cheese rice to finish in the dip ¥80 (2025) · chicken paitan ramen ¥850, dandan noodles ¥880 (August 2025) · evenings: about 20 kinds of gyoza, xiao long bao and Chinese dishes, a 90-minute all-you-can-eat of boiled dumplings (2024–2025)
places.notes: [Tsukemen · Higashi-Mikuni, thick noodles by day, dumplings by night] A small tsukemen shop near Higashi-Mikuni Station, one of the Ryusho group's shops (September 2025), whose homemade, aged, thick straight noodles have a slight green hue and a strong chew, large size free. Pick a dip: the tangy chicken paitan (¥950), a sweet-and-spicy one with the heat you choose (¥980), or the shrimp cream (¥1,000), thick with the aroma of fried shrimp; then hand the bowl back for cheese rice. At night it turns into a Chinese gyoza and dim sum place with Chinese staff and many Chinese customers (2024–2026), including a 90-minute all-you-can-eat of boiled dumplings. Closed Wednesdays; PayPay or cash.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff of the Ryusho group (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: tsukemen and ramen, opened 6 September 2020, reopened 12 March 2022. Per reviews: "a sister restaurant of" the Ryusho shop by Higashi-Yodogawa station (2022–2024); "One of the three pillars of the Ryusho Group, Tsukemen R&S, underwent a renovation during the pandemic … blending the traditional focus on tsukemen with a bar-style setting where you can enjoy gyoza and xiaolongbao" and Ryusho's traits are "No chemical additives or preservatives", a "Rich seafood and chicken white broth" and "Homemade, aged, high-hydration noodles" (September 2025); the dim sum is made by "a top-level dim sum chef" (January 2024); "staff members who are Chinese managing the restaurant" in the evening (May 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Shrimp cream tsukemen; thick homemade noodles.

anecdotes.text: "The original tsukemen, on the other hand, boasts straight, thick noodles that are smooth and chewy, with a slight green hue." — September 2025, shrimp cream tsukemen ¥1,000.
"The dipping sauce came in a cup similar to a coffee cup, and the handle was quite convenient." — December 2025, sweet-and-spicy tsukemen ¥980.
"It seems to focus more on Chinese cuisine than ramen, as most of the other customers were enjoying Chinese dishes." — May 2026, an evening visit.

places.name: らーめん キング (Ramen King)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles (thick whole-wheat noodles in the mazesoba); gyoza on the side.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood, chicken and crab broths, chashu.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu and holidays 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–01:00 (last order 00:30); Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–02:00 (last order 01:30); closed Wednesday for lack of staff; until sold out (Tabelog). Fills right after opening and is busy at 23:00 too (2025–2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), iD, PayPay and d Barai (Tabelog). 15 seats at a counter and tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Large noodles free (2025–2026). Opened 18 April 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 西中島3-6-10, 3 min from Hankyu Minamikata or Nishinakajima-Minamigata Stn (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Ramen of many kinds (Tabelog; reviews) · seafood shio ramen of iriko, kombu, katsuobushi, shijimi and hamaguri, topped with a large hamaguri (Tabelog) · tuna-bonito chuka soba with a seasoned egg ¥1,100, the most popular, "thick yet light" (March and April 2026) · chicken paitan ramen, foamed with a hand blender, ¥1,100 with egg (July and September 2026); spicy chicken paitan (June 2026) · Taiwan mazesoba of thick whole-wheat noodles with chives, chashu, seaweed, egg yolk and spicy mince, with rice to finish (Tabelog; August 2025); curry, salt and spicy versions; Taiwan curry mazesoba with rice ¥1,210 (July 2026) · seasonal bowls: Hanasaki crab miso ramen ¥1,180 (2025), chilled snow-crab tsukemen ¥1,320 (August–September 2026) · grilled or rare chashu; noodles from Maruyoshi Seimenjo; seafood powders, sansho and kombu vinegar on the table (2025–2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, a late-night counter with crab specials] A 15-seat ramen shop three minutes from Minamikata and Nishinakajima-Minamigata stations, open since 2013 and until 1 or 2 a.m., featured on an Asahi Broadcasting TV show (Tabelog). The list is long: a tuna-bonito chuka soba that regulars call the favourite (¥1,100 with egg), a seafood shio built on iriko, shijimi and hamaguri, a blender-foamed chicken paitan, and Taiwan mazesoba on thick whole-wheat noodles, plus seasonal crab bowls such as chilled snow-crab tsukemen (¥1,320, 2026). Noodles come from the group's own Maruyoshi noodle works, and large portions are free. Busy at lunch and after 23:00; closed Wednesdays.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff (unnamed); two young women on the floor in August and October 2025
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "Featured on Asahi Broadcasting's 'Matsumoto Family's Holiday'"; a seafood shio ramen "made with carefully selected iriko, kombu, katsuobushi, shijimi, and hamaguri"; Taiwan mazesoba; closed Wednesdays "due to staff shortages"; opened 18 April 2013; website maguromaruyoshi.jbplt.jp. Per reviews: "The noodles from Maruyoshi Seimenjo are perfectly balanced" (September 2026); "you can't go wrong with the noodles from the Maruyoshi Group" (April 2026); the chicken paitan "features a slightly espuma-style broth made with a hand blender" (July 2026); "The two young female staff members were energetic and provided excellent service" (August 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Tuna-bonito chuka soba; seasonal crab ramen; Taiwan mazesoba.

anecdotes.text: "I entered around 11 PM, and the place was packed with customers coming in continuously." — March 2026, tuna-bonito chuka soba ¥1,100.
"A thick layer of homemade crab oil floats on top, enhancing the crab aroma and keeping the heat in." — April 2025, crab miso ramen ¥1,180.
"They offer a fantastic service where you can get a large size (2 servings) for free." — September 2026, chilled snow-crab tsukemen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): らーめん キング、ラーメン・台湾まぜそば・餃子、大阪市淀川区西中島3-6-10、Hankyu Minamikata 駅と西中島南方駅から徒歩3分、月・火・木・祝11:00〜15:00、18:00〜翌1:00、金〜日11:00〜15:00、18:00〜翌2:00、水曜休み (人手不足のため)、売り切れまで、カード・iD・PayPay・d払い可、15席、禁煙、2013年4月18日オープン、Asahi Broadcasting の番組で紹介、いりこ、昆布、かつお節、しじみ、はまぐりの魚介の塩ラーメンに大きなはまぐり、台湾まぜそば。口コミ(2025年4月〜2026年9月): いちばん人気のマグロ節の中華そば味玉1,100円、ハンドブレンダーで泡立てる鶏白湯、辛い鶏白湯、台湾まぜそば (塩、辛、カレー)、台湾カレーまぜそば1,210円、季節の Hanasaki のカニの味噌ラーメン1,180円、ズワイガニの冷やしつけ麺1,320円、焼きかレアのチャーシュー、Maruyoshi の製麺所の麺、大盛り無料、深夜も混む、女性スタッフの接客。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; choose noodle size and chashu. No English evidence found.

places.name: 真水無香 (Shinsui Mukou)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Chinese dishes with soy and oyster sauces, noodles, dumplings, fried dishes and Shaoxing-wine marinades; nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Shanghai-style Chinese menu of pork, beef, chicken, seafood and crab; garlic water spinach and stir-fried eggplant are not described as made without meat stock.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:30; Sat 17:00–22:30; Sun and holidays 17:00–21:30; open all year; no lunch at weekends (Tabelog). Call ahead for parties of eight or more; drunken crab needs booking in advance, autumn only (Tabelog; November 2014 and 2025 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 46 seats at tables, areas screened by curtains, whole hire for 20–50; designated smoking area (Tabelog). Parking space out front if free, coin parking next door (March 2025).
places.neighborhood: 西中島4-8-4, ground floor of リッツ新大阪南, 3 min from the north exit of Nishinakajima-Minamigata or Hankyu Minamikata (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Shanghai-style Chinese (reviews) · lunch sets with salad, soup, pickles and rice that change daily (November 2025): Hainan chicken rice set ¥980 (August 2026); soupless dandan noodle set with fried rice and almond tofu ¥980 (July 2025, October 2026); yurinchi set ¥980 (May 2025); twice-cooked pork, stir-fried eggplant (2024–2025) · evenings: drunken crab (Shanghai crab in Shaoxing wine) in autumn, booked ahead (2014–2025); Shanghai-style beef and root-vegetable stew, garlic water spinach, sweet and sour pork, seafood crispy rice, xiao long bao, sesame balls, custard buns (March 2025); Sichuan vermicelli, spicy chicken (July 2025) · a ¥6,600 course with shark-fin soup and draft beer included in the drinks plan (October 2025)
places.notes: [Chinese · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, a calm Shanghai-style restaurant] A clean, quiet 46-seat Chinese restaurant three minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, serving Shanghai-style cooking that some customers order in Chinese (March 2025). Weekday lunch sets change daily, around ¥980 with salad, soup and pickles, from Hainan chicken rice to soupless dandan noodles with fried rice. In the evening the round tables fill with Shanghai-style beef and root-vegetable stew, garlic water spinach, xiao long bao and seafood crispy rice poured at the table, and in autumn one regular comes every year for the drunken Shanghai crab, which must be ordered in advance (2014–2025). Courses from ¥6,600. Friendly staff who remember faces (2022).

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: Chinese, ramen and izakaya, 46 table seats, open all year, no weekend lunch. Per reviews: "serves authentic Shanghai cuisine" (November 2021); "Unlike typical local Chinese restaurants, this place is kept very clean" (November 2024); "I noticed some customers ordering in Chinese, which suggests it's authentic Chinese cuisine" (March 2025); "The staff recalled my visits and remembered me" (November 2022); "the staff were very friendly, chatting with us a lot" (July 2025).

anecdotes.text: "My main goal was to try the 'Drunken Crab.' All the other dishes are delicious too." — November 2025, a visit made most autumns since 2014.
"Seafood Crispy Rice: [The staff] poured the sauce right in front of me with a sizzling sound." — March 2025.
"The photo is of the spicy chicken, which wasn't on the menu, but when I asked, [the staff] said it was available." — July 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 真水無香、中華料理・ラーメン・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島4-8-4 リッツ新大阪南 1F、Hankyu Minamikata 駅と西中島南方駅北口から徒歩3分、月〜金11:00〜14:00、17:00〜22:30、土17:00〜22:30、日・祝17:00〜21:30、年中無休、土日祝は昼の営業なし、8名以上は要連絡、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、テーブル46席、カーテンで仕切れる席、貸切20〜50名、分煙。口コミ(2014年〜2026年10月): 上海料理、日替わりのランチ定食 (サラダ、スープ、漬物、ごはん)、海南チキンライス980円、汁なし担々麺とチャーハンと杏仁豆腐980円、油淋鶏、回鍋肉、なすの炒め物、秋の酔っぱらい蟹 (要予約)、上海風の牛肉と根菜の煮込み、空心菜のにんにく炒め、酢豚、海鮮おこげ、小籠包、ごま団子、カスタードまん、6,600円のコース、店内はきれい、中国語で注文する客も。

cultural_comfort.note: Some customers order in Chinese (March 2025). No English evidence found.

places.name: 串焼たなかや (Kushiyaki Tanakaya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Skewers come with salt or sauce; fried items such as akaten, thick fried tofu and garlic toast are on the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken, beef and offal skewers and seafood.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 18:00–01:00 (last order 00:00); Sun and holidays 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Monday and the third Sunday of the month (shop site; Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised: only 12 seats, so phone before coming (shop site; 2024–2026). Cover charge ¥500 before tax (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 12 counter seats; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 30 November 2009 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 宮原2-4-8, 1 min from the west exit of JR Higashi-Yodogawa Stn, 4 min from exit 4 of Higashi-Mikuni (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Skewers of chicken, beef and seafood with daily side dishes (shop site; Tabelog) · big seseri (neck) skewers, salt; negima made with neck meat, sauce; tsukune; chicken thigh (February–August 2026) · special outside skirt skewers, beef harami, wagyu liver (2023–2026) · jidori tataki, chicken sashimi, raw omasum (2024) · scallop skewers, shrimp mayo, heart, gizzard, grilled corn (2024) · daily obanzai and small dishes; akaten (fried red fish cake); shredded cabbage with baby sardines as the starter (2023–2025) · thick fried tofu, garlic toast (June 2026) · about ¥3,000–5,000 a head (2025–2026)
places.notes: [Skewers · Higashi-Yodogawa, a 12-seat counter by the station] A twelve-seat skewer counter a minute from the west exit of JR Higashi-Yodogawa, open since 2009, where the owner chooses the ingredients first and then minds the cut, the skewering and the grill, at everyday prices (shop site). The skewers are big: a juicy seseri, a negima made with neck meat, tsukune, thick outside skirt and beef harami, plus daily small dishes, akaten and garlic toast. Regulars come back again and again for the friendly owner and the attentive woman who works the room (2024–2026). It fills fast, so phone first; open to 1 a.m.; ¥500 cover; smoking allowed.

roles: A woman who looks after the room (August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop site (kushiyaki-tanakaya.com, read 2026-11-02): 串焼き たなかや, a 12-seat counter izakaya near JR Higashi-Yodogawa and Higashi-Mikuni; "味も居心地も両方大事" (taste and comfort both matter) is the owner's care, so first-timers settle in easily; ingredients are chosen first, then the cut, the skewering and the grilling are attended to, at prices for everyday use; solo diners welcome; phone ahead because seats are few. Per the Tabelog listing: opened 30 November 2009. Per reviews: "The owner is incredibly friendly, and the hostess is smart and attentive" (August 2026); "the owner remembered me as soon as I walked in" after four or five years (March 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: "味も居心地も両方大事" (both taste and comfort matter; shop site).
chef_bio.specialty: Big seseri and negima skewers; outside skirt.

anecdotes.text: "You rarely come across such large chicken neck skewers. Because they are so big, they are incredibly juicy!! Plus, the meat in the negima … is also chicken neck!!" — August 2026.
"It's been about 4 or 5 years since I last visited. Yet, the owner remembered me as soon as I walked in." — March 2025.
"The counter seating fills up quickly, but if you're dining alone like I often do, you have a good chance of getting a seat." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 串焼き たなかや、JR東淀川駅・大阪メトロ東三国駅近くのカウンター12席の居酒屋、味も居心地も両方大事という店主の心くばり、まず食材を厳選し、切り方・串の刺し方・焼き方にこだわる、お手頃価格、1人飲みも歓迎、来店前に電話を、大阪市淀川区宮原2-4-8、火〜土18:00〜翌1:00 (L.O.0:00)、日・祝18:00〜翌0:00 (L.O.23:00)、月曜と第3日曜休み。食べログ (店舗会員): お通し代500円 (税別)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、カウンター12席、貸切20名まで、喫煙可、2009年11月30日オープン。口コミ(2023年〜2026年8月): 大きなせせり、ねぎまの肉もせせり、つくね、もも、特上ハラミ、牛ハラミ、和牛のレバー、地鶏のたたき、鶏刺し、生センマイ、ホタテ、エビマヨ、ハツ、砂ずり、焼きとうもろこし、日替わりのおばんざい、akaten、ちりめんのキャベツ、厚揚げ、ガーリックトースト、気さくな店主と気のきく女性スタッフ、予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: A small counter; phone ahead. No English evidence found.

places.name: 元祖 串しゃぶ専門店 まつたけ 堂山店 (Ganso Kushishabu Senmonten Matsutake Douyama ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The skewers include fresh wheat gluten (nama-fu), the dipping sauces include sesame sauce, and the finishing dishes are ramen, udon, mazesoba or rice porridge in the bonito-based broth.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the shabu-shabu broth is bonito-based dashi (operator site), and the skewers are mostly meat and seafood.
places.hours_raw: Tue–Sat, holidays and the day before a holiday 18:00–5:00 (last order 4:00); Sun 18:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); closed Mondays, or the Tuesday after when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog; the operator site gives 18:00–5:00). Reservations accepted; couples may be moved to the counter if a group books (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). 15 seats: a counter of 8 and tables for 7; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 4 April 2019 (Tabelog). The entrance is down a narrow passage (July 2026).
places.neighborhood: 堂山町17-3, ground floor of イーグルビル — 5 min from Hankyu Osaka-Umeda, Umeda (Midosuji Line) and JR Osaka Stns
places.cuisine: "Kushi-shabu": shabu-shabu served on skewers that you dip yourself in a light house broth, so no chopsticks go into the shared pot, each skewer with its own suggested dip (operator site; December 2025) · ingredients: Inobuta pork "Blessing of Eve" from Susami, Wakayama, Omi beef, Galician chestnut pork, seafood and vegetables from Mie (operator site) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): "Ume" of ten skewers and a finishing dish (mazesoba, udon or rice porridge) ¥3,300; "Take" with sashimi from the Osaka central market ¥4,400; "Matsu" with five kinds of sashimi, twelve skewers, salad and a daily dish ¥5,500 · skewers named in reviews: pork rolls, nama-fu, shrimp, onion, beef tongue with salt and sesame, wagyu rolls with sesame sauce, quail and lettuce, asparagus, scallops, yellowtail, "Negi Bakudan" green-onion bombs; clams in the broth +¥500; sesame-pepper dip (2025–2026) · finishing ramen, udon or zosui (2025–2026) · about ten seasonal sakes from around Japan, changed twice a month (operator site)
places.notes: [Shabu-shabu · Doyama, on skewers until 5:00] The second shop of the Kitashinchi kushi-shabu specialist, a small wooden room in Doyama open until 5:00 most nights, where shabu-shabu comes on skewers you swish yourself in a light bonito broth, so nobody's chopsticks go into the shared pot. Start with a clam in the broth, then work through Wakayama Inobuta pork, Omi beef, beef tongue with salt and sesame, quail and lettuce and the cult 'Negi Bakudan' green-onion bomb, each with its suggested dip; finish with ramen, udon or a rice porridge in the broth. Courses run ¥3,300–5,500 (the ¥3,300 one is the trial), or order skewers one by one. Fifteen seats, so book; smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the operator site three-six.jp: "元祖串しゃぶ専門店 まつたけ" offers shabu-shabu in a new skewer style, with Inobuta pork from Susami, Omi beef and local ingredients; shops are the Kitashinchi main shop (曽根崎新地1-9-8, 17:00–5:00), this Doyama shop and a third, 北新地別邸 (曽根崎新地1-2-23). The shop-maintained Tabelog listing calls Doyama the second shop of the Kitashinchi original; opened 4 April 2019.

anecdotes.text: "The Negi Bakudan (green onion bomb) is especially addictive—I can't help but eat several!" — June 2025.
"I appreciated that we could comfortably gather around the hot pot without using direct chopsticks." — December 2025.
"I often visit this place in Shinchi because it's open until the early morning, but this was my first time at this location!" — June 2025.

places.cuisine: Tonkatsu reworked as "butakatsu", the menu's own word: pork in a jet-black crumb ground from the shop's own 100% brown-rice squid-ink bread, gluten-free, cooked slowly in lard so the meat stays faintly pink, eaten with salt; fillet, loin and "toro" cuts (operator site) · course: a seasonal starter assortment (soft-cooked egg, sea grapes, seasonal seafood and vegetables), the black cutlets, then a squid-ink risotto or flat-grilled brown-rice fried rice; the menu changes daily; à la carte also welcome (operator site) · named courses with gut health and gluten-free themes: a "toro katsu" course ¥5,500, an ¥8,800 course (September 2026) · fruit tomato in a thin crisp coat as a salad, house smoking (fillet, loin and shoulder smoked in front of you), goya sashimi with bonito flakes and junmai soy sauce, brown-rice salt-koji soup, six small bean dishes, yam with aosa seaweed, fried yuba with shiso and cheese, omelette with pancetta, fried sweetfish (June–October 2026) · Tabelog Tonkatsu 100 in 2018, 2019, 2021, 2024 and 2026 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Tonkatsu · Ohatsu Tenjin, a black gluten-free cutlet] An eight-seat counter in the back lane behind Tsuyu Tenjin shrine, run by its owner alone and on Tabelog's Tonkatsu 100 list five times since 2018. Its signature is a jet-black cutlet: pork in a crumb ground from the shop's own brown-rice and squid-ink bread, gluten-free by the shop's account, cooked gently in lard until faintly pink and eaten with three salts. The meal starts with small seasonal dishes and ends with a squid-ink risotto or a brown-rice fried rice; a fruit tomato fried in a thin crisp coat is the other famous dish. Booking by phone (9:00–17:00) is expected. The menu shows no prices; diners in 2026 paid about ¥6,000–15,000, with a ¥1,100 seat charge that brings starters. Expect a quiet, unhurried pace.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: "「とんかつ」ではなく、豚を活かす" (not tonkatsu but making the most of pork); an 8-seat counter hideaway behind Ohatsu Tenjin; the owner runs the shop alone, so bookings are asked for. The shop-maintained Tabelog listing lists Tabelog Tonkatsu 100 in 2018, 2019, 2021, 2024 and 2026. Reviews describe a quiet chef (August 2026); a regular on a twelfth visit in October 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: "「とんかつ」ではなく、豚を活かす。" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Black brown-rice squid-ink cutlet; fruit-tomato katsu.

anecdotes.text: "Just keep in mind that since it's run by a single person, it may take a bit of time to be served." — April 2025, a tenth visit.

places.cuisine: Creative Chinese by an owner who trained ten years in hotels and at a well-known Chinese restaurant, with touches of the owner's native Hokkaido (Tabelog) · the signature "Gokawa Mapo Tofu", named to go beyond Sichuan: chunks of wagyu with tripe and tendon instead of mince, heavy with Sichuan pepper (Tabelog; September–October 2026) · dinner: a six-starter platter ¥2,000; the "classic light course" ¥7,500; a course choosing three of seven signature dishes ¥8,800 (Tabelog, tax included) · sashimi-style Chinese salad that looks like sushi, sweet and sour pork filled with several cheeses and plated as the solar system, Italian-style shrimp mayo in pistachio sauce, French-style chili shrimp, scallop ajillo, sweet potato and cheese spring rolls, beef with green peppers, dan dan noodles, potato salad with XO sauce (2026) · weekday lunch: Gokawa mapo tofu set with Koshihikari rice (refills free), crab and potato salad, Kitami onion soup ¥1,500; a ¥1,200 daily set (September–October 2026) · wine and cocktails, a reminder of the shop's bar days (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Chinese · Kitashinchi, creative Chinese and 'Gokawa' mapo tofu] A 16-seat creative Chinese restaurant by Kitashinchi station, running since 2004 under a sign that names its mapo tofu in letters bigger than its own. The 'Gokawa' mapo, meant to outdo Sichuan, uses chunks of wagyu, tripe and tendon and a lot of numbing pepper. Around it the Hokkaido-born owner plays: a Chinese salad dressed like sushi, sweet and sour pork stuffed with cheese and plated as the solar system, shrimp mayo in pistachio sauce. Dinner courses ¥7,500–8,800, or à la carte with a ¥500 seat charge; since 2026 a weekday lunch of the mapo with free rice refills for ¥1,500. Mind the spice, and skip strong perfume.

places.notes: [Oden · Kitashinchi, a Kyoto-style oden course] An oden house in Kitashinchi with a counter round the oden pot downstairs and five quiet private rooms upstairs, popular for business dinners and family meals. Courses include tax and service; à la carte adds ¥550 service and a ¥550 starter. Open to midnight, closed Sundays; completely non-smoking.

places.notes: [Soba · Kitahorie, black-bean soba and fish] A calm soba shop by Yotsubashi Station whose noodles carry the aroma of Tanba black beans. Order the black-bean zaru soba (100% buckwheat for +¥300) and the soba pudding. Lunch fills fast and cannot be booked, so come at 11:00; book for dinner.

places.notes: [Sake bar · Shinsaibashi, 100+ sakes and eel] A lively, mostly standing sake bar tucked behind the Shinsaibashi-suji arcade, open from noon every day, with over 100 sakes you pick yourself from the fridge in 90 cc pours. Eat the "U-maki" eel omelette, uzaku and some sashimi, or come at lunch for unaju at about ¥3,000. Hard to find: walk down the alley behind the vending machines beside Ichiran and turn left. Book on weekend nights; expect ¥3,000–5,000 a head in 2026.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 24 April 2015; over 100 sakes always in stock; signature "U-maki", newer unaju. A July 2026 reviewer writes that the sakes are selected by the owner (owner not named).

anecdotes.text: "There were really a lot of foreign visitors here [around Shinsaibashi] ... It's nice that a place focused on local sake has fewer inbound visitors, making it a relaxing spot." — June 2026, at 3 PM on a rainy day.
"At first, I tried to navigate there but got lost and wandered around for a bit before finally finding it!" — September 2026.

places.notes: [Kushikatsu · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, skewers in dashi and kamameshi] A calm kushikatsu restaurant where the skewers are dipped in a thick dashi instead of the usual sauce, and the meal ends with kamameshi cooked in an iron pot. places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list ticks "gluten-free options", and an April 2026 diner had a gluten-free cake set; the onigiri are rice, nori and salt, but many fillings are seasoned (soy-marinated egg yolk, mayonnaise mixes) and the side somen is wheat. Ask which fillings suit.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list ticks "vegan options" and "vegetarian options", and there are plain fillings such as sesame kombu and honey plum (2026), but nothing is labelled vegan; the miso soup is a clam broth (November 2025) and the meat soup is meat.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri and Sat 8:00–20:00; Sun 9:00–15:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations through the shop's LINE account until the day before; same-day by phone first, though the phone may go unanswered when staff are busy (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 14 seats plus a terrace where pets may sit; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; free Wi-Fi; takeaway and delivery (Tabelog). Order at the counter; staff bring the food (February 2026). Opened 11 January 2024 (Tabelog).
