places.cuisine: Made-to-order onigiri (Tabelog) · two sizes, omusubi 150 g and komusubi 100 g, ¥100 less (2026); 34 fillings (April 2026), packed inside as well as on top; Shiga Koshihikari rice, Ariake nori and Okinawa salt (April 2026); multigrain rice possible (April 2026) · fillings named in 2026: salmon, sujiko, salmon mayonnaise, minced meat with soy-marinated egg yolk, spicy cod roe with takana, shrimp mayo with cream cheese and shiso, salmon with salmon roe, tuna kakuni, salted cod with cream cheese, green-onion salmon roe, sesame kombu ¥330, honey plum, negi sake toro ¥480 (May 2026) · miso-soup set with clam miso soup, dashimaki and takuan (November 2025, February 2026); meat soup (January and April 2026); somen ¥330 (May 2026) · dashi chazuke, hot or cold, +¥150 (July 2026) · a gluten-free cake set (April 2026) · breakfast from 8:00; alcohol served (May 2026)
places.notes: [Onigiri · Higashimikuni, rice balls made to order from 8 am] A small onigiri shop in the shopping street by Higashiyodogawa Station, opened in January 2024 by an owner who trained at a popular onigiri shop in Otsuka, Tokyo (Tabelog). Each rice ball is shaped after you order, loose and fluffy with the filling packed right through, in two sizes (150 g or 100 g) and with 34 fillings from salmon and sujiko to minced meat with soy-cured yolk or shrimp mayo with cream cheese (2026). Add a set of clam miso soup, dashimaki and takuan, or the meat soup, or have the onigiri drowned in dashi as chazuke. Open from 8:00 for breakfast; Tabelog marks gluten-free and vegan options, so ask. The owner is warm (May 2026). Book by LINE the day before. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: "The owner, who trained at a popular restaurant in Otsuka, Tokyo, opened this place in January 2024"; freshly made rice balls after ordering; mostly domestic, additive-free, handmade ingredients; fillings packed from first bite to last. An April 2026 diner lists Shiga Koshihikari rice, first-grade Ariake nori and Okinawa salt. A May 2026 diner praises "the warm hospitality from the owner".
chef_bio.specialty: Made-to-order onigiri with 34 fillings; miso-soup set.

anecdotes.text: "The fillings were not only on top but generously packed inside as well, providing satisfaction until the very last bite." — February 2026, salmon and sujiko with the miso-soup set.
"For an additional JPY 150, you can have either hot or cold dashi poured over your omusubi." — July 2026, sesame kombu for JPY 330.
"The cake set is a delightful gluten-free treat." — April 2026.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade wheat noodles; the shoyu tare is soy.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken and bonito broth, shrimp in the Awai soba, pork chashu.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Thu, Sat and Sun 11:00–16:00; closed Friday, plus temporary closures announced on the shop's social media (Tabelog). No reservations; no cards; transport IC cards and PayPay accepted (Tabelog); buy a ticket at the machine by the door (October 2026). 7 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Full at lunch, often with a short wait (2026). Opened 12 November 2019 (Tabelog); closed for about three years and reopened on 29 May 2026 (June and October 2026 reviews).

places.cuisine: Dashi soba and chuka soba with homemade noodles (2026) · menu, October 2026: Dashi Soba ¥690 (extra noodles +¥150); Awai Soba ¥770 (+¥170); egg-topped noodles ¥380; toppings: premium +¥150, special premium +¥250, special assortment +¥350, seasoned egg +¥100, chashu +¥250 · Dashi Soba: a frothy, creamy "espuma" broth of chicken and honkarebushi bonito with two shoyu from Hozan (Aichi), a little chicken fat and roasted garlic, homemade noodles (1.5 servings), a large slice of smoked chashu, green onion and chopped onion, yuzu kosho on the side (2026) · Awai Soba: shrimp and white tamari, richer and a touch salty (July 2026) · limited bowls: shio (October 2026), tonkotsu about ¥880 (October 2026) · seasoned-egg roast-pork rice bowl with basil sauce (June and October 2026); mini chashu rice bowl (October 2026) · smoked seasoned egg (June and October 2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima, ¥690 espuma dashi soba] A seven-seat counter in a residential block west of Nishinakajima-Minamigata, opened in 2019 by an owner who trained at the popular Chuka Soba Kuzu, closed for about three years at the height of its fame and reopened on 29 May 2026 to lines (June and October 2026). The Dashi Soba is the bowl: a frothy, creamy chicken and bonito broth with two Hozan soy sauces, homemade noodles in a 1.5-serving portion, smoked chashu and chopped onion at the bottom, for ¥690 at a time when ramen costs ¥1,000 (2026). The Awai Soba adds shrimp and white tamari, and a smoked seasoned egg is ¥100 well spent. Buy a ticket at the door; lunch only, 11:00–16:00, closed Friday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), trained at Chuka Soba Kuzu
chef_bio.background: Per a June 2026 review: "The owner trained at the very popular shop 'Chuka Soba Kuzu' before opening this place. It temporarily closed about three years ago during its peak popularity, but it reopened on May 29th." An October 2026 review gives the broth as chicken and honkarebushi with two soy sauces from Hozan (Aichi) and the noodles as homemade, additive-free. Opened 12 November 2019 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Dashi Soba; Awai Soba; smoked seasoned egg.

anecdotes.text: "Seven years ago, the price was JPY 650, but even after reopening, you can still enjoy this great bowl for JPY 690!" — October 2026, the Dashi Soba.

"It was great to reunite with the bubbly espuma Dashi Soba!" — October 2026, just before 2 pm, the shop still packed.

places.cuisine: Beer stand: draft Pilsner Urquell poured by a certified tapster in several styles, among them the foam-heavy "Mirko", plus rotating draft beers, craft gin and fermented ginger ale (Tabelog; 2024–2026) · Pilsner Urquell large ¥1,300 (August 2026) · signature "popper": a fried pepper stuffed with jalapeño, cheese and bacon, one per person; "Tacopy", taco mince on fresh pepper (Tabelog; January and August 2026) · smoked dishes: smoked mackerel, smoked fish cake (December 2025, April 2026) · schnitzel, canola-flower ohitashi, hayashi without rice (December 2025); fresh fish with green onion, fried new potatoes, yaki udon (April 2026); five-sausage platter ¥680 (August 2026); grilled tomato and shirasu garlic bruschetta, chashu egg (August 2026); fresh figs with cream cheese (August 2026) · Masahiro Okinawa gin (August 2026)
places.notes: [Beer bar · Higashimikuni, Pilsner Urquell from a certified tapster] A 16-seat beer stand two minutes from Higashimikuni Station, opened in 2023 around draft Pilsner Urquell poured properly by its owner, Daisuke, a certified tapster (December 2025), who told one diner that the pour was learned from the Czech Pavilion staff at the 2025 Expo (August 2026); Expo fans come back for it, and the foam-heavy "Mirko" has its regulars. Busy and small, so phone ahead. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Owner and certified Pilsner Urquell tapster

An August 2026 diner was told by the owner that the staff of the Czech Pavilion had taught the pour.
chef_bio.specialty: Pilsner Urquell poured several ways; popper; smoked dishes.

anecdotes.text: "It truly tasted just like the beer from the expo! I was so moved!" — August 2026, Pilsner Urquell large for JPY 1,300.
"The more you grow up, the more you start to love green peppers, and you absolutely have to try their specialties, 'Hopper' and 'Takopi!'" — January 2026, drinks and food for JPY 2,780.

places.name: 食堂 松おか (Shokudo Matsuoka)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The oden dashi of kombu, bonito and chicken is finished with white soy sauce (Tabelog), and soy sauces usually contain wheat; the fried horse mackerel, tempura, shumai and the whole-wheat ramen are wheat-based. Sashimi is the place to start asking.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and oden izakaya; the oden dashi uses bonito and chicken (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–22:00; closed when Shinsaibashi PARCO closes (Tabelog). The official site lists lunch 12:00–15:00 and dinner 17:00–22:00, irregular closures. The ramen is a weekday-lunch dish (Tabelog; October 2026). Reservations online; groups of 12 or more by phone; a booking may be cancelled 15 minutes after the time if the shop cannot reach you (Tabelog). Courses: Tabelog says courses are currently not available, while a July 2026 regular booked the omakase course through Tabelog. Order by smartphone or QR code (March 2025; October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, iD, QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 25 seats with a counter; non-smoking, smoking area on the same floor; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog; seat count also on the official site). Opened 18 March 2021 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashisuji 1-8-3, 心斎橋PARCO北館 B2F — 1 min from the south gate of Shinsaibashi Stn (Midosuji Line)
places.cuisine: Oden, sashimi and Japanese plates (official site; Tabelog) · oden in a dashi of kombu and bonito layered with chicken and finished Kyoto-style with white soy sauce, about 25 kinds from ¥240 each (Tabelog); chef-chosen five-piece oden ¥1,280 (¥1,408 with tax, official site); beef tendon, maitake and tomato oden (September 2026) · fish delivered daily and aged to suit; sashimi platter from one portion ¥1,680 (¥1,848, official site); straw-grilled bonito tataki (2025–2026) · fried horse mackerel with bettara-pickle tartar, two pieces; soft-boiled egg with fuki miso sauce; steamed shumai, often the appetizer, ¥330 for two (2026) · Amakusa Kuroge wagyu steak ¥2,200 (¥2,420); oden-dashi udon ¥650 (¥715) (official site) · Kujo negi and hon-maguro ramen in an oden-style dashi with whole-wheat noodles and yuzu, ¥1,200 at weekday lunch (October 2026; the official site lists ¥1,800, ¥1,980 with tax) · an omakase course of small plates, sashimi, oden and tempura (July 2026) · sake and shochu (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shinsaibashi PARCO, a Bib Gourmand oden and fish izakaya] A calm counter izakaya in the B2F food street of Shinsaibashi PARCO, run by the sio group and known until 2026 as The New World (a regular reports the rename in July 2026); one regular notes Bib Gourmand listings in the Michelin Guide Kyoto-Osaka. The draws are oden in a deep kombu, bonito and chicken dashi, aged sashimi and straw-grilled bonito, crisp fried horse mackerel with pickle tartar and a soft-boiled egg in fuki-miso sauce. Weekday lunch brings a light Japanese-style ramen of Kujo negi and bluefin tuna. Diners in 2026 call the food carefully made and fairly priced for the location; one found the QR ordering confusing. Open daily, following PARCO's closing days.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an "authentic diner operated by the Sio Group", opened 18 March 2021; the former name was The New World (ザ・ニューワールド). Per a regular of 19 visits: still The New World in January 2026, "completely revamped and is now called Shokudo Matsuoka" by July 2026; the same diner congratulated it on a Bib Gourmand in the Michelin Guide Kyoto-Osaka 2023 (October 2022) and wrote in March 2025 that it had been a Bib Gourmand two years running. Per the official site: oden in an ultimate dashi and sashimi, seasonal ingredients and the plates of craftsmen, with drinks from around Japan.
chef_bio.philosophy: Casual Japanese food: oden in an ultimate dashi and sashimi, with seasonal ingredients and drinks from around Japan, in a calm room (official site).

anecdotes.text: "The izakaya 'The New World' located on the basement level of Shinsaibashi PARCO has been completely revamped and is now called 'Shokudo Matsuoka.'" — July 2026, a 19th visit, the omakase course.
"It's worth going just to try this soft-boiled egg." — June 2026, with fuki miso sauce.

"I initially thought this place would be an expensive Japanese restaurant based on its atmosphere … However, when I passed by the restaurant, I discovered they offer a reasonably priced weekday ramen special." — October 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The signature sara udon and champon, the ramen, gyoza, kara-age and the set-meal shrimp tempura are wheat-based; the thick sauces and the fried rice are not described.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a local Chinese restaurant of seafood noodles, pork, chicken and egg fried rice.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–21:30; Sat 11:00–15:00; closed Sundays (Tabelog). Daily set meals until 14:00 (September 2026); weekday lunch queues of office workers, and a bar-like crowd in the evening (2026 reviews). No reservations. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 38 seats, tables only, shared when busy (September–October 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog); a September 2026 diner found it mostly smoke-free just after lunch.
places.neighborhood: Senba Chuo 4-1, 船場センタービル10号館 B1F, at the end of the basement food street — directly connected to Honmachi Stn
places.cuisine: Local Chinese (machi-chuka) classics: noodles, set meals and izakaya dishes at night (2026 reviews) · the two signatures, sara udon of crisp thin fried noodles under a thick sauce of vegetables and seafood ¥900, and champon with vegetables, shrimp, clams and kamaboko (October 2026) · fried rice, sweet, moist and eggy, as a small add-on ¥350, a half in sets, or upsized ¥600 (2025–2026) · champon set with half fried rice and macaroni salad ¥1,180 (October 2026); sara udon with half fried rice ¥1,200 (August 2025) · daily set of ramen, half fried rice, kara-age and mini salad ¥950 (July 2026); kara-age set ¥980 with shrimp tempura, macaroni salad, soup and takana (September 2026) · yakisoba ¥900; Chinese-style katsudon ¥700 (2025); miso ramen; gyoza; sweet and sour pork; liver and garlic chives (2026)
places.notes: [Chinese · Senba, Showa-style sara udon and fried rice] A long-running local Chinese restaurant at the end of the basement food street of Senba Center Building No. 10, straight off Honmachi Station, where weekday lunch brings queues of office workers and evenings fill with colleagues over beer. Order the sara udon, crisp noodles buried in a thick vegetable and seafood sauce (add mustard, then vinegar), or the champon, with a side of sweet, moist fried rice; set meals are big. Cash only, tables shared and smoking allowed. Diners in 2026 love the fried rice, sara udon and the warm service; others found the kara-age and sweet and sour pork tough and a gyoza order slow. Closed Sundays; Saturday lunch only.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a long-established local Chinese restaurant in Senba Center Building No. 10, directly connected to Honmachi Station; a staff member who appeared to be the owner was friendly and apologised for a slow gyoza order with a few extra gyoza (August 2026). Tabelog gives no opening date; the listing is not shop-maintained.

anecdotes.text: "During lunchtime, it gets so crowded with salarymen that you could almost play a rugby match in there!" — August 2025, sara udon with half fried rice ¥1,200.
"I added some mustard for a flavor change. Then, after eating about half, I drizzled some vinegar on it for another flavor twist." — October 2026, sara udon.
"The two signature dishes here are Sara Udon and Champon." — October 2026, around 1 PM.

places.name: 喫茶ビクトリヤ (Kissa Victorya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sandwiches, toast, Napolitan, scones and the Dojima roll are wheat-based; the thick omelette is seasoned with dashi (October 2026). Drinks, pudding and the matcha affogato are the places to ask.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg sandwiches, hamburg steak, cream cakes and ice-cream desserts; the omelette has dashi (October 2026).
places.hours_raw: Daily 09:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed on the third Thursday of odd-numbered months, when the mall closes (Tabelog). Breakfast sets in the morning (2025–2026); a lunch-time price for the thick omelette sandwich (October 2026). Reservations; private hire for over 50 (Tabelog). Order by QR code or smartphone; separate bills (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 60 seats with sofas; non-smoking; children welcome; English menu (Tabelog); Wi-Fi and power outlets (October 2026). Dojima rolls to take away (January 2025).
places.neighborhood: Namba 5-chome, NAMBA なんなん No. 1 (underground mall) — by the Midosuji Line Namba gates and Nankai Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Kissa menu since 1957: coffee-shop food, sweets and drinks (Tabelog; September 2026) · the thick omelette sandwich of four eggs, 3–4 cm tall, with mustard mayonnaise and ketchup, ¥1,250, ¥1,100 at lunch (October 2026; another October 2026 diner paid ¥1,200) · Napolitan, here as a hamburg Napolitan on a silver plate with an added fried egg (September 2026); curry; vegetable sandwich set (October 2026) · Dojima roll, plain or the seasonal chestnut roll (October 2026), also to take away (January 2025) · scones with clotted cream, extra cream ¥150 (September 2026); pudding à la mode; matcha affogato (2026) · mixed juice, cream soda (Tabelog); royal milk tea ¥920 (October 2026); breakfast sets with toast and a boiled egg (2025–2026)
places.notes: [Kissa · Namba Nannan, a 1957 coffee shop with a four-egg sandwich] A long-loved kissa in the NAMBA Nannan underground mall under the sign "OSAKA NAMBA 1957", just off the Midosuji Line gates, so you can reach it without going outside. Come for the thick omelette sandwich, four eggs high and gently seasoned with dashi, or the hamburg Napolitan, a slice of Dojima roll, scones with clotted cream, an Osaka mixed juice or a cream soda. It opens at 9:00 for breakfast and stays open until 22:00, with sofas, Wi-Fi, outlets and QR ordering. Diners in 2026 praise the sandwich and the convenience; one found the royal milk tea weak and lukewarm for ¥920, another the morning mixed juice not fresh. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing (shop-maintained): established 65 years ago in Minami, Osaka, serving its signature coffee-shop menu of Napolitan, thick omelette sandwiches, Osaka mixed juice, cream soda and pudding à la mode; former name Victoria Cafe (ビクトリア カフェ). A September 2026 diner notes the sign "OSAKA NAMBA 1957".
chef_bio.specialty: Thick omelette sandwich; Napolitan; Dojima roll.

anecdotes.text: "Here, the 'Thick Grilled Egg Sandwich' uses an incredible four eggs, making it a truly luxurious treat!" — October 2026, ¥1,100 at lunch.
"Located inside NAMBA Nannan, this long-loved, traditional café has a charming retro atmosphere, marked by the sign 'OSAKA NAMBA 1957'." — September 2026, matcha affogato.
"The cup wasn't very large; it contained about two cups worth in the pot. It was quite lukewarm from the start" — October 2026, royal milk tea ¥920.

places.cuisine: American food with music, books and drinks, produced by Blue Note Tokyo (official site) · lunch (official site, read November 2026): classic burger ¥1,400; smash hamburg of coarse-ground beef ¥2,100; craft corned-beef melt sandwich with jalapeño ¥1,700; spicy shrimp jambalaya, cooked about 20 minutes to order, ¥2,200; Brooklyn-style salad bowl of 12 ingredients ¥1,900; Singapore-style popiah ¥2,700; monthly pasta ¥1,600; +¥400 for a drink · dinner burgers in half or regular sizes, from the classic ¥850 / ¥1,470 to truffle cheese with a soft fried egg ¥1,050 / ¥1,960 (official site) · appetizers and salads: clam chowder ¥1,320, Tokachi herb-beef roast beef ¥1,210, garlic shrimp and avocado bake ¥990, Cobb salad ¥1,540, shrimp and avocado ajillo ¥1,210 (official site) · 2026 reviews: lunch sets with a cold soup, appetizers and milk bread with honey dip; Bismarck pizza with truffle and prosciutto; chocolate cake with berry sauce; sweet-potato chips; an original beer
places.notes: [American · Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Blue Note's burger, book and jazz parlor] A big brick-and-wood basement café-bar for music, café, books, eats and bar, the Osaka sister of Brooklyn Parlor in Shinjuku, produced by Blue Note Tokyo, with live jazz and DJ nights. It serves non-stop from 11:00 to 23:00: burgers in half or full sizes, clam chowder, roast beef, jambalaya, salads and pizza, with lunch sets that come with milk bread and a honey dip. The 160 seats and sofas make it a relaxed place for meetings or a late coffee and cake. Diners in 2026 like the food and the mood; one found the service slow, and an earlier regular the music loud. Open daily.

roles: Produced by Blue Note Tokyo, © BLUE NOTE JAPAN (official site); operator not stated
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: "music, cafe, books, eats, bar"; produced by Blue Note Tokyo and operated by Blue Note Japan; two shops, Shinjuku (Shinjuku OIOI Annex B1F) and Osaka; regular jazz events ("JAZZ@the Parlor") and other live shows. Opened 20 April 2014 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: A place to enjoy food and music (official site).

anecdotes.text: "At 6:30 PM, the DJ set started, featuring mainly Western music. I enjoyed a relaxing holiday dinner surrounded by high-quality sound." — September 2026, a Saturday.
"I appreciated that the Wi-Fi password is written on all the tables, which is very considerate." — September 2026, chocolate cake.
"There is an OSK theater next door. I visited this place while waiting for the OSK performance." — October 2026.

places.cuisine: Korean restaurant specialising in kopchang (beef small intestine), grilled on a hot plate in a secret sauce, finished with bokkeumbap fried in the pan; beef samgyeopsal (Tabelog) · kopchang with perilla leaves, bossam, rice with chanja (July 2026) · samgyeopsal sets with green chillies (July–September 2026) · sundubu jjigae with seafood or offal, gyeran-jjim, seolleongtang and jjigae lunch sets; chijimi; kimchi and namul side dishes (June–September 2026) · courses with all-you-can-drink (Tabelog; 2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Korean · Shinsaibashi, gopchang under club lights] A bright, Instagram-styled Korean restaurant three minutes from Shinsaibashi Station, built around kopchang: beef small intestine grilled on a hot plate in the house sauce, wrapped in perilla leaves, and finished as fried rice in the same pan. Lunch from 10 a.m. runs to sundubu, seolleongtang and samgyeopsal sets; at night it fills with young groups and K-pop, with all-you-can-drink courses. The sundubu spice level is fixed, so ask if you are sensitive to heat. Bills over ¥10,000 earn a spin of the gacha at the till (August 2026). English, Chinese and Korean menus; Korean-speaking staff.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff (unnamed); Korean-speaking staff (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a gopchang specialist landed in Shinsaibashi, "Korean's favourite"; club-like, photogenic interior; kopchang grilled on a hot plate with a secret sauce, bokkeumbap to finish, and beef samgyeopsal "available only here in Kansai". Opened 15 April 2022.
chef_bio.specialty: Kopchang on the hot plate; samgyeopsal; sundubu.

anecdotes.text: "The horumon was juicy (be careful, it's hot!) and delicious when wrapped in Korean perilla leaves." — July 2026.

"if your bill exceeds JPY 10,000, you can spin a gacha at the register!" — August 2026.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat and fish izakaya, as the name says.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–2:00 the next morning (last order 1:30); closed Sundays, though it may open for group events (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day bookings by phone; a 2-hour limit when full; December courses +¥500 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 61 seats: counter, a tatami room for 6–14, tables, a 16-seat room on 2F and basement rooms for 4–20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; September 2026). All-you-can-drink ¥1,980 for two hours, also with à la carte (September–October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashi-suji 2-2-10, 新日本三ツ寺ビル 1F, among snack bars — 5 min from Shinsaibashi and Namba Stns
places.cuisine: Izakaya of meat, fish and sake with Japanese, Western and Chinese dishes, about a hundred on the menu plus a blackboard of daily specials (Tabelog; September 2026) · six-kind sashimi platter ¥3,300 (or ¥1,980 for two, half ¥1,500) of kanpachi, hirame, sawara, bluefin tuna, salmon, shime-saba, buri or tai (September–October 2026) · black-truffle "Celebu" pork gyoza ¥680, bluefin toro and takuan roll in Korean seaweed ¥900, black wagyu tataki ¥980, shrimp and mushroom ajillo ¥780, omurice ¥780, chocolate fondant ¥770 (September 2026) · Peking duck ¥1,200–1,320, domestic grilled eel (half) ¥1,800, black wagyu shigureni rice bowl ¥1,200, 10-skewer yakitori platter ¥1,800, tempura platter ¥980, mapo tofu, dan dan noodles, yodare chicken (September–October 2026) · courses with 2 hours of drinks from ¥5,000 (A4 wagyu, sashimi, dim sum; hot-pot courses) (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Minami-Shinsaibashi, a hundred dishes until 2 a.m.] A hideaway izakaya on the ground floor of a building of snack bars in Minami-Shinsaibashi, with a menu of about a hundred dishes that runs from thick-cut sashimi to Peking duck, so everyone in a mixed group finds something to order. Favourites in September 2026 were the black-truffle pork gyoza (¥680), a bluefin toro and takuan roll to wrap in Korean seaweed (¥900) and black wagyu tataki (¥980); a half grilled eel was ¥1,800 in October 2026. All-you-can-drink is ¥1,980 for two hours even with à la carte. Rooms on three floors suit groups. It was nearly full after 11 p.m. on an October night; one diner found the busy staff hard to catch. Smoking allowed. Closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a hidden gem in Minami with carefully chosen sake from across Japan, fresh fish, selected meat, Osaka specialities and authentic Chinese dishes; signature black-truffle gyoza; private rooms for small and large groups; smoking allowed.
chef_bio.specialty: Black-truffle gyoza; sashimi platters; a Japanese, Western and Chinese menu.

anecdotes.text: "With around 100 menu items, it's quite a challenge to choose." — September 2026.
"I visited after 11 PM, and the restaurant was almost full, which clearly shows its popularity." — October 2026.
"Domestic Grilled Eel (Half) for JPY 1800. Isn't that incredibly cheap?" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 肉と魚と酒 雄 心斎橋店、居酒屋・海鮮・焼き鳥、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-2-10 新日本三ツ寺ビル 1F、心斎橋駅・なんば駅から徒歩5分、月〜土17:00〜翌2:00 (L.O.1:30)、日曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、61席 (座敷、テーブル、2階、地下の個室)、喫煙可、2時間飲み放題つきのコース5,000円から。店の紹介 (英訳): ミナミの隠れ家、全国の日本酒、新鮮な魚、こだわりの肉、大阪の名物、本格中華、名物の黒トリュフの餃子。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): メニューは100品ほど、黒板の日替わり、刺身の盛り合わせ6種3,300円、黒トリュフの餃子680円、本まぐろのトロたく海苔巻900円、黒毛和牛のたたき980円、えびとマッシュルームのアヒージョ780円、オムライス780円、北京ダック1,200〜1,320円、国産のうなぎ (ハーフ) 1,800円、焼き鳥10本1,800円、天ぷら980円、麻婆豆腐、担々麺、よだれ鶏、飲み放題1,980円、23時過ぎでもほぼ満席、喫煙可、忙しくてスタッフを呼びにくいという声。

places.name: 難波 鉄板焼き Sublime (Namba Teppanyaki Sublime)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Steak comes with bonito soy sauce, onion soy sauce, salt and wasabi; one October 2026 diner who asked ahead had dietary restrictions met.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu and seafood teppanyaki courses.
places.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; open year-round; no phone cancellations outside opening hours (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 38 seats: an 8-seat counter at the teppan, private rooms (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Bottled water ¥660 a litre (October 2026).
places.neighborhood: Namba 3-4-13, 味わいばしビル 6F (the building with a Baskin-Robbins) — 2 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki of Kobe beef and black wagyu, a collaboration with Azabu-Juban Sublime, which the shop says held a Michelin star in the 2018–2020 Tokyo guides (Tabelog; official site) · lunch course of soup, a lean and strip-loin steak comparison and dessert ¥3,800 (Tabelog; October 2026) · Classic course: an appetizer box (scallop and shrimp tartare, smoked salmon pâté, wagyu roast beef yukhoe), eel and eggplant terrine, black wagyu in mushroom bouillon shabu-shabu style, live Hyogo abalone on the teppan with Burgundy butter, seasonal vegetables, sirloin and lean wagyu, rice, red miso soup and pickles or garlic rice (+¥1,200), seared wagyu sirloin sushi (¥3,500), ice cream (August 2026) · Christmas courses ¥12,000–18,000 with Yamagata beef (Tabelog, 2026)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Namba, wagyu and live abalone at the counter] A sixth-floor teppanyaki room two minutes from Namba Station, run with Azabu-Juban Sublime, the Tokyo restaurant the shop says held a Michelin star three years running. At the eight-seat counter the chef grills black wagyu and live Hyogo abalone, still moving in front of you, with Burgundy butter. Lunch is the way in: a lean and strip-loin comparison course for ¥3,800. The dinner Classic course adds an appetizer box, a wagyu shabu-shabu and wagyu sirloin sushi. A sushi bar on the same floor belongs to the same group. One October 2026 birthday diner found the course rushed at about an hour, and bottled water was ¥660. A 10% service charge applies.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a collaboration with Azabu-Juban Sublime, "featured in the Michelin Guide Tokyo for 2018, 2019, and 2020"; the finest Kobe beef on the teppan; private rooms. Official site (sublime-g.com) lists 名駅 鮨 Sublime, 難波 鉄板焼き Sublime, 銀座 フレンチ Sublime, Premium 銀座 鉄板焼き Sublime and 恵比寿 鉄板焼き Sublime. Reviews (August 2026) note that a sushi restaurant on the same floor is a sister shop.

anecdotes.text: "A giant abalone still moving right in front of me!" — August 2026.
"I visited this restaurant on a date with my girlfriend, and I’m glad I chose it for a special occasion." — October 2026; dietary restrictions raised in advance were accommodated.
"However, the course was served within about an hour, and the overall pace of the dishes was a bit too fast for my liking." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sublime-g.com): 店舗は名駅 鮨 Sublime、難波 鉄板焼き Sublime、銀座 フレンチ Sublime、Premium 銀座 鉄板焼き Sublime、恵比寿 鉄板焼き Sublime、2018年・2019年・2020年度ミシュラン3年連続の星。食べログ (店舗会員): 難波 鉄板焼き Sublime、ステーキ・鉄板焼き・日本料理、大阪市中央区難波3-4-13 味わいばしビル 6-D、なんば駅から徒歩2分、毎日12:00〜15:00・17:00〜23:00、年中無休、予約可、サービス料10%、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、38席、個室、禁煙、子ども可、麻布十番 Sublime とのコラボの店、神戸牛の鉄板焼き、ランチの赤身とサーロインの食べ比べのコース3,800円、クリスマスのコース12,000円と18,000円。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): 前菜の箱、穴子となすのテリーヌ、きのこのブイヨンの黒毛和牛のしゃぶしゃぶ、兵庫の活あわびの鉄板焼き、サーロインと赤身、ガーリックライス1,200円、和牛サーロインの炙り寿司3,500円、アイス、カウンター8席、同じ階の寿司の店は姉妹店、事前に相談した食事制限に対応、コースが1時間ほどで早すぎたという声、水が1リットル660円。

places.name: 海鮮物語 なんば心斎橋店 (Seafood Monogatari)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Raw shrimp is dipped in soy sauce, the hot pot ends with ramen, and kushikatsu and tempura are on the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; the hot pots are shrimp and crab broths.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Thu and Sun 17:00–2:00 (food last order 1:00, drinks 1:30); Fri and Sat 17:00–3:00 (food 2:00, drinks 2:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; held 15 minutes; you may be sent to the Midosuji branch when full (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards, e-money and QR payments including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 56 seats: counter facing the fish preparation, tables, tatami and sunken seating; a view over Dotonbori (Tabelog; October 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). English, Chinese and Korean menus with photos; English, Chinese and Korean-speaking staff (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-6-12, ニコービル 2F, overlooking Dotonbori — 5 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Seafood izakaya known for shrimp shabu-shabu: large red shrimp eaten raw with soy sauce first, then their heads simmered into a miso, mala or other broth for shabu-shabu, finished with ramen or rice (Tabelog; August–October 2026) · shrimp shabu-shabu courses ¥4,000–5,500 (Tabelog); crab and shrimp shabu-shabu with grilled crab miso (August and October 2026) · sashimi boat platters, "overflowing" sushi, sushi pizza on fried rice with cheese, temari spoon sushi, grilled shellfish and crab shell, grilled eel skewers, fried hamo, kushikatsu, crab cream croquettes (August–October 2026)
places.notes: [Seafood · Dotonbori, shrimp shabu-shabu above the street] A second-floor seafood izakaya on Dotonbori, five minutes from Namba Station, with a view over the street and kitchen open until 2 a.m. (3 a.m. at weekends). The thing to order is shrimp shabu-shabu: big red shrimp you first eat raw with soy sauce, then swish through a broth made rich with their own heads, finishing with ramen in the pot; a crab-and-shrimp version comes with grilled crab miso. Courses run ¥4,000–5,500. Around it are sashimi boats, overflowing sushi, a cheese-loaded sushi pizza and Osaka kushikatsu. It is busy; when full you may be sent to the sister shop on Midosuji, so call ahead. Smoking allowed. English, Chinese and Korean menus and staff.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff (unnamed); multilingual staff (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: sushi and izakaya, original shrimp shabu-shabu (raw in soy sauce, then shabu-shabu in a miso broth, ramen to finish), sashimi platters, overflowing sushi and grilled shellfish from fresh seafood; a counter to watch the fish prepared; two shops (this and the Midosuji branch).

anecdotes.text: "Since the shrimp can be eaten raw, you can enjoy it as sashimi, lightly shabu-shabu for a rare taste, or cooked thoroughly" — August 2026.
"With the a la carte hot pot, you can enjoy up to 7 shrimp per person." — October 2026.
"There are two locations, and I was directed to a different one from this one. I recommend calling ahead to confirm." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 海鮮物語 なんば心斎橋店、居酒屋・海鮮・串揚げ、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-6-12 ニコービル2F、なんば駅から徒歩5分、月〜木・日17:00〜翌2:00、金土17:00〜翌3:00、予約可 (15分を過ぎると取り消し、混雑時は御堂筋店へ案内することも)、カード・電子マネー・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay も) 可、56席、カウンター、座敷、掘りごたつ、喫煙可、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニューとスタッフ、えびしゃぶのコース4,000〜5,500円。店の紹介 (英訳): えびしゃぶ (生で醤油、味噌のだしでしゃぶしゃぶ、締めはラーメン)、刺身の盛り合わせ、こぼれ寿司、貝焼き。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 生で食べられる大きな赤えび、頭を入れて濃くなるだし、味噌や麻辣のだし、かにとえびのしゃぶしゃぶとかにみその網焼き、舟盛り、寿司ピザ、手まりのスプーン寿司、かに甲羅焼き、うなぎの串、はもの天ぷら、串カツ、かにクリームコロッケ、道頓堀の眺め、もう1店に案内されたので電話で確認をという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus with photos and staff who speak them (Tabelog).

places.name: 鶏と○○、時々 魚。 (Tori to Marumaru, Tokidoki Sakana.)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Skewers are salt-seasoned in one review (May 2024), but tsukune is glazed and courses include saikyo-miso fish, sweet-simmered liver, dashi chazuke, udon and oyakodon.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken and fish courses with dashi.
places.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–1:00 (Tabelog). Reservation only; phone lines may be closed, book online (Tabelog). Opened June 9, 2021 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), Suica-type IC cards, iD, PayPay (Tabelog). 12 seats: 6 at the counter on the first floor, tables, and a fully private second-floor room for 6; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking: Tabelog lists a designated smoking area; diners smoked at the table in the private room (December 2025), and an April 2026 diner says smoking is allowed, perhaps e-cigarettes only. The stairs start right inside the private room's sliding door (April 2026). Not an invoice-registered business (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Togano-cho, among the hotels east of Umeda — 5 min from Higashi-Umeda Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori and creative Japanese courses built on Awaodori chicken from Tokushima, with seasonal fish such as nodoguro and crab; fish can replace chicken on request (Tabelog) · 14-dish yakitori course ¥4,400; courses with all-you-can-drink ¥5,000 (90 min, 8 dishes) and ¥6,000 (2 hours, 10 dishes): sweet-simmered chicken liver, sesame buri, thigh skewers, breast-and-skin skewers, cucumber with miso, tsukune, dish of the day, finale (Tabelog) · chicken and fish course of 12 dishes ¥3,500 with akaushi roast, firefly squid with vinegar miso, skewers, menuke grilled with saikyo miso, sea-bream dashi chazuke (May 2024) · chicken and Ise lobster course ¥6,600 with sashimi, red snow crab, a hot pot of Akita pork, sea bream and shrimp, udon and zosui (October 2023) · yakitori lunch course ¥3,500 (January 2025) · katsuo tataki and oyakodon to finish (2023–2026) · oolong or green tea ¥350; sake and shochu (Tabelog; May 2024)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Umeda, Togano-cho, a reservation-only chicken house] A small reservation-only yakitori house in Togano-cho, opened in 2021, whose name says it all: chicken, and sometimes fish. The owner, who ran it solo on a January 2025 visit, grills Awaodori chicken from Tokushima over charcoal with salt and builds courses around it: thigh and breast-and-skin skewers, tsukune, sweet-simmered liver, katsuo tataki, saikyo-grilled fish, and an oyakodon or sea-bream chazuke to finish. Courses run about ¥3,500–6,600, some with all-you-can-drink, and there is a lunch course too. Downstairs is a six-seat counter; upstairs a fully private room that groups book for drinking parties, and where smoking has been allowed. Open noon to 1 am.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): opened June 9, 2021; chicken dishes centred on yakitori, made with Tokushima's Awaodori chicken; seasonal creative Japanese courses; fresh seasonal fish, with requests welcome. A January 2025 diner: "The owner operates the restaurant solo"; the counter has 6 seats and the second floor is for private dining.
chef_bio.philosophy: A calm, wood-grain Japanese room where time flows slowly (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "This yakitori restaurant uses Awaodori chicken from Tokushima, and occasionally serves fish, which is how it got its name (laughs)." — January 2025.

"The course meal started with a flavorful Katsuo no Tataki topped with plenty of condiments, followed by delicious yakitori, and finished off with a delightful Oyakodon. With an all-you-can-drink option, the price was reasonable at JPY 5000 per person." — October 2024.
"As soon as you open the sliding door to the room, there are stairs right there, so it could be dangerous if you've had too much to drink." — April 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only, booked online; hard to find (January 2024). No English evidence found.

places.name: 天ぷら もり井 (Tempura Morii)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: battered tempura, and a fried shrimp-paste bread.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood and chicken tempura; the course ends with dashi tencha or egg on rice. Vegetable tempura is served too.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00), Sat 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:00), closed Sundays and holidays. Hot Pepper: Mon–Fri and days before holidays 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00), closed Saturdays and Sundays. The two listings differ; check before a Saturday visit. Opened April 6, 2011 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Seats: 20 on Tabelog (10 counter, 10 table), 16 on Hot Pepper; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; Hot Pepper: all seats). No one under 20, even with an adult (Hot Pepper). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese field says なし (none); its machine translation says a charge is added.
places.neighborhood: Kitashinchi, ニュー華ビル 1F — 5 min from Kitashinchi Stn
places.cuisine: Tempura fried in a blend of white sesame oil and refined oil, with the oil changed for every four guests (Tabelog) · today's recommended course of 12 seasonal pieces such as prawn, free-range chicken breast with ume and shiso, young sweetfish and pike conger, finished with dashi tencha or rice with raw egg: ¥11,000 on the course menu, ¥8,580 in the shop text (Tabelog) · popular shrimp-paste bread with curry salt, heart-shaped for women (Tabelog) · à la carte ordering (July 2024; February 2026) · a February 2026 course: shrimp in shiso, asparagus, chicken breast with ume and shiso, konjac, lotus root, sea bream with grated daikon and ponzu, garlic shoots, octopus, canola flowers, soft roe, oysters, then egg on rice · shiitake stuffed with potato (February 2026) · sake chosen with breweries around Japan, shochu including Kanpachi (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Tempura · Kitashinchi, a relaxed counter with à la carte] A twenty-seat tempura room on a Kitashinchi ground floor, open since 2011, where you can watch each piece fried in front of you in a sesame-oil blend that is changed for every four guests. The seasonal course runs to twelve pieces, prawn, sweetfish, pike conger, ume-and-shiso chicken, oysters in February, and ends with tencha or egg on rice; the shrimp-paste toast with curry salt is the signature. Unusually for the area you can also order à la carte, and diners call it relaxed rather than formal, with friendly staff; one diner was remembered on a second visit. Expect ¥10,000–15,000 a head with drinks; one diner found it pricey. Smoking is allowed and no one under 20 is admitted.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a hideaway for adults with seasonal tempura and fine sake; a blend of white sesame oil and white frying oil, refreshed regularly; prawn tempura and a 12-dish seasonal course recommended; sake and shochu from across Japan. Opened April 6, 2011.
chef_bio.philosophy: Light tempura that adults can eat without feeling heavy (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "Most of the refined and delicious tempura restaurants offer only set courses, so I'm thrilled that I can order a la carte here!" — July 2024.
"This was my second visit, and I was pleasantly surprised…" — July 2025, on being remembered from the first visit.
"The signature breaded shrimp pairs perfectly with curry powder, allowing the sweetness of the shrimp to bloom." — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ホットペッパーグルメ: 月〜金・祝前日17:00〜23:00 (料理L.O. 22:00)、土日定休、16席、全席喫煙可、20歳未満は同伴でも入店不可。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seats facing the fryer; staff attentive and friendly (2025–2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: カーサ M (casa M)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The signature is spaghettini finished in a Parmigiano wheel; grilled dishes come with sauces of Japanese and Western seasonings.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: charcoal-grilled wagyu, chicken and seafood courses, and a cheese-and-cream pasta.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 18:00–23:00 (last order 21:00), closing days not fixed. Official site: 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00), closing days not fixed; a wine bar with à la carte from 21:00. The two differ on closing time. Lunch is not in either schedule, but Tabelog lists a lunch-only course and diners came for lunch (January 2025; November 2025; March 2026). Opened June 16, 2014 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, and Discover on the official site); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Seats: 16 on Tabelog (4 counter, 10 table, a private room for 2–3), 19 on the official site (5 counter, 12 table, 2 private); private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; please avoid strong perfume (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese field says なし (none); its machine translation says a charge is added.
places.neighborhood: Kitashinchi, 薬師堂ビル 4F down an alley — 2–4 min from JR Kitashinchi Stn
places.cuisine: Charcoal-grilled Italian: wagyu, jidori chicken and seasonal produce over charcoal with sauces using Japanese and Western touches (official site) · signature spaghettini flambéed in a Parmigiano wheel with cheese and cream (official site; 2025–2026 reviews) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): wagyu main ¥7,000 (amuse, seafood salad, charcoal-grilled seafood, wagyu, the cheese pasta, dessert); seasonal course with caviar, abalone, foie gras and wagyu ¥11,000; lunch-only wagyu course ¥6,000 · a ¥10,000 course with bluefin tuna, abalone, caviar, foie gras, truffles and wagyu (November 2025) · over 100 wines chosen by the owner-sommelier, centred on Burgundy pinot noir, 13 by the glass; glasses ¥700–1,400, bottles from ¥3,500 (official site)
places.notes: [Italian · Kitashinchi, charcoal grill and a flaming cheese wheel] A hidden fourth-floor Italian room down a Kitashinchi alley, open since 2014, where wagyu, jidori and seasonal fish are grilled over charcoal and the courses build to the house show: spaghettini tossed in a flambéed wheel of Parmigiano. Courses are ¥7,000 and ¥11,000 (with caviar, abalone and foie gras), and the owner-sommelier keeps over 100 wines, mostly Burgundy pinot, 13 by the glass. After 9 pm it doubles as a wine bar with à la carte. Diners call it the best value high-end Italian in Kitashinchi and say it feels like home; one describes a couple running it, others one person handling everything. Hard to find: follow the arrows down the alley.

roles: Owner-sommelier and chef (unnamed); a couple runs the room (February 2026)
chef_bio.background: Official site: Casa M (カーサ エム), charcoal grill and Italian in Kitashinchi; "casa" means "home", named so guests can relax; wine stock of over 100 chosen by the owner-sommelier. Tabelog: opened June 16, 2014. Diners: one person handles cooking and serving (January 2025, lunch; February 2026); a February 2026 diner credits the warm atmosphere to the master and the master's wife. A November 2025 regular of six or seven years says Hanshin Tigers figures Atsushi Kataoka and Kosuke Fukudome and Yuji Oda have visited (the reviewer's claim).
chef_bio.philosophy: Good ingredients, simply grilled over charcoal (official site).

anecdotes.text: "The appetizers had a simple seasoning that highlighted the ingredients, and the meat was cooked to perfection with an exquisite sauce." — February 2026.
"This is the best value high-end Italian restaurant in Kitashinchi." — November 2025.
"The pasta made on a cheese wheel was quite impressive and full of entertainment value." — March 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ワインと炭火焼 カーサ エム、18:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、不定休、21時以降はワインバー、19席、ワインは100種以上でグラスは13種、北新地駅11-21番出口から徒歩2分、路地を矢印のとおり進んだ薬師堂ビル4階。

cultural_comfort.note: Course-centred; private rooms; the entrance is hard to find (2025–2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: 創作酒場スタンドKO-NEKO (Sosaku Sakaba Stand KO-NEKO)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu includes kara-age, fried figs in dashi, gratin, Neapolitan spaghetti, garlic toast and fried chikuwa.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a creative izakaya of wagyu, sashimi, sea urchin and chicken, with many dashi-based dishes.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–3:00 (food last order 2:00, drinks 2:30); closed Sundays, some other days and at New Year (Tabelog). Opened June 6, 2025 (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥450 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay; no e-money (Tabelog). 18 seats: a counter of 8, tables for 6 and 4, and standing room for about 7; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog); a September 2026 diner found it all seated. Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Phone bookings are easiest after 17:00 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Creative Japanese izakaya food by a cat-loving chef, in cat-shaped dishes; a daily wagyu steak of a changing cut (Tabelog) · KO-NEKO appetizer trio ¥500; KO-NEKO set meal of three obanzai, fish, rice and miso soup ¥700 (September 2026) · wagyu steak with shaliapin sauce from ¥2,100 (October 2026), ¥2,200 for the thigh cut (September 2026) · fresh sea urchin appetizer ¥800, conger eel tempura ¥920, fried figs in dashi ¥620, simmered whelk ¥480, fried chicken tulip with fresh sansho ¥650, beef sukiyaki rice with egg yolk ¥860 (September 2026) · tomato stuffed with meat and cheese ¥680, potato and chicken gratin ¥780, sesame hamachi ¥850, garlic toast ¥420 (October 2026) · KO-NEKO Neapolitan after 22:00, ¥800 (October 2026) or ¥880 (September 2026) · mix-it-yourself potato salad, seafood carpaccio, seafood "escargot-style" with baguette, homemade sesame tofu with sea urchin, fried chikuwa (2026) · Sapporo draft ¥600, Aka boshi, cat-themed sours ¥600, about six sakes and seven whiskies (September 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Umeda, Doyama, a cat-themed late-night kitchen] A small creative izakaya in a Doyama leisure building, opened in 2025 and open until 3 am, where the cat-loving owner has filled the room with cat figurines, illustrations and photos of staff and customers' cats (there are no real cats, so allergies are not a worry). The cooking is more serious than the decor: a daily wagyu steak with shaliapin sauce, thick sashimi, sea urchin on homemade sesame tofu, tempura figs in dashi, a stuffed baked tomato, sansho-spiced chicken, and a Neapolitan spaghetti served only after 10 pm. Most dishes are ¥400–900, with a ¥450 seat charge, cat-named sours and a short sake list. Busy with regulars; smoking is allowed; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): creative Japanese dishes by a cat-loving chef; wagyu steak of a different cut each day; three appetizers in cat-shaped dishes with a drink; set meals; a dim, wood-toned room for office workers. Opened June 6, 2025. A September 2026 diner: "A hidden stand run by a cat-loving owner", with house specialties recommended by the owner.
chef_bio.philosophy: Dishes careful in both look and taste (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu steak; fried figs in dashi; KO-NEKO Neapolitan.

anecdotes.text: "While there are no real cats, it's a paradise for cat lovers!" — September 2026.
"There are no cats, so it's suitable for those with allergies or who prefer animals." — September 2026.
"The interior is filled with cat-themed decor, including photos of cats belonging to the staff and customers" — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Friendly staff; welcoming to solo diners (September 2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: 鮨げん家 西中島 (Sushi Genya Nishinakajima)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sushi with soy sauce and tempura in batter, with a dipping sauce of katsuobushi, saba-bushi and kombu seasoned with shio-koji (Tabelog); salt is offered as an alternative for the tempura. One February 2026 course was adjusted for a dietary restriction.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and seafood sushi, tempura and sashimi. Tabelog ticks "vegetarian options" but names none.
places.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 18:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Tuesday; open 29 December 2026, closed 31 December 2026–4 January 2027 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; calls before 16:00 are answered by an AI system; courses must be booked by the day before (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). 22 seats: 10 at the counter and 3 tables for four; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Often fully booked by evening (2025–2026). Opened 11 December 2015 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 木川東3-2-28, 7 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata or Hankyu Minamikata, a little away from the busy streets behind a deep-blue noren (Tabelog; February 2026)
places.cuisine: Sushi and tempura (Tabelog) · sushi on red-vinegar rice served at body temperature, with smaller rice (Tabelog) · tempura fried briefly at high heat in front of you, with salt or a dashi of katsuobushi, saba-bushi and kombu with shio-koji (Tabelog) · courses: seasonal sushi and tempura course, 14 items ¥6,000; seasonal sushi course, 12 items; book a day ahead (Tabelog); a ¥8,000 course with all-you-can-drink (February 2026) · a February 2026 course: sashimi of kanpachi, bluefin akami and kinmedai; saikyo-grilled fish; tempura of red eggplant, angel shrimp and kisu; uzaku; five nigiri of chutoro, white fish, red shrimp, shima-aji and sea urchin · a la carte: five-piece nigiri, five-piece tempura, soft-roe tempura and ponzu, crab miso, firefly squid (2026) · sake from around Japan, over ten kinds, a gari highball (Tabelog; 2025) · about ¥7,000–8,000 a head with drinks (2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, sushi and tempura at one counter] A 22-seat sushi bar a few minutes west of Nishinakajima-Minamigata, behind a deep-blue noren, where one counter turns out both sushi on red-vinegar rice and tempura fried in front of you. The ¥6,000 course of 14 seasonal dishes runs from sashimi and a grilled fish through tempura of red eggplant and angel shrimp to five nigiri such as chutoro and sea urchin; or order a la carte from single pieces. Ten-plus sakes come in cups you choose yourself, every plate is one of a kind, and it fills up most evenings (2025–2026). Book courses a day ahead; closed Tuesdays.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: sushi with red vinegar, served at body temperature with less rice; tempura fried at high heat for a short time; a dipping sauce of katsuobushi, saba-bushi and kombu with shio-koji; "All the plates are one-of-a-kind"; over ten sakes; opened 11 December 2015; company website sushi-genya.co.jp. Per reviews: "Thank you to the owner for the attentive and friendly service" (February 2026); the staff poured a generous cup of sake (August 2025); "I brought my child with me, and the service was attentive" (December 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Committed to Sushi." "Committed to Tempura." (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi and tempura course; red-vinegar rice.

anecdotes.text: "Red shrimp (substituted with sea bream due to dietary restrictions)" — February 2026, the ¥8,000 course with all-you-can-drink.
"The tempura was served one piece at a time, freshly fried, allowing us to enjoy it at its best." — March 2026.
"I was allowed to choose my own ochoko (sake cup) first." — August 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 鮨げん家 西中島、寿司・天ぷら・海鮮、大阪市淀川区木川東3-2-28、西中島南方駅と Hankyu Minamikata 駅から徒歩7分、月・水〜日18:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、火曜休み、16時前の電話は AI が対応、コースは前日までに予約、カード・PayPay・Alipay・WeChat Pay 可、電子マネー不可、22席 (カウンター10、4名テーブル3)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、車いす可、2015年12月11日オープン、赤酢の人肌のシャリで小さめ、高温で短時間に揚げる天ぷら、かつお節・さば節・昆布に塩麹の天つゆ、器はすべて一点もの、日本酒10種以上、季節の寿司と天ぷらのコース14品6,000円 (税込)、季節の寿司のコース12品。口コミ(2024年〜2026年): 紺色ののれん、刺身、西京焼き、赤なす・angel shrimp・キスの天ぷら、うざく、握り5貫 (中トロ、白身、赤海老、シマアジ、ウニ)、白子の天ぷらとポン酢、カニみそ、ホタルイカ、ガリのハイボール、飲み放題つき8,000円のコース、食事制限で赤海老を鯛に替えてくれた、おちょこを選べる、ひとり約7,000〜8,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

places.name: ねぎ焼・お好み焼き 和 (Negiyaki Okonomiyaki Kazu)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: negiyaki and okonomiyaki batter, yakisoba and omusoba noodles, with dashi soy sauce or sauce.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef tendon, pork, squid and egg throughout.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 15:00–23:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations not taken per Tabelog, though a diner says some times need one (August 2025); fills by 19:30 (June 2026). No cards or e-money; PayPay and d Barai (Tabelog). 16 seats with a counter facing the teppan; smoking allowed (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 西中島3-16-6, 2 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Stn, by Hankyu Minamikata (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Negiyaki and okonomiyaki, plus teppanyaki, skewers and sashimi (Tabelog) · negiyaki piled with green onion on a thin batter, finished with dashi soy sauce; tendon negiyaki ¥1,050 before tax (August 2025) · "Daimyo" negi and "Daimyo" soba ¥1,400 each (March 2026); Daimyo yakisoba ¥1,300 before tax (August 2025) · black yakisoba with squid ink, topped with egg and bonito (2025) · pork and cabbage omelette, tonpei-yaki made with two eggs (2025) · the shop's "Suji Pon" of tonpeiyaki wrapped round a tonteki with ketchup sauce; homemade jaga-cheese (Tabelog) · beef tendon stew ¥550, handmade hamburg steak ¥550, tonpei-yaki ¥950 (March 2026) · chicken heart skewers, salt, two for ¥500 (August 2025) · draft beer ¥530 (August 2025)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, a negiyaki counter at the teppan] A 16-seat okonomiyaki house two minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, always full of repeat customers (March 2026), where the counter faces the teppan and the chef cooks everything in front of you. The negiyaki is the order: a thin batter heaped with green onion and beef tendon, finished with dashi soy sauce, light enough to eat after a night out (September 2025). Regulars also swear by the black yakisoba in squid-ink sauce, the thick-pork tonpei-yaki and the big "Daimyo" negi and soba (¥1,400, 2026). Skewers, stews and a beer at ¥530 make it an izakaya too. From 15:00; PayPay, no cards; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: negiyaki, okonomiyaki, yakisoba, omusoba and modern-yaki, plus sashimi, teppanyaki and skewers; the signature "Suji Pon" and homemade jaga-cheese. Per reviews: "The owner is entertaining" (March 2025); "Sitting at the counter, I had the best view of the chef cooking right in front of me" (June 2025); "This cozy restaurant is always packed with repeat customers" (March 2026).

anecdotes.text: "The aroma of the dashi soy sauce beautifully coats the batter and green onions, while the thick batter has a light and fluffy texture." — August 2025, tendon negiyaki ¥1,050.
"I learned it was seasoned with squid ink and various sauces." — June 2025, black yakisoba.
"The Negiyaki here has a light texture, making it surprisingly easy to eat even when you're full!" — September 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ねぎ焼・お好み焼き 和、お好み焼き・その他・鉄板焼き、大阪市淀川区西中島3-16-6 1F、西中島南方駅から徒歩2分、月〜土・祝15:00〜23:00、日曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay・d払い可、16席、喫煙可、ねぎ焼、お好み焼き、焼きそば、オムそば、モダン焼き、刺身、鉄板焼き、串焼き、名物の Suji Pon、自家製の jaga-cheese。口コミ(2025年〜2026年6月): ねぎたっぷりのねぎ焼をだし醤油で、すじねぎ焼1,050円 (税別)、Daimyo negi・Daimyo soba 各1,400円、Daimyo yakisoba 1,300円、イカスミの黒焼きそば、卵2個のとん平焼き、豚とキャベツの卵焼き、牛すじ煮込み550円、手ごねハンバーグ550円、ハツの塩焼き2本500円、生ビール530円、常連でいっぱい、楽しい店主。

places.name: 新京飯店 (Shinkyo Hanten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Ramen, champon, gyoza, katsudon and sauced Chinese dishes; nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Chinese canteen of pork, chicken and egg dishes; the stir-fried vegetable set is not described as meat-free.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:16–21:50 (food last order 21:30, drinks 21:35), open all year, closing days not fixed (Tabelog, which gives these exact minutes). Lunch sets ¥900 until 16:00, ¥950 after (February 2026). Takeaway bento for sale outside, ¥400–500 (July 2022); delivery through apps such as Demaekan (May 2024). E-money accepted (Tabelog). 17 seats at a counter and tables (Tabelog; May 2024).
places.neighborhood: 西中島4-10-11, ground floor of マッセ新大阪ハイツ新館, a little away from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Stn (Tabelog; 2024–2025)
places.cuisine: Neighbourhood Chinese with a "Peking cuisine" sign (January 2025) · lunch sets with soup: champon and fried rice ¥900 before 16:00, ¥950 after (February 2026); harusai and fried rice ¥1,000 (January 2025); stir-fried vegetable set, gomoku soba and fried rice (2025–2026) · Chinese-style katsudon with a sweet-salty sauce; katsudon and ramen ¥950 (March 2024) · mapo tofu with a sweet miso note, mapo noodles, chashu ramen in a light broth, kara-age (2024) · "choi-ate" small plates ¥600: chives and egg, pork with green-onion salt, bok choy and pork, spicy chicken (May 2024) · beer sets from ¥770 with kara-age and kimchi (January 2025) · omurice and curry too (March 2024)
places.notes: [Chinese · Nishinakajima, an all-day neighbourhood canteen] A 17-seat Chinese canteen a few minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata with a retro "Peking cuisine" sign, open every day from 11:16 to 21:50, the odd minutes straight from its listing. Lunch sets of champon or gomoku soba with fried rice cost ¥900 until 16:00 (2026), and the Chinese-style katsudon under a sweet-salty sauce has fans (2022–2024). Food arrives fast, deliveries go out constantly, and bento sit outside for passers-by. In the evening, ¥600 small plates and beer sets make it a cheap place to drink. Simple, light seasoning, by one regular's account (February 2026).

roles: Kitchen and floor staff (unnamed); two in the kitchen and three on the floor on a May 2024 evening
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: Chinese, open all year from 11:16 to 21:50. Per reviews: "The restaurant is incredibly efficient during lunch hours" (July 2022); "there were quite a few staff members—two in the kitchen and three in the dining area … many takeout orders were coming in through platforms like Demaekan" and the staff "were surprisingly kind" (May 2024); "The retro feel is highlighted by its sign that says 'Peking Cuisine.'" (January 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Champon and fried rice set; Chinese-style katsudon.

anecdotes.text: "When it comes to Chinese cuisine, it might sound strange to say 'light,' but I really appreciate the simple seasoning!" — February 2026, champon and fried rice set ¥900.
"As for the katsu don, it has a unique presentation, topped with a Chinese-style sauce." — March 2024, katsudon and ramen ¥950.
"The bento boxes sold outside are a great value at JPY 400 and JPY 500!" — July 2022.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 新京飯店、中華料理、大阪市淀川区西中島4-10-11 マッセ新大阪ハイツ新館 1F、西中島南方駅から355m、毎日11:16〜21:50 (料理 L.O.21:30、ドリンク L.O.21:35)、年中無休、不定休、電子マネー可、17席。口コミ(2022年7月〜2026年9月): 「Peking cuisine」の看板、ランチのセット (ちゃんぽんとチャーハン、16時までは900円、それ以降950円)、harusai とチャーハン1,000円、野菜炒めのセット、五目そばとチャーハン、中華風のあんかけカツ丼、カツ丼とラーメン950円、甘めの麻婆豆腐、麻婆麺、チャーシュー麺、kara-age、600円のchoi-ate (ニラ玉、豚ねぎ塩、チンゲン菜と豚、鶏の辛い炒め)、770円からのビールセット、オムライス、カレー、店の外で弁当400円・500円、Demaekanなどの配達、料理が早い、あっさりした味。

places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Lunch had paused in 2023 and resumed (January 2025). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 19 seats: 6 at the counter, a tatami area for 5 and two tables for four; smoking allowed (Tabelog). About 70% full at 12:20 on a Friday (April 2026).
places.neighborhood: 西三国1-2-38, 10–13 min from the south exit of Higashi-Mikuni Stn (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Nagahama-style tonkotsu ramen with thin noodles shipped from Hakata (2025–2026) · Nagahama ramen ¥550, unchanged for years (January 2025, April 2026) · lunch set A: ramen, rice and takana (kimchi earlier) ¥650 (2025–2026); set C: ramen, gyoza, rice and kimchi ¥800 (January 2025) · chashu ramen ¥800 (2025) · extra noodles ¥150 (August 2026; ¥100 in January 2025) · homemade gyoza (August 2025) · pickled ginger and sesame on the table (2025)
places.notes: [Ramen · Higashi-Mikuni, ¥550 Nagahama tonkotsu at lunch] A long-running lunch-only ramen shop ten minutes from Higashi-Mikuni Station, run by the chef and the chef’s wife (October 2025), still charging ¥550 for a bowl of Nagahama tonkotsu with thin Hakata noodles (2026). The broth looks light but tastes of pork bone, a little salty on some days (2026); ask for the noodles firm and add a refill. Set A adds rice and takana for ¥650. Regulars return after years away and are glad to find the couple well (2025–2026). Cash only, smoking allowed, closed Sundays.

roles: Owner-chef and the owner's wife (October 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: Nagahama ramen, tsukemen and gyoza, 19 seats, lunch only, cash only. Per reviews: "I was so happy to see both the chef and [the chef’s] wife looking well" (October 2025); the owner and the owner’s wife "have aged quite a bit" but keep the shop going (April 2026); "[The shop] had paused lunch service in 2023, but it's now back" and "the owner appears to be of advanced age" (January 2025); the noodles are shipped from Hakata (2025–2026).

anecdotes.text: "At first glance, the broth looks light and thin, but it's packed with the rich flavor of pork bones." — March 2026, lunch set A ¥650.
"I was surprised that the price of the ramen hasn't changed in 5 years." — April 2026.
"The broth is a light tonkotsu with a slightly stronger saltiness. The noodles are thin, with a great texture and aroma." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 長浜ラーメン浜ちゃん、ラーメン・つけ麺・餃子、大阪市淀川区西三国1丁目2-38、東三国駅南口から徒歩10〜13分、月〜土11:30〜14:00、日曜休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、19席 (カウンター6、座敷5、4名テーブル2)、喫煙可。口コミ(2025年1月〜2026年10月): 店主とおかみさんのふたり、2023年に昼の営業を休み再開、長浜ラーメン550円、ランチ A (ラーメン、ごはん、高菜) 650円、C (ラーメン、gyoza、ごはん、キムチ) 800円、チャーシューメン800円、替え玉150円 (以前は100円)、Hakata から取り寄せる細麺、見た目はあっさりで豚骨の味、塩けはやや強め、紅しょうがとごま、自家製の gyoza、何年ぶりの常連も。

places.name: 湖陽樹 本町店 (Koyoju Honmachi ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The signature is tantanmen (wheat noodles), with dumplings, spring rolls and sauced stir-fries; mapo tofu and fried rice are not described (Tabelog menu; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: no vegan options are described; the tantanmen is topped with minced meat (reviews) and the menu is meat and seafood (Tabelog menu).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:20) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); Sat 11:30–15:00 only; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations taken; day-before and same-day cancellations may be charged. Lunch queues after noon; arrive before 12 (September and October 2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR. 163 seats incl. round tables and private rooms for 4 to 60; whole-shop hire for 120 or more; non-smoking, with a smoking space under the stairs (Tabelog). Aprons provided (October 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Minamihommachi 2-6-5, ファースト船場ビル B1F — 3 min from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stn exit 8; 7 min from Hommachi Stn exit 9
places.cuisine: Chinese with Sichuan dishes, about 40 years in Honmachi (Tabelog) · tantanmen in an original and a newer flavour with house chili oil, thin straight noodles, minced meat, bean sprouts and greens; suan la tang noodles; mapo tofu set lunches (reviews; Tabelog) · bang bang chicken, saliva chicken, shrimp in chili sauce, black-vinegar sweet and sour pork, XO beef, xiao long bao, shumai, crab-and-lettuce fried rice, almond tofu, mango pudding (Tabelog menu, 2021) · banquet courses with 90-minute all-you-can-drink
places.notes: [Chinese · Honmachi, tantanmen in a big basement room] A Chinese restaurant down a spiral stair under a Chuo-dori office building, open for about 40 years and known for its tantanmen, made with house chili oil. The small entrance hides a big room with round tables that fills with office workers at lunch; come before noon or expect a short wait. Diners in 2026 praise the original-flavour tantanmen — sesame-rich, spicy but not overwhelming, the broth light enough to drink — and the mapo tofu set, served within minutes. One diner flies back from Tokyo for it. At night it hosts banquets in private rooms for up to 60.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, Koyoju Honmachi has reached its 40th anniversary, keeping its tantanmen and suan la tang noodles while trying new dishes; a Tabelog feature speaks of "homemade chili oil and evolved Dan Dan Noodles: 27 years in the making". The shop says Sichuan food has many flavours beyond heat — spicy, sour, numbing, fruity and bitter. A September 2026 regular notes a second Koyoju in Tanimachi 4-chome.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Evolving while preserving our traditional flavours" (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "I travel back home from Tokyo just to eat the Dan Dan noodles at this restaurant." — May 2026, second visit.
"The entrance is small, so you might not expect it, but the interior is surprisingly spacious." — September 2026, fourth visit.
"Koyoju Honmachi is quite popular during lunch hours, often requiring a wait after 12 PM." — September 2026.
"Surprisingly, the broth was quite light, and I found myself drinking it all." — October 2026, original-flavour tantanmen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 日本語の情報源は未確認。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 湖陽樹 本町店、南本町2-6-5 ファースト船場ビル B1F、堺筋本町駅8番出口から徒歩3分、40周年、Tantanmen と Suan la tang 麺、自家製ラー油と進化した Tantanmen (27年)、Sichuan 料理は辛さだけでなく酸味・痺れ・果実味・苦味も、月〜金11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、土は昼のみ、日祝休み、163席、個室 (4〜60名)、120名以上で貸切、禁煙 (階段下に喫煙所)、宴会コースは90分飲み放題付き。メニュー (2021年): Tantanmen (元祖の味・新しい味)、Bang bang chicken、よだれ鶏、海老のチリソース、黒酢の酢豚、Xiao long bao、Shumai、蟹とレタスのチャーハン、杏仁豆腐。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月): 本町と谷町四丁目にある、入口は小さいが店内は広い、昼は会社員で満席、12時前がおすすめ、元祖の Tantanmenはごまの風味で辛すぎずスープまで飲める、Mapo tofu 定食1,000円、エプロンあり、東京から食べに帰る客も。

cultural_comfort.note: No English menu or English-speaking staff found in the sources.

places.name: 谷町 ふる里 (Tanimachi Furusato)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an udon shop (wheat noodles) with soba, tempura, kara-age and curry; the dashi is the house pride but its seasoning is not described (Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: no vegan options are described; the noodle dishes come in a dashi that is not described, and the toppings include meat, chicken, egg, tempura and fish (Tabelog menu).
places.hours_raw: Open 24 hours, every day; closed 1 January (Tabelog). No reservations. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), transport IC and other e-money, PayPay. 66 seats (50 table, 16 box seats); non-smoking; ¥200 discount voucher for nearby coin parking (Tabelog). Sushi is taken self-serve from a showcase and added up at the till (September 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Kozu 3-2-30, ヴァンデュール日本橋City Life1 1F — 3 min from Nippombashi Stn (Kintetsu)
places.cuisine: Osaka udon and soba open around the clock, with sushi made in house from market fish (Tabelog) · about 50 udon and soba choices from kake and kitsune to sliced (kizami), keiran, nishin, curry, beef-tendon, nabeyaki and "home run", soba ¥100 more; zaru and chilled noodles; rice bowls (oyako, katsu, egg); tempura and anago bowls with a mini udon (Tabelog menu, May 2025; reviews) · sushi and rolls from the showcase
places.notes: [Udon · Kozu, 24-hour udon and sushi] An old Osaka udon house that ran for decades in Tanimachi 9-chome and moved in June 2025 to a new building near the National Bunraku Theatre, still open 24 hours. Tabelog speaks of about 50 years; an October 2026 diner says it began as a food stall in 1948. The dashi is the house pride, the noodles soft and flat in the old Osaka style, and sushi waits in a showcase for diners to help themselves. It is a classic last stop after a night out in Minami and a breakfast spot by 5 AM. Regulars of 20 and 30 years say the taste survived the move; two September 2026 diners found the noodles softer, or more like dried noodles, than before.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, a long-established udon shop of about 50 years that relocated and reopened (opening date of the new shop 8 June 2025); dashi is its specialty, and sushi is made in the shop from fresh market fish every day. An October 2026 review says it was established in 1948, started as a food stall and moved from Tanimachi 9-chome to Nipponbashi, in front of the National Bunraku Theatre.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Dashi is our specialty" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Osaka udon in house dashi; sushi rolls with udon.

anecdotes.text: "I've been coming here for about 30 years, and I've never had a more delicious udon broth anywhere else." — September 2026, chicken udon.
"This is a must-visit spot to wrap up a night out in Minami." — September 2026.
"I feel like the noodles have changed a bit; they seemed softer before." — September 2026, sliced udon.
"The sushi is self-serve, and while I had no idea how much it would cost, it was all accounted for when I paid!" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 日本語の情報源は未確認。食べログ (英語版): 谷町 ふる里、高津3-2-30 ヴァンデュール日本橋City Life1 1F、近鉄日本橋駅から徒歩3分、2025年6月8日 (移転オープン)、24時間営業、1月1日休み、予約不可、66席 (テーブル50、ボックス16)、禁煙、創業約50年の老舗のうどん店、出汁が自慢、市場で仕入れた魚で店内で作る寿司、提灯が目印、近くのコインパーキングの200円割引券。メニュー (2025年5月): Kake、きつね、きざみ、Keiran、Nishin、カレー、すじ、Nabeyaki、ホームランなど約50種、そばは100円増し、Zaru、丼 (Oyako、Katsu、玉子)。口コミ (2026年5月〜11月): 1948年に屋台から始まりTanimachi 9-chome から National Bunraku Theatre 前に移転という声、24時間で飲んだ後の締めや朝5時の朝食に、天丼や Anago 丼にミニうどん、寿司はショーケースから自分で取る、30年通う客は出汁を絶賛、移転後も味は同じという声、麺が前より柔らかい・乾麺のようという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Sushi is self-serve from a showcase (2026 review). No English menu or English-speaking staff found in the sources.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu has gyoza, spring rolls, yakisoba and sauced dishes; the Tianjin rice sauce is soy-based (Tabelog menu); nothing is stated about wheat.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: no vegan options are described; the signature dishes are pork, chicken, shrimp and tofu with meat (Tabelog menu).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations taken; often full on holidays (September 2026). Weekday lunch sets until 18:00 (September 2026 review). A service fee may be added (Tabelog). Cards (incl. UnionPay), transport IC and other e-money, QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay. 40 seats incl. counter; open to the neighbouring shops of the food street; non-smoking (Tabelog; reviews).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashisuji 1-8-3, Shinsaibashi PARCO B2F (Neon Dining Street) — from Shinsaibashi Stn south gate
places.cuisine: Chinese tavern with a creative turn on classics (Tabelog) · "seven famous dishes": big lemony sweet and sour pork served with knife and fork, Mao Zedong chicken, mapo tofu with house chili oil and Sichuan pepper, stir-fried water spinach, whole-shrimp spring rolls, fluffy Tianjin rice, pistachio gyuhi ice cream (Tabelog menu, August 2024) · drunken shrimp, gyoza, shrimp mayo, roast duck, black-vinegar pork, chive yakisoba, yurinchi; lunch sets (reviews) · sansho highball, Shaoxing-wine cocktails, fruit-pulp lemon sour
places.notes: [Chinese · Shinsaibashi PARCO, basement Chinese tavern] A busy Chinese tavern in the Neon Dining Street two floors under Shinsaibashi PARCO, open to the neighbouring stalls like a food court and open from 11 AM to 11 PM. The signature is a big chunk of lemony sweet and sour pork eaten with a knife and fork; diners in 2026 also order the drunken shrimp, gyoza, mapo tofu and the pulpy lemon sour, often after a film at the PARCO cinema. Weekday lunch sets run until 6 PM. Diners note shops of the same name in Links Umeda and Tennoji Mio.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, "a creative twist on classic Chinese dishes by skilled chefs", with original drinks such as a homemade sansho highball and Shaoxing-wine cocktails. Two September 2026 diners mention Wakabayashi shops in Links Umeda and Tennoji Mio. Tabelog gives the opening as 18 March 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Everyday delight" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Lemony sweet and sour pork with knife and fork.

anecdotes.text: "The layout of the restaurant is open, with no walls separating it from neighboring shops, creating a lively atmosphere" — September 2026.
"The lemon sour here is refreshing, packed with fruit pulp and lemon peel, and I couldn't help but order it repeatedly." — September 2026.
"I noticed they also have locations in Links Umeda and Tennoji Mio." — September 2026, group of four on a holiday.

places.name: とらふぐ城 (Torafugu Jo)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Tessa and grilled fugu come with ponzu, garlic salt or moromi soy sauce, and the menu has kara-age, eel and zosui (Tabelog menu; reviews); nothing is stated about wheat.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fugu, crab and eel restaurant.
places.hours_raw: Winter (October–March) daily 16:00–23:30 (last order 22:00); summer (April–September) 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:45) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); 24–30 December 15:00–23:30; 31 December–3 January 15:00–21:00 with a 10% service charge; open year-round; no eel in December and January (Tabelog; official site). Reservations: reservation-only courses at least two days ahead; online bookings require a course for every guest; 2-hour limit. Cards (incl. UnionPay), PayPay, Alipay; no e-money. 78 seats: private sunken-kotatsu rooms on the second floor, a tatami room with tables for up to 32 on the third (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-4-24 — 1 min from Nagahoribashi Stn exit 7; 8 min from Shinsaibashi Stn exit 6
places.cuisine: Domestic tiger-fugu (torafugu) restaurant: aged tessa sashimi, tecchiri hot pot with the fish cut for each visit, charcoal-grilled fugu with ponzu-garlic, garlic salt or moromi soy, garlic stone-grilled fugu, fried fugu, skin kara-age, shirako in season, zosui; snow crab and eel courses; conger eel in summer (official site; Tabelog menu, August 2026; reviews) · courses such as "Tenshu" ¥7,980; hirezake
places.notes: [Fugu · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, tiger fugu with private rooms] A three-floor fugu house a minute from Nagahoribashi Station that serves only domestic tiger fugu, aged to bring out the flavour, plus snow crab and eel. Diners in 2026 praise the grilled fugu, the aged tessa and the creamy grilled shirako, and the staff who grill the fugu and tend the hot pot; one August diner saw the cut fugu still twitch in the pot. A six-visit regular calls the range of cooking outstanding. Private rooms and a tatami hall suit celebrations and banquets. Hours change with the season: evenings only from October to March, lunch and dinner from April to September.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the house ages its tiger fugu to draw out the umami for tessa and prepares the tecchiri fish at each visit "to taste the umami down to the marrow"; good dishes start from good ingredients. Tabelog gives the opening as 11 September 2014 and says all fugu is domestic tiger fugu.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Good food comes from good ingredients" (official site).

anecdotes.text: "The staff were incredibly kind, carefully grilling the fugu and preparing the hot pot, which I really appreciated." — June 2026, first fugu.
"The fugu served in the hot pot was still twitching (it was my first time seeing cut fugu move like that), and the final zosui was rich and delicious." — August 2026.
"Everything was delicious, but the grilled soft roe was especially amazing—completely free of any fishy taste and so creamy that I ordered it twice!" — June 2026, à la carte.
"The final dish, the zosui (rice porridge), ended up being quite mild in flavor" — August 2026, private-room course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: とらふぐ城、大阪心斎橋の国産ふぐ料理、ふぐ・かに・うなぎ・季節限定、熟成させて旨味を引き出した透き通るてっさ、来店ごとに捌き骨の髄から旨味を味わうてっちり、ふぐの王様とらふぐ、ずわいがに、旨い料理は良質な食材から、ふぐで忘年会・ひれ酒で乾杯、東心斎橋1-4-24、夏季 (4月〜9月) 12:00〜14:00 (L.O.13:45)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、冬季 (10月〜3月) 16:00〜23:30、長堀橋駅7番出口から徒歩1分。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 2014年9月11日オープン、国産とらふぐのみ、78席、2階は掘りごたつの個室、3階は32名までの座敷、年末年始の営業時間とサービス料、12月と1月はうなぎなし。メニュー (2026年8月): てっさ2,180円、炭火焼き、ふぐの石焼き、Kara-age、Shirako、ふぐ鍋。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月): 焼きふぐ、熟成のてっさ、焼き Shirako、スタッフが焼いて鍋を作る、鍋のふぐが動いていた、夏の conger eel、Unaju、Tenshu コース7,980円、Zosui の味が薄めという声も、6回通う客。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff grill the fugu and prepare the hot pot (2026 reviews); pays with Alipay (Tabelog). No English menu or English-speaking staff found in the sources.
