places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Ohatsu Tenjin, wagyu and a magic show] A ten-seat teppanyaki counter in a quiet lane by Ohatsu Tenjin, long-established and full of regulars, where the cheerful owner grills A5 black wagyu in front of you and, after dessert, performs magic tricks. The ¥9,900 course brings prawns baked in foil, grilled vegetables and 180 g of wagyu, best taken half fillet, half strip loin, served on bread that is then crisped in the meat juices and butter. Birthdays get a message cake (¥13,200 course). Diners keep calling it good value for teppanyaki, and the flambé is announced so you can film it.

roles: Owner and teppan chef (the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: The Tabelog invoice number T9810910782033 is registered to an individual, 野田　博臣 (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02). Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "A Historic Teppanyaki Restaurant with a Homely Atmosphere" near Ohatsu Tenjin, A5 black wagyu grilled by the chef in front of you, "You might even catch a magic show!". A February 2024 diner believed it was founded in 1975. Reviews from 2022 to 2026 describe a cheerful owner ("master") who cooks and then performs magic.
chef_bio.specialty: A5 wagyu half-and-half; magic after the meal.

anecdotes.text: "Beyond the steak, the butter-soaked bread and octopus rice crackers are also delicious, making for some unique side options." — August 2024, "a fun steakhouse with a cheerful owner".
"The master even performed some magic tricks at the end, and we were all surprised and enjoyed it together." — December 2024, a birthday.
"The steak was a half-and-half option, allowing us to enjoy two different flavors, which was very satisfying." — August 2026, dinner with a boss.

places.notes: [Izakaya · Doyama, seafood and sake for grown-ups] A 16-seat izakaya on a side street in Doyama, open since April 2025 and until 2:00 at weekends, pitched between casual and upscale with about twenty sakes. Diners order the house trio: the sashimi platter (with salmon roe), the mackerel or sardine rolls packed with herbs, and the black-vinegar sweet and sour pork; then a salmon and ikura kamameshi, which takes time, so order it early. Expect about ¥4,000–5,000 a head, plus a ¥450 cover. In October 2026 one diner found the counter cramped and the room noisy, and another found the price high for the portions; most others praise the food.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a sophisticated izakaya of sake and seasonal seafood, creative dishes such as the black-vinegar sweet and sour pork and the Shaoxing-wine squid, 20 sakes including rare labels from specialty shops; opened 11 April 2025.

places.notes: [Japanese · Dojima, fish shabu-shabu and whale hotpot] A white-wood counter restaurant on the west side of Kitashinchi, served on antique Ko-Imari and Kutani ware, with two signature hotpots: seasonal fish the head chef picks each morning, swished in a dashi of bonito, kombu and grilled kinmedai, and whale 'harihari-nabe' of rare cuts sent from Taiji in Wakayama (¥7,480 a head). Seasonal courses such as hamo shabu-shabu run ¥13,200–19,800 plus 10% service; after 20:00 you can order à la carte. Weekday lunch is a ¥1,500 bargain: a seafood bowl with thick slices, a meat-sauced dashimaki, nyumen and a house ice cream. English menu, English-speaking staff and wheelchair access.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the head chef picks seasonal fish at the market every morning; whale meat direct from a whaling master (網元) in 太地町, Wakayama; dishes served on antique Ko-Imari, Kutani and Oribe ware; about ten sakes including unlisted ones. A May 2026 diner found the owner running lunch alone. The Tabelog invoice number T7120001164445 is registered to 日本環境コンサルティング株式会社 at the shop's address (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02).

anecdotes.text: "I think getting all this for JPY 1500 is an incredible deal." — April 2026, the seafood bowl lunch.

"for dessert, you can choose from ice cream flavors like matcha, hojicha, black sesame, and coconut." — July 2026, a private booking.

places.notes: [Sushi izakaya · Higashimikuni, fish until 2 am] A roomy sushi izakaya by Higashimikuni Station, open since 2004 and serving until 2 am every night, with a counter, sunken-kotatsu tables, private rooms and a few outdoor tables. It is a favourite for office parties: two-hour all-you-can-drink courses at ¥5,000–5,500 open with the house eel sushi under crab and salmon roe and run through sashimi, tempura and butter-grilled scallops to nigiri and red miso soup, with the group's name printed on the menu (2025–2026). À la carte, people order thick-cut sashimi, a huge shrimp tempura and a crab gratin kept hot over a candle. About ¥6,000–9,000 a head with drinks (2026). Staff are warm, and one diner left with a small gift (June 2026). Smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog beyond booking notes; opened 17 February 2004 (Tabelog). Reviewers note a menu printed with the booking name (July 2025), warm service (2025–2026) and a small parting gift (June 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Banquet courses; sashimi platters; shrimp tempura.

anecdotes.text: "… a menu with the reservation name printed on it again." — July 2025, the JPY 5,000 Omakase banquet course.
"It's served with a personal stove (heated by a candle), so I could enjoy it piping hot." — August 2025, the crab gratin.
"I was looking for a sushi restaurant open late at night and ended up here." — December 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: すしまる屋 東三国店、寿司・鍋・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区東三国4-3-1 グロリアビル 1F、Midosuji 線 東三国駅5番出口から徒歩2分、毎日17:00〜翌2:00 (L.O.1:30)、予約可 (12月は席の指定不可)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、サービス料: 無し、57席 (掘りごたつ、カウンターなど)、10〜20名の個室、喫煙可、飲み放題、ベジタリアンメニューありの表示、2004年2月17日オープン。口コミ(2024年5月〜2026年9月): 2時間飲み放題の宴会コース5,000円と5,500円 (名物のうなぎの寿司にカニといくら、前菜8種、刺身5種、Hamamatsu のしらすと豆腐のサラダ、天ぷら、ホタテときのこのバター焼き、握り3貫、赤だし)、予約名入りのお品書き、厚切りの刺身、中トロ、ハマチ、甘エビ、ウニ、いくら、のどぐろ、ろうそくの火で温めるカニグラタン、南蛮の kara-age、はちみつポテト、エビとレンコンの揚げ物、万願寺とうがらしの天ぷら、カニクリームコロッケ、揚げ出し豆腐、うなぎ、生ガキ、ハモの天ぷら、大きなエビの天ぷら、食べログの予約で刺身5種が7種に、外のテーブル、ひとり約6,000〜9,000円、帰りに小さなおみやげ。

places.cuisine: Italian bar food (2024–2026) · lunch pasta ¥900, large free (October 2026): mentaiko and mushroom cream (January 2025, October 2026); chilled seafood tomato pasta with thin noodles and bonito flakes (September 2025, July 2026) · lunch glass of wine ¥600 (October 2026) · evening: three-kind antipasto with curried soybeans, Margherita with a thin crust on request (July 2025); roast black wagyu with red-wine sauce, pizza Siciliana with anchovy (December 2024); shrimp and mushroom Genovese, salad, quiche (December 2025); oysters escargot-style, meat dishes (February 2026); butter pumpkin potage, spare ribs (October 2026) · a wide drinks list (May 2024)
places.notes: [Italian · Nishinakajima, a small bar open till 1 am] A 14-seat Italian bar on a second floor three minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open since 2015, with lunch on weekdays and dinner until 1 am. Lunch is a ¥900 pasta with a free large portion, often the mentaiko and mushroom cream or, in summer, a chilled seafood tomato pasta with bonito flakes, and a ¥600 glass of wine (2025–2026). Evenings are for small plates and wine: curried soybeans in the antipasto, oysters done like escargot, roast wagyu, spare ribs, a butter-pumpkin potage, and thin-crust pizza (2024–2026). The owner will halve a salad on request (December 2025) and suggest drinks. Smoking is allowed. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 1 October 2015 (Tabelog). Reviewers: ask the master for drink recommendations (May 2024); the owner made a half-size salad on request (December 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch pasta; antipasti and wine at night.

anecdotes.text: "Pasta for JPY 900!! I also added some wine because it was such a great deal." — October 2026, lunch.
"To avoid having too much food, I spoke with the owner and requested a half-size salad." — December 2025.
"The oysters prepared escargot-style were also fantastic!" — February 2026.

places.name: 悠楽 (Yuraku)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Yakiniku comes with tare or salt; the lunch sets are kara-age, fried horse mackerel and tonjiru.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku and offal restaurant; the lunch tonjiru is full of pork.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–13:30 and 18:00–24:00; Sat and Sun 18:00–24:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog); lunch days may be irregular (August 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter of six and tables; smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi and two TVs for sports (Tabelog). A line at weekday lunch (2026).
places.neighborhood: 西中島4-8-30, ground floor of 山よしビル — 2–3 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Stn (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Yakiniku of Omi beef at night, set lunches by day (Tabelog) · night: Omi beef cuts, the popular "jou harami" (Tabelog); a ¥5,000 course with all-you-can-drink, from tongue to kalbi and offal, with kimchi and rice (September 2025); outside skirt (September 2026) · lunch sets about ¥1,000 with rice refills, a rolled omelette, salad and a small side: kara-age (spicy, or with homemade tartar) with tonjiru, fried horse mackerel with tonjiru (2025–2026); tonjiru instead of miso soup +¥50; a big bowl of pork-heavy tonjiru, the reason many come (2025–2026) · prices: tonjiru and kara-age set ¥890 (January 2026), ¥1,000 (May and October 2026); spicy kara-age set ¥950 (June 2026)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishinakajima, Omi beef by night, tonjiru by day] A small yakiniku restaurant near Nishinakajima-Minamigata that grills Omi beef in the evening, with TVs on for big matches (Tabelog), but is best known at lunch for its tonjiru: a bowl bigger than the rice, crammed with pork and vegetables, in a ¥1,000 set with kara-age or fried horse mackerel, a rolled omelette and free rice refills (2025–2026). Office workers line up for it; three women ran the lunch on a July 2026 visit. At night there is a ¥5,000 all-you-can-drink course from tongue through kalbi to offal (September 2025). Cash only; smoking allowed. Lunch days can be irregular, so check.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: Omi beef, "one of Japan's top three wagyu", with the popular "Jou Harami"; a good-value lunch; counter and tables, free Wi-Fi, two TVs for sports, surprise celebrations by arrangement. A July 2026 diner saw three women running lunch.
chef_bio.specialty: Tonjiru set lunches; Omi beef yakiniku.

anecdotes.text: "The bowl of pork miso soup was larger than the rice bowl, filled to the brim with plenty of ingredients." — July 2026, the tonjiru and fried horse mackerel set for JPY 1,000.
"Instead of miso soup, I recommend adding the Pork Soup for just an extra JPY 50." — October 2026.
"For the JPY 5000 course, we had everything from tongue to kalbi and horumon." — September 2025, a group of six.

places.name: 個室 和食 矗々家 難波店 (Chikuchikuya Namba)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The lunch gozen include tempura, dashi-maki, sashimi and miso soup; the dinner courses are chef's choice.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-focused Japanese restaurant cooking with Kansai-style dashi (July 2026).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00) (Tabelog). In the Obon week of August 2026 there was no weekday lunch (August 2026 review). Reservations accepted; the Tabelog remarks say lunch bookings are for groups of 4 or more on the banquet course, booked 2 days ahead, while August 2026 reviewers booked lunch for one and for three by phone — ask. About ten people queued before opening on a July 2026 day. Cards, PayPay and d Barai; no e-money (Tabelog). 64 seats in a three-storey house: counter (shoes off, August 2026), tatami, sunken seating and private rooms for 6 to 30+; banquets up to 60 (Tabelog). Smoking: Tabelog says non-smoking at lunch and smoking allowed at dinner; a July 2026 reviewer found smoking and non-smoking separated by floor. No toilets on the ground floor (August 2026). Children welcome (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Namba 3-7-11, behind Marui — 1 min from Namba Stn exit 1 (Midosuji Line)
places.cuisine: Japanese izakaya in a Kyoto-townhouse-style building: fish bought at the market each day by the head chef, over 50 local sakes (Tabelog shop text); fish from Kizu Market (August 2026) · lunch: "Obanzai Jussai Gozen" Ume ¥1,980 (sashimi, roast beef, tempura, dashi-maki, grilled fish, rice and miso soup), Take ¥2,380 (three sashimi and chawanmushi), Matsu ¥2,980 (with a small hot pot or wagyu steak) (July 2026); Chikuchiku Gozen ¥1,780 with three sashimi and tempura, bottled beer ¥770 (August 2026); rice in small, medium or large · dinner: chef's omakase banquets, food only, ¥5,000, ¥6,000 and ¥7,000, budgets up to ¥10,000 by request; courses with all-you-can-drink (Tabelog); grilled ayu and sea bream sashimi (July 2026); a course that came with a bottle of sake (August 2026)
places.notes: [Japanese izakaya · Namba, gozen lunches in an old townhouse] A three-storey, Kyoto-townhouse-style Japanese restaurant a minute from Namba Station, with a counter, tatami rooms and private rooms. At lunch it serves trays of ten small dishes — sashimi, tempura, dashi-maki, grilled fish — from about ¥1,800 to ¥3,000; at night, chef's-choice courses built on market fish, with over 50 local sakes. Lunch has a queue at opening; book, and ask about smoking if it matters (the rules depend on time and floor).

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): the head chef goes to the market every day to choose fish; over 50 local sakes; private rooms in a Kyoto-townhouse-style setting. Reviewers name Kizu Market as the source (August 2026). One other shop, 矗々家 JR大阪駅前店 in Umeda, appears on Tabelog with its listing on hold.

anecdotes.text: "There were about ten people lined up before the opening. The interior has an old-fashioned charm reminiscent of 'Spirited Away.'" — July 2026, at lunch.
"When I made the reservation by phone about two days ago ... only counter seats were available, but when we arrived ... a sunken kotatsu seating for us" — August 2026, three generations at lunch.
"It's a small three-story building, but there are no restrooms on the first floor, so elderly guests may find it challenging to go up to the second floor." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 個室 和食 矗々家 難波店、居酒屋・魚介・和食、大阪市中央区難波3-7-11、Marui の裏、なんば駅1番出口から徒歩1分、毎日11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)、17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、予約可、昼の予約は4名以上の宴会コースのみ (2日前まで)、カード・PayPay・d払い可、電子マネー不可、64席、個室あり (6名〜30名以上)、宴会は着席60名まで、昼は禁煙・夜は喫煙可、子ども可。料理長が毎日市場で魚を仕入れる、全国の地酒50種以上、京町家風の和食、おまかせ宴会コース5,000円・6,000円・7,000円。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): Obanzai Jussai Gozen の Ume 1,980円・Take 2,380円・Matsu 2,980円、御膳1,780円、瓶ビール770円、刺身、天ぷら、だし巻き、焼き魚、ご飯は大中小、Kizu Market の魚、開店前に10人ほどの行列、カウンターは靴を脱ぐ、1階にトイレなし、階ごとに喫煙と禁煙が分かれていたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Set gozen trays make lunch easy to order; shoes come off at the counter (2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: はり重カレーショップ (Harijyu Curry Shop)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the mainstays are breaded beef, chicken and pork katsu with curry or demi-glace sauce; the "Beef Wan" beef bowl is simmered in a sweet-salty sauce, and nothing is described as gluten-free.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the menu is built on Harijyu beef — beef curry, beef katsu, beef bowl, yakiniku set; the beef bowl has a dashi-based sauce (September 2026).
places.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–20:00; closed Tuesdays, but open on Tuesdays that are holidays or the day before a holiday, and every day in December (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Fills around noon at weekends, but seats free up quickly (June and October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transport IC, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR payment (Tabelog). 38 seats at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-9-17, the corner of the Harijyu building on Midosuji — 1 min from Namba Stn exit 14
places.cuisine: The casual curry and yoshoku shop of Harijyu, the Dotonbori wagyu sukiyaki house (reviews, July–August 2026): "Beef Wan" beef bowl with simmered egg, sukiyaki-style but more salty than sweet, with a little sansho — ¥1,200 (September 2026), ¥1,210 (June 2026), about ¥1,240 (July 2026); add red miso soup (July 2026) · beef katsu curry ¥1,540 (August 2026), chicken katsu curry ¥1,320 (June 2026), beef curry, mild and full of umami (July 2026) — another reviewer found it pleasantly spicy (October 2026) · bifukatsu of kuroge wagyu with demi-glace, with spaghetti, and an onion soup set (September–October 2026) · yakiniku set meal ¥2,200, said to use trimmings of steak-house wagyu (October 2026) · hayashi rice and vegetable salad (July 2026) · fukujinzuke and hojicha with the meal; drinks ¥660 (June 2026)
places.notes: [Yoshoku and curry · Dotonbori, Harijyu beef at diner prices] The Showa-era diner on the Midosuji corner of the Harijyu building, where the famous sukiyaki house serves its beef cheaply. Order the "Beef Wan" (a beef-and-egg rice bowl, about ¥1,200) or the beef katsu curry (¥1,540); the wagyu bifukatsu with demi-glace is the splurge. No bookings and no Tuesday service (except holidays and December); reviewers walk in at Sunday noon while the surrounding streets are packed with tourists.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews (July–August 2026): run by Harijyu, the Dotonbori sukiyaki house, next to the main restaurant and Harijyu Grill. The neighbouring record はり重 道頓堀本店 (osaka_harijyu_dotonbori) notes: "Harijyu Grill, a curry shop and the butcher share the building (official site)" and dates the house to a butcher opened in 1919 that came to Dotonbori in 1948.
chef_bio.specialty: "Beef Wan" beef bowl; beef katsu curry.

anecdotes.text: "While Namba is bustling with tourists, this restaurant is a hidden gem despite being an established spot. I was able to get in without waiting." — September 2026, Sunday noon.

"Today, Dotonbori is bustling with inbound tourists. While foreign visitors are everywhere, I make my way to the retro Showa-style Hariju Curry Shop, located along Midosuji." — October 2026, a regular.
"The paper napkins were folded into triangles, giving a wonderful retro feel." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: はり重カレーショップ、洋食・カレー・牛肉の丼、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-9-17、なんば駅14番出口から徒歩1分以内、月・水〜日11:30〜20:00、火曜休み (祝日・祝前日・12月は営業)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、38席 (4人テーブル8、2人テーブル3)、禁煙、公式 harijyu.co.jp。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): すき焼きのはり重が営む店、Beef Wan 1,200円・1,210円・1,240円ほど (時期で違う)、甘さより塩気、山椒、赤だし、ビーフカツカレー1,540円、チキンカツカレー1,320円、辛くないうまみのカレーという声と、ほどよい辛さという声、和牛のビフカツとデミグラスソース、オニオンスープのセット、焼肉定食2,200円、ハヤシライス、福神漬けとほうじ茶、ドリンク660円、昭和レトロの店内、道頓堀は観光客が多いが店は入りやすい。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk-in diner with a short set menu; reviewers note it stays easy to enter while Dotonbori is crowded with tourists (2026). No English evidence found.

places.cuisine: Oyster bar and meat bistro: over five kinds of raw oysters all year from around Japan — true oysters, rock oysters and branded oysters — raw, grilled, fried and in pasta; wagyu and game cooked over charcoal; fish direct from Miyakubo port in the Seto Inland Sea (Tabelog shop text) · courses: oyster lover's course ¥6,600; oysters, crab, lobster, beef, duck and foie gras ¥5,500; deluxe course with caviar and truffle ¥6,600 (Tabelog); +¥1,000 to choose 2–5 kinds of raw oyster on a course (June 2026) · raw oysters by origin, about ¥550–650 each: Nanao (Ishikawa), Ofunato (Iwate), Murotsu (Hyogo), Konagai (Nagasaki) (July 2026); assorted raw oysters from Hiroshima, Hokkaido, Iwate, Hyogo and Nagasaki ¥2,500 (August 2026) · fried oysters ¥550, fish and chips ¥1,580, fresh-fish risotto ¥1,580, oyster cream pasta (August 2026) · Imabari fish carpaccio ¥1,200, charcoal-grilled kuroge wagyu steak (Awaji beef) ¥3,980 (July 2026) · oysters with ikura and uni (October 2026) · crab bisque appetiser (August 2026) · roast duck lunch course (July 2026) · wine, all-you-can-drink wine on courses (June 2026) · dog menu: Awaji beef or chicken ¥600
places.notes: [Oyster bar · Shinmachi, raw oysters by origin and charcoal-grilled wagyu] A counter-led oyster and meat bistro in a quiet street of Shinmachi, with an ice bed of oysters from around Japan at the door. Order a tasting of three origins (about ¥600 each), staff explain each one, then the charcoal-grilled Awaji wagyu; courses run ¥5,500–6,600. Reviews in 2026 are mostly warm, but two diners in August–September 2026 found the cooking average and the wagyu disappointing. Book at weekends; open from 15:00 on weekdays.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 25 October 2021; oysters and meat, fish from Miyakubo port in the Seto Inland Sea, half-private rooms. A September 2026 reviewer mentions an open kitchen.
chef_bio.specialty: Raw oysters from several regions; charcoal-grilled wagyu.

anecdotes.text: "It was interesting to learn that each one has a different flavor depending on its origin, with the staff explaining the characteristics of each." — August 2026.

"I was a bit worried if it was okay to eat this many raw oysters ... if you have a sensitive stomach, it might be better to order a la carte and take it slow." — June 2026, a course with five kinds of oyster.

"Overall, the dishes were just average. The ajillo was a bit bland, and the pasta was overly seasoned." — August 2026; a September 2026 reviewer was also disappointed by the wagyu and saw a potato that fell on the kitchen floor served.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 四ツ橋・新町 牡蠣と肉たらしビストロAKIRA、オイスターバー・肉バル・ビストロ、大阪市西区新町1-9-17 矢野園ビル 1F、四ツ橋駅から徒歩5分、月〜金15:00〜23:00、土日祝11:30〜15:00、17:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00、ドリンク L.O. 22:30)、12月31日〜1月5日休み、予約可、コース以外はお通し500円、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、36席 (カウンター14、テーブル22)、禁煙 (入口横に灰皿)、ペットは入口のカウンターのみ、2021年10月25日オープン。全国の生牡蠣を常時5種以上、生・焼き・揚げ・パスタ、和牛とジビエの炭火焼き、Miyakubo の漁港 (Seto Inland Sea) から直送の魚、牡蠣好きのコース6,600円、牡蠣・カニ・ロブスター・牛・鴨・フォアグラのコース5,500円。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): 産地別の生牡蠣1個550〜650円、Nanao、Ofunato、Murotsu、Konagai、生牡蠣の盛り合わせ2,500円、カキフライ550円、フィッシュアンドチップス1,580円、Imabari の魚のカルパッチョ1,200円、黒毛和牛 (Awaji beef) の炭火焼きステーキ3,980円、犬のメニュー600円、店の人が産地ごとの味を説明、ふつうだった・和牛が残念だったという声も (2026年8〜9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain each oyster's origin (2026); counter seating. No English evidence found.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signatures are smoked wagyu, smoked sukiyaki with smoked raw egg, sashimi, bacon and sausage.

places.cuisine: Izakaya where almost everything is smoked, food and drinks (Tabelog shop text): instant-smoked wagyu tenderloin, 16-hour smoked cheese, smoked sausage, plank-grilled dishes, smoked lemon sour · "Sugiya's Specialty! Smoked Sukiyaki" ¥2,160, with smoked raw egg and smoked tomato sorbet as dips (September 2026) · smoked potato salad you finish yourself ¥690 (September 2026), with diced pickled radish (August 2026) · assorted sashimi with smoked soy sauce ¥1,480, instant-smoked wagyu tenderloin ¥2,700 (September 2026) · courses: instant-smoked tenderloin and seven smoked dishes ¥4,000 (smoked potato salad; smoked takuan, tarako, soy-pickled cream cheese and cucumber; smoked cheese; sashimi; tenderloin; smoked egg over rice; smoked raw chocolate), all-you-can-drink ¥1,500 + ¥500 for smoked drinks (July 2026); beef course with drinks ¥6,000; smoked sukiyaki course with drinks ¥6,000, finished with rice or udon (Tabelog) · horse sashimi, smoked bacon and sausage (August 2026) · smoked highball, smoked ginger highball, smoked sangria (2026)
places.notes: [Smoked-food izakaya · Namba, smoked sukiyaki at a counter] A hideaway on the 4th floor of a Namba back-street building — no sign outside, shoes off, a low door — where almost everything on the menu is smoked, down to the soy sauce and the lemon sour. Order the smoked sukiyaki (¥2,160) with its smoked egg and tomato-sorbet dips, the smoked potato salad and the 16-hour smoked cheese; the ¥4,000 course covers the classics. Counter only, adults only (20+), English menu. One July 2026 reviewer found many dishes too salty.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member) and website kunsei-sugiya-shouten.com: opened 7 March 2019; a smoked-food izakaya "tucked away in a back alley of Namba".

anecdotes.text: "I arrived at the right location, but I couldn't find the sign for the restaurant. After a bit of searching, I finally spotted a notice with the restaurant's name on the building directory and entered." — October 2026, a first visit.
"Eating the smoked tomato sorbet wrapped in meat like sushi made me involuntarily exclaim, 'So good!'" — September 2026, Sunday at 5 PM.
"Upon arrival, I found a reserved cushion with my name printed on it ... the appetizer was smoked takuan" — August 2026, a Friday booking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 燻製スギヤ商店、居酒屋・すき焼き、大阪市中央区難波1-7-18 心斎橋ヨーロピアンビル 4F、なんば駅14番出口から徒歩2分、火〜木・日・祝17:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:30)、金・土17:00〜23:30 (料理 L.O. 23:00)、月曜休み、12月30日〜1月4日休み、予約可 (Instagram の DM も)、混雑時は2時間制、お通し330円、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、28席 (カウンターのみ)、禁煙、20歳未満は入店不可、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、2019年3月7日オープン。和牛ヒレの瞬間燻製、16時間燻製のチーズ、燻製ソーセージ、板焼き、燻製レモンサワー、燻製すき焼きのコース6,000円。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): 燻製すき焼き2,160円 (燻製の生卵と燻製トマトのシャーベット)、燻製ポテトサラダ690円、刺身の盛り合わせ1,480円 (燻製醤油)、瞬間燻製の和牛ヒレ2,700円、7品のコース4,000円、飲み放題1,500円と燻製ドリンク+500円、お通しは燻製たくあん、看板がない、靴を脱いでかがんで入る、QR コードで注文、塩辛い料理が多いという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu in English, Chinese and Korean with photos, plus QR ordering (Tabelog; October 2026). Hard to find: no sign outside, 4th floor (2026). Adults only.

places.name: お好み焼き・鉄板焼 ぼんくら家 道頓堀店 (Okonomiyaki Teppanyaki Bonkuraya Doutonbori ten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki, yakisoba, sobameshi and tonpei-yaki are wheat-based and cooked on shared griddles. The steak teppanyaki is the only dish to ask about.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: okonomiyaki with pork, beef tendon, seafood and egg; the Bon-chan-yaki is served with a dashi (October 2026).
places.hours_raw: Mon 17:00–23:30; Tue–Sat 11:30–23:30 (last order 23:00); Sun 11:30–22:30 (last order 22:00); irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations, including seat-only bookings at lunch (August 2026); a two-hour limit when busy (August 2026). At least one drink per person; no service or table charge (Tabelog). Courses: six dishes with 90-minute all-you-can-drink from ¥3,500; the Bonkuraya course of six dishes with 120 minutes for ¥4,500 (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 87 seats, private hire for 50–87; non-smoking (Tabelog). Up a narrow staircase to the second floor, which a September 2026 diner flags for anyone with mobility issues. Takeaway and Uber Eats (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Okonomiyaki and teppanyaki (Tabelog) · the signature "fluffy and melty" okonomiyaki, Bonkura-yaki, with a soft batter, also with grated yam on top (2026) · Kasune-gi Mix-yaki with pickled ginger and dashi; Mixed Bon-chan-yaki served Akashi-yaki style with a dashi of green onion and bonito (October 2026) · pork okonomiyaki; Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki; Kyonyuu-yaki, a novelty okonomiyaki with mentaiko mayonnaise that the shop calls its No. 1 (Tabelog; August–September 2026) · tonpei-yaki, pork yakisoba, mega yakisoba, beef-tendon sobameshi with konnyaku, horumon, Iberico pork with chives and bean sprouts, steak teppanyaki (Tabelog; 2026) · courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥3,500; seasonal fairs (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Dotonbori, fluffy okonomiyaki above the main street] A big second-floor okonomiyaki and teppanyaki restaurant on the Dotonbori main street, up a narrow staircase, part of a small Osaka chain. The house okonomiyaki, Bonkura-yaki, is soft and fluffy; try the Akashi-yaki-style Bon-chan-yaki in dashi or the beef-tendon sobameshi, with tonpei-yaki and yakisoba on the side. Courses with all-you-can-drink start at ¥3,500, and a drink per person is required. Diners in 2026 found it reliable and easy to get into, with friendly staff, many from overseas, though several called the okonomiyaki ordinary and one found the mayonnaise heavy. Open daily to 23:30 (Mondays from 17:00, Sundays to 22:30).

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: okonomiyaki and teppanyaki in Dotonbori, famous for "fluffy and melty" okonomiyaki, featured in the media and visited by celebrities and comedians. A Bonkuraya branch in Nishinakajima is also on Tabelog. 2026 reviews note friendly staff, many from overseas.

anecdotes.text: "The Mixed Bon-chan-yaki was served in a style reminiscent of Akashiyaki, pairing perfectly with the dashi infused with green onions and bonito flakes. Personally, I found it to be the most delicious!" — October 2026.
"I climbed a narrow staircase to get here (be cautious if you have mobility issues)." — September 2026, Bonkura-yaki and beef-tendon sobameshi.
"Perhaps I had set my expectations too high, as the taste was quite ordinary." — August 2026, a first family visit to Dotonbori.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): お好み焼き・鉄板焼 ぼんくら家 道頓堀店、お好み焼き・鉄板焼き・居酒屋、道頓堀1-5-9 2F、Namba Walk B22出口から徒歩3分、月 17:00〜23:30、火〜土 11:30〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、日 11:30〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、予約可、1人1ドリンク制、サービス料・チャージなし、カード・PayPay可、87席、貸切50〜87名、禁煙、テイクアウト、Uber Eats、名物「ふわトロ」お好み焼き、メディアで紹介、芸能人や芸人も来店、6品と120分飲み放題のぼんくら家コース4,500円、90分飲み放題のコース3,500円から、明太マヨの人気No.1メニュー、本格ステーキ鉄板焼き。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): Bonkura-yaki、Kasune-gi Mix-yaki、明石焼き風の Mixed Bon-chan-yaki、とん平焼き、豚玉、豚焼きそば、牛すじそばめし、広島焼き、ホルモン、狭い階段で2階へ、土曜は2時間制、外国人スタッフが親切、お好み焼きは普通という声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests and friendly staff from overseas (August–September 2026). No English menu evidence found.

places.name: 焼鳥祐 アラカルト (Yakitori Yuu A La Carte)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Salt-seasoned skewers and the bird sashimi platter are where to start; sauce skewers, tsukune with sauce, chicken nanban, yam fries and the paitan ramen are not.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori and poultry restaurant.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Thu, Sun and holidays 11:30–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 11:30–24:00 (last orders 23:00 and 23:30) (Tabelog). The official site still lists 17:00 openings and Sundays closed, but diners came for lunch in September 2026 and on a Sunday evening in August 2026. Happy hour until 17:00 with chuhai and highballs at ¥99 (Tabelog; September 2026). Reservations online or by phone; walk-ins on a Friday (October 2026). Courses with two-hour all-you-can-drink ¥5,500, ¥4,500 Monday–Thursday (official site); banquet courses ¥4,500 and ¥6,500 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); the official site also lists PayPay, while Tabelog says no QR. 50 seats: a counter on the first floor facing the grill and tables upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; official site). Mobile ordering (August 2026). The entrance, upstairs beside a noodle shop, is a little hard to find (September 2026). Opened 20 April 2022 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nambanaka 1-15-23, 難波清覚ビル (Naniwa-ku) — 20 seconds from exit 5 of Namba Stn, 1 min from Nankai Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Yakitori and creative chicken dishes from branded and local birds, including the group's own brand 六角大魔王 and Nagoya Cochin (official site) · the signature mixed-bird platter of chicken, Kawachi duck, ostrich, pheasant and pigeon as sashimi or tataki, by the day's buying (official site; ostrich in August 2026) · 水煙蒸し, steamed in front of you with 六角大魔王 and Awaji Island vegetables (official site) · skewers: negima, heart, gizzard, skin, seseri, liver, cheese-topped skewers, tsukune with egg yolk, chicken wings with a spicy kick, pork lettuce rolls (2026) · ostrich yukke; chicken sashimi with wasabi leaves; chicken tataki; liver pâté in crisp pastry; yodare chicken; chicken nanban; yam fries; homemade pickles with quail eggs; fresh spring rolls as a starter; chicken paitan ramen to finish (2026) · about 20 wines and sakes, fruit chuhai and whisky (official site)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Namba, Yakitori Yuu's second shop: ostrich, duck and pheasant] The second shop of Yakitori Yuu, a popular yakitori place in Tanimachi 9-chome, a minute from Nankai Namba, with a counter facing the grill downstairs and tables upstairs. Beyond chicken skewers it serves a platter of different birds, chicken, Kawachi duck, ostrich, pheasant and pigeon, as sashimi or tataki, plus ostrich yukke, tsukune with egg yolk and creative plates such as liver pâté pastries, with a chicken paitan ramen to finish. It opens at 11:30 with a ¥99 chuhai and highball happy hour until 17:00, and stays open late. Diners in 2026 praise the variety and value; a couple found the grilling or the seseri less impressive than the creative dishes.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the second shop of the popular 焼鳥祐 in Tanimachi 9-chome, with courses at the same level as the main shop; branded and local chickens including the house brand 六角大魔王 and Nagoya Cochin; the group's other shops, listed on the site, include 鶏家 六角鶏 (Namba and Sakai-Higashi) and 麺屋 たにぐち. Per Tabelog: the main 焼鳥祐 takes no reservations; opened 20 April 2022.
chef_bio.philosophy: A space to unwind over good food and drink; the counter for dates and business dinners, tables upstairs for parties (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Mixed-bird platter; 水煙蒸し; tsukune with egg yolk.

anecdotes.text: "The yakitori was excellent, and the ostrich meat included in the assorted poultry was a rare and delicious treat. The chicken paitan ramen served at the end was exceptional." — August 2026.
"It's close to the station, but the entrance was a bit hard to find... I thought it was missing, but it's actually on the second floor of a udon shop!!" — September 2026, ¥99 happy hour.
"While the grilling technique could be better utilized to enhance the flavor, considering the location, cost, and ambiance, I believe it's a very convenient place to visit." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yu-alacarte.com): 焼鳥祐 アラカルト、谷町九丁目で人気の『焼鳥祐』2号店、難波駅1分、自社ブランド「六角大魔王」や名古屋コーチンなどの地鶏、名物『鳥類盛』(鶏、河内鴨、駝鳥、雉、鳩などをお造りやたたきで、その日の仕入れによって)、目の前で蒸し上げる「水煙蒸し」(六角大魔王と淡路島野菜)、おすすめユッケ、2時間飲み放題付のおまかせコース5,500円、月〜木限定の飲み放題付コース4,500円、本店同様レベル、ワインと日本酒を約20種、1Fカウンター、2Fテーブル席、難波中1-15-23 難波清覚ビル、難波駅5番出口から徒歩20秒、営業時間 月〜木17:00〜23:00・金土祝前日17:00〜24:00・日曜定休、カード・PayPay可、同じグループに鶏家 六角鶏、麺屋 たにぐちなど。食べログ (店舗会員): 焼き鳥・居酒屋・鶏料理、毎日11:30から (月〜木・日祝23:00まで、金土祝前日24:00まで)、昼は酎ハイとハイボール99円、予約可、50席、禁煙、2022年4月20日オープン。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 駝鳥のユッケ、鳥類盛、卵黄つくね、チキン南蛮、レバーパテ、山芋フライ、鶏白湯ラーメン、モバイルオーダー、3階まで席、入口が分かりにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site has an English version; many international staff and mobile ordering (August 2026).

places.name: 大阪カオマンガイキッチン (Osaka Khao Man Gai Kitchen)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Steamed-chicken khao man gai comes with a ginger sauce and a chili sauce whose contents are not described; the fried chicken and anything with soy or oyster sauce may contain wheat. The shop takes custom orders where it can (Tabelog).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the Thai chef takes custom orders where possible, but Thai dishes use fish sauce and shrimp, and the khao man gai is chicken.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:45 and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30) (Tabelog). At lunch you pay first and then sit (September 2026); lunch comes with oolong tea or coffee (October 2026); lunch reservations on weekdays only; courses need booking a day ahead; groups of 10 or more are contacted to confirm (Tabelog). Water and condiments are self-service (July and October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog); no service charge (Tabelog original text). 46 table seats on the ground floor and a loft; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking with a smoking area; children welcome; English menu; takeaway and Uber delivery (Tabelog). Opened 5 September 2013 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Nambanaka 2-4-14 (Naniwa-ku), on the way from Namba toward Nipponbashi — 2 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Thai, cooked by a Thai chef, with khao man gai as the specialty (Tabelog) · khao man gai of steamed chicken on chicken rice with a homemade sauce, ¥1,200 (October 2026); fried khao man gai with a sweeter, spicier sauce ¥1,180 (October 2026); half-and-half steamed and fried ¥1,250, with a red chili sauce and a strong ginger sauce, cilantro optional (September 2026) · pad thai with shrimp, fried tofu, egg, peanuts and sakura shrimp ¥1,050 at lunch (October 2026); gapao rice; mini tom yum noodles with flat rice noodles (July 2026) · dinner: tom yum kung, stir-fried clams, water spinach, roast pork, fried shrimp paste, glass-noodle salad, red curry, green-curry fried rice, fresh spring rolls (September–October 2026) · bua loy, rice balls in warm coconut milk (August 2026) · spice levels and orders adjusted on request (Tabelog; September 2026)
places.notes: [Thai · Nambanaka, khao man gai since 2013] A Thai restaurant run with a Thai chef since 2013, between Namba and Nipponbashi, with tables downstairs and a loft upstairs. The name is the dish to order: khao man gai of steamed chicken on fragrant rice, or fried, or half and half (¥1,180–¥1,250), with ginger and chili sauces and a soup; there is also pad thai, gapao rice, curries and, at night, tom yum kung and stir-fries. Lunch starts at 11:30 and runs to 14:45, with a free tea or coffee. Diners in 2026 call it great value and easy to get into; some found the flavors sweet or the rice too mild, which the self-service condiments can fix. Open daily.

chef_bio.origin: Thailand (Tabelog: run by a native Thai chef)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: an authentic Thai restaurant in Namba run by a native Thai chef, celebrating 12 years; khao man gai with a homemade sauce is the specialty; custom spice levels and orders accommodated where possible; opened 5 September 2013.
chef_bio.philosophy: The true flavors of Thailand, even for solo diners (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The crispy texture of the fried chicken and the moistness of the boiled chicken were both irresistible and absolutely fantastic." — September 2026, half-and-half khao man gai, a second visit.
"I arrived around 8:30 PM on a Sunday. There were three groups, including myself." — October 2026, khao man gai ¥1,200.
"Overall, the flavors were on the sweeter side." — October 2026, a first dinner visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 大阪カオマンガイキッチン、タイ料理・カレー、難波中2-4-14、各線 Namba 駅から徒歩2分、毎日11:30〜14:45・17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、予約可 (ランチの予約は平日のみ、コースは前日までに)、カード・電子マネー・QR可、サービス料なし、46席 (テーブル)、2階のロフト、貸切20〜50名、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)、ベジタリアンメニュー、英語メニュー、テイクアウト、Uber などのデリバリー、2013年9月5日オープン、12周年、タイ人シェフ、名物カオマンガイと自家製ソース、辛さなどの調整に対応。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): カオマンガイ1,200円、揚げカオマンガイ1,180円、ハーフ＆ハーフ1,250円、パッタイ1,050円、ガパオライス、トムヤムクン、ブアローイ、ランチは先払い、ウーロン茶かコーヒーつき、水と調味料はセルフ、味は甘めという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); a Thai chef; Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted.

places.name: たこやき座 (Takoyaki Za)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki, okonomiyaki and yakisoba are wheat-batter or wheat-noodle dishes.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus balls in a dashi-rich batter (August 2026).
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 10:00–24:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 09:00–24:00 (Tabelog). Takeaway, or eat in (2026). Reservations; private hire up to 50 (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; August 2026). 100 seats over three floors, with a tatami area (Tabelog; October 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). The listed website, takoyakiza.com, did not respond in November 2026.
places.neighborhood: Namba Sennichimae 12-2, diagonally across from Namba Grand Kagetsu — straight down Nankai Street from Namba Stn (Takashimaya)
places.cuisine: Takoyaki, okonomiyaki and yakisoba (Tabelog) · soft, fluffy takoyaki with a rich dashi batter, crisp outside and gooey inside, nine to a small order; sauce and mayonnaise, soy sauce, salt, garlic soy sauce or ponzu (2026); the salt and salt-mayo flavors are a regular's favorite (September 2026) · a six-flavor tasting set (August 2026) · okonomiyaki; pork yakisoba; doteyaki (2026) · draft beer, sake and shochu (Tabelog; 2026)
places.notes: [Takoyaki · Sennichimae, takoyaki across from NGK] A takoyaki shop diagonally across from Namba Grand Kagetsu, its walls covered in comedians' and celebrities' signatures, with seats on three floors including tatami, so you can sit down with a beer before or after a show. The takoyaki are small, soft and gooey in a dashi-rich batter; have them with sauce and mayo, or try salt, which one seven-time regular calls the best in the world, or a six-flavor set. Okonomiyaki, yakisoba and doteyaki too. Most 2026 diners were happy; one found the flavor not to taste and another the doteyaki small. Cash only, smoking allowed, open from morning to midnight.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: takoyaki, okonomiyaki and yakisoba diagonally in front of Namba Grand Kagetsu, with 100 seats on the second and third floors too. 2026 reviews note signatures of comedians and celebrities on the walls and friendly staff, many from overseas. No opening date is given; a September 2026 diner first came 11 years earlier.

anecdotes.text: "The takoyaki salt at Takoyaki Za is the best in Japan, and indeed, the best in the world." — February 2025, the fifth of seven visits.
"Among the many famous takoyaki shops in the area, I chose this place because it has a tatami seating area where I could relax." — October 2026, before a rakugo show at NGK.
"Even the plain one, which has no seasoning, is delicious on its own thanks to the rich dashi flavor." — August 2026, the six-flavor set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): たこやき座、たこ焼き・お好み焼き・焼きそば、難波千日前12-2、Namba 駅 (Takashimaya) から Nankai 通りをまっすぐ、Namba Grand Kagetsu の斜め前、月〜金 10:00〜24:00、土日祝 9:00〜24:00、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、100席 (2階・3階も)、座敷、貸切50名まで、喫煙可、テイクアウト、日本酒・焼酎。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): ふわふわでとろとろのたこ焼き、出汁の効いた生地、ソース、醤油、塩、にんにく醤油、ポン酢、塩マヨ、6種の食べ比べ、小9個、豚焼きそば、どて焼き、芸人やタレントのサイン、現金のみ、外国人スタッフが親切。

cultural_comfort.note: Friendly staff, many from overseas (August–September 2026); cash only. No English menu evidence found.

places.name: 鯛之鯛 難波店 (Tai no Tai)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi is served with salt or soy sauce, simmered fish is cooked in soy-based sauce, and tempura and croquettes are on the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish izakaya; the rice dishes come with bonito broth.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–23:30; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:30; food last order 22:30, drinks 23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; cancel at least three days ahead; online bookings are confirmed by phone; a two-hour limit at all tables; seating may be at the counter even if a table is requested (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments including Alipay (Tabelog). 80 seats round a central open kitchen, with noren-curtained semi-private rooms for up to 12 (Tabelog; August 2026). Heated-tobacco smoking allowed (Tabelog; August 2026). Weak phone signal in the basement; ask for the Wi-Fi to use the QR ordering (August–September 2026). Opened 14 April 2023, after moving from elsewhere in Namba (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashi-suji 2-6-14, アクロスビル B1F — 5 min from Namba Stn, 6 min from Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: Fish izakaya: staff visit Amakusa, Akashi and Kochi to buy fish, and serve aged sashimi, simmered fish of the day, grilled and fried fish (Tabelog; 2026 reviews) · sashimi platter ¥1,099 (Tabelog, 2026); sashimi with salt; sesame kanpachi (August–September 2026) · Tai no Tai course ¥7,500: edamame, mentaiko and simmered eggplant, a seven-kind sashimi platter with aged white fish, a salad of Kajitani Farm greens with fish sauce, snow crab and crab-miso cream croquettes, simmered fish, a clay-pot rice of ikura, uni and seafood; all-you-can-drink +¥1,500 (Tabelog; September 2026) · own-brand ikura from Hokkaido; ikura rice finished with bonito broth (May 2025; Tabelog); conger eel tempura, salmon and avocado poke, fried monkfish, tai-meshi (August–October 2026) · regional sake from ¥499 (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Fish izakaya · Shinsaibashi-suji, aged fish in a bright basement] A fish izakaya in a surprisingly high-ceilinged basement between Namba and Shinsaibashi, with a counter wrapped round an open kitchen and tables on both sides. Staff travel to Amakusa, Akashi and Kochi for fish, and the menu covers sashimi (aged white fish, sesame kanpachi, sashimi with salt), simmered fish of the day, conger eel tempura and fried monkfish. The ¥7,500 course (September 2026) ends with a clay-pot rice of ikura and uni; the ikura rice is finished with bonito broth poured over at the end (May 2025). Regional sake starts at ¥499. Staff are warm and quick. It can be loud and signal is weak underground, so ask for the Wi-Fi to order; heated tobacco is allowed. Weekends from noon.

roles: Manager and kitchen staff (unnamed); the Tai no Tai course is "crafted by the manager" (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a popular restaurant relocated from elsewhere in Namba; staff visit Amakusa, Akashi, Kochi and elsewhere for fresh and aged fish; a space modelled on izakayas abroad; own-brand ikura shipped from Hokkaido; daytime drinking at weekends; opened 14 April 2023. A September 2026 review: other Tai no Tai shops in Umeda, Kyoto Karasuma and Sannomiya.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Make delicious fish even better" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Aged sashimi; simmered fish; ikura clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: "Although it's located in the basement of a building, the ceiling is surprisingly high. The central kitchen is surrounded by a counter, with tables arranged on both sides" — August 2026.
"The salmon roe seafood rice bowl came with bonito broth, and I poured the broth over it at the end" — May 2025.
"The combination of mentaiko, sesame oil, and green onions served as an appetizer was shockingly delicious." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 鯛之鯛 難波店、居酒屋・海鮮・炉端焼き、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-6-14 アクロスビル B1F、なんば駅から徒歩5分、心斎橋駅から6分、月〜金17:00〜23:30、土日祝12:00〜23:30 (料理L.O.22:30、ドリンクL.O.23:00)、予約可 (キャンセルは3日前まで、全席2時間制)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、80席、のれんで仕切った半個室、加熱式たばこの喫煙可、2023年4月14日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): なんばの別の場所から移転した人気店、Amakusa、Akashi、Kochi などをスタッフが訪ねて仕入れる魚と熟成魚、海外の居酒屋のような空間、Hokkaido から直送の自社ブランドのいくら、週末は昼飲み、刺身の盛り合わせ1,099円、地酒499円から、店長のコース7,500円 (締めはいくらとうにの土鍋ご飯)、飲み放題1,500円追加。口コミ(2025年5月〜2026年10月): 塩で食べる刺身、熟成の白身、ごまかんぱち、明太子とごま油とねぎの小鉢、Kajitani Farm の葉野菜のサラダ、ずわいがにとかにみそのクリームコロッケ、煮魚、穴子の天ぷら、サーモンとアボカドのポキ、あんこうの唐揚げ、鯛めし、だしをかけるいくらの丼、天井が高い地下、中央のキッチンを囲むカウンター、にぎやか、電波が弱く Wi-Fi で注文、スタッフが気さく。

cultural_comfort.note: QR-code ordering over the shop Wi-Fi; friendly staff. No English menu evidence found.

places.name: カフェ 太陽ノ塔 なんばシティ店 (Cafe Taiyo No To)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The draw is decorated cakes; lunch is pasta and loco moco plates.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The cakes use cream and chocolate, and the lunch plates include meat and egg.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed when Namba CITY closes (Tabelog). Reservations accepted by phone, but not from 12:00 to 18:00; a two-hour limit when busy (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 100 seats: sofas, a tatami area where babies can lie down, toys and small chairs for children; smoking on the terrace only (Tabelog; June–October 2026). Children must order one kids-menu item each or pay ¥200 plus tax; one May 2026 diner with a baby was asked to buy baby food (Tabelog; May 2026). Orders by QR code (April and September 2026). English menu (Tabelog). Opened 26 April 2011 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: なんばCITY なんばカーニバルモール, Namba 5-1-60 — by Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Colourful retro café, a branch of the café whose main shop is in Nakazakicho (official site; September 2026) · cakes in the ¥900 range, served on plates drawn with sauce: seasonal lemon cake, Mont Blanc, chocolate cake with berry sauce, berry and blackberry cakes, a parfait (April–October 2026) · lunch plates with a drink bar and soup: loco moco with vegetables, tomato pasta (April–July 2026) · passion-fruit cream soda, raspberry tea, café latte, iced coffee, draft beer (April–October 2026)
places.notes: [Café · Namba CITY, cakes and a tatami corner for families] A bright, colourful branch of the Nakazakicho café in the Namba CITY mall, best known for its cakes, served on plates painted with sauce: lemon, Mont Blanc and berry cakes were around ¥900 in July 2026. It is unusually easy with small children: a tatami corner where babies can lie down, toys, small chairs and staff who offer to reheat a parent's plate (June 2026). Each child must order from the kids' menu or pay a ¥200 charge, which surprised one parent of a baby in May 2026. Lunch is loco moco or pasta with a drink bar; order by QR code. No phone bookings from noon to 6 p.m. Open daily to 10 p.m.

chef_bio.background: Official site (taiyounotou.com): a café and retro kissa in Nakazakicho and Namba; shops cafe太陽ノ塔 本店, GREEN WEST and NAMBA CITY, the 太陽ノ塔洋菓子店 cake shops (Nakazakicho, Hanshin Umeda, Shin-Osaka Station) and ニュー太陽ノ塔パーラー opening at Daimaru Umeda. Tabelog: café in Namba CITY, opened 26 April 2011.

anecdotes.text: "a staff member noticed and kindly asked, 'Would you like me to reheat that for you?'" — June 2026, a parent feeding a small child.
"The cake was in the 900 yen range, which seemed a bit pricey, but considering the decoration and the decent size of the cake, it felt reasonable." — July 2026.
"there is a system where you must order at least one item per baby, which was a bit surprising since my little one can only drink milk." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (taiyounotou.com): 中崎町・なんばのレトロ喫茶、cafe太陽ノ塔 本店、GREEN WEST、NAMBA CITY、太陽ノ塔洋菓子店、阪神梅田本店、大丸梅田店のニュー太陽ノ塔パーラー、新大阪駅の売場。食べログ: カフェ 太陽ノ塔 なんばシティ店、カフェ、大阪市中央区難波5-1-60 なんばCITY なんばカーニバルモール、毎日11:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.21:00、ドリンクL.O.21:30)、なんばCITYの休みに準ずる、予約可 (12時〜18時は受けない、混雑時は2時間制)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、100席、テラスは喫煙可、子どもはキッズメニュー1品か200円のチャージ、英語のメニュー、2011年4月26日オープン。口コミ(2026年4月〜10月): 900円台のケーキ、ソースで絵を描いた皿、レモンケーキ、モンブラン、ベリーのケーキ、パフェ、ロコモコとトマトのパスタのランチ (ドリンクバーとスープ)、パッションフルーツのクリームソーダ、生ビール、座敷とおもちゃと子ども用のいす、料理を温め直してくれたスタッフ、赤ちゃんにも1品の注文が必要で驚いたという声、QR コードで注文。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu listed (Tabelog); QR-code ordering.

places.name: 西梅田 らんぷ (Nishi Umeda Ranpu)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in a soy-sauce broth; kara-age and gyoza on the side.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork and bonito broth, pork chashu.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closing days not fixed, posted on Instagram @lamp.nishiumeda (Tabelog). Opened May 15, 2017 (Tabelog). Ticket machine (October 2026). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 6 at the counter, three tables for 2, one for 4; non-smoking; no reservations (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Fukushima 6-chome, a roadside shop west of Nishi-Umeda — 7–8 min from JR Osaka and Hankyu Umeda
places.cuisine: Shoyu ramen of Kagoshima pork and thick-shaved bonito with soy sauces from around Japan; thin noodles of 100% domestic wheat from Menya Teikaku in Kyoto (October 2026) · pork shoyu ramen ¥920, the most popular bowl, ringed with thin flower-shaped chashu, green and white onion (2026 reviews) · seasoned egg +¥100; kara-age set +¥320 (October 2026); rice; gyoza (October 2026) · pork ginger aemen (brothless) with thicker noodles ¥980 (October 2026) · tsukemen (Tabelog; September 2026) · draft beer ¥500 (October 2026) · pepper, gochujang and garlic on the table
places.notes: [Ramen · Fukushima, west of Nishi-Umeda, flower-ring chashu] A sixteen-seat roadside ramen shop a short walk west of Nishi-Umeda, open since 2017. The ¥920 pork shoyu ramen is the one to order: a light but savoury broth of Kagoshima pork and thick-shaved bonito, thin noodles from Kyoto's Menya Teikaku, and tender thin chashu laid round the rim like a flower. Add a seasoned egg, a ¥320 kara-age-and-rice set or gyoza; there is also a ginger-pork aemen and tsukemen. Buy a ticket at the machine; cash only. Weekday lunch at 11 had no queue in October 2026, and diners praise the polite, tidy service.

chef_bio.background: Opened May 15, 2017 (Tabelog). An October 2026 diner quotes the shop's motto, "Bringing light to the city with a bowl of ramen", and describes Kagoshima pork, thick-shaved bonito, soy sauces from across Japan, and noodles of 100% domestic wheat from Menya Teikaku in Kyoto.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Bringing light to the city with a bowl of ramen" (as quoted, October 2026).

anecdotes.text: "Although the Pork Shoyu Ramen isn't a chashu ramen, I was delighted to find it topped with beautiful flower-shaped chashu." — September 2026.
"The chashu was beautifully presented, resembling a rafflesia, and the shoyu ramen was light yet rich in flavor." — October 2026.
"The broth was labeled as pork shoyu, but it had a clear quality and was very tasty." — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine; attentive staff (2026). No English evidence found.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Mostly pasta and bread (an all-you-can-eat bruschetta and pasta lunch); steak, roast beef and salads too.

places.notes: [Italian · Umeda, Doyama, a seventh-floor date spot] A dim, sofa-lined Italian dining bar on the seventh floor of a Doyama building, near Nakazakicho, with a night view and oil lamps on the tables. It is built for celebrations: birthday plates with a message, an ¥4,500 eight-dish anniversary course, and all-you-can-drink; at lunch a ¥2,365 deal brings six bruschetta with unlimited pasta and bread. Diners praise the smoked beef tartare under dry ice, the carbonara and the caprese with brûléed figs; a few found the service rushed or uneven and the pasta bland. Expect a ¥330 evening charge, a one-drink-one-dish rule, a young, mostly female crowd, and no children under school age.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a cozy Italian dining bar 5 minutes from Umeda with sofa seating, a stylish design and a night view; surprise message plates for birthdays and anniversaries; an all-you-can-eat bread and bruschetta lunch. Opened August 3, 2022.

anecdotes.text: "the momentarily smoked beef tartare, was a showstopper with dry ice creating a smoky effect when the lid was lifted" — October 2026.
"The interior is quite dark, as you can see from the pictures, with only the oil lamps on the tables providing light." — August 2026.
"the last call for drinks was 45 minutes before closing, which seemed a bit excessive." — September 2026.

places.notes: [Kushikatsu · Kitashinchi, skewers and wine till 3 am] A seventeen-seat creative kushiage bar in Kitashinchi, open since 2017, pairing light, finely battered skewers with over twenty wines. The omakase runs from ¥6,600 and keeps the skewers coming until you say stop: angel shrimp, bacon-wrapped simmered daikon, sea bream in shiso, wagyu chateaubriand. Set courses are ¥7,700 and ¥9,900, with a sea-bream chazuke or Inaniwa udon to finish. Diners single out the attentive, well-paced service and the private rooms, including an upstairs room with a sunken kotatsu, popular for business dinners. Courses only until 10 pm, then à la carte until 3 am; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): seasonal ingredients crafted by skilled artisans; carefully selected fresh seafood, domestic meats and seasonal vegetables; light skewers with reduced fat; homemade sauces and seasonings; over twenty wines with drink recommendations; a refined Japanese-modern room with private rooms for up to 8. Opened January 30, 2017. Sister shop: Ohana Kitahama.
chef_bio.philosophy: The marriage of wine and kushiage (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The first skewer is the angel shrimp. The batter is finely textured, and the oil is remarkably light." — February 2026.
"The second floor features a private room with a sunken kotatsu, which is a nice touch." — March 2026.
"the selection of all-you-can-drink wine was a bit disappointing, leading us to stick with beer and highballs instead." — March 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Each dish explained; staff recommend wines (2026). No English evidence found.

places.notes: [Tempura · Kitashinchi, a sister of Kushikatsu Bon] A ten-seat L-shaped tempura counter on a third floor near Nishi-Umeda, run by the group behind the Kitashinchi kushikatsu shop Kushikatsu Bon, with big windows and a calm, spacious room. At night the chef fries one piece at a time in a sesame-and-cottonseed blend, from live shrimp and seasonal fish to wagyu chateaubriand and caviar-topped bites, in omakase courses from ¥8,000 that you stop when full. At lunch (Wednesday to Saturday) there is only a pork-cutlet set of Yamagata pork with a croquette and a seafood fry, ¥2,200 in mid-2026, a bargain for Kitashinchi that diners rave about. A 5% service charge applies; children from school age.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a tempura specialty restaurant inheriting the skills of the kushikatsu shop "Kushikatsu Bon"; Taihaku sesame oil and cottonseed oil; an L-shaped 10-seat counter; 7th anniversary. Opened October 18, 2019. Sister shops named in courses and reviews: Kushikatsu Bon and Kushiage Kitchen Dan, with an Okinawa Kume branch of Dan announced for late November 2026. An April 2026 diner calls Kushikatsu Bon a Michelin restaurant (the reviewer's claim).
chef_bio.philosophy: Carefully selected ingredients, oil and temperature (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Omakase only: sushi of fish from around Japan, the rice served at body warmth, with many small dishes first, in a counter room styled like a tea room (Tabelog) · omakase course of 18 items ¥17,600 (from August 2025; Tabelog, tax included) · dishes named in 2025–2026: spinach and turnip soup, botan shrimp, marinated mackerel, grilled horse mackerel, abalone with liver sauce, liver with Nara pickles, fried shrimp taro with karasumi mochi, fugu milt, Matsuba crab chawanmushi, crab and abalone, matsutake and sea bream soup, saikyo-grilled fish, grilled nodoguro; nigiri of red-vinegar rice, e.g. swordtip squid, Spanish mackerel, akami, chutoro, nodoguro, a fluffy anago to finish · over 15 sakes, small tasting pours, sake in a wine glass on request; sommelier-chosen wines (Tabelog; 2025–2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, an omakase in a tea-room setting] An eight-seat counter on a second floor in Kitashinchi, styled like a tea room with tea utensils on display, run by a chef with a background in Japanese cuisine. There is one menu, an ¥17,600 omakase: a long run of small dishes such as abalone with its liver sauce, karasumi mochi or crab chawanmushi, then nigiri on red-vinegar rice served warm, often with nodoguro and a fluffy anago to finish. Ask to taste the sakes in small pours, or in a wine glass. A January 2026 diner noticed many foreign guests; overseas bookings need full contact details. One January 2026 diner found the nigiri seasonings uneven; most others call it a hidden gem.

chef_bio.background: The Tabelog invoice number T8810531654620 is registered to an individual, 山本広孝 (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02). Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a relaxing space without formality, inspired by a tea room; sushi from ingredients across Japan served at the right temperature; omakase only from August 2025. A November 2025 regular of twelve visits has come since "before it became independent" and says the chef has a background in Japanese cuisine.
chef_bio.philosophy: Each dish "carefully crafted to be savored at the perfect temperature, including the ideal warmth of the sushi rice" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase of small dishes and red-vinegar nigiri.

anecdotes.text: "Additionally, you can enjoy Japanese sake in a wine glass if you ask." — November 2025, a twelfth visit.
"There were many foreign guests as well, all captivated by the chefs' techniques." — January 2026.
"Each piece of sushi was beautifully presented on the tatami mat." — September 2025, a second visit.

places.notes: [Chinese · Kitashinchi, modern Chinese at a counter] A 13-seat modern Chinese restaurant in Kitashinchi since 2009, on Tabelog's Chinese WEST 100 list in 2021, 2023 and 2024, where you watch the chef at the open kitchen. Dinner is reservation-only: Peking duck without a trace of gaminess, a mapo tofu loud with Sichuan pepper, and the signature Shanghai crab yakisoba of thin Hong Kong noodles under crab miso, with jar-aged Shaoxing wine; the eight-dish course with shark fin is ¥10,000 plus tax and service, and dishes can come in half portions. Weekday lunch is first come: a colourful plate of small dishes or a mapo tofu rice set, about ¥1,400–1,500, cash or PayPay. One cook works the kitchen, so dinner moves slowly (October 2026).

chef_bio.background: The Tabelog invoice number T3810347045687 is registered to an individual, 北村　克治 (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02). Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: modern Chinese from Chinois style to home cooking, the Shanghai crab yakisoba, jar-aged Shaoxing wine, an open kitchen with a counter; opened 20 May 2009; Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 in 2021, 2023 and 2024. A July 2026 diner writes that it is run by a man and a woman from China; an October 2026 diner saw the chef cooking alone.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Freshness is important for any ingredient" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Shanghai crab yakisoba; Peking duck; mapo tofu.

anecdotes.text: "It is run by a man and woman from China." — July 2026, the colourful plate lunch.

places.notes: [Izakaya · Kitashinchi, kamameshi by night, fresh pasta by day] A stylish 18-seat izakaya in Kitashinchi, open since 2024, with two lives. At lunch office workers queue at the red easel for ¥1,200 plates of chewy fresh pasta from Awaji, two choices a day such as clam Genovese or mentaiko cream, with salad, a cold soup and bread (¥100 more for a large). At night it serves seasonal small dishes with sake and a kamameshi to finish, or the ¥8,000 omakase course, and a rich pudding to end. Diners call it reasonable for Kitashinchi, and it is easy for solo diners.

chef_bio.background: The Tabelog invoice number T5810870182145 is registered to an individual, 松谷　竜二郎 (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02). Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: seasonal small dishes and kamameshi, an extensive sake list, a rich pudding, an upscale yet relaxed room; opened 13 May 2024. Lunch reviews from 2025–2026 name the pasta supplier as Awaji Men-gyo.

anecdotes.text: "The fresh pasta was incredibly chewy!" — September 2025, the bacon and garlic-shoot tomato lunch.
"Each dish was delicious, and the highlight was definitely the kamameshi, which was incredibly tasty." — April 2026, dinner with colleagues.
"It's a welcoming place for solo female diners as well." — October 2026, the ¥1,200 daily pasta.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): RYU、居酒屋・釜飯、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-2-3 谷安セジエムビル 1F、北新地駅から3分、大きな壁の看板が目印、月〜土・祝前日・祝後日11:30〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)、18:00〜22:00、日・祝休み、予約可、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、18席、加熱式たばこのみの喫煙スペース、車いす可、無料 Wi-Fi、子ども・ベビーカー可、2024年5月13日オープン、季節の小鉢と釜飯、日本酒、濃厚なプリン、小さめの釜飯、季節のおまかせコース7品8,000円 (〆は釜飯か Awaji の生パスタ)。インボイス登録は個人の松谷竜二郎。口コミ(2025年5月〜2026年10月): 平日ランチの生パスタ1,200円、大盛り100円、日替わり2種、ホタテと明太子のクリーム、アサリのジェノベーゼ、牛すじと小松菜のペペロンチーノ、ベーコンとにんにくの芽のトマト、チョリソーとししとうのトマト、いんげんとしらすのバジルクリーム、サラダと冷たいスープとパン、Awaji Men-gyo の生パスタ、土曜は金曜のメニューのことも、夜の釜飯がおいしい、北新地にしては手ごろ、ひとりでも入りやすい、赤いイーゼルの看板。

cultural_comfort.note: Two daily lunch pastas ordered by word (May 2025); course or à la carte at night. No English evidence found.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kushiage coated in flour, egg and fine crumbs from French bread dough (official site; Tabelog), plus a homemade curry bread and a ramen to finish.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat and seafood skewers in an egg-and-crumb coat; the dipping sauces include a tentsuyu (official site).

places.neighborhood: 堂島1-3-16, 4F of 堂島メリーセンタービル, west of Kitashinchi — 5 min from Kitashinchi and Nishi-Umeda Stns
places.cuisine: Kushiage omakase by an owner with over 20 years in Japanese cuisine: a thin coat (flour, egg and crumb applied as separate steps, with ultra-fine crumbs from French bread dough) fried in rice oil, about 15–20 skewers with dips from sauce to salt, lemon and a tentsuyu with plenty of grated daikon (official site; Tabelog) · courses (official site; Tabelog, tax included): standard, 15 skewers and dessert, ¥12,100; recommended, with abalone, shark fin and caviar, ¥15,400; special, adding strip loin and truffle, ¥18,700; rice or noodles to finish are extra (official site) · skewers named in 2026: potato and mascarpone with caviar, sweet shrimp with its head, okra, horse mackerel, Amanoyuki pork, Yoshida Farm caciocavallo wrapped in nori, abalone with liver sauce and wasabi, corn skewered kernel by kernel, eel rolls, beef with paprika, dried abalone, two kinds of bell pepper, sweet-potato curry bread; extras: a sukiyaki truffle skewer, a shoyu ramen of Daisen chicken broth; a sea urchin jelly and a cabbage salad with house onion dressing to start (January–September 2026)
places.notes: [Kushiage · Dojima, a light omakase] An eight-seat kushiage counter west of Kitashinchi whose owner spent twenty years in Japanese cuisine and learned from the Kahala school of creative kushiage. The coat is thin and the oil rice oil, and a regular on a seventh visit felt no heaviness the next day (May 2026). Skewers run from potato and mascarpone under caviar to Yoshida Farm caciocavallo in nori and abalone with its own liver sauce, with dips of sauce, lemon salt or a daikon-heavy tentsuyu. Courses are ¥12,100, ¥15,400 with abalone, shark fin and caviar, or ¥18,700 with truffle; a ramen of Daisen chicken can follow. The chef is warm and explains each skewer; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: an owner with more than twenty years of training in Japanese cuisine; seasonal ingredients chosen at the market; the coat kept thin by separating the flour, egg and crumb steps; frying judged by sound, colour and bubbles. Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: techniques passed down from places like "Kahala" and "inspired by legends like Morisawa Kahala"; opened 7 August 2020. An April 2026 diner came after receiving a card at Kahala and found the same cheese served.
chef_bio.philosophy: "その一瞬を見極める" (judging the moment) (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kushiage omakase; caciocavallo in nori; abalone with liver sauce.

anecdotes.text: "Even after eating my fill, I didn't feel any heaviness in my stomach the next day." — May 2026, a seventh visit, the ¥12,100 course.
"We started with a jelly topped with sea urchin, which was an immediate delight." — September 2026, a group of seven at the counter.
"I tried fried shark fin for the first time, and it was delicious." — September 2026, the luxurious course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 串揚げ 名倉、北新地の一角、和食の道で20余年の研鑽を積んだ店主のこだわりの串、季節の美味しさ、誕生日・接待・会食・記念日に、旬に重きを置き市場で自ら目利き、粉・卵・パン粉をつける工程を分けて衣を薄く、油の音・色・泡を見極める、素材に合わせて揚げ方を変える、スタンダードコース12,100円、鮑・フカヒレ・キャビアのおすすめコース15,400円、トリュフの特撰コース18,700円、約20種の串、ソース・塩・レモン・鬼おろしたっぷりの天つゆ、〆のご飯ものはコースに含まれない。食べログ (店舗会員): 堂島1-3-16 堂島メリーセンタービル 4F、北新地駅と四つ橋線から徒歩5分、月〜土・祝・祝前日・祝後日17:30〜23:00、日曜休み、予約可、サービス料なし、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター8席、禁煙、英語のメニュー、持ち込み可、小学生から可、2020年8月7日オープン、フランスパンの生地の極細のパン粉と米油、Yoshida Farm のカチョカヴァロ、自家製カレーパン、Kahala で学んだ技。口コミ(2026年1月〜9月): ジャガイモとマスカルポーネとキャビア、甘エビ、オクラ、アジ、Amanoyuki の豚、のりで巻いたチーズ、アワビの肝ソースとわさび、一粒ずつ刺したとうもろこし、うなぎ巻き、牛肉とパプリカ、干しアワビ、2種のピーマン、さつまいものカレーパン、すき焼きトリュフ串、Daisen の鶏のスープの醤油ラーメン、ウニのジュレ、玉ねぎドレッシングのキャベツ、翌日も胃がもたれない、親しみやすい大将、18回通う常連。

cultural_comfort.note: Tabelog lists an English menu; the chef explains each skewer (May 2026).

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu centres on pasta, gratin, cutlets, fried dishes and bread or rice with sets (Tabelog menu; reviews); carpaccio, roast beef and grilled meats are not described.

Reservations taken, not for the café; changes or cancellations at least two days ahead; 2-hour limit (Tabelog; October 2026 review). Orders by QR code (October 2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay; no e-money. 130 seats: 82 inside, 48 on the terrace; non-smoking (smoking area in the store); wheelchair and stroller friendly; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: All-day French-Italian restaurant and café with a green terrace (Tabelog) · burrata caprese, black-wagyu roast beef, prosciutto sliced on an Italian slicer, TUFFE salad with grilled chicken, pastas (Awaji beef Bolognese, Yumi pork carbonara, shrimp and karasumi), shrimp and mushroom gratin, Yumi pork spare ribs and cutlet, fish and chips (Tabelog menu, October 2026) · lunch sets with bread or rice, daily pasta, hamburg steak, beef omurice; truffle fries, cheesecake, homemade lemonade (reviews) · BBQ and beer-garden courses with all-you-can-drink ¥5,000–7,000
places.notes: [Italian · Shinsaibashi, terrace restaurant on Daimaru's 7th floor] A big, bright French-Italian restaurant and café on the 7th floor of the Daimaru Shinsaibashi main building, away from the dining floor, the floor's only terrace restaurant, with sofas, greenery and 48 terrace seats. Lunch is the busy time: pasta, gratin, hamburg steak and beef omurice with freshly baked bread that diners in October 2026 single out, plus truffle fries and cheesecake. Families with strollers, friends and solo shoppers mix; a line forms at opening. Orders are by QR code, though staff took spoken orders from older guests. In summer the terrace runs BBQ and beer-garden courses.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, TUFFE opened on 20 September 2019 on the 7th floor of the Daimaru Shinsaibashi main building as an all-day French-Italian restaurant of about 130 seats, the only terrace restaurant on that floor; prosciutto is sliced to order on a slicer brought from Italy. The official site gave no readable text, so the operator is not recorded here.
chef_bio.specialty: Terrace lunch: pasta, gratin and fresh bread.

anecdotes.text: "The freshly baked bread that came with the set (or as a side) was particularly fragrant and fluffy, making it impossible to stop eating." — October 2026, second visit.
"Ordering was done via a QR code, which allowed us to take our time choosing from the holiday menu." — October 2026, holiday lunch.
"The clientele was diverse, with groups coming in with strollers, girls' nights out, couples, families, and solo diners." — October 2026, holiday.
"The truffle flavor was a bit subtle, but they were delicious." — October 2026, truffle fries.

places.cuisine: Fish izakaya conveying "the deliciousness of fish" (Tabelog): the chef's sashimi platter (bluefin tuna from Nagasaki, sea bream from Ehime, Spanish mackerel from Awaji, red shrimp, surf clam …), swordtip squid three ways, kinmedai and local fish salt-grilled or simmered, sea-bream rice cooked with kombu and bream-bone stock, wagyu aburi sushi, charcoal-grilled thick beef tongue, teppan potato-mentaiko omelette, sake-steamed clams (Tabelog menu, June 2026) · weekday lunch set meals ¥1,600–1,800 with grilled fish (October 2026 review) · a wide local sake list; all-you-can-drink courses
places.notes: [Izakaya · Ura Namba, sashimi and sea-bream rice] A calm, softly lit fish izakaya in an Ura Namba back alley, five minutes from Namba Station, with weekday fish lunches and day drinking from 2 PM at weekends. The sashimi platter, thick-cut and sometimes served over dry ice, is the house showpiece; diners in October 2026 also praise the sake-steamed dishes, grilled collar, sea-bream rice and the local sake, and a ¥6,000 course with all-you-can-drink. Several diners note the manager's attentive service, a welcome card and Halloween cookies at the door; one found the staff's chatter distracting, another got a beer that was not cold. The tofu starter is charged.

roles: Kitchen staff unnamed; a manager praised by name of role only in reviews (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, "Uoden" is a restaurant that conveys the deliciousness of fish, which has long been essential to Japanese dining; it opened on 10 June 2015 and started weekday lunch on 16 March. Its English page calls it "Uranamba Sakaba Uo…" (truncated).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Seasonal fish is flavorful, delicious, and packed with nutrients" (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The sashimi is cut into generous pieces, providing a satisfying bite with each slice." — September 2026, seafood assortment.
"However, I was seated in front of the drinkers, and I found the staff's casual conversations quite distracting." — October 2026, second visit.
"On our way out, the manager was handing out Halloween cookies, and we decided we would definitely come back!" — October 2026.
"The presentation was impressive, complete with dry ice for a great visual effect, and the fish tasted fantastic." — October 2026.

places.cuisine: Japanese-Italian izakaya: sashimi of fish bought at the market each morning (bluefin tuna, Iwate katsuo tataki, Awaji hamachi, house saba sushi), pasta such as whole blue-crab pescatora, pizzas baked next door (large and thin-crusted), carpaccio, ajillo, white-wine-steamed seafood, fritto, burrata, steak (Tabelog menu, October 2026; reviews) · daily specials on the board · wine; all-you-can-drink courses such as ¥4,800
places.notes: [Italian izakaya · Nambanaka, sashimi beside pizza and pasta] A casual Japanese-Italian izakaya by Namba Station exit 5, open since 2008, where morning-market fish comes as sashimi alongside pizza, pasta and garlicky ajillo. It is one of a cluster of shops from the same company on the street: the Japanese-leaning 裏剣 shares the menu board out front, and pizzas come from next door. Diners in 2026 like the long menu, the speed, the staff and the all-you-can-drink courses; one September diner found nothing memorable. Names are similar, so check the address.

roles: Kitchen staff unnamed; the first shop of 小野料理研究所 (onofoodlab.co.jp)
chef_bio.background: Per onofoodlab.co.jp, 小野料理研究所 runs 料理屋 哲剣, 大衆酒場 裏剣, 立ち飲み テッケン (opened 1 November 2022, "ten seconds' walk from the main shop", at Nambanaka 2-8-92) and セルフで呑みほ 哲ちゃん. Tabelog gives TEKKEN's opening as 13 July 2008 and says fish is bought every morning.
chef_bio.philosophy: "A casual Italian izakaya you can drop by anytime" (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The menu is divided on a single board, with TEKKEN on the right and Ura-ken on the left." — October 2026.
"While all the dishes were truly tasty, the ajillo was particularly exceptional." — July 2026.
"There are several locations of the same chain nearby, and their names are quite similar, so I recommend confirming the address before you go." — September 2026.
"Nothing stood out as especially delicious, and I don't remember much." — September 2026, all-you-can-drink course.

places.cuisine: Smoked-food izakaya with an open kitchen: assorted smoked delicacies (cheese, shishamo, iburigakko and more), sirloin yukhoe with Oita "dragon's egg" yolk, salt pork-belly kakuni cutlet, seasonal dishes (Omi duck, sanma tempura, porcini satsuma-age), kamameshi cooked in a pot to finish, miso soup (Tabelog menu, September 2026; reviews) · oden as the starter · smoked gin and tonic, smoked beer, smoky whiskies, sake; all-you-can-drink course ¥5,000
places.notes: [Izakaya · Ura Namba, smoked food and kamameshi] A calm, grown-up smoked-food bar in an Ura Namba back alley — formerly bene pesce — where the smell of smoke and dashi greets you at the door. The ¥858 platter of smoked delicacies is the standard opener, then seasonal plates, and a kamameshi rice pot to finish (order it early; it takes time). Drinks lean smoky: smoked gin and tonic, smoked beer and peaty whiskies. The oden starter wins praise. Diners in 2026 call it great for a date or a second stop; one August diner noted that the smoked beer has got pricier. No minors are admitted, and the shop says it cannot cater for allergies.

roles: Kitchen staff unnamed; a shop of 株式会社ベネ (bene-p.jp)
chef_bio.background: Per bene-p.jp, 株式会社ベネ (representative director 増田幸司) runs the 燻製酒場 and 鮭酒場 restaurants — トリベーネ in Abeno, Nippombashi (Ura Namba no. 2), Ura Namba (main shop) and Umeda, and two サーモンベーネ — plus the smoked-food brand 勘田亀吉 and a building-materials business. Tabelog lists the former shop name as bene pesce.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Good time & space creation" (bene-p.jp).

anecdotes.text: "As soon as I approached the entrance, I was greeted by an amazing aroma, and once inside, the delightful scents of smoked dishes and dashi filled the air!" — September 2026.
"The Kamameshi (rice cooked in a pot) was very tasty, but it takes some time to prepare, so it's best to order it as soon as possible." — August 2026.
"It's a shame that the smoked beer has become more expensive over the years, so I couldn't order it" — August 2026.
"The classic smoked cheese, in particular, was rich and absolutely fantastic." — October 2026, second visit.
