places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thick whole-wheat noodles.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and pork-bone dip with chashu and egg.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; cards and QR payments accepted, no e-money (Tabelog); buy a ticket at the machine, then queue outside (October 2026). 9 counter seats and a table for four; non-smoking (Tabelog). A short line at weekend lunch and evening (October 2026). Opened 27 April 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 西中島3-17-5, ground floor of リバーボール — about 50 m from Hankyu Minamikata Stn (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Tsukemen only (October 2026) · three dips, all fish-and-pork-bone based, kept hot over solid fuel in a clay pot: "Honten" (soy, a little sweet and tangy, with lots of white negi), "Micro" (garlic for depth) and "Macro" (citrus and chili, the most popular) (October 2026) · noodles: long, thick whole-wheat noodles cut at the table with scissors, chewy and firm, 200 g, 300 g or 400 g at the same price (October 2026) · "Simple" topping of half an egg and two pieces of rolled chashu, or low-temperature rare chashu; "Special" for more (October 2026) · prices: Micro Simple 300 g ¥980, Macro Simple with rare chashu ¥1,080, Macro Regular 300 g ¥1,300 (October 2026) · mini pork rice bowl with mayonnaise; Hoegaarden on tap (October 2026)
places.notes: [Tsukemen · Nishinakajima, scissor-cut whole-wheat noodles by Minamikata] The tsukemen-only shop of the Osaka group behind Jinrui Mina Menrui, opened in 2025 by Hankyu Minamikata, a 13-seat room with a line at busy times. Everything is a little different here: the noodles are thick whole-wheat strands about a metre long that you cut yourself with scissors, and the dip, seafood and pork bone in three versions (the sweet-sour Honten, garlicky Micro or citrus-and-chili Macro), arrives in a clay pot kept bubbling over solid fuel, so it stays hot to the end (October 2026). Noodles from 200 to 400 g cost the same; ¥980–1,300 a bowl (October 2026). Some found the noodles very hard and the pot too hot to touch. Buy your ticket, then queue.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 27 April 2025 (Tabelog). Per an October 2026 review: Jinrui Mina Menrui began in Osaka with its main shop in Nishinakajima-Minamigata, and in 2025 opened two "Tsukemen Specialty Shops", here and in Kyoto, with "the longest whole grain noodles in Japan" cut with scissors and a clay-pot dip bowl. Another October 2026 diner credits the group's style and attentive service to the UNCHI Group and its president Matsumura.

anecdotes.text: "The dipping sauce is heated from below with solid fuel, keeping it warm until the end." — October 2026, Macro Simple with rare chashu for JPY 1,080.
"Eating the nearly one-meter-long noodles while cutting them with scissors adds to the fun!" — October 2026.
"Additionally, the noodles felt the hardest I've ever had in Tsukemen, so those who dislike firmer noodles should be cautious." — October 2026, the Macro.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 人類みな麺類 つけ麺専門店、つけ麺、大阪市淀川区西中島3-17-5 リバーボール 1F、南方駅から48m、毎日11:00〜15:00、18:00〜22:00、予約不可、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、カウンター9席と4人テーブル1つ、禁煙、2025年4月27日オープン。口コミ(2026年10月): つけ麺だけの店、2025年に西中島南方と Kyoto にできた、魚介と豚骨のつけ汁を固形燃料で温める土鍋で、「Honten」(醤油、少し甘くて酸味、白ねぎたっぷり)、「Micro」(にんにく)、「Macro」(柑橘と唐辛子、いちばん人気)、約1メートルの太い全粒粉の麺をはさみで切る、200g、300g、400g は同じ値段、「Simple」は半熟卵と巻きチャーシュー2枚、低温のレアチャーシューも、Micro Simple 300g 980円、Macro Simple とレアチャーシュー1,080円、Macro のレギュラー300g 1,300円、マヨネーズのミニ豚丼、Hoegaarden、食券を買ってから外で並ぶ、麺がとてもかたいという声、土鍋が熱すぎるという声も。

places.cuisine: Fish and offal izakaya with a menu that shifts each visit (2024–2026) · appetiser chosen from about ten (2025–2026) · sashimi: kinmedai, yellowtail, tuna, sea bream (August 2025); ishidai and tachiuo (June 2026); whelk and octopus (August 2025); red and sweet shrimp platter (March 2026); thick katsuo tataki (October 2026); mochi katsuo (July 2025) · meat: rare beef tongue with salt and green onion (July 2025); rare tongue skewers, namamino, gurensu (pancreas) (June 2026); outside skirt on garlic rice (September 2025) · dishes: niku-sui daikon (August 2025), green-onion tempura (December 2025), hamo tempura, lettuce fried rice (August 2026), celery kimchi, daikon mapo gratin (October 2026), mapo Malony (March 2026), ganjang gejang (November 2024), uni carbonara (August 2025) · shochu and highballs at low prices (August 2025) · two people about ¥9,000 (October 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Nishinakajima, rare fish and rare offal behind a red front] A busy, homely izakaya by the tracks west of Minamikata, behind a red front, that surprises with fish you rarely see in a tavern (ishidai, tachiuo, kinmedai, thick katsuo tataki) alongside rare-cooked tongue skewers and unusual offal such as namamino and gurensu (2025–2026). Start by choosing one of about ten appetisers, then let the staff steer you through a long, changing menu: lettuce fried rice, celery kimchi, daikon mapo gratin, hamo tempura, even uni carbonara (2025–2026). Prices are low, mostly around ¥1,000 a dish; two people ate well for under ¥9,000 (October 2026). Phone ahead at weekends. Cash only; smoking allowed, so no under-18s. Closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Reviewers: the staff are cheerful and recommend from the menu (May 2026); one woman ran the floor and kept checking on a table even when busy (August 2026).

anecdotes.text: "I really appreciate being able to choose my appetizer, and the quality of each option is high!" — September 2025.
"What stood out the most was the rare cut known as 'Gurensu (pancreas).'" — June 2026.
"I had to take home some of my favorite lettuce fried rice and tempura of hamo (pike eel) since I couldn't finish it all (laughs)." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラッキー酒場、立ち飲み、大阪市淀川区西中島4-8-1、西中島南方駅から128m、火〜土17:30〜23:00、日・月休み、予約可、現金のみ、18席、喫煙可。口コミ(2024年9月〜2026年10月): 南方駅の西、線路ぞいの赤い外観、テーブル約10とカウンター約10、喫煙のため未成年不可、お通しは約10種から選ぶ、メニューは毎回少しずつ変わる、刺身 (キンメ、ブリ、マグロ、鯛、石鯛、太刀魚、つぶ貝、タコ、赤エビと甘エビ、カツオのたたき、もちカツオ)、ねぎ塩のレア牛タン、レアのタン串、ミノ、Gurensu、ハラミのガーリックライス、Niku-sui Daikon、ねぎの天ぷら、ハモの天ぷら、レタスチャーハン、セロリのキムチ、大根の麻婆グラタン、Mapo Malony、Ganjang Gejang、ウニのカルボナーラ、焼酎とハイボールが安い、ひと皿約1,000円、2人で9,000円弱、週末は予約を、注文はスマホで。

places.name: さかなのじんべえ なんば店 (Sakana no Jinbee Nanba Ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi is where to start; the grilled squid with sauce, kushikatsu, gratin, chicken nanban, spaghetti and the pizza from next door are wheat- or soy-based.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 15:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); irregular closures (Tabelog). A ¥1,000 "senbero" of three drinks and a small dish, weekdays only (July–August 2026). Reservations; a ¥5,000 course of eight dishes with 90-minute all-you-can-drink (Tabelog); a regular finds à la carte better value (May 2026). Order by smartphone (July 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 100 seats: a counter of 20 on the first floor, tables on the second, tatami rooms for groups on the third; non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog). Phone charging (August 2026). Opened 21 June 2019 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Sennichimae 2-6-6, on the Sennichimae shopping street — 2 min from Kintetsu Nippombashi Stn, 3 min from Nippombashi Stn
places.cuisine: Seafood izakaya with fish delivered direct from the group's own wholesaler, Uoya Ebizo (Tabelog) · sashimi platters, plump and fresh, five kinds (2026) · the signature grilled squid (ikayaki) under mayonnaise, a sweet-spicy sauce and green onions (August–October 2026) · kushikatsu with a light, crisp batter (September–October 2026); dashimaki; seafood gratin; chicken nanban; crab salad spaghetti (2026) · Neapolitan pizza such as Margherita, ordered in from the sister pizzeria Allegro next door (Tabelog; 2026) · a ¥1,000 senbero of three drinks and a small dish on weekdays; highballs, sake and shochu (2026; Tabelog) · a ¥5,000 eight-dish course with 90-minute all-you-can-drink (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Sennichimae, fresh fish with pizza from next door] A three-floor seafood izakaya on the Sennichimae shopping street, counter downstairs, tables and tatami above, with fish sent straight from its group's own wholesaler. Order the sashimi platter and the house grilled squid under mayo and sweet-spicy sauce, then kushikatsu, seafood gratin or dashimaki, and, unusually, a Neapolitan pizza delivered from the sister pizzeria Allegro next door. Weekdays bring a ¥1,000 deal of three drinks and a small dish from 15:00; weekends it opens at noon. Regulars in 2026 call the fish fresh and well priced; others found the service curt, the upper floors short-staffed, or pairs steered to the counter without being asked.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: fish delivered direct from the group's own wholesale fish shop, Uoya Ebizo; pizza and pasta from the sister restaurant Allegro next door; opened 21 June 2019. A regular calls it part of "the Jinbee series" (April 2026). One September 2026 diner found the owner quiet but the room bright and lively.

anecdotes.text: "The signature grilled squid is generously topped with mayonnaise, making a big impact!" — August 2026, with a Margherita from Allegro.
"For just 1,000 yen, you get 3 drinks plus a dish, which is an amazing deal!" — August 2026, a daytime drink.
"I couldn't find the senbero menu, so I asked about it, and received a somewhat curt response: 'It says only on weekdays.'" — July 2026, a hot day after Kuromon Market.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): さかなのじんべえ なんば店、居酒屋・海鮮、千日前2-6-6、Kintetsu Nippombashi 駅から徒歩2分、Nippombashi 駅から徒歩3分、月〜金 15:00〜23:00、土日祝 12:00〜23:00 (L.O.料理22:00・ドリンク22:30)、不定休、予約可、90分飲み放題つきの8品のコース5,000円、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、100席 (カウンター20)、1階はカウンター、2階はテーブル、3階は座敷、禁煙、テイクアウト、2019年6月21日オープン、自社の卸 Uoya Ebizo から直送の鮮魚、いか焼き、串カツ、隣の姉妹店 Allegro のナポリピッツァとパスタ。口コミ(2026年4月〜10月): 刺身の5種盛り、マヨと甘辛いタレのいか焼き、串カツ、海鮮グラタン、だし巻き、チキン南蛮、カニサラダのスパゲッティ、平日のせんべろ1,000円 (3杯と1品)、スマホで注文、新鮮で手頃という声、接客がそっけない、席の案内に不満という声も。

places.cuisine: Creative izakaya plates for sake, with seasonal fish and vegetables from the central wholesale market and Kawachi duck from Matsubara (Tabelog) · Kawachi duck roast tataki ¥1,450; shrimp miso mayo ¥850; pork-belly chashu with a soft-boiled egg ¥1,100 (June 2026); raw duck with figs and prosciutto (September 2026); strawberry salad with duck (May 2026) · crispy potato salad with new burdock and truffle; yellowtail sashimi with homemade sesame-miso sauce; cream cheese with fuki-no-to miso; rare salmon with shiba-zuke tartar; charcoal-grilled manganji peppers; grilled sea-urchin rice ball to finish (May 2026) · fried chicken neck; sweet potato with brown-sugar butter (July 2026); thick ham cutlet (August 2026) · sake from around Japan, chosen yourself from the fridge and poured by the staff with soft water on the side (May 2026); shochu, wine, craft beer and fruit liqueurs (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Namba Hatch, a glass-walled sake bar with Kawachi duck] Up the stairs to the third floor by Namba Hatch, a glass-walled room with a long counter, popular with couples, where you pick your sake from the fridge and the staff pour it with soft water on the side. The food is creative and made for drinking: Kawachi duck roast tataki, truffle potato salad, shrimp miso mayo, pork-belly chashu with a soft egg and a grilled sea-urchin rice ball to finish. Diners in 2026 love the food and the mood; several find it pricey, one found the owner a little intimidating, and there is one restroom and no elevator. Open evenings to midnight, from 15:00 at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: creative dishes made to pair with drink, using seasonal fish and vegetables from the central wholesale market and Kawachi duck from Matsubara; sake, shochu and fruit liqueurs from across Japan; a room walled in floor-to-ceiling glass; opened 1 July 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: Creative dishes crafted to pair with drinks, enjoyed with good friends (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Kawachi duck roast tataki; truffle potato salad; sake.

anecdotes.text: "I came here for the Japanese sake, and you can choose from the fridge yourself. Just hand it to the staff, and they'll pour it into your glass." — May 2026, finishing with a grilled sea-urchin rice ball.
"I never expected that raw duck meat would pair so well with figs and prosciutto! It was surprisingly delicious!" — September 2026.
"While the prices for food and drinks are somewhat on the higher side, I wouldn't say it's the best value for money, but everything I've tried has been delicious!" — September 2026, a second visit.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Chinese dishes of pork, chicken and seafood; even the steamed cabbage comes with a shrimp sauce (September 2026).

Reservations; courses with two-hour all-you-can-drink ¥4,500 (nine dishes) or ¥5,000 (eleven, reduced from ¥6,000), or food-only ¥3,500; shumai refills ¥100 on courses (Tabelog). places.neighborhood: Namba Sennichimae 3-12, right behind Namba Grand Kagetsu (NGK) — 3 min from Namba Stn (Nankai)
places.cuisine: Chinese tavern of dim sum, steamed dishes and drinks (Tabelog) · the signature chaomen: very thin noodles steamed, then pan-fried crisp on one side over a generous thick filling, served with the staff's advice on how to eat it (August–September 2026) · juicy meat shumai, xiaolongbao, shrimp dumplings, a three-kind dim sum assortment (Tabelog; 2026) · steamed spare ribs with black bean sauce; steamed chicken with scallion-ginger sauce; homemade mapo tofu; Shaoxing-wine chicken; century egg and potato salad with shrimp chips; crisp fried chicken thigh (Tabelog) · steamed cabbage with homemade shrimp sauce; whelk in pepper sauce; tuna kimchi; tom yum vermicelli; stir-fried seaweed; pickled mustard greens (August–September 2026) · original sours made to pair with food, Shaoxing wine, tea highballs (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Chinese · Sennichimae, crisp chaomen behind NGK] A lively three-floor Chinese tavern opened in late 2024 right behind Namba Grand Kagetsu, made for drinking. The dish in the name is chaomen, a nest of very thin noodles steamed and fried crisp on one side over a thick, savory filling; the staff show you how to eat it. Add juicy shumai, xiaolongbao, steamed chicken with ginger sauce or steamed cabbage with homemade shrimp sauce, plus original sours; a refillable seaweed appetizer comes first. Courses with two hours of drinks start at ¥4,500. Diners in 2026 were almost all delighted, several singling out warm, attentive service. Lunch from noon Friday to Sunday; evenings otherwise.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a Chinese bar whose specialties are chaomen and shumai, with dim sum, steamed dishes and homemade mapo tofu; three floors that can be booked whole; weekend lunch for daytime drinking; opened 7 December 2024. A September 2026 diner calls it Taiwanese. An August 2026 diner praises staff who offered a last order and handled overseas guests in fluent English.

anecdotes.text: "The extremely thin noodles are steamed and pan-fried on one side until crispy, with a generous filling of ingredients underneath." — August 2026, with xiaolongbao.
"Holding back my urge to mix it all up, I followed their instructions, and it turned out to be crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside" — September 2026.
"The third staff member, who joined midway, was great at handling foreign customers with a smile and fluent English." — August 2026, a solo all-you-can-drink evening.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): オオサカチャオメン 難波千日前、居酒屋・飲茶・中華料理、名物はチャオメンと焼売、難波千日前3-12、Nankai Namba 駅から徒歩3分、NGK の裏、月〜木・祝前日・祝後日 17:00〜23:00、金土日祝 12:00〜23:00 (L.O.料理22:30)、予約可、2時間飲み放題つきのコース4,500円 (9品)・5,000円 (11品)、料理のみ3,500円、コースは焼売のおかわり100円、カード・PayPay可、60席、3フロア、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、2024年12月7日オープン、点心、蒸し料理、自家製の麻婆豆腐、料理に合うオリジナルサワー。口コミ(2026年8月〜9月): 細い麺を蒸して片面をかりっと焼いたチャオメン、焼売、小籠包、蒸し鶏のしょうがソース、自家製エビソースの蒸しキャベツ、ツブ貝の胡椒ソース、マグロキムチ、無料のわかめのお通し (おかわり可)、スマホで注文、接客がよいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: A staff member handled overseas guests in fluent English (August 2026); smartphone ordering. No English menu evidence found.

places.name: 楽洛亭 本店 (Rakuraku Tei Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The meat is marinated in the house sauce (October 2026), which is not described; salted tongue and unmarinated cuts are where to ask. Chijimi and cold noodles are wheat-based.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku restaurant.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); closed 30 December–2 January (Tabelog). Reservations: online bookings 11:00–13:45 on weekdays are for à la carte only, set lunches by phone; the second floor seats 30–40 for parties; two hours when busy (Tabelog). Lunch sets come with one free rice refill (August and October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 68 seats: a counter on the first floor, tables on the second, where children must sit (Tabelog; August 2026). Designated smoking area (Tabelog); ashtrays on the tables and a smoky room (August 2026). Charcoal grills at each table; the hoods struggle, so clothes take on the smell (October 2026). English and Simplified Chinese menus with photos; takeaway (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Yakiniku over table charcoal, built around a house "secret sauce", fresh and additive-free, with fresh wagyu and horumon prepared by hand (Tabelog) · the sauce, heavy with chopped green onion, spiced with sansho, and also used to marinate the meat (September–October 2026) · outside skirt, the house favorite (2024–2026); salted tongue; kalbi; loin; tsurami; mino; beef intestine; Angus beef with garlic and salt; three kinds of special wagyu (2026) · six-cut assorted platter, 300 g (October 2026) · Volume Lunch A, 160 g of belly and outside skirt with salad or kimchi and bean sprouts, rice and soup, ¥1,430; Volume Lunch B, 220 g including outside skirt and premium mino, ¥2,200 (October 2026) · bean-sprout namul, kimchi, yukhoe, gukbap, chijimi, cold noodles, pig's trotters (2026) · draft beer; a medium bottle ¥605 (October 2026)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Namba, a 70-year-old charcoal yakiniku] A long-running yakiniku by Nankai Namba, across from Marui, with a Showa-style counter downstairs where people grill alone over charcoal and tables upstairs. Everything turns on the house sauce, thick with green onion and sansho; regulars come for the outside skirt, and the Volume Lunches (¥1,430 for 160 g, ¥2,200 for 220 g) come with a rice refill. Expect smoke: ashtrays on the tables and clothes that smell of grilled meat. Diners in 2026 praise the sauce and the lunch value; others found the marinade too strong, the cold noodles weak, or the meat dear for its quality. Open daily from 11:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a yakiniku restaurant in business for over 70 years, built on its secret sauce, made fresh without additives, with fresh wagyu and horumon prepared in-house by skilled staff. An October 2026 diner puts its history at 60–70 years and describes a first-floor counter in the style of a Showa tavern. A Nipponbashi branch is listed on Gnavi.
chef_bio.philosophy: The secret sauce comes first, made fresh and additive-free to bring out the meat (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Outside skirt with the house sauce.

anecdotes.text: "This restaurant is known for its unique sauce, which is packed with chopped green onions." — September 2026, a third visit, outside skirt.
"for those who do drink during lunch, the staff amusingly asks, 'When would you like your rice?'—a service reminiscent of a ryokan." — October 2026, Volume Lunch B ¥2,200.
"the pricing seemed a bit steep compared to the quality and satisfaction of the meat itself." — October 2026, the six-cut platter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 楽洛亭 本店 (ラクラクテイ)、焼肉、難波4-4-6、Midosuji Line Namba 駅9・10番出口、毎日11:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、12月30日〜1月2日休み、予約可 (平日11:00〜13:45のネット予約は単品のみ、定食は電話で)、2階は30〜40名で貸切可、混雑時は2時間制、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、68席、カウンター、子ども連れは2階のみ、分煙、英語・中国語 (簡体字) の写真つきメニュー、テイクアウト、創業70年以上、無添加の生ダレの秘伝のタレ、新鮮な和牛とホルモンを手仕込み。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): ねぎたっぷりのタレ、山椒、外ハラミ、塩タン、ボリュームランチA 160g 1,430円、ボリュームランチB 220g 2,200円、ご飯のおかわり1回、6種盛り300g、七輪の炭火、煙が多く服ににおいがつく、卓上に灰皿、Marui の向かい、味付けが濃い、冷麺がいまひとつ、肉の質のわりに高いという声も。

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: battered, deep-fried skewers, including a mentaiko-mayo bread skewer and mini buns (October 2026), with sauces, ponzu, sesame mustard and salt.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The omakase mixes vegetable skewers (asparagus, taro, shiitake, tomato) with shrimp, crab, beef and eel; the shop asks about dislikes and allergies before the course (Tabelog; October 2026), but nothing is said about the batter or frying oil.

Vegetable charge ¥330 per person (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shimanouchi 1-12-17, behind a navy noren — 5 min from Nagahoribashi Stn
places.cuisine: Creative kushiage by a chef trained at a long-established restaurant; omakase of seasonal skewers served until you say stop, ¥110–570 a skewer; wine chosen by a sommelier and sake by a sake specialist (Tabelog shop text) · vegetable sticks with a special sauce as the opener (October 2026) · a typical October 2026 run: asparagus, beef fillet, mentaiko-mayo bread, homemade mapo tofu, natto, shiitake with shrimp mince, taro, eel and ginger, swordfish, tomato and mozzarella, konjac with roe, chicken and jako with sansho, angel shrimp, mini buns with potato croquette, crab legs · also head-on angel shrimp with miso, stuffed eggplant (August 2026), matsutake, sanma, ginkgo, abalone (September 2026), chestnut in yuba, penguin-shaped fried bread, chilled pumpkin soup (October 2026) · dips: three sauces and salt, ponzu, sesame mustard; mayo-miso extra (August–October 2026) · Asahi draft ¥600 (October 2026) · about ¥7,000 a head with drinks for 15–18 skewers (September 2026)
places.notes: [Kushiage · Shimanouchi, creative skewers until you say stop] A chic, dark-toned kushiage counter near Nagahoribashi where the omakase brings seasonal and playful skewers — mapo tofu in an edible basket, penguin-shaped bread, eel with ginger — alongside classics like angel shrimp and beef fillet, until you call stop. Staff suggest a sauce for each skewer and ask about dislikes and allergies first. Expect about 15 skewers and ¥4,000–7,000 a head. Book: it is full at opening at weekends. Smoking is allowed at the ground-floor counter; the upstairs tables are non-smoking.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 4 February 2020, later reopened after a renewal; creative kushiage using techniques honed at a long-established restaurant. Per tabiiro: the owner trained at well-known Osaka restaurants and fries in front of guests; a second shop opened in Umeda Nakazakicho in May 2024.

anecdotes.text: "I was surprised by the innovative idea of the mapo tofu skewer, where even the basket it came in was edible!" — October 2026, a 15-skewer course.
"The hospitality is exceptional" — August 2026, a reviewer noting that dislikes and allergies are carefully accommodated.
"While the flavors were delicious, I felt that the overall dishes could have used a bit less oil." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 串揚げ専門店 健串、串揚げ・居酒屋・魚介、大阪市中央区島之内1-12-17、長堀橋駅から徒歩5分、火〜日・祝17:00〜24:00、月曜休み、不定休、予約可、野菜代330円、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、28席 (1階カウンター12席は喫煙可、2階テーブル10席は禁煙、個室3〜5名)、子ども可、2020年2月4日オープン。老舗で磨いた技の創作串揚げ、旬の素材のおまかせをストップまで、1本110〜570円、ソムリエのワインと日本酒の専門家が選ぶ日本酒、苦手なものやアレルギーは事前に。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 野菜スティック、アスパラ、牛ヒレ、明太マヨのパン、自家製麻婆豆腐、納豆、エビのすり身のしいたけ、里芋、うなぎと生姜、カジキ、トマトとモッツァレラ、Angel shrimp、カニ、ペンギンの形のパン、ソース3種と塩、ポン酢、ごまからし、15〜18本と飲み物でひとり7,000円ほど、日曜17時に満席、油がもう少し少なくてもという声。

places.name: 空色COLOR (Sorairo Color)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists gluten-free options but no detail. The steamed-vegetable sets come with salt ponzu, koji-yuzu mayo and bonito salt sauces (August 2026); udon, tempura and fries are also on the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options but no detail. The 12-vegetable steamer set came with bonito flakes and a bit of hamo (September 2026), and the dipping sauces include bonito salt, so ask for it without.
places.hours_raw: Tabelog gives daily 11:30–23:30 and, in its notes, Mon–Fri and Sat/holidays 11:30–23:00; open year-round. Lunch sets were still served after 16:00 on an August 2026 day. Reservations accepted, but not for café use; phone may be hard to reach at lunch (Tabelog). Menu and ordering, and payment, by smartphone (September–October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC, iD, QUICPay and QR payment; no cover charge (Tabelog). 60 seats: low sofas, a 10-seat counter, tatami tables and an enclosed terrace with kotatsu in winter (Tabelog; 2024–2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). The entrance is easy to miss; staff let you in (2026).
places.neighborhood: Hakuromachi 4-3-1, west of Midosuji — 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese dining bar and café with low sofas and greenery: seafood delivered daily, an assorted sashimi platter as the specialty, seasonal and fruity sake, desserts by a pastry chef, shaved ice (Tabelog shop text) · lunch: 12-vegetable steamer set ¥1,280 with a small hamo dish (September 2026); branded pork and vegetable steamer set ¥1,680 with sashimi and a small side, three homemade sauces — bonito salt, koji-yuzu mayo, salt ponzu (August 2026); fish steamer set (August 2026); grilled sanma set (August 2026); seafood yukke set with broth to pour over like hitsumabushi (October 2026); white or multigrain rice, large free (October 2026) · dinner: five-kind sashimi platter, hamo tempura, bone crackers, water eggplant, fries, spicy cucumber, mentaiko udon, kiwi sour (October 2026) · winter hot-pot courses: seasonal hot pot ¥3,000, yellowtail shabu-shabu ¥3,500, premium hot pot ¥4,000, +¥2,000 for all-you-can-drink (Tabelog) · organic drinks (September 2026)
places.notes: [Japanese dining bar · Hakuromachi, steamed-vegetable lunches on sofas] A greenery-filled dining bar a few minutes west of Midosuji, with low sofas, tatami tables and an enclosed terrace (kotatsu in winter). At lunch, order a bamboo steamer of a dozen vegetables or pork with three homemade sauces for about ¥1,300–1,700; at night, sashimi, hamo tempura and mentaiko udon with seasonal sake. Order and pay on your phone. Reviews in 2026 also mention dated cleanliness and an over-hot terrace in September.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member) and website sorairocolor.jp: a Japanese dining bar and café with seafood delivered daily, sake from around Japan and desserts made by a pastry chef.

anecdotes.text: "The entrance is a bit tricky, and you need to be noticed by the staff inside to get in." — September 2026, a fourth visit.
"The staff explained, 'You can enjoy the broth as a clear soup or pour it over rice like hitsumabushi'" — October 2026, the seafood yukke set.
"The cleanliness remains an issue, and the staff's friendliness was lacking as usual." — September 2026, a repeat visitor who otherwise liked the food.

places.notes: [Yakiniku · Namba, butcher-run wagyu in Takashimaya] A wagyu yakiniku restaurant on the 8th-floor dining floor of Takashimaya at Namba, from a butcher-backed group (founded 1995). Dinner courses run ¥5,800–7,200; private rooms are popular and must be booked. Reviews in 2026 split between attentive service and a sukiyaki course where a nearly full room outran the staff (September 2026).

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): founded in 1995, backed by a butcher shop in Osaka for 50 years; this shop opened 2 March 2010. Per gurunavi, the group's main shop is 西中島総本店; a Tennoji shop is mentioned on Retty and by a September 2026 reviewer.

places.cuisine: Gyoza, Chinese dishes and drinks (Tabelog) · small one-bite gyoza with thin skins, filled with domestic black pork and vegetables (Tabelog) · pan-fried and boiled gyoza, six for ¥430 each (March 2026; ¥390 in July 2024) · spicy gyoza, six for ¥480; chilled gyoza, six for ¥500, "reminiscent of cold pasta" (2025–2026) · shrimp gyoza, cheese and mala gyoza (Tabelog; August 2026) · garlic oil and minced garlic on the table: try a gyoza plain first, then with garlic oil in the sauce (Tabelog; 2024–2026) · Chinese braised pork ¥680, xiaolongbao two for ¥500 (March 2026) · mapo tofu, yodare-dori, steamed chicken with green onion and salt, shrimp dumplings (Tabelog; 2024–2025) · pickled mustard greens, a three-item snack plate, salted cabbage (2025–2026) · draft beer ¥550, shochu with corn tea or barley tea ¥500, a lemon sour served with sorbet ¥650, a tomato chu-hi you mix yourself (2024–2026) · two banquet courses with all-you-can-drink (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Gyoza · Minamikata, bite-sized gyoza and a drink until 1:00] An 18-seat gyoza bar three minutes from Hankyu Minamikata, with a counter at the front and tables behind, where the gyoza are small enough to eat in one bite. Six pan-fried or boiled cost ¥430 (2026); a regular rates the light boiled ones best and the chilled gyoza as something new, and the table garlic oil is the house tip. Mapo tofu, braised pork and xiaolongbao round it out with beer and tea-shochu highballs. On several visits one person ran the whole place (2025–2026), and it suits a quick drink or a second stop after dinner. Open from 17:00 to 1:00 (Sundays to 23:00); cash only; smoking allowed.

roles: Owner-operator (unnamed); a regular calls the person running the shop "Yassan"
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a gyoza specialist with Chinese dishes and a drinks list; gyoza of domestic black pork and vegetables in thin skins sized for one bite; recommended to try them plain, then with garlic oil in the dipping sauce; two banquet courses with all-you-can-drink. Per reviews: "It was just Yassan running the place alone" (March 2026; also May 2025); "Even though it was a one-person operation, the service was surprisingly good" (August 2026); when a diner spilt chili oil on a white T-shirt, "the owner kindly handed me a towel with bleach on it" (May 2025); several diners found it quiet or empty early in the evening (2025–2026); a long-time regular counts 15 visits (March 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Bite-sized boiled and pan-fried gyoza with garlic oil; chilled gyoza.

anecdotes.text: "When you come to Gyoiiiiiin, you must start with the water dumplings!" — a regular on the 15th visit, March 2026.
"This dish breaks the concept that dumplings should be served hot." — May 2025, on the chilled gyoza.
"We dipped the gyoza in garlic oil and scooped some garlic with the folds for a bite. The flavor and aroma exploded." — June 2024.

places.cuisine: Miso ramen specialist, with shoyu ramen, tsukemen and izakaya dishes (Tabelog) · Sapporo-style grilled miso: vegetables and lard tossed over high flames in a pot, finished with a blend of miso, served piping hot (2026) · Sapporo-style grilled miso ramen ¥1,100 (August 2026); authentic grilled miso ¥1,000 and "Miso Revenge" ¥1,200 (February 2026) · grilled miso special with chashu, vegetables, corn, butter and egg, as recommended by Orix's Ryoma Nishikawa, ¥1,200 (August 2026) · Sapporo-style grilled shoyu ¥1,100; Hokkaido shoyu; shoyu with extra vegetables (2025–2026) · broth of chicken bones and niboshi (June 2026) · homemade noodles of Hokkaido flour including "Haru yo Koi" (Tabelog), medium-thick and chewy (2026) · thick-cut chashu; a half-boiled egg in the grilled shoyu (2026) · seasonal: Hiroshima lemon shoyu ramen (from November, ¥1,000 trial price in 2025); black garlic oil miso with cheese (winter) · sets: ramen with rice ¥1,200; with a skirt-steak rice bowl ¥1,500; rice ¥200 at lunch; salmon chili oil rice (2026) · winged gyoza (May 2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, Sapporo-style grilled miso tossed over open flame] A 27-seat miso ramen specialist a minute from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, where flames leap from the pot as the chef tosses vegetables and lard before the miso goes in (2026). The Sapporo-style grilled miso (¥1,100) comes piping hot, richer-looking than it tastes, with homemade Hokkaido-flour noodles and thick chashu; regulars swear by the grilled shoyu with extra vegetables. Winter brings a black-garlic and cheese miso, November a Hiroshima lemon shoyu. The walls are covered in Orix baseball signatures and photos. Cash only; parking for three cars; tsukemen in the evening only.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "The only Miso Ramen Specialty Shop in the ramen battleground of Nishinakajima"; celebrating its 10th anniversary; "The founder, who has thoroughly researched miso from all over Japan, has perfected the ultimate soup by adding unique twists to Hokkaido miso"; homemade noodles of Hokkaido flour blended with "Haru yo Koi". Per reviews: a diner says it "has been operating in this location for over 20 years" (April 2026) and another returned "after more than 10 years" (May 2026); signed memorabilia and photos of Orix players, especially Ryoma Nishikawa, cover the walls (2026); a regular on the 16th visit chats with the owner and staff (2025–2026); one diner could not hear the staff and had to ask three times which bowl was which (February 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Miso from all over Japan researched to make "the ultimate soup" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Sapporo-style grilled miso ramen; grilled shoyu with vegetables.

anecdotes.text: "As I watched the flames rise higher than the chef’s face, I worried my fine hairs might get singed." — August 2026.
"It has a rich, roasted flavor and depth, yet surprisingly leaves a light aftertaste that is distinct from its appearance." — August 2026, Sapporo-style grilled miso ¥1,100.
"It seems like the oil is adjusted according to the season, and for summer, it’s a bit lighter." — July 2026.

places.name: 隆勝 (Ryusho)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thick wheat noodles (whole wheat, 2026); kara-age and gyoza on the side.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: broth of pork bones, trotters, chicken bones and feet, niboshi and katsuobushi (Tabelog); chashu in the dip.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–2:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No reservations; no cards (Tabelog); tickets from a cash vending machine inside the entrance (May 2026, October 2026); PayPay accepted (February 2026). 16 seats, counter and tables; smoking in a designated area at night only; coin parking nearby (Tabelog). Opened 1 August 2014 (Tabelog). Busy at weekday lunch, quieter at weekends (October 2026).
places.neighborhood: 東三国1-1-32, 1 min from JR 東淀川駅 (Tabelog); a short walk from Higashi-Mikuni (June 2026)
places.cuisine: Tsukemen and ramen in a rich seafood and pork-bone broth (Tabelog) · broth of pork bones (marrow and back), trotters, chicken bones, hen feet, niboshi, katsuobushi, shiitake, kombu and vegetables, over 15 hours, without artificial seasoning or back fat (Tabelog) · dip with diced chashu and sautéed onion; a lemon on the side for halfway through; soup to dilute the dip at the end (2024–2026) · thick straight whole-wheat noodles (2026); homemade noodles, per the sign (March 2026) · pork tsukemen ¥1,000, large +¥180 (April and August 2026) · chicken paitan tsukemen ¥980 (July 2025) · special tsukemen with egg, menma and chashu on a separate plate ¥1,400, pork or chicken dip (March 2026) · sweet and spicy tsukemen, the most popular, in four spice levels (July 2026) · shoyu and shio ramen, rich tonkotsu ramen, a new mazesoba (2026) · lunch set with chashu rice bowl ¥280 (March 2025); kara-age, gyoza, fried rice, chashu mayo rice bowl (2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · JR Higashi-Yodogawa, seafood-tonkotsu tsukemen until 2 a.m.] A 16-seat tsukemen shop a minute from JR Higashi-Yodogawa, open since 2014 and one of the few places to eat round the station until 2 a.m. The dip is a thick seafood-and-pork-bone broth made without back fat, full of diced chashu and sautéed onion, for thick, firm whole-wheat noodles; squeeze in the lemon halfway, and finish with soup to dilute the dip. Pork tsukemen is ¥1,000; the sweet and spicy tsukemen in four heat levels is the favourite (2026). Tickets from a cash machine at the door; PayPay too. Closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: opened 1 August 2014; "Rich Seafood and Pork Bone Broth"; over a dozen ingredients simmered for more than 15 hours; "We do not use any artificial seasonings. To prioritize your health, we avoid using back fat"; soy sauce, salt, dipping soba and tsukemen. Per reviews: "They boil 80 kilograms of tonkotsu every day" (a diner, March 2026); "The staff were friendly and busy, providing thoughtful advice on menu selections" (July 2026); a discount for regular customers posted inside (October 2026); one May 2026 diner found the room greasy and saw flies.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Don’t leave any noodles behind; be sure to drink the broth!" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood-tonkotsu tsukemen; sweet and spicy tsukemen.

anecdotes.text: "Although it’s described as a rich seafood and pork bone broth, it wasn’t heavy due to the absence of back fat." — February 2026, pork tsukemen ¥1,000.
"The rich dipping sauce sticks to your lips when you wipe your mouth with a tissue! That’s how thick the dipping sauce is!" — March 2026, special tsukemen ¥1,400.
"The area around Higashiyodogawa Station doesn’t have many dining options … so a place that stays open late is quite valuable." — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 隆勝、ラーメン・つけ麺、大阪市淀川区東三国1-1-32、JR 東淀川駅から1分、月・火・木〜日11:00〜14:30、17:30〜翌2:00、水曜休み、予約不可、カード不可、16席、夜のみ喫煙所で喫煙可、近くにコインパーキング、2014年8月1日オープン、濃厚魚介豚骨、豚骨 (髄の骨と背骨)、豚足、鶏ガラ、鶏の足、煮干し、かつお節、しいたけ、昆布、野菜など十数種を15時間以上、化学調味料なし、背脂なし。口コミ (2024年〜2026年10月): 店内の券売機 (現金)、PayPay 可、豚のつけ麺1,000円、大盛り180円、chicken paitan のつけ麺980円、別皿つきのつけ麺1,400円、Sweet and Spicy のつけ麺は辛さ4段階、まぜそば、全粒粉の太いストレート麺、つけだれに角切りチャーシューと玉ねぎ、途中でレモン、最後にスープ割り、kara-age、gyoza、チャーハン、夜遅くまで開いている。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine at the entrance; menus with photos posted outside and inside (October 2026). No English evidence found.

noodles.notes: Thick straight noodles of whole wheat, firm at the core (March and July 2026); the sign says homemade noodles (March 2026).

ramen.signature_bowl: Pork tsukemen, ¥1,000 (August 2026); sweet and spicy tsukemen, the most popular (July 2026).
ramen.chashu: Diced chashu in the dip, tender in blocks (2026); the special adds sliced chashu on a separate plate, served cold (January 2026).

vegan.note: Pork, chicken and fish broth; chashu.

ramen.pantheon: JR Higashi-Yodogawa’s late-night tsukemen: a thick seafood and pork-bone dip made without back fat.

richness: "The rich dipping sauce paired perfectly with the thick noodles"; against "not as rich as I expected" for the chicken dip (B527374346) — placed high, not top.
oiliness: "It wasn’t heavy due to the absence of back fat"; the shop says it avoids back fat (Tabelog) — placed low.
clarity: "That’s how thick the dipping sauce is!" — an opaque, thick dip.
tare_strength: "The flavor was robust, but it felt a bit salty."
noodle_firmness: "They have a firm texture and are on the harder side!"; "keeping a firm core" (B524207847).
aroma_punch: "The ratio of seafood to tonkotsu is slightly tilted towards seafood! … the seafood flavor really shines in the tsukemen!"

places.name: たこやき王子 難波道頓堀店 (Takoyaki Ouji)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki is wheat batter and kushikatsu is battered and fried.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: takoyaki is made with octopus and dashi.
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; no seat charge (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 80 seats with counter and sofas; designated smoking area without partition (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). Walk-ins usually seated at once even when Dotonbori is packed (February–March 2026), though a queue formed by 1 p.m. on an October 2025 Sunday.
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-6-15, コムラードドウトンビル 3F, mid-Dotonbori — 5 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Takoyaki izakaya with kushikatsu and okonomiyaki (Tabelog) · takoyaki in many toppings: sauce, green onion and mayo ¥484, sauce, green onion and mentaiko mayo ¥539, salt, green onion and mayo ¥484, ponzu, green onion and mayo ¥484; a dashi flavour (October 2025–March 2026) · kushikatsu such as shrimp, lotus root, quail egg and banana, with sauce on the table; dote-yaki ¥451 (October 2025–July 2026) · bottled beer ¥792; drinks around ¥500; no all-you-can-drink (October 2025; February 2026)
places.notes: [Takoyaki · Dotonbori, a sit-down takoyaki bar up the stairs] A big, casual takoyaki izakaya on the third floor of a building in the middle of Dotonbori, where you can sit down for takoyaki when the street stands are mobbed. Order several kinds: sauce with green onion and mayo, salt or ponzu with green onion (all ¥484 in October 2025), or mentaiko mayo (¥539), plus kushikatsu from shrimp and quail egg to a banana skewer, and dote-yaki. It is cheap for food, less so for drinks (about ¥500 each, February 2026). Opinions run from delicious to average. Often easy to walk into, with a younger and international crowd. Smoking area without partition.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: izakaya, kushiage and okonomiyaki in the middle of Dotonbori, 80 seats, open 11:00–23:00 year-round; a sister shop in Kyoto Kiyamachi (shops.jsonl).

anecdotes.text: "This was my first time trying takoyaki with salt, and it was packed with umami flavor—so delicious!" — October 2025.
"While the Dotonbori bridge (near Glico) was extremely crowded, I was able to enter this place without waiting." — February 2026.
"I jokingly tried a banana skewer, and surprisingly, it was quite good!" — March 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): たこやき王子 難波道頓堀店、居酒屋・串揚げ・お好み焼き、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-6-15 コムラードドウトンビル 3F、なんば駅から徒歩5分、毎日11:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、年中無休、予約可、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、80席、分煙 (仕切りなし)、子ども可。口コミ(2025年10月〜2026年7月): ソースねぎマヨ484円、ソースねぎ明太マヨ539円、塩ねぎマヨ484円、ポン酢ねぎマヨ484円、だしの味、どて焼き451円、瓶ビール792円、えび・れんこん・うずら・バナナの串カツ、飲み物は500円ほどで飲み放題なし、道頓堀が混んでいてもすぐ入れた日が多い、日曜の昼には行列も、若い客と海外の客が多い、味はふつうという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests (July 2026). No English menu evidence found.

places.name: 万菓堂 心斎橋店 (Manka Do)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the best-seller is a wheat pastry pie, and mitarashi sauce is soy-sauce based.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The pie is pastry around mochi, mitarashi sauce and red bean paste; ask about butter in the pastry.
places.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–22:00; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). Takeaway shop: there are benches inside but eating in is not allowed (April 2026). Pies are warmed for you (December 2025).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashi-suji 2-3-19, at the Ebisubashi end of the shopping arcade near the Glico sign — about 5 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Japanese sweets and souvenir shop known for mitarashi mochi (2025–2026 reviews) · mitarashi mochi pie: crisp pastry around mochi filled with mitarashi sauce and red bean paste, warmed on request, ¥300 (July 2025), ¥320 (January 2026), about ¥350–380 (April 2026) · mitarashi mochi, which keeps three days (October 2026)
places.notes: [Sweets · Shinsaibashi-suji, mitarashi mochi pie to go] A long-established sweets and souvenir counter at the Ebisubashi end of the Shinsaibashi-suji arcade, a few steps from the Glico sign, where the thing to buy is the mitarashi mochi pie: flaky pastry around chewy mochi, sweet-soy mitarashi sauce and red bean paste, handed over warm. It cost ¥300 in July 2025 and about ¥350–380 by April 2026. Eat it walking (no eating inside, and it crumbles), or warm it briefly in a microwave or toaster later. The plain mitarashi mochi is good too but keeps only three days. One reviewer found the mitarashi flavour slow to arrive behind the pastry and bean paste. Open daily 10 a.m. to 10 p.m.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog: Japanese traditional sweets shop on Shinsaibashi-suji, open 10:00–22:00 daily, takeaway. Reviews (2025–2026) call it a long-established confectioner specialising in mitarashi mochi.

anecdotes.text: "The pie is filled with mochi, so it takes a while to get to the Mitarashi flavor." — July 2025, ¥300.
"Inside, there's sweet red bean paste, and the pie itself is crispy and absolutely delicious!" — December 2025; the pie is handed over warm.
"Although there are benches inside the store, eating there is prohibited, so I opted for a walk while enjoying my food." — April 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 万菓堂 心斎橋店、和菓子、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-19、毎日10:00〜22:00、予約不可、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可。口コミ(2025年7月〜2026年10月): みたらしの餅のパイ (サクサクのパイに餅、みたらしのたれ、あんこ、温めてくれる) 300円 (2025年7月)、320円 (2026年1月)、350〜380円ほど (2026年4月)、グリコの看板の裏の老舗、心斎橋筋の商店街の端、店内にベンチはあるが店内での飲食は不可、みたらし餅は日持ち3日、電子レンジやトースターで温めるとよい、みたらしの味にたどりつくまでが長いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway counter; point and pay. No English evidence found.

places.name: 黒毛和牛焼肉善 難波心斎橋店 (ZEN Nanba Shinsaibashi)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Yakiniku sauces, sukiyaki warishita and shabu-shabu dips are usually soy-based; one diner chose it to avoid flour-based food (September 2025).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: all-you-can-eat black wagyu.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–1:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–1:00; last order 24:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, also on the day (Tabelog; July 2025). Starter ¥330 when ordering à la carte only (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 90 seats, all in private rooms; non-smoking; children welcome, kids menu; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Orders by mobile (September 2025). Opened 1 September 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashi-suji 2-3-15, 戎橋Northビル 3F, by Ebisubashi — 3 min from Namba Stn
places.cuisine: All-you-can-eat A4-grade-or-better black wagyu bought whole, as yakiniku, shabu-shabu or sukiyaki, in private rooms (Tabelog) · courses from ¥4,180 (yakiniku "Manpuku", premium shabu-shabu, sukiyaki) with all-you-can-drink from +¥1,650; children 3–6 ¥550, primary pupils ¥2,035 (Tabelog) · sukiyaki special course ¥5,830 (August 2025); yakiniku with drinks ¥5,500 (December 2025) · courses include salad, kimchi and dessert; rice size chosen once, no refills (August 2025); beef tongue in some courses (October 2025); outside skirt sliced and as steak (October 2026)
places.notes: [Yakiniku · Ebisubashi, all-you-can-eat wagyu in private rooms] An all-you-can-eat black wagyu restaurant on the third floor by Ebisubashi, three minutes from Namba Station, where every table is a private room and you choose yakiniku, shabu-shabu or sukiyaki. Courses start at ¥4,180 (all-you-can-drink from ¥1,650 more), with salad, kimchi and dessert. Reviews are mixed. An October 2026 diner loved the outside skirt and the shabu-shabu and praised the English-speaking manager. Others since 2025 reported missed or wrong orders, no rice refills, and meat some found heavy or average. One March 2026 diner found that a coupon for ¥500 drinks meant ¥500 off. Busy with travellers; open to 1 a.m.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: the Shinsaibashi branch of Kuroge Wagyu Zen; A4-or-better black wagyu bought whole; all-you-can-eat yakiniku, sukiyaki and shabu-shabu from ¥3,800; private table rooms for up to 50; opened 1 September 2023. Two other Namba shops in shops.jsonl (難波千日前, 難波道頓堀).
chef_bio.specialty: All-you-can-eat black wagyu yakiniku, shabu-shabu and sukiyaki.

anecdotes.text: "The manager and the waiter were kind, the service was excellent" — October 2026; both spoke fluent English.
"I thought there might be a chance for a refill, but it turns out refills are not allowed!" — August 2025, on rice.
"On a certain reservation site, the coupon clearly stated 'All you can drink alcohol for JPY 500,'" — March 2026; the shop treated it as ¥500 off.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 黒毛和牛焼肉善 難波心斎橋店、焼肉・しゃぶしゃぶ・すき焼き、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-15 戎橋Northビル 3F、なんば駅から徒歩3分、月〜金17:00〜翌1:00、土日祝11:30〜翌1:00 (L.O.24:00)、予約可、単品のみ付き出し330円、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、90席 (全席個室)、禁煙、子ども可、英語のメニュー、2023年9月1日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): A4ランク以上の黒毛和牛を一頭買い、焼肉・すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶの食べ放題、コースは4,180円から、飲み放題は1,650円から、子ども550円と2,035円。口コミ(2025年7月〜2026年10月): すき焼きのコース5,830円、飲み放題つき焼肉5,500円、サラダ、キムチ、デザート、ご飯はおかわり不可、牛タン、外ハラミ、スマホで注文、注文が通っていなかった・違う飲み物が来たという声、肉が重い・ふつうという声、クーポンの「飲み放題500円」が500円引きの意味だったという声、英語の上手な店長とスタッフをほめる声、旅行客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); English-speaking manager and staff (October 2026).

places.name: 縁 (En)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Chinese sauces usually contain soy sauce; dumplings, noodles and fried dishes are on the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Stir-fried bok choy and a soy-meat appetizer appear in reviews; most dishes contain meat or seafood.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 15:30–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Lunch 11:00–14:00 by reservation made the day before (last order 13:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 54 seats at four round tables and a semi-private room for 6; non-smoking; BYO drinks allowed (Tabelog). English and Chinese menus with photos; English- and Chinese-speaking staff (Tabelog). Opened 13 January 2025 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Dotonbori 1-10-5, 白亜ビル B1F, opposite the Osaka Shochikuza — 2 min from Namba Stn exit 14
places.cuisine: Shanghai-style Chinese cooking adjusted for Japanese tastes, over 200 dishes at mostly ¥1,000–1,200 (Tabelog; 2025 reviews) · courses ¥3,500 (appetizers, meat dishes, seasonal vegetables, fried rice) and ¥5,000 with Peking duck (Tabelog; May 2026) · Peking duck with the meat made into kara-age, sweet and sour pork, Yangzhou fried rice, takana ramen, boiled dumplings, hot and sour soup, shrimp with mayonnaise, beef with green peppers, mapo tofu, stir-fried bok choy, sea cucumber, Shanghai yakisoba (2025–2026 reviews) · lunch sets, three choices (March 2025)
places.notes: [Chinese · Dotonbori, Shanghai cooking in a retro basement] A Chinese restaurant down the stairs of a building opposite the Shochikuza theatre, so unlike a typical Chinese place, with its bar-like door and old-Shanghai, Showa-retro room, that first-timers wonder whether this is the right spot. A small team (two chefs from northeast China and a server in July 2025) cooks Shanghai-style dishes adjusted for Japanese tastes; the room was once a French restaurant. The ¥5,000 course centres on Peking duck, with the leftover meat fried as kara-age; the ¥3,500 course is the value pick. À la carte runs to mapo tofu, sweet and sour pork and stir-fried bok choy. Round tables suit groups. Closed Wednesdays; lunch only by booking the day before.

roles: Two chefs from northeast China and a server (July 2025 review); the owner greets guests (November 2025)
chef_bio.origin: Northeast China (the chefs, per a July 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: authentic Shanghai cuisine at reasonable prices, over 200 dishes tuned to Japanese tastes, dishes ¥1,000–1,200, set meals and courses at lunch, round tables and private rooms, a modern-jazz room with a hint of Shanghai; opened 13 January 2025. A July 2026 review: the space used to be a French restaurant, taken over by the new owner a year and a half earlier.

anecdotes.text: "Later, I learned that the restaurant is run by a team of three: two chefs from Northeast China and one server." — July 2025.
"After enjoying the Peking duck, I had the meat made into kara-age, which was the best dish for me." — July 2026.
"This restaurant is located underground and doesn't look like a typical Chinese restaurant, which made me a bit nervous as I entered" — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 縁、中華料理、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-10-5 白亜ビル B1F、なんば駅14番出口から200m・徒歩2分、月火木〜日・祝15:30〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、水曜定休、ランチは前日までの予約で11:00〜14:00、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay も) 可、54席 (円卓4つと半個室)、禁煙、持ち込み可、英語・中国語のメニューとスタッフ、2025年1月13日オープン。店の紹介 (英訳): 本格的な上海料理を手ごろに、200品以上を日本人の好みに合わせて、1品1,000〜1,200円、コース3,500円と北京ダックの5,000円。口コミ(2025年3月〜2026年7月): 松竹座の向かいの地下、バーのような入口、上海の租界や昭和レトロのような店内、中国東北部出身の料理人2人と給仕1人、北京ダックの残りの肉を唐揚げに、酢豚、揚州チャーハン、高菜ラーメン、水餃子、酸辣湯、えびマヨ、牛肉とピーマンの炒めもの、麻婆豆腐、青梗菜の炒めもの、なまこ、焼きそば、以前はフランス料理の店だった。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Chinese menus with photos, English- and Chinese-speaking staff (Tabelog).

places.name: 中国菜 オイル (Chinese Sai Oil)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Chinese dishes in sauces; the menu also has shumai, fried rice, yakisoba and batter-fried shrimp.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the mapo tofu is made with meat; egg soup at lunch.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–22:00 (last order 20:30); closed Sundays (Tabelog). No lunch reservations; dinner bookings for up to 8; courses booked by the day before; omakase course from ¥2,800 (Tabelog). One drink per person at dinner; water only on request (Tabelog). Lunch queues of about 20 at opening (October and November 2026). Opened September 3, 2010 (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; October 2026). 17 seats: 7 at the counter and three tables; non-smoking; children welcome, carry babies in, no strollers (Tabelog). Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 in 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026.
places.neighborhood: Fukushima 6-chome — 8 min from JR Fukushima Stn
places.cuisine: Sichuan and Chinese cooking for many people at low prices (Tabelog) · lunch sets ¥1,700, mostly the Sichuan mapo tofu, with glass-noodle salad, egg soup and free rice refills (October–November 2026) · dinner: mapo tofu à la carte with rice ¥2,900, small draft beer ¥900, stir-fried greens (October 2026); chicken and scallop shumai, horse-mackerel carpaccio with sesame oil and green onion, shrimp mayonnaise with walnuts (October 2026); fried rice, greens stir-fried with garlic and ginger, seafood-sauce yakisoba (2022) · omakase course from ¥2,800 (Tabelog) · homemade Sichuan chili oil sold to take home (2026)
places.notes: [Chinese · Fukushima, the mapo tofu people queue for] A seventeen-seat Sichuan restaurant in Fukushima, open since 2010 and on Tabelog's Chinese WEST 100 list four times, whose name is about oil, the heart of Chinese cooking. The draw is the mapo tofu: a ¥1,700 lunch set with glass-noodle salad, egg soup and free rice, and a queue of about twenty people at the 11:30 opening. Diners describe it as numbing and fragrant rather than fiery; one regular found it oilier and heavier than before, another more refined. Dinner is pricier (mapo and rice ¥2,900, a small beer ¥900) with shumai, shrimp mayo and seasonal specials. Cash only; no lunch bookings; you can buy the house chili oil.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): oil is essential in Chinese cooking, and the name 中国菜オイル expresses the wish that customers will think of the shop as being as important as that oil; opened to let many people eat authentic-tasting Chinese food at low prices, for office workers at lunch and people after work and families at night. Opened September 3, 2010.
chef_bio.philosophy: Affordable, authentic Chinese food for many people (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The mapo tofu was different from the usual heavy flavors; it started with a light aroma, had a slight spiciness, and left a sweet aftertaste" — November 2026.
"It wasn't the sauce that felt heavy, but rather the oil was quite strong, making the dish feel weighty." — October 2026.
"The Sichuan Mapo Tofu a la carte and white rice cost JPY 2900! Lunch comes with a small side dish and soup for JPY 1700" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 店名の由来は、中華では油が大事なので、お客さんにもこの店を中華の油のように大事に思ってもらえるように。店のコンセプトは、大勢の人に低価格で、本場の味の中華を食べてもらいたい。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue at lunch; order from the menu once seated (November 2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: ステーキ鉄板エッセンス (Steak Teppan Essence)
places.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list includes gluten-free options, with no detail. Sauces include a garlic butter soy sauce and mustard soy sauce (2026 reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, and vegetables come from the shop's own farm; nothing vegan is confirmed. Courses centre on wagyu, abalone and lobster.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 18:00–23:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Same-day bookings welcome; best reached by phone 14:00–23:00 (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Opened March 26, 2020 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter, 8 at tables in semi-private rooms; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). English menu, with photos (Tabelog). Plates, cakes and bouquets from ¥1,650 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kitashinchi, 新地萬年ビル 3F — 3 min from Kitashinchi Stn
places.cuisine: Teppanyaki of A5 Tajima black wagyu, live abalone and Ise lobster, with organic vegetables from the shop's own farm in Kyotanba (Tabelog) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): short course of A5 fillet and seasonal vegetables ¥13,200 (8 items, at least 45 minutes); live abalone course ¥17,050 (9 items) with abalone in a sauce of seven mushrooms including truffle and porcini; anniversary course with A5 fillet, lobster, foie gras and caviar ¥22,000 · the live abalone course was ¥15,400 in a May 2026 review: appetizers, abalone, seasonal salad, three grilled vegetables, 80 g A5 fillet, rice or garlic rice, miso soup, pickles, dessert · appetizers such as wagyu tartare with fresh Wakayama shirasu, roast beef with hairy crab (2026) · garlic rice to finish (2026) · kinmedai can replace the meat on request (June 2026) · six courses in all (September 2026)
places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Kitashinchi, a woman owner-chef at the grill] A sixteen-seat teppanyaki room on a Kitashinchi third floor, run by a woman owner-chef who trained at a steakhouse with over fifty years of history and grows organic vegetables on the shop's own farm in Kyotanba. The signature is the live abalone course, abalone grilled whole with a seven-mushroom truffle and porcini sauce, then an A5 Tajima wagyu fillet and garlic rice fried on the teppan; courses run ¥13,200–22,000 plus 10% service. Diners praise the homey room, the flowers on each plate and the chef's warmth, and come for birthdays and business dinners. English menu; weekdays only; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): authentic teppanyaki by a female owner-chef, trained at a renowned steakhouse with over 50 years of history; A5 Tajima beef, the roots of Kobe and Matsusaka beef; live abalone and Ise lobster; the owner-chef prepares everything from scratch; organic vegetables grown on the shop's own farm in Kyotanba. Opened March 26, 2020. A September 2026 diner (fourth visit) describes "classic" and "innovative" teppanyaki by "a female chef who loves meat".
chef_bio.philosophy: "200°C Teppan. A 10-Second Miracle." (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "I was especially looking forward to the 'Garlic Rice' taught directly by the chef." — September 2026.
"I really appreciated the different flowers accompanying each dish!" — October 2026, a birthday dinner.
"the homegrown vegetables from Kyotanba were so good that they can't be compared to those from other places." — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu with photos (Tabelog).

places.name: グリルタケヤ (Grill Takeya)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. A sauce is used on the yakitori (October 2026), and the menu includes kara-age and grilled rice balls.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken shop; piman, yam and potato dishes appear alongside.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 18:00–24:00; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations open around noon on the 20th of each month for the next month, by Instagram direct message, and fill the same day (2025–2026 reviews). No time limit once booked; walk-ins after the first round has left, but the shop may close early when ingredients run out, so call first (August 2026). Some items, such as tamahimo, lamb, gizzard and horumon, must be ordered when booking (2025–2026). Service can be slow; one diner's meal took a little over three hours (October 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). 10 seats: 8 at the counter and one table (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Fukushima 6-chome, near the Sky Building — 7 min from Osaka Stn (Sakurabashi exit), 8 min from Fukushima Stn
places.cuisine: Charcoal yakitori in very large portions (2025–2026 reviews) · skewers: tsukune (also with cheese), liver served almost rare, heart, gizzard, neck, cartilage, sankaku, negima, breast with plum or wasabi, chicken wings (2025–2026) · chicken thigh tataki, chicken yukhoe, thigh sashimi, a large grilled bone-in thigh (2025–2026) · by advance order: tamahimo, lamb skewers, horumon (2025–2026) · piman rice, potato salad, dashimaki, kara-age, potato with butter, nukazuke (2026) · huge grilled rice balls with plum and bonito; smaller size on request (2026) · about ¥5,000–6,000 a head with drinks (2025–2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Fukushima, the monthly booking battle] A ten-seat yakitori shop near the Sky Building, run by a couple and on Tabelog's Yakitori WEST 100 for 2024, where every seat for the next month goes by Instagram message around noon on the 20th. Diners queue up for skewers half again or twice the usual size, grilled over charcoal by the owner: juicy tsukune, near-rare liver, thick heart and gizzard, plus chicken tataki, piman rice and huge grilled rice balls. About ¥5,000–6,000 a head with drinks. The owner grills alone, so order everything at once and allow time: meals can run three hours. Cash only; smoking allowed; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays.

roles: Owner (unnamed) at the grill; the owner's wife serves (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Several 2026 diners say the shop is run by a couple: the owner grills everything and the owner's wife serves (April, August, October 2026). Tabelog Yakitori WEST 100 2024. A May 2025 diner counts 8 counter seats and one table for four.

anecdotes.text: "Reservations can be made by sending a direct message to the restaurant's Instagram around noon on the 20th of each month." — September 2026.
"The yakitori portions are about 1.5 times larger than at regular places." — October 2026.
"The owner mentioned that it's tough to turn away customers, so please call ahead." — August 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Bookings by Instagram direct message; friendly service from the couple (2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: 炭焼き専門 ひととき 兎我野本店 (Sumiyaki Senmon Hitotoki Togano honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The shop stresses its sauce as well as ingredients and grilling (Tabelog); horse sashimi is usually eaten with soy sauce; beef-tendon curry at lunch (July 2026).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken and horse meat.
places.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–3:30 (last order 2:30); closes at 2:00 if no guests are in, so call ahead to arrive after 2:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). A July 2026 diner had a ¥1,000 lunch of beef-tendon curry with salad and iced coffee; lunch is not in the Tabelog hours. Appetizer charge ¥330 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money, PayPay, d Barai (Tabelog). 18 seats: a counter of 10 and two tables for 4; smoking allowed at all seats; private hire up to 20; groups of 6 or more by phone (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink courses (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Togano-cho, 平田第二レジャービル 1F — 5 min from Umeda and Higashi-Umeda Stns
places.cuisine: Charcoal yakitori of Asahibi Jidori, a local chicken from Hyogo, and horse sashimi shipped directly from Kumamoto, with meat sushi; all-you-can-drink courses (Tabelog) · horse sashimi platters of three cuts such as lean, fat and heart, or kokorone, futagoe and tenderloin (February 2025; June 2026) · a three-kind yakitori platter (not skewers), yagen cartilage and seseri (2025–2026) · chicken thigh tartare, slow-grilled thigh, meat sushi (December 2024) · blackboard specials; a chicken and vegetable stew as the appetizer (2026) · beef-tendon curry lunch ¥1,000 (July 2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · Umeda, Togano-cho, horse sashimi till 3:30 am] A small, retro charcoal-grill izakaya in Togano-cho with a U-shaped counter, open from 6 pm to 3:30 am every day, pairing Asahibi Jidori yakitori from Hyogo with horse sashimi sent straight from Kumamoto. Order a three-cut basashi platter (one diner had kokorone, futagoe and tenderloin) and a three-kind yakitori plate, plus yagen cartilage and seseri. A ¥330 appetizer is charged, all-you-can-drink courses suit groups, and smoking is allowed at every seat. Diners credit the cheerful woman owner and staff; it is busy, so dishes can be slow. There is a second shop in Doyama.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): charcoal-grilled Asahibi Jidori chicken and horse sashimi sourced directly; ingredients from local producers; a spacious counter for couples, friends and solo diners; all-you-can-drink courses; a smoking-friendly shop. Hyogo chicken; horse sashimi and meat sushi shipped from Kumamoto. A June 2026 diner had earlier visited the Doyama branch and praises "the warm hospitality from the female owner".
chef_bio.philosophy: Care over ingredients, sauce and grilling (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The three-sample platter included Kokorone, Futagoe, and Tenderloin, showcasing a luxurious lineup." — June 2026.
"It's a smoking-friendly place with a bit of a B-grade gourmet vibe, making it a friendly spot reminiscent of a typical bar in Umeda." — March 2026.
"I highly recommend the Yagen Nankotsu and Seseri." — March 2025.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seats welcome solo diners; friendly staff (2025–2026). No English evidence found.

places.name: ミルカレス (MILLE CARESSES)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The signature is a wagyu-fillet katsu sandwich; the course has pasta and a beef stew; cheese with dried fruit and bread.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wine bar menu of beef, oysters, cheese and stew.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat, holidays and the day before and after a holiday 17:30–0:30; closed Sundays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; French wine, whisky and cocktails only (no non-French bottles) (Tabelog). Service charge 10% and a ¥1,100 charge, courses excepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: a counter of 7, a semi-private room for 2–3 and a private room for 2–6 (room fee ¥11,000); non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 23 June 2009 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 曽根崎新地1-6-1, ground floor of ENISHI北新地ビル, wine bottles visible in the window — 3 min from Kitashinchi Stn exit 11-43
places.cuisine: Wine bar of French wine, mainly Burgundy and Champagne, by the bottle or by the glass (Coravin), with a kitchen (Tabelog; August 2026) · the course runs through starters, pasta, a special beef stew and the famous katsu sandwich (Tabelog); à la carte: the bite-sized wagyu-fillet katsu sandwich, seasonal rock oysters, blue cheese with dried fruit and bread, raisin and macadamia chocolates (2026) · premium wines by the glass, a service started at the request of international guests: in September 2026 Armand Rousseau Mazis-Chambertin and Emmanuel Rouget Echezeaux, with three Champagnes and six or seven reds and whites (September 2026)
places.notes: [Wine bar · Kitashinchi, Burgundy, Champagne and a katsu sandwich] A French-wine bar in Kitashinchi since 2009, its window lined with bottles, where a veteran sommelier with a following matches wine to your budget and talks you through it in an easy Osaka style. Only French bottles are poured, Burgundy and Champagne above all, with a long list by the glass that runs to grand crus. Almost everyone orders the bite-sized wagyu-fillet katsu sandwich, even as a second or third stop; there are also oysters, cheese, pasta and a beef stew. A 10% service charge and ¥1,100 cover apply; expect ¥10,000 and up. Open until 0:30.

roles: Senior sommelier and manager (listed on Tabelog's English page as "Toshihisa Kibi")
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: the senior sommelier, a Chevalier of the Champagne knights, was born in Shiga in 1965, started at "Bistro Vinsank", worked as a sommelier at several restaurants and became manager here in 2009, with over 20 years in Kitashinchi; the chef was born in Tokushima in 1970, worked at several restaurants after culinary school, was a private chef for visiting overseas artists and joined as opening chef in 2009; two sommeliers on staff. The Tabelog invoice number T4120001161429 is registered to 株式会社ブリス・ダイニング at the shop's address (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02); August 2026 reviewers write that an Ise winery runs the bar. Names are given only in the English translation, which spells them inconsistently.
chef_bio.specialty: French wine by the glass; wagyu katsu sandwich.

anecdotes.text: "The premium wine by the glass service, which originally started from requests by international guests, is still going strong." — September 2026.
"Above all, Sommelier Kibi is entertaining, and not only is the wine selection impressive, but the conversation is also enjoyable." — July 2026.
"And when you come to MILLE CARESSES, you just have to try the beef cutlet sandwich!" — August 2026, a sixth visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ミルカレス、ワインバー・イタリアン・ビストロ、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-6-1 ENISHI北新地ビル1階、JR 東西線 北新地駅11-43出口から徒歩3分、月〜土・祝・祝前日・祝後日17:30〜0:30、日曜休み、予約可、フランスのワインのみ (ほかの国のワイン、ウイスキー、カクテルはない)、サービス料10%、チャージ1,100円 (税込、コースは除く)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、16席 (カウンター7、半個室2〜3名、個室2〜6名、個室料11,000円)、禁煙、2009年6月23日オープン、ソムリエが選ぶワイン、ブルゴーニュとシャンパーニュ、前菜、パスタ、特製ビーフシチュー、名物のカツサンドのコース、ソムリエは1965年 Shiga 生まれで2009年から店長、Champagne の騎士団の Chevalier、シェフは1970年 Tokushima 生まれで海外のアーティストの専属シェフも、2009年の開店から。インボイス登録は株式会社ブリス・ダイニング (店と同じ住所)。口コミ(2024年3月〜2026年10月): 牛ヒレのカツサンド、岩がき、ブルーチーズとドライフルーツとパン、レーズンとマカダミアのチョコ、Coravin でグラスの種類が多い、海外のお客さんの要望で始まったプレミアムワインのグラス、シャンパーニュ3種と赤白6〜7種、ソムリエの話が楽しい、予算に合わせて選んでくれる、Ise のワイナリーが運営という声、値段が上がったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: The premium wines by the glass began at the request of international guests (September 2026); the sommelier guides choices at the counter. No English-language evidence found.

places.name: 割烹 大田川 (Kappou Ootagawa)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Kaiseki courses with tempura; lunch sets of crab cream croquette, beef croquette, fried chicken wings and spring rolls.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood kaiseki and dashi-based dishes.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–13:30 (ends when sold out) and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays; Saturdays by reservation only, booked by the day before, and some Saturdays closed (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted; 100% course fee for cancellations within three days, ¥10,000 a head for seat-only bookings (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter of about nine and sunken-floor private rooms for 3–12; smoking allowed (Tabelog; June 2026). Children's meals with notice (Tabelog). Opened 20 November 2006 (Tabelog). New Year osechi to order (official site).
places.neighborhood: 堂島1-3-16, basement of 堂島メリーセンタービル, behind 堂島アバンザ, a lantern at the entrance — 3 min from Kitashinchi Stn
places.cuisine: Creative kaiseki of seasonal ingredients from the central market, about 50 on the day's menu (Tabelog; official site) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): "Hana" for first visits ¥12,100, with two hours of drinks ¥16,500; chef's omakase chicken course ¥14,300; "Kaze" ¥16,500; "Wa" ¥19,800 · à la carte: dashimaki, bacon and daikon (February 2026) · lunch, four set meals at ¥1,300 each with three small dishes, rice, miso soup, pickles and a jelly dessert: the favourite crab cream croquette under a vegetable sauce (bamboo shoot, konnyaku and bean sprouts with curry powder), fried chicken wings with beef croquettes, grilled salted mackerel, a chicken rice in dashi like ochazuke (Tokunoshima style per a June 2026 diner), ginger pork, spring rolls (March–October 2026)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Dojima, creative kappo and a famous lunch] A basement kappo restaurant west of Kitashinchi since 2006, with a counter and tatami-style private rooms for business dinners, betrothal meals and anniversaries. The owner trained at 石和川 in Kitashinchi and has twenty-five years at the stove; evening courses of seasonal creative kaiseki run ¥12,100–19,800. Lunch is the bargain and fills fast: four ¥1,300 sets, the favourite a crab cream croquette under a curry-scented vegetable sauce, with small dishes, rice, miso soup and a jelly. Smoking is allowed; Saturdays are by reservation only.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site of 株式会社タイガー・アイ, which runs 割烹 大田川 (read as かっぽう おおたがわ): the owner trained at 石和川 in Kitashinchi and is a craftsman of twenty-five years; ingredients are chosen one by one and prepared slowly; private rooms for up to 12; osechi at New Year. Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: about 50 seasonal ingredients on the daily menu; opened 20 November 2006. An April 2026 diner writes that the chef is from Tokunoshima.
chef_bio.philosophy: "食を通じてお客様に感動をお届けする" (to move guests through food) (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Creative kaiseki; crab cream croquette lunch.

anecdotes.text: "I’ve never had such delicious bean sprouts that make you want to eat more rice." — May 2026, the crab cream croquette lunch.
"The chef is from Tokunoshima, and you can really feel the love for Tokunoshima in the dishes." — April 2026.
"I visited during lunch hours, and the place quickly filled up, creating a line outside." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (株式会社タイガー・アイ): 北新地で季節の食材の割烹・小料理『割烹 大田川』(かっぽう おおたがわ) を運営、堂島1-3-16 堂島メリーセンタービル B1F、月〜土11:30〜13:30、17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、旬の食材とこの道二十五年の匠の技、知る人ぞ知る北新地の隠れ家、接待・結納・顔合わせ・夫婦の記念日に、創作懐石、食材を職人が選びじっくり時間をかける、年末はおせち、12名までの個室のお座敷、カウンター席、店主は北新地の『石和川』で修業。食べログ (店舗会員): 割烹 大田川、日本料理・海鮮・天ぷら、日・祝休み、土曜は前日までの完全予約制、ランチは売り切れ次第終了、3日前からのキャンセルは100%、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、20席、掘りごたつの個室、喫煙可、子どもの料理も相談、2006年11月20日オープン、季節の食材約50種、はなコース12,100円、飲み放題つき16,500円、鶏のおまかせコース14,300円、風コース16,500円、和コース19,800円。口コミ(2026年2月〜10月): ランチは4種で各1,300円、野菜あんかけのカニクリームコロッケ (たけのこ、こんにゃく、もやしのカレー風味)、手羽先の唐揚げと牛肉コロッケ、塩サバ、だしをかける鶏飯、しょうが焼き、春巻き、小鉢3種、ごはん、みそ汁、漬物、ゼリーのデザート、すぐに満席で行列、大将は Tokunoshima 出身という声、だし巻き、ベーコンと大根、喫煙できる、スタッフが丁寧。

cultural_comfort.note: Set lunches and kaiseki courses (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

places.notes: [Chinese · Fukushima, a ¥1,000 mapo tofu lunch] A small wooden-fronted Chinese diner on a side street between Osaka and Fukushima stations, with manga on the shelves and a counter where you hear the wok. Workers come at lunch for the ¥1,000 mapo tofu set, gentle on chilli but fragrant and numbing with Sichuan pepper, with a big bowl of rice, egg soup and salad, or the daily noodle set. At night it runs to about midnight with fried rice and liver with chives. Cash only; smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog listing (not shop-maintained): Chinese diner of dim sum, dumplings and ramen; 26 seats; cash only. An August 2026 diner saw the owner cooking alone.

anecdotes.text: "From the kitchen, you can hear the pleasant sound of the Chinese wok being tossed." — January 2026, the mapo tofu lunch.

"The interior has a bar-like atmosphere, and I noticed the owner was cooking solo." — August 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Hotpots in dashi with rice porridge to finish, tempura of beltfish and of eel and matsutake in buckwheat flour, sashimi with soy.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, eel and beef dishes and dashi hotpots.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sundays, and Mondays that are holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; two-hour limit for seat-only bookings when busy; parties of two at the counter only (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter and semi-private table rooms for 4 to 20; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 10 May 2010 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 堂島1-3-33, 2F of 新地萬年ビル on Kamidori, above a flower shop — 4 min from Kitashinchi Stn
places.cuisine: Fish and vegetables sent from Awaji Island by the owner's friends there, with over 20 sakes including Awaji's Tomi Bijin (Tabelog) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): banquet courses from ¥6,800; Awaji hamo hotpot ¥7,000 in summer; grilled-eel and eel-hotpot course of seven dishes; courses also at ¥9,350, ¥9,650 and ¥14,000 · winter fugu and its milt (Tabelog) · dishes named in 2025–2026: noresore (baby eel), white amadai sashimi, grouper liver, abalone steak, grilled kinmedai, buri shabu-shabu with aosa; Hinai chicken soup with Kawachi chicken tsukune; six-kind sashimi; ayu with fruit tomato; eel and matsutake tempura in buckwheat flour; Awaji beef roast with green-onion sauce; tomato and yuba "mapo"; beltfish tempura; aburi beltfish sushi; hamochiri hotpot and zosui with sansho oil; eel shabu-shabu
places.notes: [Izakaya · Dojima, Awaji fish and sake] A 20-seat kappo-style izakaya above a flower shop on Kitashinchi's Kamidori, open since 2010, whose owner, from Awaji Island, gets fish and vegetables straight from friends back home. Summer means Awaji hamo, as hotpot, shabu-shabu or tempura, finished with a rice porridge lifted with sansho oil; eel courses with eel shabu-shabu; winter brings fugu. Courses run from about ¥6,800 to ¥14,000 plus 10% service, with over twenty sakes, including Awaji's own. Popular for business dinners, with semi-private rooms; smoking is allowed. The company runs a second shop, 本通り店, nearby.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "The owner from Awaji Island sources fresh fish and vegetables directly from friends, focusing on local produce from Awaji Island"; over 20 sakes always; opened 10 May 2010. The operator site of 株式会社心屋 lists two shops, 地魚と地野菜 心屋 上通り店 (this one) and 個室と地肴 心屋 本通り店. The Tabelog invoice number T2120001171041 is registered to 株式会社心屋 at this address (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02). An October 2026 diner thanks "the head chef, the owner, and the staff".

anecdotes.text: "I added the chef's recommended "Sansho Oil" to the zosui (rice porridge), enhancing its flavor and making it absolutely delicious." — September 2025, the hamochiri hotpot.
"It was my first time trying fresh eel shabu-shabu, and it had a refreshing taste and a melt-in-your-mouth texture, even better than grilled eel." — July 2026, the eel course.
"Thank you very much for accommodating my last-minute change in visit time." — October 2026, a second visit.

cultural_comfort.note: Courses and à la carte; semi-private rooms (Tabelog). No English evidence found.
