places.notes: [Italian · Namba Parks, all-day pizzeria and terrace café] A big, resort-style pizzeria, café and bar on the 2nd floor of Namba Parks, with a terrace by the Starbucks and a glass front, open from 11 AM to 11 PM. Lunch comes with a buffet of about 20 breads, soup curry and soup; in the afternoon it is a café for cakes and big parfaits, and at night a place for pizza, ajillo and wine. Diners in 2026 like the terrace, the seasonal pizzas and the desserts; one found the fettuccine came out so fast it might have been pre-made, and one thought a single pizza in a ¥3,000 course was thin for three. Orders are by QR code.

roles: Kitchen staff unnamed; a restaurant of BALNIBARBI Co.,Ltd. (official site)
chef_bio.background: The official site shows the © of BALNIBARBI Co.,Ltd. and lists lunch, café & bar and dinner times at Namba Parks 2F. Tabelog gives the opening as 29 April 2019.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal pizza; lunch bread buffet; desserts.

anecdotes.text: "When you order a main dish, you can enjoy all-you-can-eat from about 20 types of bread, soup curry, soup, and rice." — September 2026, lunch.
"The fettuccine pasta was chewy, but it was served in under 5 minutes, so it might have been pre-made." — September 2026.
"Through the large glass windows, the interior exudes a stylish vibe reminiscent of a resort destination abroad." — October 2026.
"I ordered the Basque cheesecake, which was so rich and creamy that it felt like I was eating cheese itself—it was absolutely delicious!" — October 2026, night café.

places.neighborhood: Namba 1-6-21, by Hozenji — 3 min from Namba Stn exit 14 (Midosuji Line)
places.cuisine: Kyushu food from around the island (Tabelog): live squid sashimi (when in stock), Kumamoto horse sashimi, seasonal sashimi, Hakata motsunabe and mizutaki, Hakata ramen salad, mentaiko rolled omelette, karashi renkon, Nakatsu kara-age, Miyazaki chicken nanban, Beppu chicken tempura, steamed sea-bream head, squid shumai (Tabelog menu, August 2026) · lunch sets: tempura and sushi, black-wagyu sukiyaki, Kyushu chicken rice (reviews) · Kyushu shochu and sake; courses with all-you-can-drink
places.notes: [Izakaya · Hozenji, Kyushu food with private rooms] A Kyushu restaurant by Hozenji, opened in August 2017, with a counter on the ground floor and private rooms over four themed floors, used for business dinners, celebrations and quiet lunches. The menu travels the island: live Yobuko-style squid when it can be had, Kumamoto horse sashimi, Hakata motsunabe and mizutaki, Miyazaki chicken nanban and the Hakata ramen salad. An eight-visit regular notes the squid is often sold out, especially on holidays, and booking a day ahead helps. Weekday lunch sets can be booked for one. Diners in 2026 praise the calm rooms and the service.

roles: Kitchen staff unnamed; a shop of the Kato Pleasure Group (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (カトープレジャーグループ), Hakata-ro has four shops: Hozenji, Osaka (Mitsui Garden Hotel Osaka Premier, Nakanoshima), Fukuoka main shop (Daimyo) and Nishi-Nakasu. Tabelog describes Kyushu as surrounded by sea with mountains inland, its ingredients "bold and delicate, simple yet expressive", and lists four uniquely themed floors of private rooms. A September 2026 diner recalls opening in 2017.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Bold and delicate, simple yet expressive" Kyushu ingredients (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Live squid sashimi; Hakata motsunabe; mizutaki.

anecdotes.text: "I always go there hoping to have squid, but it’s hard to find it in stock, especially during holidays." — September 2026, eighth visit.
"It's rare to find a place that allows solo reservations for weekday lunches, so this was a valuable find." — July 2026, first lunch.
"After the 2-hour course, we enjoyed an all-you-can-drink plan in the free space on the 4th floor." — September 2026, farewell party.

places.name: 冷麺館 心斎橋店 (Korean Cold Noodles Kan Shinsaibashi ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The handmade cold noodles are not described; the menu also has chijimi, bibim noodles, hot pot with udon or ramen to finish, and yakiniku (Tabelog menu; reviews). Tabelog asks diners to note allergies when booking.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Korean restaurant of yakiniku, soups and hot pots; the cold-noodle broth and kimchi are not described.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Wed 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); Fri the same until 22:30; Sat 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:30; Sun 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Thursday, subject to change (Tabelog). Reservations taken; no time limit except 2 hours when busy; allergies and dislikes can be noted when booking (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). Set meals at dinner too (September 2026 review).
places.neighborhood: Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-19-23, 尾形ビル 1F — 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn; 7 min from Nagahoribashi Stn
places.cuisine: Korean restaurant built on handmade cold noodles, opened so that cold noodles could be a casual meal as in Ikuno, where the main shop is (Tabelog menu) · cold noodles with chewy handmade noodles and a light broth, bone-in kalbi cold noodles, bibim noodles; samgyeopsal, chijimi, steamed pork, tail soup, kimchi stew, tetchan hot pot with udon or ramen to finish; set meals (yakiniku, kalbi soup, tail soup) with rice; lunch sets with bibimbap or cold noodles (Tabelog menu, February 2025; reviews)
places.notes: [Korean · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, handmade cold noodles since 2000] A Korean restaurant five minutes from Shinsaibashi Station, there since 2000, the Minami shop of a cold-noodle house whose main shop is in Ikuno-ku, where cold noodles are an everyday meal like udon. The handmade noodles are chewy in a light broth; diners in 2026 also order the samgyeopsal, chijimi, steamed pork, tail soup and hot pot, and praise the kimchi served alongside. Portions are made for sharing. A regular of 20 years calls everything delicious and cheap; a September 2026 diner who knows the Kitashinchi branch felt less satisfied here. Closed Thursdays.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog menu, the main shop is in Ikuno-ku, an area with many Korean residents of Japan, where cold noodles are as casual a choice as udon or okonomiyaki; usually eaten to finish a yakiniku meal, so the house created a place to enjoy a bowl of cold noodles on its own. Per Tabelog, the Shinsaibashi shop has been in Minami for 26 years (opened 18 April 2000) and promoted Korean food long before the recent Korean wave.
chef_bio.philosophy: "A place where you can casually enjoy a bowl of cold noodles" (Tabelog menu).

anecdotes.text: "The noodles are handmade, with a strong chewy texture that pairs perfectly with the light broth." — September 2026, bone-in kalbi cold noodles.
"I've been coming to this restaurant for over 20 years since I was a child." — September 2026.
"For some reason, my satisfaction level felt different from the Kitashinchi branch." — September 2026, first visit to Shinsaibashi.
"The kimchi that came as a side was incredibly tasty!" — July 2026, bibimbap set with cold noodles.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 日本語の情報源は未確認 (公式サイト reimenkan.com は応答なし)。食べログ (英語版): 冷麺館 心斎橋店、東心斎橋1-19-23 尾形ビル1F、2000年4月18日オープン、ミナミで26年、韓流ブームの前から韓国料理、手作りの冷麺、Kimchi stew、Samgyeopsal、Chijimi、月〜水11:30〜15:00・17:30〜22:00、金は22:30まで、土11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:30、日11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、木曜休み、予約時にアレルギーや苦手な食材を記入可、混雑時は2時間制。メニュー (2025年2月): 本店のある Ikuno では冷麺が udon や okonomiyaki と同じくらい気軽、Yakiniku の締めの冷麺を気軽な一杯にと冷麺館が生まれた、セット、定食 (Yakiniku、Kalbi スープ、テールスープ)、Tetchan 鍋 (締めは udon か ramen)。口コミ (2026年7月〜9月): 手作りの麺のもちもち感とあっさりスープ、骨付き Kalbi の冷麺1,750円、Bibim 麺、Samgyeopsal、蒸し豚、テールスープ、付け合わせの Kimchi、量が多く分け合う、20年通う客、Kitashinchi の店の方が満足という声。

cultural_comfort.note: No English menu or English-speaking staff found in the sources.

places.name: 故郷羊肉串店 (Fushang Ryang Ruchai Ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The skewers are seasoned with chili, sesame and cumin; the menu also has dumplings, glass noodles and sauced stir-fries (Tabelog menu; reviews).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a lamb-skewer and Northeast-Chinese restaurant; vegetable stir-fries such as eggplant, pepper and potato are not described.
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00) (Tabelog). Reservations taken; a January 2026 pair walked in. No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 64 seats incl. tatami; non-smoking; private hire for 20 or more (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shimanouchi 2-17-22, by the Dotonbori River — 5 min from Nippombashi Stn exit 6
places.cuisine: Lamb skewers and home cooking of Northeast China, based on the lamb food of Yanji, Jilin, where the owner was born (Tabelog) · mutton skewers with chili, sesame and cumin grilled over charcoal at the table, lamb tendon, heart, cartilage and spare-rib skewers; stir-fries such as di san xian (eggplant, pepper, potato), garlic sprouts with pork, tomato and egg, mapo eggplant, sweet and sour pork, offal; boiled dumplings, fried rice, Northeast vegetables (Tabelog menu, October 2026; reviews) · Qingdao beer, Chinese liquor
places.notes: [Chinese · Shimanouchi, Yanji-style lamb skewers] A Northeast-Chinese restaurant near the Dotonbori River, run on the lamb cooking of Yanji in Jilin, where the owner grew up: small cubes of mutton dusted with chili, sesame and cumin and grilled over charcoal at your table, ¥220 a skewer in September 2026. Regulars come back for the skewers with Qingdao beer, the di san xian of eggplant, pepper and potato and the boiled dumplings; portions are big and made for groups. A January 2026 diner found all the floor staff were from China and the flavours like a trip there; a March diner was sometimes unsure of being understood in Japanese. The street around it has Chinese shops and a Chinese grocery across the road. Pay by cash or PayPay; no cards.

roles: Owner unnamed, born and raised in Yanji, Jilin, China (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, the dishes are based on the lamb cuisine of Yanji City in Jilin Province, where the owner was born and raised; lamb leg is grilled over charcoal on a grill set at the table, and lamb is presented as high-protein and low-fat. Tabelog gives the opening as 29 June 2002.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Deliciousness without borders" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Mutton skewers with cumin and chili.

anecdotes.text: "As of September 2026, lamb skewers are priced at a very affordable JPY 220." — September 2026.
"All the staff in the dining area were from China." — January 2026.
"The potatoes are fluffy, the eggplant is tender, and the bell peppers are perfectly cooked and incredibly tasty." — October 2026, di san xian.
"I can feel that a Chinatown is starting to form, with Chinese restaurants on both sides and across the street." — October 2026, first visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 日本語の情報源は未確認。食べログ (英語版): 故郷羊肉串店、島之内2-17-22、日本橋駅6番出口から徒歩約5分、道頓堀川沿い、店主の出身地である中国 Jilin 省 Yanji 市の羊料理がもと、テーブルの炭火で焼く羊のもも肉、毎日17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、64席、座敷、禁煙、20名以上で貸切。メニュー (2026年10月): 羊肉串220円 (唐辛子、ごま、クミン、炭火)、羊のすじ、ハツ、軟骨、スペアリブの串、Di san xian (なす、ピーマン、じゃがいも)、にんにくの芽と豚肉炒め、トマトと卵炒め、Mapo なす、酢豚、ホルモン炒め。口コミ (2026年1月〜10月): 羊肉串と Qingdao ビール、Di san xian、水餃子、チャーハン、東北の野菜、量が多くグループ向き、ホールのスタッフは全員中国出身 (1月)、日本語が通じているか不安な時があったという声 (3月)、向かいに中国食材店、60歳の誕生日祝いにも。

cultural_comfort.note: All the floor staff were from China (January 2026); a March 2026 diner was sometimes unsure of being understood in Japanese. No English menu found in the sources.

places.name: たこ焼 十八番 西中島本店 (Takoyaki Juhachiban Nishinakajima Honten)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat batter packed with tenkasu (tempura scraps).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus and small shrimp in a batter made with dashi and milk.
places.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–22:00, last order 21:30; takeout still sold after last order; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; cash or PayPay only (Tabelog). 18 seats: 8 at the counter and two tables for four; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 26 November 1990 (Tabelog). Takeout in microwave-safe boxes (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 西中島3-17-17 — about 20 m from Hankyu Minamikata Stn, 2 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Stn (Tabelog), across from the Minamikata north-east gate (September 2026)
places.cuisine: Takoyaki only (July 2026) · batter made with dashi and milk, creamy inside; each ball holds octopus, pickled ginger, small shrimp and plenty of tenkasu, so the outside is crisp (September 2026) · flavours: sauce, salt, tendashi (dipping broth) and ponzu; sauce mayo and green-onion mayo (2025–2026) · "Ohashiko" assortments: three kinds, 12 pieces, ¥950; four kinds, 16 pieces, ¥1,270 (September 2026) · bonito flakes, aonori, sauce and mayonnaise free on the table (2025–2026) · beer and highballs (2026); sake, shochu, wine and cocktails (Tabelog); Coke ¥250 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Takoyaki · Nishinakajima, tenkasu-packed takoyaki since 1990] The 1990 main shop of Juhachiban, right by the Hankyu Minamikata gate: takoyaki at the front window and a small room behind with counter, two tables and drinks. The balls are full of tenkasu, so they come out crisp outside and creamy inside, with octopus, pickled ginger and small shrimp in a batter of dashi and milk (September 2026). Try the "Ohashiko" assortment: salt, sauce and tendashi or ponzu, 12 pieces for ¥950, or all four flavours for ¥1,270 (September 2026). Bonito flakes, aonori and mayonnaise are free on the table. A favourite late stop for locals after a drink. Cash or PayPay only; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 26 November 1990 (Tabelog). A September 2026 diner writes that the shop "was established with the desire to create a takoyaki shop where girls can casually drop by" under the motto "One Ball, One Soul". Another September 2026 diner was shown in by an older woman grilling takoyaki at the front, and writes that the brand has since opened other shops, including Dotonbori and Universal Studios Japan.
chef_bio.philosophy: "One Ball, One Soul" (motto, as quoted by a September 2026 diner).

anecdotes.text: "The takoyaki batter is blended with dashi and milk, making it creamy." — September 2026, Ohashiko three kinds for JPY 950 with ponzu.
"The takoyaki from the long-established Takoyaki Juhachiban is delicious even when reheated the next day." — September 2026, an after-party regular.
"The takoyaki here had a unique flavor that you can't find in Kanto, and it was the most delicious I've ever had in my life." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: たこ焼 十八番 西中島本店、たこ焼き、大阪市淀川区西中島3-17-17、南方駅から21m、毎日12:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30、L.O. 後もテイクアウト可)、予約不可、現金か PayPay のみ、18席 (カウンター8、4人テーブル2)、喫煙可、1990年11月26日オープン、電子レンジ可の容器で持ち帰り。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年9月): たこ焼きだけ、生地はだしと牛乳でクリーミー、タコ、紅しょうが、小エビ、天かすたっぷりで外はカリッ、ソース、塩、tendashi、ポン酢、ソースマヨ、ねぎマヨ、「Ohashiko」は3種12個950円、4種16個1,270円、かつお節、青のり、ソース、マヨネーズは卓上で自由、ビール、ハイボール、コーラ250円、道頓堀や Universal Studios Japan にも店がある、飲んだあとに寄る常連も。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the front, sit inside if there is room; cash or PayPay only. No English evidence found.

places.name: らーめん ぴ! (Ramen Pi!)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken paitan broth, some with shellfish, chashu and egg.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Thu 11:30–15:30 and 17:30–01:00; Fri 11:30–15:30 and 17:30–02:00; Sat 11:30–02:00; Sun and holidays 11:30–21:00; open all year; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Tabelog lists no cards, e-money or QR, but an October 2026 diner found cashless payment at the ticket machine. 8 counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). No alcohol (October 2026). Opened 8 August 2020 (Tabelog). Reviewers from September 2026 say the shop now goes by "French Chicken Noodles", with a new menu.
places.neighborhood: 西中島3-16-6, ground floor of 三勝ビル — by the Hankyu Minamikata east gate (Tabelog); same building as osaka_negiyaki_okonomiyaki_kazu_nishinakajima
places.cuisine: Chicken-paitan ramen with French touches (2026) · Tabelog shop text: "Jidori White", a rich soup of Tamba Kurodori chicken with a vegetable purée; "Jidori Gold" (salt) and "Jidori Black" (soy); tsukemen; chashu don · from September 2026 reviewers report a new name and menu built on chicken paitan: "Classic" chicken paitan with egg and chashu ¥1,300; "Maree", chicken paitan with shellfish broth, ¥1,350; special topping ¥450 (September–October 2026) · basil sauce, mustard and lemon on the rim of the bowl (2026) · rare chashu (2026) · finish with the cheese risotto set ¥550, raclette melted with a torch (September 2026); small rice ¥150 · Pi! White ¥1,050 and tsukemen still ordered in October 2026 · noodle size small, regular or large at the ticket machine (October 2026)
places.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima, chicken paitan with a French accent] An 8-seat counter by the Hankyu Minamikata gate that serves a rich chicken paitan dressed like a French plate, with basil sauce, mustard and lemon around the rim and rare chashu on top (2026). Finish the broth as a cheese risotto, raclette melted with a torch, for ¥550 (September 2026). In 2026 it changed its name and menu: reviewers now call it "French Chicken Noodles", with the "Classic" chicken paitan at ¥1,300 and "Maree", chicken paitan with shellfish broth, at ¥1,350 (September–October 2026). One regular missed the old clear salt and soy bowls (October 2026). Open past midnight Monday to Saturday; ticket machine; no alcohol.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog shop text: a stylish ramen shop right in front of the Hankyu Minamikata gate, with a rich soup of Tamba Kurodori chicken; opened 8 August 2020 (Tabelog). From September 2026, several reviewers report a new name, "French Chicken Noodles", and a revamped menu; the Tabelog listing still reads Ramen Pi!. Reviewers praise the friendly staff (2023–2026).

anecdotes.text: "The broth has a unique flavor, combining the essence of chicken paitan with a hint of potato, which is quite delightful." — September 2026, the Classic for JPY 1,300.
"It was so delicious that I wanted to drink every last drop." — October 2026, the Maree for JPY 1,350.
"The raclette cheese enhances the guilty pleasure, and it goes incredibly well with the broth." — September 2026, the cheese risotto set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: らーめん ぴ!、ラーメン・つけ麺、大阪市淀川区西中島3-16-6 三勝ビル 1F、阪急 南方駅の東改札すぐ、月〜木11:30〜15:30、17:30〜翌1:00、金11:30〜15:30、17:30〜翌2:00、土11:30〜翌2:00、日・祝11:30〜21:00、無休、予約不可、カウンター8席、禁煙、子ども可、2020年8月8日オープン、店の紹介に「Jidori White」(Tamba Kurodori の濃厚スープに野菜のピューレ)、「Jidori Gold」(塩)、「Jidori Black」(醤油)、つけ麺、チャーシュー丼。口コミ (2023年10月〜2026年10月): 2026年9月から店名が「French Chicken Noodles」に変わり、メニューも鶏白湯中心に、「Classic」1,300円、貝だしの鶏白湯「Maree」1,350円、特製トッピング450円、ふちにバジルソース、マスタード、レモン、レアチャーシュー、チーズリゾットのセット550円 (ラクレットをバーナーで)、小ライス150円、2026年10月にも Pi! White 1,050円とつけ麺、券売機でキャッシュレス可、お酒はない、前の塩や醤油が好きだった常連は残念がる。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine with cashless payment; choose noodle size and toppings. No English evidence found.

places.name: 寿司割烹 ふじい (Sushi Kappou Fujii)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sushi comes with soy sauce, a different one for each topping (September 2026). The shop says it may decline bookings from guests with extensive allergies, for safety (Tabelog). Mention allergies when you book.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a single seafood omakase.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 17:00–23:00; closed Wednesday, Sunday and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservation only: one ¥25,000 omakase course, all guests start together at 18:00; late arrivals may miss dishes; book or cancel by 22:00 the day before (Tabelog). Cash and cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats (Tabelog house rules; September 2026); non-smoking; no children; no strong perfume; no phone calls inside; photos of food fine but not of other guests or staff; no very revealing clothes (Tabelog). Opened 20 June 2023; reservation-only course format since mid-2026 (Tabelog; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: 西中島3-3-9, ground floor — 3 min from Nishinakajima-Minamigata Stn and Hankyu Minamikata Stn (Tabelog)
places.cuisine: Sushi kappo: one omakase course, ¥25,000, starting at 18:00 (Tabelog; September 2026) · starters: hairy crab, ikura and tuna in a crab shell, with sudachi (September 2026); nodoguro soup made without soy sauce (September 2026) · uni tasting of three or four kinds, e.g. Hokkaido and Rishiri murasaki uni and Ehime red uni (September 2026) · nigiri: yellowtail, akagai, kohada marinated four days, eel wrapped in Lake Hamana aonori, shima-aji from Amakusa, toro, sanma, simmered clam from Kujukuri, marinated yellowfin, nodoguro, anago (September 2026) · rice served warm, at body temperature or slightly cool to suit each topping, and a different soy sauce for each (September 2026) · between pieces: grilled akagai, mozuku, grilled managatsuo and mehikari, abalone steamed six hours with liver sauce (September 2026) · wasabi from Shizuoka (September 2026) · finish: toro-taku rice bowl (September 2026) · drinks: draft beer ¥800, Taketsuru highball ¥900, chuhai and shochu from ¥700, sake from ¥800 (September 2026)
places.notes: [Sushi · Nishinakajima, 8-seat omakase at a single 18:00 start] A bright, calm sushi kappo near Minamikata that since mid-2026 serves one ¥25,000 omakase to eight guests at the counter, all starting together at 18:00 (Tabelog; September 2026). Expect hairy crab and ikura to open, a nodoguro soup, a tasting of several kinds of uni, and nigiri from four-day kohada to anago, with abalone steamed six hours and charcoal-grilled fish between pieces, ending on a toro-taku bowl (September 2026). The chef serves the rice at three temperatures and uses a different soy sauce for each topping, and talks guests through every fish (September–October 2026). Book by the day before and arrive on time; no children, no strong perfume. Closed Wednesday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog beyond house rules; opened 20 June 2023 (Tabelog). Since mid-2026 the shop runs as an 8-seat counter, reservation only, with a single course starting at 18:00 (September 2026 reviews; Tabelog). Reviewers describe the chef as friendly and talkative, explaining each ingredient, with deep knowledge of fish (September–October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Rice temperature and soy sauce matched to each topping (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Uni tasting; abalone steamed six hours with liver sauce.

anecdotes.text: "They categorize the rice temperature into three ranges: warm, body temperature, and slightly cold, adjusting it according to the topping." — September 2026, the JPY 25,000 omakase.
"One standout was the abalone, which was steamed in a vacuum for six hours." — September 2026.
"The charcoal-grilled mehikari was especially surprising, with an incredibly fluffy texture that changed my previous impressions." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司割烹 ふじい、寿司・海鮮・和食、大阪市淀川区西中島3-3-9 1F、西中島南方駅と南方駅から徒歩3分、月・火・木・金・土17:00〜23:00、水・日・祝休み、完全予約制、コースは25,000円の一つだけ、18:00にいっせいにスタート、遅れると出せない料理もある、予約とキャンセルは前日22:00まで、現金とカード、カウンター8席、禁煙、子ども不可、強い香水はひかえて、アレルギーが多い場合は予約を断ることもある、店内で電話はしない、ほかの客やスタッフを写さない、露出の多い服はひかえて、2023年6月20日オープン。口コミ (2026年9〜10月): 毛ガニ、いくら、マグロの前菜、のどぐろのスープ、ウニの食べくらべ (Hokkaido、Rishiri、Ehime など)、ブリ、赤貝、4日漬けたコハダ、Lake Hamana の青のりで巻いたうなぎ、Amakusa のシマアジ、トロ、さんま、Kujukuri の煮た貝、漬けのキハダ、のどぐろ、穴子、シャリは温かい、人肌、少し冷たいの3つの温度で、醤油もネタごとに変える、6時間蒸したアワビの肝ソース、炭火のメヒカリ、しめはトロたく丼、生ビール800円、Taketsuru のハイボール900円、日本酒800円から、大将は気さくで魚にくわしい。

places.name: たこ焼き 夢屋 (Takoyaki Yumeya)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat batter full of tenkasu (tempura scraps).
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus takoyaki; kara-age and yangnyeom chicken also on the menu.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; Sun 11:00–17:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; no cards or e-money, QR payments accepted (Tabelog). 8 seats, 7 at the counter; smoking allowed; private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). One drink per person to eat in at lunch; eating in costs about ¥200 more than takeaway (April 2026). Eat-in had already closed at 14:10 on a holiday in January 2026. Freshly made, so expect a wait of about 15 minutes (April 2025). Opened 19 October 2020 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: 東淀川区西淡路1-14-30 — about 60 m from JR Higashi-Yodogawa Stn (Tabelog), across the crossing from the east exit (November 2025), one stop from Shin-Osaka
places.cuisine: Takoyaki: 6, 9 or 12 pieces, with sauce, soy sauce, ponzu or salt; salt mayo recommended (April 2025) · lots of tenkasu inside, crisp outside and creamy inside; large balls with small pieces of octopus (2025–2026) · prices: 6 pieces ¥500 (May 2025; March 2026); 9 pieces with sauce ¥750 (January 2026); 9 pieces with salt ¥850, green-onion topping ¥50 (April 2025) · soy-sauce mayo with green onion (May 2026) · mayonnaise added free (2025–2026) · small kara-age (November 2025); yangnyeom chicken (May 2025) · "senbero" set of takoyaki and two drinks; oolong tea ¥250 (April 2025)
places.notes: [Takoyaki · Higashi-Yodogawa, crunchy tenkasu takoyaki one stop from Shin-Osaka] A tiny takeout window with a few counter seats behind it, a minute from Higashi-Yodogawa Station, decorated half American, half Osaka, with Yoshimoto comedy on the TV (April 2025). The takoyaki are big and rough-surfaced, so full of tenkasu that they come out crunchy outside and creamy inside; the octopus pieces are small (2025–2026). Six cost ¥500 (March 2026). Locals favour salt mayo or soy-sauce mayo with green onion. Each batch is made to order, so allow about 15 minutes; eating in at lunch needs one drink each. Closed Wednesday; open to 23:00 most evenings.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 19 October 2020 (Tabelog). Reviewers find it through YouTube recommendations (November 2025; January 2026) and praise the friendly staff (May 2026).

anecdotes.text: "After a brief wait, I was informed, 'It will take a little time,' and the sounds of sizzling from the unseen counter heightened my anticipation." — April 2025, 9 salt takoyaki for JPY 850.
"While Kansai-style takoyaki is often thought of as fluffy, these were crispy on the outside, then fluffy, and finally creamy on the inside." — March 2026, 6 pieces for JPY 500.
"The soy sauce mayo with green onion topping was so delicious that I felt like I was enjoying a completely different dish rather than just takoyaki." — May 2026.

places.name: 珈琲艇CABIN (Coffee Tei Kyabin)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The food is toast and hot sandwiches, all on bread; coffee, tea and the flavored drinks are where to start.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cheese toasts, honey toasts and egg and bacon sandwiches; black coffee and straight tea are the plain options.
places.hours_raw: Mon, Wed, Thu, Sat, Sun and holidays 09:00–18:00; closed Tuesdays and Fridays, but open when they fall on a holiday (official site; Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); the official site links a booking page and space rental. Order by QR code (July–August 2026). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 35 seats: a counter of 5, six tables for four and a terrace of 6; a private room for 8 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog), paper cigarettes (August 2026). Takeaway (Tabelog). A queue at weekend lunchtime (September 2025; September 2026).
places.neighborhood: Minami-Horie 1-4-10 (Nishi-ku), on the Dotonbori River, down the stairs — 4 min from Osaka Namba Stn, 5 min from Namba Stn (Midosuji Line)
places.cuisine: Kissa toasts, hot sandwiches and a long drinks list (official site) · the top three sandwiches: the Popeye sandwich, two hot sandwiches on one plate, one of bacon and spinach with a sweet, spicy Japanese seasoning and one of mushroom and onion omelette in butter-soy (half size available); cheese toast with homemade tomato sauce and cheddar, gouda and mozzarella; a lasagna-style hot sandwich of meat sauce, béchamel, soft egg and four cheeses (official site; September 2026) · honey toasts with honeydew honey from New Zealand and Germany: goat cheese and cream cheese; blue cheese and cream cheese; seven cheeses with homemade white sauce and black pepper (official site); fruit sandwich (August 2026) · coffee from ¥500, full-city roast hot and Italian roast iced, beans from Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Indonesia and Vietnam; tea from ¥500, Nilgiri straight and Assam for chai; 25 flavored drinks from ¥600; honey drinks from ¥700 (official site) · cream soda, mixed juice and homemade ginger ale, "a taste unchanged for 40 years" (official site); almond latte, Wiener coffee (2026)
places.notes: [Kissa · Minami-Horie, a ship-shaped coffee shop on the Dotonbori River] A long-running kissa built like a ship on the bank of the Dotonbori River near Namba: go down the stairs into a dim, wood-and-red-velvet cabin with round portholes, ship models and a mirrored ceiling. The sandwiches are the thing, especially the Popeye, a plate of a spicy-sweet bacon and spinach sandwich and a butter-soy mushroom omelette one, or a thick cheese toast, with one of dozens of drinks; the cream soda, mixed juice and ginger ale have not changed in 40 years, the site says. Order by QR code; cash only and smoking allowed. Diners in 2026 love the setting; several found the staff aloof or unfriendly and the coffee ordinary. Closed Tuesdays and Fridays.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 珈琲艇CABIN, "Feeling on a boat"; its popular drinks keep "a taste unchanged for 40 years"; it also sells drip-coffee gifts and rents out the space. 2026 reviews describe a long-established, ship-themed coffee shop on the Dotonbori River, reached down a flight of stairs.

anecdotes.text: "A ship suddenly appears in Namba, making you wonder, 'What is this?' But once you descend the stairs, you find a long-established coffee shop" — July 2026, a second visit.
"By the way, the ceiling is mirrored, which made for some cute photo opportunities." — July 2026, cheese toast and coffee.
"From the seating arrangement to the checkout, [the staff member] was unfriendly, which left a negative impression." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (cafecabin.net): 珈琲艇CABIN、営業時間9:00〜18:00、定休日は火曜と金曜 (祝日は営業)、Feeling on a boat、人気サンドイッチ TOP3: ポパイサンド (甘味とスパイスの効いたベーコンとほうれん草のピリ辛和風テイストと、キノコとバター醤油オムレツのサンドイッチ、ハーフサイズあり)、チーズトースト (自家製トマトソースにチェダー・ゴーダ・モッツァレラなど)、ラザニア風クワトロサンド (自家製ミートソースとベシャメルソースに半熟卵と4種のチーズ)、甘露蜜トースト (ニュージーランドとドイツの甘露蜜3種、ゴートチーズとクリームチーズ、ブルーチーズとクリームチーズ、7種のチーズ)、コーヒー500円から (ホットはフルシティロースト、アイスはイタリアンロースト、ブラジル・コロンビア・ペルー・インドネシア・ベトナムの豆)、紅茶500円から (ストレートはニルギリ、ティーオーレやチャイはアッサム)、フレーバードリンク25種類600円から、ハニードリンク700円から、クリームソーダ・ミックスジュース・自家製ジンジャーエールは40年変わらないテイスト、季節で内容が変わり店内の QR コードのメニューで確認、ギフト、レンタル。食べログ: 予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、35席 (カウンター5、テーブル4名×6、テラス6)、個室8名、喫煙可、テイクアウト。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): 船のような内装、丸窓、鏡の天井、階段を下りる、QR で注文、アイスコーヒー500円、ポパイサンド、フルーツサンド、そっけない接客という声。

places.name: 本等鮨 海馬 本店 (Hontou Sushi Kaiba Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi is the place to start; soy sauce, tempura, simmered fish and grilled eel with sauce are not.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and seafood restaurant.
places.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); "open year-round", with occasional closures for menu changes (Tabelog). Tabelog says lunch is currently not served, though a May 2026 diner had a ¥1,200 seafood bowl at lunch. Reservations; courses by the day before; children by phone booking only; course cancellations on the day or the day before are charged 100%, seat-only bookings ¥10,000 a person (Tabelog). An appetizer charge, no service charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, Rakuten Edy and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 45 seats: a first-floor counter of 11 and two tables, 24 seats upstairs; the first floor is non-smoking, smoking allowed upstairs (Tabelog; May and August 2026). Wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; English menu with photos; English- and Chinese-speaking staff; children welcome, with smaller portions; takeaway (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Kita-Horie 1-15-22 (Nishi-ku) — 4 min from exit 4 of Yotsubashi Stn, 3 min from exit 4 of Nishi-Ohashi Stn
places.cuisine: Sushi, sashimi and Japanese dishes with sake and wine, using mainly natural, wild ingredients (Tabelog) · courses: Umi ¥8,800 (ten dishes, changing monthly), Kaiba ¥9,800 (eleven), Horse ¥12,800 (eleven, booked by the day before) (Tabelog); an omakase course of about ¥8,000 (May 2026) · sashimi platters; nigiri; toro tekka maki; tempura including conger eel; simmered fish; a cheek steak; lotus-root dumplings; grilled eel (May–July 2026) · half a hairy crab ¥5,800 (August 2026) · highballs ¥680 and ¥980, chuhai from ¥550, draft beer ¥680 (August 2026); Hibiki highball, champagne, sake and wine (2026; Tabelog)
places.notes: [Sushi · Kita-Horie, a modern sushi and sake house] A stylish two-floor sushi restaurant in Kita-Horie, a counter downstairs and tables up, serving natural, mostly wild fish as sashimi, nigiri and plenty of cooked dishes, from conger-eel tempura to grilled eel and hairy crab, with sake, wine and highballs. Courses run ¥8,800–¥12,800, and diners in 2026 spent anything from ¥8,000 to ¥30,000. Regulars praise the fish and the balance of rice and topping; one November 2026 regular heard the owner had changed, with the same chefs but only one at the counter, so service was slow. Smoking is allowed upstairs. Dinner daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "real sushi, so you can truly enjoy sake", made from carefully selected, mainly natural ingredients in a modern Japanese room; staff advise on sake and wine pairings. A November 2026 regular writes: "I heard that the owner has changed. However, the main staff and chefs seemed to be the same."
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic sushi with sure technique, to be enjoyed with sake (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "I heard that the owner has changed. However, the main staff and chefs seemed to be the same." — November 2026, a second visit, noting the turtle outside is gone.
"The sushi, in particular, had a perfect balance between the rice and toppings" — May 2026, an omakase course of about ¥8,000.
"Please note that smoking is allowed on the second floor, so if you're sensitive to tobacco, it might be best to consult with the staff." — May 2026.

places.name: 喫酒オルタナ (Kissa Alterna)
places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the shop says it does not take allergy requests, that everything is made in one kitchen with shared dishes and utensils, and that cross-contamination is possible (Tabelog). The signature cutlets, tempura and soba are wheat-based.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, beef, salmon, duck and shrimp dishes, soba in dashi, and no allergy or diet requests taken (Tabelog).
places.hours_raw: Tabelog lists 17:00–23:00, closed Wednesdays, while its shop text says open daily 17:00–23:00 (last food order 22:00, drinks 22:30, last entry 21:30) and closed on the last day of consecutive holidays; the official site gives 17:00–24:00 (last orders 23:00 and 23:30) and irregular closures. Reservations; the seat type may change on the day (Tabelog). A ¥550 appetizer charge (Tabelog; ¥500 in September 2026). Mobile ordering (September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 24 seats: 14 at a counter around the open kitchen and 10 at tables (Tabelog; 22 on the official site); smoking outside only; English-speaking staff; children by arrangement, no child cutlery (Tabelog). Opened 17 June 2023 (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Shinmachi 1-8-10, 横山ビル 1F (Nishi-ku), down a back street — 5 min from exit 1-B of Yotsubashi Stn
places.cuisine: Restaurant, bar and soba in one: creative izakaya plates finished with soba (official site; Tabelog) · the signature shimi-ton, a juicy rare pork cutlet over soft egg under plenty of sauce, a twist on Osaka tonpei-yaki, ¥2,000 (Tabelog; September 2026); a beef "bisha katsu"; rare salmon cutlet (August–October 2026) · Miracle Ebi Mayo, four large shrimp, ¥1,000; carpaccio ¥1,100; scallops ¥770 for two; fig and prosciutto with white miso; duck; the soba shop's potato salad with soft egg; grilled cheese "volcano"; red sausage (September–October 2026) · soba to finish: cold soba with natural-yam foam, sudachi soba, tantan soba (September–October 2026) · craft gin and original cocktails, sake, shochu and wine (Tabelog); Asahi Maruefu and Sapporo Lager on draft or by the bottle (September–October 2026) · a ¥1,650 celebration dessert plate by reservation (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shinmachi, creative plates and soba behind a hieroglyph sign] A dim, stylish back-street izakaya in Shinmachi, run by a soba company and marked by a hieroglyphic sign, with most seats at a counter around the open kitchen and hip-hop on the stereo. The draw is the shimi-ton, a juicy rare pork cutlet over soft egg drowned in sauce, along with Miracle Ebi Mayo, rare salmon cutlet and fig with prosciutto and white miso, all in small, pretty portions. Finish with soba, such as cold soba under natural-yam foam. Diners in 2026 were almost all delighted; one wished for more dishes. The shop takes no allergy requests. Evenings only.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a directly run shop of the Sobayoshi (そばよし) group, "restaurant × bar × soba", marked by "the world's only existing hieroglyphics" on its sign. Per Tabelog: opened 17 June 2023; the specialty is the shimi-ton, a twist on Osaka's tonpei-yaki.
chef_bio.specialty: Shimi-ton pork cutlet; soba to finish.

anecdotes.text: "One of my favorite aspects of this place is the opportunity to enjoy soba at the end of the meal." — September 2026, a second visit, cold soba with natural-yam foam.
"The crispy fried pork cutlet is generously coated with sauce and fluffy eggs, making it a perfect pairing with drinks." — September 2026, the shimi-ton.
"One downside was the limited food options, which was disappointing." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sobayoshi.com): 喫酒オルタナ、グループ直営店、世界で唯一現存する象形文字が目印、レストラン×酒場×蕎麦、17:00〜00:00 (料理 L.O.23:00、ドリンク L.O.23:30)、不定休、西区新町1-8-10 横山ビル1F、22席、分煙 (屋外に喫煙スペース)、四ツ橋駅・西大橋駅から徒歩5分。食べログ (店舗会員): 居酒屋・そば・創作料理、17:00〜23:00、水曜休み (店の紹介では毎日17:00〜23:00、連休最終日休み)、予約可、お通し550円、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、24席 (カウンター14、テーブル10)、英語を話すスタッフ、アレルギーには対応しない (同じ厨房・器具でコンタミの可能性)、2023年6月17日オープン、名物の Shimi-ton、クラフトジン、オリジナルカクテル。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): Shimi-ton 2,000円、Miracle Ebi Mayo 1,000円、カルパッチョ1,100円、レアサーモンカツ、いちじくと生ハムの白味噌、締めの蕎麦 (自然薯の泡の冷たい蕎麦、すだち蕎麦、担々蕎麦)、モバイルオーダー、料理の種類が少ないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff (Tabelog); mobile ordering (September 2026).

staff_allergy_handling: The shop does not accommodate allergy requests; all dishes are made in one kitchen with shared dishes and utensils, so cross-contamination is possible; ask by phone before visiting about changes to a meal (Tabelog).

places.name: 立喰酒場 金獅子 心斎橋パルコ店 (Tachigui Sakaba Kinjishi Shinsaibashi paruko ten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi, marinated mackerel and seared wagyu are where to start; the fried horse mackerel, demi-katsu, shumai, yakisoba, ramen and baguette are wheat-based.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu, pork, chicken and fish; a mitsuba namul (September 2026) is the only vegetable dish described.

A ¥500 set of a drink and three small snacks (September 2026). Reservations (Tabelog). places.cuisine: Standing-bar izakaya with a daily-changing menu of fish, meat and sake (Tabelog) · marinated mackerel ¥100; lightly seared wagyu with egg yolk; wagyu; negitoro; pork tongue; meat sushi; loquat with prosciutto (June–October 2026) · fig butter on baguette; beef-tendon fried rice; mitsuba namul (September 2026) · lunch sets from ¥880: Super Ebi Soba (salt yakisoba with sakura shrimp and mayonnaise) with grilled shumai; fried horse mackerel with shiba-zuke tartar; demi-katsu; pork steak; a chuka soba set with kara-age, rice and raw egg (August–October 2026) · the owner's choice of local sake; lemon sours (Tabelog; September 2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Shinsaibashi PARCO, a standing bar open from 11:00] A standing bar (with high stools) in the B2F food street of Shinsaibashi PARCO, the third shop of Kinjishi, with a daily-changing board of fish and meat and the owner's choice of local sake. It opens at 11:00, so lunch sets from ¥880 (salt yakisoba with shumai, fried horse mackerel with pickle tartar) turn into daytime drinking; try the ¥100 marinated mackerel, seared wagyu with egg yolk or a ¥500 drink-and-three-snacks set. Diners in 2026 praise the value and some dishes; others found it cramped, the portions small, the ramen too salty or some staff off-putting. Open daily to 23:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: the third Kinjishi, with an upgraded menu alongside the signature dishes, a daily-changing menu and the owner's selection of local sake; open from 11:00 for daytime drinking; opened 18 March 2021. A June 2026 diner compares it with the Sakaisuji Honmachi shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Daily fish and wagyu small plates with sake.

anecdotes.text: "Then I found the 500 yen set! You get your choice of drink and three types of snacks!" — September 2026, before a movie.
"The marinated mackerel was an incredible bargain at just 100 yen." — October 2026.
"However, the ramen itself is disappointing... It has a strong salty flavor, which overshadows the taste of the dashi." — October 2026, the chuka soba set.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: battered, deep-fried kushikatsu, plus crispy fried gyoza and tonpei-yaki.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kushikatsu of beef, pork, chicken, shrimp and fish alongside the vegetable skewers, with doteyaki and gyoza; nothing is described as vegan.

places.cuisine: Kushikatsu and teppan izakaya: skewers with a batter and frying oil developed in-house; signature gyukatsu of misuji beef, curry-flavoured "tulip" chicken, tonpei-yaki, homemade crispy fried gyoza, over 50 drinks (Tabelog shop text) · courses of 15 dishes: ¥3,500, or ¥5,000 with 100 minutes of drinks; à la carte all-you-can-drink 100 minutes ¥1,680 (Tabelog) · lunch: set of 9 kushikatsu (beef, pork, chicken, shrimp, kisu, octopus, onion, asparagus, quail egg) plus a small dish such as addictive cucumber or beef-tendon stew (October 2026); dashimaki set meal ¥720 before tax with two small dishes (October 2026); lunches under ¥1,000 (August 2026) · à la carte: shiitake, eggplant, lotus root, whiting, negima skewers (August 2026), stuffed shishamo (September 2026), doteyaki (August 2026), spicy cucumber with the seeds removed (September 2026), fried rice (August 2026) · free cabbage (October 2026)
places.notes: [Kushikatsu · Sennichimae, a big, lively skewer house behind NGK] A 140-seat kushikatsu and teppan izakaya just behind the Yoshimoto theatre, open from 11:30 to midnight every day, with a counter and plenty of enclosed private rooms. Order a mix of skewers with the misuji gyukatsu, the tonpei-yaki and the crispy gyoza; at lunch there are sets of nine skewers or a ¥720 dashimaki set. Reviewers praise the light batter; order in small batches so the skewers stay hot. Card payment is listed, but one 2026 lunch visitor was told cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 6 April 2015; kushikatsu with batter and frying oil developed through the shop's own research.
chef_bio.specialty: Misuji gyukatsu; tonpei-yaki; crispy fried gyoza.

anecdotes.text: "I visited during holiday lunchtime after going to the Yoshimoto Theater. The restaurant has plenty of seating, so I was able to get in right away." — September 2026.
"All the freshly fried Kushi Katsu arrived at once. If you want to enjoy them hot, it might be better to order in smaller batches." — September 2026.
"Just a heads up, ... only accept cash for payment." — August 2026, lunch after 15:00 (Tabelog lists cards).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 串かつ ひょうたん 本店、串揚げ・鉄板焼き・居酒屋、大阪市中央区難波千日前11-25 はつせビル 1F、NGK の裏、Namba Walk の B21出口・Nannan Town の E5出口から徒歩3分、毎日11:30〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、年中無休、定食は昼のみ (11:30〜16:00)、予約可、チャージ300円、カード・電子マネー可、QR 決済不可、140席、個室 (2〜30名)、加熱式たばこのみの喫煙所、2015年4月6日オープン。衣と揚げ油にこだわった串かつ、みすじの牛肉のカツ、カレー風味のチューリップ、とんぺい焼き、手作りのパリパリ焼き餃子、50種以上のドリンク、15品のコース3,500円、飲み放題つき5,000円。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 串かつ9本のランチ、だし巻き定食720円 (税抜)、1,000円以下のランチ、どて焼き、ししゃも、種を取ったきゅうり、無料のキャベツ、衣が軽い、まとめて出てくるので少しずつ注文を、現金のみと言われたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Large, lively and easy to walk into; private rooms. A gurunavi-sourced listing mentions English (search result, 2026-11-02), not confirmed on Tabelog.

places.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: monjayaki and okonomiyaki are wheat-flour batters, and yakisoba is wheat noodles.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the monjayaki base is a Western-style stock of chicken bones, onion, celery and red wine (Tabelog shop text), and okonomiyaki comes with bonito flakes (May 2026).
places.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00 (last food order 14:00) and 17:00–22:30 (last food order 21:30); closed irregularly once or twice a month, see Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations: Tabelog says not accepted, while reviewers booked in May and July 2026 — ask. Menu in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean; English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Seats by the entrance get hot in summer (July 2026). Okonomiyaki takes about 30 minutes (August 2026).
places.neighborhood: Namba-naka 2-10-25, Namba CITY "Namba Komejirushi" food street — 3 min from Nankai Namba Stn, 8 min from subway Namba Stn
places.cuisine: Osaka-style monjayaki on a Western-style stock of chicken bones, onion, celery and red wine; also ochazuke (Tabelog shop text) · 29 kinds of monjayaki and okonomiyaki (search result) · monjayaki cooked at the table by staff: Momoju monjayaki, mentaiko potato mayo cheese (April 2026), mentaiko special ¥1,980 with double mentaiko, mochi, cheese, potato, tomato and kimchi (June 2026), curry, negi-suji curry (May–July 2026), potato mayo corn (August 2026), mochi cheese mentaiko (October 2026); about ¥1,780 for one serving (August 2026) · okonomiyaki and yakisoba come cooked from the kitchen: fluffy okonomiyaki, beef-tendon okonomiyaki, pork okonomiyaki (2026); pork yakisoba ¥1,100 (May 2026), seafood yakisoba ¥1,440 (June 2026), kimchi omu-soba, yakisoba with domestic pork and fried egg (July–October 2026) · beef-tendon stew, potato salad, spicy cucumber, horumon stir-fry, cheese tonpei, tonpeiyaki, shrimp mayo, yam with yuzu, celery with lemon, fried rice (2026) · à la carte only at lunch, no set meals (May 2026)
places.notes: [Monjayaki · Namba CITY, Osaka-style monja cooked for you] A monjayaki and okonomiyaki shop in the Namba Komejirushi food street under Nankai Namba, branch of a long-running Osaka monja house whose batter uses a Western-style chicken and vegetable stock. Staff cook the monja at your table — try the mentaiko special (¥1,980) and finish with the crispy edges; okonomiyaki and yakisoba arrive cooked. English menu and English-speaking staff. Expect queues at weekend lunch; okonomiyaki takes about 30 minutes.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: a long-established Osaka-style monjayaki restaurant loved by Kansai locals. An August 2026 reviewer says the main shop is in Nagai; aumo (search result) mentions a Grand Front Osaka shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Osaka-style monjayaki with a Western-style stock.

anecdotes.text: "This time, I found myself nearby at an early hour, so I checked for reservations and was able to secure one perfectly!" — May 2026, after eyeing it for 3–4 years past long lines.
"I had forgotten how to eat it, so the staff kindly showed me." — July 2026, a second try at monjayaki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 百十 なんばこめじるし店、もんじゃ焼き・お好み焼き・鉄板焼き、大阪市浪速区難波中2-10-25 なんばCITY なんばこめじるし、南海なんば駅から徒歩3分、毎日11:30〜15:00 (料理 L.O. 14:00)、17:00〜22:30 (料理 L.O. 21:30)、不定休 (月1〜2回、Instagram で案内)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、40席 (カウンター4、テーブル36)、禁煙、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、英語を話すスタッフ。鶏ガラ、玉ねぎ、セロリ、赤ワインの洋風だしの大阪らしいもんじゃ、お茶漬けも。口コミ(2026年4月〜10月): もんじゃは店の人が焼いてくれる、明太スペシャル1,980円、カレー、ねぎすじカレー、ふわふわのお好み焼き、すじのお好み焼き、豚焼きそば1,100円、海鮮焼きそば1,440円、とんぺい、山芋の柚子、昼は単品のみ、本店は Nagai、予約して行ったという声、お好み焼きは30分ほどかかる。

places.name: 肉バルGAM 難波本店 (Niku Bar GAM Namba Honten)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Steaks and meat sashimi come with sauces, ajillo with baguette, and courses include onion fries and wagyu tendon stew.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a red-meat bar; the free salad that comes with a steak order is the main vegetable dish.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–25:00 (last order 24:00); Sun and the last day of long holidays 17:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed irregularly (Tabelog). A May 2026 reviewer had sukiyaki here at lunch. Reservations accepted online until 22:00 on the day, three groups a day; pairs may be seated at the counter (Tabelog). Appetiser ¥440 (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink of 200 drinks: ¥1,000 for two hours (January 2026), ¥1,500 (May 2026); the minimum food order has changed over time — three dishes per person (March 2026), one steak per person (June 2026), two dishes per person (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 60 seats over the 2nd and 3rd floors; the 3rd floor can be booked privately (up to 30); smoking allowed (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Namba 4-6-3, 南進ビル 2F, behind the former Kabukiza — 5 min from Namba Stn exit 12
places.cuisine: Meat bar of red meat and rare cuts, oyster-and-meat dishes and meat sushi; order a steak and the salad is free (Tabelog shop text) · courses with two hours of 200 drinks: seasonal value course of 6 dishes (soup, salad, cold meat starter, wagyu tendon stew, onion fries, teppan steak); banquet course of 9 dishes with oysters, meat sushi and steak ¥6,500 (Tabelog) · thigh steak sushi (March–April 2026) · top-blade sashimi (March 2026) · rib-roast steak, "Niku-ra" (meat and ikura), horse sashimi, mushroom and oil-sardine sauté (April 2026) · vichyssoise, roast beef and avocado salsa, chicken ham, prosciutto (May 2026) · steak, top blade, yukhoe, shrimp ajillo, chicken salad (August 2026) · tataki with momiji-oroshi and jelly sauce (September 2026) · curry or gelato to finish a course (February 2026) · lunch sukiyaki, regular 150 g black wagyu with rice refills and egg, ¥5,720 with black oolong tea (May 2026)
places.notes: [Meat bar · Namba, steaks with free salad and cheap drinks] A late-opening meat bar on two floors behind the old Namba Kabukiza, serving red-meat steaks, meat sashimi and meat sushi, with a free salad when you order a steak. The draw is the 200-drink all-you-can-drink, ¥1,000–1,500 for two hours in 2026, but it now comes with a minimum food order. Portions are small, so order several plates. Smoking is allowed; many foreign guests (October 2026). Book: online slots are limited.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 1 September 2015, floors renewed October 2021. A second shop, お初天神店 in Umeda, opened in September 2018 (ikyu, search result).

anecdotes.text: "For the all-you-can-drink option, you now have to order one steak per person, and the prices have really gone up" — June 2026, a regular.
"I was surprised by the small size of the meat dishes. They were truly just bite-sized!" — April 2026.
"It was almost fully booked, with many foreign guests as well." — October 2026.

places.notes: [Chinese · Crysta Nagahori, set meals and three dandan noodles] A long-running Chinese restaurant in the Crysta Nagahori underground mall, with set meals mostly under ¥1,000 served all afternoon. Order a dandan noodle — white (sesame and miso), black or red (numbing and spicy) — or the kara-age set with its egg-and-sauce dish to pour over the rice. In the evening a beer, gyoza and kara-age set is ¥1,290. Busy at noon; quieter after 12:30.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): in the Crysta Nagahori gourmet zone; 44 seats. An August 2026 reviewer heard it has been a long-standing Chinese restaurant for decades. Another shop, パナンテ天満橋店, appears on autoreserve; one October 2026 review on this listing describes a visit to a shop at Keihan Tenmabashi.
chef_bio.specialty: Three dandan noodles (white, black, red); set meals.

anecdotes.text: "You can choose from three types of gyoza and five or six types of kara-age. The draft beer is a proper size" — August 2026, the ¥1,290 quick drink set.
"Even though it was past 4 PM, ... set meals available!" — October 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Pasta, baguette and quiche are central; smoked dishes may be safer but nothing is stated.
places.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Smoked nuts are the starter; most dishes use meat, seafood, cheese or egg.

Charge ¥500 with house-smoked nuts, none with a course (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 37 seats: 11 at the counter, 16 on sofas, 10 at tables; karaoke and darts at the back, with a darts tournament on Thursdays (Tabelog; September 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 5 June 2012 (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Dining bar of Italian and seasonal creative dishes, house-smoked foods and inventive pasta, with over 100 drinks including sommelier-chosen wine and seasonal fruit cocktails (Tabelog) · champagne hot pot of abalone, oysters, clams and fish cooked in a whole bottle, finished as an oyster cream stew, November to May; course ¥6,300 (Tabelog; February 2025, April 2024) · five-kind smoked meat platter, prosciutto with figs, red carbonara, spaghetti aglio e olio with egg, a pasta topped with a hamburg steak, ajillo, shime-saba, quiche (2024–2026 reviews) · 7-dish course with all-you-can-drink ¥4,950 (Tabelog); a course with all-you-can-drink was ¥4,500 in December 2024
places.notes: [Dining bar · Soemoncho, smoked plates and pasta until 2 a.m.] A calm, wood-toned dining bar on the third floor of a building a short walk from the Glico sign, open until 2 a.m. (3 a.m. at weekends) and good for a late first or second stop. The kitchen is better than the bar setting suggests: house-smoked nuts with the ¥500 charge, a five-kind smoked meat platter, prosciutto with figs and inventive pasta, from a garlicky aglio e olio with egg to one crowned with a hamburg steak. From November to May the draw is a champagne hot pot of abalone, oysters and clams cooked in a whole bottle (course ¥6,300). Karaoke and darts at the back, darts nights on Thursdays. Smoking allowed. Closed Sundays.

roles: Kitchen and bar staff (unnamed); a sommelier chooses the wine (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: dining bar with authentic Italian and seasonal creative dishes, homemade smoked foods and pasta, over 100 drinks including sommelier-selected wine and seasonal fruit cocktails, a signature champagne hot pot; open from 18:00 until late; opened 5 June 2012.
chef_bio.specialty: Champagne hot pot; smoked dishes; pasta.

anecdotes.text: "This dish is available only from November to May, so be sure to check it out before the season ends." — February 2025, the champagne hot pot.
"The homemade smoked nuts served as an appetizer were so delicious that I wanted to order more." — February 2026.
"There's a darts and karaoke area in the back" — September 2026; the reviewer adds that a darts tournament is held every Thursday.

No reservations per Tabelog, though diners in 2025–2026 booked (June 2025; April 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX) and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Full by about 19:00 on a Friday in April 2026; the entrance is set back on the ground floor, look for the sidewalk sign (June 2025).

places.cuisine: Okonomiyaki and yakisoba from the Tsuruhashi okonomiyaki house Omoni; this branch is a little pricier than the main shop (2024–2025 reviews) · the signature Omoni-yaki, packed with egg inside and out, fluffy and cabbage-heavy, about 30 toppings including kimchi (October 2025–June 2026) · ABCDE-yaki of pork, shrimp, mochi, egg and cheese ¥1,650 (October 2024) · thick-noodle yakisoba in sauce or squid and salt, small or large; tonpei-yaki; grilled squid; a foil-steamed dish (2024–2026 reviews)
places.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Soemoncho, the Tsuruhashi favourite near Glico] The Soemoncho branch of Omoni, the Tsuruhashi okonomiyaki house, on the ground floor near the Glico sign, its walls covered with celebrity autographs and open until 2 a.m. late in the week. Order the signature Omoni-yaki, fluffy, cabbage-heavy and wrapped in egg, or build your own from about 30 toppings including kimchi. Regulars rate the yakisoba just as highly, especially the squid-and-salt version. Prices are a little above the main shop, and one long-time regular noted the taste varies with the griller. Fully booked by 7 p.m. on an April 2026 Friday; smoking allowed; cards limited to JCB and AMEX.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog: okonomiyaki and yakisoba in Soemoncho. Reviews: Okonomi Omoni has shops in Tsuruhashi (the main shop), Souemoncho and Grand Front (October 2024); a long-established okonomiyaki house Osaka is proud of (June 2026); celebrity autographs and photos on the walls (2024–2026).

anecdotes.text: "Okonomi Omoni has locations in Tsuruhashi, Souemoncho, and Grand Front." — October 2024, a regular of 28 visits.
"The Omoni-style okonomiyaki here is delicious. It's packed with eggs both inside and out, making it very filling." — January 2026.
"I especially recommend the squid salt yakisoba." — June 2026.

places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi comes with soy sauce; yakitori, tempura, kushikatsu and gratin are on the menu.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken and fish izakaya.
places.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–24:00 (food last order 23:00, drinks 23:30); earlier openings by reservation (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Charge ¥1,000 covering service and a three-kind appetizer, plus 10% from 31 December to 4 January (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 36 seats: counter, tables, semi-private rooms and sunken seating for up to 12 (Tabelog; April 2026). Smoking allowed at all seats (Tabelog; July 2026). Chicken sashimi may be off when the market is closed (December 2024).
places.neighborhood: Shinsaibashi-suji 2-3-12, 喜八ビル 4F, by the Soemoncho gate — 3 min from Namba Stn, 5 min from Shinsaibashi Stn
places.cuisine: Izakaya of chicken and fish: sashimi of morning-slaughtered chicken, binchotan yakitori and creative chicken dishes, with fish bought daily at the market (Tabelog) · chicken sashimi platter, fresh liver sashimi, raw tsukune wrapped in nori, the "bakudan" tsukune, a grilled-chicken platter in a bento box, yakitori rice bowl (2024–2026 reviews) · thick-cut fish sashimi, grilled fish, grilled milt, giant clam, crab-miso gratin, tempura, kushikatsu, takoyaki, potato salad; homemade tofu as the starter; hot pot in winter (2024–2026 reviews) · 7-dish course with 90 minutes of drinks ¥5,000, Sunday to Thursday (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Soemoncho, chicken sashimi and fish by the gate] A fourth-floor chicken-and-fish izakaya by the Soemoncho gate, open 15 years, with semi-private rooms and a counter. The menu changes daily: sashimi of chicken slaughtered that morning (liver, a mixed platter, raw tsukune to wrap in nori), binchotan yakitori and the house "bakudan" tsukune, beside thick-cut fish from the market, grilled milt and crab-miso gratin. The ¥1,000 charge covers service and a three-dish starter. On weekdays a 7-dish course with 90 minutes of drinks is ¥5,000. Staff are friendly; every seat is smoking. Chicken sashimi depends on market days.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: fifteen years in business; sashimi of carefully selected morning-slaughtered chicken, yakitori over binchotan and creative chicken dishes, fish sourced directly from the market, a wide sake list; sunken seating for up to 12, banquets up to 35–36. Sister shops: 個室和食 鳥魚 御堂筋店 (27092728) and 隠 鳥魚 (osaka_kakure_toriuo_higashishinsaibashi).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken sashimi; bakudan tsukune; market fish.

anecdotes.text: "Eating the raw tsukune wrapped in seaweed is pure bliss!" — December 2024, a regular of about ten visits.
"The signature 'Bakudan Tsukune' (explosive chicken meatballs) is incredibly delicious every time I have it." — January 2026.
"Located near the gate in Souemoncho, this restaurant has all smoking seats." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 鳥魚 宗右衛門町店、居酒屋・海鮮・焼き鳥、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-12 喜八ビル 4F、なんば駅から徒歩3分、心斎橋駅から5分、毎日18:00〜24:00 (料理L.O.23:00、ドリンクL.O.23:30)、予約で早い時間も可、予約可、1,000円 (サービス料とお通し3種盛り)、年末年始は別途10%、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、36席、半個室、掘りごたつ (12名まで)、喫煙可、平日のコース7品と90分飲み放題5,000円。店の紹介 (英訳): 創業15年、朝引きの鶏の刺身、備長炭の焼き鳥、創作の鶏料理、市場から仕入れる日替わりの刺身、日本酒。口コミ(2024年1月〜2026年7月): 鶏刺しの盛り合わせ、レバ刺し、のりで巻く生つくね、Bakudan つくね、焼き鳥の弁当箱盛り、焼き鳥丼、厚切りの刺身、焼き魚、焼き白子、大あさり、かにみそグラタン、天ぷら、串カツ、たこ焼き、ポテトサラダ、自家製の豆腐のお通し、冬は鍋、市場の休みの日は鶏刺しがないことも、全席喫煙、スタッフが気さく。

places.name: 燻製バル モトカラ (Kunsei Bar Motokara)
places.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Smoked meats and grilled meat come with salt and yuzu pepper; there are also pizza, ramen and a pork and cabbage omelette.
places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a smoked-meat bar; even the smoked egg and cheese plates are animal products.
places.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 16:00–23:00; Sat 12:00–15:00 and 15:30–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); Sun 12:00–18:00 (last orders 17:00 and 17:30); irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; group courses from 12 people (Tabelog). Charge ¥300 except with a course (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 48 seats: 40 at tables and 8 on the terrace; smoking on the terrace only (Tabelog). Entrance on the Dotonbori river side (Tabelog).
places.neighborhood: Soemoncho 7-11 B1F, entrance on the Dotonbori riverside — a short walk from the Glico sign
places.cuisine: Smoked-food bar: dishes, seasonings and drinks given a smoky touch, in a wood-toned room with a terrace (Tabelog) · 12-kind smoked platter ¥850 a serving under a lid that releases the smoke at the table; regular meat platter ¥2,800 (February 2025); whole smoked squid ¥950; pork and cabbage omelette ¥1,150 (February 2025) · smoked duck, sausages, smoked egg, potato salad, a chijimi-style pizza, grilled vegetables with salt and yuzu pepper (2025–2026 reviews) · smoky orange spritzer ¥800, smoked umeshu (2025) · weekday steak lunch of domestic beef, single or double (May 2026); Cremia soft-serve (April 2026); daytime course ¥2,000 with dessert (Tabelog)
places.notes: [Smoked food · Soemoncho, a smoky bar on the Dotonbori river] A basement bar with a small riverside terrace on Dotonbori, a few minutes from the Glico sign, where nearly everything is smoked. Start with the 12-kind smoked platter (¥850 a serving in February 2025); the lid comes off at the table in a cloud of smoke. Add smoked duck, sausages and smoked egg, and try a smoky orange spritzer or smoked umeshu. Daytime it serves domestic-beef steak lunches and generous Cremia soft-serve. One February 2025 diner found the meat overcooked, and a 2025 regular felt the menu now leans toward tourists. Smoking on the terrace only.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a bar specialising in aromatic smoked dishes, seasonings and drinks, with creative items, lunch and café menus, a wood-tone room, private bookings and a well-ventilated terrace. Sister format グリル モトカラ (堺筋本町, 西中島, 長堀橋) is in shops.jsonl.

anecdotes.text: "One of the highlights was the performance of opening a lid that traps smoke right in front of you." — September 2025.
"The smoked umeshu (plum wine) was a unique experience, as I could taste the plum first, followed by the smokiness." — June 2025.
"The meat was tough... It seemed overcooked..." — February 2025, on the 12-kind smoked platter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 燻製バル モトカラ、バル・居酒屋・イタリアン、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町7-11 B1F、大阪難波駅から徒歩10分、入口は道頓堀川側、月〜金16:00〜23:00、土12:00〜15:00・15:30〜23:00、日12:00〜18:00、不定休、予約可、コース以外はチャージ300円、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、48席 (テーブル40、テラス8)、テラスのみ喫煙可。店の紹介 (英訳): 香りのよい燻製の料理、調味料、飲み物、創作のメニュー、ランチとカフェ、木の内装、テラス、昼のコース2,000円。口コミ(2025年2月〜2026年5月): 燻製12種盛り850円 (ふたを開けると煙)、肉の盛り合わせ2,800円、いかの丸ごと燻製950円、豚とキャベツのオムレツ1,150円、燻製の鴨、ソーセージ、燻製卵、ポテトサラダ、チヂミ風のピザ、焼き野菜と塩と柚子こしょう、スモーキーなオレンジのスプリッツァー800円、燻製の梅酒、国産牛のステーキのランチ、Cremia のソフトクリーム、肉が固かったという声、海外の客向けになったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas customers (2025–2026). No English menu evidence found.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fugu and eel restaurant; the hitsumabushi comes with a fugu bone soup and dashi.

places.cuisine: Fugu restaurant whose signature is "yaki fugu": Nagasaki fugu fillets seasoned and grilled lightly, one by one, like yakiniku, with three dips and shredded green onion; also tiger-fugu sukiyaki, conger eel and eel (Tabelog; May 2026) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): yaki fugu course of six dishes (tessa, grilled fugu, fugu kara-age, zosui) ¥11,200; Yufuku course with grilled fugu and fugu sukiyaki finished with pasta ¥13,800; with grilled fugu and tecchiri ¥13,800; a lunch grilled-fugu course with yubiki, sashimi, kara-age and a mini grilled-fugu bowl (May 2026); a Matsuba crab course in season; hire-zake · lunch: grilled-fugu hitsumabushi ¥1,500 (October 2026), fugu tempura hitsumabushi, both with three small dishes, pickles and fugu bone soup; eel hitsumabushi ¥1,800 and unaju (May–July 2026) · summer eel course: eel sashimi with ponzu, uzaku, grilled eel, tempura, kara-age, clay-pot eel rice (July 2026)
places.notes: [Fugu · Dojima, grilled fugu from a one-man counter] An eleven-seat fugu restaurant on the ground floor of a Kitashinchi building, run by one chef, known from television for 'yaki fugu': Nagasaki fugu fillets seasoned and grilled piece by piece like yakiniku, smoky and sweet. At lunch the ¥1,500 grilled-fugu hitsumabushi (or fugu tempura) comes with three small dishes and a fugu bone soup, and sells out; eat half as it is, then pour on the dashi. Dinner courses run ¥11,200–13,800, with tessa, kara-age and either tecchiri or a fugu sukiyaki finished with pasta; summer adds eel, even eel sashimi. Lunch is cash only and dishes take time, as the chef works alone.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: specialty "Yaki Fugu", lightly grilled; tiger-fugu sukiyaki with an original dipping sauce; conger eel and eel dishes; opened 6 July 2015. The Tabelog invoice number T5120001117479 is registered to 株式会社イデアプラス (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02). Two May 2026 diners write that the chef runs it alone.

anecdotes.text: "The style of enjoying it involves grilling seasoned fugu fillets one by one, similar to yakiniku, allowing you to savor the different flavors and textures of each part." — May 2026, the luxury lunch grilled-fugu course.
"It features a rare delicacy: eel sashimi, which you eat with ponzu sauce and condiments." — July 2026, the summer eel course.
"I ate half and turned the rest into hitsumabushi, which was also exquisite!" — October 2026, a visitor on a trip, the ¥1,500 lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: soba of house-milled buckwheat, firm and chewy; side dishes and about ten sakes at night; a warm wooden room; Tabelog Soba 100 in 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2025.

anecdotes.text: "I had never tried soba with salt before, but when I dipped a bit in, the rich aroma and sweetness of the soba really stood out" — September 2026, the last serving of inaka soba.

places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Kitashinchi, steak by the gram] A black-themed teppanyaki room in a Kitashinchi basement, open since 2021, with a counter and a VIP private room. Order wagyu by weight, or take the nine-dish ¥13,800 course: meat sushi topped with Hokkaido sea urchin, a mini burger, lobster and fillet steak, then garlic rice or the black curry (¥999 extra). The ¥6,600 trial course and the lunch steak from ¥2,980 are the cheaper ways in. Diners praise the flambé and the manager's service; one found the private-room fee a surprise (March 2026). 10% service; e-cigarettes allowed at every seat.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: teppanyaki in the basement of エスパス北新地8, steak by weight, counter and private rooms; opened 20 October 2021. The Tabelog invoice number T9120001240145 is registered to 株式会社リブレ (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02).

places.notes: [Yakitori · Dojima, a Kozaka-chicken omakase] A nine-seat yakitori counter on a second floor in Dojima, open since 2024, that grills only Kozaka chicken from Kyotanba, aged for days, over charcoal. The ¥13,800 omakase moves from a thigh tataki and side dishes such as shumai through neck, heart and liver to a finish of ramen, chicken soba or clay-pot rice; there is no chicken sashimi, by design. A September 2026 diner calls it the high-end shop of the Goichi yakitori group. Reservation only; diners praise the friendly head chef, though one in October 2026 wanted more surprise for the price.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: an omakase of rare Kozaka chicken from Kyotanba with seasonal ingredients, slowly charcoal-grilled, nine counter seats; opened 13 March 2024. A September 2026 diner calls it "a high-end version of the Goichi Group"; another met the same griller and owner earlier at "Ryoubou"; a July 2026 diner writes that the grillers came from the former "Bird Oka" in Nakameguro.

anecdotes.text: "The ramen and mapo tofu served as a finale were of such high quality that they could stand alone as a restaurant offering." — August 2026.

places.cuisine: Sushi of seasonal fish from across Japan on red-vinegar rice, as courses with all-you-can-drink; over 10 sakes and champagne; fugu shabu-shabu is popular (Tabelog) · courses (Tabelog, tax included): Akatsuki course of 24 items with beer, highball and sour ¥11,000; the same with 10 sakes ¥12,000; Akatsuki Premium of 27 items with fugu shabu-shabu, 12 pieces of sushi and sake ¥16,500 · each course: a sashimi platter, ten seasonal appetizers, nine pieces of sushi, chawanmushi, grilled skewers, red-miso soup and dessert (Tabelog) · several 2026 diners paid ¥11,000 with sake included (Kido, Nabeshima) · a February 2026 course: Kyoto buri tataki, a turnip and salmon broth, a toro-takuan roll, aji, hirame, saba, salmon, toro
places.notes: [Sushi · Kitashinchi, a sake-flowing counter run by women] An eleven-seat basement sushi counter in Kitashinchi, opened in July 2025, where a woman owner-chef and an all-women team serve a fixed course with all-you-can-drink for about ¥11,000, a rare price for the area. Ten seasonal appetizers and a sashimi plate come first, then nine pieces of red-vinegar sushi, chawanmushi, skewers and red-miso soup; the ¥16,500 premium adds fugu shabu-shabu. The sake list for the drinks plan runs to Kido and Nabeshima. Diners love the value, the warmth and the birthday songs; one regular found the menu unchanged after six months and the nigiri less careful, and others note bold seasoning. Smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): opened July 1, 2025; sushi of fresh seafood and seasonal flavours; a counter course with all-you-can-drink for ¥11,000, rare in Kitashinchi; complimentary fugu shabu-shabu and a monthly-changing menu; rice chosen to suit sushi, seasoned with red vinegar; over 10 sakes and champagne; an L-shaped counter. Diners: "A sushi restaurant run by a female chef" (March 2026); "The chef was a woman, and all the staff were also women" (May 2026); the owner remembered a couple from a year earlier (September 2026).

anecdotes.text: "Despite being located in Kitashinchi, I was amazed to find a course with all-you-can-drink for just JPY 11,000!" — February 2026.

"Entering a sushi restaurant can be intimidating, especially when the chef has a serious demeanor, but this place was filled with friendly women, creating a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere." — May 2026.
"The quality of the nigiri has definitely declined. It feels less delicate than before." — October 2026, a return visit.

cultural_comfort.note: Fixed courses; a friendly, chatty counter (2026). No English evidence found.

staff_allergy_handling: Asks guests to state food allergies and dislikes when booking (Tabelog).

places.cuisine: Kaiseki in the tea-ceremony tradition of Kitcho, with seasonal ingredients from across Japan, fine tableware and private rooms (Tabelog; official site) · dinner courses (Tabelog, tax included): kaiseki Nishiki ¥22,000; special Takumi ¥33,000; kaiseki Homare ¥44,000 · dishes in reviews: Matsuba crab, clams steamed in tea custard, sashimi of buri, Oma toro, flounder and Hokkaido uni, kue hot pot, tempura of shrimp and fugu milt (January 2024); hamo, matsutake and wagyu (September 2024); chawanmushi and tai chazuke (2023–2024); nama-fu (December 2024); Akashi sea bream sashimi, red rice with chestnuts, grilled gurnard for a birthday (October 2025); sea bream with sesame sauce under Tanabata decorations (July 2026) · a wagyu sukiyaki lunch (December 2024) · sake from around Japan, wine, shochu (official site) · house mentaiko and dashi to take home (official site)
places.notes: [Kaiseki · Kitashinchi, Kitcho's legacy by the founder's grandson] A kaiseki restaurant by Kitashinchi Station, opened in 2011 by the grandson of Yuki Sadaichi, founder of the famous Japanese restaurant Kitcho, and carried on in that tea-ceremony style: seasonal dishes from across Japan on fine tableware, with private rooms for business dinners and celebrations. Dinner courses run ¥22,000–44,000 (lunch by reservation only); diners recall Matsuba crab, Oma tuna, kue hot pot, hamo with matsutake, and a sea-bream chazuke to finish. One diner who had dreamed of Senba Kitcho called it a legacy carried on; another found the staff slow to come by in a private room. The group also runs a New shop with more private rooms.

roles: Owner (surname 湯木 on the official site), grandson of Kitcho founder Yuki Sadaichi
chef_bio.origin: Grandson of 湯木貞一 (Yuki Sadaichi), founder of 吉兆 (Kitcho) (official site; Tabelog).
chef_bio.background: Official site and Tabelog: the owner's grandfather Yuki Sadaichi founded the famous Japanese restaurant Kitcho; the owner opened the Honten in Kitashinchi to carry on the grandfather's kaiseki in the tea-ceremony line, with tableware, a refined space and hospitality, learning from the grandfather to keep tradition while trying new things. The company runs four shops: Honten, New shop, 肥後橋ゆきや。 and Shinsaibashi (official site). The official FAQ says the owner moves between the shops and greets guests where possible.
chef_bio.philosophy: Ichigo ichie; expressing the season is the heart of Japanese cuisine (official site; Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "although the name Senba Kitcho has disappeared, the legacy has been beautifully carried on" — February 2026.
"The appetizers were served with a piece of paper featuring a poem from the Hyakunin Isshu, creating a refined atmosphere." — June 2025.
"One guest had some difficulty walking, so being able to access the room without using stairs and having a nearby restroom was incredibly helpful." — September 2024.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 祖父の湯木貞一は老舗日本料理店「吉兆」の創業者。茶懐石の流れを汲んだ本格懐石、器、空間、おもてなしを大切にした祖父の想いを継ぐため、北新地に本店を開業。伝統を守りながら新しいことに挑戦する姿勢を祖父から学んだ。本店はカウンター6席と個室3部屋、昼11:30〜14:30 (L.O.13:30)、夜17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、日曜・祝日休み。苦手な食べ物やアレルギーは予約時か当日に言えば除ける。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site has English, Korean and Chinese pages; no evidence of English service in the reviews read.

staff_allergy_handling: Official FAQ: foods you dislike or are allergic to can be removed if you say so at booking or on the day.

places.notes: [Oden · Umeda, Higashi-dori, duck-broth oden from 3 pm] A twenty-seat oden izakaya on the Higashi-dori side of Doyama, opened in 2024 by 中道大夢, once of the Osaka comedy trio Chumma, with a younger brother helping out. The draw is oden simmered in duck and seafood broth, finished with a duck zosui made from it; around it come a raw sirloin-cap chinjao rosu under egg yolk, a spiral-battered shrimp mayo, a dashimaki in a milky broth, and a medium-rare duck cutlet, with sakes like Dassai and Kido. Opening at 3 pm, it runs all-you-can-eat-and-drink deals from ¥3,500 in the early hours. Retro-chic and friendly; smoking at every seat; ¥385 seat charge.

chef_bio.chef_name: 中道大夢 (stage name カラムーちゃんかなーち思て)
roles: Younger brother 中道大成 (なりちゃん) helps (Wikipedia)
chef_bio.background: Japanese Wikipedia (via Weblio, version of 2026-10-29; the article is tagged as lacking sources): a former member of the comedy trio ちゅんま, formed in 2017 with younger brother なりちゃん (中道大成) and しゃっくー大佐; the trio reached the third round of M-1 Grand Prix 2019 and split in October 2020; both brothers later retired, and カラムーちゃん opened the izakaya 酒とツマミ ちゅんま in Doyama with なりちゃん helping. Tabelog: opened October 3, 2024; operating company Charmeir Co., Ltd.

places.notes: [Teppanyaki · Kitashinchi, a late teppan bar with okonomiyaki] A sixteen-seat teppan bar on a Kitashinchi third floor reached by stairs, open weekday evenings until 1 am, where the master cooks at speed in front of the counter and the women on the floor keep regulars smiling. The menu runs from Inunaki pork okonomiyaki, grilled slowly for twenty minutes, to Saga beef steak, with regulars' standbys of a fluffy hamburg steak, shrimp chili mayo, garlic dishes and a spicy keema curry bread to take home. Omakase courses are ¥7,150 and ¥8,800; à la carte plates are small, so it can add up. One regular notes the chef switches spatulas between dishes. Smoking, including cigarettes, is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): teppanyaki in Kitashinchi, from local favourites like okonomiyaki to luxurious meat, with premium ingredients such as Saga beef, Inunaki pork and Bolivian rock salt. Diners: the master and several staff run it (November 2024); one cook handled everything at speed on a busy night (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Hamburg steak; Inunaki pork okonomiyaki; curry bread.

"It's one of the few places left where you can smoke regular paper cigarettes." — October 2025.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter talk with the master; friendly staff (2025–2026). No English evidence found.

positives: A regular says the chef changes the spatula for each dish to avoid mixing flavours (July 2026); not an allergy policy.
