places.notes: [Chinese · Higashi-Mikuni, a Showa-style takeaway canteen with cheap lunch sets] A tiny local Chinese kitchen two minutes from Higashi-Mikuni, where most of the trade goes out by delivery bike and phone, and the few seats inside sit among the bustle of four or five staff (2025–2026). The daily lunch set is the draw: a main such as pork kimchi with kara-age, shumai, salad, soup and endless rice for ¥850 (October 2026), served fast. Evenings bring the "Horoyoi Set", a drink and a spread of small plates. Diners call it greasy and Showa-era but filling; smoking is allowed inside, and it is cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Chinese restaurant two minutes from Higashi-Mikuni; delivery through Demae-can (the listing links its Demae-can page). Per reviews: "There were about three delivery bikes in front of the restaurant" (September 2023); "It seems that takeout is the main service, as there were continuous orders coming in" (February 2024); "about 4 to 5 staff members present" with phone and delivery orders (April 2025); "a slightly greasy, Showa-era local Chinese food atmosphere" (August 2025); some side items tasted pre-prepared or came out lukewarm (2022–2025); "Another impressive aspect was the speed of service" (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Daily lunch set with refills; Horoyoi Set.

anecdotes.text: "With this many options for only JPY 800, it’s an unbeatable price." — February 2024, daily lunch set.
"If you’re looking for a cheap, fast, and filling Chinese lunch around Higashi-Mikuni, this is definitely a place to remember." — October 2026, daily lunch ¥850.
"I was a bit surprised to see about five staff members in this cozy little restaurant!" — May 2026.

places.cuisine: Yakitori grilled over Kishu binchotan, fanned by hand (site) · omakase skewers, 7 or 10, chosen and ordered by the owner from the day's rare cuts (site): 7 for ¥1,800 (January 2026), 10 for ¥2,700 (February 2026) · skewers: breast with wasabi, gizzard, neck, liver, heart, skin, tsunagi, quail egg, wings with spices, tsukune with salt or rare, tomato, young corn, yagen cartilage (2023–2026) · chicken sashimi: breast ¥870 (January 2026), liver sashimi ¥900, rare-grilled hen ¥680 (February 2026); sasami-zukuri and liver pâté (site) · fried cartilage ¥500, kara-age, offal stew, eringi with anchovy butter, smoked prosciutto, ginkgo (2025–2026) · to finish: grilled rice ball in tea broth, chicken-soup chazuke ¥700, rice porridge (2025–2026) · seasonal: Iwate duck loin over charcoal; smoked prosciutto with fig (site, August 2026) · sake, shochu and wine chosen by the owner; draft Heartland ¥650 (site; January 2026) · raw tsukune, once famous, dropped after a TV feature brought too many orders (January 2026)
places.notes: [Yakitori · JR Higashi-Yodogawa, binchotan skewers and chicken sashimi, book ahead] An 18-seat yakitori shop two minutes from JR Higashi-Yodogawa, open since 2004 and usually fully booked. The owner grills over Kishu binchotan, fanning by hand, and the omakase of 7 or 10 skewers (¥1,800 or ¥2,700, 2026) runs through rare cuts in a set order, slightly rare and juicy. Chicken sashimi and liver sashimi are the other draw, and a grilled rice ball in tea broth is the usual finish. A diner says the owner trained at Ayamuya (October 2026). Closed Wednesdays; non-smoking; cards accepted.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site (toriya-en.com, read 2026-11-02): strong-heat Kishu binchotan; the owner judges each cut's moisture and fat and fans without pause; the omakase skewers, with the doneness and order chosen by the owner, are "the essence of Toriya, En"; sake, wine and shochu chosen by the owner; seats kept few so each skewer can be grilled with care. Per Tabelog: opened 1 March 2004. Per reviews: "The master, who has proper skills, comes from Ayamuya" (a regular since the opening, October 2026); raw tsukune was dropped after a TV feature by the duo Savannah brought a rush of orders (January 2026); "The staff is very friendly" (April 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Lock the umami inside with charcoal smoke, for "the powerful juiciness of the chicken itself" (site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase skewers over binchotan; chicken and liver sashimi.

anecdotes.text: "After the broadcast, we received so many orders for raw tsukune that we stopped offering it." — the staff, January 2026.
"Sitting right in front of the grill was quite an experience, as I watched delicious dishes being grilled that I hadn’t even ordered." — January 2026.
"Instead of going for the omakase skewers, I recommend ordering what you really want." — a regular since the opening, October 2026.

places.cuisine: Chicken and fish izakaya with charcoal grilling (Tabelog; reviews) · lunch sets with rice, miso soup, a small side and pickles; all under ¥1,000 (2024–2026): chicken nanban set ¥850 (July 2024), ¥900 (2025–2026); "Yamitsuki" kara-age set ¥850–900, sweet and savoury glaze (2024–2025); tsukimi tsukune set, two patties, ¥900 (September 2026); daily specials such as shrimp tempura bowl ¥800 (November 2024); small or large rice ±¥50 · evening: flounder, kanpachi and conger-eel sashimi (2024–2026); grilled jidori and Tanba chicken, neck and tail (2024–2026); grilled chicken neck with yuzu kosho ¥638, with green onion and ponzu ¥693 (January 2026); chicken tender tempura; yagen cartilage with yuzu kosho; fried oysters; grilled edamame; dashimaki tamago; hot pot in winter; shrimp mayo ¥693; garlic butter fries ¥473 (2024–2026) · course with all-you-can-drink ¥4,400 (February 2026) · sake, shochu and awamori (2024–2026)
places.notes: [Izakaya · Higashi-Mikuni, chicken and fish by day and night] A 26-seat izakaya a minute from Higashi-Mikuni Station, tucked into a back street off Shin-Midosuji, built around charcoal-grilled chicken and fresh fish. At lunch the owner often works alone, turning out chicken nanban with plenty of tartar sauce, kara-age or tsukimi tsukune sets for ¥900 in about five minutes (2026). In the evening it fills up for flounder or kanpachi sashimi, grilled jidori neck with yuzu kosho, dashimaki and a long sake and shochu list, or a ¥4,400 course with all-you-can-drink. Open to midnight; closed Sundays; cards accepted.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya for chicken and fish, with yakitori and chicken dishes; particular about vegetables and fish; opened 21 October 2015. Per reviews: "Although the owner runs the place alone, the service is efficient, taking less than five minutes from seating to serving" (lunch, September 2026); a young chef ran lunch single-handed and said "Fish is quite expensive, so I can’t keep it under JPY 1000. We do serve it occasionally for lunch, but chicken is our main focus" (October 2026); in the evening, efficient staff (September 2025) or a single staff member (February 2026); "Many of the other customers seemed to be regulars" (July 2024).

anecdotes.text: "A genius combination of seafood and local chicken. Both ingredients are excellent, likely due to high-quality suppliers." — December 2024.
"The Chicken Nanban was incredibly tender, and the tartar sauce was simply exquisite." — October 2026, ¥900 set.
"They even have Awamori and some unique Japanese sake, which made it a fun experience." — April 2026.

places.cuisine: Izakaya (Tabelog) · now (October 2025): renovated, serving Oita dishes such as "Ryukyu" and tori-ten, and kara-age made with the shop's broth · the name comes from tail (shippo) dishes (April 2024): oxtail hot pot finished with rice, grilled tail, "Shippo-yaki" (2020–2025); a diner still hoped to try the tail in May 2026 · vegetables sourced from Kumamoto and Kyushu (November 2020): the "luxury vegetable salad", half ¥780 (2019, 2024), with Batten Nasu from Kumamoto and Shizuka tomato from Hyogo (April 2024); homemade pickles ¥300 (2019) · Kenken bonito with homemade salsa and soy-koji ¥1,100; white asparagus with tuna kimchi ¥600 (April 2024) · shime-saba and fried tuna (April 2025) · beef-tendon dishes, wiener and beef-tendon fried rice (2020–2024) · highballs ¥440, wine bottles, sake chosen with the owner's advice (2024–2025)
places.notes: [Izakaya · JR Higashi-Yodogawa, a 1994 tail-and-vegetable izakaya now cooking Oita food] A 21-seat izakaya along the tracks two minutes from JR Higashi-Yodogawa, open since 1994, with a small counter and a tatami room. It made its name with tail dishes (shippo means tail) such as oxtail hot pot, and with a salad of rare vegetables from Kumamoto and Kyushu (2019–2024). A new chef took over (November 2024), and after a renovation it now serves Oita dishes such as "Ryukyu" and tori-ten (October 2025). The owner runs it alone, so food can take a while (April 2025), but gives good sake advice (December 2025). Closed Mondays and Tuesdays; PayPay, no cards.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 28 July 1994; izakaya particular about vegetables and fish; English-speaking staff listed. Per reviews: "The name Shippo Ya may sound fantastical, but it essentially means a place that serves tails" (April 2024); "They are committed to sourcing vegetables from Kumamoto and the Kyushu region" and "family-owned and closely connected to the community rather than being a chain" (November 2020); delivery begun during COVID-19 (2020); "The chef has changed, and the pickled cabbage is no longer available" (November 2024); "Since the owner runs the place alone, the wait time from ordering to receiving your food can be quite long" (April 2025); "Previously, the restaurant was known for its tail dishes … but it has since been renovated to offer Oita cuisine" (October 2025); "The owner's advice on Japanese sake is very helpful" (December 2025).

anecdotes.text: "Every vegetable is carefully selected, and I felt as if I was savoring the essence of each ingredient." — September 2024, on the vegetable salad, from a customer returning after 20 years.
"You can enjoy local specialties like Ryukyu and Tori Ten." — October 2025.
"The tail is perfectly simmered to a tender texture, yet retains its rich flavor." — December 2023, tail hot pot.

places.cuisine: Seafood Italian with fish delivered daily from the group's own fishmonger, 魚屋えび蔵 (Tabelog) · carpaccio of the day's fish, aqua pazza of whole sea bream with pasta in the leftover broth, sea-urchin cream spaghetti, pescatora bianca with akaza shrimp, squid with liver butter sauce, smoked-cheese frittata, sardine fish and chips, shirasu bruschetta, zeppole, arancini; house bread baked by AC Bagels (Tabelog menu, October 2026; reviews) · white and orange wine chosen by a sommelier; all-you-can-drink courses from ¥5,000
places.notes: [Italian · Ura Namba, a fishmonger's trattoria with white wine] A small seafood trattoria hidden in an Ura Namba back alley, opened in September 2024, where the fish comes daily from the group's own fishmonger and the wine list is white (and orange) only. Diners in 2026 go for the carpaccio, oysters, fish and chips, sea-urchin pasta and the whole sea-bream aqua pazza, finished with pasta tossed in the broth. Plates are small and cheap, so groups order many. Two diners who love red wine missed it; one found the tuna carpaccio tiny. Often full at weekends; book ahead.

roles: Kitchen staff unnamed; a sommelier chooses the white wines (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, fish comes daily from the group's own fishmonger 魚屋えび蔵 ("Uo-ya Ebizo"), and the bread is a special loaf baked by AC Bagels. Tabelog gives the opening as 13 September 2024.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Fresh and high-quality seasonal fish unique to our own fish shop" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Carpaccio and aqua pazza of the day's fish.

anecdotes.text: "The food was really good, but surprisingly, being an Italian restaurant, they only had white wine!" — July 2026.

"The sashimi was uniquely prepared to match the flavors of each fish, and it was delicious." — October 2026, farewell party.

places.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the oden broth is seafood and vegetable dashi (Tabelog), and the menu is meat and seafood.

UnionPay) and PayPay; no e-money. 36 seats: a first-floor counter and second-floor tables; smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Orders by smartphone or QR code (September 2026 reviews).

places.cuisine: Late-night yoshoku bar: Western-style oden in seafood and vegetable dashi (daikon with sea-urchin sauce, truffle-oil egg, trippa arrabbiata), kushikatsu with house Worcestershire sauce (beef menchi, black-pork demi katsu, eel katsu), "rare aji fry" of sashimi-grade horse mackerel, beef-tongue stew, truffle omurice, baked hamburg steak with two sauces, carbonara, ramen-style pasta to finish (Tabelog menu, September 2026; reviews) · house wine; 3-hour all-you-can-drink course
places.notes: [Yoshoku · Motomachi by JR Namba, oden, kushikatsu and omurice until 5 AM] A small two-floor yoshoku bar three minutes from JR Namba, open from 6 PM to 5 AM, mixing Western-style oden in a seafood-and-vegetable broth with kushikatsu, a rare-cooked aji fry, beef-tongue stew and truffle omurice. Diners in 2026 like the creative dishes and the late hours, handy for the hotels nearby; several found the portions small, which suits ordering many plates. A 10% charge applies after 10 PM, and smoking is allowed. A September 2026 review says it is run by SASAYA Holdings.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, the specialty is Western-style oden in seafood and vegetable dashi, kushikatsu with homemade Worcestershire sauce and a "rare aji fry" of sashimi-grade horse mackerel filleted in house. A September 2026 review says the shop is run by SASAYA Holdings, which has opened a takoyaki-and-oden concept nearby.

anecdotes.text: "The truffle omurice in the photo was especially exquisite!" — August 2026.
"Overall, the portion sizes felt a bit small!" — September 2026.
"Considering its proximity to the hotel and being open until 5 AM, this price seems reasonable." — September 2026.
"All the dishes were truly amazing, but the Beef Tongue Stew was particularly exquisite." — September 2026.

places.notes: [Chinese · Ura Namba, wagyu and Chinese cooking in a back alley] A Cantonese-Sichuan restaurant with a wooden, American-bar feel, tucked into a narrow Ura Namba alley where cars cannot pass, the main shop of a three-shop name now 20 years old. Since 2026 it has leaned into wagyu, from wagyu mapo tofu and mala yakisoba to Peking-duck-style crepes. Diners in 2026 praise the assorted appetizers, ebi mayo, the curry mapo tofu and creative takes on sweet and sour pork; one found it a bit pricey. Groups use the second floor and the party room; a September diner noticed many staff from abroad.

roles: Owner unnamed, who sources the ingredients (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the name has three shops: 難波本店, なんば2号店 (12 years old in 2026) and お初天神店; the main shop marks its 20th anniversary and in 2026 is partnering with 肉のにれ's Osaka office to bring in more wagyu, with a Kagoshima black-wagyu campaign; a party room behind the first-floor kitchen opened in December 2024. Per Tabelog, the owner sources the finest ingredients for authentic Cantonese and Sichuan food at reasonable prices, and dishes are available for takeout.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Authentic Cantonese and Sichuan cuisine at reasonable prices" (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The spacious interior is surprisingly large for the narrow alley in front, with a lovely atmosphere reminiscent of an American bar with wooden accents." — October 2026.
"I particularly liked the curry mapo tofu, which is something I don’t usually eat." — August 2026, group course.
"While it may be a bit pricey, the intricate dishes were enjoyable from start to finish." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: けむり屋＆FLOWER【本格中華】難波本店・なんば2号店・お初天神店、なんば2号店は2026年7月から月〜金17:00〜24:00・土祝と祝前日の日曜15:00〜24:00 (日曜定休、ランチは当面休み)、本店は20周年、2026年は肉のにれ大阪営業所と提携し和牛を多く取り入れ、鹿児島県産黒毛和牛のキャンペーン、2024年12月から本店1階キッチン奥に貸切専用の宴会場 (15〜40名)、なんば2号店は2026年で12周年。食べログ (英語版): 和牛と中華料理 けむり屋＆フラワー 大阪なんば本店、難波千日前6-12、月〜金17:00〜23:30、土日祝15:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、1月1〜2日休み、ランチ休止中、突き出し440円 (コースは除く)、110席、店主が仕入れる食材の本格広東・四川料理、テイクアウト可。メニュー (2025年11月): 和牛のたたきユッケ、松阪牛とフォアグラ、和牛麻婆豆腐、和牛の麻辣焼きそば、和牛チャーハン、和牛の北京ダック風クレープ、よだれ鶏、棒棒鶏、ふかひれの姿煮。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月): 前菜盛り合わせ、エビマヨ、カレー麻婆豆腐、締めの担々麺、酢豚や辛い鶏のひと工夫、木のアメリカンバーのような内装、狭い路地、少し高めという声、外国人スタッフが多いという声。

places.neighborhood: Nishi-Shinsaibashi 2-13-5, Amerikamura — 5 min from Namba Stn (subway) and Kintetsu Osaka-Namba
places.cuisine: American-style burgers and sandwiches: the Grand Slam (thick patty, crispy fried onions, mashed potato; 4th at the Japan Burger Championship 2024, per a review), bacon cheeseburger, mozzarella burger, Mooki burger with bacon jam, golden beef melt cheese egg sandwich, nuggets with a smoky flavour, fries, hamburg steak (reviews) · craft beer at the group (Walker+, 2018)
places.notes: [Burgers · Amerikamura, American diner since 2013] A small American-style burger shop in Amerikamura, open since July 2013, the first shop of a founder who, in the founder's own words, learned burgers from Google and YouTube. The tall Grand Slam with crispy fried onions and mashed potato is the signature; diners in 2026 also order the bacon cheeseburger, the mozzarella burger and the beef-melt egg sandwich. Most call the burgers juicy and hearty; a May 2026 diner was not greeted on entering and found it unremarkable. An October diner found the room full of guests from abroad.

chef_bio.background: Per Walker+ (May 2018), 安藤啓示, born in Osaka, joined a Nagoya design company after university, quit, and through an acquaintance went to work at a ramen shop, where after a month of learning the cooking and the business 安藤 became the manager; two years later 安藤 came home to Osaka wanting to run a restaurant, saw Harajuku's Great Burger in a magazine and decided on burgers. With no burger training, "my burger teachers were Google and YouTube". The article describes three shops in Osaka pairing burgers with craft beer, including the Nishihommachi shop.

anecdotes.text: "This hamburger ranked 4th in Japan at the "Japan Burger Championship 2024."" — September 2026, Grand Slam.
"However, as soon as I entered the restaurant, no one greeted me, which was a bit disappointing right from the start." — May 2026.
"The restaurant has an American vibe and is filled with foreign customers!" — October 2026, bacon cheeseburger.
"With no burger training, my burger teachers were Google and YouTube." — 安藤啓示 to Walker+, May 2018 (translated).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ウォーカープラス (2018年5月): 大阪で3店舗展開するハンバーガー×クラフトビール店「リッチガーデン」、代表の安藤啓示さん、ハンバーガーの修行経験はなく先生は『Google』と『YouTube』、大阪出身、大学卒業後に名古屋のデザイン会社に就職し退職、知り合いの紹介でラーメン店で働き1か月で作り方と経営を学び店長に、2年後に大阪へ戻り、雑誌で原宿の『グレイトバーガー』を見てハンバーガーに、西本町店。食べログ (英語版): RICHGARDEN 心斎橋本店、西心斎橋2-13-5、2013年7月19日オープン、毎日12:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、ランチの予約不可、24席、禁煙。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月): グランドスラム (Japan Burger Championship 2024で4位という声、2,100円)、ベーコンチーズバーガー、モッツァレラバーガー、ベーコンジャムのバーガー、ゴールデンビーフメルトチーズエッグサンド1,750円、ナゲット、ハンバーグ、アメリカンな雰囲気、外国からの客が多い、入店時に挨拶がなかったという声。
